Title: Tumen Government Builds a Bridge for People's Livelihood, Citizens Walk the Road to Happiness Content: In 2017, the Tumen Municipal Committee and Municipal Government once again included work and projects related to people's livelihood in their work report, such as building a happy Tumen with ethnic characteristics, fully improving people's livelihood, adhering to targeted poverty alleviation, strengthening livelihood security, and continuously enhancing the people's happiness index. Since the beginning of this year, efforts to build livelihood projects have been intensified, constructing a bridge to a moderately prosperous society for the masses, allowing citizens to embark on the path to happiness. ★ Opening a Route: No More Detours for High-Speed Rail Travel On September 20, 2015, the Changchun-Hunchun Intercity Railway, known as the 'Most Beautiful High-Speed Railway in Northeast China,' was officially opened. This was a great benefit for residents along the route. However, the residents of Shixian Town could not rejoice, especially those in villages like Xiangyang, Dalazi, and Xiaga. Although separated from the high-speed rail station only by a river, villagers had to detour tens of kilometers to access the station. According to the construction party, in October 2015, the Tumen Bypass Line of National Highway Huna, with a total investment of 250 million yuan, officially commenced. After two years of construction, the 6-kilometer-long project, built to first-class highway standards, including bridges and roadbeds, has been connected and is in the final stages of pavement laying. Once completed, this bypass line will not only alleviate traffic pressure on National Highway 302 but also shorten the distance between residents in the northern mountainous areas of Tumen City and the high-speed rail station. Particularly for villagers in Xiangyang and other villages, it will only take a 5-minute walk to reach the station. ★ Building a Platform: Improving National Fitness Levels In July this year, the Tumen Bureau of Culture, Radio, Television, and News independently raised 5.06 million yuan to construct the Tumen National Fitness Center at the intersection of Jinshui South Street and Yingchun Road. The project has a total construction area of 7,480 square meters, including a new standard 11-a-side football field, a caged 5-a-side football field, and four gateball courts. According to Xu Minghua, Director of the Bureau, to meet the people's growing demands for a better life, the Tumen government has consistently included national fitness projects in its practical projects for the people in recent years. So far, 80% of the project has been completed. Upon completion, it will not only meet national fitness needs but also address the shortage of venues for events. ★ Relieving Pressure: Daycare for the Elderly Warms Hearts On the morning of December 8, reporters saw a recently renovated building facade next to the Xinhua Border Police Station on Tumen Port Street. A staff member explained that this is the renovation project of the Tumen Elderly Care Center, specifically the Day Care Center for the Elderly. Tumen is a border city where many young people work away from home, leading to a severe aging population trend. Many elderly people lack daytime care. To promote social harmony and stability, the Civil Affairs Bureau invested over 5 million yuan to build this center. Che Wenzhe, project manager of Tumen Jinshan Construction and Installation Co., Ltd., stated that the Day Care Center for the Elderly is a 'eldercare' project established by street communities for individuals over 60 years old who lack daytime care. Children can drop off their elderly parents here during work hours, where they can enjoy services like fitness and medical care, and pick them up after work. The center is expected to be operational around the Spring Festival next year. ★ Support Projects Benefit Poor Households in Four Villages At the soybean deep processing project base in Qixin Village, Yueqing Town, Tumen City, Jin Zhenquan, legal representative of the Tumen Hometown Farmers' Professional Cooperative, reported that since 2015, after the village established the cooperative, ownership of the project shifted to collective ownership. The city and town governments invested a total of 1.95 million yuan from whole-village advancement, poverty alleviation, and east-west pairing assistance funds. While expanding the factory and increasing production capacity, the project also boosted the rapid development of the collective economy. The processing plant returns 8% of the investment annually to the town government for unified distribution, benefiting 168 impoverished villagers in Qixin Village and four surrounding administrative villages.

Title: Joint Trial | How to Qualify Profits from Reselling a Property Purchased at Low Price? Content: Click the "Blue Text" above to follow us! How to Qualify Profits from Reselling a Property Purchased at Low Price? Starting from the Case of Zhang Weidong, Former Party Branch Secretary and Director of Luzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center, Sichuan Province. Chart: Zhang Han. Invited Guests: Zhang Xiaogang, Deputy Director of the Third Discipline Inspection and Supervision Office of Luzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection; Han Shaohua, Deputy Director of the Case Adjudication Office of Luzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection; Mei Zhicai, Director of the Second Prosecutorial Department of Xuyong County People's Procuratorate, Luzhou; Zhang Yong, Vice President of Xuyong County People's Court, Luzhou. Editor's Note: In this case, from 2009 to 2013, Xiong gave Zhang Weidong cash totaling 15,000 yuan on multiple occasions under the guise of holiday greetings. Why was this 15,000 yuan included in Zhang Weidong's bribery amount? In 2017, Zhang Weidong signed a housing presale contract with Zhao's company for a total price of over 570,000 yuan. In 2018, he resold the property to another person for 1.127 million yuan. How should the bribery amount and bribery proceeds be calculated in this matter? We invite relevant staff to analyze. The picture shows staff from the Case Adjudication Office and the Third Discipline Inspection and Supervision Office of Luzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection discussing the Zhang Weidong case. Photo by Yang Zhensen. Basic Case Facts: Zhang Weidong, male, joined the Communist Party of China in June 1991. He formerly served as Deputy Director of Luzhou Agricultural Comprehensive Development Leading Group Office, Section Chief of Economic Construction Division and Fund Management Division of Luzhou Municipal Finance Bureau, Director of Luzhou Municipal Government Financial Supervisor Office, Party Branch Secretary and Director of Luzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center, and other positions. Violation of the Central Eight Regulations spirit. From 2013 to 2022, while serving as Section Chief of Fund Management Division of Luzhou Municipal Finance Bureau, Director of Luzhou Municipal Government Financial Supervisor Office, and Party Branch Secretary and Director of Luzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center, Zhang Weidong successively accepted gifts of cash totaling 18,000 yuan (same currency below), gifts (worth 52,000 yuan), and 8 consumption cards (worth 40,000 yuan) from management and service objects. Bribery. From 2008 to 2022, Zhang Weidong took advantage of his position to seek benefits for others in business contracting, provident fund loans, and other aspects, accepting property totaling over 3.56 million yuan. Among them, in June 2010, while serving as Section Chief of Fund Management Division of Luzhou Municipal Finance Bureau, Xiong, a boss, in order to gain Zhang Weidong's favor for his company's related business, actively proposed a loan request to Zhang Weidong when there was no actual funding need, verbally promising monthly interest of 3% paid quarterly. Zhang Weidong knew that Xiong had no actual funding need but still agreed. Thereafter, Zhang Weidong lent Xiong principal totaling 450,000 yuan on three occasions. In 2018, due to the investigation of other personnel in the municipal finance system, Zhang Weidong demanded that Xiong return all principal and end the lending relationship. By then, Xiong had paid Zhang Weidong interest totaling 1.386 million yuan. In addition, from 2009 to 2013, in order to gain Zhang Weidong's favor, Xiong gave Zhang Weidong cash of 3,000 yuan on five occasions under the guise of holiday greetings, totaling 15,000 yuan, all of which Zhang Weidong accepted. Upon investigation, from 2009 to 2018, Zhang Weidong accepted bribes totaling over 1.5 million yuan from Xiong. At the end of 2017, Zhang Weidong actively approached Zhao, legal representative of a real estate company, demanding to purchase a property developed by the company at a low price. Zhao, considering Zhang Weidong's restraining effect on the company's provident fund loan business, agreed to gain Zhang Weidong's favor. In December of the same year, Zhang Weidong signed a housing presale contract for a total price of over 570,000 yuan (the market price at the time of transaction was determined to be over 1.06 million yuan). In December 2018, Zhang Weidong resold the property to another person for 1.127 million yuan. Investigation Process: [Filing for Review and Investigation] On August 28, 2022, the Luzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision filed a case for review and investigation of Zhang Weidong's serious violations of discipline and law, and took detention measures on September 6. [Party Discipline and Government Sanctions] On March 1, 2023, after deliberation at the meeting of the Standing Committee of Luzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and with the approval of the Luzhou Municipal Party Committee, it was decided to expel Zhang Weidong from the Party; the Municipal Supervisory Committee gave him dismissal from public office. [Transfer for Review and Prosecution] On March 2, 2023, the Luzhou Municipal Supervisory Committee transferred Zhang Weidong's suspected bribery case to the Luzhou Municipal People's Procuratorate. On March 3, 2023, the Luzhou Municipal People's Procuratorate designated the Xuyong County People's Procuratorate to review and prosecute according to law. [Initiating Public Prosecution] On April 13, 2023, the Xuyong County People's Procuratorate initiated public prosecution against Zhang Weidong for bribery at the Xuyong County People's Court. [First Instance Judgment] On August 18, 2023, the Xuyong County People's Court sentenced Zhang Weidong to six years in prison for bribery and a fine of 500,000 yuan. The judgment is now in effect. From 2009 to 2013, Xiong gave Zhang Weidong cash totaling 15,000 yuan on multiple occasions under the guise of holiday greetings. Why was this 15,000 yuan included in Zhang Weidong's bribery amount? Zhang Xiaogang: Upon investigation, from 2009 to 2013, Xiong gave Zhang Weidong small amounts of cash on multiple occasions under the guise of holiday greetings, 3,000 yuan each time, totaling 15,000 yuan, all of which Zhang Weidong accepted. There were two different opinions on the qualification of Zhang Weidong's above behavior: constituting bribery crime or violating gift acceptance regulations. After analysis and research, we believe that Zhang Weidong's above behavior constitutes bribery. In practice, distinguishing between violating gift acceptance regulations and bribery should focus on analyzing whether the actor has the characteristics of power-for-money transactions. Essentially, bribery is a two-way transaction behavior, while violating gift acceptance regulations does not have explicit transactionality. Although the giver's property does not point to specific official duties and interests, it may affect the recipient's fair execution of official duties. Therefore, Party members and cadres who constitute violating gift acceptance regulations have not sought benefits for others; state workers who constitute bribery must meet the objective requirement of seeking benefits for others. According to Article 13 of the Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Embezzlement and Bribery issued by the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, if a state worker solicits or accepts property worth more than 30,000 yuan from a subordinate with a superior-subordinate relationship or a managed person with an administrative management relationship, which may affect the exercise of authority, it is deemed a promise to seek benefits for others.

Title: Kuancheng District CPPCC Inspects Enterprise Work Safety Content: Kuancheng District CPPCC Inspects Enterprise Work Safety Time: 2013-05-31 00:00 Source: 【Font: Large Medium Small 】 Print On May 29, the Kuancheng District CPPCC conducted an inspection of work safety across the district. Comrade Zou Na, Deputy District Head of the district government, accompanied the inspection. Comrade Gao Xumeng, Director of the District Work Safety Supervision Bureau, gave a special report on the progress of the work titled "Strengthening Safety Supervision, Building a Happy Kuancheng". At 2:30 PM, Wang Xiaojun, Vice Chairman of the District CPPCC, and some members of the District CPPCC Committee, accompanied by Gao Xumeng, Director of the District Work Safety Supervision Bureau, Wu Xianjun, Deputy Director, and others, visited Tianli Machinery in the Kuancheng Economic Development Zone and Jilin Forest Industry Group. They listened to reports from the enterprise leaders on production, operations, management, and the implementation of the enterprises' primary responsibility for work safety. They went deep into the workshop floors to inspect fire protection equipment, employee work procedures, operations, and the use of labor protection tools. Vice Chairman Wang Xiaojun and the CPPCC members had open discussions with enterprise leaders and employees on ensuring safety in all aspects of production. The inspection team fully affirmed the achievement of zero fatal work accidents for three consecutive years in the district. They expressed satisfaction with the district's work safety supervision and management approach, which focuses on small details, and implements measures such as weekly self-inspections, monthly checks, and quarterly re-inspections. Vice Chairman Wang Xiaojun highly praised the achievements in the district's work safety. He pointed out that the District Party Committee and government attach great importance to work safety, consistently treating it as a key task for implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development and governing for the people, reflecting the philosophy of governing for the people and scientific development. He suggested that in future work, it is necessary to further strengthen the safety foundation, optimize safety measures, implement work responsibilities, increase safety investment, and achieve safe development for enterprises. Efforts should focus on four key areas: First, intensify publicity efforts in work safety, select and promote various safety models widely within the district. Second, rigorously carry out the identification, rectification, and re-inspection of potential work safety hazards. Third, establish a long-term mechanism for work safety to ensure persistent safety prevention, making new contributions to the safe and healthy economic and social development of Kuancheng.

Title: [Listed Company Cases] Warning and Learning: Summary of Top Ten Cases of A-Share Listed Companies Being Defrauded. Content: Recently, a development attracted market attention: the CSRC first issued a Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty, and several months later withdrew the administrative penalty. On November 17, 2023, Company A was investigated by the CSRC for suspected illegal acts such as unauthorized change of raised funds use and failure to truthfully disclose the deposit and actual use of raised funds. In May 2024, Company A received the Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty from the CSRC, which decided to issue warnings and fines to Company A, its chairman, CFO, and board secretary, totaling approximately 4.9 million yuan. However, a few months later, the situation took a turn: the CSRC believed that Company A was a first-time offender and that the actual controller had actively taken remedial measures, so it decided not to impose administrative penalties on Company A and related personnel, closing the case. Notably, the matter of failure to truthfully disclose the deposit and use of raised funds involved in Company A was related to the company being defrauded by high-interest wealth management products. Wealth Management Fraud Case 1: Believing in High-Interest Wealth Management Led to Funds Being Transferred. Specifically, to improve the efficiency of capital use and increase returns, Company A decided to use idle raised funds for cash management. Considering that the interest rates offered by large-denomination certificates of deposit products at several local banks were relatively low, the company consulted multiple institutions about the returns of principal-protected products, hoping to purchase principal-protected products meeting expected returns. During this process, the head of the company's investment department met Sun, a deposit and wealth management intermediary, through a friend. Sun introduced that banks usually have strong demand for deposits at the end of the first quarter, and connected with multiple banks including China Merchants Bank Nanjing Chengbei Sub-branch (hereinafter referred to as the Deposit Bank) that could offer higher-yield deposit products. Subsequently, Company A decided to purchase the deposit bank's deposit and wealth management products. Sun promised an annualized interest rate of approximately 4% for this deposit attraction amount, of which 1.55% deposit interest would be paid after the deposit matured. Sun stated that the amount corresponding to the promised floating interest would be transferred to the company's account by the relevant party before the end of the first quarter. However, the company did not sign any agreement with the deposit bank or Sun regarding this approximately 4% interest rate, nor did it obtain written confirmation documents from Sun or the deposit bank. Moreover, Company A did not question the authenticity of this deposit business and interest rate, nor did it verify further with the deposit bank. On March 30, 2023, the company deposited 60 million yuan of idle raised funds into the deposit bank to achieve deposit returns. On the same day the funds were deposited into the deposit bank account, 59.95 million yuan was converted into margin deposits for external bank acceptance bills. On October 7, 2023, 59.95 million yuan was transferred out of the company account. The basis for handling was that the funds were used as margin for issuing bank acceptance bills, and the margin was transferred after the bank acceptance bills matured. On October 9, 2023, two days after the funds were transferred, Company A discovered that 59.95 million yuan was not in the deposit bank account. Thereafter, the company reported to the Jiangsu Regulatory Bureau of the National Financial Regulatory Administration and filed a case with the Economic Investigation Detachment of Nanjing Municipal Public Security Bureau with materials. The actual controller of the company made a commitment to advance the payment. The following month, Company A received an inquiry letter from the regulator and a notice of filing from the CSRC. Although the CSRC ultimately withdrew the administrative penalty against the company, this case shows that for listed companies, raising awareness of fraud prevention, verifying information from multiple parties, and improving the effectiveness of internal control management are very important; otherwise, they will still fall into the trap. Handing Consulting retrieved and collected other types and situations of listed companies being defrauded, finding that the types of fraud against listed companies can generally be divided into two categories: telecom fraud and contract fraud. Contract fraud scenarios include acquisition cases, signing large orders, and suspects stealthily substituting materials, among others. Some cases are listed below for sharing and warning. Telecom Fraud Case 2: The Largest Telecom Fraud Against an A-Share Listed Company. The fraudster forged multiple emails. Company B announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary recently suffered telecom fraud by a criminal gang, with the involved amount being approximately 11.7 million euros (approximately 92 million yuan), exceeding Company B's net profit after non-recurring items in the first three quarters of 2023 (85.35 million yuan), making it the largest telecom fraud against an A-share listed company. According to management interviews and IT data restoration, on December 13, 2023, the general manager of the subsidiary received an email from the fraud suspect impersonating his superior, stating that the company planned a secret acquisition. To avoid information leakage, the suspect requested the subsidiary's assistance and absolute confidentiality, requiring him to sign a confidentiality agreement and instructing him to complete the payment himself before the transaction was publicly disclosed and to conceal the operation. The general manager of the subsidiary took a series of actions to try to confirm the identity of the fraud suspect but apparently failed to identify anomalies. From December 13, 2023, to January 3, 2024, the general manager of the subsidiary received multiple rounds of instructions from the fraud suspect through forged emails of company executives, external lawyers, and auditors, and arranged payments exceeding 11.7 million euros without approval or notifying others in the company. After detecting anomalies, Company B reported to local police and closely cooperated with Italian police to trace the fraud gang. Meanwhile, Company B also hired a law firm and established an independent third-party investigation team for a comprehensive investigation. The special investigation team was led by the company's independent director and entrusted with an internationally leading forensic investigation team, working in coordination with the law firm. Case 3: Employee's Corporate Email Hacked Led to Information Leakage. Company C's annual report shows that during the reporting period, a subsidiary suffered telecom fraud, causing losses of approximately 23.3019 million yuan. After the incident, the subsidiary reported to Chinese public security authorities, and police have filed a case and launched investigation and handling. Police investigation found that the subsidiary's employee was suspected of being hacked by the perpetrator abroad while accessing the Internet at a hotel during a visit to a supplier in Italy, gaining access to business information between the subsidiary and the supplier.

Title: Trademark Rights Protection Wins Public Support, Sincere Thanks from the Masses Content: Trademark Rights Protection Wins Public Support, Sincere Thanks from the Masses – The Trademark Registration Window of the Provincial Market Supervision Administration Earns Gratitude for Serving the People. On July 23, the Trademark Registration Window of the Provincial Market Supervision Administration in the Provincial Government Affairs Service Hall received a thank-you letter from Huayin Yinshi Malatang Restaurant in Chengxi District, Xining City, expressing gratitude for the warm and thoughtful service of the window staff. On the morning of July 21, Mr. Yin Jianhua came to the Trademark Registration Window of the Provincial Market Supervision Administration to inquire about trademark registration-related business. After understanding the situation, the window staff found that the original trademark "Xigang Huayin Yinshi Malatang" had been maliciously registered by others. The window staff promptly searched for relevant materials, explained how to protect his rights and promptly file an objection with the National Intellectual Property Office, informed him how to find and collect evidence favorable to him to protect his rights, and suggested that he register all other unregistered trademark categories to better protect his legal rights from infringement. The staff at the Trademark Registration Window of the Provincial Market Supervision Administration were warm, thorough, patient, and meticulous, providing the necessary application documents for the registrant to avoid unnecessary trips. They also handled the matter as a special case, speeding up the trademark registration process and helping Yin Jianhua successfully complete the trademark registration, registering all the unregistered categories on the same day. Mr. Yin said: "Now it's really convenient for ordinary people to handle affairs. The services like warm guidance upon entry, form filling, problem solving, and extended hours are all excellent. It's very comfortable and warm to handle things here, and the efficiency is very high!" This seemingly ordinary thank-you letter demonstrates that the staff at the Provincial Government Affairs Service Hall window have fulfilled their promise of allowing the public to "make at most one trip" with practical actions. It is not only recognition of the government service work but also the best support and motivation for the window staff. In the future, the window staff will continue to adhere to the service tenet of "integrity and standardization, convenience and efficiency," optimize processes, reduce steps, shorten time limits, provide more efficient and high-quality services for enterprises and the public across the province, continuously improve the service level of government service windows, and comprehensively enhance public satisfaction.

Title: Laobian District: Promoting the Resolution of Enforcement Difficulties, Special Supervision Alleviates People's Worries
Content: "Our back wages have been paid, and we finally feel at ease!" Recently, when staff from the Laobian District Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision in Yingkou City conducted a telephone follow-up with Song, who had been owed wages, Song happily expressed. In 2023, a machinery development company in Laobian District, due to poor management, owed wages to Song and 42 other workers. Song and the other 43 workers filed a lawsuit in the district court. After winning the case, they applied to the court for compulsory enforcement. However, because the person subject to enforcement had financial difficulties and their factory buildings and equipment had been subleased, the enforcement payment had not been received. The District Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision adhered to a problem-oriented approach, closely monitored the prominent issue of "difficult court enforcement" strongly reflected by the masses, and carried out special supervision. They strengthened tracking and supervision, randomly selected and reviewed some enforcement case files, and used methods such as participating in coordination meetings, heart-to-heart talks, and reviewing documents to keep abreast of progress. They supervised and rectified outstanding problems in enforcement work, such as failure to file cases, passive enforcement, selective enforcement, and chaotic enforcement, effectively breaking through the "middle-level obstruction" in enforcement work and promoting achievements in the "practical resolution of enforcement difficulties" effort. Under the supervision of the District Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision, the District People's Court conducted a comprehensive investigation into the property status of the person subject to enforcement using online and offline control methods, detailedly assessed their repayment ability, and effectively protected the rights of the applicants. At the same time, they actively promoted negotiation and mediation between the two parties, striving to facilitate a settlement between the workers owed wages and the person subject to enforcement. Ultimately, through the efforts of the District People's Court, the over 500,000 yuan in wages owed by the company to Song and the other 43 workers were fully paid. Under the supervision of the Laobian District Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision, as of now, the District People's Court has handled 781 enforcement cases, concluded enforcement applications for 643 individuals, and enforced funds totaling 13.62 million yuan. "Court enforcement must adhere to a people-centered approach,坚持善意执行、文明执行 (persist in善意执行、文明执行),既要维护申请人的合法权益，又考虑到被申请人的实际困难，为全区营商环境的优化提供有力的司法保障 (both safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the applicants and consider the actual difficulties of the respondents, providing strong judicial guarantees for the optimization of the district's business environment)." said the relevant responsible person of the District Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision.

Title: Provincial Leaders Inspect Work Safety of Commercial Self-built Houses in Fuzhou_Dangerous Building Renovation and Appraisal_Fuzhou Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau Content: Provincial leaders came to Fuzhou to inspect work safety of commercial self-built houses. Time: 2023-01-19 09:53 Document Number: To thoroughly implement the important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping regarding the "4·29" Changsha self-built house collapse accident and the requirements of Premier Li Keqiang's directives, the municipal party committee and government attached great importance. They successively carried out the "100-day campaign" and "follow-up review" for risk investigation and remediation of commercial self-built houses citywide. A total of 52,946 commercial self-built houses were documented and recorded in the Fujian Provincial Housing Information Platform. Among them, 19 houses with major safety hazards and 73 houses with general safety hazards have been rectified, and all are now fully addressed. In accordance with the relevant requirements and deployments of the State Council and the provincial party committee and government, our city aims to complete the investigation and documentation of all self-built houses by the end of June this year. Currently, related work is progressing orderly. The provincial party committee and government place high importance on the work safety of commercial self-built houses in our city. On the morning of January 18, Vice Governor Lin Wenbin led a team to conduct an on-site inspection of work safety for commercial self-built houses in Jin'an District, affirming Fuzhou's housing safety management efforts. He also emphasized that while achievements have been made, complacency must be avoided, and work safety management tasks should continue to be done well during the year-end and beginning of the new year. Due to historical reasons, self-built houses are relatively complex, especially requiring close attention to the safety of self-built houses in densely populated areas and urban-rural fringes. By implementing the挂牌巡检制度 (placard inspection system) and pilot projects for housing insurance monitoring, commercial self-built houses should be strengthened in monitoring and daily management to ensure the safety of people's lives and property.

Title: Prosecutorial Content: Carrying out the special campaign to combat organized crime and root out local mafia is a major deployment made by the Party Central Committee during the decisive stage of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and as socialism with Chinese characteristics enters a new era. Since the Party Central Committee decided in 2018 to carry out the special campaign nationwide, our procuratorate has established an office for combating organized crime and rooting out local mafia, established multiple work systems, fully performed the procuratorial supervision function, actively leveraged the advantages of litigation system reform, the reform of the case handling mechanism integrating arrest and prosecution, and other reforms, strived to overcome difficulties, and achieved phased results in the work of combating organized crime and rooting out local mafia. Criminal activities of organized crime and local mafia within our jurisdiction have been effectively curbed. The disposal of involved property is an important task in handling cases of organized crime and local mafia, and is also an issue that inevitably arises in every such case. The standardized disposal of involved property helps achieve the penal goal of combating organized crime and local mafia, and relates to whether the economic foundation of mafia-style organizations and evil forces can be completely destroyed. Therefore, doing a good job in the procuratorial supervision of involved property in cases of organized crime and local mafia, and truly achieving 'cutting off financial resources and bleeding them dry', is an issue we must currently emphasize. I. Analysis of the Current Situation of Involved Property in Cases of Organized Crime and Local Mafia In 2015, the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council issued the 'Opinions on Further Regulating the Disposal of Property Involved in Criminal Litigation', providing guidance for the disposal of property involved in criminal cases; after the special campaign to combat organized crime and root out local mafia began in January 2018, the 'Two Supremes and Two Ministries' formulated and issued the 'Guiding Opinions on Several Issues in Handling Criminal Cases Involving Mafia-style Organizations and Evil Forces', unifying the law enforcement philosophy for handling such cases and clarifying the standards of law enforcement; in April 2019, the 'Two Supremes and Two Ministries' jointly issued four opinions on handling cases of combating organized crime and rooting out local mafia, among which the 'Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Disposal of Property in Criminal Cases Involving Mafia-style Organizations and Evil Forces' regulated the disposal of property related to organized crime and local mafia, further providing rules for our work in disposing of property involved in criminal cases of mafia-style organizations and evil forces. Last year, our procuratorate prosecuted a total of 4 cases involving 40 people for crimes of a mafia-style nature. Taking the case of Hao Moumou and others suspected of organizing and leading a mafia-style organization, illegal detention, and extortion as an example, the case involved 19 defendants, 8 charges, and 23 criminal facts. The criminal organization primarily used soft violence, repeatedly and organizedly employing methods such as harassment, pestering, causing disturbances, and gathering crowds to create momentum to carry out illegal and criminal activities, perpetrating evils, oppressing and harming the masses, amassing substantial illegal economic benefits, severely disrupting the local normal economic and social order, causing恶劣影响 among the masses, and threatening the personal and property safety of the people. During the investigation stage of this case, involved property such as bank cards, cash, vehicles, and real estate was seized, frozen, and sealed off according to law; during the review and prosecution stage, opinions on the disposal of the relevant involved property were proposed respectively; during the trial stage, the court, after hearing the case, sentenced according to law the confiscation of all personal property of two defendants including Hao Moumou, and fines ranging from 15,000 to 260,000 yuan for other defendants. After the first-instance judgment, defendants including Hao Moumou appealed, and the court ruled to dismiss the appeal and uphold the original judgment. After the ruling took effect, the procuratorial supervision of the execution of property punishments became one of the key focuses of our next work. In handling such cases, we found that, on the one hand, cases of organized crime and local mafia are subject to the general provisions for ordinary criminal cases, and in practice, there are不规范现象 such as illegal seizure,扣押, freezing measures and illegal handling of involved property; on the other hand, cases of organized crime and local mafia have particularities. Their crimes generally last for a long time, involve many people, and the property related to organized crime and local mafia has wide sources, large scale, diverse forms, and complex composition, types, and circulation situations. Coupled with criminals intentionally laundering money and disguising illegal gains in legal forms, and the mixing of legal property with property related to organized crime and local mafia, it objectively increases the difficulty of定性 and disposing of involved property; moreover, existing regulations are relatively fragmented and principled, and there is no unified standard among public security, procuratorates, and courts for the disposal of involved property. How to ascertain the involved property, distinguish between property related to organized crime and local mafia and legal property, propose appropriate sentencing suggestions for property punishments, and enhance the rigidity of procuratorial supervision over involved property are all problems existing in practice. II. Several Thoughts on the Involved Property in Cases of Organized Crime and Local Mafia The procuratorial supervision of involved property in cases of organized crime and local mafia should run through the entire criminal procedure. This article specifically discusses my thoughts from three perspectives: guiding the investigation of involved property, sentencing suggestions for property punishments, and supervising the disposal of involved property: 1. Strictly grasp the identification standards for property related to organized crime and local mafia, and comprehensively investigate the involved property in such cases. By intervening early in cases of organized crime and local mafia, guide the public security organs to ascertain and control the involved property to the greatest extent possible. Conduct evidence review and judgment on the involved property seized, frozen, or扣押 according to law, comprehensively investigate and analyze the property status of the mafia-style organization and its members. If necessary, establish a special investigation team for involved property, contact auditing, banking, and other institutions to ascertain the source, nature, purpose, ownership, value, etc., of the involved property, and accurately distinguish between property related to organized crime and local mafia and other legal property, as well as between the personal property of the involved persons and the property of family members; supervise the public security organs to dispose of involved property strictly in accordance with legal conditions and procedures, and promptly return legal property. At the same time, prevent situations where the recovery and confiscation of involved property are insufficient, and criminal proceeds continue to be possessed by criminals. For situations where property coercive measures are improperly taken or there are procedural violations or work flaws affecting the disposal of involved property, promptly提出监督意见 to protect the legitimate rights and interests of relevant right holders. 2. Reasonably apply the system of leniency for admitting guilt and accepting punishment, and propose opinions on the handling of involved property and precise sentencing suggestions. During the handling of cases of organized crime and local mafia, strengthen communication and contact with public security organs and courts. By establishing a mechanism for consultation and coordination among public security, procuratorates, and courts, strengthen cooperation and promote the effective connection of investigation, arrest, prosecution, and trial work; do a good job in explaining the law and reasoning regarding the system of voluntary admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment. When prosecuting a case, clearly list the name, quantity, value, source, etc., of the involved property in legal documents such as the 'Review Report', propose opinions and suggestions for the disposal of involved property item by item, and state the reasons and basis; on the basis of full communication with the criminal suspect, defender, or duty lawyer, propose targeted and precise sentencing suggestions according to the criminal facts of the involved persons and their attitude towards admitting guilt, especially regarding the property punishment part of the accessory punishment, to maximize the correspondence between crime and punishment, ensuring the punishment fits the crime. 3. Give full play to the role of criminal execution supervision and strengthen the supervision of the execution of property punishments. Conduct a comprehensive verification and cleanup of the adjudication and execution of fine punishments, confiscation of property punishments, and confiscation of illegal gains in criminal judgments of cases of organized crime and local mafia, as well as the disposal of involved property. Form special files for property punishments in cases of organized crime and local mafia, check and establish data information for each person, conduct procuratorial supervision at every stage from case filing to execution, establish a notification mechanism for the execution status of property punishments in such cases, regularly and irregularly notify work information, update data in real time, implement dynamic supervision, continuously follow up on the execution activities and progress of property punishments. When discovering problems such as failure to execute到位 or irregular execution, promptly propose procuratorial suggestions or correction opinions to promote the smooth and lawful execution of property punishments in cases of organized crime and local mafia, ensuring the purpose of severely punishing crimes of organized crime and local mafia is achieved from the perspective of criminal execution. The special campaign to combat organized crime and root out local mafia matters to the overall stability of society and the long-term peace and order of the nation. This year is the decisive year for achieving the goals of the special campaign. We must maintain a state of never slacking, further发挥 the role of procuratorial supervision in the special campaign, increase the intensity of procuratorial supervision over involved property in cases of organized crime and local mafia,依法 destroy the economic foundation of mafia-style organizations and evil forces to the greatest extent, fight the tough battle and the concluding battle of the campaign well, achieve the organic unity of political, social, and legal effects, win a comprehensive victory in the special campaign, and deliver a satisfactory procuratorial answer sheet to the Party and the people. Title: All the toxins in the upper body are here, one move to completely clean them out. Content: In many theories of Traditional Chinese Medicine, the human chest and abdomen are divided into three parts: upper, middle, and lower jiao. This upper jiao mainly refers to the two organs of the heart and lungs. They are like a canopy in the sky, covering the organs of the middle and lower jiao. Pathogenic factors in the upper jiao mainly affect the heart and lungs, with various manifestations. A common example is wind-heat common cold, which is the most obvious pathogenic factor affecting the heart and lungs. This warm-heat pathogen first enters the lung tract from the mouth and nose, then circulates through the heart and lungs, affecting the heart and pericardium. People with weak constitutions who cannot withstand it may eventually develop serious heart diseases like myocarditis. TCM practitioners familiar with pulse studies will find that for wind-heat common cold, heat-dispersing herbs such as honeysuckle and forsythia are needed. Often, the pulse at the cun position (inch position) on both left and right wrists is noticeably more prominent, floating, and rapid compared to the guan and chi positions. This indicates that the wind-heat pathogen is simultaneously affecting the heart and lungs of the upper jiao. The left cun position corresponds to the heart, and the right cun position corresponds to the lungs. This type of cold often has the most significant characteristic of wind-heat common cold: sore throat. At this time, using Yinqiao San or Lianhua Qingwen Capsule can lead to very quick recovery. These external, mild pathogenic factors generally do not stay in the human body for long. Even without medication, the body's own righteous qi and immune system will usually clear them out within a few days. However, there is another type of pathological stagnation that the body's righteous qi finds difficult to clear out, and that is blood stasis. We have discussed blood stasis many times. A healthy, normal young person rarely has blood stasis in their body. Not only is there little blood stasis, but the environment for blood stasis does not exist, which is key. As people age, heart and lung function declines, arteriovenous circulation weakens, and blood stasis appears. The key is that the environment for blood stasis has emerged. Wherever blood stasis lingers, it causes discomfort. Once blood stasis occurs in the heart and lung circulation, blocking the blood vessels and meridians, it manifests in a specific place: the hollows of both elbows, which is one of the 'Eight Deficiencies' in TCM. We have previously recommended patting the groin area, also one of the Eight Deficiencies, to regulate the meridian qi of the liver, spleen, and kidney. Today, we are talking about the elbow hollows, which can regulate the meridian qi of the heart and lungs. These hollow areas easily retain pathogenic factors and cause blockages! Continuously patting the elbow hollows can stimulate the heart and lung meridian qi and enhance heart and lung function. Beginners will find the first pat quite painful; those who persist for a minute are champions! But as long as you keep patting, you will find that dark, stagnant, purple blood appears here. These are the physiological wastes blocking the heart, lungs, and upper jiao! After the first patting session, rest for a few days to let the body digest them, then repeat the patting. Only after patting them away and cleaning them out will the heart and lung meridian qi flow smoothly! Remember, when patting the elbow hollows, also pat the Quchi point (LI11) on the neighboring Large Intestine Meridian. This can regulate the large intestine and promote its detoxification.

Title: Based in Shanghai, which domestic well-known insurance brokerage company is the best? Content: Based in Shanghai, I first joined Yongdali, spent 3 years at Mingya, achieved the industry COT honorary title, and have now joined Guoshou Nianfeng. I think each has its own strengths. The partners at Mingya online are all excellent, while partners from other insurance companies speak up less. Here I will talk about the insurance brokerage platform I chose — Guoshou Nianfeng. The full text is nearly 3000 words, with a reading time of about 10 minutes. Guoshou Nianfeng, formerly known as China Life Insurance Sales Co., Ltd., was established in October 2015. In July 2023, it was officially renamed China Life Nianfeng Insurance Agency Co., Ltd., with its registered capital increased to 544 million yuan, jointly funded by China Life Insurance (Group) Company and China Life Insurance Company Limited. In terms of the insurance brokerage industry, Guoshou Nianfeng's registered capital scale is at an industry-leading level. The company's official website address is https://www.clpia.com. The company's customer service phone number is 4009-012345. Guoshou Nianfeng's shareholder, China Life Group, was established in 1949, formerly known as the People's Insurance Company of China. In 2012, it was officially upgraded to a vice-ministerial level unit, becoming the first insurance enterprise to be promoted to a vice-ministerial level central state-owned enterprise. As a large state-owned financial insurance enterprise, China Life Group's business scope covers life insurance, property insurance, enterprise and occupational annuities, banking, funds, asset management, wealth management, alternative investments, health investments, overseas business, and many other fields. Fortune magazine released the 2024 "World's 500 Largest Companies" list, with China Life being selected for the 22nd consecutive year, ranking 59th in 2024. The "China's 500 Most Valuable Brands" list released by World Brand Laboratory in 2024 valued the China Life brand at RMB 501.985 billion, ranking first in China's insurance industry for consecutive years. The company's headquarters is located in Beijing. Leveraging the strong strength of the state-owned background platform, Guoshou Nianfeng's institutions have developed rapidly. The first branch was officially opened in July 2023, and by the end of 2024, branches had been established in ten provinces and cities across the country, mainly concentrated in economically developed regions. Addresses and contact numbers of each branch: In terms of personnel, as of November 2024, there were nearly 1,200 sales personnel nationwide, with rapid recruitment growth. Taking the Shanghai branch as an example, it officially opened in 2024, and by January 2025, the number of sales personnel in the company was close to 300. Guoshou Nianfeng's product lines can be divided into several different segments: life insurance, property insurance, Guoshou Nianfeng exclusive, overseas business, retirement communities, etc. Partner companies include but are not limited to: including China Life Hong Kong, China Life Singapore. China Life's self-built retirement community, China Life Jiayuan, is currently operating in Tianjin, Suzhou, Sanya, and other places. Personally, I feel that although the insurance products may not have the most complete product lines compared to top intermediary platforms, they are basically sufficient for daily sales. Moreover, Guoshou Nianfeng's unique products and linkages with other business segments give it its own unique advantages. As everyone knows, the basic law involves system confidentiality issues, so this part cannot be disclosed directly. Here I share a few aspects of Guoshou Nianfeng's basic law that I appreciate, to help everyone understand more: Referring to the practices of top intermediaries, departing personnel can designate a successor broker. As someone who has already used this policy, I highly appreciate this practice of leaving the decision-making power to the salesperson, which is conducive to choosing a successor partner with aligned values and professional service quality. (Compared to companies where the decision-making power lies with the supervisor, those who have been through it will understand the problems that can arise.) However, compared to top intermediaries, Guoshou Nianfeng's policy has been optimized, allowing the successor to receive a certain percentage of renewal commissions, encouraging the successor to provide good service. Let me explain here: A recruits B, B recruits C. B is A's first generation, C is A's second generation. Guoshou Nianfeng's new basic law allows team leaders to have management benefits for both the first and second generations, which can incentivize cooperation between the team leader and the first-generation recruiters to grow and strengthen the team. Based on personal experience, if it were designed to only have first-generation benefits, the motivation to build the team together would indeed be less sufficient. In Guoshou Nianfeng's basic law, team leaders at the quasi-director level can directly extract management benefits from their team members, offering great income potential. The key is that the performance and personnel requirements are not that high, which is very motivating after reading it. It's not like traditional insurance companies where you almost have to clock in daily, nor is it like some companies that have no clock-in management at all. Guoshou Nianfeng adopts a moderate attendance intensity, requiring about 3-4 days of clock-in at the company per month. Maintaining a certain level of management intensity is beneficial for the rhythm of team business development, while also retaining sufficient freedom. If you successfully achieve MDRT in one quarter, you are exempt from performance assessments for the subsequent quarters. This exemption policy is quite friendly for those who make large deals or have unstable business rhythms. Learning from the internet operation characteristics of top intermediaries, partners can conduct joint sales and close deals with clients from different locations. Team leaders can also recruit from different locations and build national teams. Finally, let me mention the commission level for frontline sales. It's not convenient to disclose directly, but I can only say it is benchmarked against top intermediaries to ensure it is comparable. Guoshou Nianfeng has humbly learned from the business platform systems of top intermediaries, and the efficiency of online business collaboration is very high. Agents can sell policies, recruit partners, query products, take courses, review performance, etc., on the APP. Agents can use the Nianfeng Bao APP to apply for pre-underwriting resources for sub-healthy clients: You can also use the Nianfeng Bao APP to conduct policy reviews and organization for clients: Daily partner business communication and document downloads are mainly done through Enterprise WeChat: Guoshou Nianfeng's service philosophy is: Neutral and objective, professional service, client first, consultant supreme. Translated, it is also the company's value proposition: To tailor exclusive comprehensive financial solutions for clients with a neutral and objective attitude, prioritizing client interests and honoring consultant value. In terms of personnel composition, 60% hold bachelor's degrees, 20% hold master's degrees, and 20% hold associate degrees. In the early stages of each branch's development, the focus is on attracting industry elites. Two-thirds of the main force in the Shanghai branch comes from the insurance brokerage industry, and one-third comes from primary insurance companies. From the experience of joining the Shanghai branch, the company emphasizes offline attendance and training, supervisors value team management, attendance rates are high, everyone is pragmatic and focused on implementation. Plus, Guoshou Nianfeng is a startup company, and the environment and atmosphere are bustling even in this industry winter. Guoshou Nianfeng refers to the onboarding model of a top intermediary. Newcomers mainly follow an online process: The newcomer scans the QR code on the onboarding poster shared by the referrer to download the Nianfeng Bao APP, registers and logs in with a mobile number, clicks "I want to join" on the homepage, and starts the contracting process. At this stage, you need to confirm your basic information, referrer information, and work location information. Special note: confirming the referrer and work location is very important. Once confirmed, it is very difficult to modify, so be sure to understand the differences before clicking. Fill in normally, and after completion, you can click next to enter the subsequent process. You can return to check after receiving messages. Submit documents including ID card, graduation certificate, CHSI report, income proof, etc., for company review of personal information and submitted materials. Pass the interview with the Wealth Center General Manager, usually arranged by the referrer as an offline interview. If in a different location, a phone interview is also possible. Complete the online training courses on the Nianfeng Bao APP, then take and pass the online exam within the APP. Sign the insurance agency contract, letter of commitment, etc., and enter bank card information. After successful contracting, wait for the company to process the practice registration. You can download the Jinshitong APP and confirm your practice registration within 3 days. Address of Guoshou Nianfeng's Shanghai branch: 30th Floor, No. 1158 Dongdaming Road, Hongkou District, Shanghai. Title: Why hasn't the housing price in county towns dropped? Content: It is not uncommon for housing prices in county towns to remain stable or decrease only slightly. The main influencing factors include the strengthened mindset of farmers moving to cities, especially in economically underdeveloped rural areas, as urban education, healthcare, and living facilities are far superior to those in rural areas. Additionally, some county towns carry out investment promotion activities, enabling small counties to host enterprises with promising business development prospects, which attracts some locals working in big cities to return to their hometown for development due to the high cost of living (food, accommodation, transportation) in large cities. The pressure of buying a home in large or medium-sized cities is too great for this group, making purchasing property in county towns more aligned with their personal conditions.

Title: Liang Weifa: Street Stability Maintenance Centers Should Be the New Judge Bao Content: Information Times News (Reporter Tong Dan, Correspondent Chen Jianzhong) Yesterday, the third supervision area experience exchange on-site meeting for the construction of town and street comprehensive governance and petition stability maintenance centers was held in Guangzhou. Meeting representatives conducted field visits and inspections of the comprehensive governance and petition stability maintenance centers in four streets: Dengfeng Street in Yuexiu District, Fengyuan Street in Liwan District, Xinshi Street in Baiyun District, and Xinhua Street in Huadu District of Guangzhou. Liang Weifa, Member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee, Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Committee, and Deputy Director of the Provincial Comprehensive Governance Committee, attended the meeting and delivered a speech. He emphasized the need to truly build the 'centers' into hubs for gathering public opinion, mediating disputes, and commanding stability maintenance and emergency response, making them 'conflict resolvers in society and the new Judge Bao in the hearts of the people.' Liang Weifa expressed yesterday full affirmation for the successful practices and experiences of Guangzhou, Zhuhai, Foshan, Dongguan, and Zhongshan cities in vigorously promoting the construction of town and street comprehensive governance and petition stability maintenance centers, further resolving conflicts and hidden public security risks at the grassroots level. According to statistics, the already established town and street comprehensive governance and petition stability maintenance centers in these five cities handled 7,914 various conflicts and disputes in the third quarter, with 6,912 cases concluded, achieving a closure rate of 87%. Case: Yuexiu Dengfeng Street: Hiring Foreigners as Volunteers Yesterday morning, Liang Weifa first visited the Dengfeng Street Comprehensive Governance and Petition Stability Maintenance Center in Yuexiu for an on-site inspection. It is understood that Dengfeng Street has a total population of 145,000, including 50,000 registered residents and 50,400 permanent residents. Additionally, there are 41,000 floating populations, including 4,500 foreigners from 83 different countries. From January to September this year, the center received 150 petition cases, resolved 143, with a petition resolution rate of over 95%, receiving positive feedback from the public. Unlike other centers, Dengfeng Street's center also includes services from a foreigner workstation and hires foreigners as volunteers. Liwan Fengyuan Street: Establishing an Elderly Volunteer Team The Fengyuan Street Comprehensive Governance and Petition Stability Maintenance Center in Liwan District reflects the traditional Xiguan architectural style in its decoration, giving a sense of familiarity to every citizen coming for services. Fengyuan Street is a typical old Xiguan street located in the central part of Liwan District, predominantly inhabited by local elderly and children. In response to these characteristics, Fengyuan Street innovatively established an elderly volunteer team, composed entirely of individuals aged 60 and above. Baiyun Xinshi Street: Building an Information Team Xinshi Street in Baiyun District consists of three 'urban villages,' with over 5,000 rental units and more than 200,000 migrant populations. A relevant responsible person from the Xinshi Street Comprehensive Governance and Petition Stability Maintenance Center stated that after the center was established, they actively used this platform to enhance publicity, particularly by building an information team. 'Many petitioning and road-blocking behaviors stem from information asymmetry and mutual distrust,' the person said. Establishing an information team aims to identify problems at the earliest stage and resolve them to the greatest extent while they are still nascent. Currently, the first batch of 50 information officers in Xinhua Street have been trained and deployed, with the street issuing formal appointment letters to them. Huadu Xinhua Street: Pioneering 'One Police Officer per Area' 'Due to the large jurisdiction area and high floating population, we greatly need a comprehensive platform for governance, stability maintenance, and petitions,' said a relevant responsible person from Xinhua Street. It was reported that the construction of the comprehensive governance and petition stability maintenance center officially started on August 12. Based on the original 24 staff members, 9 new staff were recruited, and an unveiling ceremony was held on September 30. Additionally, it took the lead in the district in implementing the 'one police officer per area' system, integrating forces from rental housing management, family planning, safety supervision, urban management, etc. 1 point 2 points 3 points 4 points 5 points

Title: A friend needs help completing a task, opening an internet account with Ping An Bank, but during the opening process, it requires binding a bank card. Content: A friend needs help completing a task, opening an internet account with Ping An Bank, but during the opening process, it requires binding a bank card and also the withdrawal password for that card, and even requires paying one cent with that card. Is there any risk? Ping An Bank's internet account (Type II account) is a virtual account opened online, provided for you to conduct financial business (such as deposits, purchasing wealth management products, limited consumption and bill payments, limited transfers to non-bound accounts) through electronic banking channels. It is a personal RMB bank settlement account that requires binding at least one physical bank card under your own name. Response time: 2020-06-04. For the latest business changes, please refer to the announcements on Ping An Bank's official website. Under normal circumstances, you can check if there is official information about this. Normally, no bank requires a transfer to verify identity. You should be careful. Normally, only verification for companies and enterprises requires public account transfers; I haven't encountered it for personal accounts. It is recommended not to proceed.

Title: An 18-month-old infant was fed beer by a guest, resulting in multiple rashes on the body. How harmful is it to force-feed alcohol to infants? What legal responsibilities should the person who forced the alcohol bear? Content: Is this something a person with a brain could do? The scene is heartbreaking just to think about. Seeing such news makes one furious. The child is only 18 months old and cannot even eat food with normal oil and salt, let alone alcohol! This customer is indeed hateful, and the law will definitely punish him severely. But as a parent, you must keep a close eye on your child. You cannot neglect the child for the sake of making money, nor can you leave the child in any potentially dangerous environment. You must protect your child. What does 50 milliliters of beer mean for an infant? A child's liver is as tender as tofu, and its ability to process alcohol is less than one-third of an adult's! Just these 50 milliliters of beer are enough to cause the child's blood alcohol concentration to spike, severely exceeding the limit! It may cause nervous system damage, leading to impaired brain development; it can also cause digestive system damage, resulting in acute gastric bleeding; and it can harm the reproductive and immune systems. Damage to the nervous system is irreversible, meaning the child may later react slowly, have difficulty remembering things, and be affected in learning. Even the coordination of basic skills like speaking and walking may be problematic. Over time, insomnia, frequent nightmares, and even hallucinations may occur—these psychological shadows could haunt the child. Not to mention the delicate stomach and intestines, which, when stimulated by alcohol, can lead to acute gastric bleeding at any moment; the small liver is forced to work overload; and even the future ability to have children may be subtly compromised! This is no joke—it's planting a time bomb in the child's lifelong health! Lawyers have also given a clear statement: This customer's behavior cannot be dismissed as "just playing around"! The nature of the act is very serious. If the assessment shows that the child's symptoms of alcohol poisoning reach the level of minor injury or worse; or even if the injury standard is not met, but clear health damage has been caused to the child's young body, coupled with the fact that the person intentionally forced the alcohol, it could likely be classified as "intentional injury"! Even if it doesn't qualify as intentional injury, a charge of "provoking trouble" is absolutely unavoidable. The law is not for show—there is zero tolerance for harming children. I actually had a similar experience when I was young. During a New Year's family gathering, my cousin tricked me into thinking baijiu was Sprite. I picked up the glass and took a big gulp without hesitation, then passed out and slept for an entire day. I only found out about it later from my mom, and my cousin was severely scolded! I really want to say: This bad habit of "teasing children to drink," disguised as "liking the child" or "just playing around," is essentially a blatant disregard and harm to a vulnerable life. It is not an isolated case. At dinner tables or gatherings, there are always people who think "a lick is fine" or "a little drink is fun," treating the child's innocent resistance as a joke. This essentially treats the naive and innocent child as a toy for entertainment—how cruel! Children are not playthings; their bodies and dignity cannot be treated with the slightest disrespect or violation. Everyone knows that alcohol is harmful to the body, but the "alcohol-teasing" culture keeps emerging. I often come across posts from moms saying that at banquets, some elderly people (not only relatives but even the child's own grandparents) dip chopsticks in alcohol and let the baby taste it. As a junior, they dare not directly oppose it. Here, I want to say: No one else will take responsibility for your child. Only you are the child's greatest reliance and support. As a guardian, you must bravely say no to anyone or anything that could harm the child. Don't wait until something bad happens to regret it. In daily life, besides alcohol, there are many other seemingly edible things that pose safety risks. Parents must also be vigilant. What are some things that children under three years old should eat less or avoid? Peanuts/Nuts: A small piece, if fed to a child, may get stuck in the throat during swallowing, causing choking—especially when the child is eating while jumping around. Jelly: It looks soft and can be swallowed in one gulp, but a child's windpipe is small. If eaten too quickly, it can easily block the trachea, causing difficulty breathing and suffocation. My child is already two years old, and we never give him jelly. Sometimes when we go out, others offer it to him, but I never allow him to eat it. Lollipops/Hard Candy: High-sugar foods should be eaten sparingly before the age of three, especially whole hard candies. Children can easily swallow them whole, which can also cause choking. Once, a relative gave my child a candy without me noticing. By the time I found out, it was almost finished, and I held a grudge about it for a long time. As parents, you must keep a close eye on your children. Always carefully check any food that goes into their mouths. What may be normal food for others can be a matter of life and death for a child if not handled properly. You must keep a close eye on your child! And please, do not do anything that harms society!

Title: How to reduce the occurrence of chrysanthemum diseases? Content: Chrysanthemums have the following common diseases, and corresponding prevention and treatment should be carried out. 1. Spot Diseases: 1. Black spot, brown spot, ring spot, etc., of chrysanthemums are all caused by fungal parasites. They usually appear in mid-July during the humid rainy season, especially during continuous rainy, muggy weather, prolonged waterlogging, and large day-night temperature differences, which can lead to large-scale outbreaks, with brown spot being the most common. Initially, dark brown spots appear on the leaves at the base of the stem, gradually expanding and increasing in number, turning into circular black spots 3-10 mm in diameter, eventually causing the entire leaf to dry up. The pathogen lurks in the soil for long periods and is splashed onto the leaves by rain or irrigation. If the leaves remain wet for 5 consecutive hours, the disease occurs and spreads upward. 2. Prevention and Control Methods: (1) Strengthen cultivation management. During the vegetative growth period, apply compound fertilizers containing nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium to prevent excessive growth, improve ventilation and light penetration, avoid placing pots too closely together, and try to avoid wetting the lower leaves when watering. (2) Promptly remove diseased leaves from the chrysanthemum cultivation site during the growth period or in winter and spring, and burn them centrally to reduce the source of infection. (3) Chemical control. From August to October, spray 65% zineb 600 times solution every 10 days or so to protect the leaves. After the disease occurs, use 50% carbendazim or 50% thiophanate-methyl wettable powder 500-1000 times solution, or spray 75% chlorothalonil wettable powder 800-1000 times, every 7-10 days for three to four consecutive times, with good results. 2. Fusarium Wilt: 1. This disease is prone to occur in July and August when there is heavy rainfall. The pathogen survives and spreads in the soil. After the plant is infected, the pathogen secretes toxic substances, destroying tissue cells and blocking the vascular bundles, hindering water supply, leading to rapid wilting and death. 2. Prevention and Control Methods: (1) Disinfect the potting soil. Use 40 times formalin solution or other agents (such as potassium permanganate) for disinfection. (2) Apply fertilizers and water rationally. Ensure fertilizers are fully decomposed and pay attention to increasing phosphorus and potassium fertilizers. Water only when the soil is dry and ensure good drainage. (3) Isolate affected plants. Severely diseased plants should be immediately removed, kept away from healthy plants, and burned. For mildly diseased plants, water the soil around the roots directly with 50% carbendazim several times. 3. Rust Diseases: Including black rust, white rust, brown rust, etc., are all caused by fungal spore infection and are prone to occur in humid weather. They first appear in early July and become severe in September. Black rust is the most common. Initially, pale white spots appear on the leaf surface, gradually swelling into circular protrusions. Soon, the epidermis on the back of the leaf ruptures, producing piles of orange-yellow powder that scatter with the wind, causing widespread infection. Subsequently, dark black oval spots appear on the leaves, and after the epidermis on the back ruptures again, black powder is produced. In severe cases, the entire plant is infected from the bottom up, causing leaves to dry out. Prevention and Control Methods: Besides soil disinfection, spray thiophanate-methyl or carbendazim during high temperature and humid periods. Alternatively, during the disease outbreak, spray 25% triadimefon wettable powder 1500 times solution to better control the disease. 4. Powdery Mildew: Caused by fungal infection. From August-September until winter, it is most likely to infect under conditions of high humidity, weak light, poor ventilation, and day-night temperature differences around 10°C. Gray-white mycelium grows on the backs of new leaves on upper tender branches and flower buds, forming a layer of powdery frost, deforming flowers and leaves, seriously affecting normal growth and ornamental value. Prevention and Control Methods: Spray thiophanate-methyl or carbendazim in early to mid-August, every half month, for 3 to 4 consecutive times. 5. Viral Diseases: Viruses are tiny parasites visible only under an electron microscope. When chrysanthemums are infected by viruses, the top shoots and tender leaves curl inward, and light yellow patches of varying intensity appear on the middle and upper leaves, commonly known as mosaic disease. The plant becomes stunted, root growth weakens, leaves and flowers become deformed, seriously affecting growth, ornamental value, and the condition can be hereditary. Viruses only multiply within living flower cells and are transmitted through insects (mainly piercing-sucking insects like aphids, thrips, spider mites, etc.), grafting, and mechanical damage. Prevention and Control Methods: ① Select strong, virus-free suckers and top shoots for propagation. ② Remove weeds and diseased plants to reduce infection sources, and eliminate vectors such as insects, nematodes, and fungi. ③ Choose optimal cultivation management conditions to keep plants healthy. 6. Nematode Diseases: 1. Nematodes are tiny lower animals. The main species parasitizing flowers are the southern root-knot nematode and the northern root-knot nematode, followed by the peanut root-knot nematode. Because the symptoms resemble general disease symptoms, it is often called nematode disease. The roots of infected plants often develop tumors of varying sizes containing shiny white granular matter, which are the nematode bodies. The larvae, males, and females are spherical. Infected plants become weak, often forming 'stunted seedlings,' with yellowing leaves, smaller flowers, even deformed basal buds, topped growth, and gradual withering. Nematodes can spread through infected plants, irrigation, fertilization, tools, and soil. Strict quarantine is necessary to prevent spread. 2. Prevention and Control Methods: ① Practice crop rotation to avoid continuous cropping. ② Disinfect soil. Fumigate potting soil and used old pots with 20% formalin solution for disinfection. ③ Chemical control. Use furadan or temik for soil disinfection, generally at 0.01%-0.02% of the potting soil volume. 7. Root Rot: 1. A large amount of mycelium聚集 (gathers) at the plant roots, causing partial or complete rot, yellowing, and wilting of stems and leaves. The main cause is heavy, compact soil poor in permeability, water accumulation at the pot bottom, leading to massive pathogen reproduction. 2. Prevention and Control Methods: (1) Ensure the potting mix is loose and well-aerated, enlarge the drainage hole, place a 1-2 cm thick layer of sifted soil residue at the pot bottom as a drainage layer, water appropriately, and avoid water accumulation in the pot during rain. (2) Monitor regularly. If the top young leaves of the chrysanthemum turn yellow, immediately reduce watering, deeply loosen the soil to enhance aeration and moisture dispersion, and the plant should recover within a week.
