Title: What to do if the security door in an old residential area is broken? Content: In June 2008, the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee and Government decided to fund the installation of electronic security doors for old residential areas in Xicheng. By June this year, the project was basically completed. Currently, more than 6,000 security doors have been installed in 122 old residential areas across the city, benefiting approximately 120,000 households and nearly one million people. How has this two-year practical project for the people been implemented? A reporter conducted an investigation. Installing security doors is for theft prevention. Over the past two years, the project has benefited about 120,000 households and nearly one million people in 122 old residential areas across the city, with over 6,000 security doors installed. Due to the non-uniform door sizes in the old residential areas, each security door had to be custom-made after precise on-site measurements. Just for the door measurement task alone, the construction unit organized 230 people in six batches this year to conduct six rounds of measurements in the stairwells of the old residential areas, totaling 39,100 measurements. During the installation of indoor intercoms, since residents were not always at home, each unit required at least five or six visits to complete the intercom installation. Many problems were encountered during the work, such as electricity fee collection and disagreements over the installation location of the doors. Residents had differing opinions; some were willing to install them, while others were not. "We can't just ignore the residents' opinions and force the installation," the staff member said helplessly. There were also residents willing to have the doors installed but not to connect the electricity. After some time, complaints would come in about why the security doors had no power. "Those who complain are the ones willing to connect the electricity, but we also have to consider the views of those unwilling to connect." As a result, doors were installed and then removed, removed and then reinstalled; electricity was connected and then disconnected, disconnected and then reconnected, repeating back and forth, which increased the project workload. Cases like home burglaries have significantly decreased. Fortunately, many community residents have realized the benefits of security doors. Staff from Shangmadun Community, where security doors were installed earliest, said that since the installation of electronic security doors, cases like home burglaries have significantly decreased, residents' quality of life has improved, and the nuisance of "small ads" in the stairwells has reduced. "But there are also many problems," the staff said. Since there is a portion of migrant workers in the community, some need to leave for work very early and are therefore unwilling to keep the security doors closed. Additionally, as there are many elderly people in the community, some find it hard to adjust to the extra step of opening the door when returning home. Moreover, "many elderly people like to sit at the entrance of the stairwell to chat in the evenings, making them even more reluctant to close the door." Consequently, many residents use bricks to prop the doors open to prevent them from closing. "Many doors are constantly propped open with bricks. Over time, the internal components of the door closers get damaged, and the doors won't close." Due to these issues, the community had to specially organize security guards to close the doors for every building every night around 9 or 10 p.m. when most residents are home. "No matter what, we must ensure the residents' safety." Proper use of security doors is essential for real theft prevention. The installation and maintenance of this free security door project, a public welfare initiative, were undertaken by Jiangsu Zhengze Technology Industrial Co., Ltd. Costs for replacing parts due to improper use or人为 damage are often borne by the company, and these investments have exceeded 700,000 yuan. Yesterday, a relevant person from the company introduced that indeed some electronic control doors have been damaged. When residents call to complain, they go to the site and find a brick under the door. Upon inspection, the door closer of the security door is damaged from being under tension for a long time, or the hinges are deformed. Zhengze Company reminds residents to use the security doors correctly, especially not to block the doors with bricks, wooden sticks, or other objects, which reduces the normal lifespan of the security doors. If you find that the door cannot be locked, you should report it for repair promptly. If you encounter strangers, ask about their origins and do not open the door casually. If there is a problem with the building's electronic security door system, you can call the 24-hour repair hotline at 66002110, and repair personnel will promptly come to fix the fault. Chen Chao Hu Shanjiao

Title: Postal Savings Bank Wuhe County Sub-branch: Extended Services Show Sincerity, Proactive Actions Warm Hearts Content: "With utmost sincerity, dedication, and effort to satisfy customers" is not only the service philosophy and purpose of the Postal Savings Bank Wuhe County Sub-branch but also the starting point and ultimate goal of all its work. That afternoon, Ms. Lu returned to the bank branch with her documents and materials, accompanied by the staff, and completed the card loss reporting and reissuance, password reset, and cash withdrawal services. Ms. Lu gratefully said to the staff: "Your Postal Savings Bank service is really good, so thoughtful, warm, and efficient. I give you a thumbs up!" The extended financial services cover 12 townships in Wuhe County, and door-to-door service has become a "normalized" service method for the Postal Savings Bank Wuhe County Sub-branch. Title: The difference between p2p and consumer finance Content: Both p2p and consumer finance belong to internet financial services, but there are the following differences between the two: 1. Different lending models: p2p is a form of private lending from individual to individual, where the platform acts as an intermediary; consumer finance is from individual to institution, with no intermediary platform; 2. Different risk levels: After p2p financing, the use of funds is difficult to verify, and the risk is relatively high; consumer finance loans go directly to the borrower, making risk easier to control and relatively lower.

Title: How do uterine fibroids develop? What should you do if you have uterine fibroids? Don't worry, don't panic! Success stories give you confidence! Content: Yijiangchun Home, people of Yijiangchun pay attention to Yijiangchun brand promotion, product introduction, health preservation, gynecological knowledge and other content! Uterine fibroids: One in five women may be affected. Uterine fibroids, known as the 'number one gynecological tumor,' have an extremely high incidence rate, with almost one in five women affected. They are generally seen in women aged 30-50, most commonly during childbearing years, with an incidence rate of about 20%-25%. When it comes to uterine fibroids, many women might have the following thoughts: 'Since there's no feeling, just leave it be...' 'It's been many years, occasionally there's some pain, just bear with it...' 'Didn't they say that fibroids disappear on their own after menopause? Let's wait and see...' ...BUT!! The belly gets bigger day by day, can't wear pretty clothes... Vaginal bleeding occurs from time to time... Leukorrhea has an odor, very embarrassing... The pain is getting worse and worse... If you can still tolerate these, can you tolerate the following? 1 Unknowingly developing anemia. Long-term menorrhagia in uterine fibroid patients can lead to secondary anemia, even anemia-related heart disease. In severe cases, symptoms like palpitations, shortness of breath, and fatigue may occur. 2 Sudden pain due to torsion. Subserosal fibroids can twist at the pedicle, causing acute abdominal pain. Severe pedicle torsion, if not surgically addressed immediately or if it doesn't resolve spontaneously, may lead to the pedicle breaking and forming a free fibroid. A twisted fibroid can also pull the entire uterus, causing uterine axial torsion. 3 Infertility. If uterine fibroids grow in the cervix or other areas that could affect fertility, patients are likely to experience infertility, and pregnancy may lead to miscarriage. 4 Complications with various gynecological inflammations. Uterine fibroid patients may experience menstrual changes, such as increased flow or prolonged periods. Irregular bleeding often leads to pathogenic bacterial invasion, subsequently causing gynecological inflammations like pelvic inflammatory disease and adnexitis. 5 Uterine fibroids combined with uterine body cancer. Uterine fibroids combined with uterine body cancer account for 2% of cases. Perimenopausal uterine fibroid patients with persistent uterine bleeding should be vigilant about the possible coexistence of endometrial cancer. Since uterine fibroids are so common, what specific factors are related to them? 1 Excessive estrogen secretion. Title: Samsung Washing Machine 5E Error - Specific Causes and Solutions Content: The specific causes and solutions for the Samsung washing machine 5E error code are as follows: I. Specific Causes of the 5E Error Code Drain pump clogged: The washing machine's drain pump is blocked by foreign objects or debris, causing poor drainage. Drain pipe clogged: The washing machine's drain pipe is blocked, such as by dirt, fibers, or foreign objects obstructing the pipeline. Drain pump failure: Malfunction or damage to the drain pump itself, such as motor failure or mechanical component damage, leading to reduced or complete loss of drainage capability. Water level sensor: Faulty or abnormal water level sensor, which may misjudge the water level, causing the washing machine to fail to drain correctly. II. Basic Steps to Resolve the 5E Error Code Power off and restart: Disconnect the washing machine from power, wait a few minutes, then reconnect the power to try to eliminate temporary drainage issues. Clean the drain pump filter: Regularly clean and inspect the drain pump filter, removing any dirt and foreign objects to ensure smooth drainage. Check the drain pipe: Inspect and clean the washing machine's drain pipe, especially areas like bends and connections where debris may accumulate. Check the drain pump: Check if the drain pump is operating normally. If there are abnormal noises or the pump impeller does not turn smoothly, it may require repair or replacement. III. In-depth Troubleshooting and Repair Methods Consult the user manual: Refer to the washing machine's user manual or technical manual for the specific meaning of the 5E error code to understand more detailed diagnostic steps and repair methods. Contact Samsung after-sales service: If the user cannot resolve the issue themselves, it is recommended to promptly contact Samsung's washing machine after-sales service center or an authorized repair service provider for professional technical support and assistance. IV. Preventive Measures and Regular Maintenance Recommendations Regular cleaning: Regularly clean the washing machine's drain pump, drain pipe, and filter to prevent drainage problems caused by debris blockages. Avoid overloading: Follow the washing machine's user manual and avoid putting too many clothes in a single wash to reduce stress on the drainage system. Regular inspection: Periodically check the washing machine's water level sensor and drainage system to ensure proper operation and promptly identify and resolve potential issues.

Title: How can people with low GPA study abroad? The second situation is: your GPA is truly low, already below the application requirements of the schools. Foreign institutions generally require applicants to have a GPA above 3.0, but your GPA is in the 2-point range. If you are in the first situation of being relatively lower, then it's okay. Based on your financial situation and personal goals, you can choose any country. Just be careful to avoid highly competitive popular majors when applying. If you believe you have obvious strengths and advantages in certain areas, with outstanding personal highlights, and still want to aim for prestigious universities, then the United States is a relatively better choice. Among all application countries, the United States places relatively less emphasis on GPA scores. Usually, other countries have clear minimum requirements for GPA, and schools will pay more attention to the applicant's university background and GPA during the application process. Among all countries, only the United States values the comprehensive factors of the applicant. This is the often-heard case of 'low score reversal,' which usually happens in applications to American universities. Examples include students from non-211/985 universities being admitted to Ivy League schools in the US, or students with very low GPAs being admitted to world-ranked prestigious universities. Title: Why does acid reflux and burping occur frequently in winter??? Content: Cold weather can cause constriction of gastrointestinal blood vessels, leading to disordered gastrointestinal regulation, increased gastric acid secretion, and reduced secretion of protective mucus for the gastrointestinal tract. This further irritates the gastric mucosa, worsening mucosal inflammation. Additionally, in winter, people tend to enjoy spicy hot pot or heavily oily and salty foods, which can irritate the stomach. Can stomach-nourishing meals really nourish the stomach? Drinking more milk can neutralize stomach acid - Wrong ❎. Milk is a weakly alkaline food that can neutralize stomach acid and protect the gastric mucosa; moderate consumption can help protect ulcer surfaces. However, the sugar in milk can easily cause bloating, and drinking too much can increase gastric acid secretion. So, drinking one cup of milk (250ml) per day is sufficient~ Eating more sweet potatoes is good for the stomach - Wrong ❎. Sweet potatoes are rich in fiber, which is beneficial for gastrointestinal motility and good for patients with indigestion. However, patients with ulcers should not eat too many, as they can easily cause bloating and belching. Whole grains should only be eaten in combination and not as a staple food. Eating smaller, more frequent meals is wrong ❎. For patients with peptic ulcers, especially young people, eating smaller, more frequent meals is absolutely wrong. This is because eating stimulates gastric acid secretion; frequent eating keeps gastric acid secretion ongoing, worsening damage to the gastric mucosa. However, for elderly patients or those with indigestion, smaller, more frequent meals are recommended, as these patients need gastric acid secretion to aid digestion. Chili peppers should be avoided - Wrong❎. Extremely spicy chili peppers should indeed be avoided, but green peppers can be consumed in moderation. This is because small amounts of capsaicin can promote gastrointestinal motility, accelerate blood circulation, and increase the secretion of gastric mucus, thereby protecting the gastric mucosa. As for garlic, it can also help kill Helicobacter pylori in the stomach, which is currently considered one of the main pathogenic causes of peptic ulcers. Thus, patients with peptic ulcers can appropriately consume chili peppers, garlic, and other spicy foods according to their dietary preferences, just being careful not to overdo it. Eating soft, fine foods is correct✅. During acute phases, easily digestible foods like porridge, noodles, steamed buns, etc., should be consumed. However, after the acute phase, it is advised not to over-rely on soft, fine foods because these foods require less chewing in the mouth, preventing sufficient saliva secretion. Saliva not only aids digestion but also neutralizes stomach acid and enhances the gastric mucosal barrier. Therefore, as long as their condition is stable, gastric ulcer patients can eat a normal diet but should minimize or avoid foods high in roughage or coarse fiber to reduce irritation to the affected areas as much as possible.

Title: What should I do about adenomyosis combined with infertility? Content: Personalized treatment plan for adenomyosis infertility. Adenomyosis combined with infertility is a relatively complex issue that requires developing an individualized treatment plan based on the patient's specific condition. The following are some possible management strategies: I. Drug Treatment Hormone Therapy: Includes estrogen-progestin replacement therapy, progesterone therapy, etc. Under a doctor's guidance, using synthetic estrogen and progesterone to regulate hormone levels in the body can help alleviate problems such as dysmenorrhea and pelvic adhesions caused by endometriosis, thereby improving infertility. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Regulation: Under a doctor's guidance, take TCM formulas such as Danzhi Xiaoyao Powder and Guizhi Fuling Pill for regulation. These medicines have the effect of promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, and have a certain therapeutic effect on infertility caused by qi stagnation and blood stasis. Gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists: For simple diffuse adenomyosis, this drug can be used for treatment under a doctor's guidance. After 3-6 months of treatment, patients have a certain pregnancy rate after stopping the drug. II. Surgical Treatment Tubal Patency Test (Hydrotubation): This is an examination method used to determine if there is a fallopian tube blockage, thereby helping to diagnose the cause of infertility and take corresponding measures. Laparoscopic Surgery: Suitable for infertility caused by endometriosis. Surgery is performed by inserting a laparoscope and instruments through small incisions, such as ovarian cystectomy, uterine fibroid removal, etc. This method allows direct observation and treatment of the lesion site. Lesion Resection: For localized adenomyosis, surgical resection of the lesion can be considered, and there is a certain pregnancy rate after surgery. III. Assisted Reproductive Technologies Intrauterine Insemination (IUI): For those who are ineffective with drug or surgical treatment or are older, intrauterine insemination technology can be considered to promote pregnancy. In Vitro Fertilization (IVF): Before IVF, gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists can be used for pretreatment to improve the success rate of pregnancy. IV. Lifestyle Adjustments Dietary Adjustments: Ensure adequate intake of nutrients such as protein, vitamins, minerals, etc., to meet the developmental needs of the embryo. Avoid excessive consumption of irritating foods such as spicy foods, tobacco, and alcohol, as these may stimulate uterine contractions or affect embryo implantation. Appropriate Exercise: Appropriate exercise helps improve physical condition and increase the chance of pregnancy. Stress Reduction: Maintain a good mental state, avoid excessive anxiety and tension, as these emotions may lead to endocrine disorders, decreased immune function, and other problems, thereby affecting conception and maintaining pregnancy. V. Regular Check-ups and Monitoring Condition Monitoring: Adenomyosis may affect reproductive system function and increase pregnancy risks. Regular check-ups and monitoring can help detect problems early and take corresponding measures. Gynecological Examination: Married adult women should regularly undergo gynecological examinations at the hospital to promptly detect and treat diseases that may affect fertility. In summary, the treatment of adenomyosis combined with infertility requires comprehensive consideration of the patient's specific situation to develop an individualized treatment plan. At the same time, patients also need to actively cooperate with the doctor's treatment recommendations and guidance to improve the success rate of pregnancy.

Title: Qu County: "Community + Homeowners Committee" Breaks Through the "Last Mile" of Grassroots Governance Content: In recent years, Qu County has adopted more measures to benefit people's livelihoods and warm their hearts, effectively solving the urgent, difficult, and worrisome problems that community residents care about, making their lives more comfortable and secure, and breaking through the "last mile" of grassroots governance. Beimen Community in Qujiang Street has explored a new model of co-governance, integrating the "Community + Homeowners Committee" model throughout the entire process of grassroots governance to serve the people more effectively. Beimen Community is a typical old residential area with 11 resident groups and a registered population of nearly 10,000 people. However, it lacks property management and is not a closed, modern residential complex. Establishing homeowners committees has become the best choice to break through the "last mile" of grassroots governance. "Establishing homeowners committees has several benefits: it facilitates management, helps the community collect and understand public opinion, and, more importantly, provides better services to residents. For example, if problems like broken water pipes or littering occur in the community, the homeowners committee can directly and quickly resolve them," said Zhou Yang, Secretary of the Party Committee of Beimen Community in Qujiang Street. To successfully establish homeowners committees, Beimen Community widely publicized the initiative through WeChat group notifications, bulletin board announcements, and door-to-door visits, ensuring residents were informed about the progress. From initial household surveys to discussions at courtyard meetings, Zhou Yang traversed every street and alley in Beimen. Eventually, three homeowners committees were established in Fengdong Lane, Beidajie, and Yucai Road, categorized by area, and implemented smoothly. "The establishment of homeowners committees has enhanced the democratic awareness and self-governance capabilities of grassroots residents, laying a solid foundation for building a harmonious and amicable community," Zhou Yang said. The next step for the community is to continue promoting institutionalized and standardized management of residential areas, improving the living environment for residents, and continuously enhancing their sense of happiness. (By Yin Dan, Wen Shan)

Title: Three Questions and Answers About Hepatitis C, How Much Do You Know? Content: Three Questions and Answers About Hepatitis C, How Much Do You Know? Hepatitis C, might some people find it unfamiliar? But like hepatitis B, it is a highly contagious disease. As a killer proficient in covert operations, one must be on guard. A while ago, there was a very popular TV drama called "The Bad Kids"; many people have probably seen it. The male protagonist in the plot planned to take his parents-in-law on a trip. When they traveled to a mountain on the outskirts of the city, he had them sit on the edge of a cliff, pretending to take photos for them. Seizing the moment when they were off guard, he pushed the elderly couple off the cliff. Don't you think such a person must be guarded against? Hepatitis C, as a silent killer, must be guarded against even more. Once it latches on, hepatitis C won't just ask you to climb a mountain! It will silently infiltrate the body, gradually multiply and grow, unknowingly conquer our liver, until our health defenses completely collapse. I once encountered a patient, Ms. Guan, 53 years old, from Chengde. A year ago, she experienced dizziness and fever for no apparent reason. At the time, it was thought to be a cold, but she didn't improve after treatment at a local hospital. A year ago, she came to Beijing to visit her daughter, who brought her mother for a consultation. At the time of the visit, she had a sallow complexion, fatigue, and nausea. I arranged tests which showed abnormal transaminase levels, HCV-DNA >38 (the normal value should be 1.00×10E2), and she was diagnosed with hepatitis C. Through questioning, the patient said that a year ago she went to a small clinic to have a tooth extracted, and after that, she had a persistent cold that wouldn't heal. I told her that hepatitis C can be transmitted through blood, broken skin, and mucous membranes. The dental instruments used in small clinics might not be properly sterilized, leading to infection. How much do you know about hepatitis C? I receive questions from patients in the comments section asking me about hepatitis C. Question 1: Which groups of people are susceptible to hepatitis C infection? 1. People with unexplained abnormal liver function; 2. Those who have received blood transfusions and blood products; 3. Injection drug users (especially intravenous); 4. Hemodialysis and kidney transplant patients; 5. Close household contacts of hepatitis C patients, especially spouses; 6. Individuals with promiscuous sexual behavior or homosexuals; 7. Infants born to women with hepatitis C; Question 2: What are the antiviral treatment options for hepatitis C? 1. IFN combined with RBV regimen. Due to its long treatment duration, numerous adverse reactions, poor patient tolerance, and insufficient sustained virological response rates, this regimen has gradually been replaced by DAA-based antiviral treatment regimens. 2. DAA-based antiviral treatment regimens. Specific treatment plans need to be carried out under the guidance of a specialist doctor. Question 3: Can cured hepatitis C patients relapse? For patients who have completed treatment, it is recommended to have follow-up examinations at 3 months, 6 months, and 1 year. After one year, an annual check-up is required. Follow-up items include HCV-RNA, liver biochemical indicators, alpha-fetoprotein, and liver ultrasound. These tests can rule out hepatitis C recurrence while also detecting the likelihood of cirrhosis and liver cancer. Although antiviral treatment for hepatitis C clears the virus, the infection can cause liver damage, which may lead to complications. Therefore, after treatment, it's necessary not only to confirm the clearance of the hepatitis C virus but also to have regular follow-up examinations to maximize self-protection. In summary, there's no need to be overly nervous if infected with hepatitis C. As long as standardized treatment is received, the vast majority can be cured. The earlier the prognosis, the better the effect. Curing hepatitis C is no longer out of reach!

Title: Rural houses have started to levy a usage tax, so what about cities? Aren't the abnormally high prices today inevitably linked to real estate? A few days ago, the village was promoting that a usage tax would be levied on residences exceeding the area limit. To be honest, this is not the first time for rural housing issues: one house per household, a maximum per capita square footage, including the current usage fees. Of course, most oversized residences are historical legacies. For example, properties from grandparents or even great-grandparents were naturally passed down. Previously, family planning wasn't emphasized, populations were larger, so houses were more numerous. With family planning, populations decreased, leading to more houses per descendant. Nowadays, building a house involves not only difficult approval processes but also strict per capita area limits. For instance, a family of four living in a nearly 500-600 square meter house is indeed excessive. But honestly, I'm just a bit envious! The key point is: rural areas can be regulated, but what about cities? As long as you have money, you can buy eight or ten apartments, even form groups to purchase and speculate on properties. It is precisely this disorderly development that has driven up housing prices, subsequently inflating general prices. Ordinary people endure both high housing costs and high living expenses. If every Chinese citizen were limited to a maximum of 50 square meters of residential space, with additional purchases being illegal or even criminal, would there still be so many property speculation groups? Would housing prices be so high? Would general prices be so inflated? I believe we must treat everyone equally! Without rural residents providing stable-priced food, how could urbanites enjoy stable lives? Without the labor of rural people, where would your sense of happiness and superiority come from! If the market is free, you can buy too; but if ordinary people were not subject to state price controls and could set prices for grains, vegetables, and fruits arbitrarily, wouldn't urbanites be the ones to suffer? You now enjoy everything brought by farmers, using real estate as leverage to enhance your economic status, all at the expense of ordinary people's interests. How can you bear it? Therefore, rural and urban residents should not be treated differently!

Title: A man in Datian was caught on the spot by police with contraband! Content: As the Spring Festival approaches, the sale and setting off of fireworks and firecrackers enter their peak season, and some illegal business activities also emerge, attempting to profit through illegal transportation and sale of fireworks and firecrackers. According to a unified deployment, the Chengguan Police Station of the Datian County Public Security Bureau organized police officers to conduct comprehensive pre-holiday safety inspections, cracking down severely on illegal storage and transportation of fireworks and firecrackers. Around 20:00 on December 28, during a carpet-style inspection by the Chengguan Police Station of the Datian County Public Security Bureau, it was discovered that someone was illegally storing and selling fireworks and firecrackers near the former Liulian Motorcade on Xiangshan Road in Junxi Town, Datian County. The officers on duty, You Decheng and Xiao Jiatian, immediately conducted analysis and organized personnel to investigate and set up surveillance around the houses near the former Liulian Motorcade on Xiangshan Road. Around 21:00, a batch of fireworks and firecrackers was seized in a house on Xiangshan Road. After investigation, the suspect, Lin, had privately purchased fireworks and firecrackers without obtaining a storage permit. Due to the large quantity and having no place to store them, he stored them in his mother's house, intending to sell them for profit during the Spring Festival. Upon on-the-spot inspection by the handling officers, a total of 22 pieces of fireworks and 103 pieces of firecrackers were seized from the site. Currently, the suspect Lin has been administratively punished, and the privately stored fireworks and firecrackers have been confiscated. Here, the police remind the public that the storage of fireworks and firecrackers requires a warehouse that meets national standards. Storing large quantities of fireworks and firecrackers without approval is illegal. It is hoped that the public will learn and abide by the law. At the same time, public security organs will severely crack down on illegal activities such as the production, storage, transportation, and sale of fireworks and firecrackers in accordance with the law. If residents discover such illegal activities in their vicinity, please call 110 to report to the public security organs promptly. (Contributed by the Chengguan Police Station of Datian County) Source: Colorful Datian

Title: A Prescription with Four Herbs to Expel Cold from the Body, So Women No Longer Have Cold Hands and Feet Content: Inheriting traditional Chinese medicine culture, cultivating TCM talents. Hope more people can share it with friends around them, so that every Chinese person can learn and understand TCM. Aging is a woman's greatest enemy. Who dares to say they can maintain a young face and an enviable figure forever? 'Wanting to stay young forever' may sound like a pipe dream, but who doesn't hope for it? When we find our skin gradually sagging, nasolabial folds deepening, and crow's feet appearing, we go to great lengths to hold onto the tail end of youth: white hair appears, we grit our teeth and pull it out; wrinkles and age spots appear on the face, we buy various skincare products to apply; we gain weight, we start desperately dieting, etc. Is this the fundamental way to solve the problem? Of course not! Why does our appearance age? It's because as age increases, the functions of various organs in the body gradually decline, manifested externally as our appearance beginning to age gradually. The "Suwen • Shanggu Tianzhen Lun" discusses in detail the life curve of growth, development, and decline for women based on multiples of seven. It clearly states: human birth, growth, maturity, and aging are all greatly related to the decline of our body's foundation - the five zang organs and their functions. TCM says: 'What is inside must manifest outside.' This means that if there are problems inside the body, they will inevitably manifest in our appearance, physique, and other external aspects. Therefore, to have a charming exterior, one must have healthy and strong five zang organs for support. Today, starting with expelling cold from the body, let's talk about how to safeguard beauty. First: Expel cold from the body to safeguard your beauty. Having a good complexion starts with relieving cold hands and feet. Every winter, I treat hundreds of girls who come to me for调理 because of cold hands and feet. It's clear that cold hands and feet are indeed one of the most common problems for women. I have a friend whose hands are particularly cold in winter. She herself says that because her hands are cold, she feels embarrassed to shake hands with people. At night, she can't even warm up the bed. She says that when she sees other couples going out hand in hand, intimately, her husband is unwilling to hold her hand throughout the autumn and winter. Superficially, cold hands and feet seem unrelated to beauty, but actually, that's not the case. Think about it, a woman's body must be warmed by qi and blood to be healthy and charming. If qi and blood cannot reach the limbs and other areas far from the heart, can that woman have a healthy beauty? Can her complexion be rosy? So, you see those women with cold hands and feet may also be accompanied by problems like cold back and waist, lower abdominal distension and pain, irregular menstruation, hearing loss, memory decline, constipation, etc. Externally, they may have a pale complexion, dull skin, spots, and acne. Normally, women in their twenties and thirties should be 'calm as a virgin, active as a fleeing rabbit,' but these girls with cold hands and feet are always slow in doing things, lack energy, and their bodies tend to go to two extremes: either虚胖 or skinny. From a TCM perspective, cold hands and feet are largely caused by kidney yang deficiency, because kidney yang is the foundation of the body's overall yang qi. If kidney yang is sufficient, all the zang-fu organs, body, and orifices can be warmed, and various physiological activities can operate normally. If kidney yang is deficient, its warming effect on the body and limbs will weaken, the functions of the zang-fu organs will also weaken, the body's metabolism will slow down, heat production will be insufficient, and of course, symptoms of cold hands and feet will appear. For this type of cold hands and feet caused by kidney yang deficiency, we use 10 grams of Astragalus (Huang Qi), 5 grams of Safflower (Hong Hua), 5 grams of Codonopsis (Dang Shen), and 3 grams of Peach Kernel (Tao Ren). Then add 300 ml of water to the herbs, decoct, and take morning and evening. The condition will improve. This formula has very good effects in tonifying the kidney, boosting qi, warming yang, and promoting blood circulation. Many of my patient friends have used it to调理 their cold hands and feet symptoms. Please note, do not throw away the dregs from decocting this formula. You can add more water to the dregs and boil them a while longer, then use the liquid to soak your feet. This medicinal liquid can not only help warm yang and promote blood circulation but also promote sleep! Second: Speranskia Herb (Tou Gu Cao) lets you be beautiful without being 'frozen'. Throughout the four seasons, you can see women wearing dresses on the streets. They walk with a feeling of elegance and lightness. But I believe beauty comes at a cost. Fluttering skirts in the cold season, though beautiful, are very 'freezing'. For the sake of fashion and individuality, some women wear dresses all year round, exposing their knees and joints to the wind, cold, and dampness, which can cause joint pain. Every winter, I encounter many such women. They are not old but have developed leg pain early on. Joint pain from cold is not formed in a day or two. As the saying goes, Rome wasn't built in a day. Precisely because of this, expelling the pathogenic factors from the body is also a troublesome matter. Here, I remind all the young ladies who love wearing dresses, whether you have joint pain or not, you must pay attention to joint maintenance. Here, I recommend a method for women who often have leg pain. Buy some Speranskia Herb (Tou Gu Cao) from the pharmacy. Every night, take 60 grams, add an appropriate amount of water, boil for half an hour. After boiling, pour the decoction into a foot basin. Don't rush to add cold water; first, use the steam to fumigate the knee and ankle joints. Then take two towels, soak them in the medicinal liquid, wring them out slightly, fold them into blocks, and place them on the knees for a hot compress. Do this for about 20 minutes each night. When the temperature of the liquid drops to about 40 degrees Celsius, use the remaining liquid to wash the knee joints. Because the pores and texture (cou li) of the human body's joint areas are relatively loose, wind, cold, and dampness pathogens can easily invade. Also for this reason, the medicinal effect can penetrate more easily, so the effects of the above fumigation, washing, and hot compress are relatively ideal. Additionally, after fumigating and soaking, you can rub your ankles and toes until they feel hot and red. This can help unblock the meridians and expel cold. If you have a foot bath桶 at home, you can also use this liquid to soak your feet. Everyone must not underestimate the single herb Speranskia Herb (Tou Gu Cao). The reason it's called this name is because it is very effective in expelling wind, cold, and dampness. Medical texts record that Speranskia Herb can 'treat all rheumatic pain and contractures of tendons and bones,' and it can also promote blood circulation and benefit qi, allowing the qi and blood in the joints to become通畅. Many women have the chronic problem of cold legs and joint pain. I usually prescribe this formula for them. After using it, they generally say the effect is good. Originally, knee joint cold was the 'patent' of the elderly, hence the term 'old cold legs,' but now 'old cold legs' are also starting to target young and middle-aged women. Finally, I hope everyone pays attention to protecting their legs when the weather is cold. While letting others appreciate your beauty, also give yourself a share of health and vitality. Forward and share with those you care about. One more person who sees this is one more share of health! Today's recommendation

Title: What are the insurmountable gaps for electric vehicles on the racetrack? Content: Currently, with existing technology, it's temporarily unfeasible for electric vehicles to enter the racetrack. The high-load operation of the battery leads to overheating, causing issues with the entire braking and central control system, which is just one of the problems. The main challenge lies in the damage caused to the machine by energy loss during the energy conversion process. I believe that with the nation's technological capabilities, solving this problem is only a matter of time. Personally, I think the most critical source for energy-based cars on the racetrack is still range: Imagine the rate of electrical energy loss for an electric vehicle under high-load operation? Constantly replacing batteries throughout a race? Could there be a phenomenon of insufficient power during the race? If it truly reaches that point, the damage to a brand would be immeasurable. Ultimately, putting electric cars on the track is more about allowing the target audience to recognize and understand the development trend of electric vehicles or new energy, building brand influence, and ultimately serving the general consumers. Therefore, solving the range problem is the key difficulty. Range can be divided into two aspects: the vehicle itself and charging. A breakthrough in either one can largely solve the range problem. First, the vehicle: the solution paths for the car itself are increasing battery energy density and reducing energy consumption – essentially, increasing supply and reducing demand, which is easy to understand. Battery energy density has been increasing in recent years, but limited by the constraints of lithium batteries themselves, this increase is not very fast and has a ceiling. On the other hand, there is still great potential in reducing energy consumption, such as极致风阻 (Audi e-tron), dual-motor coupling and transmissions (Roewe Marvel X), efficient energy recovery配合电控刹车 (Bosch iBooster), heat pump air conditioning (all Roewe models), etc. These require certain technological and cost investments but aren't limited by fundamental science, so there is great hope for widespread adoption, and the actual results are very good. In fact, with current technology, the biggest breakthrough point lies in charging. Charging speed is limited by lithium batteries and won't improve significantly, so we won't elaborate further. The breakthrough is in the construction of charging infrastructure. Charging facilities themselves face no technical barriers, occupy little space, and even if there are obstacles, they can easily be resolved through government decrees. The only problem is the cost, as charging piles and circuit expansion are major expenses, and maintenance also requires significant costs. Both the government and social capital need to make tremendous efforts. The government needs to pave the way with policies and shift the National Energy Security Fund towards charging infrastructure construction, while social capital is responsible for optimizing the distribution of charging facilities and improving overall economic efficiency, etc. The development of charging infrastructure is a process of quantitative change leading to qualitative change. Once the quantity reaches a critical point, it is entirely possible for charging an electric vehicle to become more convenient than refueling a gasoline car.

Title: Take my advice! Which is more practical, a robot vacuum or a floor washer? Content: I've been using both a robot vacuum and a floor washer on and off for about a year now, and the more I use them, the more I feel these two products aren't for the same type of person. The floor washer is better suited for people who prefer to clean their house manually themselves, while the robot vacuum is more for the lazy crowd. So much so that I now prefer using the floor washer, and only opt for the robot vacuum when I'm exhausted but still need to clean 😂 I started using the robot vacuum earlier than the floor washer. When I bought the Narwal J4, I was drawn to its looks, and after using it for a while, it was indeed very convenient. However, over time, I found myself wishing this robot vacuum had a mechanical arm 🧐 Even though it has a mopping function that wiggles to cover more area, it still can't reach the corners and edges of my house. What really struck me was that after using the robot vacuum for a month, I noticed that the corners and edges were full of hair and dust, and I had to clean them myself again 🙃 Another issue is hair tangling. I still check the bottom of the robot vacuum every weekend to see if it's dirty, and alas, it never disappoints – I always end up wiping the chassis and washing its triangular mop pads. That said, it's perfectly fine for cleaning the main surfaces of the house 👌 As for the floor washer, the only downside for me is that the battery life isn't great; it's almost drained after each cleaning session. The upside, however, is that it's easy to operate and can compensate for the robot vacuum's inability to reach corners and edges. Its edge-cleaning feature is very practical 👍 Another point is the dock-in base. Initially, I wanted to choose the Narwal S1 floor washer because it's really good-looking, but considering the need to carry it back and forth, I opted for the Yowant push-in floor washer instead. After mopping, I just push it in, and it's done. Also, the roller brush doesn't get tangled with hair, which nicely complements the robot vacuum ☺ Overall, I prefer using the floor washer, but using the robot vacuum for daily cleaning and the floor washer for corners and edges on weekends gets the job done efficiently. Using both together works great too~ But I also don't want my robot vacuum to just sit around collecting dust! #FloorWasher #FloorWasherRecommendation #AffordableHomeFloorWasher #WashAndMopCombo #FloorWasherReview #FloorWasherRecommendation2024 #IsAFloorWasherNecessary #WhichFloorWasherBrandIsGood #YowantFloorWasher #PersonalExperienceSharing #FloorWasherRecommendation2024 #YowantFloorWasher #NarwalJ4 #RobotVacuum #WhichIsBetterFloorWasherOrRobotVacuum

Title: Hong Kong🇭🇰 Food Exploration - Central's Most Worth-Checking-Out Spanish Restaurant Chueca Content: This Spanish restaurant is located on the famous Gough Street, yes, the same street as Kau Kee Beef Brisket. For lunch, you can choose the two-person set menu🌟 Appetizers: You can choose four chef's rusa: topped with generous salmon roe, with thick mashed potatoes underneath. It can be spread on crispy toasted bread slices to eat together, adding more layers of flavor. It's my favorite appetizer. Tuna Tartare: Tuna sashimi, paired with avocado puree, tastes very fresh and tender. Ham croquettes: This one is quite special; the base is tomato, topped with savory ham, and the crispy outer layer is also delicious. Padron peppers: Traditional Spanish fried green peppers, very tasty (great with alcohol), probably fried in olive oil.🌟 Main Course: Originally, you could order one main per person, options include spring chicken, turbot, etc. We paid extra for steak, but it requires a minimum order for two people, so it became our shared main course. It came with fries, which were delicious with a strong potato flavor.🌟 Dessert: We ordered one each of the ice cream sandwich. The outer shell is like a crispy waffle, and you pour the chocolate sauce yourself. The small portion was just right. The other one was a berry jam with cream, very airy, and even more calorific. It was also quite tasty. Surprisingly, this place doesn't provide tap water; you must order sparkling water... Might as well order other drinks. My friend ordered sparkling wine, I ordered a cappuccino, both were just okay. However, the meal was a bit dry and salty, so you definitely need to order drinks. Title: Qinzhou Port Area Successfully Disposes of Batch of Positive Imported Cold Chain Fruits in Harmless Manner Content: On January 6, the Command Headquarters of the COVID-19 Prevention and Control Leading Group of the China (Guangxi) Pilot Free Trade Zone Qinzhou Port Area (hereinafter referred to as "Qinzhou Port Area"), under the guidance of experts from the Qinzhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention, successfully disposed of 14 containers of positive imported cold chain fruits (hereinafter referred to as "positive fruits") in a harmless manner, ensuring these fruits did not enter the market and strengthening the "safety wall" for epidemic prevention and control. In accordance with relevant regulations such as the "Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China," the "Law of the People's Republic of China on the Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases" and its implementation rules, the State Council's "Urgent Notice on Strengthening Nucleic Acid Testing for COVID-19 in Cold Chain Foods and Other Work" (Joint Prevention and Control Mechanism Comprehensive Issuance [2020] No. 220), and the "Qinzhou City Imported Cold Chain Food COVID-19 Prevention and Control Emergency Plan," and after obtaining approval from the Qinzhou City Command Headquarters, the Command Headquarters, in coordination with relevant departments, legally disposed of the positive fruits by burial. The disposed positive fruits involved varieties such as bananas, dragon fruit, mangoes, longan, and jackfruit, totaling approximately 25,000 cases weighing 350 tons. The entire disposal process was completed smoothly and successfully. On the day of disposal, before transporting the positive fruits to the site, the disinfection company conducted a comprehensive disinfection and nucleic acid sampling test on the exterior of the cold storage containers holding the positive fruits in the dedicated storage area. After the test results came back negative, large trucks, escorted by traffic police throughout the journey, transported the containers to the disposal site. Using their self-dumping function, the positive fruits were unloaded in batches into burial pits. Excavators then pushed the fruits into the pits, where they were crushed, destroyed, and covered with soil for burial. The disinfection company carried out continuous, uninterrupted disinfection throughout the process - before opening the containers, during unloading, during crushing and destruction, and during burial - targeting the positive fruits, trucks, excavators, other goods, operational tools, and the work environment. Safety警戒线 (warning lines) were set up at the site, and close-range workers wore full Level II protective gear throughout the operation; there was no direct contact between personnel and the positive fruits. After the disposal was completed, soil, operational machinery, and the containers that held the positive fruits were sampled for testing. The disposal work was guided and supervised throughout by professional institutions like the Qinzhou Center for Disease Control and Prevention, ensuring the scientific, standardized, and safe nature of the operation. Previously, the Qinzhou Port Area had successfully disposed of a batch of smuggled frozen beef products that tested positive for nucleic acids and a batch of imported cold chain longan, accumulating rich experience in handling positive goods. It is understood that the Qinzhou Port Area Epidemic Prevention and Control Command Headquarters is coordinating the advancement of epidemic prevention and control with the facilitation of customs clearance. On one hand, it focuses on epidemic prevention and control, and on the other hand, it works to optimize customs clearance procedures and the process for returning containers containing goods related to epidemics. This ensures the area can effectively guarantee the healthy, safe, and sustainable development of the economy and society under the normalized situation of epidemic prevention and control.

Title: What are the impacts after uploading ID card to Jiebei? Content: Uploading an ID card to Jiebei itself normally does not have negative impacts. This is primarily to complete necessary processes such as identity verification, ensuring the security and compliance of the lending business. Firstly, uploading the ID card is a key step for Jiebei to perform real-name authentication. By accurately verifying identity information, it confirms that the account holder is operating the Jiebei services, preventing others from fraudulently using the identity to borrow money, thus protecting the user's own rights. For example, if someone attempts to steal your identity to obtain a loan, they will fail due to mismatched identity information. Secondly, it helps Jiebei assess the user's credit risk. Complete identity information allows the platform to understand the user more comprehensively. Combined with other credit data, it can more accurately judge the user's repayment ability and credit status, thereby reasonably determining credit limits and interest rates. Furthermore, it complies with regulatory requirements. The financial industry has strict identity verification regulations. Uploading the ID card demonstrates Jiebei's adherence to laws and regulations, ensuring the lending business operates legally and compliantly, and maintaining the stability of the financial market.

Title: How Many Ghost Scales Are Hidden Around Consumers? Content: A street vendor selling durian at a special price from a tricycle weighed it on-site at 9.6 jin, but when weighed at home it was only 6.2 jin; a hot pot restaurant labeled 120g of tripe but actually weighed only 82g, and labeled 200g of beef but actually weighed only 142g. A reporter recently learned through extensive visits and investigations that from offline to online, from fresh food to cooked food, from street stalls to brand stores, there are different tricks and varying degrees of short-weight phenomena, with ghost scales hidden among them. For merchants using ghost scales and short-weight practices, there are clear legal regulations; merchants must not only bear corresponding civil liability but may also receive administrative penalties such as warnings, fines, and even revocation of business licenses. To create a rule-of-law governance model, legislation should improve punitive compensation rules, law enforcement should strengthen supervision and form joint forces, judiciary should increase punishment, while simultaneously strengthening merchants' awareness of law-abiding operations and consumers' awareness of self-rights protection, to eradicate this chronic problem that disrupts market order. Focus on March 15 International Consumer Rights Day. Reporter: Zhang Shoukun, Han Dandong, Zhou Bin. Labeled 120g of tripe actually weighed only 82g, labeled 200g of tripe actually weighed only 126g; labeled 200g of beef and mutton, some stores actually weighed 172g, while others only 142g. This was recorded in February this year when blogger Super B Tai, who has over 15 million followers on a short video platform, experienced multiple hot pot restaurants in Shanghai. I did not specifically choose which brand of hot pot restaurant; these 5 hot pot restaurants were all experienced on the same day, and only one was sufficiently portioned, while the other 4 had short-weight phenomena. I didn't expect the short-weight problem in hot pot restaurants to be so serious, Super B Tai recalled in a recent interview with Legal Daily. Faced with questioning, merchants used various excuses to evade responsibility, such as water on the ingredients, the meat cutter being new, or ingredient upgrades not being updated on the menu in time. Super B Tai's experience is not an isolated case. A reporter recently learned through extensive visits and investigations that from offline to online, from fresh food to cooked food, from street stalls to brand stores, there are different tricks and varying degrees of short-weight phenomena, with ghost scales (tampered electronic scales) hidden among them. Multiple interviewed experts said that solving the ghost scale and short-weight problem requires creating a rule-of-law governance model, improving punitive compensation rules in legislation, strengthening supervision and forming joint forces in law enforcement, increasing punishment in judiciary, while simultaneously strengthening merchants' awareness of law-abiding operations and consumers' awareness of self-rights protection, to eradicate this chronic problem that disrupts market order and create a good atmosphere of honest business practices. Ghost scales frequently appear in aquatic product stores and roadside stalls: a 6-jin durian weighed out at nearly 10 jin. Thai Golden Pillow durian, special price 19.9 yuan per jin. Not long ago, Liu Beibei (pseudonym), a resident of Changshu City, Jiangsu Province, saw a street vendor selling durian from a tricycle with such a promotional advertisement on her way home from work. Feeling the price was much cheaper than the supermarket, she stopped and picked one. When weighed, it was 9.6 jin. The boss was very enthusiastic, saying he would peel the durian for her, and if the flesh inside was bad, he would replace it on the spot. I thought the boss was really kind at the time. But because I wanted to try making soup with the durian shell, I didn't let the boss open the durian. When I got home, my mother felt the weight was wrong as soon as she held it, and when weighed it was only 6.2 jin, Liu Beibei said. Liu Beibei took the durian back to confront the vendor, but found he had long disappeared. She posted her experience online, immediately attracting a lot of complaints, with many people saying they had fallen for the same trick: the vendor opens the durian on-site, leaving the shell behind, so even if consumers later realize the weight is wrong, they cannot prove there is a problem. Some netizens also said the vendor was using a ghost scale, and they had once brought a scale to buy durian from a street stall, but the vendor refused to sell to them. During interviews, multiple consumers claimed to have encountered ghost scales, saying they are everywhere in life. Wu Yun from Linyi, Shandong, told reporters that in March this year, when he bought seafood at a seafood stall in a night market in Qingdao, he noticed that the customer before him hadn't ordered much but the price was quite high. When it was his turn, he joked with the boss, Is your scale accurate? The boss said it was definitely accurate without hesitation. He quickly took out his phone and placed it on the scale, which showed over 220 grams, while the actual weight of his phone was about 170 grams. The boss's face instantly darkened. Wu Yun told reporters that after this experience, he carries an electronic scale with him when shopping. A few days ago, when buying strawberries at a subway entrance, he found that 2 jin of strawberries were only 1.7 jin. The vendor glanced at him and added a bunch of strawberries. Carrying an electronic scale is much more useful than bargaining with people, but those who do this are still a minority in life, Wu Yun said. Especially street stalls, market stalls, and night market stalls are highly mobile, and people don't go there often, so they may unknowingly be cheated by some unscrupulous merchants. Afterwards, they want to protect their rights but it's very difficult, and often the difference in money isn't much, so many people are too lazy to pursue it. Sun Jing (pseudonym) from Beijing had a similar experience. Sun Jing lives outside Beijing's East Fourth Ring Road, near a seafood market. She went there 3 times to buy seafood, and every time she encountered short-weight phenomena. The first two times were ghost scales: once she found a problem when weighing at home, and another time she found a problem using the fair scale directly at the market, and the merchant refunded her 90 yuan. The third time, there was a lot of water in the bag, and after pouring it out, the weight was much less, and the merchant eventually refunded her 20 yuan. It's too hard and tiring to buy seafood without being cheated, Sun Jing lamented. In addition to street vendors and seafood stores, many hot pot, malatang, and other shops label food weight or calculate prices by weight. A reporter recently took a newly bought kitchen scale and randomly walked into a malatang shop in a shopping mall in Tianjin's Heping District, and after ordering found the weight difference was about 10%. The electronic scale in the malatang shop showed the reporter's selected dishes weighed 420 grams, but after weighing with his own scale, the reporter found the weight was only 385 grams. The reporter noticed that the electronic scale used in the shop had no quality inspection label. Faced with the reporter's questions about portion size, the boss appeared somewhat flustered, his eyes constantly glancing at customers dining in the shop. Subsequently, the boss found four or five vegetable-taking bowls in the shop, adjusting and testing them on the electronic scale back and forth, finally explaining that it was because the new bowl had not been peeled.

Title: What are the precautions for purchasing a second-hand house? Content: There are many and complex tax regulations for second-hand house transactions, and the cumulative amount of various taxes and fees is relatively large, making it very necessary to estimate the tax burden. According to national regulations, the buyer should bear the deed tax and stamp duty, while the seller should bear business tax, urban construction tax, education surcharge, and personal income tax under certain conditions. Depending on the nature of the transacted house and local actual conditions, land value-added tax, property tax, handling fees, transaction management fees, and other taxes and fees may also occur. Furthermore, factors such as the nature, size, purpose of the house, and the duration of property rights registration may cause changes in the deed tax rate. Both parties can consult professionals or relevant departments for specific details on the types and rates of taxes and fees based on the actual situation of the intended transaction property.

Title: Why can't the up, down, left, and right keys on the laptop be used!_Baidu Knows Content: The inability to use the up, down, left, and right keys on a laptop may be mainly due to issues with the keyboard driver, physical damage to the keyboard, incorrect system settings, or software conflicts. Firstly, a driver is software that controls the interaction between hardware devices and the operating system. If there is a problem with the laptop's keyboard driver, such as it being outdated, corrupted, or incompatible, it can cause abnormal keyboard function, including the up, down, left, and right arrow keys not working properly. At this point, updating or reinstalling the keyboard driver might solve the problem. Secondly, physical damage to the keyboard is also a possible cause. If the arrow keys on the keyboard have suffered physical damage, such as keys being stuck, worn contacts under the keys, or damage to the keyboard circuit, these can all prevent the arrow keys from functioning correctly. In this case, it is necessary to check the keyboard for obvious physical damage and consider replacing the keyboard. Furthermore, incorrect system settings can also affect keyboard function. For example, if the operating system or a certain application has incorrectly configured the keyboard settings, it might disable or change the function of the arrow keys. Users can check the system settings to ensure the keyboard layout and language settings are correct and try restoring the default settings. Finally, software conflict is also an issue that cannot be ignored. Sometimes, certain software installed on the computer might conflict with the keyboard driver or other system components, causing the arrow keys to fail. Methods to resolve such problems might include uninstalling recently installed software that could be causing the conflict, or performing a system restore to a point before the problem occurred. In summary, the inability to use the up, down, left, and right keys on a laptop can be caused by various reasons. Users need to troubleshoot step by step and take corresponding measures. If the problem still cannot be resolved, it is recommended to contact professional technical support for further assistance.

Title: A drowning fatality occurred at a scenic spot in Chongqing, tourists asked who will guarantee our life safety! Content: The May Day holiday has begun, everyone is taking their families out for travel to relax, but it is necessary to remind everyone that due to the free expressway, vehicles will be congested, so drive carefully. Also, pay attention to personal safety! It was reported online that on April 30, a tragedy occurred at the Shuiyuntian water play area in Houba Town, Kaizhou District, Chongqing. A man drowned while experiencing a floating bridge project. After the man fell into the water, the scenic spot staff did not arrive promptly, and there was no rescue for a long time, ultimately leading to the man's drowning death! When the man first fell into the water, many tourists took out their phones to record videos. Everyone initially thought it was a funny incident. As time passed minute by minute, it became clear the man couldn't swim and was losing strength. Only then did everyone realize he was drowning, but throughout the entire process, no staff came to rescue him, finally resulting in the tragedy. According to informed sources, the deceased was 28 years old, the only son in his family, leaving behind a young child. The informant also mentioned a lack of rescue measures on site. The matter is currently under further handling! Objectively speaking, the scenic spot bears 100% responsibility for this incident. They failed to equip the water area with life-saving equipment and lifeguards. Even without lifeguards, they should at least have life rings! If a young, strong man can drown, one can imagine how much more dangerous it would be for women and children! Netizens have launched comments overwhelmingly blaming the scenic spot. As tourists, our purpose for visiting is to relax and enjoy the holiday, so who will guarantee our life safety! As the person in charge of the scenic spot, have you considered which facilities might have safety hazards? Don't joke with tourists' lives! What are your thoughts on this?

Title: MiCun Mixed Rice Children's Set Meal Accused of Using Lymph Meat, Market Supervision Department Responds Content: Recently, a netizen reported that they ordered a beef children's set meal for delivery from MiCun Mixed Rice's Xi'an Sunshine World store and found some abnormal meat in the meal upon opening, suspecting it to be lymph meat. The netizen claimed that after reporting to the platform customer service, they did not receive an apology, only a refund, and expressed concern about the store's food safety. The local market supervision department responded that neither lymph meat nor obvious fat particles are compliant, and consumers can provide clues and evidence to file a complaint. [] Image/Online screenshot On September 19, a Jingshi Live reporter attempted to contact the netizen but received no response. Staff from the involved MiCun Mixed Rice store explained that what the customer called 'lymph meat' was actually fat particles in the beef, which appeared more noticeable due to cross-sectional cutting, leading to misunderstanding. 'All meats may contain fat particles, including beef and pork sold in supermarkets,' the staff emphasized, adding that all meat products have factory inspection reports and purchase records, and a refund has been processed for the customer. [] Image/Online screenshot Staff from Yanbian MiCun Catering Management Co., Ltd. also confirmed the presence of fat particles in the children's meal beef, stating that the company's beef is sourced from large suppliers with a sound food safety system, and they would compensate consumers if the meat is indeed problematic. Regarding the cause of the fat particles, the company explained that it results from the melting and solidification of beef fat after high-temperature cooking, which is common, and they can provide relevant inspection certificates upon request. Staff from the Xi'an High-tech Zone Xiliu Market Supervision Management Office advised consumers to file a complaint with evidence if they have doubts about the meat, and regulatory authorities will investigate according to the law. 'Lymph meat or excessive fat particles are non-compliant; we will handle complaints upon receipt,' they said. An industry insider with long-term experience in catering stated that it is difficult to determine the nature of the meat based solely on video—it could be lymph meat, fat particles, or even pepper seeds. They pointed out that lymph meat is indeed harmful to health and should not be consumed. Even if it is fat particles, they should be removed to ensure a good dining experience. If consumers still have doubts, they can send samples to a third-party agency for testing. (Source: Jingshi Live)

Title: Is an air purifier the best way to remove formaldehyde? Content: Using an air purifier can help remove indoor formaldehyde, but it is not the best method. Firstly, air purifiers do have some ability to remove formaldehyde, mainly due to materials like activated carbon in their internal filters, which can adsorb formaldehyde and other volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from the air. However, this method of formaldehyde removal is passive, meaning it only removes formaldehyde when it comes into contact with the filter, so the effectiveness is limited. Secondly, to enhance formaldehyde removal, some air purifiers use photocatalyst technology or ultraviolet sterilization, which can actively decompose harmful gases and bacteria. But these technologies also have some issues, such as potentially causing secondary pollution, short product lifespan, and potential harm to the human body from ultraviolet radiation. Furthermore, when choosing an air purifier, attention should be paid to its performance parameters, such as the formaldehyde CADR value (Clean Air Delivery Rate) and CCM value (Cumulative Clean Mass). These two indicators can reflect the purifier's efficiency in removing formaldehyde and the lifespan of the filter material. It is worth noting that despite these technologies and products, experts still emphasize that the most effective way to reduce indoor formaldehyde hazards is to open windows for ventilation. By maintaining air circulation between the indoors and outdoors, the volatilization and dilution of formaldehyde can be accelerated. Therefore, in practice, it is recommended to ventilate the room frequently and supplement this with an air purifier; using this combination can achieve better formaldehyde removal results. In summary, while air purifiers can help remove indoor formaldehyde to some extent, they are not the only solution, and their effectiveness has limitations. The best formaldehyde removal strategy should combine multiple methods, especially by enhancing indoor-outdoor air circulation. Title: Changsha Content: Q: Can I buy an apartment after living in Changsha Gushan Leyuan public rental housing for the full term? A: No, you cannot buy it. Public rental housing is managed city-wide, with a waiting list for supply. It is for rent only, not for sale, and involves limited-term leasing. Families or individuals who qualify for physical allocation of housing can only be allocated one public rental housing unit. Attachment: Application method: Changsha Gushan Leyuan is non-directional allocation. Non-directional allocation public rental housing is mainly used to solve the housing problems of low-income and lower-middle-income urban household registration families in the city, lower-middle-income new employees without housing, and migrant workers. First, the applicant applies to the community neighborhood committee at their registered residence location; then the sub-district office accepts, conducts preliminary review, and publicizes the application; after the district housing security department completes the review; finally, the sub-district office delivers a written notice to the applicant.

Title: Should I buy a gasoline car or an electric car for around 150,000 RMB? Content: I won't discuss how many years the battery can last here; I will calculate the costs for you realistically to show the most intuitive difference between gasoline and electric cars! According to a paper's statistics, the average annual mileage of private cars in China is 15,000 km, so we will calculate the vehicle usage cost based on 15,000 km per year. The fuel cost is calculated at 0.67 RMB per km, which amounts to 10,000 RMB per year for fuel. In the past gasoline car era, ordinary families typically bought cars in the 100,000 to 150,000 RMB range, such as the previous Leiling and Corolla. Taking a median value, most private cars cost around 130,000 RMB. Coincidentally, a pure electric car like the MO3 for young people is now available, with a version priced at 130,000 RMB and a range of 620 km. Therefore, we will compare a pure electric car and a pure gasoline car both priced at 130,000 RMB. 1. Usage for 5 years. For 5 years, gasoline car fuel cost is 50,000 RMB; after 5 years, the used gasoline car value is 50,000 RMB; after 5 years, the used electric car value is 20,000 RMB; electricity cost without a home charging pile is 10,000 RMB for 5 years, with a home charging pile it is 3,750 RMB. Then the total costs for gasoline and electric cars after 5 years are: Pure gasoline car: 130,000 RMB car price + 50,000 RMB fuel cost - 50,000 RMB residual value = 130,000 RMB. Electric car with home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 3,750 RMB electricity cost - 20,000 RMB residual value = 113,750 RMB. Electric car without home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 10,000 RMB electricity cost - 20,000 RMB residual value = 120,000 RMB. 2. Usage for 8 years. Gasoline car fuel cost is 80,000 RMB; used gasoline car value after 8 years is 30,000 RMB; used electric car value after 8 years is 10,000 RMB; electricity cost without a home charging pile is 16,000 RMB for 8 years, with a home charging pile it is 6,000 RMB. Then the total costs after 8 years are: Pure gasoline car: 130,000 RMB car price + 80,000 RMB fuel cost - 30,000 RMB residual value = 180,000 RMB. Electric car with home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 6,000 RMB electricity cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 126,000 RMB. Electric car without home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 16,000 RMB electricity cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 136,000 RMB. 3. Usage for 10 years. Gasoline car fuel cost is 100,000 RMB; used gasoline car value after 10 years is 10,000 RMB; used electric car value after 10 years is 10,000 RMB; electricity cost without a home charging pile is 20,000 RMB for 10 years, with a home charging pile it is 7,500 RMB. Then the total costs after 10 years are: Pure gasoline car: 130,000 RMB car price + 100,000 RMB fuel cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 220,000 RMB. Electric car with home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 7,500 RMB electricity cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 127,500 RMB. Electric car without home charging pile: 130,000 RMB car price + 20,000 RMB electricity cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 140,000 RMB. 4. The gasoline car is used for 10 years, while the electric car can only be used for 5 years, requiring one car change within 10 years. Gasoline car fuel cost is 100,000 RMB; used gasoline car value after 10 years is 10,000 RMB. For the electric car, since it is replaced after 5 years, we only need to multiply the electric car's total cost for 5 years by 2 to calculate the total cost for the electric car. Then the total costs after 10 years are: Pure gasoline car: 130,000 RMB car price + 100,000 RMB fuel cost - 10,000 RMB residual value = 220,000 RMB. Electric car with home charging pile: 5-year cost 113,750 RMB × 2 = 227,500 RMB. Electric car without home charging pile: 5-year cost 120,000 RMB × 2 = 240,000 RMB. 5. The gasoline car is changed after 8 years, used for 16 years. The pure electric car is changed after 5.3 years, used for 16 years. Total cost for gasoline car: 8-year total cost 180,000 RMB × 2 = 360,000 RMB. Total cost for electric car without home charging pile: 5-year total cost 120,000 RMB × 3 = 360,000 RMB. Total cost for electric car with home charging pile: 5-year total cost 113,750 RMB × 3 = 341,250 RMB. Conclusion: For a family car priced at 130,000 RMB or below, just choose an electric car without hesitation. After all, even if you change the car directly after 5 years, it's more enjoyable than using a gasoline car all along, and the cost is similar. More importantly, at the same price, domestic electric cars are far superior to gasoline cars in terms of power and configuration. Electric cars are also more convenient in daily maintenance, with lower maintenance costs and less frequent maintenance compared to gasoline cars.

Title: Why can't I fall asleep after exercising at night? Content: I've been doing intense exercise at night these past few days. The problem is exactly the same as the poster's. I tried several methods that didn't work, like changing my mindset, or exercising even more to get more tired. Finally, I realized it was because I was too hot. I was severely overheated from head to toe and had body aches. In this situation, even if I tried not to think about anything, I couldn't sleep. It was like someone was hitting me, waking me up. My solution is to take a cold or lukewarm shower, turn the air conditioning to maximum cooling, cover my legs and feet with the blanket while sleeping to cool down my upper body. I wait until overwhelming drowsiness hits, to the point where I can't stay awake, and then cover my whole body with the blanket to sleep. As for those who say you might catch a cold, if that happens, it just means the exercise intensity wasn't high enough...
