Title: These 41 commonly used drugs are prohibited for pregnant women and children, but many hospitals still prescribe them. Don't take them! Content: Let's first look at a set of data: According to statistics from the China Rehabilitation Research Center for Deaf Children, 3,000 children become deaf each year due to improper medication. In 2014, there were 1,519 emergency room cases of infants and young children in the United States due to misuse of cold medicine, among which 3 infants died directly after taking cold medicine equivalent to 14 times the recommended dosage for children aged 2-12. In 2016, a 2.5-year-old girl simultaneously took several cold medicines including "Yixiu" oral liquid, "Pediatric Paracetamol, Amantadine and Chlorphenamine Granules," and "Antipyretic Suppository," leading to acute liver failure and admission to the intensive care unit. The World Health Organization (WHO) warns that irrational drug use has become the fourth leading cause of death in children. One-third of global deaths are not due to the disease itself, but to irrational drug use. In 2018, the National Medical Products Administration issued multiple announcements, successively revising and banning a large number of drugs and usage instructions related to pregnant women and children. Many of these drugs are frequently prescribed by doctors, and some are even still being prescribed today. However, these drugs pose significant safety risks to pregnant women and babies, and may even cause death! For example, drugs praised as miracle cures for children, such as Pudilan Oral Liquid, Ribavirin, Yinzhihuang Injection, and Chaihu Injection, actually contain ingredients that can harm babies. For the health of expectant mothers and babies, Junjun has specially compiled this blacklist of drugs for pregnant women and children. If doctors prescribe these drugs in the future, please refuse them all! Junjun's Special Reminder 1: Drugs containing pseudoephedrine should not be given to babies because it is a nervous system stimulant that can be used to manufacture drugs. 2. Do not take multiple cold medicines simultaneously, especially those containing paracetamol. Overlapping drug doses may cause irreversible liver damage or even death. Junjun's Special Reminder: Cough medicines containing codeine. Some drug names indicate "codeine," while others do not, but the ingredient list includes codeine, such as Keyu Syrup, Strong Loquat Syrup, Compound Licorice Tablets, etc. Do not give these to children. Junjun's Special Reminder: Chinese patent medicines containing aspirin include: Jinling Cold Tablets, Julan Anti-Influenza Tablets, Suke Cold Tablets (Capsules), Lysine Acetylsalicylate, Benorilate (Apu Shuangxin Benorilate Granules, Pediatric Benorilate and Vitamin B1 Granules, Pediatric Compound Benorilate Chewable Tablets), etc. Junjun's Special Reminder: Aminoglycoside antibiotics, including streptomycin, kanamycin, gentamicin, etc.; non-aminoglycoside antibiotics, including Lincomycin (Lincomycin Hydrochloride) and erythromycin. These antibiotics are ototoxic, and babies using them may suffer permanent hearing loss! Therefore, unless a doctor diagnoses a bacterial infection, do not casually give any antibiotics to children! Junjun's Special Reminder: Don't believe the nonsense that health products have no side effects. All drugs have potential toxicity; don't idly feed poison to your child. It's better to spend that money on more green and healthy food for your child! Junjun's Special Reminder: "Asarum" in Wantong Muscle and Bone Tablets belongs to the Aristolochiaceae family. A research article in the authoritative scientific journal "Science" indicates that aristolochic acid and its derivatives may be one of the important causes of liver cancer in Asia. China banned four Chinese herbal medicines containing aristolochic acid in 2004: Aristolochia debilis, Xungufeng, Tianxianteng, and Zhushalian. However, there are more than 80 Chinese herbal medicines containing aristolochic acid, and many can be easily purchased online. Children's medicines containing aristolochic acid include: Xiao'er Jindan Tablets, Fenshen Wulin Pills, Children's Qingfei Pills, Pediatric Cough and Asthma Granules, Xiaoqinglong Mixture, Houzao Powder, Cough and Phlegm Pills, Longdan Xiegan Pills, Gynecological Fenshen Pills, Bronchitis Cough, Asthma and Phlegm Pills, as well as the famous old Chinese medicine practitioner's empirical formula Muruiling Granules, Bufei Ejiao Tang from "Key to Therapeutics of Children's Diseases," etc. Besides the above, Junjun also wants to mention the following drugs: 1. Ribavirin: Actually, many doctors abuse Ribavirin. Junjun wrote a special article about it recently; you can click the reading link at the end to see it. 2. Adult antidiarrheal drugs: Compound Diphenoxylate (Lomotil), Loperamide Hydrochloride (Imodium), Norfloxacin, Xieliting, Furazolidone, etc., are commonly used strong antidiarrheal drugs for adults and are prohibited for babies with diarrhea. 3. Drugs not explicitly banned but posing significant risks for babies: Polymyxin, Norepinephrine: Can cause kidney damage in children; Metoclopramide: Can cause brain damage in some children; Tetracycline, Norfloxacin, etc.: Can affect teeth and bone development in young children; Gantong (Clofenamine Tablets): The active ingredient diclofenac sodium can cause hematuria in children and is prohibited for children under 3 years old. Diclofenac Sodium Sustained-Release Tablets are not suitable for children and adolescents due to their larger dosage (75mg per tablet). Furthermore, due to the age and physical condition of infants and young children, plus the significant individual differences in each baby's response to drugs, special attention should be paid to the following points when medicating babies: 1. Absolutely do not use the banned drugs mentioned above; use non-recommended drugs cautiously; do not misuse Chinese herbal medicines and folk remedies. 2. Usage and dosage must be precise. Children's medication is not simply half the adult dose. Strictly follow the doctor's advice or the instructions regarding usage time, method, frequency, times, and dosage. 3. Do not overuse drugs, especially antibiotics. 4. Drugs that worked well for others may not be effective for your child. Medicine is a very special commodity and cannot be used arbitrarily by everyone for reference. 5. Do not give adult medicine to children without authorization. 6. Do not mix medications, as it is difficult to control the dosage, which may lead to overdose, reduce drug efficacy, or even cause potential adverse reactions. 7. After using medicine, remember to store it safely, ensuring children cannot reach it, and store it separately from adult medications to prevent accidental ingestion by children. Finally, remember to share today's article with people around you promptly after reading it. It might save a family!

Title: How to Identify Various Misconceptions About Stem Cells Content: Stem cell therapy is one of the most cutting-edge and popular directions in medical research today. As the saying goes, fame invites criticism, and our stem cell industry also faces a situation of uneven quality. Standing in this vast blue ocean today, let's sort out the various misconceptions and those taken-for-granted wrong ideas about stem cells. The idea that stem cells are a 'cure-all' makes many patients view stem cell therapy as a last lifeline, arriving with extremely high expectations, only to find after consultation that stem cells have limited effect on certain diseases. Why is this? Stem cells are a type of primitive, undifferentiated cell with multi-directional differentiation potential and self-replication functions. Under certain conditions, stem cells can differentiate into cells of different human tissues, hence scientists call them 'universal cells'. However, universal cells are not all-purpose cells. Stem cells have significant therapeutic effects on degenerative diseases, nervous system diseases, autoimmune system diseases, and other multi-system diseases, but we cannot conclude that stem cells can 'cure all diseases'. For the treatment of some cancers and viral diseases, stem cell therapy only plays an auxiliary role. Furthermore, the therapeutic effect of stem cells varies from person to person, with no unified standard. In medicine, there is never a 100% guarantee; no one can definitively give a 'can' or 'cannot' answer. Is using more stem cells better? From a medical perspective, 'tailoring the medicine to the illness' is also common sense. Different patients and conditions require different treatment plans. Similarly, the type of stem cells, the dosage, and the infusion method will all vary; more is not necessarily better. Can stem cells be 'eaten or applied'? Claims that stem cells can be taken orally or applied topically often appear in the promotion of skincare and medical aesthetic products. It is precisely this conceptual confusion within the industry that casts doubt on stem cell science, leaving many consumers with no results after use, feeling cheated and used as testing grounds. Misconception 1: Oral stem cells are alive. Setting aside storage conditions, they would be dissolved by stomach acid upon entering the stomach, thus having no effect. Misconception 2: Regarding skincare products, we first emphasize that stem cells *can* be used topically, but this is for medical purposes. They are first cultured aseptically, then combined with biomaterials, and applied immediately for treatment, requiring operation by professional medical personnel. (For example, topical application to wounds has been used for treating diabetic foot). We repeatedly emphasize that cells are alive. The optimal living storage environment for stem cells is 2°C-8°C, and after 24 hours, their number and viability begin to decline significantly. Long-term storage requires a -196°C liquid nitrogen tank to ensure long-term cell viability. Conventional products do not provide the conditions for long-term stem cell survival. △ Mesenchymal stem cells dispersed in a culture flask. Can anyone undergo stem cell therapy? Although stem cell therapy can be a primary treatment for certain diseases, not everyone is a candidate. Before undergoing stem cell therapy, strict and careful physical examinations are required. Specifically, individuals with a highly allergic constitution or a history of severe allergies, those with coagulation disorders like hemophilia, HIV感染者, etc., cannot undergo stem cell therapy. How exactly are stem cells used? Stem cells are primarily administered through three methods: intravenous reinfusion, local injection, and combination with biomaterials. Intravenous Reinfusion: Due to the homing property of stem cells, when using intravenous reinfusion, the stem cells can act throughout the body, automatically finding where they are needed. This is currently the most commonly used method, applicable both as a disease treatment and for daily beauty, anti-aging, and bodily health maintenance. Local Injection: Mainly used in the treatment of diseases such as spinal cord injury, knee joint injury, and periodontitis. Doctors can tailor the stem cell dosage plan based on the specific condition. Combination with Biomaterials: Since stem cells are cells, attachment and colonization become technical challenges in treating certain diseases like premature ovarian failure and dental pulp regeneration. Advanced biomaterials can perfectly solve this problem, making other treatments more effective when combined.

Title: Do hemorrhoids really require surgery? Content: The treatment for hemorrhoids varies depending on the individual's condition and clinical manifestations. Generally, mild symptoms of hemorrhoids can be alleviated, or even resolved, through lifestyle adjustments, dietary modifications, and improving bowel habits. However, if symptoms are severe, such as unbearable pain, significant bleeding, etc., affecting daily life, work, and mental health, it is advisable to seek treatment at a specialized hospital early, especially for patients who cannot correct or relieve severe symptoms like incontinence, pain, or defecation disorders. In some cases, surgery is a necessary treatment option, particularly for refractory, recurrent large hemorrhoids and mixed hemorrhoids, as well as emergency situations involving severe prolapse, obstruction, or necrosis of the hemorrhoidal mass. Surgical treatment can comprehensively and thoroughly resolve the condition, improve the patient's quality of life, and prevent the worsening of the disease and the occurrence of complications.

Title: How to solve mildew on latex paint walls in the bathroom? Content: Mildew on latex paint walls in the bathroom may be caused by high humidity and poor ventilation. Here are some solutions: Cleaning and mildew removal: First, the mildewed wall needs to be cleaned and the mildew removed. You can use professional mildew removers or a homemade white vinegar solution to clean, removing mildew stains and mold. Then wipe clean with water, and it's best to let it air dry for a while. Maintain ventilation: To prevent moisture from accumulating in the bathroom, ensure good ventilation by installing an exhaust fan or opening windows. Choose mildew-resistant latex paint: If the bathroom has poor ventilation conditions, you can choose to repaint with mildew-resistant latex paint. This type of paint usually contains additives that inhibit mold growth, effectively preventing wall mildew. Use moisture absorbers: Placing moisture absorbers in the bathroom can absorb humidity from the air, reducing the moisture level in the bathroom. It should be noted that if the mildew on the wall is severe, it is recommended to contact a professional cleaning company or decorator for treatment. At the same time, in daily life, it is necessary to keep the bathroom clean and dry, ventilate and clean regularly to avoid moisture accumulation and mold growth.

Title: Does learning boxing have practical combat use for ordinary people? Content: It's useless. Wrestling + grappling + wild swinging punches work best. Don't listen to their nonsense about distance control. Real fights aren't naked; you wear clothes. And no gloves either. Your hands can grab the opponent's wrists, arms, clothes, sleeves. The only useful thing about boxing is that bouncing footwork. If you want to dodge, dodge far away, seven or eight meters, ten meters away, let him bounce however he wants. If you don't dodge, then charge. Protect your head up top, protect your ribs and liver below. Use one hand to grab his jab, use the other hand to assist while grabbing, expose your shoulder, and block a punch with your forearm. That basically settles it. Protecting the head, bending over, hugging the legs, leaning into the person works even better. The technical name is the double leg takedown. Best for a smaller person fighting a taller boxer. Two key points: 1. Hug below the buttocks. 2. Once you hug, don't fantasize about lifting him high. You need to put your center of gravity on him, lean on him, use your shoulder to lean on him. If you are tall, fighting a shorter person. Use front kicks, low sweeps, both work well. He uses jabs to measure distance, you use front kicks to measure distance, your legs are longer than his arms. Can you do the goose-step march? Shoulders basically don't move, use the ball of your foot to kick the shin, don't use the toes. Don't fantasize about kicking to hurt him either. Most people are afraid of pain, but some specifically trained aren't that afraid. Just treat him like a wooden stake, kick the base of the stake, and the stake will fall. The goose-step kick controls distance better than that jab. Note: The goose-step kick is for controlling distance, kicking the shin is a bonus. Don't always fantasize about kicking the opponent down, just think about using the kick to make him step back and dodge. If the boxer charges forward, and you are big and tall, use your forearm and elbow to intercept. Bat away the fist, then deliver a big slap. Wrong, that's called a downward strike. Your upper and lower arms are like nunchucks. Use the elbow and forearm to intercept, then conveniently use the palm as the whip end, a downward strike works well. One downward strike equals one big slap. Or, both fists seize the center line, thrust under the ribs for a takedown. If you are taller than him, have longer arms, and are stronger, thrusting under the ribs for a takedown works well. Street fights have no referees; once he's down, you can use soccer kicks. Forgot to mention wild swinging punches. If your arms are long, seizing the center line can use straight punches. But don't think about hitting the chest or head with straight punches; whoever does that is an idiot. Just thrust at his shoulder. Whichever hand he punches with, you extend your fist and thrust at the punching shoulder. A punch without shoulder movement is nothing. If you thrust and block his shoulder, that punch hitting the body is like a massage. The shoulder and collarbone, such a large area, you won't miss, right?

Title: What to do if the insurance company you are insured with is sold? Content: Recently, there is big news in Singapore's financial circle: Singapore's largest local insurer, Income Insurance, will be acquired by the German financial services giant Allianz for at least 51% of its shares. Some friends have started to worry: "I bought a policy from Income Insurance. The insurance company is sold. Will it affect my policy?" In Singapore, acquisitions or mergers between insurance companies are not uncommon. Over the past 25 years, there have been many mergers and acquisitions among insurance companies in Singapore. Especially in recent years, M&A activities in Singapore's insurance industry have increased. So, will the policy be affected? The merger and acquisition activities of insurance companies have no impact on the policyholders. Therefore, the policy you bought will not be affected at all. If there is any effect, it is only positive. Changes in shareholders and shareholding ratios of the insurance company are matters for these financial giants and have nothing to do with us small policyholders. However, whenever an insurance company merger or acquisition occurs, we always hear some negative comments. In particular, a very small number of financial advisors from certain insurance companies may make misleading comments about the merger or acquisition activities of competing companies, such as questioning the sustainability of the policies from that company or suggesting that the company has financial problems and is forced to sell. When you hear such untrue statements, you should question their professionalism and credibility. Does Income Insurance have any financial problems? It has a government background and is one of the insurance companies with the highest market share in Singapore. Then think about it, why would the government sell its own insurance company or its shares? There is only one answer: a strong alliance. In fact, behind these actions is the goal of creating a more mature financial market and a more competitive insurance company with combined expertise. Income has a large market share in Singapore and is a well-branded large insurance company highly regarded by Singaporeans. Allianz is the largest insurance company in Germany and one of the world's largest financial services groups, serving approximately 120 million individual and corporate customers in nearly 70 countries. However, Allianz's market share in Singapore in 2023 was only 2.1%, with only 129 full-time employees in Singapore. After the transaction is completed, Income Insurance will be renamed Allianz Income Insurance. It is conceivable that after the acquisition is completed, Income's deep local presence and high penetration rate in Singapore, combined with Allianz's strong product design capabilities and global expertise, will improve overall services and offer more competitive insurance products. Singapore, as a financial center, is attracting increasing attention from global financial players. In the future, this market will become more mature, but competition among insurance companies will intensify, which is great news for policyholders. Usually, after an insurance company merger, it brings several benefits, such as stronger financial stability, better products and services, improved customer service, a stronger brand, and more optimized premiums due to economies of scale reducing costs. The more active a financial market is, the more vibrant it becomes, which stimulates innovation. Conversely, a stagnant financial market is what should cause concern. Therefore, if your insurance company is acquired or a stake is sold, it is not a bad thing.

Title: Untitled Content: The key to maintaining dried flowers lies in keeping them dry, avoiding direct sunlight, preventing exposure to wind, and regular dust removal. 
First, keeping dry is the foundation of dried flower care. Since dried flowers have undergone dehydration treatment, their internal moisture content is extremely low, making them highly susceptible to moisture. In daily care, dried flowers should be placed in a well-ventilated location, away from environments with high humidity such as bathrooms and kitchens. Additionally, regularly take the dried flowers out to air them, especially during the rainy season or humid weather, and strengthen moisture-proof measures to ensure the dried flowers do not become moldy or deteriorate. 
Second, avoiding direct sunlight is also an important aspect of dried flower care. Intense sunlight can cause the pigment molecules in dried flowers to undergo photosensitive oxidation reactions and photolysis, damaging their chemical structure and thus accelerating the fading process. Therefore, when placing dried flowers, choose a location with soft, diffused light, such as a corner near a window but not directly exposed to sunlight, or an area indoors with relatively gentle lighting. 
Furthermore, preventing wind exposure is equally important. After dehydration treatment, the toughness of the dried flower materials becomes poorer, and their weight decreases. In environments with strong wind, dried flowers are prone to breaking, deforming, or even shedding petals and fruits, which severely affects their ornamental value. Therefore, dried flowers should be placed in a windless or low-wind environment, avoiding locations with strong wind such as balconies or windowsills. 
Finally, regular dust removal is a necessary step to maintain the beauty of dried flowers. Over time, dust will inevitably accumulate on the surface of dried flowers. This dust not only affects their appearance but may also cause damage. When dusting, use a dry, soft cloth to gently wipe the surface of the dried flowers. Alternatively, you can use a hairdryer set to the cool air setting to gently blow away the dust, but be careful not to use too much force to avoid damaging the dried flowers. Never use a damp cloth or water directly to clean the dried flowers, as this may cause them to become moist and deform. 
In summary, by maintaining dryness, avoiding direct sunlight, preventing wind exposure, and regularly removing dust, the ornamental lifespan of dried flowers can be effectively extended, and their aesthetic appeal preserved.

Title: What value does online freight transportation actually bring to enterprises? Content: 1. Online freight transportation solves the "hard currency" problem of VAT invoices. After the replacement of business tax with VAT, VAT invoices became "hard currency". After the implementation of the "Replacement of Business Tax with VAT" policy, the logistics industry shifted from the original "full amount levied" business tax to a VAT system characterized by "levied at each stage, no double taxation", which connected the VAT deduction chain between the secondary and tertiary industries. This changed the previous pattern of paying tax on the full amount each time a transaction occurred, and more importantly, broke through the long-standing business model of becoming large and comprehensive for tax-saving considerations in the logistics industry. Before, cargo owners only needed to pay business tax; after the reform, the VAT deduction chain requires the carrier logistics company to provide deductible VAT invoices. Before the pilot program for replacing business tax with VAT in 2011, logistics and transportation enterprises paid business tax. After the reform, because VAT invoices became hard currency, upstream enterprises receiving these invoices could directly use them for their own deductions, turning from indifference towards invoices to an absolute necessity. Downstream, logistics and transportation enterprises only have invoices for fuel and vehicle purchases that can substantially reduce tax burden through deductions. The vast majority of logistics and transportation enterprises do not directly hold transport capacity assets, so only fuel can be deducted. Obtaining fuel invoices itself is not easy and also incurs costs. Even at best, assuming a 35% proportion for fuel deduction, it can only reduce the tax rate by less than half. If you add the cost of freight bills, it is definitely not cost-effective for an enterprise to issue VAT special invoices itself. After the reform, if the VAT rate cannot be reduced, it would eat into the already low gross profit margin. The gross profit margin of most logistics and transportation enterprises is below 20 percentage points, while the impact of the tax rate is basically above 2 to 3 percentage points, which is a very alarming proportion and can even affect the development of the enterprise. Therefore, finding a third party to issue invoices compliantly and legally is a rigid need to better reduce the tax burden rate borne by the enterprise itself. So, logistics and transportation enterprises are also having a very hard time. The problem of settling payments for outsourced transport capacity. Outsourced vehicles are used by any logistics and transportation enterprise, to a greater or lesser extent. Because the freight rates for outsourced vehicles are very difficult to control. Another issue is how to pay the freight to the drivers. If this part also needs to be treated as taxable income, because drivers have difficulty issuing invoices smoothly, in practice, the problem faced is not just how to reduce the tax point for this part of the business, but also because drivers find it hard to provide payment receipts recognized by the tax authorities, leading to enterprises being unable to balance their accounts. It might even lead to this part being treated as enterprise income and subject to corporate income tax. Of course, it's certainly impossible to handle it this way, but how to pay the money from the enterprise's account to individual drivers becomes a concurrency problem. Therefore, for most enterprises, finding a third party to issue invoices to solve the problem of public-to-private payments between the enterprise and drivers has also become a rigid need. Online freight transportation, the original intention of its promotion was to reduce costs and increase efficiency in the logistics industry, relying on internet platforms and technological means to integrate and allocate transportation resources, eliminate intermediate links, shorten the transaction chain, and achieve large-scale, intensive transportation production. Regarding the issues of logistics enterprises sourcing external vehicles, individual drivers having difficulty issuing invoices smoothly, and enterprises being unable to obtain corresponding invoices for VAT deduction and pre-tax cost listing for corporate income tax, these can actually be solved. According to the "Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Work for Online Platform Road Freight Transport Enterprises to Issue VAT Special Invoices on Behalf of Others" (State Taxation总局函 [2019] No. 405 document) issued by the State Taxation Administration in December 2019, drivers who are members of online freight platforms included in the pilot program can have the platform issue VAT special invoices on their behalf and handle related tax matters. Both methods greatly improve the convenience for individual drivers to have VAT invoices issued on their behalf, effectively solving the problem of logistics enterprises (including online freight enterprises) obtaining freight invoices for payments to drivers when sourcing external vehicles. 2. What else can online freight transportation do? Building a freight supervision system to enable orderly industry development. Before the emergence of online freight transportation (non-vessel operating common carriers), the freight market was characterized by numerous participants, decentralized operations, and high mobility, ultimately resulting in overloading, violations of laws and regulations, and non-credible operations. Online freight transportation involves资格审查 of transport capacity, online integrity assessment, and unified service standards. The resulting situation is that 7.18 million business operators, 13.89 million trucks, and 21.38 million employees can be better incorporated into the supervision system, while also using market-based means to constrain enterprise business behaviors. Reducing costs and increasing efficiency for enterprises and the industry through disintermediation and flattening; shortening the transaction process and links; reducing the costs associated with层层转包 (multiple subcontracting); facilitating information flow between consignors and carriers; promoting resource integration and connection; reducing vehicle waiting times; reducing empty truck mileage. Currently, overall logistics costs are high, and its greatest value lies in "disintermediation". However, due to too many intermediate links, communication between cargo owners and truck drivers is not smooth and information connection is poor. The online freight transportation model introduces application innovations, using technological means to achieve transport capacity innovation, forming a seamless connection between cargo owners, the platform, and drivers. Using big data to solve transport capacity issues, allowing cargo owners to place orders and drivers to bid independently, completely breaking the original "acquaintance transactions" and "regional market barriers", returning the freight pricing power to the market, thus making logistics prices reasonable and transparent, and minimizing freight costs to the greatest extent. At the same time, it can invite numerous logistics enterprises to become partners, integrating national freight resources, providing a direct communication channel for cargo owners and truck drivers, eliminating intermediate links, and naturally leading to lower freight rates. The need for transformation and development. The decentralized economy and extensive development model need to change to intensive organization and resource integration. Under the decentralized and extensive development model, the efficiency of the individual, single-vehicle operation model has been pushed to its limit. Influenced by factors such as cargo source, cost, and risk bearing, the development model has become unsustainable. With the emergence of mobile internet – online freight transportation – it has become possible for the industry to intensively organize and integrate scattered transport capacity and cargo sources, which will effectively promote the intensive development of the freight industry. Forming a cross-platform transport capacity credit system. The direct beneficiaries of the credit system are driver groups and cargo owner enterprises. Using big data to actively promote cross-domain, cross-platform, and cross-department data sharing and opening, creating an overall environment of credible transport capacity. Daoda is a professional online freight platform, possessing a sound safety production management system, providing authentic and complete information, standardized management, rigorous information review. Upon order completion, information is directly uploaded to the regulatory platform, achieving intelligent, electronic, and standardized management, business, and service, and legally issuing VAT invoices. As long as the transaction is matched and completed online through Daoda, a VAT invoice can be issued, avoiding corporate income tax issues caused by using informal receipts for accounting, truly enabling enterprise taxation to be legal and compliant. Title: Please note! These nine diseases have miraculous effects when treated with Traditional Chinese Medicine! Don't seek medical help blindly anymore! Content: The worst thing about seeking medical treatment is 'rushing to any doctor in a panic when seriously ill.' Although the efficacy of Western and Chinese medicine is similar for many diseases, there are indeed some therapies that each excels in for specific areas. Understanding these patterns can make it more convenient when choosing between Chinese and Western medicine. 9 types of ailments are most suitable for Traditional Chinese Medicine. 01 Allergic diseases: Normal immunity is moderate and timely. If regulation is abnormal, abnormal immune reactions can occur, leading to body damage and the formation of new diseases. For example, eczema, urticaria, allergic rhinitis, allergic asthma, rheumatoid arthritis, lupus erythematosus, scleroderma, etc., are generally caused by immune dysfunction. Because the immune system has the characteristic of affecting the whole body by moving one part, it is difficult for Western medicine to find targeted treatments, often only suppressing immune function, and the condition is prone to relapse after stopping medication. Traditional Chinese Medicine, however, steps out of the local area to regulate the whole body, often achieving good results. 02 Gynecological diseases: Gynecological diseases are often caused by hormonal secretion disorders. Simply regulating a certain hormone is not only difficult to control the dosage but also easily triggers a series of hormonal changes in the body. However, Traditional Chinese Medicine has unique efficacy in this area. Especially in treating dysmenorrhea, irregular menstruation, infertility, breast hyperplasia, premature ovarian failure, polycystic ovary syndrome, menopausal syndrome, functional uterine bleeding, and other diseases, it often has remarkable effects. 03 Andrological diseases: For andrological diseases such as erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, and prostatic hyperplasia, Traditional Chinese Medicine also has good therapeutic effects. 04 Shoulder, neck, back, and leg pain: Methods like massage, acupuncture, and Chinese medicine can improve blood circulation, promote inflammation reduction, and functional recovery. 05 Spleen and stomach diseases: Such as chronic gastritis, abdominal distension, and loose stools, generally have a long course and complex mechanisms. Western medicines are mostly single-component and less targeted than the personalized prescriptions of Traditional Chinese Medicine. 06 Respiratory system diseases: Traditional Chinese Medicine is often called a 'slow doctor,' but this view is not entirely correct. Diseases like cough, tonsillitis, and bronchitis are also suitable for TCM treatment, which can avoid the use of antibiotics. 07 Complex chronic diseases: It is well known that Traditional Chinese Medicine has unique advantages in treating chronic diseases. Especially in the treatment processes of hepatitis, nephritis, bronchitis, chronic enteritis, gastritis, emphysema, anemia, diabetes complications, and geriatric diseases, modern medicine often finds it difficult to exert its advantages. Traditional Chinese Medicine, however, can adjust the balance of Qi, blood, Yin, and Yang in the human body through syndrome differentiation and treatment, improving overall health. 08 Functional diseases: Many people often experience discomforts such as abdominal distension, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, palpitations, chest tightness, fatigue, insomnia, anxiety, depression, and various unexplained pains, but their examination indicators are normal. We usually call this a sub-health state, which is particularly suitable for treatment using TCM theory to 'prevent disease,' with significant effects. 09 Post-major illness recovery: Whether it's physical weakness after a major illness or limb paralysis and cognitive impairment after a stroke, these are strengths of Traditional Chinese Medicine treatment. In addition, neurological diseases such as facial paralysis, neurogenic deafness, tinnitus, and neuropathic pain are all suitable for TCM conditioning. The earlier acupuncture intervention is applied, the better the effect. When seeing a TCM doctor, these are the things you should fear doing the most. Observation, listening/smelling, questioning, and pulse-taking are the foundation of TCM disease diagnosis. If you do the following six things before your visit, it can easily lead to misdiagnosis by the doctor! 01 Fear of you wearing makeup: Observation is very important for diagnosis. Although makeup can give you a 'good complexion,' it also adds a 'protective cover' to the disease, making it difficult for the doctor to judge the condition through observation. Therefore, definitely do not wear makeup before seeing a TCM doctor; ensure a completely bare face so the doctor can see your 'true face.' 02 Fear of you eating indiscriminately: Observing the tongue coating is also an important means for TCM practitioners to diagnose the condition. If you eat and drink indiscriminately before the visit, it can easily change the tongue coating, similarly affecting diagnosis. For example, foods high in fat like milk and peanuts can easily make your tongue coating white and greasy; coffee, oranges, and vitamin B2, etc., may turn the tongue coating yellow; drinking hot beverages right before the visit can make the tongue body red. Therefore, before seeing a TCM doctor, everyone must not eat indiscriminately, especially avoid eating foods with colorants. 03 Fear of you wearing perfume: Many diseases manifest as abnormal breath or body odor. Therefore, do not use perfumes or skincare products with strong scents; do not eat foods with strong odors, such as onions and garlic, etc., to avoid affecting the accuracy of smelling diagnosis. 04 Fear of you engaging in strenuous exercise: Pulse diagnosis is an important method in TCM diagnosis. Before the visit, try to keep your mood calm and avoid factors like emotional agitation and strenuous exercise. 05 Fear of you lacking trust: The treatment of many diseases requires a certain amount of time. If you are impatient for success and frequently change doctors, it will disrupt the doctor's treatment rhythm. TCM experts suggest that if there is still no obvious effect after 1-2 months of treatment, you can consider changing the treatment method. 06 Fear of you not cooperating: TCM places great importance on individual constitutional differences during the diagnosis and treatment process. The cause, time, location, and manifestations of the illness differ, so the prescriptions and medications will also differ. Unless permitted by the doctor, please do not continue using old prescriptions or prescriptions for others. The best cooperation is to carefully follow the doctor's instructions.

Title: 2025 Shanghai Yangpu District Commercial District & Accommodation Consumption Voucher Collection and Usage Q&A (11 Questions) Content: [Introduction]: This round of "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" consumption vouchers will distribute two types of vouchers. Among them, commercial district consumption vouchers will be distributed via Alipay, while accommodation consumption vouchers will be distributed via Meituan and Ctrip. Related Q&A is as follows. The "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" consumption vouchers are here again! From August 8th to September 4th, a total of 4 batches will be distributed. To further promote the integration of commerce, tourism, culture, and sports, this round of "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" consumption vouchers will distribute two types of vouchers. Among them, commercial district consumption vouchers will be distributed via Alipay, while accommodation consumption vouchers will be distributed via Meituan and Ctrip. 01 How can consumers collect the vouchers this time? Commercial District Vouchers: After the activity starts, users can open Alipay. If they see the activity entry on the Alipay homepage, they can click to enter the activity page. They can also search for "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" in the search bar on the Alipay homepage to enter the activity page, or scan a designated QR code to enter the activity page. Accommodation Vouchers: Consumers can search for "Enjoy Yangpu Digital Hotel Voucher" in the Meituan App or Dianping App to enter the activity page. Voucher usage rules can be checked on the activity details page. 02 What is the face value arrangement for the vouchers this time? There are two types of Commercial District Vouchers. For each type, users can choose 1 voucher per round, with a maximum of 2 vouchers per person per round. Trendy Goods Voucher: 150 yuan off for every 500 yuan spent, 300 yuan off for every 1000 yuan spent. Subculture Voucher: 20 yuan off for every 100 yuan spent. Accommodation Vouchers are tiered discount vouchers, meaning one voucher contains three threshold tiers: 90 yuan off for every 300 yuan spent, 150 yuan off for every 500 yuan spent, 240 yuan off for every 800 yuan spent. 03 When can consumers collect the vouchers? Commercial District Vouchers will be distributed every Friday starting August 8th. A total of 4 batches will be distributed, with limited quantities per batch, first-come-first-served. *Subsequent batches may be adjusted dynamically based on the actual situation. Accommodation Vouchers can be collected starting at 11:00 AM on August 6th, August 15th, and August 22nd, until supplies last, for a total of three rounds. 04 How long is the voucher validity period? How soon can they be used after collection? Commercial District Vouchers: Vouchers can be used within their validity period after being collected on the distribution day. If successfully collected but not used, they will expire automatically. Accommodation Vouchers: The validity periods for the three rounds of vouchers are until 23:59:59 on August 14th, August 21st, and August 28th, respectively. Vouchers expire automatically after these times. 05 If a consumer fails to collect a voucher or the collected voucher expires, can they collect it again next time? Commercial District Vouchers: Consumers have the opportunity to collect vouchers each time according to the distribution schedule. Accommodation Vouchers: During the activity period, one round is distributed at a time, and consumers have the opportunity to collect vouchers in each round. 06 If an order paid for with a voucher is refunded, how are the funds and voucher handled? Commercial District Vouchers: The funds paid by the consumer will be refunded via the original payment method. If a full refund occurs and the voucher is still valid, the voucher will be returned to the consumer's platform account, with the validity period unchanged. If the voucher has expired at the time of refund or a partial refund occurs, the voucher will not be returned to the consumer's platform account. Accommodation Vouchers: If an order paid for with a voucher is fully refunded within the voucher's validity period, the voucher will be returned to the user's account. The returned voucher's validity period remains unchanged after the refund. If the refund occurs after the voucher's validity period has expired, or if a partial refund occurs for an order within the validity period, the voucher will not be returned and cannot be used again. If an order paid for with a voucher includes multiple items settled together, and one or several items are refunded, the refund amount will be calculated proportionally after deducting the voucher discount amount, and the voucher will not be returned in this case. 07 How can consumers or participating merchants get help if they encounter problems during voucher verification? Commercial District Vouchers: Consumers or participating merchants can consult the voucher distribution platform for relevant information. For issues regarding voucher usage, please call the Alipay 24-hour customer service hotline: 95188. After connecting to an agent, inform them that you wish to inquire about the "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" activity, and a dedicated agent will assist you. Accommodation Vouchers: If users have any questions about the activity rules, they can consult the Meituan dedicated customer service line "4006170100" (Service Hours: 09:00-23:30). 08 Can the "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" vouchers collected be used across platforms? Vouchers collected on each platform cannot be used across platforms. 09 What are the usage rules for the 2025 "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" consumption vouchers? The vouchers can be used in conjunction with platform and merchant coupons. Platforms and merchants are encouraged to invest their own funds to issue additional coupons during the same period. After deducting platform and merchant discounts, the single transaction amount must meet the minimum spending requirement for the respective voucher face value. Each voucher is automatically verified after use, and only one voucher can be verified per single transaction. 10 What are the requirements for the payment method in the APP when consumers use Commercial District Vouchers for discounts? When consumers use vouchers for discounts via Alipay, the actual payment page display shall prevail. 11 How can consumers check information about specific participating retail merchants after obtaining Commercial District Vouchers? Consumers can search for "Enjoy Yangpu Digital" in the Alipay App to enter the activity page and check the information of participating merchants on the activity page. Title: A sudden thought, why hasn't any manufacturer produced a hybrid model using an ultra-small displacement turbocharged engine combined with a very small power battery to replace small-displacement, low-price gasoline cars? Content: Regarding the question of why no manufacturer has produced a hybrid model using an ultra-small displacement turbocharged engine combined with a small power battery to replace small-displacement, low-price gasoline cars, it can be considered and summarized from the following aspects: I. Technical Challenges and Cost Considerations Technical Integration Complexity: Integrating an ultra-small displacement turbocharged engine with a small power battery into a single vehicle model requires solving the complexity of technical integration. This includes the coordinated control of the engine and electric motor, optimization of the energy management system, energy conversion efficiency between the battery and engine, and other issues. These technical challenges require significant investment of R&D resources and time. Cost Considerations: The R&D and production costs for ultra-small displacement turbocharged engines and small power batteries are relatively high. To control costs, manufacturers may prefer to use existing, lower-cost traditional internal combustion engine technologies. Furthermore, hybrid vehicles require complex energy management systems and battery systems, which also increase manufacturing costs. II. Market Demand and Consumer Acceptance Market Demand: Although small-displacement, low-price gasoline cars hold a certain market share, the market demand for hybrid vehicles does not completely overlap with that of small-displacement, low-price gasoline cars. Hybrid vehicles typically have a higher price point, which may limit their competitiveness in the low-price car market. Consumer Acceptance: Consumer acceptance of hybrid vehicles is also an important factor. While hybrid vehicles have advantages in fuel economy and environmental friendliness, some consumers may still prefer traditional internal combustion engine vehicles. Additionally, for hybrid models featuring ultra-small displacement turbocharged engines and small power batteries, consumers may need more time to understand and accept this new technology. III. Policy and Environmental Factors Policy Support: The government plays a key role in promoting the development of new energy vehicles. If there is no clear policy support or subsidies from the government for hybrid models using ultra-small displacement turbocharged engines and small power batteries, the market promotion of such models might be limited. Environmental Factors: With increasing global emphasis on environmental protection and energy conservation, the development prospects for new energy vehicles are becoming broader. However, the promotion and acceptance of new energy vehicles may vary across different regions. In some areas, hybrid vehicles might face greater market challenges. In summary, although hybrid models using ultra-small displacement turbocharged engines combined with small power batteries are technically feasible to some extent, practical promotion requires consideration of multiple factors including technical challenges, cost considerations, market demand, consumer acceptance, and policy and environmental factors. Therefore, no manufacturer has yet introduced such a model to replace small-displacement, low-price gasoline cars.

Title: Zhongjing Consultation | Recurrent oral ulcers, how to solve? Try this therapy... Content: Dahe Bao "Daily Health" official WeChat recommendation index ★ Reader Ms. Yue: My daughter is 7 years old this year. Four years ago, she developed oral ulcers for no apparent reason, often hurting so much she couldn't eat. During this time, I took her to multiple hospitals for diagnosis and treatment, but it was never cured, recurring intermittently for years. Later, I saw in the newspaper that Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) could regulate this disease, so I sought TCM treatment. During the consultation, the doctor observed that the ulcer surfaces were mainly concentrated on the lower lip mucosa, lower gums, and the root of the lingual frenulum. The ulcer surfaces were about the size of sesame seeds, with local redness, swelling, and pain. The tongue tip was red with a thin white coating, and the pulse was slightly wiry. After syndrome differentiation, pulse feeling, and inquiry, it was diagnosed as aphthous stomatitis (mouth sores). The main regulatory principles should be nourishing yin, clearing heat, strengthening the spleen, and promoting diuresis to remove dampness. A prescription for 10 doses of decoction was given. After the child persisted in taking the medicine, the ulcer surfaces gradually shrank. After nearly two more months of continued regulation, the ulcer surfaces healed. Now I want to ask, my daughter has stopped the medication for nearly 1 month. If we continue the regulation, can it be completely cured? -- Expert Consultation Liu Duwen (Chief TCM Physician, Specially Appointed Expert at Zhang Zhongjing Traditional Chinese Medicine Hall): Recurrent oral ulcer is a relatively common oral mucosal disease in clinical practice today, with an increasing incidence year by year. Because the ulcers recur, with obvious congestion and pain, they often affect the patient's speech and eating, significantly reducing their quality of life. Therefore, patients have a very urgent need for treatment, even a cure. So far, the etiology of this disease is not clear, so there is currently no once-and-for-all radical cure. The purpose of treating recurrent oral ulcers is not to prevent recurrence entirely, but rather, through a series of treatments, to achieve reduced frequency of attacks, alleviation of the severity of ulcer outbreaks, promotion of ulcer healing, and pain relief. TCM clinical practice generally adopts individualized syndrome differentiation treatment, seeking the cause and treating accordingly. Title: Is Leshan really the food gathering place of Sichuan as everyone says? Content: Old Chongqing native. Acknowledge the unity of Sichuan and Chongqing as one family, recognize the 1997 direct-controlled municipality consensus. My taste buds and DNA both recognize Leshan as the true soul capital on the genuine Sichuan-Chongqing food map. Without Leshan, Chongqing's food scene would have hotpot as the heaven, small noodles as the earth, and Jianghu cuisine extending in the middle, practicing a bold and spicy style, showcasing the numbing taste of Sichuan pepper, with a fierce folk custom, and the food also exudes a Jianghu dominance, lacking some variation and charm. Without Leshan, Sichuan's food scene would be like rival warlords dividing the territory: Youting Crucian Carp, Zigong Stir-fry, Yibin Ranmian, Ziyang Diving Rabbit, Jianyang Mutton, Steel Pipe Factory Skewers, difficult to rank, each has its strengths, noisy and clamoring, never settling down. Leshan, this place, has mountains and rivers, abundant ingredients, similar to Chongqing, yet located in central Sichuan, able to absorb the flavors of the entire province, and furthermore, situated peacefully outside Chengdu, undisturbed by the hustle and bustle, with its food沉淀 (precipitation/refinement) year after year, month after month, the quality is simply稳定如一 (stable and consistent) month after month, year after year. With Leshan, the Sichuan-Chongqing food map can be unified.

Title: Can gypsum improve head tremors?_Baidu Knows Content: The first reason: if the head tremor is caused by essential tremor, and if the patient has no contraindications, β-blockers can be used for treatment, and some patients will have significant effects. When using medication, pay attention to the patient's heart rate should not be too slow. Some patients may also have some effect with a small amount of benzodiazepine sedative drugs. Some more severe patients can undergo evaluation by functional neurosurgery to assess whether deep brain stimulation surgery can be performed. Second point: if the patient's head tremor is caused by Parkinson's disease, it generally indicates that the disease has reached the middle or late stage, and anticholinergic drugs need to be used, along with drugs like levodopa for treatment, which can be combined with dopamine receptor agonists. The above plans are for reference only. Specific drug use should be combined with your own situation under the guidance of a professional doctor.

Title: Is it China's mobile phone hardware that's no good? Or is it the software that's no good! Why does it get laggy after a few years of use? Content: It's mainly a system issue. To put it this way, if you buy a phone and leave it unused for seven or eight years, then use it, wouldn't it also not be laggy? This is because the software state and hardware state are the same as they were originally. Even if you've been using it all these years, the CPU's speed, how many instructions it processes per second, remains the same; it doesn't slow down just because you've used it for a long time. So the hardware hasn't slowed down; it must be the software. After using it for three to five years and updating the system several generations, you'll visibly notice that even just swiping left and right on the home screen becomes laggy. If you could revert to the system from several years ago at this point, it would be as good as new again, because the state of the software and hardware would be no different from before. So, ultimately, it's an issue of new systems not being optimized well for old models. If you don't update the system, there are no problems at all; at most, a factory reset is needed, which is the same principle as reinstalling a computer's operating system.

Title: Yucheng: A "Thank You Letter" from Shanghai Content: Early in the morning of April 12th, Chen Xiaohui, the President of the Yucheng County People's Court, received a mobile phone text message from Shanghai: "Hello, leader. I was unable to return to Yucheng for a court hearing due to the epidemic in Shanghai. On the morning of April 11th, Judge Zhang Xiaohong from the Zhanji Tribunal of your court patiently guided me through the online hearing. After the hearing, she didn't even have time to eat and repeatedly called and sent text messages to communicate with the defendant, Wang. The case was successfully mediated around 1 p.m., and the full 9,000 yuan debt was received. Judge Zhang also told me to pay attention to epidemic prevention and control, take care of myself and my family, which made me feel very warm during this special period." The party who sent the message was named Zhang Xinzhong, a resident of Dalizhuang Village, Mangzhongqiao Township, Yucheng County. In May 2020, Wang from Dianji Township transferred a meat stall in a supermarket in Minhang District, Shanghai, to Zhang Xinzhong for 39,000 yuan. Unexpectedly, the entire supermarket closed down the day after Zhang Xinzhong paid the transfer fee, preventing him from taking over the stall. Despite repeated requests for repayment, Wang only refunded 30,000 yuan, leaving 9,000 yuan unpaid. On February 26th of this year, Zhang Xinzhong filed a lawsuit with the court. After the case was assigned to the Zhanji Tribunal, the hearing date was set for 11 a.m. on April 11th. Due to the COVID-19 outbreak in Shanghai, Zhang Xinzhong could not return to Yucheng to attend the hearing. During the pandemic, no matter is trivial. Although the case was small, Judge Zhang did not relax at all. To reassure Zhang Xinzhong and address his concerns, she maintained contact with him via phone before the hearing and worked through his entrusted lawyer to assure him that the case would be handled fairly, advising him to follow instructions and focus on epidemic prevention in Shanghai. On the morning of April 11th, Zhang Xinzhong, who was in Shanghai, participated in the online hearing with his lawyer using the "Henan Online Hearing" system under Judge Zhang Xiaohong's guidance. Although the defendant was absent during the hearing, Judge Zhang did not simply issue a judgment. Instead, she patiently communicated with the defendant, Wang, via phone and text messages, emphasizing the need for mutual understanding and support during the pandemic. Through her efforts, the case was successfully mediated, and Wang transferred the 9,000 yuan to Judge Zhang via WeChat. Since the pandemic began, while ensuring epidemic prevention and control within the court, the Yucheng County People's Court has increasingly utilized information technology such as "electronic service, online mediation, and online hearings." Particularly for parties who are unable to return due to working in Shanghai or being in medium- and high-risk areas, the court's Party committee requires the handling judges to contact each party by phone, informing them of relevant litigation procedures and requirements during the pandemic. In addition to strictly adhering to the "Provincial High Court, Provincial Procuratorate, Provincial Public Security Department" notice on fulfilling legal obligations to maintain normal epidemic prevention and control order, the court fully leverages online litigation services during case processing, providing all possible conveniences to parties via the internet. For parties who cannot attend hearings due to pandemic-related reasons, the court avoids a one-size-fits-all approach, tailoring solutions based on the case and local conditions to maximize the protection of parties' legal rights within the law. (Wang Zhiyuan, Chen Jinhua) Source: Yucheng Radio and Television Station public account

Title: Majoring in Japanese, but don't like Japanese, what to do about employment? Content: The idea that whatever you major in, you'll have to make a living from it in the future is naive. I majored in Japanese. Although I also worked in a Japanese company for three years, my job had nothing to do with Japanese. My first three years were in international freight forwarding, and after that, I've always been in foreign trade. Although I have had Japanese clients, I never used Japanese. When I did international freight forwarding, I was just a junior employee. When I started in foreign trade, I began as a foreign trade SOHO. Later, my attempt at starting a company failed, and I went out to work for other companies, mostly as a foreign trade manager. These jobs had absolutely nothing to do with Japanese; I mainly used English. No matter what you major in, it's really just to get a diploma. If you feel you don't like Japanese, then just aim to get the diploma for the Japanese major. Work hard in whatever area interests you; it doesn't affect your future employment at all. Actually, I don't like Japanese either, and I'm usually embarrassed to tell people I majored in Japanese, but I passed the N1 almost 20 years ago, and it's of no use to me now. In school, even for vanity and face, you should do well in your major courses; that's the most basic. When it comes to making a living, very few people like what they do. It's like many people going to work; very few actually like their jobs. The main reason you don't like it now is probably that you haven't mastered it well and lack confidence in it. Although I don't like Japanese, I found it much simpler than English, and I learned it very easily. However, I rarely attended lectures; if I could skip class, I definitely wouldn't go. Because following the school's teaching plan would make learning too slow. Nowadays, with all kinds of foreign language learning apps and AI, there are so many more learning aids compared to our time, so it's naturally easier to learn. Put in some effort, and you can pass the N1 in two years. If you're thinking about future job hunting, research self-media in advance; you might not even need to look for a job after graduation but could become a freelancer.

Title: 【Education Rectification · Governing Incompetence · Facilitating the People】Police Officers Help with Small Matters, True Feelings Warm People's Hearts—Guandu Police Continuously Promote the New "Five Small Projects" to Solidly Carry Out Service Work (14) Content: Guandu Police always adhere to the principle of serving the people, firmly establishing a people-centered development philosophy. Since the launch of the thematic practice of "Governing Incompetence and Laziness, Strengthening Responsibility, and Fostering New Practices," Guandu Police have solidly advanced the new "Five Small Projects" for building a harmonious new police-civilian relationship, effectively solving difficulties for the people. On the evening of October 3rd, around 23:00, a boy about 10 years old entered the sentry box of Liujia Police Station and sought help from the officer on duty. The officer learned through inquiry that the boy had been playing alone nearby, but as it was late and he was unfamiliar with the area, he couldn't find his way home. Seeing the lit police light on the sentry box, he felt a sense of security and came in for help. Based on the information provided by the boy, the officers at Liujia Police Station worked to locate his father. The father explained that he had an urgent matter that night and couldn't pick up the child. Considering the late hour, the officers first arranged for the boy to stay at a hostel. The next morning, the boy's father rushed to the police station. After verifying his identity, the officers informed the father that he should not let the child go out alone for extended periods to avoid accidents. At noon on October 8th, a热心群众 (warm-hearted citizen) carried a crying little girl to the sentry box at Wangqiying Vegetable Wholesale Market on East Third Ring Road, seeking help from the officers. The citizen said they saw the little girl crying alone by the roadside and, worried about an accident, brought her to the police. After receiving the report, the officer on duty at the sentry box took the little girl to search for her family nearby. As the girl was very young and couldn't explain how she got lost, and the search nearby yielded no results, the officer brought her back to the duty room of Liangting Police Station. After patiently communicating with the girl, the officers deduced from her模糊的口音 (unclear accent) that her name was "Cai Mourui" and she had a Zhaotong accent. Through various efforts, the officers discovered that a Zhaotong native named Cai Mou living within their jurisdiction had a 4-year-old daughter with a similar name. After contacting Cai Mou by phone to verify the situation, Cai Mou confirmed that his daughter had gone missing while playing outside with her older brother and they were currently searching for her. Cai Mou rushed to the police station, and upon seeing his child safe and sound, couldn't help but hold the officers' hands, repeatedly expressing his thanks. On the morning of October 9th, an anxious citizen came to the household registration window of Shuangfeng Police Station seeking help, stating that his elderly mother had lost her ID card and urgently needed to apply for a second-generation ID card. As the elderly woman was advanced in years and had difficulty moving, to practically solve the citizen's problem and implement the "放管服" (delegating power, improving regulation, and upgrading services) measures, the staff at the household registration window, upon learning of the situation, took a camera and drove to the nursing home to collect the information needed for the ID card application. During the photo-taking process, the elderly woman, due to emotional instability, refused to cooperate with the officers for the photo collection. The photos that were好不容易 (with great difficulty) collected ended up not meeting the standards due to issues like insufficient lighting. After repeated efforts and attempts by the officers, constantly comforting the elderly woman, they finally managed to collect a suitable photo and successfully processed the ID card. The family members expressed heartfelt thanks to the officers for their proactive home visit service and active efforts! Title: The First Hot Pot of Autumn, That Bowl of Thick Pork Tripe and Chicken Soup is Unforgettable Content: The first hot pot of autumn, that bowl of thick pork tripe and chicken soup is unforgettable. Title: A Sharp Decrease in Blood Cells, All Caused by This Drug! Content: Some say that the neurology department is the one most likely to encounter疑难杂病 and奇葩病人. For me, the people and things encountered in the department are often not just that; it is also the place where the root cause of diseases can be most clearly seen. "小竹医记" focuses on numerous cases in neurology,透析事件 from cases, tracing the etiology, and exploring the stories behind the cases. Blood is the red, viscous fluid flowing in human blood vessels. It contains important blood cells - white blood cells, red blood cells, and platelets. Red blood cells - the main medium for transporting oxygen. White blood cells - participate in the body's defense response. Platelets - hemostasis and coagulation. All blood cells perform their respective duties within our bodies,共同建立一个平衡、和谐的血液内环境. Everyone knows that blood cells are generated, grow, and mature in the bone marrow. But in some special circumstances, the bone marrow can get sick. For example, neoplastic proliferation of hematopoietic stem cells, on which病理基础会有一系列的细胞尤其突出性的增生. Proliferation主要表现为红细胞增生 is called polycythemia vera; proliferation主要表现为粒细胞增生 is called chronic myeloid leukemia; proliferation主要表现为巨核细胞增生 is manifested as essential thrombocythemia. There is another situation where the bone marrow does not proliferate but is instead suppressed. The most common cause of suppression is drug toxicity. The case we are going to talk about today is about a disease of the blood system,骨髓抑制 caused by chemotherapy drug toxicity. Xiao Wen, 16 years old, one summer in 2020, while doing homework after school, suddenly experienced发作性意识不清,抽搐,阵挛,强直, which lasted for a few minutes before the symptoms gradually improved. Xiao Wen's parents knew she was sick and rushed her to a nearby hospital. In the emergency department, Xiao Wen's condition was diagnosed as an epileptic seizure. Because it was the first seizure and there was no clear disease etiology, according to诊疗原则, Xiao Wen was not started on anti-epileptic drugs. After returning home, Xiao Wen went to school,放学, did homework as usual... Two months later, Xiao Wen developed new symptoms: emotional instability, frequent crying, tears, fear, and terror, and once even差点出现了意外. This time, Xiao Wen was admitted to the neurology ward. After a lumbar puncture and testing for autoimmune encephalitis antibodies, she was diagnosed with NMDA receptor antibody-associated encephalitis. After treatment with hormones, human血丙种球蛋白, plasma exchange, and other medications, Xiao Wen's symptoms such as epilepsy,精神异常,情绪障碍 gradually improved. In subsequent follow-ups, Xiao Wen's encephalitis symptoms recurred. After careful consideration and weighing the pros and cons, Xiao Wen was started on an oral immunosuppressant - azathioprine. Azathioprine is an immunosuppressant that can inhibit inflammatory reactions and the inappropriately activated immune system in the human body. This drug is called a "hormone替代药" or "immune调节剂". Because glucocorticoids are highly effective immune调节剂, but they also have side effects including osteoporosis,股骨头坏死,胃粘膜损害,痤疮, obesity, etc. The emergence of immunosuppressants like azathioprine can replace hormones; many patients can maintain hormones at the最低剂量, and some patients can even eventually stop glucocorticoids after taking "hormone替代药". Our patient Xiao Wen is young and has an immune system disease. Hormones cannot be used long-term, but long-term use of an immune调节剂 is needed. Among the many immunosuppressants, after weighing the pros and cons, azathioprine was chosen as her hormone替代药物. Azathioprine, initially used as an anti-rejection drug for organ transplantation, also has side effects. Its most serious side effect is骨髓抑制. Twenty days after taking azathioprine, Xiao Wen gradually developed symptoms such as fatigue, dull complexion, loss of appetite, and fever. A repeat blood count吓了小文的父母亲一跳. White blood cells dropped to 1/10 of normal, hemoglobin also dropped to 7.4g/L, and platelets dropped to 1/4 of normal. If all peripheral blood cells are reduced, one can imagine many diseases occurring. For example, hemoglobin cannot carry oxygen, white blood cells cannot kill pathogenic microorganisms, bleeding can occur anywhere in the body, and platelets cannot participate in hemostasis. And the reduction of all these blood cells was due to taking the drug azathioprine. Xiao Wen was brought to our hospital and admitted to the ward. For fear of infection, we placed Xiao Wen in a single isolation room; to prevent bleeding after injury, we strictly controlled Xiao Wen's外出 and avoided heavy physical activity. After applying a series of升血细胞药物, controlling infection, and conservative treatment for two weeks, Xiao Wen's blood cells gradually rose to normal. So how should azathioprine be taken? How can we avoid severe drug side effects like Xiao Wen's? It turns out that in the metabolism of azathioprine, thiopurine methyltransferase (TPMT) is very important. If it is deficient, then some patients will experience severe side effects after taking the drug. Approximately 10% of Chinese people have TPMT gene deletion or abnormality. These patients cannot metabolize azathioprine and will experience severe adverse reactions after taking it. Therefore, for patients with the条件, it is best to perform a blood TPMT level or TPMT genotype test before medication. Azathioprine is in tablet form for oral administration. When starting to take it, there may be some不适的反应. It is usually recommended that patients start with a small dose,推荐剂量为25mg, to allow the patient an适应过程, and then gradually increase the dose. At the same time, it is recommended to check blood counts, liver and kidney function, and other indicators weekly. If side effects occur, stop the medication promptly. By checking TPMT genotype, gradually increasing the dose from a small amount, and monitoring blood cells, the occurrence of azathioprine side effects can be greatly avoided. Xiao Wen recovered and was discharged after active treatment. For her, this drug-induced骨髓抑制 indirectly gave all her blood cells, including immune cells, a "drug holiday", which could be considered a blessing in disguise for her autoimmune disease. We also hope that after this treatment, her autoimmune encephalitis can be fully treated and not recur. ▼Recommended Reading▼ The Only Tumor in the World Named After a Place, Related to China 2021-03-07 The Late Spring Cold Snap is Here, This Group of People is Most Likely to Fall Ill! 4 Key Body Parts建议你多捂七天 2021-03-06 This Dish Found on Almost Every Family's Table Recently is Actually a "Lethal Weapon" for Some People? 2021-03-05

Title: What are the benefits of choosing liberal arts in high school? Content: If you choose liberal arts, your path to university and employment becomes narrower, and it's harder to find a job, unless you get into a top-tier school. However, if you choose science, you can still major in interdisciplinary fields like industrial engineering, transportation, etc., in university. These science majors with a liberal arts slant have good employment prospects. If you want to study liberal arts, that's fine too. Many domestic companies currently have a shortage of professionals in minor languages; you can minor in one. This career offers good compensation. For geography-related fields, you can study geology, petroleum, etc. Don't take things for granted; some high school knowledge becomes obsolete in university. Or a subject you were strong in during high school might hold you back in university. It's better to aim for a balanced approach, get into a reliable university, carefully review the enrollment plans for various majors, combine that with your own interests, and then make a cautious choice. This decision is not something to be taken lightly.

Title: German Virologist: Beijing Has Responded Well to This Outbreak Content: [External Pandemic Perspectives Reference] On June 16, members of the Beijing Blue Sky Rescue Team carried out disinfection operations at the Yuegezhuang Wholesale Market in Fengtai District. Jonas Schmidt-Chanasit, a virologist teaching at the University of Hamburg, pointed out that the recurrence of COVID-19 in Beijing does not mean the second wave has begun. "I am not surprised by the reappearance of the outbreak, and I don't think Chinese experts are either, because the virus itself has not disappeared. The resurgence only highlights that the virus can continue to spread silently through asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic cases until it causes a large-scale infection before being detected." Jonas Schmidt-Chanasit noted that unless there is large-scale cross-regional transmission, meaning outbreaks in only a few areas of one city do not signify the start of a second wave. No one can predict the future regarding whether a second wave will come, but China's epidemic prevention measures are very thorough, striving to prevent a second wave. For instance, in this Beijing case, China responded well, acted quickly, took various effective anti-epidemic efforts, conducted large-scale testing, and promptly locked down certain areas. These are very wise, targeted measures to block the virus's spread. Jonas Schmidt-Chanasit believes that multiple usable COVID-19 vaccines may become available simultaneously in various countries next year. However, there won't be a single super-vaccine suitable for everyone; different vaccines will emerge for different groups such as the elderly, children, high-risk populations, and young people, but not earlier than next year. — Excerpt from Deutsche Welle (DW), June 17, 2020, "I Don't Think China Will Have a Second Wave Now". 2.
