Title: Is there a leakage in the home circuit? Content: Electrical measurement can only measure current; voltage and resistance values are calculated. Resistance measurement is done through direct current. Based on your test phenomenon, it can be guessed that closing the circuit breaker directly connects to the transformer and the transformer is powered off. The neutral wire and ground wire on the transformer are both connected to the grounding grid. The transformer's coil has almost no resistance when direct current passes through, so after closing the circuit breaker, the live wire to ground and neutral wire to ground show connectivity. To verify this idea, check the live wire to neutral wire; it should also be connected. Of course, if the circuit breaker is closed while energized, it will most likely burn out the megohmmeter directly. If the meter has a protection function, it will alarm directly, and you need to distinguish between the alarm buzzer and the connectivity buzzer. If there is a circuit leakage, it will trip when the leakage protection is good. If it occurs, unplug all sockets, turn off the circuit breaker, and measure the ground resistance circuit by circuit to troubleshoot slowly.

Title: Onion paired with "it", eat a little every day, high blood lipids disappear, blood vessels become elastic and smooth as new. Content: What is dyslipidemia? Dyslipidemia is the abbreviation for abnormal blood lipid metabolism, including hypercholesterolemia, hypertriglyceridemia, mixed hyperlipidemia, and low high-density lipoprotein cholesterol血症. Because a decrease in high-density lipoprotein cholesterol in the blood is also a pathological state, dyslipidemia is more comprehensive and accurate than the commonly used term hyperlipidemia. What are triglycerides? Triglycerides, also known as neutral fats, account for about 1/4 of the total lipids in the blood. A considerable part of the food ingested by the human body is stored in the body as energy for use when needed. What factors affect the level of triglycerides in the human body? Studies show that among Chinese patients with dyslipidemia, about 60% have hypertriglyceridemia. The main reasons are as follows. (1) Unhealthy lifestyle, such as some people's fondness for alcohol, especially frequent heavy consumption of beer, increases energy sources, promotes triglyceride synthesis, leading to elevated triglyceride levels in the body. (2) Lack of physical exercise or manual labor, especially for mental workers who sit for long periods, severely affecting the body's metabolism, resulting in reduced breakdown of carbohydrates and fat tissues, increased protein synthesis, significantly decreased energy consumption, and surplus energy stored as fat, often causing elevated triglycerides in the body. How are triglycerides formed? Like cholesterol, triglycerides are fatty substances, and their formation pathways can be divided into exogenous and endogenous. (1) Exogenous pathway: The human body must ingest a certain amount of food daily to maintain energy needs for its activities. After entering the body, part of the triglycerides is hydrolyzed by pancreatic enzymes in the intestine into monoglycerides and fatty acids, then absorbed and stored in the body; another part can be directly absorbed after being dispersed into very small particles by the action of bile acids. These digestive products are absorbed into small intestinal mucosal cells and resynthesized into triglycerides, which then form chylomicrons together with phospholipids, cholesterol, apolipoproteins, etc. When chylomicrons flow through capillaries, they are hydrolyzed into fatty acids and glycerol; fatty acids enter tissues for oxidative energy supply; in adipose tissue, fatty acids can be resynthesized into triglycerides for storage. (2) Endogenous pathway: Besides obtaining triglycerides from food intake, the human body can also synthesize triglycerides itself. Triglycerides are mainly synthesized in the liver and adipose tissue. The synthesized triglycerides form very low-density lipoproteins with apolipoproteins, phospholipids, cholesterol, etc. After this very low-density lipoprotein enters the blood, its triglycerides are hydrolyzed into fatty acids by enzymes and then utilized by tissues. Onion paired with "it", eat a little every day, high blood lipids disappear, blood vessels become elastic and smooth as new. Onion is a very familiar food, so what is this "it"? It refers to flavone glycosides, a type of unsaturated fatty acid that can promote cholesterol decomposition, effectively lowering cholesterol levels. Simultaneously, flavone glycosides can enhance the activity of lipoprotein lipase, thus promoting the decomposition of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol and triglycerides, thereby having a good improving effect on blood lipid levels. 1 kind of coarse grain is the natural "fat absorber". This coarse grain is called buckwheat. Locally, many people roast it and then brew it in water to drink, hence the name Ankang Buckwheat Tea. Buckwheat tea is locally famous as the "fat absorber". Many hyperlipidemia patients seek it out by reputation, and most traditional Chinese medicine lipid-lowering formulas also contain this ingredient. Even the medical book "Yilin Zuan Yao" records: "Neutral and cold nature, calming, activates qi and blood, cleanses and moistens intestines, lowers lipids and relieves constipation." If buckwheat is not easily found around you, it is now available ready-made on the market, saving the effort of preparation. Usually, take 1 spoonful and brew it directly in water to drink; it's simple and convenient. Why can buckwheat tea lower blood lipids? Because it contains 2 components: Selenium: A trace element that can effectively adsorb lipids in the blood, reducing the risk of hyperlipidemia; additionally, it has the effects of anti-vascular oxidation, blood thinning, and anti-free radicals. Rutin: Rutin is a component very rarely found in ordinary foods. It can maintain vascular patency, clear triglycerides, and unblock blood vessels.

Title: In the consultation room, I encountered Aunt Li, who had a worried expression and tightly held a prescription that clearly read 'Respiratory tract infection, third-generation cephalosporin recommended.' Her eyes were full of confusion and unease as she softly asked me, 'Doctor, among cefoperazone, ceftazidime, ceftriaxone, and cefotaxime, which one is best? I've heard that improper use of antibiotics can have serious side effects.' I smiled slightly, signaling her not to worry, and then slowly explained, 'Aunt Li, your concern is shared by many patients. These four cephalosporins are like four aces in our hand, each with its own specialty; the key is to know the opponent.' 'You see, ceftriaxone and cefotaxime are particularly effective against common pathogens like Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae. If your infection is caused by these, choosing them would be correct. However, if you've had previous encounters with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, then ceftazidime or cefoperazone should be used instead, as they are adept at dealing with this stubborn bacterium.' Aunt Li listened intently, her frown gradually easing, but then she became anxious again, 'How do I know which bacteria it is? What if I choose wrong?' I patted the back of her hand reassuringly, 'Don't worry, we have professional tests that can roughly identify the bacteria. Moreover, even if the initial judgment is incorrect, we can adjust the treatment based on the response. It's like playing cards—try one first and switch if needed.' 'Also, Aunt Li, you must be careful: when taking cephalosporins, absolutely avoid alcohol, even a little bit of anything containing alcohol. This is crucial and not a joke,' I emphasized, reminding her of this important safety precaution. Aunt Li nodded repeatedly and asked, 'Will there be any discomfort after taking cephalosporins?' 'Well, it's possible, such as diarrhea, dizziness, or small red spots on the skin for some people. However, these are low-probability events, and most are tolerable. If they do occur, we have ways to manage them,' I patiently explained, trying to alleviate her concerns. After a detailed explanation, Aunt Li finally felt relieved and decided to follow my advice to try ceftriaxone first. A few days later, she returned for a follow-up with a smile, saying her symptoms had significantly improved, and she specifically thanked me, 'Doctor, now I understand. Using medication is like cooking—you need the right remedy for the illness to be cured.' I smiled and shook my head, 'Aunt Li, that's a fitting analogy. However, using medication is much more complex than cooking; it requires professional knowledge and experience. In the future, if you feel unwell, remember to consult a doctor promptly.' The above is a doctor's story.

Title: Why does the rural cooperative medical insurance price increase every year? What are the reasons? Content: New Rural Cooperative Medical Insurance (NRCMS) is very common in rural areas and serves as the most basic medical security for the vast rural population. NRCMS requires an annual payment, and the cost has risen from the initial ten-plus yuan to several hundred yuan now. The NRCMS fees in various regions increase every year.
Although it's only a few hundred yuan per year, for some rural residents with relatively difficult family finances, it still represents a significant expense. Moreover, many people who have paid the insurance premium for years might hardly use it throughout the year, leading them to question whether it's necessary to continue paying.







So, should we continue to pay for NRCMS? First, we need to understand why NRCMS premiums increase every year. The main reasons are as follows!
In 2020, the state required all regions to fully implement the reduction of the deductible line for critical illness insurance for urban and rural residents, unifying it to half of the per capita disposable income of residents. The policy-defined reimbursement ratio was increased to 60%, and regions with conditions were encouraged to explore removing the cap.
Continued increased倾斜支付 for the impoverished population. During the poverty alleviation period, the deductible line for registered poor rural households was halved compared to ordinary insured residents, the reimbursement ratio was increased by 5 percentage points, and the cap for registered poor rural households was completely abolished, further alleviating the medical cost burden for patients with major illnesses and people in difficulty.
If participants are特困人员 (extremely poor individuals), 低保对象 (subsistence allowance recipients), or registered poor rural households joining the resident medical insurance, they can also enjoy medical assistance benefits. Not only are premiums exempted, but the reimbursement ratio is higher, which leads to increasing medical costs.
To maintain the normal operation of the medical insurance fund, appropriately raising the premium standard for urban and rural resident medical insurance is a necessary action to sustain the sustainable development of healthcare.







In 2020, the state steadily increased the individual contribution standard. In principle, the individual contribution standard was raised by 30 yuan simultaneously, reaching 280 yuan per person per year. Although the premium standard was appropriately increased, the state has also been actively enhancing the coverage for residents' medical insurance outpatient and inpatient services.
① Reimbursement Ratio
Nationally, the policy-defined reimbursement ratio for inpatient expenses under resident medical insurance reached about 70%, and the reimbursement ratio for outpatient medical expenses reached 50%, significantly reducing the medical cost burden for urban and rural residents.
② Inclusion of Long-term, High-cost Outpatient Chronic and Special Diseases in Insurance Reimbursement
Regions commonly provide coverage for outpatient chronic and special diseases. Based on the revenue and expenditure of the medical insurance fund, regions include the medical expenses of some long-term, high-cost outpatient chronic diseases and special diseases into the pooled fund payment scope, reducing the outpatient expense burden for the insured. From a local perspective, regions with more covered conditions exceed 50 types, while those with fewer have over ten.
③ Establishment of Outpatient Medication Coverage for Hypertension and Diabetes
For resident medical insurance participants with mild hypertension or diabetes who do not receive outpatient chronic/special disease coverage, the drug costs for lowering blood pressure and blood sugar incurred at secondary and below primary healthcare institutions are included in the fund payment scope, with a policy-defined reimbursement ratio of over 50%.







With the development of the socio-economic level, the average wage of employees and commodity prices increase annually, and the per capita disposable income of residents also rises. To ensure the sustainable development of the medical insurance fund and to improve the treatment level of resident medical insurance, state financial input continues to increase. Although individual contributions for resident medical insurance have increased, the per capita financial subsidy standard for resident medical insurance has also risen from 40 yuan in 2007 to 520 yuan in 2020.

Title: Australian Woman Returning to Beijing Shouts "Help!", Being Unreasonable! Content: Recently, a video of a woman returning from abroad who went out for a run without quarantining has sparked public anger. The woman is an Australian citizen of Chinese descent. After returning to Beijing, she did not follow the rules for home quarantine, went out for a run, and did not wear a mask. Community epidemic prevention personnel discovered her and followed her to her doorstep to advise her against this. The woman turned her head and said, "Get your leader here!" The防疫人员 said to her, "You just came from abroad, you must quarantine at home for 14 days. We didn't expect you to go downstairs for a run, and you're not even wearing a mask!" Subsequently, this is how the woman replied: Even more absurdly, the woman actually forgot her electronic lock password. She was seen continuously entering the password, continuously getting it wrong, and while entering it wrong, she turned around and unleashed a torrent of abuse at the防疫人员: The防疫人员 warned her: Home quarantine for 14 days is a regulation of the Beijing Municipal Government. Unexpectedly, the woman suddenly shouted, "Help!!!" After shouting this, the woman suddenly remembered the password, then opened the door, entered the house, and closed the door. Later, police officers arrived and issued her a warning that she must follow the regulations for home quarantine for 14 days and is not allowed to go out. On March 17, People's Daily published a commentary stating that in recent days, the emotional words and actions of a few returning individuals have been criticized by everyone, also raising a practical issue: the hard-won results of domestic epidemic prevention and control should be cherished by those entering the country, who should adapt to the rhythm of domestic epidemic prevention and control. Some returnees, due to differences in living habits, may not yet be accustomed to the domestic epidemic prevention requirements, especially when in quarantine, which can easily lead to irritability and psychological imbalance. At this moment, what is needed is cooperation, not complaints or even scolding. If epidemic prevention regulations are violated by acting spoiled or unreasonable, such behavior is unacceptable and threatens everyone's collective safety. Latest information: On the evening of March 17, the woman's employer, Bayer AG, issued a statement via its official Weibo account @BayerChina stating: Bayer always complies with the laws and regulations of the countries where it operates and firmly supports the Chinese government and people's efforts to combat the epidemic. Regarding the video circulating online, Bayer verified it immediately. Upon investigation, the person involved is indeed a Bayer employee. Regarding this incident, Bayer makes the following statement: 1. Bayer has terminated the employee's contract in accordance with relevant regulations, effective immediately. 2. All employees of Bayer China should strictly comply with the various measures implemented by local governments to fight the COVID-19 pandemic and strictly abide by local laws and regulations. 3. Bayer will continue to work together with the Chinese government and people to combat the COVID-19 pandemic and contribute to an early final victory. Title: Which freight forwarding company has cheaper prices? Content: There are thousands of freight forwarding companies in the market, and the market has never been monopolized by large companies, which indicates the particularity of the freight forwarding industry. The composition of logistics prices is quite complex, involving policy changes, fuel price fluctuations, cargo variations, market shifts, off-peak and peak season changes, and even war-related fluctuations, so there has never been a stable price. Finding the cheapest freight forwarder to ship goods is something most foreign trade companies want to achieve, because lower shipping costs mean easier deals. However, those who basically run away or have blowouts are often the ones collecting goods at low prices. So, cheap isn't necessarily good. Don't end up losing on both sides. Compare prices from several companies; as long as the price isn't significantly below the market rate, there generally won't be major issues. Don't be greedy for cheap prices and end up losing the goods, having foreign clients refund, and even losing the freight cost. Such incidents are not uncommon. In 2024, about 50 freight forwarding companies in Yiwu encountered problems, with ransom amounts abroad reaching over 20 million. So, reliability is the most important, brother.

Title: If a non-owner causes an accident while driving, can the insurance company refuse compensation? Content: Nowadays, many people choose to drive themselves when traveling, so borrowing cars has become very common. If a traffic accident occurs while lending a car to someone else, the car owner is considered the responsible party for the accident. At this point, if a claim is made to the insurance company and the insurance company refuses compensation on the grounds that the driver was not the owner, what should be done? First, it's necessary to understand whether the insurance company can refuse compensation. In fact, regardless of whether the driver is the owner or not, as long as the vehicle is involved in an accident, the insurance company is required to provide compensation within the limits of the compulsory traffic insurance. Compulsory traffic insurance applies to the vehicle, not the owner. This means that as long as the vehicle is involved in an accident, regardless of who is driving, compensation should be paid. However, if any of the following situations occur, the insurance company has the right to refuse compensation under the vehicle's commercial insurance: 1. The accident was caused by force majeure. There are many force majeure factors, many of which are uncommon. For example, earthquakes, armed militant activities, riots, or compulsory requisition by authorities. In these cases, the insurance company can refuse compensation. 2. The vehicle lacks valid documentation. If there are issues with the vehicle's license plates or documents, the insurance company can also refuse compensation. (1) The driver's license has been revoked. (2) Driving without a license. 3. The vehicle did not undergo its annual inspection on time. The insurance company is only responsible for vehicles that have passed the qualified inspection. If the vehicle did not undergo its annual inspection on time, the insurance company can refuse compensation. 4. If the vehicle involved in the accident was engaged in illegal activity. If the accident occurred due to illegal driving, the insurance company can refuse compensation. For example, drunk driving, driving under the influence of drugs, hit-and-run, or intentional illegal acts. In these cases, of course, one should not expect to receive compensation from the insurance company. 5. Intentional causation of the accident. If the accident was intentionally caused in an attempt to claim compensation from the insurance company to repair pre-existing problems with the car, this falls under the scope of insurance fraud. Not only will compensation be denied, but legal penalties will also be faced. According to the relevant provisions of the 'Insurance Law', if someone other than the owner is driving the vehicle and the insured causes harm to a third party, if the insured does not compensate the third party, the insurance company will not compensate the insured. Insurance-related matters are actually very complex. If the parties involved encounter a situation where the insurance company refuses compensation, it is best to seek assistance from a professional lawyer specializing in insurance. Title: Regulatory Policies Overlay to Stabilize the Property Market, What Signals Are Released? Content: Entering 2024, positive signals emerged in domestic economic expectations. Tianjin registered residents purchasing new commercial residential properties over 120 square meters in the six central districts of Tianjin will no longer require verification of purchase eligibility. 3. Hangzhou, Xi'an: Comprehensive Lifting of Purchase Restrictions. On May 9, Hangzhou issued the 'Notice on Optimizing and Adjusting Real Estate Market Regulation Policies,' explicitly proposing the comprehensive removal of home purchase restrictions and simultaneously relaxing household registration policies. On the same day, Xi'an followed suit, completely canceling property market purchase restriction measures. Many other cities are continuously introducing various stimulus policies. Author's Note: Many stimulus policies for the property market have been introduced recently, but if you think carefully, why are so many being introduced? Isn't it because the management authorities want everyone to feel that, hey, it seems the economy is warming up, recovering, and transaction volumes are rising again, right? However, in the past couple of days, once this social financing data was published, those in the know can see what's really going on. But, ordinary people, where would they understand these data? They simply don't pay attention to things like M1, M2, changes in social financing data, etc. Anyway, no matter when, the economic situation is always described as steadily improving, creating a thriving scene. But if they didn't do this, how would anyone get on board? Otherwise, how can this property market achieve a soft landing? The twenty-year property myth was broken in just three years. Over the past three years, including first-tier cities, national housing prices have experienced the longest and largest adjustment since housing commercialization. It used to be said that buying one year late meant five years of work wasted; in recent years, buying one year early meant ten years of work wasted. The harsh reality has forced more and more people to change their expectations and start viewing the property market more calmly. The most concerning question now is: Have housing prices bottomed out? If they have, will they rise next? If not, how much further will they fall, and for how long? We can also refer to Japan and the US, which experienced prolonged housing price declines. Japan's real estate bubble burst in 1991, and the US subprime mortgage crisis in 2007 triggered a sharp fall in housing prices. Goldman Sachs recently created a housing price comparison chart, aligning the peak times of housing prices in China, the US, and Japan on the same horizontal timeline, and comparing their performance before and after the peak. Although housing prices have fallen significantly over the past three years, they haven't truly bottomed out yet. Future declines may slow, and there might even be short-term transaction increases and price stabilization due to more forceful stimulus measures, but it will be difficult to change the medium-to-long-term downward trend. I am not surprised by the rapid decline in housing prices over the past three years. I don't see it as a decline, but rather a price reset, because China's economy, globalization, and the world order are also changing or even resetting at an unprecedented speed... Finally, regarding the property market and investment direction, here are some clear suggestions: (1) For home-buying decisions, you can first make an assumption for yourself: assume that prices will continue to fall. If you still want to buy a house under this circumstance, then buy. Otherwise, be cautious. (2) Lower expectations, invest cautiously, adhere to the principle that 'losing less is winning,' and conduct investments and consumption by seeking advantages and avoiding disadvantages, both internally and externally. (3) Before the rental yield reaches the mortgage interest rate, never consider buying a house as an investment again. (4) Exercise to help yourself get through difficult times and improve your quality of life. For anyone, only by adhering to common sense, respecting the market, and revering objective laws can one remain invincible; otherwise, the market will punish you, as it did in the past three years.

Title: Suzhou University Conducts Democratic Evaluation for the 2019 Comprehensive Assessment of Department-Level Leadership Teams and Department-Level Cadres Content: According to the "Suzhou University Comprehensive Assessment Measures for Department-Level Leadership Teams and Department-Level Cadres (Trial)" and the university's 2019 comprehensive assessment work arrangement, on May 27, Suzhou University held the democratic evaluation meeting for the 2019 comprehensive assessment of department-level leadership teams and department-level cadres. A total of 115 participants, including department-level cadres, provincial-level "two representatives and one committee member," chairpersons of democratic parties at or above the municipal level, personnel with senior professional titles, and representatives of faculty members from the university's trade union congress executive committee, attended the meeting. The meeting was presided over by Wang Liusong, Secretary of the University Party Committee. Wang Liusong emphasized that to successfully carry out this comprehensive assessment, it is essential to fully recognize the significant importance of the annual comprehensive assessment of department-level leadership teams and department-level cadres. Conducting the annual comprehensive assessment is an important measure by the University Party Committee to strengthen the construction of department-level leadership teams and cadres, and to improve the ability and level of mid-level cadres in managing the university. Through the annual assessment, a comprehensive and accurate understanding and evaluation of the department-level leadership teams and cadres can be achieved, guiding them to further improve their work style, strengthen the construction of a clean and honest administration, and continuously enhance their leadership capabilities and levels. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on the Assessment of Party and Government Leading Cadres," and based on the principles of scientific precision and practical feasibility, the 2019 assessment measures have been further improved in terms of assessment content, methods, democratic evaluation scoring, and the application of assessment results. In line with the requirements of the annual comprehensive assessment for department-level leadership teams and cadres, various specialized assessment groups, participants in the evaluation, and the assessment office must adhere to rules and discipline to ensure the smooth progress of all aspects of the comprehensive assessment. It is crucial to attach great importance to this, coordinate and promote the simultaneous deployment, advancement, and assessment of party building and development, further stimulate the enthusiasm and initiative of department-level leadership teams and cadres in pursuing entrepreneurship, encourage department-level units to form operational mechanisms characterized by self-management, self-restraint, vitality, and innovative development, and promote the healthy, coordinated, and high-quality development of all tasks related to the construction of a local high-level application-oriented university. We can use the fingertip to press and knead this grain-sized bump back and forth, or gently pinch it with a fingernail. Alternatively, you can push back and forth over the Neiguan acupoint, or tap it with the thumb. Place the ginger paste on an adhesive plaster or fine-mesh gauze and apply it to the location of the Heart Bump. Apply for 4-6 hours at a time. Method Two [Herbs] Cinnamon Twig (Guizhi), Salvia Root (Danshen) Cinnamon Twig: Unblocks heart yang, unblocks heart collaterals, increases skin permeability. Salvia Root: Treats heart disease. [Usage Method] Grind the two herbs into powder, mix equal parts into a flour-like consistency, blend with vinegar. Place the medicine on an adhesive plaster and apply it to the location of the Heart Bump. Apply for 3-4 hours at a time. Craving Bump The Craving Bump is related to the spleen, stomach, and digestive system, mainly regulating digestive system diseases. It is primarily located on the Foot Taiyang Sinew Channel. [Location] Draw a line from the inferior angle of the scapula; it passes the seventh thoracic vertebra. Downwards are the 11th and 12th thoracic vertebrae. In the acute stage, it appears quickly and, if handled properly, disappears quickly. In the chronic stage, methods like pressing, kneading, tapping, and application can be used to make the bump smaller or disappear. Due to differences in individual conditions and constitution, the time for disappearance varies – for some it takes a month, for others several months. [Expert Tip] Although the sinew-kneading method is effective for the condition and works well, it is not a panacea. Medication is also needed for regulation. The red dot in the image above indicates the local area with tenderness – you'll know by touching it. There is also distal tenderness around the Weizhong (BL40) acupoint. When feeling the Weizhong acupoint with the hand, it often feels like a long, cord-like strip, sometimes a small, distant bump. Title: Friends, using a laptop as a main computer, will leaving it on like this for a long time damage the machine? Content: Wow~ you're something. I thought you meant using the laptop as a main computer by connecting it to an external monitor. I didn't expect you to just not treat the laptop as a computer at all. But what you're doing is indeed possible. After all, closing the lid will make the C-side very hot, so keeping it half-closed is more reasonable. But facing down is not good; turning it over is better. Adding a stand will work. Using a laptop as a main computer is fine, but you need to pay attention to a few points: one is to keep the lid open and expose the air intake vent (usually on the bottom). Second, set it to display only on the external screen. Then set all power management settings to maximum performance. Even so, the battery life will be affected. Elevating it definitely helps, but under high load it will still be very noisy, after all, it's just a laptop. The heat dissipation issue is a long-standing problem that's hard to solve. I still recommend getting a desktop. Otherwise, over time, if the temperature can't be controlled, you'll have to clean the dust and reapply thermal paste. It's even more troublesome. If you can only use a laptop, I suggest looking into barebone systems; Clevo has a few models with really good cooling. Or buy an air purifier and place the main unit on top of the purifier...

Title: Zhengzhou, Henan, a woman bought a luxury car and cherished it dearly. Content: In Zhengzhou, Henan, a woman bought a luxury car and cherished it dearly. She even specifically spent 17,800 yuan to buy a high-end car wrap at the 4S shop. Unexpectedly, more than a year after taking delivery of the car, something happened. It turned out that the 4S shop had not applied the car wrap for her. The woman was kept in the dark until later, when she went for a car wash, and someone else told her that the car had never been wrapped. On January 18, 2021, Ms. Zhang bought an imported Mercedes-Benz GLE350. The car was not cheap, and at the time, she also spent nearly 20,000 yuan on a high-end car wrap. The staff said that the car could only be picked up after the wrap was applied. When taking delivery, Ms. Zhang assumed the wrap had definitely been applied, so she didn't check again and directly took the car away. It wasn't until September 13 of this year, when Ms. Zhang went for a car wash, that the young man told her: "The car has no film applied at all." This was strange. She clearly spent 17,800 yuan on the car wrap, but the 4S shop didn't apply it, making one question the reason. Ms. Zhang said: "We don't understand this stuff. They didn't remind me that it wasn't applied. I specifically went to the after-sales department, and it was confirmed that the car wrap was indeed not applied. As a consumer, I trusted the 4S shop, which is why I paid the money there. But now, since it wasn't applied, where did the money go, and where is the car wrap?" This shows that Ms. Zhang completely trusted the 4S shop before. She didn't understand car wraps, so she never discovered the problem. But now, the agreed-upon wrap wasn't applied, and the reason needs to be clarified; otherwise, the nearly 20,000 yuan spent would be a total loss. Actually, this situation is quite easy to resolve. First, Ms. Zhang bought the car wrap through formal channels at the 4S shop, so there should be relevant invoice proof, making it possible to defend her rights later. There are two possible outcomes when defending rights. The first is that the 4S shop forgot about it and did not intentionally fail to apply the wrap. In that case, the consumer can negotiate with the 4S shop to choose to terminate the wrap application contract, get a refund, or have the wrap applied as a remedy. According to Article 577 of the Civil Code, if one party fails to perform its contractual obligations or performs them in a manner inconsistent with the agreement, it shall bear liability for breach of contract such as specific performance, remedial measures, or compensation for losses. If Ms. Zhang no longer wants the wrap applied, she can also rescind the contract according to the relevant provisions of Articles 562 and 563 of the Civil Code, get a refund of the 17,800 yuan for the car wrap, and claim relevant liquidated damages. The second scenario for defending rights is if the 4S shop engaged in intentional fraud, which could involve refunding the amount and paying triple damages. It has been about 1 year and 8 months since Ms. Zhang took delivery of the car. If the 4S shop intentionally deceived her, making her believe the wrap was applied, then it涉嫌欺诈 (suspected fraud). Ms. Zhang can provide relevant evidence to defend her rights. So, what is the nature of this incident? Regarding this, the manager of the 4S shop said: "This is an imported car. At the time, it needed to go to the vehicle management office first for licensing and inspection. The car wrap cannot be applied before the inspection, so it was planned to be applied later. However, the staff member previously handling this resigned, and the handover was not done properly, resulting in the car wrap never being applied and a failure to communicate effectively with Ms. Zhang." In other words, the main reason the 4S shop didn't apply the wrap was due to an employee resignation and an inadequate handover, not intentional fraud. Such situations do exist in reality. A work oversight might warrant some compensation at most, but it doesn't amount to fraud. Ms. Zhang also said: "In the age of big data, whether it was applied or not can be known by checking the records. Businesses can forget things sometimes, which is understandable. But I discovered this myself. What if I hadn't discovered it?" Ms. Zhang was still dissatisfied. However, she later chose to resolve it through negotiation. The 4S shop manager apologized to Ms. Zhang and proposed applying the car wrap now and offering some additional compensation. But Ms. Zhang refused. She requested a refund, and both parties reached an agreement. From this, it seems that in work, resignation handovers indeed need to be careful, and a resignation checklist is necessary. When an employee resigns, the company should prepare a checklist listing all unfinished tasks to facilitate the handover and try to avoid omissions. For consumers, when taking delivery of a car, it's best to inspect it. Generally, a car with a wrap applied will have a different feel and glossiness. Before taking delivery, check that all accessories have been installed to avoid omissions.

Title: Why does the idle speed of an old Buick car fluctuate up and down, sometimes causing stalling? Content: Many factors can cause unstable engine idle speed. First, check the carbon buildup on the throttle body, idle valve, intake manifold, and fuel injectors. Excessive carbon buildup can lead to unstable idle speed, difficulty starting, or stalling while driving. The working condition of the idle valve is also very important; vehicles with high mileage are prone to idle valve failure. Secondly, focus on checking the working condition of the spark plugs and ignition coils. Poor performance of the ignition system can also cause unstable idle speed. Spark plugs need to be replaced every 3,000 kilometers. Additionally, faults in the electronic control system can be a cause. For an electronically controlled engine to work properly, it needs to collect information from various sensors. Inaccurate sensor signals can also lead to engine idle shaking or stalling while driving. Such faults require a comprehensive inspection. Hello, regarding the issue of unstable idle speed, shaking, and easy stalling, it is usually caused by a dirty throttle body. This leads to reduced air intake, which in turn causes poor engine idle. You can solve this by simply cleaning the throttle body. Furthermore, if your spark plugs are faulty, fuel pressure is insufficient, or there is an air leak in the intake system, these are also common causes of unstable idle speed and even stalling. You can have these checked at a repair shop. Also, the quality of the fuel and the degree of carbon buildup in the intake system have a significant impact on the stability of the engine idle speed. Title: Everyone, talk about why your bank cards were frozen? How did you finally get the freeze lifted? Content: I inexplicably received two payments totaling 228 yuan. If I don't transfer money into it myself, the turnover in my card should be less than 5,000. As for how someone got my card number to send me money, I had previously joined one of those scam groups and made small advance payments, which were repaid. Later, I advanced payments twice and was blocked by the scammer. After that, when I encountered similar situations, I didn't advance any more money. I faked screenshots, and they still paid me back. After I finished getting the benefits, I told everyone in the group it was a scam and to leave quickly. The scammer said they would retaliate against me, but I didn't take it seriously. I said, 'Go ahead, if I receive money, I'll report it to the police.' Over a month later, my card received dirty money. I didn't know at the time because my card doesn't have SMS notifications. It was probably around noon the day after receiving the money, when I was adding funds to my stock account, I transferred money into the card and then noticed those two suspicious payments. When I tried to transfer money to my securities account, I found it was blocked. I went to the bank to ask and was told it was blocked by a public security bureau in another location. I called that bureau, explained a lot, and they simply said it needed investigation and to wait three days. After three days, it was unblocked, and then I went to the bank to unfreeze it. About ten days later, it was frozen again, but this time it was different. All the bank cards under my name were restricted to counter services only. I hope that on Monday they can produce evidence that I rented or sold my bank card. I don't know if those police officers have any brains. If I were money laundering, how much money would come in and not go out? If I were a scammer, would I use my own card to receive 200 yuan? Title: For tooth filling, should I choose removable dentures, porcelain teeth, or dental implants? Content: One day 6 years ago, Old Zhang lost a tooth. Being frugal, he opted for relatively cheap removable dentures. But before long, the dentures became loose, constantly shifting in his mouth. After persisting for about 3 years, several healthy teeth next to the dentures actually became loose and soon fell out one after another. As he lost more and more teeth, Old Zhang began to suffer from malnutrition, and his physical condition worsened, his weight dropping from 128 jin to just over 100 jin. 'I can't bite into anything tasty; if I use a little force, I feel like the adjacent teeth are going to fall out; food gets stuck in the gaps, making it hard to eat and drink properly. Eating feels like torture,' Old Zhang sighed repeatedly. Tooth loss is a problem many people face. Currently, there are three methods for repairing missing teeth: removable dentures, porcelain teeth, and dental implants. What are the pros and cons of these three restoration methods? Which tooth filling method is better to choose? This publication interviewed Professor Deng Manjing, Director of the Stomatology Department at Daping Hospital, Army Medical University, who provided detailed answers to these questions. Removable Dentures: These are the most commonly mentioned traditional dentures. Since they are removable, their stability is naturally poor, making it difficult to achieve the chewing efficiency of natural teeth; furthermore, dentures can easily corrode adjacent teeth or cause tooth loosening. Porcelain Teeth: These belong to the category that cannot be easily removed, also called fixed dentures. They involve grinding down the healthy teeth adjacent to both sides of the gap to serve as abutment teeth, then placing a crown over them, connecting the two sides, and placing a false tooth in the middle, like building a bridge, hence they are called 'porcelain bridges.' Their biggest drawback is the significant damage to natural teeth, requiring the intentional grinding down of otherwise healthy teeth. Dental Implants: These involve directly placing a root into the alveolar bone and then placing a crown on it, completely simulating the physiological structure of a natural tooth. Professor Deng Manjing explained that implant materials are broadly divided into two parts: the root material and the crown material. The crown material can be flexibly chosen according to the patient's wishes, but the root material has strict regulations. Currently, the commonly used root material is mainly titanium. Titanium has good wear resistance, corrosion resistance, and biocompatibility; it is non-toxic, has no side effects on the human body, is non-magnetic, non-irritating, and stable within the body. Besides dental implants, titanium is widely used in artificial bones and joints, heart valves, pacemakers, etc. Compared to removable dentures and porcelain teeth, dental implants have two main advantages: ① They can take root in the patient's alveolar bone like natural teeth, transmitting the chewing pressure in the oral cavity to the alveolar bone through the root (implant), able to withstand forces within physiological limits. When chewing, they help restore the comfort of natural teeth, significantly improving chewing efficiency compared to traditional dentures, and can also sense cold, heat, sour, sweet, fragrant, and spicy sensations. ② Dental implants do not rely on adjacent teeth for fixation; they have good independence and integrity. Not only is there no foreign body sensation in the mouth, making patients easily forget the presence of the dentures, but there is also a gap between the implant and adjacent teeth, making cleaning as convenient and durable as with natural teeth. In 1965, Professor Branemark from Sweden placed the first titanium implant. After more than 50 years of continuous improvement and development, dental implants, as a restoration method very similar to natural teeth in function, structure, and aesthetic effect, have become the preferred choice in the field of stomatology and for patients with missing teeth. Especially in the last decade, dental implants have developed rapidly. Computer-aided digital navigation technology has enabled fast, precise, and minimally invasive surgery. For elderly patients with complete tooth loss, implant technology can help them achieve the dream of same-day surgery, same-day denture placement, and same-day eating. Like our own teeth, dental implants can also get sick; they similarly face destruction by bacteria and viruses, as well as damage from forces, such as peri-implantitis. This directly affects the lifespan of the implant. Therefore, Professor Deng Manjing reminds us that post-operative care and daily maintenance of dental implants are particularly important. Elderly patients must strictly follow the doctor's instructions after implant surgery, such as: consuming liquid food within 24 hours after surgery, not brushing teeth to avoid irritating the wound; within 3 to 6 months after suture removal, pay attention to protecting the artificial tooth root. Only after the implant and alveolar bone form a firm osseointegration can normal chewing function be restored. After successful implantation, pay attention to maintaining oral hygiene, adjust personal lifestyle and hygiene habits, have regular dental check-ups, and create a good use environment for the implant. For example, eliminate bad habits that can easily cause inflammation of the soft tissues around the implant, such as smoking and incorrect use of toothpicks. If infection occurs around the implant, seek medical attention promptly for special cleaning of the implant and routine cleaning of the surrounding natural teeth. Title: Practicing the Spirit of Lei Feng, Border Inspection Police Donate School Supplies to Mountain Children
Content: Beijing Daily Client | Reporter Zhang Lei
On the eve of the Lei Feng Memorial Day, Beijing Daxing International Airport Border Inspection Station held a unique theme party day activity titled 'Let the Spirit of Lei Feng Shine Brightly in the New Era'. School leaders, teachers, and students from Laobao Township Central Primary School in Sanjiang Dong Autonomous County, Liuzhou, Guangxi, where the station's young police officer Zhang Kuo is currently teaching as part of a support program, were invited to participate online. After the event, over 30 types, totaling more than 10,000 pieces of school supplies donated by the police officers were packed and mailed to the teachers and students. Since the National Immigration Administration launched the teaching support program, Daxing Airport Border Inspection Station has actively responded to the call. Outstanding young Party member Zhang Kuo, after passing multiple selection rounds, went to teach in Sanjiang County, Guangxi, in February this year as one of the fifth batch of support teachers. Sanjiang County is located on the edge of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, with continuous mountains. The Laobao Township Central Primary School where Zhang Kuo went to teach is particularly remote, surrounded by mountain roads. When he walked into the school along the rugged mountain path, he was met with old teaching buildings and the dark-skinned faces of the mountain children. The teaching and living conditions made him deeply aware of the hardships these children face. After settling in, he immediately reported the teaching support work situation to the Party branch of his duty team. Upon learning of the situation, the Party Committee of Daxing Airport Border Inspection Station used the 'March 5th Lei Feng Memorial Day' as an opportunity to issue an initiative within the station to donate school supplies to Laobao Township Central Primary School in Sanjiang County, leading the donation effort. The police officers were very enthusiastic, donating over 30 types of school supplies including exercise books, pens, geometry sets, school bags, globes, colored markers, volleyballs, and extracurricular books, totaling more than 10,000 items. 'You are loyal practitioners of the Lei Feng spirit!' praised the principal of Laobao Township Central Primary School during the donation ceremony. Zhang Kuo expressed that becoming a support teacher, he hopes he can 'contribute his modest effort like a speck of dust to the mountains and seas, and add a glimmer of light like a firefly to the sun and moon.' As a member of Daxing Airport Border Inspection Station, he will more actively learn from Comrade Lei Feng, take initiative and responsibility, integrate his personal goals into the collective good, and contribute his modest strength to the development and growth of the township central primary school and its students. All along, while fulfilling its duties of maintaining port safety and stability, Daxing Airport Border Inspection Station has always adhered to a people-centered approach, actively serving local social and economic development. Especially since the National Immigration Administration began its targeted poverty alleviation work in Sanjiang County, the station has deeply engaged in the front lines of rural revitalization by purchasing local agricultural products and sending personnel for teaching support, contributing to the national rural revitalization strategy.

Title: Saved 100,000 yuan over the past two years, mostly kept in Yu'ebao. Are there any more stable wealth management options? Content: Are you really content with just leaving this 100,000 yuan in Yu'ebao? Leaving 100,000 yuan in Yu'ebao earns less than 4 yuan a day in interest, can you believe it? I checked Yu'ebao's recent returns the other day, and they were so low it was hard to look at! For instance, the 7-day annualized yield recently fell below 1.4%. What should we do when the interest earned on money kept there keeps decreasing? Are there other investment channels available for ordinary folks like us? Actually, currently, there are mainly three types of stable wealth management products in the market that can lock in returns: bank deposits, government bonds, and long-term savings insurance. So, which of these three methods offers higher returns? Without exaggeration or bias, let's compare them properly today. 1. Looking at familiar bank deposits First, there are bank deposits, which we are all quite familiar with. If you have 100,000 yuan on hand that you won't need in the short term and just want to deposit it in the bank to earn some interest, how much can you actually make? Many friends have probably heard this year that the interest rates for 3-year fixed deposits at major banks are generally higher than or equal to those for 5-year deposits: this is commonly known as an 'inverted yield curve'! So, assuming you deposit 100,000 yuan for about 10 years, and considering that banks calculate simple interest, the best way to maximize returns is to withdraw the principal and interest upon maturity and redeposit it. For example, for a 3-year fixed deposit, withdraw and redeposit the money upon maturity. After doing this three times consecutively, by the tenth year, the total principal and interest would be 135,243.53 yuan. If you opt for a 5-year deposit, you only need to perform this operation once. By the tenth year, the total in the account would be 129,390.63 yuan. As you can see, due to the 'inverted yield curve,' the return from the 3-year deposit is significantly higher! 2. Considering Chinese government bonds The second option is government bonds. Simply put, this is like lending money to the country. Their returns are slightly higher than bank deposits. For example, the recently issued government bonds had a 3-year rate of 3.2% and a 5-year rate of 3.37%. However, although these products are good, they are basically snatched up quickly. For instance, a 40-billion-yuan quota of government bonds released recently was sold out in less than a minute. So, whether you can buy them depends on luck. Similarly, let's calculate buying 100,000 yuan worth of government bonds and holding them for about 10 years using the method above. If you buy the 3-year bond, the principal and interest upon maturity would be 135,866.17 yuan. For the 5-year bond, after 10 years, the total would be 136,539.23 yuan. Both methods mentioned above are commonly heard of and frequently used. The advantages are obvious: whether it's government bonds or bank deposits within the 500,000 yuan deposit insurance limit, there's no need to worry about safety. Secondly, they are very easy to get started with. You can basically handle them through major bank apps or at physical branches. Of course, there are drawbacks too. If you want to maximize returns, you have to repeat the process every 3 or 5 years. Although it's a bit troublesome, it's not particularly difficult. The hardest part is a crucial prerequisite: you must ensure that interest rates won't fall further over the next 10 years and will remain at this level. But honestly, given the current situation, I'm not very optimistic about that. Government bond rates are dropping, and deposit rates are inverted. So, it's likely that the actual money received in the future might not be as much. Now, the third option I want to talk about is long-term savings insurance. 3. Researching long-term savings insurance Its stability level is similar to banks and government bonds, and it is protected by strict regulations and the Contract Law. There's no need to worry about future redemption issues. For example, the increasingly popular whole life insurance with increasing coverage (增额终身寿) in recent years has its returns clearly stated in the contract. Still, assuming a lump-sum payment of 100,000 yuan (for a 30-year-old woman), after 10 years, the cash value would be 140,040 yuan, which is considerably higher. This is because this type of asset is the only one that calculates compound interest, with returns potentially reaching close to 3.5% compound interest. However, it also has a drawback: lower liquidity. For instance, in the early years, these increasing coverage policies have a 'lock-up period.' For the product I used as an example, there are no returns in the first 6 years: If you want to withdraw money to spend during this period, you could even incur a significant loss. But starting from the 7th year, its cash value exceeds the premiums paid. By the 8th year, its returns suddenly surpass the other two options. And as time goes by, this lead keeps increasing. By the 21st year, the cash value is 204,410 yuan, meaning the premiums paid have doubled. Crucially, it is not affected by declining interest rates. That is to say, if you now choose an account with compound interest close to 3.5%, no matter how the market changes in the future, your returns are already locked in. So, after comparing, let me summarize for everyone: If you have some idle money and only plan to use it for short-term wealth management, wanting to earn stable returns without loss, then choosing bank deposits or government bonds is definitely suitable – pick whichever offers the higher rate. However, if you won't need this funds in the short term and can accept holding them for ten or twenty years – for example, planning to save for your child's future use or to accumulate a pension for yourself – then you might want to seriously consider whole life insurance with increasing coverage. After all, it is currently one of the few assets that can achieve 3.5% compound interest growth and lock in rates long-term. It also allows flexible withdrawals; after the lock-up period, you can withdraw money through 'partial surrender' (减保). The only prerequisite is that you must choose the right product. As for how to select a good whole life insurance with increasing coverage and what good products are currently available on the market, I have previously done a detailed evaluation of popular products currently on sale. If you need it, you can leave me a message saying '增额寿排行榜' (ranking of whole life insurance with increasing coverage), and I'll share it with you for free. Finally, follow me to learn how to make money, manage wealth, and grab benefits – don't miss out!

Title: Attention! This "Delivery Guy" is All Over Social Media, Many People Have Added His WeChat! Multiple People Have Been Scammed~ Content: Cooperation & Suggestions WeChat & Phone丨13106994328 Recently, a screenshot of a WeChat friend request from an account named "XX Express" offering to deliver a package has gone viral on WeChat Moments. It's the image below. From the message in the image, you can see a person claiming to be a "XX Express" delivery guy wants to add you on WeChat, with a few key points: 1. The delivery guy adds you via a shared contact card. 2. The delivery guy's reason for adding you: claims your package has arrived but your phone was unreachable, making delivery impossible! Is it really that simple? This is a new type of scam! Recently, there have been multiple cases in Shenzhen of impersonating delivery personnel for fraud! The method involves the "delivery person" adding you on WeChat, claiming "Your package is lost, we can offer a full refund." Once the victim believes it, they send a link or QR code, and the victim's money is quickly transferred. Police remind the public not to easily add strangers on WeChat and to be vigilant about fund security. There have been multiple cases of impersonating delivery personnel for fraud. According to the Shenzhen Anti-Telecom Network Fraud Center, Shenzhen has recently seen multiple cases of fraud involving impersonation of delivery personnel. Case 1: Not long ago, Ms. Shao reported that she received a call from someone pretending to be staff from a certain courier company. The caller informed her that her package was lost and intended to provide a full refund, but required Ms. Shao to add them on WeChat. Subsequently, Ms. Shao, following the other party's instructions, took out an online bank loan and paid over ten thousand yuan by scanning a QR code provided by the other party. Case 2: Ms. Luo encountered a similar situation. Ms. Luo received a call from someone claiming to be courier company staff, saying her package was lost and offering compensation. After adding the person on WeChat, Ms. Luo clicked a link sent by the other party, filled in her bank account number and password as requested, entered a verification code, and then discovered over ten thousand yuan had been transferred from her bank account. Method: Sending Phishing Links to Defraud. A Shenzhen CID officer explained the modus operandi of such cases to a reporter. The victim receives a WeChat friend request, with the sender's identity showing as "XX Express." The reason for the friend verification is "Your package has arrived, but the phone was unreachable." After adding the person, they will ask if the package has been delivered, if the delivery person called, and tell the victim "You have a package that is lost." Immediately after, the victim receives a call from someone claiming to be from the courier company's headquarters, informing the victim that the lost package qualifies for double compensation. This is the critical step: the scammer sends a QR code to the victim and instructs them to perform a series of operations. After scanning the code, the victim's phone screen jumps to a login page very similar to Alipay, requiring the entry of Alipay account, bank card number, and password. After these steps are completed, the money on the victim's card is immediately transferred. Exploiting the victim's eagerness to receive packages by impersonating a delivery person and adding them on WeChat for fraud is truly despicable! Currently, this scam method is relatively new. If you are waiting for a package and encounter this situation, please be vigilant!!! Below, our editor will help you see through the "fake delivery guy's" scam trap with this image 👇 Our editor reminds everyone to improve your discernment when adding friends. If a stranger actively tries to add you, always verify their identity. Besides the above cases, our editor has also summarized several similar scams: 01 The "Beauty Selling Tea" Series. Remember the WeChat message that was wildly shared on Moments a while ago? ↓↓↓ Some netizens personally experienced adding a WeChat friend. After daily chats and continuously updated life moments on their朋友圈 for over two months, "the beauty I added two months ago finally tried to sell me tea." 02 Impersonating System Messages. When scammers send friend requests, they fill in the verification message with "From Mobile Contacts" or "System detected you and XXX have XXX mutual friends." This small trick might make you add them as a friend. ● From Contacts: ● System detected you and XXX have XXX mutual friends: 03 Using Strange Phrases as Verification Messages, Impersonating an Acquaintance. ● Are you sick, how did I offend you yesterday? ● Why aren't you replying to my QQ messages? ● I'm Old Liu, Manager Wang asked me to find you. … 04 "People Greeting from Nearby". "They" usually have very attractive profile pictures, making you secretly pleased, your heart beating fast, thinking you might spark something with them... Police Reminder: Do not easily add strangers on WeChat. Do not easily click on links to fill out information. Shenzhen CID reminds citizens that when receiving calls from unknown numbers, be sure to carefully scrutinize them. Do not easily believe claims like double compensation. Do not easily add strangers as WeChat friends. If you haven't received a package, first log in to the shopping website to check the logistics information, which contains the delivery person's phone number. Contact the delivery person directly by phone. If you have already added the person on WeChat, never fill in personal information such as bank account numbers or Alipay accounts on any website links sent by the other party. Pay attention to protecting your fund security. Furthermore, the general procedure for a lost package is: The courier company verifies the item's value, etc. -> The courier company compensates the seller -> The seller reships the goods. Therefore, even if a package is really lost, you should contact the seller, not the shopper personally. Please be more vigilant. Be extra careful with monetary transactions. Hurry up and share this with the person waiting for a package near you! Source: Guangzhou Daily, Shenzhen CID, Guangdong Criminal Police

Title: Answering Apprentice Questions (Part 11) Content: Unconsciously, we've reached the eleventh installment. This apprentice reads the materials quite carefully and asks detailed questions. Since you are eager to learn, I will teach you diligently. How much you grasp depends on yourself. As the saying goes, the master leads you in, but the practice is up to the individual. 1. I have my own company, can I use my own company to submit samples for inspection? Answer: Of course you can. 2. The company's business scope includes food (pre-packaged food, online sales). Is this acceptable? Answer: I think what you want to ask is whether your own company, whose business scope includes food, can accept commissioned sample submissions. Yes, it can. 3. Can every testing company test everything? For example: donkey-hide gelatin, sibutramine, phenolphthalein, ginseng heavy metals, etc. Answer: Testing companies are generally categorized by their scope of detectable items. For instance, some can only test food and drugs; some, with additional categories, can test environmental pollution, clothing, jewelry, alcoholic beverages, etc. All the items you mentioned - donkey-hide gelatin, sibutramine, phenolphthalein, ginseng heavy metals - fall within the scope of food testing, and many testing companies can perform these tests. 4. Does 'targeting medicinal and food homology' mean adding traditional Chinese medicinal ingredients to the ingredient list? Answer: We should call it 'targeting illegal non-medicinal and food homology'. It basically refers to the illegal addition of traditional Chinese medicinal ingredients that are *not* considered both medicine and food into ordinary food. This is the category we target for cracking down on fakes. However, there are some shameless manufacturers who claim it was a labeling mistake and they didn't actually add the ingredient, and this has been supported by the courts and market supervision bureaus. So, my suggestion is to always rely on the actual test results. 5. Regarding medicinal and food homology, even if it's known not to comply with food safety standards, why would they still add it to the ingredient list? Is it possible that traditional Chinese medicinal ingredients are added but not listed in the ingredient list? Answer: Yes, it is possible. For example, our team is currently targeting cases where senna leaves are illegally added to substitute teas or flavored teas (which are ordinary foods). Senna leaves are a traditional Chinese medicinal ingredient, a raw material for health foods, not for ordinary foods. Drinking too much may lead to melanosis coli. The unscrupulous merchants don't list it in the ingredient list, so detection can only rely on testing. 6. How to identify when health products fraudulently use others' licenses? Is calling the manufacturer for confirmation the only way? Answer: You can check on the SAMR (State Administration for Market Regulation) website. 7. If a health product has a fraudulent name, ingredient list, license, manufacturer, etc., is testing the only way to prove it's counterfeit and shoddy? Answer: There's another method. You can file a complaint with the market supervision bureau of the location stated as the manufacturer on the label. They will reply to you, stating that it was not produced by a manufacturer in their area. This serves as an official proof of counterfeit goods, which can be used to sue the merchant. 8. Which foods are prone to having illegal additives? For example, dried noodles often have sodium bicarbonate added, etc. Answer: Go watch the video lesson again; it's covered there. 9. For conducting test-based actions, it's necessary to purchase the product multiple times. In the course materials about targeting weight loss drugs, it says: frequently send videos to the merchant, informing them of weight changes. Could this alert the merchant, causing them not to ship the product, as the customer's behavior seems abnormal? Answer: If you *don't* send them, they might think you're abnormal. But don't be too frequent; about once every two or three days is enough, for up to a month. Once the test results come out after a month, you can proceed with negotiation or litigation. 10. In one lesson, it said: Build your own database, create an Excel file, and compile these statistics. The more judgment documents we read, the more data we accumulate, and we will gradually summarize some patterns. Is there a template for this table? I'd like to use it for reference. Answer: Yes, send me a private message to request it. 11. After we confirm that a weight loss drug contains sibutramine, and we purchase it a second time, we ask the merchant for a return address (to facilitate serving court summons to the merchant). If the address the merchant gives me is a courier station, or the phone number is wrong or not in use, what should we do? Answer: There's no easy way; you can only rely on more communication or accessing archival records. 12. The 'Counterfeit and Shoddy Goods Notice' section in the 'National Medical Products Administration' website is gone. Where can I quickly find safety information about cosmetics now? Answer: It's in the course materials, under the 'Poisonous Mushroom Effect'. 13. The course materials say you shouldn't have three or four cases on hand at once. If you only have one or two cases, and they are scheduled for court hearings two or three months later, will the judge think we are purchasing in large quantities within a short period and thus not consumers? Answer: It's possible, depending on the locality. However, the Supreme People's Court now has a draft soliciting opinions that supports 'knowingly buying fakes' within the scope of consumption. This is intended to standardize judicial rulings. 14. Recently, I've added many micro-businesses from Xiaohongshu selling weight loss products, male health products, and tonics. They asked for my height and weight, which I reported falsely. If I purchase weight loss products from them using false height and weight information, what happens in court when the judge sees that the reported height and weight don't match my actual height and weight? Answer: It's not important; it's not the focal point of the trial. 15. Can new resource foods be added to ordinary foods? Answer: New resource foods approved by the SAMR can be added. 16. Where can I view documents issued by the state? For example, notifications and documents regarding liquid-state fermentation baijiu (which uses food spices, meaning it's not pure grain liquor) and solid-state fermentation baijiu. Answer: SAMR website or Baidu. 17. How can I quickly determine the category of a commodity in GB2760? For example, some say grilled cold noodles are 'raw wet noodle products', others say they are 'seasoned noodle products'. How to distinguish? Answer: It's a bit like spicy strips (latiao), which also have two national standards; either can be used. 18. In the course on negotiation and payment techniques, if the merchant offers an extra 500 yuan and asks us to tell them who is behind targeting them, if we accept the money, could the merchant turn around and cause trouble for us? Answer: No, because it was offered voluntarily by the other party. 19. What do the product receipt video and the sample submission for testing video look like? Could you send me a few examples? This evidence is too important; I'm afraid one wrong step could lead to losing the entire game. Answer: Yes, send me a private message to request them. We use online notarization software to do this. 20. If a merchant's business license address, shipping address, and return address are all different, which address should be used when filing a lawsuit? Answer: The business license address. 21. If we sue the merchant at the location where they ship the goods, and the court does not agree to an online hearing, do we have to appear in person for the hearing? Answer: Yes. Litigation is the means. The goal is to stop the merchant from continuing to sell counterfeits. 22. If some merchants are stubborn and refuse to comply, even if the court has ruled in favor of tenfold compensation, but the merchant simply refuses to pay, what should be done? Answer: Apply for compulsory enforcement. Remember, after the case number is issued, try to apply for property preservation as much as possible.

Title: How do you get and treat hallux valgus? Content: Hallux valgus is a relatively common foot deformity among middle-aged and elderly women, often caused by development and long-term wearing of narrow shoes. The specific treatment method for this condition should be determined based on the severity of the hallux valgus. If there are no clinical symptoms and only the deformity exists, no special treatment is needed. For mild hallux valgus, foot clips or hallux valgus correction shoes should be used for correction. If the deformity is severe and accompanied by significant pain symptoms that affect foot movement, orthopedic surgery should be performed. ### Hallux valgus refers to the excessive tilting of the big toe toward the outside of the foot. Treatment is divided into non-surgical and surgical methods. For patients with early-stage mild pain and not very obvious deformity, non-surgical methods can be adopted, including local hot compresses, physical therapy, massage, and foot muscle exercises. Patients can be guided to frequently pull the big toe toward the inside of the foot and wear loose shoes. Surgical treatment is for patients with significant pain and severe deformity who have not responded to non-surgical treatment. The goal of surgery is to reduce pain and correct the deformity. ### Hello, generally speaking, hallux valgus has hereditary factors and acquired factors, such as wearing inappropriate shoes. Treatment is usually primarily surgical correction. ### Bunion is a disease often caused by wearing small shoes or incorrect walking posture. To treat it, surgical or corrective treatment methods can be used.

Title: Is the sound quality of open-ear headphones good? Content: There is actually no definitive answer to whether the sound quality of open-ear headphones is good or not, because open-ear headphones also have their unique advantages and characteristics. Due to the design of open-ear headphones, if compared with in-ear headphones, they might be slightly inferior in terms of sound reproduction accuracy and noise cancellation features. Of course, the sound quality of open-ear headphones is not necessarily poor; their main characteristic is providing a more natural listening experience, along with clearer and more detailed sound nuances. They emphasize a wide soundstage, relaxed sound, and easy listening, making them very suitable for users who listen to music or make calls for extended periods. So, are there any open-ear headphones with good sound quality worth buying? Certainly, there are. I recently purchased several high-sound-quality open-ear headphones, and the listening experience has been excellent, making them highly recommended for purchase.

Price: 299

The Hongmi HOLME Fit 2 is an open-ear headphone that is most worth adding to your shopping list in 2024. It offers excellent comfort with its unique composite ear hook design. The front part of the ear hook uses ABS hard plastic for stable force distribution, making it less likely to fall off no matter how much you move your head. The rear part uses liquid silicone material, offering a skin-friendly experience. Furthermore, it allows for 48° adjustment, with adjustable tightness and a close fit, adapting to different ear shapes. Each earpiece weighs only 8.9g, making it perfect for various scenarios such as daily fitness, indoor gaming, and office work. When listening to music, you can hear sufficiently detailed 3x sound details, adequately meeting the general public's demands for sound quality. Additionally, it includes HD sound beam directional transmission technology. This technology, based on the principle of bat ultrasound, concentrates sound into the ears, significantly reducing sound leakage. Overall, the Hongmi Fit 2 is an open-ear headphone particularly suitable for enjoying music and answering calls.

Owning the Hongmi HOLME Fit 2 is like having three headphones in one, as the Hongmi Fit 2 features three modes: music, gaming, and sports, allowing for effective switching based on whether you are listening to music, playing games, or exercising. The earpieces offer a battery life of 8 hours per charge, and with the charging case, the total battery life extends to 32 hours, eliminating concerns about battery life during long trips or running sessions. The headphones also feature a dual-microphone noise cancellation design, greatly reducing environmental noise. An IPX5 waterproof rating makes them suitable even for intense sweating during running. Furthermore, HBC smart dual-connect allows for an experience where you can play games and listen to music simultaneously. Considering all these points, I believe the Hongmi Fit 2 deserves to be called a high-value open-ear headphone where both performance and price are maximized.

In terms of wearing experience, the Youlv Ringbuds Pro uses ergonomic aerospace-grade titanium alloy ear hooks, plastic, and素皮 (vegan leather?) materials. It is not only resistant to deformation and adaptable to different ear sizes but also has a premium feel and offers great comfort. Regarding performance, the Bluetooth 5.3 technology used in the Youlv Ringbuds Pro provides stable connection and faster transmission speeds. It also supports dual-device connection, allowing free switching between two Bluetooth devices, so you won't be interrupted by incoming calls while watching movies. The battery life of the Youlv Ringbuds Pro is 9 hours per charge for the earpieces, and 40 hours with the charging case, totaling 49 hours, which is considered top-tier among open-ear headphones. The dual-microphone call noise cancellation technology effectively distinguishes between voice and environmental noise, enhancing call quality.
