Title: Can men build muscle starting from age 40? Content: I know many 40-year-old men often worry that 'they are too old to build muscle,' but scientific research indicates that the primary cause of muscle loss is long-term lack of exercise, not age itself (Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise, 2017). With age, testosterone levels decline by 1-2% per year, and growth hormone secretion decreases, which indeed affects muscle synthesis efficiency. However, regular resistance training can reverse 30-50% of age-related muscle decline (Journal of Applied Physiology, 2020). Key data: Even at 60 years old, muscle mass can be increased by 8-10% through training (The Journals of Gerontology: Series A, 2019). At 40, it's merely a 'slowing of muscle gain speed,' not 'impossible.' I. Three Golden Rules for Muscle Building at 40 1. Resistance Training: Prioritize 'Multi-Joint Compound Movements' Focus on compound movements like squats, deadlifts, bench presses, and pull-ups first, as they stimulate over 80% of muscle groups and boost testosterone secretion (Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, 2018). Avoid excessive isolation training (e.g., single-joint machines) as it is inefficient and increases injury risk. Training frequency: 3-4 times per week, 60-75 minutes per session, with 48 hours of rest between muscle groups. 2. Protein Intake: More Critical Than for Younger Adults After 40, the muscle's 'anabolic response' to protein decreases, requiring an increased intake of 1.6-2.2g/kg of body weight per day (The American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 2015). Example: A 70kg man needs 112-154g of protein daily, equivalent to 4 eggs + 200g chicken breast + 500ml milk. Timing principle: Consume 20-30g of high-quality protein (e.g., whey protein + banana) within 30 minutes post-workout; consider adding a cup of cottage cheese (containing slow-release casein protein) before bed. 3. Sleep Management: The 'Invisible Nutrient' for Muscle Growth Growth hormone secretion peaks during deep sleep. Men over 40 need to ensure 7-9 hours of high-quality sleep. Research found that insufficient sleep (<5 hours/night) can reduce testosterone levels by 15% and muscle synthesis efficiency by 30% (Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, 2019). Improvement methods: Avoid screens 1 hour before bed, maintain bedroom temperature at 18-22°C, try meditation or breathing exercises. II. Debunking Common Misconceptions About Muscle Building at 40 Misconception 1: 'My metabolism is slow; building muscle will make me fat.' Truth: Muscle is 'metabolically active tissue.' Each kilogram of muscle consumes 10-15 calories per day, while fat consumes only 2 calories. During a muscle-building phase, a caloric surplus of 300-500 calories/day (Sports Nutrition, 2021) can precisely promote muscle growth, not fat gain. Misconception 2: 'My joints are not good; I can't lift heavy weights.' Truth: Correctly performed resistance training can strengthen tendons and ligaments (Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy, 2020). Recommendation: Start with bodyweight exercises or light weights, apply the 'progressive overload' principle (increase weight by 2-5% weekly), master the movement patterns first, then gradually increase load. Misconception 3: 'Supplements are for young people; I don't need them.' Truth: After 40, digestive and absorptive capacity declines. Supplements like creatine, Vitamin D, and Omega-3 can aid muscle building: - Creatine: Improves strength and muscle endurance (Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition, 2017), recommended daily dose 5g. - Vitamin D: Alleviates muscle soreness and regulates testosterone synthesis (Endocrinology, 2018), recommended daily dose 800-1000 IU. To summarize: At 40, you might not have the recovery speed of a 20-year-old, but you possess more mature execution ability and a deeper understanding of health. The essence of muscle growth is 'stress adaptation' – as long as you provide your body with sufficient stimulus, nutrition, and recovery, you can activate the 'muscle-building switch' at any age. Starting today, let go of the self-limiting belief of 'I can't.' Give it 3 months to witness how increased muscle mass can lead to transformative changes in your physical fitness, energy levels, and even your mindset. References 6. Phillips SM, et al. (2015). Am J Clin Nutr. 7. Trappe TA, et al. (2019). J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci. 8. Schoenfeld BJ, et al. (2018). J Strength Cond Res. 9. Spence LA, et al. (2020). J Orthop Sports Phys Ther. 10. Varady KA, et al. (2021). Sports Med. (The professional content of this article has been reviewed by a Doctor of Sports Medicine).

Title: Xi'an will completely suspend ride-hailing 'fixed-price' and 'special offer' orders. What are the reasons behind this? What impact will it have on ride-hailing drivers and passengers? Content: Yesterday, while scrolling on Douyin, I saw a ride-hailing moving order. On the driver's app, it showed the customer paid 250, the platform took a 75 commission (the national regulation caps it at 30%), and the driver's income was just over 100; but the customer actually paid 500. Title: Exercise Rehabilitation for End-Stage Liver Disease: How to Stay Active in Health Maintenance? Content: End-Stage Liver Disease (ESLD) is the advanced stage of liver disease, where the patient's liver function is severely impaired, and their quality of life is significantly reduced. Although the liver cannot fully recover, exercise rehabilitation can still help patients maintain a certain level of health, improve physical strength, alleviate symptoms, and enhance self-care ability. Today, let's talk about how patients with end-stage liver disease can enhance their physical function and maintain a better quality of life through exercise rehabilitation. I. Why is exercise beneficial for patients with end-stage liver disease? Many people believe that liver disease patients should avoid exercise, especially when the condition is more severe. However, appropriate exercise actually offers many benefits for end-stage liver disease patients: 1. Enhanced Physical Strength End-stage liver disease is often accompanied by fatigue, muscle atrophy, and decreased physical strength. Moderate exercise can help patients improve muscle strength and alleviate these symptoms. 2. Improved Circulation and Metabolism Exercise can promote blood circulation, enhance the body's metabolic function, help the liver better cope with the burden, and reduce symptoms such as ascites and edema. 3. Improved Mental Health Long-term liver disease can negatively affect the patient's psychological state. Moderate exercise can reduce anxiety and depression, improving the patient's mental state. 4. Enhanced Immune Function Although liver function is declining, exercise can boost the body's immune capacity, helping patients resist complications such as infections. II. Suitable Types of Exercise for End-Stage Liver Disease Patients For end-stage liver disease patients, exercise choices must be cautious, as excessive exercise may worsen the condition. The following types of exercise are suitable for most patients and aid in rehabilitation: 1. Walking Walking is a light and safe exercise suitable for liver disease patients at all stages. 20-30 minutes of light walking daily can help patients move their limbs, promote blood circulation, and improve endurance without placing excessive burden on the body. 2. Stretching Exercises Stretching exercises help maintain joint flexibility and reduce muscle tension. Patients can perform simple stretching movements at home, such as arm stretches and leg stretches, to avoid joint stiffness and muscle atrophy caused by prolonged inactivity. 3. Deep Breathing and Yoga Some simple yoga poses and deep breathing exercises can help liver disease patients relax, promote oxygen flow in the body, and reduce abdominal pressure. Particularly, mild seated or supine yoga poses can help patients alleviate fatigue and increase mental strength. 4. Stationary Cycling or Spinning Stationary cycling is a low-impact exercise that allows patients to control the intensity, improving cardiovascular function and lower limb strength. It is recommended to maintain a moderate speed during exercise, avoid excessive exertion, and prevent stress on the body. 5. Water Exercises The buoyancy of water can reduce joint burden. Water walking or light swimming is very beneficial for liver disease patients. Such exercises not only help improve endurance but also relax muscles and reduce edema. III. Precautions During Exercise Although exercise rehabilitation offers many benefits for end-stage liver disease patients, they must pay attention to safety during exercise to avoid excessive fatigue or worsening the condition. Here are some key precautions: 1. Control Exercise Intensity Exercise should be light to moderate in intensity and not too strenuous. An increased heart rate without gasping for breath is an appropriate standard. The "able to talk comfortably but slightly strained" measure can be used to gauge overexertion. 2. Avoid Exercises with High Abdominal Pressure Patients with cirrhosis and end-stage liver disease often have ascites or portal hypertension, so they should avoid exercises that increase abdominal pressure, such as weightlifting or vigorous bending, to prevent exacerbating abdominal pressure. 3. Maintain Adequate Hydration Sweating during exercise may lead to fluid loss, especially since liver disease patients are prone to electrolyte imbalances. Therefore, it is important to replenish fluids promptly but control total fluid intake, particularly for patients with ascites or edema. 4. Closely Monitor Physical Reactions If discomfort such as chest tightness, dizziness, extreme fatigue, or difficulty breathing occurs during exercise, stop immediately and seek medical advice. Liver disease patients should always pay attention to their physical changes and not force themselves to exercise. 5. Regular Consultation with a Doctor Before starting any exercise, it is best to consult a doctor to ensure the chosen exercise is suitable for the patient's physical condition. The doctor will provide reasonable exercise recommendations based on the patient's liver function, severity of the condition, and overall health status. IV. Summary Exercise rehabilitation for end-stage liver disease patients is not aimed at curing the disease but at improving quality of life, helping patients maintain muscle strength, enhance cardiovascular function, and improve mental health. Moderate exercise can not only alleviate discomfort caused by the condition but also help patients maintain a more positive mindset during their fight against the disease. Each liver disease patient's physical condition is different, so it is essential to exercise within one's limits and choose the most suitable exercise method based on the doctor's advice. Through scientific exercise rehabilitation, end-stage liver disease patients can still stay active during health maintenance and enjoy a better quality of life. Title: Which is better, side-suction range hood or European style? Who can tell? Does anyone know? Content: Side-suction and European-style range hoods each have their own advantages and disadvantages. The specific choice should be based on personal needs and actual circumstances. The main advantages of side-suction range hoods include: Good smoke extraction effect: Because the suction port of a side-suction range hood is closer to the stove, it can more effectively remove cooking fumes, reducing kitchen air pollution. No oil dripping: The design of side-suction hoods places the oil mesh not directly above, thus avoiding oil dripping and keeping the kitchen clean. Saves space: Side-suction hoods are usually installed on the side of the stove, not occupying the overhead space, making them suitable for kitchens with limited space. However, side-suction hoods also have some disadvantages: Slightly noisier: Due to the side-mounted motor and horizontally placed shaft, noise may increase after prolonged use. Relatively higher price: Compared to Chinese-style hoods, side-suction hoods are usually more expensive. The main characteristics of European-style range hoods include: Aesthetic appearance: European-style hoods have a fashionable design and elegant appearance, which can enhance the overall decor of the kitchen. Moderate suction power: The suction power of European-style hoods is usually sufficient for daily cooking needs, but may not be as strong as side-suction hoods. Expensive: European-style hoods are often highly priced, sometimes many times the cost, making them unsuitable for families on a tight budget. In summary: If you prioritize smoke extraction effectiveness and saving space, and are not particularly sensitive to noise and price, you can choose a side-suction range hood. If you seek an aesthetic appearance and moderate suction power, and your budget allows, you might consider a European-style hood. For families with limited budgets, a Chinese-style range hood may be a more cost-effective choice.

Title: The Impact of Private Placement on Stock Price? Content: The impact of private placement on stock price is mainly reflected in the following aspects: 1. Short-term impact: The stock price may rise. Since private placement often involves the participation of company executives or strategic investors, the market views this positive signal favorably. Investors participating in the placement often have confidence in the company's prospects, and their participation may drive the stock price higher. Furthermore, the funds raised from the placement may be used for company expansion, R&D, etc., which is beneficial for the company's long-term development. Detailed explanation: Private placement is a financing method for listed companies. When a company decides to conduct a private placement, it typically issues new shares to specific investors, rather than through the public market. Therefore, such information can have a significant impact on investor decisions. In the short term, the market often responds positively to these actions. Positive expectations from market participants and well-planned use of funds can push the stock price up. At the same time, the raised funds are used for improving company operations or expanding business as part of long-term planning, which helps enhance the company's competitiveness and also has a positive impact on the stock price. However, the long-term impact of a private placement depends on various factors, including the use of funds, market conditions, and the company's long-term strategy. If the funds raised are used effectively, leading to improved profitability and business growth, then the long-term impact on the stock price will also be positive. Conversely, if the funds are misused or market conditions change unfavorably, it may have a negative impact on the stock price. Therefore, when considering the impact of a private placement on the stock price, investors need to comprehensively evaluate multiple factors and make a well-rounded judgment. Overall, the impact of private placement on stock price is not one-directional; it has short-term positive effects but also long-term uncertainties. When making decisions, investors need to fully consider relevant information and market conditions.

Title: Which industries can one engage in now to avoid being replaced by artificial intelligence in 20 years? Content: In the next 20 years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence, many traditional industries will face unprecedented challenges and transformations. However, amidst this technological wave, some industries remain as stable as Mount Tai, even becoming more prosperous. This article will analyze the characteristics and reasons of these industries for you, helping you make wise choices in career planning. The healthcare industry is a solid fortress against the impact of artificial intelligence. Although AI shows great potential in medical diagnosis, surgical assistance, and other areas, the core of medical services still lies in human interaction. Patients' need for professional trust, emotional support, and humanistic care from doctors is something that no algorithm can easily replace. Additionally, medical research and innovation often require interdisciplinary knowledge integration and intuitive judgment, and the development in these fields will also rely on the deep involvement of professionals. The education industry also holds irreplaceable value. Education is not just about the transmission of knowledge; more importantly, it involves inspiring students' creativity, critical thinking, and social skills. Although online courses and intelligent teaching systems can provide personalized learning experiences, the real classroom atmosphere, teacher-student interaction, and teamwork experiences are crucial for students' growth. Future educators will be guides, motivators, and problem-solvers, rather than mere transmitters of knowledge. The non-replicable nature of the arts industry also makes it a safe harbor in the age of artificial intelligence. Whether it is painting, music, dance, or literary creation, art is a direct expression of human emotions and imagination. The unique value of artistic works lies in the creator's personal perspective and emotional resonance, which machines cannot simulate. The creative process of artists often involves non-linear thinking and spontaneous inspiration, which are difficult for AI to capture and reproduce. Besides the aforementioned industries, there are other fields that will continue to retain their unique value in the next 20 years. For example, the legal services industry: although AI can help analyze cases and predict outcomes, the role of lawyers in negotiation, moral judgment, and lawmaking is irreplaceable. The same applies to the psychological counseling industry; the human need for empathy and emotional understanding ensures that this profession maintains its humanized service characteristics. In the next 20 years, industries that rely on human emotions, creativity, interdisciplinary knowledge, and complex interpersonal interactions will become the true "iron rice bowl." Facing the impact of artificial intelligence, we should actively adapt while also recognizing the unique value and abilities of humans. When choosing a career path, considering these factors will help us find a solid foothold in this era of change. Navigating the future ocean of careers, choosing the right direction will allow you to ride the wind and waves, rather than being swallowed by the tide of technology. We hope this article can serve as a guiding light for your career planning, helping you maintain competitiveness in the age of AI and find a truly secure "iron rice bowl" that belongs to you.

Title: Common Problems and Solutions in Painting and Calligraphy Mounting Content: Manual mounting of paintings and calligraphy is an exquisite traditional craft that protects the artwork and enhances its artistic value. However, some problems may arise during the mounting process. Below are some common mounting issues and their solutions: 1. Ink bleeding and color fading: During mounting, issues like ink bleeding or color fading may occur. This could be due to poor-quality ink used in the original work or uneven paste application during mounting. Solution: Before mounting, choose high-quality ink to ensure clear and vibrant colors. During mounting, apply the paste evenly to avoid uneven penetration. 2. Delamination and wrinkles: Improper handling during mounting may cause delamination or wrinkles in the artwork. Solution: Before mounting, ensure the artwork surface is smooth and free of wrinkles. Handle the artwork gently during mounting to avoid excessive force causing delamination or wrinkles. 3. Brushing damage to the painting core: Applying too much force while brushing the paste may damage the painting core. Solution: Brush the paste gently during mounting to avoid damaging the painting core. If damage occurs, use a fine needle to repair the hole. 4. Wall detachment and tearing after mounting: After mounting is complete, the artwork may detach from the wall or tear. This could be due to uneven mounting or poor-quality mounting materials. Solution: Ensure the artwork is mounted evenly and use high-quality materials. If detachment or tearing occurs, remount the artwork to ensure stability. 5. Uneven silk brocade mounting: Improper handling of silk brocade during mounting may cause unevenness or waviness. Solution: Ensure the silk brocade adheres evenly to the artwork surface during mounting to avoid waviness. If waviness has already occurred, gently iron it flat with an iron. Manual mounting of paintings and calligraphy requires skill and experience. Pay attention to details during the process to ensure the artwork's safety and aesthetics. If problems arise, refer to the solutions above or consult a professional mounter to preserve the artwork's integrity and artistic value. Title: Will holding on to losing funds recoup losses? Cut losses timely or hurry to average down? Content: Holding on to losing funds may not necessarily recoup losses; specific strategies need to be analyzed based on the situation. I. Possibility of recouping losses by holding on Temporary pullback: If the fund is only experiencing a temporary pullback, then holding on may recoup losses. Because the fund market is volatile, there will be rises and falls, and it may rise again after a short-term pullback. Long-term downtrend: If the fund has been in a downtrend and the loss is very severe, then the possibility of recouping losses by holding on is very small. In this case, cutting losses timely may be a wiser choice. II. Averaging down vs. cutting losses Averaging down: For investors still within their risk tolerance, they can consider averaging down appropriately. Averaging down can spread investment costs, and the speed of recouping losses will be faster when the fund rises. But averaging down also requires caution to avoid continuous averaging down during a downtrend leading to greater losses. Cutting losses: If the loss has exceeded the investor's tolerance, or the fund's prospects are unclear, then cutting losses timely may be a better choice. Cutting losses can prevent further losses and wait for a more suitable opportunity to enter the market later. III. Other strategies to recoup losses Swing trading: After cutting losses timely, recoup losses through swing trading (i.e., buying low and selling high). But this method carries high risks and requires investors to have high operational skills and market judgment. Seize rising opportunities: When there are rising opportunities in the fund market, buy heavily and sell when it pulls back and falls. This strategy also carries high risks and is not suitable for all investors. In summary, holding on to losing funds may not necessarily recoup losses; specific strategies need to be chosen based on market conditions, fund performance, and the investor's risk tolerance. Investors should carefully assess their own situation and market risks to make wise investment decisions.

Title: Municipal Public Office Holds Annual Public Lawyer Symposium Content: Municipal Public Office Holds Annual Public Lawyer Symposium || Document Number: || Release Date: | 2018-01-24 || Keywords: | | | |【Print】 【Font: Large Medium Small】Municipal Public Office Holds Annual Public Lawyer Symposium Release Date: 2018-01-24 View Count: - On January 18, 2018, the Shantou Municipal Public Lawyer Office held a symposium on the 2017 work summary and 2018 work plan for public lawyers in the conference room of the Municipal Justice Bureau. Attendees included 23 participants such as Zeng Qingkai, Party member and Deputy Inspector of the Shantou Municipal Justice Bureau; Zhou Meifang, Deputy Director of the Shantou Bonded Zone Customs; Wang Kundian, Principal of the Shantou Public Security Police School; the Public Lawyer Office of Shantou Customs; public lawyer positions from the Municipal Public Security Bureau, Civil Affairs Bureau, Compulsory Isolation Drug Rehabilitation Center, Industry and Commerce Bureau; public lawyers from the People's Bank of China Shantou Branch; and lawyers from the Municipal Public Office. The meeting involved exchanges and summaries of the work of public lawyers across the city in 2017, and opinions were exchanged on how to better carry out public lawyer work in the future. At the meeting, Xu Cuihong, Deputy Director of the Municipal Public Law Firm, introduced the main work of the Shantou Municipal Public Law Firm in 2017, including serving as legal advisors, handling litigation cases, participating in financial mediation, and processing legal aid cases, and proposed the work plan for 2018. Wang Kundian, head of the public lawyer position at the Shantou Public Security Bureau, introduced the work content of reviewing over 70 contracts, approving more than 200 administrative cases, and organizing regulations. It was suggested that a public lawyer committee be established in the future to precisely define the responsibilities of public lawyers. Zhou Meifang, Deputy Director of Shantou Bonded Zone Customs, proposed that institutional norms are needed to clarify the scope of responsibilities of public lawyers within their units. Zheng Chuze, a public lawyer from the Municipal Civil Affairs Bureau, believed that public lawyers should not participate in the specific work of business departments and suggested that public lawyers could be evaluated for professional titles or establish dedicated positions. Participants spoke freely, conducting in-depth exchanges and reaching consensus on the work ideas and specific methods for 2018, particularly regarding the positioning of public lawyer responsibilities, institutional norms, and cooperation and exchange. Finally, Deputy Inspector Zeng Qingkai fully affirmed the work of the Municipal Public Office and public lawyers, stating that they are an indispensable force in promoting the rule of law in various units. He encouraged continued confidence, leveraging professional roles to provide high-quality and efficient legal services, and expressed hope that public lawyers would continue to participate in and support legal aid endeavors in the future.

Title: Anhui Provincial Health Commission's "Media Open Day" Event Visits The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui University of Science and Technology Content: On March 26, the Anhui Provincial Health Commission's "Media Open Day" event visited The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui University of Science and Technology. Content: 【A 9 Million Yuan School District House Defeated by Registration Priority】"In July 2019, after comparing over ten school district houses in Xicheng and Haidian, Yu Ting spent 9 million yuan to buy a 70-square-meter old house on Wanshou Road in Haidian District. Built in 1984, the unit price was over 120,000 yuan, assigned to Beijing Yuying School, a nine-year consistent school that directly advances to its own junior high school. But two days ago, with the sudden announcement of the registration priority scheme, Yu Ting was informed that her child could not attend the main campus of Yuying School and would have to accept reassignment." Firstly, the cause of school district houses is the imbalance between supply and demand in educational resources, but the current situation is that school district houses have been hyped into a form of resource speculation. Secondly, school district houses are defined by administrative decisions and regulations, but "the speculation and pricing of school district houses" are entirely market behaviors, so it cannot be said that the price dynamics of school district houses are illegal. Furthermore, because the method of dividing school districts is unilaterally administrative, it inherently carries "uncertainty and (investment) risk." It is understandable that parents buying school district houses are deeply concerned about their children's education, but risk awareness is also necessary. Finally, the development trajectory of school district houses in some major cities is essentially a process of passing the parcel. The prices during this process, including premiums, are reasonable, but the risk of being the last one holding the parcel also exists. This is how speculators, investors, and even "homebuyers themselves unwittingly get caught up in this relay game." Therefore, for those homebuyers who suffer losses as a result, their feelings are understandable, but the risks must also be borne. In summary, "the school district matters more than the house" is itself an abnormal phenomenon, and homebuyers should have an awareness of the trade-offs.

Title: Which is easier to get a band 5: A or G? Content: Which IELTS type, Academic or General Training, is easier to get a high score? I am a civil servant taking IELTS not for going abroad, but just because it might be useful in the future. So, I can take either A or G. I know G is simpler, but I heard the grading criteria are stricter. I just want to know which one makes it easier to get a higher score, which sounds better. Thank you. For IELTS A and G types, the G type is less difficult, making it easier to get a higher score. However, the specific choice between A and G should be based on personal needs. IELTS Academic (A) tests the candidate's English proficiency to assess if it meets the requirements for applying to undergraduate, postgraduate, and higher degrees, suitable for students preparing to study abroad. IELTS General Training (G) focuses on assessing basic language skills, applicable for those planning to work or immigrate in English-speaking countries (such as Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and the UK), or for applying for training and non-degree courses. The IELTS test (International English Language Testing System) is managed jointly by Cambridge English Language Assessment, the British Council, and IDP Education. It is an English proficiency test designed for people who intend to study, work, or settle in countries where English is used.

Title: Impact｜Guizhou Rural Credit: New Forms of Telecom Fraud, Beware of "Screen Sharing" Content: As online transactions become increasingly convenient today, fraudulent methods emerge endlessly, making it hard to guard against. One day, Ms. Wu, who runs a rice noodle business in the Jindingshan Town market in Zunyi, received a call from an unknown number. The caller claimed that her loan on a certain shopping platform incurred high daily penalties and required Ms. Wu to provide personal information to handle the loan. Ms. Wu downloaded an APP with a "screen sharing" function as instructed. After following the caller's directions, she suddenly found that her WeChat could not function normally, and even all the buttons on her phone were out of control! Panicked, Ms. Wu went to the credit office of the Jindingshan Branch of Zunyi Honghuagang Rural Commercial Bank, urgently seeking help from the staff. Ultimately, with the assistance of the bank's staff, Ms. Wu reported the incident to the police, reset her WeChat, bank card, and Qiannongyun passwords. The balances in her WeChat wallet and deposit accounts remained unchanged, avoiding a property loss of over 340,000 yuan. It is understood that using "screen sharing" is a new type of telecom network fraud method that has recently emerged. Criminals trick victims into downloading APPs that offer "shared screen" functionality. Once "screen sharing" is activated, criminals can monitor all operations on the victim's phone in real time, stealing bank account passwords, SMS verification codes, etc., and transfer money without the victim's knowledge. Zhang Yuanjun, General Manager of the Operations Management Department at Honghuagang Rural Commercial Bank: Here we solemnly remind the public: Do not arbitrarily download video conferencing APPs that provide "screen sharing" functionality without confirmation, and use the "screen sharing" function cautiously. Do not open payment software, bank account operation interfaces, or perform operations involving password entry, transfers, remittances, etc., while "screen sharing" is active. Do not casually disclose important personal information such as ID number, bank card number, password, verification code, etc. Yuan Hua, Member of the Party Committee and Vice President of Honghuagang Rural Commercial Bank: Recently, various branches under Zunyi Honghuagang Rural Commercial Bank have strengthened customer identification and due diligence, intercepting 12 abnormal card opening attempts and successfully劝阻 2 suspicious fraud-related transfers, blocking amounts totaling 387,600 yuan. At the same time, our bank has intensified publicity efforts to prevent telecom network fraud, conducting over 100 sessions through financial night schools, and outreach to commercial districts and schools, reaching an audience of more than 25,000 people. Source: Guizhou Satellite TV Editor: Luo Jing Reviewer: Zhang Xun

Title: Is Big or Small Cod Better? Content: When selecting cod, consumers often struggle with choosing between large or small cod, but this is not the only criterion. The quality of cod depends not only on its size but also on factors such as variety, freshness, and cooking methods. Firstly, we should understand the types of cod. Common varieties include true cod, secondary cod, and imitation cod. True cod is highly regarded for its high protein, low fat, and rich vitamins and minerals, while secondary cod and imitation cod are more affordable but slightly inferior in texture and nutritional value. Therefore, when purchasing, decisions should be made based on personal needs and budget. Secondly, freshness is key to evaluating cod quality. Fresh cod has plump flesh, bright color, and a faint sea scent. Less fresh cod has soft flesh, dull color, and may even have an off odor. Thus, when buying, you can judge by observing its appearance, smelling it, or asking the salesperson. Additionally, size is not the only factor. Although larger cod might have grown in different environments or with different feed, their flesh isn't necessarily better than smaller cod. Hence, when purchasing, size alone should not be the sole criterion; instead, consider variety, freshness, and size comprehensively. Furthermore, different cooking methods require different quality standards for cod. For example, when making cod steaks or grilled fish, choose cod with plump flesh and clear visible grain; for fish balls or fish soup, you can opt for more affordable secondary cod or imitation cod. Therefore, purchasing decisions should also be based on specific needs. In summary, selecting high-quality cod requires considering multiple factors. When buying, make reasonable choices based on personal needs and budget. At the same time, to ensure food safety and a healthy diet, pay attention to controlling consumption amount and frequency, avoiding overeating or excessive reliance on a single food.

Title: Why should homeowners bear the responsibility after a real estate project is abandoned? Content: The following three letters of response to public complaints are what I have collected over the years in the homeowners' group, compiled into a bound volume to show you how credibility collapses. The construction progress of each building in the complex is not entirely consistent; this article only discusses my own building, which has a total of 34 floors, with a contractual delivery date of July 30, 2022. After the delay in 2022, they promised to top off the building by July 2023 and deliver it by the end of 2023. Actual construction progress: July 2023 - 18 floors, December 30, 2023 - 18 floors. In 2023, they promised delivery by the end of 2024. Actual construction progress: It is said that the main structure was just topped off by the end of 2024. I say 'it is said' because the developer's official WeChat account last posted a progress update in March 2024. Also, don't think that topping off means delivery is close. As mentioned in one of the complaint response letters above, Section 2 was topped off as early as 2020. After the delay, they initially promised delivery by December 30, 2022, but it still hasn't been delivered. A new promise was made in January 2025: delivery by the end of 2025. The response letter explicitly states there is a significant funding gap. Given the current state of the real estate market, the developer basically can't rely on sales to recover funds. Guess if delivery by the end of the year is possible? As lawyer @Xu Bin previously summarized, 'delivery by the end of the year' is a universal golden phrase that helps developers and task forces smoothly get through year after year. Why have homeowners borne the brunt of everything so far? Because many lovely neighbor friends still don't understand what博弈 (game theory) means. For the developer, the housing funds were squandered long ago. Resuming construction won't generate any new profits; lying low is the optimal choice. For the bank, the mortgage payments are collected in full. Even if some homeowners applied for deferrals, interest is still calculated. It's just a matter of collecting sooner or later – a trick of 'three in the morning and four in the evening' versus 'four in the morning and three in the evening' (deceiving with superficial changes). Some people actually fall for this monkey trick. If turning a single win into a double loss doesn't happen, why would they care about your dire straits? If they can suck blood while lying down, why would they stand at attention and take a beating based on your attitude? Your struggles have nothing to do with their peaceful, comfortable lives. Before the victims demonstrate sufficient deterrence, fantasizing about that motorcycle-riding authority figure delivering justice? Haven't you had enough empty promises?

Title: Companies in the Tourism Sector with Terminated Equity Incentive Plans Content: Some companies in the tourism sector have experienced the termination of their equity incentive plans. This can be caused by various factors. On one hand, the company's operational status may have changed, such as performance failing to meet expectations, making it difficult to continue the equity incentive plan. On the other hand, uncertainty in the market environment may also influence the company's decisions, leading them to believe that implementing equity incentives is not the optimal time currently. Another possibility is a strategic adjustment by the company, reallocating resources to other business areas, thus terminating the equity incentive plan. The specific reasons vary for different companies and require comprehensive analysis considering their own development history, financial status, market competition situation, and other aspects. The termination of these equity incentive plans may have certain ripple effects on the companies' own development and the competitive landscape within the industry. 1. Company Performance Factors: If a company's performance fails to meet the set targets during the implementation of the equity incentive plan, it may lead to the termination of the plan. For example, slow revenue growth or declining profits may cause the company to believe that continuing the equity incentive plan will not achieve the desired results. 2. Changes in Market Environment: External factors such as intensified market competition or overall industry downturn may undermine the company's confidence in future development, leading to the decision to terminate equity incentives. Factors like fluctuations in the macroeconomic situation or the rise of new competitors can influence the company's decision-making. 3. Strategic Adjustments: The company may decide, based on considerations for its long-term development strategy, to concentrate resources on other core businesses or projects, thus abandoning the equity incentive plan. For instance, strategic moves such as exploring new market areas or developing new products may render equity incentives no longer aligned with the company's development direction.

Title: Is it reliable for an intermediary to say there are bank products that don't check inquiries or debt? Content: Based in Shanghai, serving nationwide, I'm telling you responsibly it's not reliable. Generally speaking, there are bank products that don't check inquiries, but products that completely ignore both inquiries and debt do not exist. First, when you hear an intermediary tell you this, you should first assess whether you have any advantageous conditions. For example, owning a property, or having high housing provident fund contributions that could offset your shortcomings of having many inquiries or high debt. Alternatively, they might just be saying such unreliable things to charge you high fees. If your housing fund is average, your salary is average, and you don't own a property, then you can only conclude they are trying to fool you. Taking Shanghai as an example, there are two products that don't check inquiries, but they have other requirements. For instance, your debt cannot exceed 200,000, or your monthly salary needs to be above 8k before tax, or some require a guarantor. So, each case needs specific analysis; don't act blindly. It wasn't easy typing all this out. I hope my answer can help you. Shanghai Finance Ayang, with seven years of industry experience. My wish is to help everyone who sees me 'step into fewer pitfalls, encounter fewer traps, and avoid more pitfalls.' Looking forward to your follows and inquiries.

Title: Wujiang Maritime On-site Visa Service Receives Positive Feedback Content: Since the Party's Mass Line Education and Practice Campaign, the Wujiang District Local Maritime Department has implemented immediate corrections upon identification of issues, actively carried out rectification measures, and promoted convenience measures. The on-site visa service, launched since January 2013, has received widespread praise from shipping companies and crew members. Recently, due to the rectification and closure of most quarries in Huzhou, Deqing, and other areas of Zhejiang Province, coupled with the accelerated urbanization construction following Wujiang's transition from a county-level city to a district, which increased the demand for construction raw materials, some mine owners from Huzhou and other areas have relocated their gravel processing operations to our district. Consequently, the number of vessels entering and leaving the Zhenze area docks and navigating the Zhenze section of the waterway has significantly increased compared to previous years. Before the on-site visa service was implemented, these vessels faced great inconvenience when handling ship visa procedures. Crew members often had to take public buses or unlicensed motorcycles to the service hall of the Zhenze Maritime Office, consuming considerable time and energy. In response to feedback from crew members regarding such issues, the Zhenze Maritime Office actively addressed their concerns. To meet the expectations of the crew, during daily patrols, they now carry ship visa seals, computers, and ticket printers to provide on-site visa services for vessels within their jurisdiction. This facilitates the visa application process for vessels entering and leaving the port, striving to save manpower, material resources, and financial costs for the boaters.

Title: Municipal Human Resources Content: Release Date: 2019-10-30 Source: In order to further improve the professional quality of personnel cadres in public institutions in our city, standardize personnel management work, strengthen the construction of personnel cadres, and effectively improve the work style of human resources and social security departments, on the afternoon of October 25, the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau organized personnel section chiefs from some government agencies and public institutions (57 units) in the city to hold a city-wide public institution personnel business training session and a symposium for soliciting opinions on the "Remaining True to Our Original Aspiration and Keeping Our Mission Firmly in Mind" thematic education campaign. The symposium was presided over by Li Aihong, Party Secretary and Director of the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau. The training session emphasized that personnel cadres in public institutions across the city must achieve the following three points: First, they should self-impose pressure, actively learn policy and business knowledge related to personnel management to better address emerging new problems and contradictions; Second, they should apply what they have learned, strengthen the standardization of personnel management in their respective units through this training, and promptly report discovered problems and shortcomings to the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Third, they should enhance communication, promptly feedback problems encountered in work, share successful experiences and good practices, and avoid being evasive or ashamed to speak up, so that all units can progress together. Subsequently, as part of the second batch of the "Remaining True to Our Original Aspiration and Keeping Our Mission Firmly in Mind" thematic education campaign, the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau invited 10 government agencies and public institutions in our city to conduct a symposium, inquiring in detail about each unit's opinions and suggestions regarding the business processes, efficiency, and service attitudes of the human resources and social security departments. For the issues identified in this symposium, the Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will identify the causes, dig deep into the roots, investigate and rectify immediately, and make corrections as soon as issues are known, living up to the trust and responsibility placed by the Party and the people, and continuously enhancing the people's sense of gain, happiness, and security.

Title: Father Gifts Property to Caregiver Content: 💔 Fan Submission: Shanghai Ms. Li's father (78 years old) was hospitalized in the late stages of Alzheimer's disease. Before his death, he recorded a video will in the presence of two caregivers, gifting his property worth 12 million RMB to Auntie Zhang, the caregiver who had looked after him for 3 years. Points of Dispute: 1⃣ The children question whether their father was "of sound mind" when making the will, submitting a "Mental Assessment Report" from six months prior showing "moderate cognitive impairment". 2⃣ In the video, the father only made an oral statement; the date and the identities of the witnesses were not recorded. 3⃣ The caregiver insists it was "the elderly man's own decision in his last moments of clarity" and presented a handwritten thank-you letter from him as evidence. 👩⚖ Legal Analysis: 1⃣ Core of Will Validity: Capacity: If the testator was assessed as having no/limited capacity for civil conduct at the time of making the will, the will is invalid. This case requires comparing the "Mental Assessment Report" with the video recording time. If the illness had worsened to the point of "inability to recognize the consequences of actions" at the time of recording, the will is invalid. Formal Requirements: A video will must completely record the likeness of the testator, the witnesses, and the date. The recording in this case lacks a date, and the witnesses are caregivers (who may have an interest with the caregiver), constituting major flaws. 2⃣ Children's Countermeasures: Apply for a reassessment of the mental state at the time the will was made (requires obtaining the hospital's real-time medical records, medication records); Provide evidence of the caregiver's inducement (e.g., frequent money transfers, unusually intimate call records); Claim the property is marital joint property (the mother is deceased, the children can inherit her share). 💡 Action Guide: 🔸 Emergency Measures: Freeze property transactions (to prevent the caregiver from selling); Obtain hospital surveillance and care logs (to verify if the caregiver provided round-the-clock care). 🔸 Evidence Strategy: Children's Side: Focus on the "Mental Assessment Report" + flaws in the will's form; Caregiver's Side: Emphasize "de facto support" + emotional appeal (the elderly man's handwritten thank-you letter, end-of-life care photos). 🔸 Reference Precedents: Guangzhou Xu Qiang Case: Will of an Alzheimer's patient ruled invalid due to lack of capacity; Beijing Mr. Wang Case: Printed will overturned due to flaws in witness identity. 🔥 Outcome Prediction (Data Reference) ▫ Strong Evidence: Will invalid, children inherit 90%+, caregiver receives 10% humanitarian compensation; ▫ Procedural Flaws: Will partially invalid, caregiver receives 30% property + 500,000 RMB cash; ▫ Moral Pressure: Both parties settle, property sold and distributed proportionally. 👇 If it were you, would you support "Respecting the Will" or "Protecting Bloodline Inheritance"? #WillInvalid #AlzheimersDisease #PropertyInheritance #MentalAssessment #MoralDilemma #FamilyEthics ✨ Further Thoughts ⚠ How to avoid the "deathbed will" trap? ✅ Plan Ahead: Make a notarized will specifying property distribution while mentally clear; ✅ Video Will Standards: Record in one continuous shot, clearly record the date, witness identities, and the testator's mental state; ✅ Regular Assessment: Conduct capacity assessments for elderly relatives and retain medical evidence. Your Choice: ▫ Law First: Judge based on evidence ▫ Emotion Priority: Compensate the caregiver for years of service

Title: Is it necessary to buy a TV box with 2GB RAM? Content: Personally, I think it is necessary to buy a TV box with 2GB RAM. The reason is that most TV boxes on the market currently run on the Android system. Many Android TV applications automatically start up upon boot. System modules that can disable auto-start on boot, similar to those available on mobile phones, do not exist on TV boxes. Therefore, many applications occupy memory right after startup, leading to tight memory resources. Furthermore, the number of pre-installed applications inside a TV box is limited. If users need to install more software, they have to download it themselves. However, TV boxes can hardly save newly installed software on an external TF card; they can only occupy the internal storage space. This means the more applications installed, the greater the memory requirement. From the perspective of mobile phones, the current memory configuration of phones has significantly improved. Currently, most phones come standard with 4GB RAM, while high-end models are equipped with 6GB RAM. It is predicted that starting from 2017, 8GB RAM will become the standard for high-end phones. This indicates that as technology develops, memory requirements are also continuously increasing. In summary, to ensure the smooth operation of a TV box, 2GB of RAM is necessary.

Title: Is Gout Incurable? Anti-inflammatory, Analgesic, and Uric Acid Reduction? Surgical Stone Removal? There's a Lot to Know About Gout Treatment, Authoritative Interpretation. Content: Click the blue text above to follow the Deep Reading WeChat public account. Is joint pain always gout? What medication is used to relieve joint pain? How to lower uric acid and treat gout? When does gout require surgery? Deep Reading feature is now showing. 'Deep Read Sir, what tests should be done for gout? Can it be cured?' The big warm guy in medical science popularization, Deep Read Sir, now presents you with super practical干货 - 'Gout Examination and Treatment Special Topic'. Examination Section. Physical Examination. The doctor gathers relevant information by asking questions, such as whether the joint is painful, the degree and duration of the pain, etc. Then, by observing whether the joint has swelling, deformity, limited movement, etc., a preliminary judgment can be made about whether gout is present. Serum Uric Acid Measurement. Through a blood draw, if the male blood uric acid level is greater than 420 μmol/L or the female blood uric acid level is greater than 357 μmol/L, it indicates possible hyperuricemia. Combined with symptoms and physical examination, gout can be basically diagnosed. Urine Uric Acid Measurement. After diagnosing hyperuricemia, urine uric acid measurement can be used to find the cause and determine the clinical type of gout. Urine uric acid measurement involves collecting all urine over 24 hours, mixing it well, and then extracting a sample for testing. The uric acid concentration is measured, then multiplied by the total urine volume to calculate the total amount of uric acid excreted in the urine per day. If the total 24-hour uric acid excretion is low, it indicates too little uric acid excretion, possibly due to a problem in the excretion process. If it is high, it suggests that there may be overproduction of uric acid, a problem in the production process. Joint Cavity Puncture Examination. Joint cavity puncture examination is the gold standard for diagnosing gout. By performing a puncture, synovial fluid from the joint cavity is obtained. If urate crystals are found in the synovial fluid under a microscope, then it is gout. X-ray Examination. In the early stages of gout, there is often no significant manifestation on X-ray films. As the disease progresses, tophi deposits can be observed around the affected joint, and bone destruction can be seen at the joint margins. Joint Ultrasound Examination. When observing joint effusion under ultrasound, if heterogeneous, fine, dotted echoes appear, similar to a cloud or fog, it is called the 'stormy sky' sign. When observing the articular cartilage surface under ultrasound, if a double-layer parallel strong echo appears, it is called the 'double contour' sign. Both the 'stormy sky' sign and the 'double contour' sign indicate the deposition of urate crystals and are the most characteristic ultrasound manifestations of gout. Treatment Section. Anti-inflammatory and Analgesic Therapy. During an acute gout attack, medications are often used for anti-inflammatory and analgesic therapy to relieve joint pain. Commonly used drugs include non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), colchicine, and glucocorticoids. Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). A gout attack is essentially inflammation caused by urate crystals in the joint. Prostaglandin is a very important inflammatory mediator. It can dilate blood vessels and recruit more immune cells to the battlefield to fight the enemy, further exacerbating the inflammation. NSAIDs can reduce the synthesis of prostaglandins, control joint inflammation, and relieve joint pain. Representative drugs include indomethacin, diclofenac, etoricoxib, etc. Colchicine. Colchicine can not only interfere with the function of immune cells but also inhibit their activity, thereby reducing the immune response and achieving the therapeutic goal of anti-inflammation and analgesia. Glucocorticoids. A gout attack is an inflammatory reaction in the joint. Glucocorticoids can calm down the immune cells, bringing the inflammation under control. Representative drugs include prednisone and methylprednisolone, etc. Uric Acid-Lowering Therapy. Keeping the level of uric acid in the blood within a reasonable range can reduce gout attacks. Inhibiting Uric Acid Production. Purine, with the involvement of xanthine oxidase, undergoes a series of reactions and can transform into uric acid. If the activity of xanthine oxidase is inhibited, uric acid production naturally decreases. Representative drugs include allopurinol, febuxostat, etc. Promoting Uric Acid Excretion. Drugs that promote uric acid excretion can act on the renal tubules, inhibiting the reabsorption of uric acid. With more uric acid excreted in the urine, doesn't the level of uric acid in the blood decrease? Representative drugs include probenecid, benzbromarone, etc. Surgical Treatment. Tophi are commonly found in the auricle, fingertips, joints, and other parts. If tophi affect joint function, compress nerves, blood vessels, or other tissues, or cause ulceration and infection, surgical removal of the tophi is necessary. After surgery, it is still important to maintain a low-purine diet and control blood uric acid levels. 'Deep Read Sir, you've explained gout so clearly, you're like a walking medical book! Title: How should I interact with someone around me who has depression? Content: Depression is a common mood disorder, with typical symptoms including low mood, slowed thinking, loss of interest, and reduced volitional activity. In severe cases, individuals may experience feelings of guilt, self-blame, worthlessness, meaninglessness, and have thoughts or engage in behaviors of self-harm. If someone close to you has depression, it is necessary to interact with them using appropriate methods and attitudes, offering comfort, understanding, support, and care at the right time, while avoiding causing them stimulation and harm. Otherwise, it may harm the patient and hinder their recovery and improvement. When caring for someone with depression, the following points must be emphasized! Image source: Internet. 1. What should you NOT say to someone with depression? "1. 'What do you have to be depressed about?'" Do not casually say things you assume are obvious. A person's depression might be due to unfortunate events, or it could be related to genetic, biological, and other factors. However, it is not something the patient desires, and you cannot judge the potential impact of these factors. Do not ignore or dismiss another person's pain, and certainly don't instinctively assume their suffering is insignificant. "2. 'You're just too idle, overthinking things.'" In reality, many people face challenges and difficulties in life and silently endure pressure without choosing to tell those around them. It cannot be simply explained by having free time or overthinking, nor can pressure be relieved merely by keeping busy and reducing thoughts. Such statements might instead cause secondary harm to the patient. "3. 'Everything will get better.'" This is somewhat like a useless "inspirational quote." Sometimes when a patient reaches out to you, they might hope to communicate, vent their inner distress, and seek help. If you only respond with such a phrase, it might lead the other person to believe you fundamentally cannot understand their sadness and worries, causing them to close the opened door of their heart and unwilling to express their true feelings again. "4. 'Others can handle it, why can't you?'" Everyone's experiences, personality, living environment, etc., are different. It's impossible to expect everyone to react the same way or show the same resilience to life's events. Such words do not alleviate the patient's suffering but might make them feel more pitiful, fragile, and troubled, as if they have no right to feel pain. 2. What can you do? 1. Companionship is the longest confession of love. Often, simply being silently present when the patient needs us, letting them feel they are not alone and that someone is there during their most helpless moments, can be enough. If possible, listen to what the patient wants to say and promptly offer understanding, support, comfort, and help. 2. Communicate more and offer encouragement at appropriate times. Support and encouragement are often what depressed individuals need. During communication, be mindful of your language and approach, trying to avoid factors that might stimulate the patient. Encourage the patient to maintain an optimistic and positive attitude, and to have hope and confidence in life. 3. Urge the patient to adhere to treatment. It is advisable to accompany the patient to receive professional psychological therapy and gently remind them to take medication as prescribed by the doctor, on time and in the correct dosage, to help stabilize the condition and facilitate improvement. During this process, it is especially important to note that if the patient shows negative thoughts or behaviors, corresponding rescue measures must be taken promptly. Title: Why do insurance companies sometimes decline coverage for conditions that doctors say are fine? Content: Recently, there were two very typical clients: one very thin young woman with a BMI of only 16, and another older brother who was too heavy, with a BMI of 40. Although neither had other health issues, both were 'declined' for critical illness insurance—actually, their applications were deferred, as the underwriting did not pass, making it impossible to pay the premium for coverage. Many people find it strange: I'm clearly not sick, so why was I declined? I'm your customer, your 'god'; I'm spending money on your product, yet you refuse my business? Actually, there are many 'minor issues' that we ourselves, or even doctors, might say are no big deal, suggesting we just go back and take care of ourselves. However, insurance companies look at it from a risk perspective. For example, the brother with a BMI of 40, who is also close to 40 years old, has a higher probability of future illness compared to someone with an average weight. To maintain fairness for all policyholders, the insurance company might suggest deferring the application, meaning to apply again after losing weight. The underweight young woman needs to gain weight. The same logic applies to other minor issues: even if a doctor says you're fine, you might face hurdles with the insurance company. The fundamental reason is the difference in perspective, which brings us to the distinction between clinical medicine and insurance medicine. The goal of clinical medicine is to treat the patient's disease, alleviate suffering, and prolong life. The goal of insurance medicine is to maintain the fairness of insurance by assessing whether the applicant, at the time of application, has risk factors that could affect their future mortality and morbidity rates, ensuring that different risk groups are insured under different premiums and conditions. If insurance companies were to 'accept all comers,' the company could face financial difficulties, unable to sustain normal operations, ultimately leading to 'bankruptcy,' and clients' interests would not be protected. However, there's no need to worry too much; being declined is a relatively rare extreme case. Different underwriting standards can lead to five outcomes: Standard Acceptance, Rated Premium (Extra Charge), Exclusion Acceptance, Deferred Acceptance, and Declined. Below, we discuss the four types of abnormal underwriting results and the common conditions they correspond to. Rated Premium (Extra Charge): Small Three Yang Positive (Hepatitis B markers), Fasting blood glucose between 6.3 and 7.0, Mildly elevated blood pressure, Significant abnormal blood lipids, Mildly abnormal ECG, Significantly elevated liver function. Exclusion Acceptance: Breast nodules/Thyroid nodules grade 0-3 (For critical illness insurance, with an ultrasound within six months showing clear borders, size less than 2cm, no enlargement, etc., standard acceptance might be possible; medical insurance usually excludes, some specific products might accept), Colon polyps, Pulmonary nodules less than 5mm. Deferred Acceptance: BMI over 30-32 or under 17, High-grade breast nodules/thyroid nodules, Severely abnormal ECG, Abnormal urine protein/red blood cells, Leukopenia/Granulocytopenia, Unexplained anemia, Neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, Planned surgery, Hyperthyroidism not fully treated. Declined: Thyroid nodules/Breast nodules graded 4A or above, Epilepsy, Intellectual disability, Sequelae of brain trauma, Mental disorders, Chronic alcoholism, Severe liver disease (e.g., cirrhosis), Severe hypertension (over 180/110), Diabetes, Cerebrovascular disease, Diseases affecting kidney function, Severe blood diseases (e.g., aplastic anemia), Those who have received organ transplants, Individuals with sexually transmitted diseases, Patients with a history of cancer (including carcinoma in situ). The above four categories are for reference only; the final underwriting result is subject to the underwriting policies of each insurance company. So, dear friends, be sure to take care of your health, not just for insurance purposes—being healthy is always good. If you want to buy insurance, be sure to disclose any issues honestly and let the insurance company make the judgment. Of course, many products now have automated underwriting, and you can also use it for pre-underwriting without leaving a record. If the automated underwriting doesn't have the option for your specific condition, look for products that allow manual underwriting without leaving a trace, so no record is created. Ask your own company, compare several similar products, as there might be differences because each insurer's claims experience and KPIs are different, which might lead to more lenient underwriting for certain conditions. Of course, it's best to come directly to me; I can make things very, very easy for you. Those who haven't arranged their coverage yet, remember to come find me early.

Title: Which is better, PVC ink or traditional ink? Content: PVC ink is better compared to traditional ink. The following are the main advantages of PVC ink over traditional ink: Environmental friendliness: Traditional ink: Has the problem of high environmental pollution during production and in the finished product, and contains a large amount of toxic heavy metals, such as lead, which pose a threat to human health. PVC ink: Compared to traditional ink, PVC ink has significant advantages in environmental protection, reducing the emission of harmful substances and better meeting modern environmental requirements. Technology and personalization: Traditional ink: Printing content is limited to paper, and after printing, it needs to air dry, which can easily damage the surface of the printed material. PVC ink: Achieves personalized printing, accurately replicating various shapes and colors, not limited to paper, but also capable of printing on a variety of materials. Convenience and efficiency: Traditional ink: The printing process is relatively strict and has high requirements for the surface flatness of the printed material. PVC ink: The printing technology is more convenient and efficient, easily achieving printing on uneven objects, improving the flexibility and efficiency of printing. Cost: Although not directly mentioned in the cost comparison, the simplicity of use and wide applicability of PVC ink may help reduce overall printing costs, especially in large-scale or complex printing tasks. In summary, PVC ink shows significant advantages over traditional ink in terms of environmental friendliness, technology and personalization, convenience and efficiency, etc. Therefore, PVC ink is an ideal alternative to traditional ink, bringing innovation to the printing industry.
