Title: Xinmi City Agricultural Committee Focuses on Characteristic Agriculture to Assist Rural Industry Development Content: Xinmi City's rural industry closely revolves around the overall goal of achieving "beautiful countryside, strong agriculture, and prosperous farmers," following the construction requirements of "one belt, one theme; one village, one characteristic," and taking the integrated development of "primary, secondary, and tertiary industries" as the path. It focuses on characteristic industries, aggregates resource elements, and consistently adheres to the agricultural development philosophy of "high-end, high-quality, and high-efficiency," fully highlighting regional characteristics. It focuses on leading enterprises, nurtures entities, expands and strengthens characteristic advantageous industries such as ecological agriculture and rural tourism, cultivates and constructs 48 municipal-level or above modern agricultural demonstration parks in Xinmi City, and creates 11 routes for leisure agriculture and premium rural tours. Characteristic agriculture such as grapes, cherries, and vegetables covers nearly 150,000 mu. Concentrating efforts on industrial development, it implements the "one village, one product" strategy to highlight individual characteristics. The Xinmi City Agricultural and Rural Committee encourages, guides, and advises towns, villages, and agricultural business entities to adapt to local conditions, highlight characteristics, introduce new varieties, utilize new technologies, and implement the "one town, one industry; one village, one product" project. By adopting methods such as going out and inviting in, and focusing on five aspects—"primary industry enriching people, secondary industry strengthening villages, tertiary industry revitalizing villages, beautiful scenery enhancing villages, and good governance benefiting villages"—it holds various forms of meetings such as symposiums, experience exchange meetings, and business training sessions to help town and village cadres and leaders of agricultural business entities broaden their horizons, change their concepts, clarify their thinking, and define their direction. According to the characteristics of the agricultural season, our committee has timely organized 7 symposiums, Q&A sessions, training sessions, and experience exchange meetings on "one village, one product" development. Building brand effect and cultivating leading backbone enterprises. First, introducing supportive policies to nurture backbone enterprises. Formulated the "Implementation Opinions on High-Quality Development of Xinmi City's Characteristic Agricultural Industry (2022-2025)". Focus on promoting the industrial development of seven industries and two types of projects, including germplasm resources, Chinese medicinal materials, minor grains, forestry fruits, edible fungi, and agricultural (livestock) product processing industries, to drive the co-construction of the agricultural industry chain, supply chain, and value chain, and accelerate the modernization of the agricultural industry. Enterprises that obtain national, provincial, or Zhengzhou city-level leading enterprise, cooperative, or green certification status are given financial support ranging from 10,000 to 100,000 RMB to encourage qualitative breakthroughs and new leaps in the characteristic agricultural industry. Second, enhancing brand effect to assist backbone enterprises. The Xinmi City Agricultural Committee annually organizes all city-involved agricultural business entities to participate in various national agricultural expos and agricultural product exchange meetings. Through forms such as "exhibition, showcasing, promotion, and tasting," it displays Xinmi's new, special, and refined products, continuously enhancing the external知名度 and influence of agricultural products. Enterprise brands such as "Ma Yongxin" beef, "Huang Baijie" soy sauce and vinegar, "Huayu Xuanyuan" grapes, and "Sister Sha" condiments have become well-known inside and outside the province. Currently, the city has more than 20 agricultural product brands. This year, Yuanzhuang Township Luanshipo Village's "Mi Lian Ni" millet and "Shipo" dinosaur egg plum were recognized as provincial famous agricultural product brands. Recently, Xinmi City's important agricultural cultural heritage, genuine Chinese medicinal material "Mi Er Hua," has signed an intent agreement with CCTV-2 program team for a special feature broadcast, "brand leads the market," providing a good start for the application of Xinmi's regional brand. Third, telling brand stories to promote backbone enterprises. Actively guide enterprises to achieve new breakthroughs in marketing methods. Through news media, WeChat, Douyin, and other online self-media platforms, tell stories about the product's "taste," "quality," and "feeling" to enrich and promote products, pushing Xinmi's local agricultural special products "online and connected to the internet," playing an exemplary and leading role in the industry. Currently, Henan Qiannian Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. in our city has been designated as the live-streaming base for the national e-commerce rural project in Xinmi, laying a good foundation for Xinmi's e-commerce development. Increasing policy support to promote deep industrial integration. First, insurance policy supports development. Agricultural insurance is a "booster" for agricultural modernization, a "stabilizer" for farmers' agricultural income, and an "umbrella" against natural and market risks in agriculture. Currently, characteristic agricultural insurance includes 9 types of insurance categories: forestry fruits, vegetables, agricultural facilities, edible fungi, beef cattle, sheep, seedlings, flowers, and wetland agriculture. Financial subsidies are provided according to the ratio of municipal finance bearing 70%, county finance bearing 20%, and insured enterprises or farmers paying 10%. Currently, agricultural insurance service workstations are widely established in townships and the Fuxishan Management Committee. Through business control and hierarchical arrangements, the efficiency of agricultural insurance services is continuously improved, the grassroots service system is continuously perfected, and the bottom-line guarantee role of agricultural insurance is fully utilized. In 2021, the financial subsidy amount for characteristic agricultural insurance reached 16.37 million RMB. Second, inclusive finance assists development. Innovate rural financial services, introduce the Zhejiang Mybank Xinmi County Inclusive Finance Project. By applying "Internet + big data," build a credit decision model with local industry characteristics, providing farmers with digital inclusive financial services that are unsecured, guarantee-free, pure credit, with a three-minute application, one-second loan disbursement, and zero manual intervention. Allocate more financial resources to key areas and weak links in rural economic development, better meeting the diverse financial needs of the rural industry. Third, the service network radiates more widely. Accelerate the improvement of the rural e-commerce public service system. The E-commerce Public Service Center has achieved functional upgrades, providing one-stop services such as policy consultation, personnel training, marketing promotion, product matching, and activity planning. Optimize rural e-commerce public service sites, implement multi-station integration, one station with multiple functions, and service sharing. 13 township-level service stations and 165 village-level service points have achieved business叠加, expanding the coverage of e-commerce in rural areas and smoothing the channel for products to enter and exit the countryside. Title: Why do I need to go to the toilet as soon as I drink water, but don't need to go if I don't drink? Is it because of kidney deficiency? Content: Men with soft tendons are often deficient in kidney and liver stagnation. Traditional Chinese Medicine teaches you how to replenish the essence and blood of the liver and kidney, increase firmness and delay time. Many male friends always fail at critical moments. Even if they try various methods, the tendon remains unresponsive. This situation is often mainly due to kidney deficiency and liver stagnation. It's not only necessary to tonify the kidney but also to soothe the liver, regulate qi, and promote blood circulation to remove blood stasis. Firstly, many people who develop weakness often first damage the kidney. Damaging the kidney means short duration. As kidney damage continues, the mother disease affects the child, damaging the liver. When liver blood is deficient, the tendons lose nourishment and become weak and unresponsive. Also, the end result of masturbation must be impotence. In ancient times, if this situation occurred, only TCM methods could be used for recuperation. But in modern times, people have more choices. They can use some fast-acting Western medicines, without needing syndrome differentiation, to meet your immediate needs. Such things are good, but not lasting. Many people know that the more you use them, the less effective they become, until finally even doubling the dose is useless. Actually, this kind of thing can quickly mobilize your vital energy, using this energy to meet your needs. But this energy is for preserving life, so afterwards you will feel weak in all your internal organs, and all need replenishment. In a natural state, the body has a natural protective function. The appearance of weakness is the body's self-regulation. To achieve a rapid response upon visual stimulation, the first thing to do is to greatly tonify the essence and blood of the liver and kidney. Our goal is to nourish the tendons by replenishing liver blood. Tonifying the mother kidney can achieve the purpose of tonifying the child liver. Therefore, whether for weakness or premature ejaculation, it can be solved by tonifying the liver and kidney. Similarly, while tonifying the liver and kidney, we also need to appropriately regulate the qi mechanism, quickly unblock the stagnant yang pathway. Once the qi mechanism is smooth, a continuous flow of essence and blood comes, and the tendons naturally become firm. So, one tonifying and one unblocking will show results quickly. Moreover, young people shouldn't be that deficient in the first place. Mr. Li from Hefei is such a case. He is not yet thirty years old this year and has developed weak impotence. Because of this problem, several relationships have fallen apart, and he is very anxious. Although using some fast-acting things can勉强维持, but he doesn't want to rely on this for life. He still wants to use TCM to completely solve this problem, achieving a permanent effect. Symptoms: Strong sexual desire but often unable to achieve erection. Even if勉强起来, he fails too quickly, with no sense of experience. Sore and weak waist and knees, lack of energy, dizziness, tinnitus. Very depressed personality, frequent sighing, often陷入一种焦虑状态. Observation of his tongue: pale tongue body, white coating. Pulse: weak. Comprehensive syndrome differentiation: Deficiency of liver and kidney, stagnation of qi mechanism. Treatment: Tonify liver and kidney, regulate qi mechanism. Can use: Gu Ya, Mai Ya, Chuan Niu Xi, Fo Shou Hua, Shan Yao, Shan Zhu Yu, Shu Di, Fu Ling, Ze Xie, Dan Pi, Gou Qi Zi, Tu Si Zi, Fu Pen Zi, Xian Ling Pi, Yang Qi Shi, Wu Gong. Advised him to usually maintain an optimistic and positive attitude, not always anxious, have a fulfilling life, light diet, try to eat small frequent meals. After a period of recuperation, he felt that his tendons became firm and strong. In a natural state, he could also quickly become excited and maintain it for a considerable period of time. Is weak impotence upon visual stimulation always due to yang deficiency? TCM: There can also be liver deficiency and qi stagnation. Title: Warehouse Raided! All These 'A-Mao' in Putian Have Fallen! 5 Bosses Taken Away! Content: Internet stock image Introduction From April 20 to 26, 2023, is the National Intellectual Property Publicity Week. The theme of this year's National Intellectual Property Publicity Week is 'Strengthening the Legal Protection of Intellectual Property Rights to Effectively Support Comprehensive Innovation'. To establish an awareness of respecting knowledge, advocating science, and protecting intellectual property, create a legal environment that encourages knowledge innovation, further combat crimes of infringing intellectual property rights, maintain market economic order, and effectively support comprehensive innovation, Hanjiang Court released five typical cases of combating intellectual property infringement crimes, actively interpreting the law through cases to maintain a good business environment. Case 1: Crackdown on Counterfeit Cigarettes - Investigating and Punishing the Source of Counterfeiting According to Law Basic Facts Since April 2020, defendant Shen XX was commissioned by an upstream party to produce cigarette box molds bearing registered trademarks of brands such as 'Zhonghua' and 'Golden Leaf', and used WeChat to send pictures of the required cigarette packaging to defendants Chen XX and others for production. Chen XX produced the aforementioned cigarette box molds as required and mailed them to Shen XX, who then mailed them to the upstream party. Shen XX received payment of 439,940 yuan for producing these molds, and Chen XX received a fee of 55,417 yuan for processing the molds. Judgment Result After trial, Hanjiang Court held that defendants Shen XX and Chen XX forged or manufactured without authorization registered trademarks of others. Among them, defendant Shen XX's illegal business amount was 439,940 yuan, constituting a particularly serious circumstance; defendant Chen XX's illegal business amount was 55,417 yuan, constituting a serious circumstance; the actions of both defendants constituted the crime of illegally manufacturing registered trademarks. Both defendants had sentencing circumstances such as confession, voluntary admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment, and returning illicit proceeds. According to law, defendant Shen XX was sentenced to three years in prison, suspended for three years, and fined; defendant Chen XX was sentenced to six months in prison, suspended for one year, and fined. Typical Significance The crime of illegally manufacturing or selling illegally manufactured registered trademarks refers to the act of violating trademark management regulations, forging or manufacturing without authorization the registered trademarks of others, or selling forged or unauthorized registered trademarks, with serious circumstances. This case is a typical source crime of intellectual property infringement. Illegally manufacturing registered trademarks is a key link in the counterfeiting and selling counterfeit goods industry chain. Trademark identifiers are the soul of intellectual property. Additionally, the production and sale of cigarettes belong to a特许 industry and should undergo approval, licensing, and authorization according to law. This case strengthens the protection of intellectual property at the source, promotes the high-quality creation of intellectual property, achieves precise strikes at the source, and maintains market economic order. Case 2: Crackdown on Counterfeit Down Jackets - Restorative Justice for Recovery of Illicit Proceeds and Losses Basic Facts In October 2020, defendant Lin XX hired accomplices Liang XX, Lin Xuan, and Lin Li to produce counterfeit 'CANADA GOOSE' brand long down coats and vests in a leased factory building and stored them in the aforementioned warehouse for sale. The group had already sold goods worth 70,040 yuan. On January 21, 2022, public security authorities seized 4,000 counterfeit 'CANADA GOOSE' brand long down coats and 500 vests from the aforementioned warehouse, with a goods value reaching 1,180,000 yuan. After the incident, defendant Lin XX compensated the trademark rights holder for economic losses and obtained their understanding. Judgment Result After trial, Hanjiang Court held that defendants Lin XX and Liang XX used identical trademarks on the same kind of goods without the permission of the trademark registrant. The illegal business amount was 1,250,040 yuan, constituting particularly serious circumstances. The actions of both defendants constituted the crime of counterfeiting registered trademarks. Defendant Lin XX had sentencing circumstances such as voluntary surrender, meritorious service, voluntary admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment, returning illicit proceeds, having compensated the rights holder for losses and obtained understanding. Defendant Liang XX had sentencing circumstances such as being an accomplice, confession, voluntary admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment, and returning illicit proceeds. According to law, defendant Lin XX was sentenced to two years and six months in prison, suspended for three years and six months, and fined; defendant Liang XX was sentenced to one year and nine months in prison, suspended for two years and three months, and fined. Typical Significance The crime of counterfeiting registered trademarks refers to the act of violating national trademark management regulations, using identical trademarks on the same kind of goods or services without the permission of the trademark registrant, with serious circumstances. This case is a typical production-type intellectual property infringement crime case, which is a key target for crackdown and governance. Simultaneously, this case reflects the concept of restorative justice, integrating the recovery of illicit proceeds and losses throughout the entire litigation process, urging the implementation of returning illicit proceeds and compensation, combined with the execution of property penalties to further curb the possibility of recidivism, maximize the repair of damaged legal interests, and compensate for the losses of the intellectual property rights holder. Case 3: Crackdown on Counterfeit Daily Necessities - Protecting the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Consumers Basic Facts From February 2020 until the incident, defendant Li XX purchased counterfeit goods such as counterfeit 'Safeguard' soap bearing registered trademarks from accomplices Cai XX and Chen XX, and resold them at a markup to Wen XX and others at his store located in Hanjiang District, Putian City. The sales amount was 109,056.67 yuan. In February 2022, public security authorities arrested defendant Li XX at the aforementioned store and seized 192 'Safeguard' soap bars, among other items. Judgment Result After trial, Hanjiang Court held that defendant Li XX sold goods that he clearly knew were counterfeit registered trademarks. The sales amount was 109,056.67 yuan, and the unsold amount was 306.67 yuan, constituting serious circumstances. His actions constituted the crime of selling goods with counterfeit registered trademarks. Defendant Li XX had sentencing circumstances such as partial attempted crime, confession, voluntary admission of guilt and acceptance of punishment, and returning illicit proceeds. According to law, defendant Li XX was sentenced to one year in prison, suspended for one year and six months, and fined.

Title: Is it appropriate to terminate the labor contract and receive unemployment benefits with only two years left before retirement? Content: It is not recommended to do so. First, if you want to receive unemployment benefits, it must be that the company unilaterally dismisses you without reason. If you resign voluntarily, you cannot receive unemployment benefits. Second, the unit cannot dismiss you because you are only two years away from retirement age. Unless, you and the unit reach a mutual agreement, they can give you compensation for terminating the labor contract, and at the same time, they report in the system that the suspension of insurance is due to the unit's reason, so you won't lose out. Therefore, it is recommended that you think carefully about what reason led you to have such an idea. During the pandemic and the post-pandemic era, life is not easy for everyone. I think the unit is unlikely to make things difficult for you, so it's better to negotiate properly with the unit.

Title: Loudi Shuangfeng Police Dismantle Two Illegal "Underground Mark Six" Gambling Dens! Content: Recently, based on the actual situation in its jurisdiction, the Huamen Police Station of the Shuangfeng County Public Security Bureau conducted in-depth investigations, took proactive measures, vigorously carried out a special rectification and inspection campaign targeting "drugs, prostitution, and gambling", and increased efforts to crack down on illegal and criminal activities related to "Underground Mark Six". Title: Why Do Driving School Intermediaries Exist? Content: In Nanning, when learning to drive, at least eight out of ten people taking the driver's license test sign up through intermediaries! Those who often get cheated are these students who find intermediaries to register. Clearly knowing that learning to drive is done with the coach, why sign up through an intermediary? Actually, this really can't be blamed on the students, because driving school coaches are usually busy all day training students and have little time or energy to recruit. If they can't recruit students, they can only accept training from intermediaries at low prices, which provides an excellent survival space for driving school intermediaries. Intermediaries only need to trick students into signing up; the quality of subsequent services depends on whether the training fee given to the coach is sufficient. Conscientious intermediaries pay slightly higher training fees, and the coach will provide good service. With more intermediaries, all kinds of unscrupulous people appear. After being an intermediary for a long time, conscience disappears, and then they earn more while giving less training fees to the coach, leading to poor coaching! #

Title: Why is it easier for Beijing residents to get into Tsinghua University and Peking University? Title: Good figure cannot ignore the training of this part, regardless of boys and girls, these 3 points let you understand Content: #Fitness# #Weight Loss# I don't know if you have found such a phenomenon, what is the favorite exercise for girls who go to the gym to exercise? It's running, elliptical machine, aerobics, yoga. On the contrary, they stay away from strength training. They think that will train them into "Kongfu Barbie", afraid of the appearance of muscles... But about this point (will girls doing strength training develop big muscles?) No: Because of physiological reasons, girls have low androgen levels, and combined with the amount of exercise, nutrition, and training methods, it is very difficult to achieve the imagined result. Just practice with confidence. Of course, everyone has different purposes for going to the gym to exercise. I believe many girls are aiming for a six-pack, perky buttocks, and long legs, but in fact, many people neglect the training of back muscles. As the saying goes, "Beginners train the chest, veterans train the back." "An inch thicker back makes you look ten years older." In fact, a thick back gives the first impression of obesity, and the second is that it makes you look old. Why train your back for fitness? You must know these 3 points. After reading, you will consciously train your back! Point 1: Training your back helps burn fat, makes it easier to lose weight. Your latissimus dorsi and other back muscles almost fill your entire upper body, accounting for a large part of the body's muscle mass. It is the second largest muscle group in the body. Precisely because the back has a large amount of muscle in the body, when using the same amount of time to exercise muscles, it can effectively involve other small muscle groups in the exercise, the most obvious being the arms, abdomen, and shoulders, thereby promoting blood circulation, increasing basal metabolism, accelerating fat burning, and developing a physique that is not prone to obesity. Point 2: Training your back can improve posture and correct hunched back. The back muscle group plays an important role in maintaining the posture of the human body, that is, your main body shape is given by the back. Problems like hunchback and poor walking posture in modern people are all due to insufficient strength of the back muscles, combined with some bad living habits. Therefore, strengthening the training of back muscles and improving back muscle strength can sufficiently alleviate the weakness of insufficient balance between your front chest and back, and also make your posture more upright and defined. You can improve hunchback by exercising your back muscles, help correct rounded shoulders, and make your posture look more proper. Point 3: Training your back can also relieve shoulder and back pain. The back plays a pivotal role in stabilizing the upper body muscle groups. A strong and powerful back muscle can stably support your body and reduce your back pain. We often hear people complain about back pain. In fact, this is all caused by the back muscles "going on strike". After training your back muscles for a period of time, you will find that you become less prone to fatigue and pain whether sitting or standing for long periods, and this is the best proof of enhanced muscle endurance. This is very effective for sedentary office workers. In summary, after reading these 3 points, do you have the urge to train your back? Whether you are a boy or a girl, whether you want to become a "back-view killer" or to become a "clothes hanger" who looks good in anything, it is very necessary to train your back more.

Title: What to do if the debtor transfers property after a court judgment? Content: There are three remedies for a debtor transferring property: (1) Apply for compulsory enforcement and cooperate with the court to assist in investigation and evidence collection. After the creditor applies for enforcement, they should learn about the debtor's property clues through various channels to assist the court in enforcement. If it is discovered that the debtor transferred property after the incident occurred, legal proceedings can be used to protect one's legitimate rights and interests. (2) Civil remedies. There are generally four ways for a debtor to transfer property: (1) Maliciously colluding with others to transfer property for the purpose of reducing the debtor's ability to compensate; (2) Waiving their due claims or transferring property gratuitously; (3) Transferring property at an obviously unreasonably low price; (4) Acquiring property from others at an obviously unreasonably high price. For the first method, the creditor can file a lawsuit with the court to confirm the invalidity of the debtor's civil legal act. If losses are caused, the debtor and the third party shall also bear joint liability for compensation. For the second to fourth methods, the creditor can file a revocation lawsuit with the court, requesting the court to revoke the debtor's civil act. The court can then enforce the return of property by the third party. (3) Criminal remedies. The Criminal Law stipulates the crime of 'refusing to execute a judgment or ruling'. For those who have the ability to execute but refuse to do so, if the circumstances are serious, criminal penalties such as imprisonment for up to three years, criminal detention, or a fine may be imposed.

However, the study might not be fully enclosed because it would need to rely on ventilation from other rooms. This would create three rooms. Then, take a little space from the south side of the living room to create another room, squeezing the dining area and living room together. By doing this, you would end up with exactly four rooms.

Title: @Elderly people in Lintong, please take note of the latest reminder from Xi'an Market Supervision Administration!! Content: On June 7, the Xi'an Market Supervision Administration issued a consumer reminder for the elderly, advising the general public to be cautious when consuming and to avoid falling into the consumption traps set by unscrupulous merchants. "In recent years, as the self-health awareness of the elderly has gradually increased, health-oriented consumption of 'spending money to buy health' has become the choice of many elderly people. However, there are still many problems in the current health product market, and the elderly also have many misconceptions about health products." Relevant staff from the Xi'an Market Supervision Administration explained that health foods are not drugs and cannot claim therapeutic effects. Some illegal health food advertisements often exaggerate product efficacy, contain absolute terms and false promises, claim to cure all diseases, use words such as 'radical cure' and 'effective immediately,' or make promises like 'refund if ineffective' and 'non-toxic and without side effects,' seriously deceiving and inducing consumers. In addition, some unscrupulous merchants use forms such as 'interviews, lectures, interviews, and symposiums' as a cover, inviting some fake experts, professors, and old Chinese medicine practitioners to conduct 'health preservation' lectures on site, while also peddling health foods. Many elderly people, blindly trusting the introductions of these so-called experts or celebrities, end up purchasing a large amount of counterfeit health foods. Some unscrupulous merchants attract the elderly to participate in their organized activities through methods like 'giving away medicine,' 'free trials,' 'distributing small gifts,' and 'lotteries.' Sometimes, they even invite so-called patients to share their experiences and hire people to create the illusion of a rush to buy products, giving the elderly the psychological suggestion that if they don't buy, they will miss out or lose. Unknowingly, they are 'brainwashed' and end up purchasing the products. Some illegal health food advertisements use the names and images of state organs, public institutions, medical institutions, academic institutions, and industry organizations to explain the efficacy of the products, in order to enhance the authority and persuasiveness of the products. There are also advertisements that contain unverifiable so-called 'scientific or research findings' and 'experimental or data proof.' Consumers should be vigilant. At the same time, some unscrupulous merchants hire so-called 'experts' and 'professors' to provide free expert physical examinations or free clinics for the elderly. Many elderly people are lured by the free offer. After the examination or consultation, the 'experts' and 'professors' often inform the elderly that they have multiple health problems and need to purchase products for treatment promptly. As a result, many elderly people are deceived into buying a bunch of useless health foods of unknown authenticity. Source: Xi'an Release Editor: Shi Wei Responsible Editor: Cheng Fang Reviewer: Wang Kun, Jing Jing

Title: Are pure science students (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) suitable for studying Journalism and Communication? Content: Probably suitable, depending on whether you like this major or not. But I don't think it's necessary to change majors; getting a double major is possible. Using my personal experience as a reference: I am an engineering student, have worked in engineering jobs, and accidentally stumbled into the world of journalism. Many journalists around me are science students. Their articles are often better than those from journalism majors and are highly valued by supervisors. (This shows that science students without journalism training can also manage. If you really like journalism work, you can try it after graduation. If you find you don't like it after trying, at least you have a fallback option.) Personally, I am deeply influenced by a scientific mindset (I'm also a 'straight male cancer' with not much artistic flair), and I can't stand the indirectness of humanities-related work. There's also little tangible output; it's more about ideological stuff, so I found it quite painful. (My first thought when seeing this question was 'Don't change majors.') From a societal perspective, it's widely acknowledged that humanities majors have poor job prospects, so it's still advisable to study science. Taking talent introduction programs in a city as an example, where both science and humanities graduates are accepted, science graduates usually get higher salaries.

Title: Is frequent makeup really bad for the skin? Content: 1. Formation of acne. If you do not pay attention to cleaning and hygiene after applying makeup, and do not remove makeup thoroughly, cosmetics can easily clog pores, affect the skin's normal metabolism, leading to the formation of acne and causing breakouts.
2. Skin damage. Many cosmetics sold on the market contain chemical and metal components, some even exceeding standard limits. If these components accumulate on the face for a long time, they can cause damage to the skin, making it rough and dull.
3. Making the skin sensitive and fragile. Facial skin is inherently very delicate. If the cosmetics used frequently contain many irritating ingredients, it can easily weaken the skin's stratum corneum, leading to skin sensitivity.
4. Occurrence of various adverse reactions. Many chemical components in cosmetics, if inhaled into the body over a long period, may cause various adverse reactions in the body, such as affecting the central nervous system, leading to memory loss, insomnia, anxiety, and other symptoms.
Therefore, makeup should be applied intermittently; do not wear makeup every day to allow the skin to rest. Because the endless accumulation of cosmetics can harm the skin. Thus, the skin should be given appropriate breaks, such as not wearing makeup when not going out, simplifying skincare, and only providing basic care for the skin.



Extended Information:
Be cautious when choosing cosmetics, as some ingredients in makeup can easily cause skin problems. Besides reading the instructions, test the product before purchasing or choose based on your skin type. Oily skin should avoid greasy and heavy cosmetics because oily skin already has strong sebum secretion and naturally enlarged pores. The oils in cosmetics can attract dust from the air, making it easier for skin pores to become clogged, leading to the growth of acne and pimples.

Reference: Baidu Encyclopedia - Cosmetics

Title: If you have 3 million in savings, would you dare to quit your job and live a laid-back life? Content: It also depends on the following aspects: 1. What age group you are in. For example, the choice might be completely different for a young person in their 20s who just started working versus a middle-aged or elderly person who is 5 years away from retirement. 2. It depends on future expenses. For someone whose parents are no longer around and whose children are already in college, 3 million might be enough to cover expenses. But for someone supporting both elderly parents and young children, 3 million might be far from sufficient. 3. It depends on whether you have ongoing opportunities and the ability to obtain high investment returns. If you possess the stable ability to achieve 20% returns from stock investments, then the 3 million principal would generate 600,000 per year. For an ordinary family, this could completely cover expenses with surplus to increase the principal, leading to even higher future income – in that case, 3 million is enough. If you can only deposit it in the bank for interest, it might not be enough. Finally, from the perspective of social development, inflation is a major trend. The purchasing power of 3 million today will sharply decline over ten or twenty years due to inflation, which is also a necessary consideration.

Title: 💬 Jilin Medical Structured Interview: Interpersonal Communication Practice Questions! Content: [Private Message] If a patient with a chronic illness loses confidence in treatment and does not cooperate, what would you do? [Reference Analysis] [Red Book] As the saying goes, 'Sometimes cure, often help, always comfort.' It is inevitable to encounter uncooperative patients at work. In such cases, it is necessary to communicate more with the patient, comfort them, win their trust, and ultimately guide them to actively cooperate with treatment. [Red Book] I would take the initiative to approach the patient during my spare time, ask how they have been feeling recently, and why they are not taking medication on time or cooperating with treatment, to understand their concerns. If the patient feels that the treatment is taking too long, and they perceive little effect, leading them to believe the treatment is hopeless and lose confidence, then I would persuade the patient from the following aspects: [Red Book] First, explain the characteristics of the disease and the patient's current recovery status. The characteristic of chronic diseases is that the development process is slow and the treatment period is long, so one cannot be too impatient. Moreover, according to recent examination results, various indicators have improved compared to when they were first admitted to the hospital. Objective data shows that there is improvement, so I would encourage the patient to maintain confidence. [Red Book] Second, inform the patient that this hospitalization is due to an acute episode and does not mean they need to stay in the hospital or take medication continuously. Once the condition is stabilized, they can fully recuperate at home. Through daily diet, exercise, and healthcare, they can maintain a good quality of life, so the patient should not worry too much. [Red Book] Furthermore, a depressed mood is certainly not conducive to recovery. If the patient remains unhappy and uncooperative, it will negatively impact their health, even undoing the progress made in previous treatments, wasting time, energy, and money. I would hope the patient can cheer up. [Red Book] Finally, suggest that the patient can move around more, chat with fellow patients, friends, and family, and communicate with me promptly if any issues arise. Encourage the patient that as long as they maintain a happy mood, have confidence in curing the disease, and actively cooperate with the doctor's treatment, they will surely recover quickly and be discharged from the hospital. I hope that through my communication, it will help the patient's treatment. Afterwards, I will continue to pay attention to the patient's mood and recovery status.

Title: Why is the second string of the guzheng always tuned to 2B and how can it be tuned to 2D? Content: The pitch of the second string of the guzheng should be D (2D), not 2B. If you consistently get a 2B reading during tuning, it might be because your tuner is set incorrectly or there is an issue with your guzheng. Here are some suggestions that may help you tune the second string of your guzheng to 2D: 1. Check your tuner settings. Ensure your tuner is set to your guzheng's brand and model, and set to the required tuning (for example, if you are playing in the standard C scale, you need to set the tuner to the standard C major pitch). 2. Confirm your guzheng is in good condition. If your guzheng is damaged or has incorrect pitch issues, this might cause inaccurate tuner readings. If there is any damage or pitch problem, contact a professional guzheng repair technician as soon as possible. 3. Try adjusting the pitch manually. When the tuner shows 2B, you can try manually adjusting the pitch. The specific method is as follows: gently pluck the second string while observing the tuner's reading, slowly adjust the pitch until the tuner displays 2D. 4. Confirm your playing technique. Improper technique while playing might cause the guzheng's pitch to change. If you are a beginner, it is recommended to seek guidance from a professional guzheng teacher during learning to master correct playing techniques. Hope these suggestions help you correctly tune the second string of your guzheng to 2D. If the problem persists, consider contacting a professional guzheng repair technician or your guzheng manufacturer for assistance. Guzheng tuner, the red button at the bottom right is the power switch. To the left of the red button is the tuning channel selector; click that button to select Guzheng D tuning. Then there is an option for manual or automatic tuning; beginners are recommended to choose manual operation. Then select the 2nd string to adjust. If you need further help, you can check the Guzheng Bar online.

Title: On the highway, still maintaining a snail's pace despite traffic police shouting, driver: Never been on the highway before, dare not drive fast. Content: September 30, 2024, Xiarong Expressway, Yudu section, Jiangxi. While patrolling the highway, traffic police noticed a white car driving extremely slowly in the slow lane. They immediately used their loudspeaker to instruct the driver to increase speed and followed behind, sounding their siren to warn vehicles behind. To quickly eliminate the safety hazard, the police stopped the vehicle at a safe location. Upon inquiry, it was learned that the driver, Ms. Rao, had never driven on a highway before and was afraid to drive fast... The police helped drive her car off the highway, provided criticism and education, informed her about the relevant speed regulations on highways, and fined her for the violation of driving below the minimum speed limit on the highway, also recording 3 points on her driving license. Police reminder: Highways are roads designed for high-speed vehicle traffic, with minimum speed limits, and different lanes have different speed limits. Driving below the minimum speed limit creates a large speed differential with other vehicles, turning your car into an 'obstacle' in the traffic flow, which can easily cause accidents. Therefore, driving slowly on the highway is not only unsafe but actually increases risk. Only by maintaining a speed similar to other vehicles can you reduce 'conflicts' with them and ensure your own safety. Title: Why do many people fail to replenish blood effectively? Content: We often hear complaints like, 'I've eaten over ten boxes of donkey-hide gelatin with no effect'; 'I've consumed many blood-tonifying health products and traditional Chinese medicine, so why am I still blood-deficient?' Today, let's discuss the precautions for blood replenishment in TCM and commonly used blood-tonifying medicinal diets. 01· Strengthen the Spleen and Stomach First Before Replenishing Blood. TCM states that the stomach governs reception and the spleen governs transportation and transformation. The essence from food and water absorbed by the spleen and stomach is the source of qi and blood production. A weak spleen and stomach lead to poor nutrient absorption, causing blood deficiency, and also result in poor efficacy of blood-tonifying substances. Therefore, strengthen the spleen and stomach first to repair and maintain the blood-producing 'machine'. Spleen-strengthening herbs include: White Atractylodes, Chinese Yam, Gordon Euryale Seed, Jujube, Tangerine Peel, etc. Stomach-strengthening herbs include: Medicated Leaven, Germinated Barley, Germinated Rice, Chicken's Gizzard Membrane, Chinese Fevervine Herb, etc. Medicinal diet examples: Chinese Yam Porridge, White Atractylodes and Pork Tripe Porridge, Codonopsis and Chinese Yam with Pork Pancreas Soup, Tangerine Peel Beef, Codonopsis with Potatoes. 02· Replenish Blood While Also Replenishing Qi. Qi is the commander of blood; qi can generate blood, move blood, and contain blood. TCM theory holds that qi is the raw material for blood production, so strong qi leads to abundant blood, while qi deficiency leads to blood deficiency. Combining qi-tonifying herbs with blood replenishment treatment means using qi tonification to generate blood. Blood-tonifying formulas or diets should also include qi tonification—like adding fuel to the blood-producing machine for power. Title: Parents who want their children to grow taller, don't "do more harm than good" to your children. Content: Many parents hope their sons can reach 1.8 meters. If they fail to reach the 90th percentile where 1.8 meters is located, parents become very anxious and start using various unscientific methods to "do more harm than good" to their children. Listen to a pediatrician's advice: Stop! First, we need to understand the scientific definition before we can provide targeted treatment. Medically, there is a clear definition for a child's normal height: as long as the child's height is at the 50th percentile or above, it can be considered medium height, and most children can meet this standard. For those children below the medium level, early attention and identifying the reasons for their shorter stature are key, because through appropriate postnatal intervention, children's height can potentially increase by about 5-10 cm. Based on the height percentile, we can predict the child's approximate adult height: boys and girls at the 25th percentile will have adult heights of about 169 cm and 157 cm respectively; those at the 10th percentile will have adult heights of about 165 cm and 154 cm respectively; and those at the 3rd percentile will have adult heights of about 162 cm and 150 cm respectively. Helping children catch up in height, injections are not the only method, nor the first choice. Many children have impaired spleen and stomach function, making it difficult to absorb not only nutrients but also medication. Regulating spleen and stomach function, enhancing absorption, strengthening dietary management, engaging in moderate exercise, ensuring sufficient sleep, maintaining a scientific routine, and creating a harmonious family atmosphere will help improve all aspects of the child's health, and height will naturally catch up.

Title: Shanxi Tourist Lost Wallet Containing a Train Ticket for That Evening
Content: Yesterday at 15:32, Ms. Chen from the Infirmary of Zhejiang University's Zhijiang Campus got into a taxi in Cuiyuan District 1 and found a black wallet on the back seat. The wallet contained an ID card, cash, two bank cards, and a train ticket from Hangzhou to Yuci, Shanxi for that evening. "The person who lost the wallet is Han Zhiguo, from Shanxi. He must be extremely anxious now. The train is leaving tonight, how can he go without the ticket?" 15:50: The Express staff, using the address on the ID card, contacted the Chenguan Police Station in Qi County, Shanxi, through the Shanxi 114 directory inquiries. Officer Wang who answered the phone was very enthusiastic and immediately helped search for relevant information. 16:20: Officer Wang called back, having contacted Han Zhiguo's family and provided a contact number. 16:30: The Express staff contacted Han Zhiguo's sister and obtained his mobile number. 18:30: They finally got through to Han Zhiguo's phone. He was surprised and delighted to learn that someone had found his wallet. Ms. Chen arranged to meet him at Yuguzhuang. 19:10: "I just got my wallet back. I'm really grateful to that Ms. Chen. She was very kind and told me to be more careful in the future, saying it's not easy for people from out of town and that I should be very careful." In the evening, Han Zhiguo called from the train station; he was about to board the train and said Hangzhou had left him with a wonderful impression! 19:40: They called Ms. Chen again, and her cheerful laughter came through the phone: "I'm very happy. I did a good deed, which also adds to the positive image of our Hangzhou!" (Reporter Jin Jing, City Express)

Title: Panjin Police Crack a Case of Fraudulently Issuing Special VAT Invoices Involving Oil Content: Panjin Police Crack a Case of Fraudulently Issuing Special VAT Invoices Involving Oil Photo Collection Xinhua News Agency, Shenyang, August 18 (Reporters Li Zheng, Yu Yetong) From opening to collapse, with very little business, yet they collectively issued 2.96 billion yuan in invoices, illegally profiting over 47.6 million yuan. Recently, in Panjin, Liaoning, the police, in collaboration with the tax department, cracked a case of fraudulently issuing special VAT invoices. In December 2019, a clue transferred by the tax department alerted the Tax Investigation Unit of the Panjin Municipal Public Security Bureau: Panjin Changhui Petrochemical Co., Ltd., with input invoice product descriptions as chemical raw materials and output invoice product descriptions as refined oil, was suspected of committing the crime of fraudulently issuing a large number of special VAT invoices by changing the product names. After analyzing the flow of invoices from Changhui Petrochemical Co., Ltd., the Panjin police found that the company was established in March 2019, with very few transactions occurring before October. They only fraudulently issued special VAT invoices in May and June 2019 from a company in Henan and a local company in Panjin respectively, involving a tax amount of over 1.16 million yuan and a total price and tax of over 10.14 million yuan. Subsequently, in June 2019, they issued special VAT invoices to Panjin Fengshun Petrochemical Co., Ltd., actually operated by suspect Gu Moumou, involving a tax amount of nearly 1.17 million yuan and a total price and tax of over 10.16 million yuan. Investigators explained that the suspects used these three instances of fraudulent invoicing to increase the version and volume of the company's invoices, preparing for Changhui Petrochemical Co., Ltd. to massively issue fraudulent refined oil invoices in the future. Starting in October 2019, suspects Wang Mou, Wang Moumou, Gu Mou, and Qi Mou, after multiple secret discussions, first had Qi Mou employ illegal means within the refined oil consumption tax management module. Afterwards, Wang Mou, Yang Mou, and others fraudulently obtained input invoices for chemical raw materials by paying around 70 yuan per ton as invoice fees, and then fraudulently issued output invoices for refined oil to several downstream companies by charging 340-450 yuan per ton as invoice fees. A relevant responsible person from the Panjin Municipal Public Security Bureau stated that during its operation, Panjin Changhui Petrochemical Co., Ltd.'s purchases and sales of goods severely diverged. The suspects, aiming for illegal profit, had several petrochemical companies in Jiangsu, Shandong, Zhejiang, and other places issue special VAT invoices for goods described as chemical raw materials to them. Then, exploiting vulnerabilities in the refined oil invoice issuance module and using methods such as tampering with tax control disk data and customs import special VAT payment document data, they fraudulently issued special VAT invoices for goods described as fuel oil to several petrochemical enterprises in Shandong, Shanghai, Jiangxi, and other places. The Panjin police investigation revealed that in November and December 2019, Panjin Changhui Petrochemical Co., Ltd. fraudulently obtained input special VAT invoices totaling over 150 million yuan in tax amount and over 1.34 billion yuan in total price and tax. Through illegal means, they fraudulently issued output special VAT invoices totaling over 180 million yuan in tax amount and over 1.62 billion yuan in total price and tax. On December 30, 2019, the Panjin police organized over 60 elite officers to carry out arrests, took compulsory measures against 6 suspects, and promptly recovered over 47.6 million yuan in illegal gains.

Title: DeepSeek: The Nation's First Pilot Program Merging Healthcare Security and Health Commissions Has Been Operating for Three Years - An In-depth Analysis of the Logic Behind County-Level Reform Pilots

Content: In August 2022, Huanghua City in Hebei Province took the lead in merging the Health Commission and the Healthcare Security Bureau into the "Health and Healthcare Security Bureau," becoming the first administrative region in China to achieve functional integration of health and healthcare security at the county level. DeepSeek analyzes the motivations behind this reform and its industry impacts from the perspective of the reform model for sharing purposes.

Image source: Huanghua City Health Commission

County Reform Breaking New Ground - The Innovative Practice of the Huanghua Model

This reform is not a simple institutional merger but a deep institutional restructuring based on the concept of "triple medical linkage." According to official documents, the merged new department has achieved three breakthroughs: unified budget management, unified policy formulation, and unified enforcement inspections.

Screenshot source: Huanghua City Health Commission

In specific operations, Huanghua City cross-reorganized functions such as fund supervision and drug procurement execution from the original Healthcare Security Bureau with functions like medical institution management and public health services from the original Health Commission. For example, urban and rural resident healthcare insurance operations were coordinated with the promotion of tiered healthcare, while healthcare payment method reforms formed linkage mechanisms with medical record quality control management. This functional coupling reduced policy implementation costs for primary medical institutions by approximately 30% and shortened policy response cycles by 40%.

Reform Motivations - The Inevitable Choice to Overcome Systemic Obstructions

Efficiency Demands Under Economic Downturn Pressure

Against the backdrop of increasing fiscal revenue and expenditure pressures, county-level governments have strong motivations for institutional streamlining. Taking Huanghua City as an example, the merger reduced four section-level positions and compressed annual administrative expenses by over 2 million yuan. This cost control need contrasts sharply with the "super ministry" approach when the National Healthcare Security Administration was established in 2018, reflecting shifts in governance logic under different economic cycles.

Practical Dilemmas of Triple Medical Linkage

Under separate setups, health departments focus on medical service provision while healthcare security departments concentrate on cost control, creating inherent goal conflicts. A typical case is DRG payment reform, where health commissions promote clinical pathway expansion while healthcare security bureaus require cost caps, putting hospitals in a dilemma of "wanting the horse to run fast without eating grass." The Huanghua model resolves policy friction by enabling synchronous design of medical service standards and payment standards through institutional integration.

Need for Enhanced Regulatory Efficiency

Under the previous separate governance structure, medical institutions faced dual regulatory systems. A county hospital director revealed undergoing 18 inspections from the health department and 12 audits from the healthcare security department annually, with a 35% duplication rate. Post-merger, inspection frequency decreased by 20% but problem detection rates increased by 15%, demonstrating the professionalization enhancement effect of integration.

Controversies During Reform Process

Supporters' Perspective: Implementation Path for Healthy China Strategy

Professor Li Ling, director of Peking University's Health Development Research Center, believes the Huanghua reform signifies a paradigm shift in "health governance" - from fragmented departmental management to comprehensive governance oriented toward health outcomes. This integration facilitates coordinated use of basic healthcare security funds and public health funding, such as bundling insurance payments with health management services for chronic disease management, achieving prevention-treatment integration.

Skeptics' View: Accumulating Risks of Functional Conflicts

Xu Yucai, former deputy director of Shanyang County Health Commission in Shaanxi Province, points out inherent contradictions between healthcare security's "strategic purchaser" positioning and health departments' "service provider" role. Policy biases have already emerged in Huanghua's practice: in 2023, average costs per admission in secondary hospitals decreased by 8%, but healthcare professional turnover increased by 3%, reflecting potential impacts of cost control pressure on medical quality.

Moderate Views: Limited-Scope Institutional Innovation

Some scholars advocate restricting such reforms to county levels. Experts from the National Health Commission's Health Development Research Center estimate that county-level healthcare security fund expenditures account for 65% of national totals but have less than 10% policy-making authority. In this context, grassroots integration can better leverage synergistic effects at implementation levels without affecting macro policy frameworks.

Industry Impacts - Changing Landscape During Restructuring

Medical Institutions: From Dual Games to Single Games

Post-merger, hospitals face a single regulatory entity, but game intensity hasn't weakened. A tertiary hospital manager admitted: "Previously we could exploit policy gaps between departments, but now we need to more precisely grasp performance indicators." This pushes medical institutions to strengthen cost accounting and case management capabilities.

Pharmaceutical Companies: Extended Regulatory Chains

Volume-based procurement enforcement supervision has extended from healthcare security bureaus to health systems. A pharmaceutical company reported: "Unannounced inspections have increased frequency, and inspection content has expanded from price compliance to clinical use rationality." This forces companies to establish full-lifecycle compliance systems.

Insured Public: Experience Improvements with Lingering Concerns

Huanghua City achieved "one-stop" processing for basic insurance and family doctor signing services, streamlining reimbursement materials by 60%. However, the city's healthcare security fund expenditure growth rate dropped to 5% in 2024, below the national average of 8%, raising concerns about stagnant coverage levels.

Although the Huanghua model has operated for three years without major issues, its推广 still faces three constraints:
1. Lack of legal authorization - current "Medical Institution Management Regulations" and "Social Insurance Law" are based on separate departments;
2. Professional capability gaps - compound regulatory talent shortage reaches 40%;
3. Interest adjustment resistance - surveys show 73% of healthcare security handlers oppose institutional mergers.

Overall, the merger of healthcare security bureaus and health commissions represents an important exploration in healthcare system reform. While facing numerous challenges, it also brings opportunities like resource integration and policy coordination. Huanghua City's pioneering trial provides valuable experience for other regions. Whether more areas will follow suit and how this merger will promote healthcare industry development deserves continued attention and in-depth research.

Title: Parent's Question: Can children with epilepsy receive normal vaccinations? Dr. Yang answers for you. Content: Whether children with epilepsy can undergo normal preventive vaccination is a very complex issue and one that concerns both parents and doctors. Many parents hold misconceptions about vaccination, believing that vaccines can worsen epilepsy or that children with epilepsy cannot be vaccinated. Some vaccination stations and health centers are also reluctant to administer vaccines to children with epilepsy. These phenomena highlight the特殊性 of epilepsy itself and the lack of scientific and authoritative operational guidelines and standards regarding vaccination for children with epilepsy. However, the preventive vaccination of children with epilepsy requires societal attention and support, especially from clinicians, public health personnel, and the media, who should enhance their ability to discern information and counteract unscientific information interference, conveying the correct message to the public. Typically, children with epilepsy can receive normal vaccinations, but certain special circumstances should be noted. Some vaccines, such as DTP (especially whole-cell DTP) and MMR (especially when combined with the varicella vaccine), can cause fever, leading to febrile seizures; they may also increase the frequency of certain heat-sensitive seizures. There are also cases indicating that vaccination might cause changes in the blood concentration of antiepileptic drugs, which should be taken seriously. For example, after influenza vaccination, the blood concentration of carbamazepine taken by a child increased, even showing symptoms of toxicity. Currently, there are no reports proving that children with epilepsy are more prone to neurological complications after vaccination. If there are no other contraindications and seizures are stably controlled (generally, it is recommended that children who have been seizure-free for 3-6 months receive normal vaccination). For children with epilepsy above 7 years old, if the epilepsy is not effectively controlled, they should not receive a pertussis vaccine booster. If a child with epilepsy experiences convulsions within 3 days after the first vaccination, the same vaccine should not be boosted; if encephalopathy manifestations occur within 7 days after the first vaccination, the second dose should not be administered; if the child has frequent seizures or an unexplained, progressively worsening encephalopathy, vaccination should be postponed. Meanwhile, parents need to carefully review the contraindications listed in the vaccine's instructions. For vaccines with contraindications related to 'neurological diseases' or 'epilepsy,' parents must pay special attention. Title: Yining County Establishes Legal Aid Workstation Content: Zhu is a migrant worker from Jiangsu Province employed by an enterprise in our county. This year, Zhu was accidentally knocked down and injured by a forklift in the workshop. The county's Human Resources and Social Security Bureau recognized Zhu's injury as work-related. Subsequently, the Ili Prefecture Labor Capacity Appraisal Committee assessed Zhu as having a third-degree disability. A dispute arose between Zhu and the enterprise regarding work-related injury benefits, leading Zhu to seek help from the Yining County Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Committee. The committee, recognizing that Zhu had a severe disability resulting in life difficulties, advised Zhu to apply for assistance at the Legal Aid Workstation. After review, Zhu's situation met the criteria for legal aid acceptance. The workstation promptly forwarded the application materials to the Legal Aid Center for approval, which assigned a legal aid lawyer to provide free legal assistance to Zhu. With the help of legal aid, economic losses of over 400,000 yuan were ultimately recovered for Zhu. The establishment of this legal aid workstation will play a positive role in opening a green channel for workers' legal aid, establishing and improving the legal aid guarantee mechanism for labor and personnel disputes, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of workers, and promoting harmonious and stable labor relations. The Yining County Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will further standardize and strengthen legal aid work in labor and personnel dispute mediation and arbitration, truly leveraging the effectiveness of legal aid work and effectively safeguarding the rights of vulnerable groups.
