Title: How to Avoid Greed in Trading? Content: Avoiding greed in trading is one of the key factors for maintaining long-term success. Greed can lead to overtrading, neglecting risk management, and chasing high-risk, high-reward trades, thereby increasing the risk of losses. Here are some strategies to help traders avoid greed in trading: 1. Set clear trading goals: Establish clear profit targets and stop-loss points before trading. Once the target is reached, close the position decisively to avoid pursuing higher returns while ignoring risks. 2. Adhere to risk management rules: Strictly follow capital management rules, such as limiting the risk per trade to 1% to 2% of the total account capital. This helps control greed and avoid overbetting. 3. Develop and follow a trading plan: Create a detailed trading plan before trading, including entry points, stop-loss points, profit targets, etc. Execute strictly according to the plan during trading to avoid impulsive trades. 4. Emotional management: Learn to control emotions during trading, avoiding the influence of greed, fear, or hope on trading decisions. Techniques such as meditation and breathing exercises can help maintain calm. 5. Set trading frequency and size: Limit the number of trades per day or week to avoid frequent trading. Also, control trade sizes to avoid concentrating all funds on a few trades. 6. Diversify investments: By diversifying across different markets, industries, or assets, you can reduce the risk of a single investment failure and lessen the temptation to greedily pursue a single high return. 7. Continuous learning and self-reflection: Regularly review trading records, analyze results, and identify errors caused by greed. Improve the quality of trading decisions through continuous learning and self-improvement. 8. Set a "cooling-off period" after profits: After achieving profit targets, set a "cooling-off period" to avoid immediately entering the next trade. This helps prevent impulsive decisions during emotional highs. 9. Use technical tools: Utilize automated stop-loss and take-profit features in trading software to execute trades automatically when preset targets are met, reducing manual intervention. 10. Maintain patience: Market opportunities are not available every day; learn to wait for the best trading opportunities and avoid trading for the sake of trading. 11. Keep a trading journal: Record the decision-making process, emotional state, and outcome of each trade to aid self-reflection and emotional management. By implementing these strategies, traders can better control greed, maintain rationality and discipline, and thus improve trading success rates and long-term profitability. Remember, trading is a marathon, not a sprint; consistent and stable profits are more sustainable than occasional high returns.

Title: What benefits does the new "trade-in" car purchase policy bring? Expert interpretation. Content: Recently, the effects of policies such as consumer goods trade-ins and full loans for personal car purchases are gradually becoming apparent. In May, car consumption, especially car purchases through loans, showed significant growth. Policy synergy promotes consumption: Car sales growth is evident in many regions. In many local car dealerships, promotional measures such as subsidies for car replacement and zero-down-payment loan car purchases are displayed in the most prominent places, and these discounts are also the most concerning for people coming to look at cars. The consumer goods trade-in policy directly subsidizes consumers, while the implementation of the zero-down-payment car loan policy further lowers the threshold for car purchases. Many car dealers have stated that since May, these two policies have significantly promoted car sales. Gu Zhihua, General Manager of a car 4S store in Dongguan: Most of these policies were introduced in mid-to-late April, which has increased our overall customer visits by nearly 30%. Li Chaoyun, General Manager of a car trading company in Hangzhou: The increase in replacement sales is about 10% to 20%, and the mortgage sales have increased by about 40% to 50% compared to last year. Data from the Ministry of Commerce shows that in May, national passenger car retail sales increased by about 10% compared to April. As of June 6th, the number of applications for national car scrapping and renewal subsidies has exceeded 40,000. Significant growth in car consumption loans from multiple banks. In May, Agricultural Bank of China's car installment loan disbursements increased by 137% year-on-year; Bank of China's car installment loan disbursements increased by 47% year-on-year; Industrial and Commercial Bank of China's credit card car installment business increased by 18% year-on-year; Bank of Communications' car loan disbursement amount increased by 1467% year-on-year; Ping An Bank's new energy vehicle loan disbursements increased by 70% year-on-year. Ji Guangheng, President of Ping An Bank: We dynamically lowered product interest rates and made targeted arrangements to stimulate consumption in multiple areas. For example, offering discounts on handling fees and interest for credit card customers, providing interest rate support for new energy vehicle buyers, and offering financing convenience and benefits to customers. Many banks and auto finance companies have launched zero-down-payment loan products. At the same time, car consumption loan interest rates are also continuously decreasing. Liu Wentao, Deputy General Manager of the Bank Card Center of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Guangdong Branch: The five-year installment rate for the "Trade-in Installment Payment" converts to an annualized rate of 3.44%, which is 51 basis points lower than the current Loan Prime Rate (LPR) of 3.95% and 76 basis points lower than the same period last year. Beware of hidden fees when applying for loans. First, it is best to go to authorized 4S stores or manufacturer's direct stores to purchase a car, and also choose banks or formal auto finance companies for loans. Do not easily believe online loan promotions, and guard against fraud schemes in the name of zero down payment and zero interest. Experts also remind that the terms of loan car purchase contracts on the market are often complex and difficult for ordinary people to fully understand. Especially for zero-interest car purchases, consumers must be clear whether the loan interest is subsidized by the manufacturer or has turned into hidden charges such as handling fees or service fees. Dong Ximiao, Chief Researcher at Zhaolian: Superficially advertised as "zero interest," but actually a certain proportion of handling fees are still charged. Consumers must carefully distinguish the terms. Carefully read the loan and car purchase contract terms to prevent car dealers from using zero down payment and zero interest to indirectly raise car prices, charge additional fees, or bundle high-priced insurance. Experts explain that some zero-interest car purchase plans require customers to purchase insurance from the dealer, so it's necessary to compare whether the insurance price is inflated; some contracts have clauses charging penalties for early repayment;还有一些"lease-to-own" sales models charge rent before the consumer pays off the loan, all of which consumers need to be aware of. Experts also remind that "zero down payment" lowers the threshold for buying a car, but consumers should also fully consider their own repayment ability when taking out a loan. Dong Ximiao, Chief Researcher at Zhaolian: Because it's a full loan, the total interest will also be larger. Consumers should reasonably determine the down payment ratio based on their actual situation. Do not borrow blindly because of zero down payment and zero interest, and do not borrow large amounts beyond personal repayment capacity.

Title: The cost of buying a car is enough to take a taxi for a lifetime, so what's the point of buying a car? Content: I've been thinking about this question too. The annual cost of my car is basically around 10,000 (insurance, maintenance, gas). If I took a taxi everywhere I went, the cost might be around 5,000. Having a car has brought a qualitative leap in the comfort of my life compared to before, I really enjoy it! That's something you can't experience without a car. For this kind of enjoyment, I think spending an extra 5,000 or even 10,000 a year is worth it.

Title: Comparison between Yunjing J5 Max and Xiaoyao 002, which one is better to use between Yunjing Xiaoyao 002 and J5 Max? How to choose based on reviews? Content: When choosing between the Yunjing J5 Max and Xiaoyao 002 robotic vacuum cleaners, this article provides a detailed comparison and evaluation focusing on sweeping and mopping performance, smart features, and other aspects. In terms of suction power, the Yunjing J5 Max reaches 18,500 Pa, while the Xiaoyao 002 reaches 22,000 Pa, making it easier to clean stubborn dust in crevices. For anti-tangle performance, both robotic vacuum cleaners use a cyclone-guided zero-tangle roller brush and an anti-tangle side brush, preventing hair and pet fur from tangling. Regarding mopping, the Yunjing J5 Max uses a Reuleaux triangle mop pad and supports 12N strong pressure mopping, while the Xiaoyao 002 uses a caterpillar-track-style mop pad with the same 12N downward pressure. Its body is equipped with a 130ml water tank, which ensures the mop pad stays clean during the cleaning process through real-time fresh water circulation, avoiding secondary pollution caused by dirty water repeatedly smearing like traditional mop pads. In terms of body height, the Yunjing J5 Max is 11 cm tall, while the Xiaoyao 002 is 9.5 cm tall, allowing it to access more low spaces. For obstacle crossing, the Yunjing J5 Max only supports a 2cm crossing height, while the Xiaoyao 002 supports a 4cm crossing height. In navigation and obstacle avoidance, the Yunjing J5 Max uses conventional LDS laser navigation combined with AI monocular (infrared fill light) + line structured light, capable of recognizing 100 types of objects, while the Yunjing Xiaoyao 002 uses a hidden DToF radar combined with AI binocular + line structured light, capable of recognizing 200 types of objects. For corner cleaning, both robotic vacuum cleaners support side brush extension for edge cleaning. Regarding mop extension, the Yunjing J5 Max supports edge twisting + mop extension (twisting while extending), while the Xiaoyao 002 supports track extension, with the mop extending 48mm overall, 5mm beyond the body, achieving millimeter-level edge cleaning. In terms of battery life, the Yunjing J5 Max has a built-in 5200mAh battery, while the Xiaoyao 002 has a built-in 6400mAh battery, allowing for longer use on a single charge. From the perspective of hosting mode, the Yunjing J5 Max uses Whale Hosting 2.0 Pro Max, while the Xiaoyao 002 uses Whale Hosting 4.0, giving it an advantage in intelligence. For dust collection, the Yunjing J5 Max uses a light dust collection system with a 1L antibacterial dust bag in the body, supporting 30 days of maintenance-free use, while the Xiaoyao 002 is equipped with a 2.5L large-capacity dust bag in the base, supporting 120 days of maintenance-free use. For self-cleaning, both robotic vacuum cleaners support base self-cleaning and allow for replacing cleaning filters. Additionally, the Yunjing J5 Max supports dynamic hot water mop washing from 45 to 75 degrees Celsius, while the Xiaoyao 002 supports dynamic hot water mop washing from 45 to 80 degrees Celsius, providing better antibacterial effects. Summary: The Yunjing Xiaoyao 002 focuses more on comprehensive intelligence while ensuring an ultimate cleaning experience, making it suitable for users with higher demands for smart features. The Yunjing J5 Max also emphasizes the overall cleaning experience and is suitable for users with a relatively lower budget.

Title: Shiyan Construction Waste Management Office Inspects Urban Construction Waste Transport and Site Leveling Projects, 8 Companies with Prominent Dust Problems Punished Content: Recently, reporters learned from the Construction Waste Management Office of the Municipal Urban Management and Law Enforcement Commission that from March to May this year, during inspections of urban construction waste transport and site leveling projects, the department found that 8 construction companies had not properly implemented the "8 100%" requirements for dust prevention and control, with prominent dust issues. Ultimately, 2 companies were placed under挂牌督办 (listed for supervision), and 6 construction companies were collectively interviewed. From March to May this year, due to failure to properly implement the "8 100%" requirements for dust prevention and control (100% enclosure of construction sites, 100% hardening of main roads, 100% washing of outgoing vehicles, 100% sealing of transport vehicles, 100% coverage of exposed materials, 100% spraying/watering for special operations and dusty areas, 100% washing of entrance/exit sections, 100% coverage or greening of land not currently developed) and prominent dust problems, the Municipal Construction Waste Management Office placed 2 enterprises (Xunjie'an Emergency Equipment Industrial Park Plant Construction Project, Shiyan City Hangzhou Road Road Project + Cross Zhejiang Road Overpass + Huojian Road Renovation Project) under挂牌督办 (listed for supervision), and 6 construction companies (Chongqing Qianhe Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., China Construction Third Engineering Bureau Group Co., Ltd., Hangzhou No.2 Construction Co., Ltd., Zhejiang ZhanCheng Construction Group Co., Ltd., Hubei Zhigao Hongji Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., and Hubei Xiongshi Construction Engineering Co., Ltd.) were collectively interviewed. Through a series of punitive measures, the phenomenon of construction waste dust pollution in the urban area has significantly improved. It is reported that the problems existing in the punished construction units mainly include uncovered exposed soil at the project site, earthwork not using wet methods, severe dust from on-site construction, no dust control supervision signboard, vehicles not loaded level or transported sealed, no washing trough facilities, substandard hardening of intersections, etc. The relevant person in charge of the Municipal Construction Waste Management Office told reporters that the 6 interviewed construction units should complete rectification within one week after the interview ends; for those that fail to implement or inadequately implement the限期整改 (deadline rectification) measures, strict legal punishment will be enforced. The 2 units under挂牌督办 must submit限期整改 reports to the Municipal Air Office and the supervising unit on time, apply for delisting, after which on-site verification of the rectification effectiveness will be conducted, and the挂牌督办 status will be lifted based on the rectification situation, with ongoing follow-up reviews. It is understood that to improve the city's ambient air quality and enhance air pollution prevention and control, the Municipal Construction Waste Management Office adheres to the "person盯工地" (person monitoring the site) management model, with all staff on duty, managing from the source. Recently, the Construction Waste Management Office has also established and improved daily management records categorized by construction sites, soil backfill sites, and soil transport companies, standardizing management systems, clarifying work responsibilities, and achieving traceability management for construction waste work. Simultaneously, the Construction Waste Management Office implements a考核排名制 (assessment ranking system) for construction sites under development in the urban area and soil transport companies, reminding construction units to act proactively, take initiative, and seriously implement various dust pollution prevention and control measures. (Reporter Ye Churong, Correspondents Pan Lingling, Wang Chi)

Title: Why can't my phone make or receive calls? What should I do? Content: If this happens, first turn off the phone and restart it. This usually solves the problem if it's due to the phone occasionally freezing or a system issue. If restarting doesn't work, it's likely that the phone has an overdue bill. Use another phone to pay the bill for this number, then try to see if calls work normally. If neither of the above methods works, it is recommended to go to a phone repair shop or the brand's official store to report the issue for repair.

Title: What are the advantages of men practicing yoga? Content: Men practicing yoga can relieve tension and reduce stress. In modern society, men bear a lot of pressure, so there is an urgent need for stress relief. By calming the mind through complete breathing, meditation, and various yoga postures, yoga regulates the nervous system, achieving the elimination of tension and cultivating the mind and character. Yoga promotes a healthy life attitude, allowing you to naturally quit bad habits like smoking and drinking. By constantly surpassing oneself, it also fills you with confidence.

Without a calm mind, people are always under pressure, and emotions can easily become intense. As stress increases, diseases become more prominent.
Chronic stress increases the probability of heart disease and cancer by 6 times compared to risk factors like smoking and high cholesterol. The brain is one of the most important organs in the human body. When the brain is fatigued, many functions are affected. A major benefit of yoga is that it helps brain waves return to a calm state, maximizes the role of the parasympathetic nervous system, restores an energetic state, and combats various health crises.
Men practicing yoga can enhance male sexual ability. Do not misunderstand that yoga can help men improve sexual function; this utilitarian thinking distorts the benefits yoga brings to the body. However, the benefits of practicing yoga for men's sexual ability are natural. The greatest benefit is not the prolongation of time or the improvement of ability, but helping practitioners enhance body sensation, extend sexual pleasure, and achieve a higher state of sexual arousal. With continuous practice, women can increase their chances of multiple orgasms, and both men and women can direct orgasms to various parts of the body.

Practicing yoga is particularly effective in reducing local body fat and赘肉, increasing body flexibility, and helping men maintain a normal body shape.
Unlike other sports, yoga is a comprehensive system that encompasses the body, mind, and spirit. Yoga is the foundation of other sports. Many sports stars, such as baseball catcher Barry Zito and running back Eddie George, use yoga to maintain their best physical condition. Kevin Garnett, the most valuable player of the NBA Timberwolves, always practices yoga breathing and concentration before each game. Yoga practice does not contradict other sports and can even enhance the effects of other sports.
Men practicing yoga can better appreciate the essence of cultivating the mind and body. Women mostly practice yoga to seek a more perfect figure and pay attention to the elegance of postures during movements. Men, however, are not very concerned with the aesthetic of movements and can better understand the true meaning of yoga in cultivating the mind and character.
Men practicing yoga can enhance physical strength. Since yoga movements are relatively slow and the pace is leisurely, they require relatively high flexibility. At the same time, yoga emphasizes breathing methods and bringing the body into a calm state. Generally, men's flexibility is not as good as women's, so progress may not be fast at the beginning. But as practice deepens, they will find that due to increased body flexibility, men may gain more benefits from practicing yoga. Their physical strength will improve, and their mindset will become more peaceful.
Men find advanced yoga poses easier to achieve. Although flexibility is important in the initial stages of yoga, as you progress to more difficult poses, the demand for strength increases. Many poses are almost impossible for women to complete, but men can accomplish them easily.
The disadvantages of men practicing yoga. In fact, yoga itself is not harmful to men. However, during specific practice, men are prone to injuries in the early stages, such as degeneration and wear of spinal cartilage.
We must first clarify that practicing yoga is not about challenging yourself. We all know that yoga has many difficult poses. But not everyone is suitable for completing such high-difficulty poses, especially since men's bodies are not as soft as women's. However, flexibility is crucial in the initial stages of yoga. If you force yourself to complete poses, it can lead to overuse and damage to the spine, which is not worth the gain.

Title: Ni Hong Conducts Research on Counterpart Support Work in Liancheng
Content: On July 12, Ni Hong, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Minister of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, and Leader of the Designated Assistance Work Leading Group, led a team to conduct research in Liancheng County, Fujian Province. The purpose was to understand the situation of counterpart support work, visit and express regards to cadres assigned for assistance, and emphasize the need to deeply study and implement the important speeches and instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping on the revitalization and development of old revolutionary base areas, seriously implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and wholeheartedly, diligently, and effectively carry out counterpart support work to assist in the development of the old revolutionary base areas. Use professional capabilities to accomplish practical tasks. The Sijiaojing Historical and Cultural Block is the only remaining large ancient block in the urban area of Liancheng County, including two provincial-level historical and cultural blocks, Shuinan and Wujia Lane. The protection of this block is a key project of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development's counterpart support. Ni Hong and his delegation visited the Sijiaojing Historical and Cultural Block to learn in detail about street restoration and utilization, as well as the business formats in the block. Ni Hong pointed out that old city streets carry historical memories and also condense the new appearance of the times, serving as precious assets of the city that must be protected and passed down. To do this well, it is necessary to uphold a spirit of professionalism and dedication, respect history, respect reality, respect the masses, and make efforts to improve the supporting facilities of the old blocks, retain their characteristics and charm, and revitalize the historical and cultural blocks. Promote self-development through advantageous industries. The Liancheng New Building Materials Industrial Park Construction Project is a major industrial project implemented by the county, leveraging the advantage of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development's counterpart support for Liancheng, focusing on cultivating and strengthening the new building materials industry chain, and attracting investment through the industry chain. At the industrial park, staff introduced new building materials such as vacuum glass, thermal insulation materials, composite stainless steel pipes, and cement grinding aids to Ni Hong and his delegation. Ni Hong carefully compared different materials, understanding their prices, performance, applications, and other aspects. Ni Hong said that it is necessary to continue to leverage the industry's advantages, strengthen guidance and support in policies, technology, and markets, promote the development and growth of Liancheng's new building materials industry, and continuously enhance the endogenous momentum of the old revolutionary base areas' development. Currently, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development is mobilizing the entire industry to promote the construction of 'good houses.' It is hoped that building materials enterprises will actively participate, increase investment in scientific and technological research and development, innovate and produce more high-performance good materials, and use good materials to help build 'good houses.' Protect cultural heritage with genuine sincerity. 'Fujian has always had the fine tradition of 'respecting culture and valuing education.' The ancient village of Peitian, known for 'farming and reading as a family tradition,' is located in Fujian.' Peitian Village in Xuanhe Town is a famous Chinese historical and cultural village and a traditional Chinese village, one of the most completely preserved ancient residential communities in southern China. Walking along the stone path, Ni Hong and his delegation entered Peitian Village to research and understand the concentrated and contiguous protection and utilization demonstration of traditional villages, as well as disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief work during the flood season, and held discussions and exchanges with town and village cadres and villager representatives. He pointed out that traditional villages are important carriers for protecting Chinese agricultural civilization and inheriting excellent traditional culture. It is necessary to fully explore the historical, cultural, and ecological resources of towns and villages, not only retaining the 'form' of traditional villages but also inheriting the inner 'spirit,' achieving a unity of form and spirit. It is necessary to continuously improve the living conditions of villagers, making traditional villages livable and workable harmonious and beautiful villages. Ni Hong said that practice has shown that the '1+1+1' group assistance mechanism explored and formed by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development—involving one department of the ministry, one institution, and one industry association—is effective and should be continued, upheld, and applied well. Closely integrating with the actual situation of Liancheng, continuous efforts should be made to increase support in industrial development, urban and rural construction, and grassroots governance, working together with the local Party committee and government to build Liancheng's old revolutionary base areas into more livable places and enable the people of Liancheng to live better lives. Lin Wenbin, Vice Governor of Fujian Province, participated in the research.

Title: #Learn from Lei Feng Community Companionship~Dongtang Street Micro-Filial Support for the Elderly# — New Year Visit (6) Content: On January 31, the weather was clear. Accompanied by community staff, two volunteers from the Micro-Filial Support for the Elderly program visited the companionship recipients in Huayinyuan Community. The grandparents are all elderly. Although they suffer from various illnesses to some extent, and some even have their daily lives affected by these ailments, many elderly people do not dwell too much on their troubles but face life with a positive attitude. They entered the community to provide volunteer services to residents, with the primary service targets being disadvantaged, disabled, and empty-nest elderly individuals. The Dongtang Street Micro-Filial Support for the Elderly project is derived from the Learn from Lei Feng Community Companionship project. Within the service period, it can effectively improve the current situation of home-based elderly care for this group of elderly people, leveraging social organizations as the government's humanitarian assistants and serving as a strong supplement to government-purchased home-based elderly care projects. Title: Hebei Province Xinglong County People's Procuratorate Content: Current location: Home >> Procuratorial Business What are the specific duties of a prosecutor assistant when appearing in court? Time: 2021-10-15 Author: News source: Procuratorial Daily 【Font size: Large | Medium | Small】 Consultation category: Legal policy consultation Content: Article 390, Paragraph 2 of the 'People's Procuratorate Criminal Procedure Rules' stipulates that the public prosecutor shall be held by a prosecutor, and a prosecutor assistant may assist the prosecutor in appearing in court. So how should 'assisting in appearing in court' be specifically understood? Can they read the indictment, participate in court interrogation, evidence presentation and cross-examination, and court debates? According to the rules, they should not be referred to as public prosecutors in court, so how should they refer to themselves? 'This assistant'? 'This auxiliary'? 'Public prosecutor assistant'? (Consultant: Supreme People's Procuratorate, Yang Jianjun) Personal opinion: The work of a prosecutor assistant should be auxiliary. First, a prosecutor assistant is not a prosecutor. Article 682, Paragraph 2 of the 'People's Procuratorate Criminal Procedure Rules' stipulates, 'The term "procuratorial personnel" in these Rules includes prosecutors and prosecutor assistants.' Second, the work of a prosecutor assistant in court is auxiliary. For example, Article 390, Paragraph 2 of the 'People's Procuratorate Criminal Procedure Rules' stipulates, 'The public prosecutor shall be held by a prosecutor. A prosecutor assistant may assist the prosecutor in appearing in court. A court clerk may be assigned to take records as needed.' Article 394 stipulates: 'If the People's Court notifies the People's Procuratorate to send personnel to participate in a pre-trial conference, the public prosecutor attending the court shall participate. The prosecutor assistant may assist. A court clerk may be assigned to take records as needed.' Response from the Supreme People's Procuratorate Expert Group: Regarding the specific duties of a prosecutor assistant assisting a prosecutor in court, there are currently no normative documents that provide clear regulations. Referring to the requirements concerning the prosecutor's personal involvement matters in the 'Several Opinions on Improving the Judicial Responsibility System of the People's Procuratorates', we believe that reading the indictment, interrogation, questioning, cross-examination, rebuttal, and presenting court opinions are matters requiring the prosecutor's personal involvement and constitute important courtroom responsibilities that should be performed by the prosecutor themselves. The prosecutor assistant may, according to the prosecutor's instructions, perform supplementary and auxiliary tasks such as reading evidence and assisting with multimedia evidence presentation. The legal status and title of the prosecutor assistant in court should remain consistent with the indictment, still referred to as 'prosecutor assistant'. Title: I had a thyroid ultrasound yesterday, and the result was thyroid nodule TI-RADS 4a. I've scheduled a puncture biopsy and I'm really scared. Are there any precautions I should take? Are there any friends who understand this area? Content: Thanks for the invitation, former thyroid surgeon here. Generally speaking, color Doppler ultrasound can roughly assess the probability of a nodule being benign or malignant. Ultrasound features suggestive of malignancy include: solid composition, hypoechoic, ill-defined borders, irregular shape, taller-than-wide (A/T > 1), internal punctate echogenic foci, rich blood flow signals, and abnormal enlargement of cervical lymph nodes. If three or more of these features are found on the ultrasound, or if the TI-RADS classification reaches 4a or higher, it indicates the nodule has a certain possibility of being malignant. In such cases, a puncture biopsy is generally recommended for a definitive diagnosis. A puncture biopsy is a pathological examination that can confirm whether the nodule is benign or malignant. Ultrasound can only suggest the likelihood of malignancy, while the puncture can determine if it actually is malignant. If the puncture confirms malignancy, surgical removal is generally advised. ① I am a former thyroid surgeon. For thyroid condition analysis and treatment advice, you can consult me for a fee. Title: Why does vaginal discharge form clumps on underwear? Is there a problem? Content: My vaginal discharge has turned into hard lumps on my underwear, what's going on? Some women feel this is a bit dirty, while others worry if it's caused by some kind of gynecological disease... Through today's article, women can understand the reasons for vaginal discharge crusting and see which situations require more daily attention. Why does vaginal discharge crust? "Vaginal discharge crusts because it dries on underwear over time as moisture evaporates. If the discharge is slightly thicker, it can appear clumpy or congealed after drying. How to observe if vaginal discharge is normal? Color: Usually white or clear, egg-white-like discharge; Consistency: Normal discharge is thin, flocculent, and sticky; Odor: Normally, discharge is odorless, sometimes slightly fishy in hot and stuffy conditions; Amount: Mainly depends on the secretion and exudation functions of the cervix, endometrium, and vaginal mucosa. What situations with vaginal discharge require attention? "1. Curd-like or cottage cheese-like discharge: Large amounts of curd or bean dregs-like discharge, accompanied by severe vulvovaginal itching or burning pain lasting a long time, may indicate candidal vaginitis. "2. Grayish-yellow or yellow-green frothy discharge: Often accompanied by frothy secretions, with varying degrees of itching, occasional burning sensation, increased yellow-green discharge, may indicate trichomonal vaginitis. "3. Purulent discharge, yellow or green: Discharge appears yellow, yellow-green, thick, or with a foul odor, often indicates bacterial infection; commonly seen in cervicitis; or infection from retained material in the vagina/uterus; or may occur with concurrent infection in malignant tumors of the vagina, cervix, or endometrium. "4. Blood in discharge: Bloody discharge should alert to possibilities like cervical or endometrial lesions, but benign conditions like cervical polyps, cervicitis, submucosal fibroids, dysfunctional uterine bleeding, or atrophic vaginitis can also cause bloody discharge. Title: The importance of U.S. stocks to the United States is increasingly strengthening, making significant pullbacks unlikely. Content: Overnight performance of major foreign market indices on December 20th: After the Nasdaq 100 futures fell nearly 2% pre-market, they closed strongly higher. Market confidence recovered somewhat, with the three major indices counterattacking and rising over 1%. The main reason was that U.S. PCE inflation data showed signs of cooling again, the U.S. dollar index fell from a two-week high, and gold surged over 1% during the session. Trump threatened the EU to buy U.S. oil and gas; crude oil turned positive after falling over 1% during the session, while BTC rebounded sharply. Global risk assets showed significant overnight recovery. Next week, both U.S. and Hong Kong stocks will face Christmas, but their market closure times differ. The Hong Kong stock market will close from the afternoon of December 24th to the 26th, totaling two and a half days. U.S. stocks will close early by three hours on December 24th and remain closed on the 25th, totaling one and a half days. Therefore, if you want to trade before the holiday, Monday should be the last operational node. In previous articles, I explained the fundamental differences between Chinese and U.S. stock markets based on the differing authority of Chairmen and CEOs in Chinese and American companies. Today, I will further analyze this from the strategic nature of Chinese and American enterprises. When delving into the leading companies in the U.S. stock market, it's easy to see they are true global monopolistic giants. These companies not only shape industry rules but are also standard-setters. Their uniqueness lies in building solid "Great Walls," continuously reinforcing their advantages and moats, making it difficult for competitors to surpass them. Take Microsoft as an example; it has been nearly half a century since its founding in 1975. The seven tech giants in U.S. stocks now occupy the market's commanding heights. Looking ahead five to ten years, they will likely remain firmly entrenched. As Duan Yongping succinctly summarized Warren Buffett's investment strategy, its core can be described as buying "the present discounted value of a company's future cash flows." In contrast, companies in the A-share market show a different development trajectory, more often adopting an iterative development model. This reflects the strategic choice of a later-developing country – leveraging relatively low labor costs to continuously innovate and iterate. However, this rapid development model carries risks. In constant iteration, companies might disappear in fierce market competition due to wrong directions; no one can guarantee how long they will exist. Therefore, investment returns in the A-share market often come from changes in valuation, i.e., price differences from short-term market value fluctuations. As for why real estate is the anchor of wealth in China, comparing it with U.S. stocks makes it clear. When companies struggle to build long-term, stable "Great Walls," cities become the new frontier for wealth accumulation. Investing money in real estate at least ensures the city's long-term existence, fundamentally reflecting the pursuit of future certainty. Generally, the world's total wealth is always increasing; it only gets transferred or redefined, not reduced or disappeared. However, excess wealth needs a vessel to contain it. During the agrarian civilization, farmland was the primary vessel of wealth. In the commercial civilization era, land, minerals, and valuation together formed the main vessels of wealth. The United States has undoubtedly explored the financial field the deepest. Since the subprime mortgage crisis, Wall Street recognized that stock market valuation is more controllable and has a higher ceiling than land and real estate. Consequently, the primary wealth in the U.S. began to coalesce through consensus, materialize through valuation, and eventually, the wealth contained in the vessel of U.S. stocks grew increasingly massive. Before the subprime crisis (2007), the total market capitalization of U.S. stocks was less than $15 trillion. According to Siblis Research data from September 11, 2024, as of June 30, 2024, the total market capitalization of the U.S. stock market was $55.25 trillion, with the total market cap of U.S. domestic companies listed on the NYSE, Nasdaq, or OTCQX being $48.23 trillion. In 17 years, the total market cap of U.S. stocks increased nearly fourfold. Additionally, AI search shows the total U.S. real estate market cap was approximately $24.3 trillion in 2007 and $49.6 trillion in 2024. In 17 years, the U.S. real estate market cap roughly doubled. These objective data strongly support the above view: U.S. stocks have surpassed U.S. real estate to become a crucial vessel for American wealth. Usually, places where wealth concentrates heavily are prioritized for national policy倾斜. The fluctuations in U.S. stocks are now deeply tied to U.S. wealth. Furthermore, the current trend suggests the U.S. wants to build a "chip-dollar" and "stock-bond-dollar" system alongside "petrodollar." As the importance of U.S. stocks strengthens, it is indeed difficult for them to experience significant pullbacks. In conclusion, for lightly positioned or empty-handed investors, if a golden opportunity arises from an oversold dip in U.S. stocks, the opportunity far outweighs the risk.

Title: Talking About Two US Index Funds Content: Throughout the history of US securities, Warren Buffett himself has always recommended that ordinary investors should invest in the US S&P 500 index. In addition, I personally also recommend the Nasdaq 100 Index; they represent the epitome of the US traditional economy and innovative technology, respectively. Introduction: Standard & Poor's 500 Index (English: Standard & Poor's 500): Regarding the S&P 500 index, Buffett has recommended it many times. In his 2017 letter to shareholders, he wrote: 'If a statue is ever erected to honor the person who has done the most for American investors, the hands-down choice should be Jack Bogle. For years, Jack has been mocked by the investment-management industry. Today, however, he has the satisfaction of knowing that he helped millions of investors realize far better returns on their savings than they would otherwise have earned. He is a hero to them and to me.' Jack Bogle was the founder of the Vanguard Group, a public fund company, and the inventor of index funds. His Vanguard Fund issued the world's first index fund in 1975—the S&P 500 Index Fund. The S&P 500 is the first US stock market index calculated by float-adjusted market capitalization and is the most well-known stock index launched by Standard & Poor's. Currently, this index includes 500 US large-cap stocks with a market capitalization of over $10 billion. The S&P 500 covers about 80% of the total US stock market capitalization and includes a wider range of sectors, so it is widely considered the index that most closely reflects the overall market performance. Nasdaq-100 Index (English: NASDAQ-100 Index): Established on January 31, 1985, it is a US stock market index composed of the 100 largest domestic and international non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, based on market capitalization and adjusted by some rules to balance the impact of larger-cap stocks. Unlike the S&P 500 Index and the Nasdaq Composite Index, it does not include financial institutions. The Nasdaq-100 Index, Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500 Index, and Russell 2000 Index are the most important stock indices in the US. All four major indices have standard, mini, and micro futures/options available for investors to trade. Performance comparison of the two indices over the past ten-plus years (charts from the Nasdaq official website and Wind data): Looking at the time span from 2008 to 2023, the Nasdaq-100 underperformed the S&P 500 in only two years: 2008 and 2022, both years of global turmoil (financial crisis and global pandemic). Additionally, I recall that further back, in the year 2000 when tech stocks crashed, the Nasdaq-100 significantly underperformed the S&P 500. Of course, at that time, most internet companies lacked solid performance support, so the comparability is limited. At the current stage, whether in the S&P 500 or the Nasdaq-100, a large proportion of the top ten holdings are comprised of high-quality companies like Apple, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, META, Berkshire Hathaway, etc. These leading companies generate real cash flow. Personally, I believe that conservative investors who have a long-term optimistic outlook on the US economy but are not familiar with US companies can invest in these two index funds at a certain ratio when valuations are normal or even undervalued. For example, ratios like 5:5, 6:4, or 7:3 are all acceptable. It is highly likely that the long-term annualized return will reach 10% or more. Purchase: There are corresponding funds for these indices established both domestically and internationally. So how should investors buy them? I have selected some representative products for reference: Domestic purchase of S&P 500: 513500 Bosera S&P 500 ETF, market cap 6.6 billion, management fee 0.85%; 161125 E Fund S&P 500, market cap 430 million, management fee 1.05%. Both are relatively large-scale, but the fees are quite expensive; no way around it. 513500 is slightly better. International purchase of S&P 500: Vanguard VOO, market cap 181.1 billion, management fee 0.03%; BlackRock iShares IVV, market cap 274 billion, management fee 0.03%. Both are fine, no real difference. Domestic purchase of Nasdaq-100: On-exchange funds: 513100 Guotai Nasdaq 100 (QDII-ETF), market cap 11.8 billion, management fee 0.8%; 513300 ChinaAMC Nasdaq 100 ETF (QDII), market cap 4 billion, management fee 0.8%; 159632 Huaan Nasdaq 100 ETF (QDII), market cap 7.7 billion, management fee 0.8%. Off-exchange funds: 270042 GF Nasdaq 100 Index, market cap 6.7 billion, management fee 0.85%; 040046 Huaan Nasdaq 100 Index A, market cap 3.3 billion, management fee 0.8%. International purchase of Nasdaq-100: QQQ: market cap 248 billion, management fee 0.2%; QQQM: market cap 22 billion, management fee 0.15%. There is no difference in the holdings between QQQ and QQQM; the difference is that one has a larger market cap and the other smaller, plus QQQM has a slight advantage in management fees. Additionally, during the holding period, these index funds distribute dividends quarterly, with a dividend yield between 1% and 2%, paid four times a year. Current Valuation: According to Wind data, compared to the approximately 5% yield of US Treasury bonds, the current valuations of these two index funds are not very cheap. The P/E of the S&P 500 is around 26, and the P/E of the Nasdaq-100 is around 35. Investment should consider overall valuation and risk. However, if using a fixed-amount periodic investment plan, one can proceed without overthinking, as regular fixed amounts ensure buying fewer shares when prices are high and more shares when prices are low. Summary: Overall, these index funds are replicas of the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 samples. When the overall P/E ratio is not high—for example, the S&P 500 P/E around 20 or below, and the Nasdaq-100 P/E around 25 or below—one can buy in batches and hold long-term. Also, among funds with reasonably large market caps and decent liquidity, choose the one with lower fees; there's no difference. For domestic purchases, I recommend using off-exchange channels to reduce speculative sentiment. If investors have foreign brokerage accounts (e.g., Futu, Tiger, Snowball, Interactive Brokers, Charles Schwab, etc.), it is even more recommended to purchase through foreign brokers because the annual management fee difference is several times, and this cost erosion is not negligible over the long term. Whether it's Buffett's endorsement or data spanning decades, both of these US passive indices—the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq-100—have proven that they can outperform most active fund products in the market over the long term. Okay, that's all for today. Thank you!

Title: Terrifying! Quanzhou City: Sudden explosion in the kitchen, this item is in every household! Be careful when buying! Content: Having been in and out of the kitchen for so many years (not really), the editor once thought the scariest things were being splashed by hot oil or cut by a kitchen knife. But it was completely unexpected that we also need to be wary of pressure cooker explosions. A pressure cooker exploding just like that is no joke. Not long ago, a pressure cooker suddenly exploded at Ms. Xiao's home in Quanzhou. Ms. Xiao's family lives on Donghu Street, and her mother is 75 years old this year. On the afternoon of January 4th, Ms. Xiao's mother went as usual to a small supermarket near their home to buy items. Persuaded by the shop assistant, she bought a ¥230 no-brand electric pressure cooker with a trademark name similar to Philips. Even though the family already had an electric pressure cooker, since her mother had already bought it, Ms. Xiao didn't say anything more. At noon the next day, the family used this new electric pressure cooker to cook rice. Unexpectedly, after cooking for twenty or thirty minutes, just as the rice was about to be done, a "BANG" sound came from the kitchen. When Ms. Xiao and her mother ran to the kitchen, they found the electric pressure cooker had actually exploded. Ms. Xiao was still shaken by the experience. Just before the explosion, her mother had just come out of the kitchen, so she wasn't hurt by the explosion. Otherwise, who knows what might have happened. Graphic: Huang Hui. Subsequently, Ms. Xiao contacted the store, hoping to get a refund for the electric pressure cooker and compensation for her mother's treatment costs for burns sustained while cleaning up. At first, the store questioned whether they hadn't closed the lid properly. After some back and forth, they finally refunded the cost of the pot and compensated ¥100. "Some elderly people are easily persuaded by others. As soon as someone promotes a product, they buy it without checking if the product is truly reliable. If it was just spending money, that would be one thing, but the worst fear is that after using counterfeit or substandard products, an accident happens," Ms. Xiao said. "I hope what happened to my mother can serve as a warning to other elderly people, so they don't readily trust others anymore." This is not an isolated incident. Last month, a pressure cooker explosion also occurred in Guangdong, resulting in a woman being disfigured. Around 6 PM on December 3rd, Mr. Peng returned home in Jiangmen, Guangdong, and saw his girlfriend, Miss Tang, using a pressure cooker in the kitchen to make congee, so he went in to help. At that time, the lid of the pressure cooker was open. Seeing the congee was almost done, Mr. Peng twisted the exhaust vent to the venting position and then put the lid on. But unexpectedly, when the congee was cooked, the pressure cooker couldn't be opened no matter what. Suddenly, the pressure cooker exploded with a "BANG"!!! Along with the explosion, congee splattered everywhere. Mr. Peng couldn't dodge in time and was burned on the back of his neck. Miss Tang was unfortunately disfigured. Due to the severe burns, eating has now become very difficult. △ The hospital's initial diagnosis was burns on the left thigh and face, with a burn area of about 3%, local skin loss, and facial redness and swelling. Video News ▼ In recent years, news of pressure cooker explosions is not uncommon. The scene photos look even more shocking. In June 2017, at a hotel in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, a pressure cooker explosion caused the unfortunate death of a 17-year-old cook. In February 2018, while a resident in Ningbo was using a pressure cooker to cook rice, the pressure cooker suddenly exploded, blowing a large hole in the ceiling. In February 2018, scene of the Ningbo pressure cooker explosion incident. Remember! The main reason a pressure cooker explodes is likely because the exhaust vent on the lid is blocked and cannot release pressure. Besides buying pressure cookers produced by正规 manufacturers, you also need to master these kitchen knowledge to keep the danger of explosion away from us! ▼ Quickly forward this to the "chef" in your family, remind her to pay utmost attention to operational safety! Source: Quanzhou Evening News, Guangdong Radio and Television's "DV Live", Guangzhou Fire Department

Title: Octogenarian Walks Out of City in Snowy Weather; Patrol Officers Promptly Help Him Return Home Content: Octogenarian Walks Out of City in Snowy Weather; Patrol Officers Promptly Help Him Return Home

Northeast Network, March 18th. On March 15th, during a public security patrol in their jurisdiction, police officers from the Xinghua Border Police Station of the Jiamusi Border Management Detachment promptly rescued a lost octogenarian.

Police help the lost elderly person return home. Photo provided by the police. At 16:00 on March 15th, officers from the Xinghua Border Police Station were conducting their routine public security patrol. When they reached the South Gas Station in the suburbs of Tongjiang City, they discovered an elderly woman in her eighties walking on foot towards the direction out of the city. As it was snowing heavily at the time, the officers stopped their vehicle and approached to inquire. They found the elderly woman's speech was slurred and communication was difficult. The officers invited the elderly woman into the police car to warm up and contacted her family through a community grid group. It was understood that the elderly woman, named Gao Mourong, suffers from cerebellar atrophy and was temporarily residing in a nursing home. The officers then contacted the elderly woman's granddaughter, Ni Mou, who rushed to the scene immediately to take her grandmother back.

Title: Brand-new color TV covered in dust Content: □ Reporter Bai Huajie Evening News A reader purchased a color TV at a large supermarket's Gongjiang store. Upon unpacking it at home, they found it was a TV covered in grime and dust, without any plastic sealing. When negotiating with the store's home appliance department, they were told to bring it back to the store for exchange themselves. Yesterday, Mr. Xie told reporters that on the 13th of this month, he went to a large supermarket's Gongjiang store and bought a Philips color TV. After payment, he went to the pickup point to collect the goods. Because the staff at the pickup point couldn't confirm a delivery time, he had to take it himself. When the movers loaded the TV into Mr. Xie's car, they felt something was wrong and said to him, "The center of gravity of this TV box is off, why is it reversed?" Mr. Xie saw that the sealing tape was intact, so he didn't pay much attention. After returning home, Mr. Xie opened the box and found a TV without inner packaging. Upon closer inspection, he saw the TV was covered in grime and dust. He immediately called the supermarket. A supervisor said, "Then you come and exchange it yourself," and hung up. Helpless, Mr. Xie drove back to the Gongjiang store to negotiate. The staff at the pickup point were already aware of the issue and contacted the home appliance department, which sent a new TV to the pickup point. After the new TV was loaded into Mr. Xie's car, a worker got in and went to Mr. Xie's home to retrieve the old TV. Then Mr. Xie drove the worker and the TV back to the Gongjiang store pickup point. He spent almost the entire afternoon on this TV, sweating profusely from moving it up and down. The reporter dialed the service hotline number provided on Mr. Xie's invoice, but it connected to the cashier department. After several attempts, they reached a man who claimed to be in charge of the TV department. He replied, "This kind of thing is impossible. Our machines are all in original sealed boxes, original packaging, and are genuine products. If it were a display model, we would inform the customer." Shortly after, the head of the Gongjiang store's home appliance department called the reporter and said that the customer on the 13th complained about the packaging, so they exchanged it for one with original packaging. The reporter also called the Philips Consumer Electronics Service Office, but the phone rang unanswered. An explanation from the Philips 400 service hotline staff was that the person at the office switchboard might have stepped away temporarily, and they would investigate the issue encountered by the customer.

Title: Were my expectations for Harbin too high? Content: #HarbinTravel[Topic]# #SouthernLittlePotatoBravesHarbin[Topic]# Harbin Temperature: As someone from Huangshan, Anhui, I actually found it okay when I landed in Harbin. If you wear enough layers, it really isn't cold! Wearing thick clothes, I even worked up a sweat playing directly in the Ice and Snow World. Harbin People: Having been here for two days now, I've encountered both warm and rather unreasonable people. When we went to a restaurant, three girls ordered two dishes (afraid the portions would be too big to finish). Seeing we ordered little, the service was very neglectful - no plates, no water [disappointedR]. The attitude was like "take it or leave it" [embarrassedR]. Harbin Prices: After coming to Harbin, I feel the prices aren't as outrageous as online rumors suggest. What I saw online was Ma Die'er ice cream bars for 5 yuan each, but actually in the store it was 10 yuan each. The restaurant I just mentioned with the somewhat neglectful service - the 30 yuan portion of Guo Bao Rou wasn't very large either; two dishes were a bit insufficient for three people [disappointedR]. Holding the white fox for a photo was also 30 yuan per time. Ice and Snow World: First, let me state I really, really, REALLY like the Ice and Snow World. It's super, super beautiful inside, the ice sculpture architecture is truly amazing. BUT, the random overcharging by cars is just too outrageous! (Although this is a common problem in tourist cities [disappointedR]). But the experience was really poor. After playing all afternoon, super tired, we couldn't get a taxi when leaving the Ice and Snow World! We really tried for ten or twenty minutes without getting a single car. Asked the cars at the entrance how much to go back to Central Street - 70 yuan! A taxi ride would only cost over ten yuan, less than 20. In the end, we had no choice but to take the subway back. To summarize, Harbin is very fun. The architectural style is very different from Huizhou, which I think is very beautiful. The prices aren't as cheap as spread online, but they are also somewhat different from Huangshan. The overall experience was still quite good. When traveling, just relax and have fun [approvalR]

Title: Rumor that Tsai Ing-wen will take the lead in receiving domestically produced vaccines? Tsai's office: Must follow professional judgment. Content: Huaxia Jingwei Net, March 22nd: According to a report from Taiwan's "China Times News Network", Taiwan's "Minister of Health and Welfare" Chen Shih-chung suggested that Tsai Ing-wen take the lead in receiving the domestically produced vaccine. Title: The 25th National Hypertension Day丨The First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University Holds Online and Offline Public Welfare Free Clinic "Know Your Blood Pressure, Achieve Blood Pressure Control" Content: To welcome the 25th "National Hypertension Day", with the support of the Hypertension Professional Committee of the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, the Hypertension Professional Committee of the Chinese Geriatrics Society, the Hypertension Professional Committee of the Heilongjiang Provincial Medical Doctor Association, and the Hypertension Professional Committee of the Heilongjiang Provincial Medical Promotion Association, on October 8th, the Department of Cardiovascular Medicine of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University held an online and offline charity free clinic event with the theme "Know Your Blood Pressure, Achieve Blood Pressure Control". Professor Li Yue, Vice President of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University and academic leader of Internal Medicine, Professor Li Weimin, expert receiving special government allowance from the State Council, Vice President of the Hypertension Branch of the Chinese Geriatrics Society, and Lifetime Professor of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University, as well as directors from various wards of the Department of Cardiology participated in the event. Directors and experts from various wards of the Department of Cardiology discussed issues related to hypertension prevention and treatment. Professor Zhao Dechao, Director of the Hypertension Ward, led all doctors in conducting an online free clinic via the internet. Deputy Director Ma Dan and other cardiology experts conducted an offline charity free clinic at the hypertension outpatient department. Among the outpatients were young people under 20 years old who experienced elevated blood pressure due to academic pressure, insufficient sleep, unhealthy diet, and lack of exercise; elderly patients with concurrent cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases whose blood pressure fluctuated due to the recent colder weather; and successful middle-aged individuals whose work was affected by unstable blood pressure. The experts provided professional and detailed guidance for each patient. In an interview with reporters, Professor Zhao Dechao called on everyone to maintain a healthy diet, quit smoking and limit alcohol, exercise regularly, keep warm and avoid cold, adjust work and life rhythms, and have regular health check-ups to prevent hypertension as temperatures gradually drop. When blood pressure exceeds 140/90 (mmHg), close attention is needed. Work with professional doctors to manage your blood pressure and protect important organs such as the heart, brain, and kidneys from damage, safeguarding your health. Vice President Li Yue pointed out that Heilongjiang Province, located in the cold northern region, is a "high-incidence area" for hypertension. Under the leadership of several generations of renowned cardiovascular experts in China, such as Fu Shiying and Li Weimin, the Department of Cardiology of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University has conducted six large-scale hypertension epidemiological studies in Heilongjiang Province, making significant contributions to the cause of hypertension in Heilongjiang Province and even nationwide. The Hypertension Ward of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University is one of the first national Hypertension Centers, a CDQI Hypertension Center of Excellence, the Heilongjiang Provincial Hypertension Prevention and Control and Quality Control Center, and the leading unit of the National Hypertension Specialist Medical Consortium in Heilongjiang Province. In the future, all colleagues in the Department of Cardiology of the First Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University will continue to work hard to make further contributions to the prevention and control of hypertension in Heilongjiang Province and across the country, better safeguarding the health of the general public! Text by Chen Wenjia, Photos by Zhou Xiyao

Title: The computer starts up normally, the keyboard and mouse respond, but the monitor screen is black. What is the reason? Content: Keyboard and mouse respond - motherboard is fine 
Can start normally - CPU, memory, hard disk, including the system are all fine 
Monitor screen is black - graphics card problem or monitor problem 
"The monitor works fine after being on for a while, and can function normally. It's just black at startup." - graphics card is fine

Business license social insurance. Pros and cons explained. Is it better to do it through a business license, or is it better as a flexible employment individual? Don't worry. Today, Shuangshuang will explain it specifically for you. Be sure to like, favorite, and save this video. Okay. First, for those of us with a business license, individual businesses can be divided into two situations: those with employees and those without employees. Those without employees are 'mom-and-pop shops' that do not hire other personnel. Those with employees are similar to enterprises. In this case, you must pay enterprise employee social insurance for your staff. If you don't pay, it is an illegal act. For these 'mom-and-pop shops' that don't hire others, is it better to handle social insurance through the business license, or as flexible employment? What's the difference between these two choices? Listen carefully. First, the payment process is different. If you handle social insurance through the business license, you need to open a corporate bank account and then pay at the tax bureau. After we pay, we then declare it at the social security bureau, usually quarterly or annually. Paying social insurance as a flexible employment individual requires applying for a bank card, and we pay monthly by deduction. Second, the types of insurance coverage are different. Using a business license to handle social insurance allows us to pay for the five social insurances. Paying as a flexible employment individual, however, only allows for Pension Insurance and Medical Insurance. Furthermore, the policies you can benefit from also differ. Using a business license to handle social insurance may allow you to make back payments for previous social insurance in some places. Flexible employment social insurance can qualify for the '4050' subsidy, which can be up to 6,000 yuan per year, and you can also make back payments for three to five years. I have made a video about this subsidy before, you can go check it out. Finally, the retirement age is different. If you retire using the business license method, women can retire at 50. If you are insured as a flexible employment individual, the retirement age for women is 55. Everyone can compare and choose according to their actual situation. If you have special requirements like maternity needs, buying a house, or children's schooling, we suggest you handle social insurance using the business license. This way you can reimburse maternity insurance, receive maternity allowances, and meet the conditions for buying a house and children's schooling. At the same time, women can retire 5 years earlier. But if you have no other requirements, Shuangshuang suggests you pay for flexible employment employee social insurance. This way you can save a lot of money. Does everyone understand?

Title: Why are some people calling "National 11 Articles" a tightening-type regulation, "National 10 Articles" a suppressive regulation, and the "9.29" new policy a control-type regulation? Content: The main function of the National 11 Articles was to suppress speculation. Its core content was a 40% down payment targeting property speculation groups, while its tightening aspect was to prevent the impact of foreign hot money, also targeting real estate speculation. The background for this was that China had been implementing a loose monetary policy, and interest rates worldwide were very low. At that time, countries were successively implementing trade protectionism. The inflow of international hot money would increase the expectation of RMB appreciation, which would harm China's foreign trade. The suppressive nature of the National 10 Articles is reflected in: establishing an assessment mechanism to prevent reckless investment and standardize the market; the purchase restriction order for third homes; proposing a property tax; and proposing land purchase restrictions and the construction of affordable housing. The main effect of this policy was to accelerate price reductions in the real estate industry and significantly reduce demand, naturally suppressing market enthusiasm and vitality. As for transaction volumes, I think you've seen them – sluggish in second and third-tier cities, shrinking in first-tier cities. I think the highlight of the 9.29 policy is the clear purchase restriction: one person, one home. It includes a property tax policy with Chinese characteristics – ambiguous (not officially announced, but there are signs). There's also the collection of a land tax. I think the control aspect of this is not obvious, but it further affects the supply-demand relationship in the market. Overall, the three rounds of regulation were all aimed at expanding demand and reducing supply, but the policies became increasingly clear. This is like our experts: before something happens, they tell you it's absolutely impossible; after it happens, they seriously tell you it was possible.

Title: After cleaning the surface of 304 stainless steel plate with pickling passivation solution, what cleaning agent do you generally use to deal with residual water stain marks? Content: The treatment of wastewater from stainless steel pickling passivation solution usually requires following these steps: 1. Neutralization reaction: - First, neutralize the acidic substances in the wastewater, usually using alkaline substances (such as sodium hydroxide, lime water, etc.) to adjust the pH value to near neutral. 2. Precipitation separation: - Add an appropriate amount of flocculant (such as polyaluminum chloride, polyacrylamide, etc.) to promote the formation of precipitates from suspended solids and heavy metal ions in the wastewater. 3. Filtration and purification: - Allow the precipitate to settle through a sedimentation tank or settler, and then further remove impurities from the wastewater through a filtration system (such as sand filtration, activated carbon filtration, etc.). 4. pH adjustment: - Test the pH value of the wastewater again to ensure it meets discharge standards, and perform secondary neutralization if necessary. 5. Heavy metal removal: - For wastewater containing heavy metals, technologies such as ion exchange, chemical precipitation, and electrochemical methods can be used for heavy metal removal. 6. Biological treatment: - For wastewater containing organic matter, biochemical methods (such as activated sludge process, biofilm process, etc.) can be used for biodegradation. 7. Monitoring and compliance: - Conduct strict monitoring of the treated wastewater to ensure that various indicators (such as pH value, COD, BOD, heavy metal content, etc.) comply with local environmental protection discharge standards. 8. Comprehensive utilization or safe discharge: - If the wastewater treated by the above methods meets relevant standards, it can be considered for recycling; otherwise, it should be discharged to designated wastewater treatment plants or discharge points that meet environmental protection requirements. During the treatment process, national and local environmental protection regulations must be strictly followed to ensure the compliance and effectiveness of wastewater treatment. In addition, depending on the specific composition of the wastewater and treatment requirements, other specific treatment measures may be necessary.

Title: Can we install a main door at home 20-some days after an elderly person passed away? Content: Generally, if a funeral has been held at home, it's best not to move things like doors and windows. It's preferable to wait until 100 days after the elderly person's passing before doing these things. However, some local customs allow it. It's best to ask the elderly in your local area if it's acceptable; if you feel there are no taboos, then you can install it. About 20-some days after an elderly person passes away, it should be possible to install a main door at home, as long as the deceased has been laid to rest peacefully. Of course, there will be an impact, a significant impact on the child's physical and mental health, and it is also an important factor in deciding custody. [Unclear text: 酝讼桓某辆曰酪源糙胶你敬] Installing a main door isn't calculated based on how many days have passed since the elderly person's death, but rather on the surviving family members' birth characters and the house's location and orientation. An elderly person passed away 20-some days ago, can we install a main door at home? Well, I think since it's been over 20 days, I'd suggest waiting until a full month has passed before considering it!

Title: Tourist Rides 'Unlicensed Tricycle' and Gets Disfigured Content: □ Evening News reporter Guo Yu reported that after a late-night outing and missing the last subway, Mr. Jiang and his female companion were persuaded to get on a tricycle by its owner. A conflict ensued due to a disagreement over the fare, resulting in Mr. Jiang receiving about 10 stitches on his face, leaving him 'disfigured'. Regarding this, the Huangpu District traffic management department stated that there are indeed a small number of 'unlicensed vehicles' near the Nanjing East Road subway station. The traffic management department has conducted multiple crackdowns, but with little success, as many unlicensed vehicle owners play 'cat and mouse' with the traffic police. However, they indicated they will increase enforcement efforts. Tourist: Assaulted by Tricycle Owner Late at Night Mr. Jiang, from Guizhou, came to Shanghai for tourism with his female companion. On the evening of the 20th, they were sightseeing near the Nanjing East Road pedestrian street. Captivated by the night scenery, they lost track of time. When they arrived at the Nanjing East Road subway station to take the subway, they found that subway operations had ended for the day. Unfamiliar with the area, they also couldn't find a taxi. As they were hesitating, a tricycle pulled up and persuaded them to get on. 'The driver asked for 50 yuan, I bargained down to 40 yuan,' Mr. Jiang recalled. After he told the owner the destination, the owner quoted 50 yuan. Mr. Jiang felt the price was too high and was reluctant to take the ride. 'That person seemed a bit unwilling, but probably because it was already early morning and there wasn't much business, he reluctantly agreed to 40 yuan,' Mr. Jiang said. He and his companion then got on the tricycle. Mr. Jiang said that after the vehicle had traveled only about 50 meters, the tricycle owner stopped and demanded 50 yuan, refusing to continue otherwise. 'We just agreed on 40 yuan, how can you go back on your word!' Mr. Jiang was furious. Subsequently, an argument broke out between the two parties, escalating into a physical fight. Mr. Jiang said his face was injured, with a cut from the corner of his mouth to his cheek that required about 10 stitches afterwards. Scene: Motorcycle Taxis Solicit Passengers on Pedestrian Street Exit 3 of Nanjing East Road subway station is a gathering place for motorcycle taxis and tricycles, with dozens of vehicles shuttling back and forth daily to pick up passengers. Around 9 PM last night, the owners were still busy. 'The Bund, City God Temple; The Bund, City God Temple...' one owner shouted repeatedly. Not far away, five or six vehicles were parked by the roadside, and a few more were on the pedestrian street, including tricycles and motorcycle taxis. 'How much to City God Temple?' a reporter inquired. '10 yuan!' A owner near the subway exit immediately approached, almost grabbing the reporter's arm. Posing as a tourist, the reporter asked the driver about the locations of the Bund and City God Temple. 'No matter where it is, I'll take you there for 10 yuan,' the owner said readily, while pulling the reporter onto the motorcycle taxi. At the same time, a nearby tricycle started up. Besides the driver, there were three passengers on the tricycle: two middle-aged men sitting on the back seat, and a young man sitting next to the driver. The tricycle wobbled as it moved, making one nervous. 'Such a small vehicle is already struggling with two people; carrying three is very dangerous,' the motorcycle taxi driver carrying the reporter criticized the tricycle for overloading and being unsafe. Traffic Police: Continue to Increase Enforcement Efforts 'This is an old problem,' a police officer from the Huangpu District Traffic Police Brigade said regarding the 'unlicensed vehicles' near Nanjing East Road subway station, also admitting that the work is challenging. He explained that the traffic management department has conducted multiple crackdowns in this area, but with limited effect. It is understood that the concentration of tricycles and motorcycle taxis around Nanjing East Road subway station is related to its special geographical location. Passengers heading to tourist spots like the Bund and City God Temple usually take the subway to this station. However, the station is about a 10-minute walk from both the Bund and City God Temple, creating a market for motorcycle taxis and tricycles. With the adjustment of Line 10's operating hours, Nanjing East Road Station has gradually become a very busy station. The increase in passenger flow has led to a recent rise in such vehicles. The officer said that currently, there indeed exists a small number of unlicensed vehicles. They take advantage of times when traffic police are absent or during shift changes to solicit passengers, which can inevitably lead to disputes, or even conflicts, with passengers. Regarding this, the officer stated that they will continue to strengthen patrols and crack down on the illegal solicitation of passengers by unlicensed vehicles. At the same time, he reminded everyone not to choose unlicensed vehicles for the sake of temporary convenience, especially at night, when one should be even more cautious.

Title: When asked a question you don't know the answer to in a graduate school interview, should you 'rack your brains to answer' or directly request 'I don't know, can I have another question?' Content: Obviously, you should choose the 'rack your brains' response rather than directly requesting to change the question. However, how to rack your brains is quite nuanced. First, making things up on the spot, pretending to know when you don't, and forcefully saving face are definitely not acceptable. The interviewers you are facing are experts in the field, and they can tell within a couple of sentences if you are talking nonsense. Therefore, the correct approach is: First, be honest that you are not familiar with the question. This demonstrates honesty, the most important foundation for academic research – knowing what you know and knowing to verify what you don't. Next, it's about showcasing your thought process for encountering difficulties and solving problems. If it's a conceptual question, you can make an educated guess based on the literal meaning in the relevant field, and then the key is to emphasize how you would subsequently verify whether your guess is correct. This is actually the norm in academic research. If it's an analytical question, then list your logical reasoning step by step, including the inference and progression between each point, and again, you need to emphasize how you would verify these logics and relationships. (If you don't know how to reason, it's recommended to look at how deepseek thinks through problems when encountering them). This entire response should take about 5-10 minutes and has many benefits: First, it actively demonstrates your scientific literacy. Graduate students are not know-it-alls; it's normal not to know something. However, not knowing and not actively trying to figure it out is a major flaw. Therefore, directly asking to change a question is never the right attitude. Second, it reflects your logical thinking and critical reasoning abilities, which are also important foundations for academic research. A student who actively thinks but has knowledge gaps is definitely better than a student who knows everything but doesn't use their brain. Third, it puts you in control. The interview is essentially a process of getting to know you. If you fully demonstrate yourself with one question, and the time is mostly used up, the interviewers' subsequent questions will likely become simpler and more 'perfunctory'. On the other hand, if you give up on the first question, you'll enter hard mode. You'll become more nervous, and the interviewer will likely ask more questions to try to understand you... Finally, if there really is an interviewer who just wants to test your specific knowledge points, who wants to see you recite concepts perfectly without caring about your thought process, then congratulations – avoid such a teacher quickly. They are most likely a master of PUA, because they only want to find a laborer, not mentor a student...
