Title: How long after a cat scratch should you get a vaccination?_Baidu Knows Content: In this situation, it's best to get the shot within 72 hours. This effectively avoids later infections and complications, so it's better to get vaccinated as soon as possible. As the two most beloved companion animals globally, cats and dogs have become members of human families. Cats, with their graceful bodies, beautiful eyes, and agile movements, are deeply cherished by humans. When people talk about cats, they generally believe that catching mice is a cat's inherent duty. Other characteristics often mentioned include cats being "greedy." In reality, through thousands of years of evolution, domestic cats have developed a series of physical characteristics and behavioral patterns, some of which are still very similar to wild cats. Although different breeds and individual cats have their corresponding breed or individual characteristics, as an animal, the typical behavioral traits of a cat are: intelligence, solitary nature, selfishness, and a tendency towards jealousy. Cats are smart and have high intelligence. They quickly adapt to their living environment and can use household fixtures, such as correctly using a litter box, turning water dispensers on and off, discerning human attitudes and behaviors, and even anticipating certain events, like their owner going out. These traits are due to cats having well-developed cerebral hemispheres and a relatively complete cerebral cortex. Kittens rely on the help of their mother and owner before five months of age because their brains are not fully developed. Adult cats, however, have extremely strong memories. After one visit to the vet for a shot, they become very nervous on subsequent visits. It's quite common for them to find their way home over distances of dozens of kilometers. Cats can also anticipate certain natural phenomena, such as earthquakes. Independence and a naturally solitary nature are characteristics formed during the long evolutionary process of cats. In the wild, cats are primarily solitary creatures, only coming together during breeding season. Therefore, domestic cats retain this nature, exhibiting wariness and solitude, and prefer to establish their own territory within their home environment, not welcoming other cats. After giving birth, a mother cat can raise her kittens independently without relying too much on the owner. The nature of cats determines that they prefer outdoor activities, refuse to do things they dislike, and resist forced behavior. This suggests that cat owners should first build trust with their cat, treat it well, and coexist peacefully to gain the cat's acceptance and "friendship." Expecting blind obedience from a cat is unrealistic. When we say cats are selfish, we should consider this a need and result of their natural survival. Long-term survival in the wild and harsh natural conditions have led cats to develop a self-centered code of conduct; otherwise, they would be eliminated by natural selection. They adopt an attitude of "out of sight, out of mind." But once prey (like a mouse) appears, they swiftly attack and capture it. A strong sense of jealousy is a common trait in cats. If multiple cats are kept in one household, and the owner shows affection to or picks up one cat, the other cats often express dissatisfaction through sounds or destructive actions. This is a manifestation of the cat's concern for the owner's emotions and attitude towards it. Fully utilizing this characteristic is a means to cultivate the bond between human and cat.

Title: Xuefeng's Battle Against the 'Epidemic' with Blooming Branches—A Record of the Medical Team on the Clinical Frontline in the Xuefeng Ward of Dongkou County. Content: The Xuefeng Ward became the main battlefield for Dongkou County's fight against the COVID-19 pandemic. Red Net Moment, March 12 (Correspondents: Xie Dingju, Xiao Yuyao, Xiao Bin) 'Don't worry, after you are cured and discharged, multiple tests have shown that your nucleic acid is negative. After a few more days of observation, you can leave the observation ward!' On March 11, in the observation ward of the Xuefeng Street Health Service Center in Dongkou County, Xiao Jinping and Liu Shefu once again provided psychological counseling to a cured confirmed patient to ensure the patient's emotional stability. At the end of the year and the beginning of the new year, COVID-19 raged. On January 22, the Infectious Diseases Department of Dongkou County People's Hospital admitted the first fever patient returning from Wuhan, marking the start of the battle against the epidemic in Xuefeng. On February 1, based on the needs of prevention and control, the county transferred the Second Infectious Diseases Department of the County People's Hospital to the Xuefeng Street Health Service Center and renamed it the Xuefeng Ward (Second Ward) of the Infectious Diseases Department. From then on, the Xuefeng Ward became the main battlefield for the county's fight against the COVID-19 pandemic. 'The Little One' Bravely Shoulders Heavy Responsibilities 'In critical times, we still need the 'little one' to shoulder the heavy load.' When establishing the Xuefeng Ward, the hospital leadership carefully selected a temporary head for the Infectious Diseases Department, and the 'little one' Xiao Jinping stood out. Xiao Jinping, a post-80s generation, is a attending physician who has worked in the Infectious Diseases Department for 7 years and specialized in advanced studies at the Infectious Diseases Department of Xiangya Second Hospital, possessing rich clinical experience. 'Don't let my small stature fool you; in the face of the epidemic, I am fearless and rise to the challenge.' Accepting the appointment in a crisis, Xiao Jinping signed a petition stating 'regardless of pay, regardless of life or death' and immediately rushed to the new battlefield. 'With a solid theoretical foundation, he always manages to present the dull knowledge of disinfection and isolation in an exciting and easy-to-understand manner.' After entering the Xuefeng Ward, Xiao Jinping immediately trained the other medical staff who entered the battlefield with him. Under Xiao Jinping's leadership, everyone quickly set about coordinating the work between the isolation ward, the People's Hospital, and the County CDC. 'Whenever there is a new patient or an emergency, he always charges to the front.' One late night, a confirmed patient needed to be transferred to a higher-level hospital immediately. To avoid disturbing everyone's rest, Xiao Jinping alone escorted the patient to a hospital in Shaoyang. By the time he returned, it was already 3 a.m. 'I am a Party member; I go first.' When a patient experienced difficulty breathing, Xiao Jinping carried a 150-jin oxygen tank and climbed to the second floor on foot, delivering the oxygen to the ward promptly. To better coordinate treatment, the Xuefeng Ward established a psychological counseling team, and Xiao Jinping proactively took on the role of psychological counselor. Whenever he noticed patients feeling depressed or restless, he would immediately provide psychological counseling. When the COVID-19 pandemic struck, Liu Shefu was the first to step forward. 'The Great Hero' Goes to Battle Again 'I am a Communist Party member, have been the director of the Infectious Diseases Department for many years, and participated in the fight against SARS. It's only natural that I take responsibility.' Upon learning that a special Xuefeng Ward for admitting fever patients was to be established, Liu Shefu, over fifty years old, proactively volunteered. Liu Shefu, a Communist Party member, deputy secretary of the Internal Medicine Party Branch, and director of the hospital's Infectious Diseases Department, participated in the 2003 SARS battle and is called the 'great hero' by his colleagues. When the COVID-19 pandemic struck, even as the hospital leadership was still formulating the anti-epidemic plan, Liu Shefu was the first to stand up. 'Let's form a team based on the original Infectious Diseases Department. Among the 15 members of the new team, 9 are Communist Party members. Party members must fully play their exemplary and leading roles; we can only add glory to the Party flag, and must never let the organization down!' Liu Shefu's proposal received unanimous support from everyone. On the 28th of the first lunar month, the county's first confirmed case appeared, casting a pall over the epidemic area, and the atmosphere during shift handovers became somewhat heavy. Liu Shefu raised his voice to encourage everyone: 'Don't panic. The appearance of a confirmed case is something we anticipated. We must despise the enemy strategically but take them seriously tactically. Starting today, I will lead the ward rounds; you follow me.' These brief words dispelled the gloom pervading the Infectious Diseases Department. 'Seeing Director Liu puts my mind at ease.' This is what patients said most often. After being diagnosed, patients often became mentally tense, emotional, and even uncooperative with treatment. At such times, Liu Shefu would always take the initiative to communicate with the patients, educate them about prevention and treatment knowledge, and even prioritize giving the comfort items intended for the medical staff in the isolation ward to the patients. When the Xuefeng Ward was being established, Liu Shefu encouraged the worried Xiao Jinping: 'What are you afraid of? You are an attending physician and have worked in the infectious diseases department for years; your skills are solid. The key is that you are a Communist Party member, politically reliable. If you encounter difficulties, I'm here for you.' Xiao Jinping happily accepted the task. Working Together to Achieve Victory. 'The Veteran Nurse' Leads by Example. Sweat soaked through the protective clothing, fog obscured the goggles, and talcum powder chafed the calloused hands. Tired, she would lean against the wall for a short rest; weary, she would rest her head on the edge of the table and close her eyes... Her name is Liu Yanmei, the head nurse of the Infectious Diseases Department. In the isolation ward, Liu Yanmei carried disinfectant and shuttled between the wards every day. 'I'm over 50 years old; I need to play a role in mentoring and guiding the younger generation. I must do first what I require the young nurses to do.' When the department was first established, Liu Yanmei gathered all the necessary supplies for the department in just half a day, without any slackness despite being the head nurse. 'To save protective clothing, she, who already had a chronic stomach condition, insisted on eating lunch at 3 p.m. or simply skipped it. Sometimes the pain made her roll around in bed, but the next day she would appear on time at the shift handover meeting.' Speaking of the head nurse, post-90s nurse Lei Li felt heartache. Inspired by Liu Yanmei, Lei Li resolutely left her two-year-old child with her parents and proactively requested to join the frontline. Her lover was also fighting on the epidemic prevention frontline. The hospital, considering her special circumstances, had initially politely refused her request. 'The head nurse set an example for us; I am unwavering.' After coming to the Xuefeng Ward, every time Lei Li called her family and heard her babbling child call out 'Mom,' tears would well up in the corners of her eyes. At such times, this strong post-90s woman would wipe away her tears and playfully tease the child: 'Be good, baby! Wait for Mom to finish fighting the monster and then come home...' 'I will not withdraw from the battle until the epidemic retreats.' Luo Dexin, also a post-90s young man, usually cheerful, was unequivocal in the face of the epidemic. He escorted confirmed patients to the designated hospital in Shaoyang twice and proactively took on the follow-up work for discharged patients. When asked why everyone else wanted to go home, but he chose to stay, he shyly said: 'I'm not married, have no ties, I'm young, full of energy, and I can persevere.' 'Mentoring' in the Battle Against the Epidemic, Working Together to Achieve Victory. In the Xuefeng Ward, there were many more beautiful anti-epidemic warriors坚守ing silently: Deng Wei, a father of two, proactively submitted a petition when the ward urgently needed a radiologist; Peng Meihua, leaving her newlywed husband of just two months to rush to the frontline; Wang Fei, who admitted 12 fever patients during one night shift and still proactively escorted a confirmed patient for transfer the next day; Yuan Jie, who rushed back overnight from visiting his in-laws to join the frontline... 'In this world, there is no such thing as tranquil times, nor are there any angels in white. They are just a group of children who changed into different clothes, learning from their predecessors' examples and rushing along the path of fighting the epidemic.' It is precisely this group of ordinary medical staff who, with their original aspiration and mission, and their benevolent hearts as healers, guard the safety of the people at the foot of Xuefeng Mountain. Title: "Things About Recruitment in Xi'an Public Tertiary Hospitals" Content: Recently, I've seen some public tertiary hospitals in Xi'an recruiting, and I'd like to chat with everyone about the situation regarding this. Public tertiary hospitals in Xi'an hold a pivotal position in the medical field, providing high-quality medical services to the general public. Naturally, the recruitment processes of these hospitals attract significant attention. Let's first talk about the issue of fees, which many people might be concerned about. Generally speaking, during a formal recruitment process, hospitals will not charge any unreasonable fees. If a recruiter asks job applicants to pay fees under various pretexts, you should be highly vigilant, as it's likely a scam. [I've heard of cases where people were cheated out of money by fake recruitment information during their job search, so everyone must be cautious.] Recruitment for Xi'an's public tertiary hospitals is often highly competitive. This is because they represent a higher platform, better development opportunities, and broader career prospects. These hospitals usually openly recruit various medical professionals from the public, including doctors, nurses, pharmacists, technicians, etc. Regarding the recruitment process, it generally involves steps such as posting announcements, registration, qualification review, written exams, interviews, and medical examinations. Each step is crucial and requires serious attention from the applicant. The written exam primarily tests professional knowledge and related abilities, while the interview focuses more on comprehensive qualities and adaptability. For job seekers, to stand out in the recruitment process for Xi'an's public tertiary hospitals, thorough preparation is necessary. First, ensure you possess solid professional knowledge and skills, and continuously improve your professional level. Second, exercise your communication and teamwork skills, which are very important in medical work. [For example, when dealing with patients and their families, good communication skills can better build trust and understanding.] At the same time, applicants should also pay attention to the channels through which recruitment information is released. Typically, hospitals will post recruitment announcements on their official websites, recruitment websites, and relevant media. Obtain information promptly and register on time to avoid missing opportunities. Furthermore, during the preparation process, you can learn more about the hospital's culture and values to better adapt to the work environment. Understanding the hospital's key departments and special projects can also help demonstrate your interest and enthusiasm during the interview. From the hospital's perspective, recruiting the right talent is crucial. They hope to find employees who are not only highly skilled professionally but also possess a strong sense of responsibility and dedication. After all, medical work concerns the life and health of patients and cannot tolerate the slightest carelessness. In summary, recruitment for Xi'an's public tertiary hospitals is a rigorous and important process. For job seekers, it is a rare opportunity but also requires effort and hard work. At the same time, applicants must remain vigilant and not be deceived by some fake recruitment information. I believe that as long as everyone prepares thoroughly, they have the opportunity to find their own stage in Xi'an's public tertiary hospitals and contribute their strength to the medical cause. Let's work hard for our dreams together! I hope this article can be helpful to friends who are currently paying attention to recruitment in Xi'an's public tertiary hospitals.

Title: In-depth Analysis! The Syndrome Differentiation and Medication Approach of Guizhi Fuling Wan Content: Hey everyone, Guizhi Fuling Wan from "Shang Han Lun" is considered a classic famous formula. Today, let's follow three renowned Traditional Chinese Medicine masters—Ni Haixia, Hu Xishu, and Huang Huang—to see how they approach its syndrome differentiation and rational medication. 💡 Ni Haixia's Syndrome Differentiation and Medication Approach Master Ni believes that Guizhi Fuling Wan primarily targets symptoms of blood stasis and obstruction. During differentiation, if a patient has a mass in the lower abdomen that is painful upon pressure, and if a woman has dark purple menstrual clots, irregular periods, combined with a purplish-dark tongue and distended sublingual veins, it can basically be judged that this formula is applicable. In terms of medication, Master Ni emphasizes the combination of doses, with cinnamon twig (Guizhi), poria (Fuling), moutan bark (Danpi), peach kernel (Taoren), and peony root (Shaoyao) working synergistically to unblock blood vessels and dissipate masses. He often fine-tunes the dosage based on the patient's specific symptoms, such as increasing the amount of peach kernel and moutan bark for severe blood stasis. 💡 Hu Xishu's Syndrome Differentiation and Medication Approach Master Hu bases his approach on Six Channel syndrome differentiation. He points out that when there is acute tension and fullness in the lower abdomen, accompanied by irregular menstruation, dysmenorrhea, and the patient's constitution tends to be deficient and cold, with manifestations like cold hands and feet, it is mostly a Guizhi Fuling Wan syndrome. In terms of medication, Master Hu pays great attention to the proportion between the herbs, believing that the original formula's ratio has its subtleties and should not be changed lightly. At the same time, he emphasizes caution when making modifications based on the syndrome; for example, if the patient also has an exterior syndrome, he would appropriately combine herbs to release the exterior, but never disrupt the core efficacy of the original formula. 💡 Huang Huang's Syndrome Differentiation and Medication Approach Teacher Huang Huang starts from the constitution theory. Patients with a "Cinnamon Twig Constitution" (slender build, delicate skin, prone to spontaneous sweating and fear of wind) and a "Blood Stasis Constitution" (dark complexion and lips, rough skin with ecchymosis, purplish tongue), who have gynecological diseases such as uterine fibroids or ovarian cysts, are very suitable for Guizhi Fuling Wan. In terms of medication, Teacher Huang focuses on overall regulation, often combined with dietary therapy and lifestyle adjustments. For example, having the patient appropriately consume foods that invigorate blood and resolve stasis, while paying attention to keeping warm and strengthening their constitution to enhance the medicine's effect. Overall, the three masters' approaches to syndrome differentiation have their own emphases, and their medication methods are also unique. When we study and apply Guizhi Fuling Wan, we should refer to them comprehensively and apply them flexibly according to the patient's specific situation. But remember, TCM medication requires caution; it's best to do it under the guidance of a professional physician! Everyone, which master's approach are you more interested in? Title: Dialogue with UChicago Offer Recipient: Why Continue Applying to Graduate School After Getting a Full-time Offer from JPM? Content: Regarding the question of whether to work or apply to graduate school after undergraduate studies, students always ask this during our seminars. We have answered it many times, generally recommending pursuing both graduate school applications and job hunting simultaneously, then making a decision based on your background and the outcomes. But what if you actually receive an offer from a top-tier company? Today's interview guest is precisely such a practitioner who was already working full-time at J.P. Morgan. Now, he has successfully received multiple offers, including one from the University of Chicago's MScA program. Sanmu's 2023 "Special Project for US Undergraduates Applying to US Graduate Schools" officially begins! Why continue applying to graduate school after getting a full-time offer from JPM? How to achieve success in both work and studies? Morgan Offers Received: University of Chicago MScA (U.S. News 6) 1. Please briefly introduce yourself. Hello everyone, I have been working full-time at JPM for ten months now as a Product Control Analyst. I just received an offer for UChicago's MScA program with the help of Teacher Sanmu. 2. How did you get the full-time offer from J.P. Morgan? I didn't have a very high GPA, and my undergraduate institution wasn't ideal. I think getting the full-time offer was mainly due to participating in many Career Fairs, which greatly improved my interview skills. Secondly, during my undergraduate studies, I often sought advice from seniors and predecessors, who provided me with a lot of help, allowing me to avoid pitfalls and not encounter major difficulties in my job search. Additionally, during my job search, I found that even without extensive internship experience, Certificates obtained through Coursera online courses can be used to enrich your resume. If you don't have an outstanding background, you can try starting from this angle. Certificate examples. 3. Why apply for a master's degree when you already have such a good job? Applying for a master's is mainly due to Peer Pressure. Most people around me have master's degrees, and there are many colleagues who graduated from Top 10 schools. Working in such an environment, I naturally hope to obtain a Top School diploma to enhance my competitiveness in future job searches. At the same time, applying for a master's also adds more possibilities to my career development, rather than being confined to the finance industry; I can try to do more things I enjoy. 4. Where did you see us, and why did you choose Sanmu for your application? I saw you on Jinri Toutiao. I chose Sanmu partly because consultant Teacher Bonnie happened to be my senior, so it's understandable that she is very familiar with the programs my background qualifies me for. My first impression of her and Sanmu was very good. On the other hand, during our interactions, I found Sanmu to be very professional, especially the writing skills of the document teachers. The communication was also very comfortable and full of humanity. I think the personal statement played a very significant role in my admission to UChicago. 5. What obstacles did you encounter when applying to graduate programs? The main obstacles occurred in the early stages of application. Since I work during the day, I could only squeeze out some time at night, lacking sufficient time and energy to prepare the application. Moreover, I didn't know the Prerequisites for programs at different schools, which programs suited me, or how to demonstrate my abilities in the essays. This was why I wanted to seek help from an agency. These problems were all resolved after signing with Sanmu. 6. Are there any other memorable stories with Sanmu? The memorable thing was spending a relatively long time with Teacher Bonnie on school selection, understanding which schools were suitable for me. Bonnie really knows a lot about master's programs and provided many suggestions when I was determining my target schools. The University of Chicago places great importance on academic ability, and I think the personal statement is particularly crucial. Teacher Emma, who was responsible for my essays, has exceptional writing skills. She always listened carefully to my needs, understood my ideas, and used her professional knowledge and experience to write excellent application essays for me, expressing my stories and thoughts very vividly and attractively. Moreover, not only was the quality high, but the efficiency was also high. I am truly grateful. To be honest, there aren't many other memorable stories because the entire application process was very smooth (really). I am very grateful for the help from all the teachers at Sanmu, which enabled me to be admitted to my desired school. I am very satisfied with this application. The curriculum emphasizes practical application and is more quantitative compared to general finance or business analytics. Title: Over 70% of Residents Are Pessimistic About the Property Market! Is There No More Universal Price Increase in the Property Market? Content: Recently, the central government released the 'Second Quarter Urban Depositors Questionnaire Survey Report,' which is quite interesting. Let's take a look at the public's expectations for future housing prices: 25.5% expect an increase, 52.3% expect them to remain basically unchanged, 10% expect a decrease, and 12.2% are uncertain. In other words, over 70% of the public are not optimistic about real estate. Hey, haven't Chinese people always believed in the myth that 'housing prices only rise and never fall'? Why is this happening? A report on real estate loans published by the Economic Daily might answer this question. It mentioned that all five major indicators of real estate finance have shown a continuous decline, with the growth rate of real estate loans hitting a new low in nearly eight years. Details are as follows: So, behind the 'five continuous declines and an eight-year low,' are housing prices really going to fall? Let's first extend the timeline to the past eight years and look at the data from the central bank's 'Statistical Report on Loans of Financial Institutions.' In addition to real estate loans and personal housing loans, I also selected data on household loans and household business loans, with only the first quarter data available for 2021. It can be seen that the growth rates of real estate loans and personal housing loans in the first quarter of this year indeed hit a new low in nearly eight years. Specifically, the growth rate of real estate loans dropped to 10.9%, a decrease of 0.8 percentage points from last year. The growth rate of personal housing loans dropped to 14.5%, a decrease of 0.1 percentage points from last year. However, when compared to the GDP growth rate over the past eight years, it can be found that even though these two sets of data have declined, they still outperformed the economy. Since last year's GDP growth rate was not announced, I used the two-year average growth rate of 5% for the first quarter of this year. As shown in the figure below, over the past eight years, the growth rates of real estate loans and personal loans have generally been 2-3 times the GDP growth rate. In a booming property market year like 2016, it even reached 4-5 times. If we shift our focus to household loans and household business loans, the situation is completely different. In the first quarter of this year, the growth rate of household loans reached 16.3%, higher than in 2019 and 2020, basically returning to the levels of 2014 and 2015, and did not hit a new low in nearly eight years. As for household business loans, the growth rate in the first quarter of this year was even more exaggerated, reaching an astonishing 24.6%, hitting a new high in nearly eight years. Everyone knows that since last year, there have been constant news reports about business loans illegally flowing into the property market, especially in hot cities like Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Xiamen. Business loans have largely become a catalyst for soaring housing prices. This is because using business loans to buy houses is really cost-effective. Compared to commercial mortgage interest rates of over 5% or even breaking 6%, business loan interest rates are usually below 4%, which can save tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of yuan in interest. Isn't that attractive? However, this year is different. Starting from the first quarter, regulatory authorities have taken serious action, and various regions are investigating business loans. Some have dealt with it perfunctorily and were required to conduct a second self-inspection, while others have been strict with themselves. As for how many cities have violations and how many business loans have illegally flowed into the property market, there is no convincing final result yet. From the above four major indicators, two signals can be identified: 1. Leveraged home buying is still continuing but has slowed down. Combined with recent targeted interest rate hikes, suspension of second-hand housing loans, and extended loan cycles, the growth rates of real estate loans and personal loans are expected to decline further in the short term. 2. The growth rates of household loans and business loans have increased instead of decreasing, attracting regulatory attention and leading to precise crackdowns, resulting in reduced funds in the property market. In the short term, the momentum for housing price increases in hot cities will further weaken. Therefore, it is precisely because of the tightening of funding and the increasing difficulty of leveraged home buying that most people's expectations and home-buying plans have changed. Of course, you could also argue that more and more people are realizing the impact of monetary policy on housing prices. Coincidentally, the recently released 'June National安居Index Report' for 2021 also shows: In June, national home search热度decreased by 3.7% month-on-month. The home search热度in first-tier cities decreased by 8.3% month-on-month, in second-tier cities by 2.9%, and in third- and fourth-tier cities by 3.3%. The home buyer confidence index in June also dropped to 106.6, a decrease of 4.35% month-on-month. But anyway, I think the tightening of real estate loans is always temporary, and there's no need to worry too much. After all, the top level just doesn't want housing prices to rise so quickly, not to kill them outright. As long as we get through the darkness before dawn, there will naturally be a new atmosphere. Title: The number of people taking the postgraduate entrance exam has dropped so much, has the difficulty of getting in become lower? Content: In recent years, the number of people taking the postgraduate entrance exam has indeed decreased somewhat. But to say that the difficulty of the exam has consequently lowered, that's really not very scientific. We have to understand that when it comes to the postgraduate exam, you can't just look at the big overall number; you have to focus on the specific school and major you want to go to. Think about it, for each school and each major, how many people they recruit, where the cutoff score is set – these are the things that truly determine how difficult the exam is for you. You can't just see that the total number has decreased and think you can get in easily; that won't work. When preparing for the exam, you need to carefully consider the situation of the school and major you're targeting. You need to be clear about the admissions policy, how many people were admitted in previous years, what the score lines were. This way, you can assess your own capabilities and formulate a suitable preparation plan, so you don't end up busy for nothing. Also, after the initial written exam, don't think everything is settled. You need to reassess based on your exam performance and see if you need to adjust your application choices. If you find you didn't perform as well as expected, or if the competition for your desired place is too fierce, then you should consider switching to a slightly less competitive school or major to increase your chances of admission. So, the postgraduate exam is not a simple task. You need to consider all aspects and be flexible in your response. Don't just focus on the big number; get specific about your target and analyze it properly. Only then can you find your own path in this fierce competition and have hope of realizing your dream. In short, on the road to the postgraduate exam, we need to be careful, pay more attention to the details, and not accidentally miss any important information. This way we can advance steadily and step by step towards success.

Title: A golden retriever taking shelter from the heat in a restaurant in Yongzhou was allegedly beaten to death; local police have intervened. What are your views on pets entering restaurants? What legal responsibilities should be borne for animal abuse? Content: From a legal perspective, this matter has nothing to do with animal abuse because there are no relevant provisions on animal abuse in our country's laws. It also has nothing to do with pets, cats, dogs, or humanity, as these are not legal concepts. This is about the property rights of the dog owner and the issue of necessity for the person who beat the dog. It is undisputed that the dog is the property of the owner. Killing someone else's dog causes property loss to that person, which is easy to understand. However, causing property loss does not necessarily entail legal liability. The first thing to determine is whether the person who beat the dog acted out of necessity. This involves three considerations: first, the urgency—whether the dog was attacking people in the restaurant or damaging property; second, the necessity—whether killing the dog was the only way to protect the people and property on site; and third, a comparison of interests—weighing the potential harm the dog might cause against the value of the dog. If necessity is established, the person who beat the dog bears no liability. Otherwise, they may be liable for civil compensation or even criminal liability, especially since the dog is not cheap. Of course, the dog owner was at fault in this incident for failing to properly restrain the dog, allowing it to run loose. Therefore, even if the person who beat the dog did not act out of necessity or acted inappropriately, their legal liability could be reduced to some extent. Based on this, my judgment in this case is that since there is sufficient evidence indicating the dog was not aggressive toward humans and no evidence proving the dog attacked people in the restaurant or damaged property (if there were, the restaurant owner would have already produced the surveillance footage), the person who beat the dog did not act out of necessity and should bear legal liability for intentionally damaging another person's property. However, since the dog owner, the victim in this case, was clearly at fault, and the value of the dog is barely at the threshold for criminal liability, it is unlikely that the person who beat the dog will face criminal prosecution. The matter will likely be resolved through civil compensation.

Title: Do fraudsters really prefer going to jail over returning the money? Content: It's not that fraudsters prefer going to jail over returning the money. In many cases, some fraudsters may not have the ability to repay the money at the moment. There are also some fraudsters who have a侥幸心理, feeling that since the money is already in their hands, even if they go to jail, they don't want to give it back. Additionally, after being arrested, the judicial process mainly focuses on punishing the criminal behavior, and repaying the money may not be the fraudster's priority during this process. However, you can file an incidental civil action during the criminal proceedings to demand the other party to return the money. If the other party has executable property, the court can compensate for your losses through compulsory enforcement.

Title: Refusing to Execute Judgment and Transferring Property Leads to Criminal Sentence Content: After owing money to someone, instead of urgently repaying the debt, he tried every means to transfer property under his name, transferring a car to his son. On October 12, 2016, Zhang was punished by law for the suspected crime of refusing to execute a judgment or ruling. On March 16, 2015, the Mizhi Court ruled that Zhang must repay Feng 400,000 RMB plus interest. Zhang appealed, but the Yulin City Intermediate People's Court rejected the appeal and upheld the original judgment. The Yulin City Intermediate People's Court legally served the judgment document to Zhang on May 3, 2016, and Zhang signed to confirm receipt. On May 9, 2016, Zhang transferred a Toyota compact SUV under his name to his son. The prosecution authority believed that Zhang had the ability to repay but refused to execute the People's Court's judgment, with serious circumstances. His actions had violated the provisions of Article 313 of the "Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China". The criminal facts were clear, and the evidence was conclusive and sufficient. He should be investigated for criminal responsibility for the crime of refusing to execute a judgment or ruling. In accordance with the provisions of Article 172 of the "Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China", a public prosecution was initiated, requesting a lawful sentence. It is understood that the applicant for execution applied to the Mizhi County People's Court for execution. After the Mizhi County People's Court accepted the case, it issued an execution notice on May 24, 2016, ordering the defendant Zhang to fulfill the judgment obligations within three days of receiving the notice. The defendant still did not fulfill the effective judgment content. However, in order to evade the debt, Zhang transferred a Toyota compact SUV to his son's name on May 9, 2016, and the license plate number was also changed. During the trial of this case, Zhang fulfilled the obligations determined in the civil judgment document, paid off the debt, and repaid the money advanced by others. He expressed remorse and pleaded guilty in court. Zhang disregarded the effective judgment document of the People's Court. After the execution notice was issued, he turned a deaf ear. In order to evade the debt, he transferred property. He had the ability to repay but refused to fulfill his obligations, and the circumstances were serious. His actions constituted the crime of refusing to execute a judgment or ruling. The criminal facts and charges accused by the prosecution authority were clear and established, and were supported. Considering that Zhang truthfully confessed his crime during the investigation stage, voluntarily pleaded guilty during the trial, and fulfilled the content determined by the People's Court's judgment document, repaid the debt, and did not cause economic losses to others, he could be given a lighter punishment. In accordance with the provisions of the "Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China", Zhang was sentenced for the crime of refusing to execute a judgment or ruling: six months of criminal detention, with a one-year probation declared, and a fine of 10,000 RMB. Comment: Repaying a debt is a matter of course. Not repaying and even transferring property will definitely be punished by law.

Title: Why do many people not take the civil service exam for urban areas, but instead take the exam for township civil service? Content: Firstly, the vast majority want to go to urban areas because of better benefits, better working environment, better resources, and convenient living conditions. However, the difficulty of passing the exam is high, competition is fierce, and requirements are strict. Among candidates who meet the application conditions, many have taken the exam multiple times over several years without success, leading to significant pressure. Therefore, to secure a position ('get ashore'), they choose township positions. Township positions are more numerous, have lower application requirements, all civil servants have administrative编制 (bianzhi), promotion is faster, and those with connections can even transfer back to the urban area.

Title: Take my advice, the simpler the formaldehyde removal in summer, the sooner you can move in! Content: Summer is the golden period for formaldehyde removal. My family started removing formaldehyde in early June, and now we have already moved into our new home. This was all done by following the methods shared by experienced Xiaohongshu users. It only took one month to reduce the formaldehyde level to 0.04. ☑️ Here's some popular science on the safe formaldehyde occupancy standard: a formaldehyde concentration ≤0.08mg/m³ is safe for occupancy! If there are pregnant women or children at home, it is recommended to wait until the formaldehyde level is ≤0.06mg/m³ before moving in ❗ Precautions before formaldehyde removal: 🔸 Do not rush to open windows for ventilation immediately after renovation. Wait about 15 days for the latex paint to dry, then use the 'close-up and release' ventilation method to prevent wall cracks. 🔸 Before removing formaldehyde, wipe the dust off furniture with a clean cloth (to avoid affecting the removal efficiency due to dust). 🔸 Be sure to remove the plastic film from furniture before formaldehyde removal to prevent the formaldehyde inside from being trapped and accumulating. 🔸 Formaldehyde can be released continuously for 3-15 years. Hiring a formaldehyde removal company only offers quick short-term results, and there's no guarantee it won't rebound after moving in. ☑️ Specific formaldehyde removal steps: ⭐ Accelerate formaldehyde release: 🔹 Turn on the air conditioner in heating mode to raise the temperature above 28°C (not necessary now as temperatures are high, just focus on humidification). I didn't buy a humidifier; I sprinkled some water on the floor and then placed bowls of water around. 🔹 After the temperature and humidity rise, keep the doors and windows closed for about 5 hours, then open them for ventilation. ⭐ Decompose water-soluble formaldehyde: 🔹 For surfaces like cabinets and large items like sofas, I usually wipe them and then spray a layer of Dingluo photocatalyst, basically maintaining a frequency of once every two days. It can penetrate into the interior of the furnishings to decompose formaldehyde without leaving residual pollution. I used less than one bottle, and the formaldehyde level dropped by more than half. 🔹 Wash fabric items like bedsheets and sofa covers before use. For items that cannot be washed, I use a steamer to steam them at high temperature, which also helps release and dissolve formaldehyde. ⭐ Expel and adsorb formaldehyde from dead spots: 🔹 Except on rainy days, I keep the windows open for ventilation. In rooms with poor ventilation, like side bedrooms, I place a fan blowing towards the window to create air convection, which is more effective. 🔹 Customized wooden furniture easily creates ventilation dead spots. You also shouldn't point a fan directly at the furniture. I placed several packs of Luomi'en nano mineral crystal activated carbon in every corner. This material can adsorb and decompose formaldehyde long-term, doesn't saturate, and won't cause secondary pollution. I haven't touched them since moving in, and when I tested again two weeks later, the formaldehyde had dropped to 0.04. 🔔 Preparations before formaldehyde testing: 1. Before testing, remove items that could affect the results (leftover renovation materials, air fresheners, etc.). Keep the indoor temperature between 22°C and 28°C. 2. Close the room's doors and windows in advance; a sealing time of 12 hours is optimal. It is recommended to open wardrobe and cabinet doors during sealing. 💬 Based on my personal experience, this process for removing formaldehyde is really fast and effective. Those with formaldehyde removal needs can save this and give it a try.

Title: Do You Really Understand Stock Dividends? Not Understanding Can Lead to Big Losses, Read Here and You'll Fully Understand. Content: Stock dividends refer to listed companies distributing a portion of their profits to shareholders in the form of cash or additional shares. Cash stock dividends actually have pitfalls. If you don't understand them, not only might you not benefit from the profits, but you could even incur losses, especially when the market is poor, as dividends become less meaningful. Some people see a stock has a high dividend yield and decide to buy just before the ex-dividend date, intending to sell after the dividend is paid. This is where it's easy to lose money, because a 20% tax is levied. If the overall market is weak, the stock might not undergo 'filling the right' (price recovery after ex-dividend) at opening and could even fall sharply, leading to compounded losses. Below, I have compiled all the issues related to cash stock dividends. Study them carefully to avoid losses. Holding period <= 1 month: Dividends are subject to a 20% individual income tax rate. Holding period > 1 month and <= 1 year: Dividends are subject to a 10% individual income tax rate. Holding period > 1 year: Dividends are exempt from individual income tax. Important Notes: The holding period is calculated from the day you buy the stock, not from the dividend date. The end point is the time you sell the stock. The full dividend amount is credited to your account, but the income tax is deducted when you sell the stock. This point must be clear, otherwise, it's easy to get confused. Suppose an investor holds 10,000 shares, and the listed company issues a cash dividend of 3 yuan per 10 shares. The investor would receive a cash dividend of 3,000 yuan. If the investor sells the shares after holding them for 20 days, they need to pay 20% individual income tax, which is 600 yuan. If the investor sells after holding for 60 days, they need to pay 10% individual income tax, which is 300 yuan. The tax is calculated and deducted when selling the stock, based on the actual holding period to determine if additional tax is owed. The tax deducted is not simply personal income tax; the cash portion of the dividend is fully deposited into the account, and the tax deduction only appears when the stock is sold. After a cash dividend, the exchange will adjust the stock price (closing price) for ex-rights. Suppose Company A's stock price is 100 yuan, and a user holds 1 share. The company pays a cash dividend of 10 yuan per share. On the ex-dividend date, the stock price is adjusted to reflect the value distributed per share to shareholders. Generally, the adjusted price after ex-rights is calculated as follows: = Closing price - Dividend per share = 100 yuan - 10 yuan = 90 yuan. Meanwhile, the user's cash account increases by 10 yuan. Summary: Actually, dividends can be a pitfall. Profit is only realized if the stock price 'fills the right' (recovers); otherwise, it's just a numbers game. When the market is good, 'filling the right' generally happens easily, and dividends are quite beneficial. But when the market is poor, if the stock price doesn't recover and you still have to pay individual income tax, it becomes a trap.

Content Title: You must understand 'yield speed, not lane' when driving, otherwise it's better not to drive. Everyone should watch this, whether you have a car or not. Release Date: 2025-02-10 18:10:09 Content Status: Review Completed Content Type: Multimedia Industry: Digital Government Affairs_Government Media_Government Media Author Name: Haiyue Talks Cars Owner Name: Haiyue Talks Cars Content Account Type: Enterprise Content Details: Hello everyone, today let's talk about the topic of 'yield speed, not lane'. Many people say that 'yield speed, not lane' is generally an unwritten rule followed by truck drivers. For private car owners, it is actually very practical as well. Many people might think this is just an unsuccessful rule for truck drivers. After all, if an emergency occurs, if they change lanes quickly or turn the steering wheel sharply, it's very easy to cause a rollover, leading to greater losses and more danger. This also applies to family cars. Why? Because when our small vehicles are driving on city roads, there are often multiple lanes. If a situation occurs, for example, a car in front changes lanes directly into our lane, and this lane change is very close to us, it can easily create danger. Many people feel that we should quickly change lanes to avoid them, otherwise a collision will occur. If such a collision happens, it's likely we would be the rear vehicle hitting the front vehicle, making it entirely our fault. Actually, if you have a dashcam, in a situation like this where they make an emergency lane change, there's no need to worry at all. The fault lies entirely with them. If you take another approach, like making an emergency lane change to quickly avoid them, but if there are other vehicles beside us at that moment, whether you turn left or right, the vehicles on our left and right sides might collide with us. Then the fault would be entirely ours. So, originally it wasn't our fault, it was the other party's fault, but it becomes ours instead. Furthermore, if there are other vehicles beside us, the potential collision could be more severe and pose a greater threat to us. Therefore, everyone must keep this in mind. Even when driving a private car, 'yield speed, not lane' is very important. The best way is to slow down and brake. Emergency lane changes are truly not advisable. Of course, if you have better experiences in your daily life, please feel free to leave a comment below and let's share together. Okay, that's all for this video. See you next time. Title: The house has been sold, full payment made, notarized, why does the buyer still want the seller's bank card? Content: The buyer asking for the seller's bank card after the house has been fully paid for and notarized might be due to the following reasons: Ensuring transaction security: Even though the house has been fully paid for and the notarization is complete, there might be some subsequent potential risks, such as costs involved during the property handover. Having the seller's bank card held by a relevant party or under fund supervision can ensure controlled fund flow, avoiding transaction disputes or financial risks. Following transaction procedures and contract agreements: The transaction process might require the use of the seller's bank card to handle specific matters, such as refunding previously paid deposits or property management fees, ensuring traceable and standardized fund transfers. The contract might also explicitly stipulate the need to provide a bank card to protect the rights and interests of both parties throughout the transaction process, preventing unexpected issues due to payment problems and ensuring an orderly transaction. Bank or regulatory requirements: In some regions or for certain transactions, there might be bank fund supervision requirements, necessitating operations through a designated seller's bank card to ensure fund safety and legality. Handling outstanding matters: There might be some outstanding fees related to the house, such as refunds for water, electricity, gas fees, or handling of public maintenance funds. Using the seller's bank card facilitates unified settlement. The seller should handle this cautiously, communicate with the buyer and intermediaries to clarify the purpose, and if necessary, specify related risks and responsibilities in the contract.

Title: Postdoctoral doctors, media, and nutritionists believe that the iron released from cooking in an iron wok is ferric iron (Fe³⁺), saying that iron woks cannot supplement iron. However, my small experiment detected ferrous iron (Fe²⁺)? Content: Let me first explain the difference between iron supplements and consuming ferrous ions. Ferrous ions have a fatal flaw: they are very easily oxidized and hydrolyzed into ferric ions when exposed to oxygen. Therefore, chemical and industrial processes require protective measures. There are three main approaches: 1. Isolate from oxygen using a reducing atmosphere: add excess iron, protect with a nitrogen atmosphere, and finally make tablets, capsules, etc., which are all protective methods; 2. Isolate from water, meaning use oil or other components during synthesis and storage; 3. Form "chelates," where organic molecules form coordinate bonds with iron, making it difficult to oxidize. The cooking process completely fails to meet these three conditions, so once the food leaves the wok, ferrous iron will quickly be lost. Regarding the amount of iron filings from cooking, it is actually minimal. But if you insist on supplementing iron through an iron wok, I suggest not using vinegar. Just use a steel wool pad or sandpaper—force can work wonders. Because iron filings are not easily oxidized; they will be converted into ferrous iron by stomach acid in your stomach, without needing acetic acid as a middleman. Actually, this issue is simple: your experimental design for the iron wok cooking process differs from what experts consider the general iron wok cooking process. Let me briefly explain the transformation process of iron during general iron wok cooking: 1. The usual starting step for stir-frying is heating the wok, adding oil, and sautéing aromatics. This process involves stirring but occurs in an oily environment, and the oil temperature quickly rises to a suitable temperature above 150°C. Some iron might be scraped off, but this mainly depends on the maintenance of your wok, such as whether the surface is rough or rusty. 2. Once the oil temperature is suitable, ingredients and seasonings should be added for stir-frying. Some people add ingredients first, others add seasonings first; I won't debate the order here but focus on the role of vinegar. First, household vinegar mainly falls into three categories: mature vinegar, rice vinegar (southern white vinegar), and white vinegar. Among these, mature vinegar has lower acidity (pH around 3–4), while white vinegar has higher acidity (pH around 2–3). So, for iron supplementation, white vinegar is definitely the preferred choice. Second, there's the issue of vinegar volatility. Vinegar is a volatile liquid; even pure acetic acid has a boiling point around 118°C, and white vinegar is a mixture of acetic acid and water, so its boiling point is even lower than the oil temperature used for stir-frying. This leads to a continuous process of water from the ingredients and vinegar evaporating during cooking. Finally, there's the issue of reaction quantity. You might think that white vinegar with a pH of 2–3 would quickly corrode the iron wok. Acetic acid is a weak acid; it dissolves in both water and oil. In stir-frying, there is oil as a heat conduction medium, as well as water released from vegetables when heated, both of which reduce the reaction effect. No matter how weak the above reasons may seem, a trace amount of ferrous iron is still obtained. 3. However, the decisive process does not occur in the wok but after the dish is cooked. Once the dish is ready, it is served on a plate and eaten. The problem lies here: ferrous iron at high temperatures, without protection in an acidic environment, quickly undergoes oxidation: 4Fe²⁺ + 4H⁺ + O₂ → 4Fe³⁺ + 2H₂O. This leads to the experts' claim that it is mainly ferric iron. There's another counterintuitive issue: often, if the dish tastes very sour, you might think you've ingested iron. In fact, ferrous and ferric iron are mainly in the solution, i.e., the dish's sauce. So, if you don't drink the sauce, this iron doesn't actually enter your stomach. In summary, these are the main reasons experts generally believe that iron woks cannot supplement iron.

Title: 【Case Sharing】Is Resume "Enhancement" or "Fabrication"? Content: Case Source: Shanghai High Court Such incidents reflect the current state of the recruitment market. In an increasingly competitive job-seeking environment, resume enhancement is evolving from an isolated phenomenon to a "normalized" practice. According to a survey report released by a recruitment platform in 2023, 86% of HR professionals reported encountering candidates with significantly exaggerated resumes. The "Impression Management Theory" in psychology is the psychological motivation for job seekers to over-package themselves. Academic credential embellishment, inflated job titles, and exaggerated project involvement constitute the three most common types of fabrication. Faced with these overly "packaged" resumes, if companies make judgments based solely on paper information, they may fall into hiring risks and even incur direct economic losses. Therefore, HR must possess "sharp eyes," ensuring the accuracy and fairness of recruitment through effective screening and verification methods. Interviews are a crucial stage for detecting resume exaggerations. HR should employ structured interview techniques to delve into candidates' actual experiences, such as asking candidates to describe their past experiences in detail using the **Situation, Task, Action, Result (STAR)** method, preventing them from getting by with vague statements. Background checks are an essential means to ensure information authenticity. HR can adopt the following methods: Verify previous employer information: Contact the HR or direct supervisor from the candidate's former company mentioned in the resume to confirm their position, employment period, and core responsibilities. Professional background check agencies: Utilize third-party agencies to investigate the candidate's work history, educational background, etc., to mitigate the risk of false information. In the face of resume exaggeration, HR needs to improve recruitment precision through scientific screening methods and background checks. Rather than correcting the losses caused by a wrong hire later, it is better to establish a robust screening mechanism from the outset, reducing the company's hiring risk at the source. Precise recruitment not only minimizes company losses but also ensures the overall quality of team members, laying a solid foundation for the company's long-term development. As an HR professional, are you ready?

Title: Shenzhen Real Estate Market Development Forecast and Investment Consulting Report, 2025-2030 Content: At present, the bubble in Shenzhen’s property market is continuing to deflate, homebuyers are becoming increasingly rational, and the once-common spectacle of projects selling out on launch day has all but disappeared, making those developments that do achieve a sellout within the year all the more remarkable. According to public data from the Shenzhen Real Estate Information Platform, 178 new projects entered the Shenzhen market in 2023. The supply area of newly built commercial residential housing in Shenzhen reached 5.792 million square meters in 2023, up 27.6% year on year; the number of units supplied reached 56,909, up 21.9% year on year. Supply was the second highest in the past eight years, second only to 2021. In 2024, in order to further ease inventory pressure and the liquidity crisis, developers are expected to maintain or even increase discounts and incentives for their projects, and the average transaction price of first-hand residential housing in Shenzhen is expected to continue a slight downward trend. In the future, as various economic indicators steadily recover, regulatory policies continue to be optimized, and the credit standing of real estate enterprises is gradually repaired, market confidence and transaction activity are expected to improve at the margin. From January to November 2023, the combined sales value of the top 10 commercial residential projects in Shenzhen reached RMB 59.252 billion, accounting for 31.38% of the city’s total sales value, down 37.63% year on year. The threshold for entering the top 10 list was RMB 3.913 billion, down RMB 1.227 billion from the same period last year. Among them, Shenye Yunhaiwan in Nanshan District ranked first with sales of RMB 9.109 billion; Hyper Core Center | Runfu in Longhua District ranked second with RMB 8.580 billion; and Hongrongyuan Jiayufu in Bao’an District ranked third with sales of RMB 8.159 billion. In terms of sales area, from January to November the top 10 Shenzhen real estate projects recorded a combined sales area of 813,400 square meters, accounting for 23.82% of the city’s total sales area, down 20.46% year on year. The threshold for the top 10 was 57,500 square meters, down 9,600 square meters from the same period last year. Among them, Hongrongyuan Jiayufu ranked first with a sales area of 147,600 square meters, Hyper Core Center | Runfu ranked second with 118,400 square meters, and Shenye Yunhaiwanfu ranked third with 99,000 square meters in transaction area. On October 25, 2023, the official website of the Shenzhen Municipal Housing and Construction Bureau released the Notice of the Shenzhen Housing Provident Fund Management Committee on Matters Relating to the Withdrawal of Housing Provident Fund for Renting Housing in Shenzhen. The notice proposed increasing the maximum withdrawal amount of housing provident fund for rent by employees without housing. Where an employee and his or her family members do not own any commercial housing, policy-based housing, or affordable housing in Shenzhen, the employee may, when applying for rental withdrawal, withdraw up to the amount payable into the housing provident fund account for the month of application. It also proposed greater support for rental withdrawals by employees from families with multiple children. For families with two or more children and at least one minor child, where the employee and his or her family members do not own any commercial housing, policy-based housing, or affordable housing in Shenzhen, and where a housing lease contract has been filed with the municipal housing authority and the rental contract and rental invoice are provided, the employee may withdraw according to the actual monthly rent without being subject to the monthly contribution cap. Vaccination is the most economical and effective measure to prevent, control, and even eradicate infectious diseases, playing a huge role in protecting public health. The 4th Citywide Million Workers "Focusing on the 'Six Newes' to Assist Transformation" Health System "Youkang Cup" Vaccination Vocational Skills Competition was hosted by the Taiyuan Labor Competition Committee and co-organized by the Taiyuan Federation of Trade Unions, the Taiyuan Municipal Health Commission, and the Taiyuan Municipal Center for Disease Control and Prevention. The competition concluded successfully from August 7th to 9th. Liu Jing and Dong Yanjia, vaccination staff from the Preventive Care Department of our center, after procedures such as the written test and practical exam of the Yingze District Vaccination Competition, served as representatives for Yingze District and participated in the Taiyuan City Vaccination Vocational Skills Competition. After competing in multiple segments including theoretical knowledge competition, skills operation competition across 4 segments, and live knowledge Q&A, they ultimately achieved the excellent result of the first prize in the team category for vaccination. This skills competition activity, themed "Learn Technology, Practice Skills, Strive for First-Class," mobilized grassroots vaccination personnel to delve into their professional work, diligently study their skills, and hone their abilities through layered post training and skills competitions, fostering a positive atmosphere of "being proactive and striving for progress," greatly enhancing the vaccination service capacity and level across the city. Through this competition, we further cultivated a good atmosphere of "compete, learn, catch up, help, and surpass"; we hope that vaccination personnel will continue to carry forward the spirit of diligent study and courageous progress! Behind winning the competition lies extraordinary hard training and a deep love for vaccination work – you are the best!

Title: Mitsubishi Machine-Room-Less Elevator Drive Light Not Illuminating Content: The drive light of a Mitsubishi machine-room-less elevator is not illuminating. Cause analysis: 1. When the elevator safety circuit is open, indicator 29 is abnormal, and the LED for light 89 also cannot illuminate normally. Alternatively, if light 89 turns off and immediately lights up again, it is highly likely an issue with the safety circuit. 2. Check if the upper and lower limit switches are normal, if the wiring is correct, and if there is any broken insulation or grounding in the lines. 3. If the thermal fuse is blown, light 89 also cannot illuminate. 4. If the glass tube fuse on the power board that detects whether the safety circuit is grounded is blown, causing an abnormal safety circuit, light 89 also cannot illuminate in this case. 5. When the brake gap is too small, prolonged operation causes excessive friction on the host traction sheave, raising the host temperature. If excessive brake temperature is detected, the elevator activates self-protection, leading to a system halt where neither high nor low speed operation is possible. 6. If the module or IGBT is faulty, light 89 will also not illuminate. Repairs can be made based on the major and minor fault codes. 7. Mainboard relay failure.

Title: Zhejiang, a man bought a new mobile phone and found that it actually contained photos of himself and his wife. The man believed it was not a new phone and demanded a refund and triple compensation. The store said: This is extortion! The court ruled. Content: Please scroll down to watch the video! In Hangzhou, Mr. Zheng wanted to buy a new phone for his wife. They liked a high-end phone priced at 2799 yuan at a specialty store. The store clerk said there was sufficient stock and the phones were brand new and unopened, promising "hassle-free after-sales service." Mr. Zheng paid in full, agreeing to pick up the phone in three days. When picking up the phone, Ms. Lin opened the photo album to test the camera and found three photos taken three days earlier when they were testing the phone, suspecting it was a demo unit. Mr. Zheng questioned the clerk, who initially denied it, then said "there was a mistake with the transferred stock," not admitting to fraud, but willing to process a return. Mr. Zheng believed it constituted consumer fraud and demanded a "refund and triple compensation." The store refused and accused him of "picking a fight." After failed negotiations, Mr. Zheng sued the store in court, submitting multiple pieces of evidence. The store argued it was a "transfer error" but had no valid records. The court found the store had subjective fraudulent intent and ruled that the store must refund the 2799 yuan phone payment and pay triple compensation of 8397 yuan. This incident sparked heated discussion. Industry insiders pointed out that the ruling protects consumer rights and warns businesses to operate with integrity. Title: Jiugu River Wetland Park Environmental Volunteer Activity Content: At 2 PM on May 28th, five volunteers gathered on time at Jiugu River Wetland Park. After a brief discussion, the volunteers decided to split into two teams, responsible for the environmental maintenance work in the western and eastern areas of the park respectively. Then, wearing vests and holding tools, the volunteers officially began their environmental volunteer journey under the scorching sun. Along the way, the volunteers looked around and paid attention to the ground, promptly picking up litter such as cigarette butts, tissues, and snack wrappers whenever they found them, meticulously completing the task of maintaining the park's cleanliness. During this process, we encountered a seven or eight-year-old child who had casually thrown garbage on the ground. As the saying goes, "Environmental protection starts with children." We chose to approach the child, communicate with him, and teach him that littering is uncivilized behavior and the importance of protecting the environment. After our teaching, the child deeply realized his mistake, picked up the garbage from the ground, and threw it into the trash can. After the three-hour volunteer activity, we had a "bountiful harvest"—collecting three full bags of garbage. While feeling a sense of achievement from actively participating in volunteer service and realizing social value, we also felt somewhat heavy-hearted—raising everyone's environmental awareness still has a long way to go. "Heaven and earth coexist with me, and all things are one with me." Humans and nature are a community of life. Whether it's the blue sky and white clouds, lush forests and blooming flowers, or the babbling streams in the mountains and the chirping cicadas in the woods, a beautiful environment requires the joint protection of countless individuals like you and me.
