Title: Proxy Exam Certificates Openly Priced Content: Recently, someone publicly posted information online about taking IT certificate exams for others, with clearly marked prices ranging from a minimum of 1500 yuan to a maximum of 6000 yuan. Mid-Autumn Festival Greetings Turn Out to Be Proxy Exam Bait On the morning of the 11th, Ms. Wu said: 'I just received an email with information about taking IT certificate exams for others. Because the email's subject line was a Mid-Autumn Festival greeting, I initially thought it was a holiday greeting from a friend.' Subsequently, the reporter accessed the email address provided by Ms. Wu and found the email's subject was 'Wishing You a Happy Mid-Autumn Festival.' Through this email, they entered a website where a prominent message immediately popped up: 'Good news for IT professionals! If you need IBM, ORACLE, JAVA certification, I can take the exam for you for a certain fee, guaranteeing you get the certificate. You can pay the exam fee first, then check online. After you pass, pay the remaining balance to receive the certificate.' Five Types of IT Certificates Openly Priced Clicking further, the reporter saw a price list. The table clearly stated that five types of IT certificates could be taken by proxy: CCNA, ORACLE, IBM E-Commerce Specialist, IBM E-Commerce Professional, and SUN JAVA Assistant Programmer. The five certificates had their own prices: 2500 yuan, 2500 yuan, 1500 yuan, 6000 yuan, and 2000 yuan respectively. The man not only provided a bank account number but also included his address, email, and QQ number. Based on the address, the man is in Chengdu. Proxy Exam Taker Repeatedly Assures Reliability At 2 PM on the 11th, the reporter contacted the man who called himself Mr. Gui. 'I want to get an E-Commerce Professional certificate. How much does it cost?' '2000 yuan per subject. Pay 1200 yuan per subject first. Pay the rest after you pass,' the other party said. 'If I proceed, what is the procedure?' 'You transfer the money to the account first.' 'And then?' 'That's it.' 'Don't you need an ID number or anything?' 'Oh. Of course.' The other party sounded very nervous. After repeated reminders from the reporter, he said that a photo and name were also needed. 'What if you are a scammer?' 'I understand your concern. It's absolutely reliable, otherwise I wouldn't publish so many contact methods online.' 'Contact methods can be fake too,' the reporter pressed on. 'We will issue you an invoice and mail it to you.' 'Once you have the money, there's nothing I can do if you don't send the invoice.' 'Then you can come see for yourself. Besides, the key is mutual trust. It's absolutely reliable, you have to believe me.' Chengdu Media Has Intervened in the Investigation After hanging up, the reporter contacted the hotline department of the Chengdu Business Daily. Their counterparts in Chengdu immediately stated that the Chengdu Business Daily would assist our reporter in investigating the matter. At 7 PM on the 11th, the proxy exam man called urging the reporter to make a decision soon. Who is behind this proxy exam scam? Reporters from Jinan and Chengdu will continue to track the story and uncover the inside story. (Reporter Huang Zhiyi)

Title: Untitled Content: If the user has activated the SMS notification function, the bank will notify when the bank card is frozen.

Reasons for bank card freezing:

If the bank card is a credit card, it may be frozen by the bank due to abnormal transactions, such as malicious cash-outs, forged information, consecutive password errors, etc.
For overdraft-enabled bank cards, the bank sets an overdraft limit based on actual repayment capacity. When the overdraft exceeds this limit, the bank will immediately freeze the card.
If the bank card is a debit card, freezing can occur due to: incorrect account freezing, where the bank mistakenly deposits more money into the account and freezes the excess; or judicial freezing, where judicial authorities apply to freeze the card for case handling per legal provisions. Customs, tax authorities, etc., also have the power to freeze cards.
For any bank card, entering the wrong password three times consecutively will cause the bank system to lock the password, similar to freezing but not identical. This lock automatically lifts after 24 hours.
If a bank card expires and is not replaced, the bank will freeze the expired card.
If a card is reported lost multiple times consecutively, the bank may freeze it suspecting malicious reporting.


Solutions are as follows:
Depending on the freezing reason, bring your ID card and bank card to the bank counter for relevant unfreezing procedures.

Title: Legal System Network News Reporter Huo Shiming: After the owners of Sanli Hepingwan Home in Shashan Street, Heping District, Shenyang City, Liaoning Province elected 9 members of the homeowners' meeting preparatory group, 3 of them were actually "removed" by the Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office through a public announcement. These 3 "removed" owner "representatives" sued the Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office in court. Content: Legal System Network News Reporter Huo Shiming: After the owners of Sanli Hepingwan Home in Shashan Street, Heping District, Shenyang City, Liaoning Province elected 9 members of the homeowners' meeting preparatory group, 3 of them were actually "removed" by the Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office through a public announcement. These 3 "removed" owner "representatives" sued the Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office in court.
The Heping District Court recently issued a first-instance judgment in this administrative litigation case: the "removal" announcement should be revoked. From November 16 to 19, 2005, under the guidance of the Heping District Housing Property Bureau and the Heping District Shashan Subdistrict Office, the owners voted to elect members of the homeowners' meeting preparatory group. On December 15 of that year, with personnel from the Housing Property Bureau, the Subdistrict Office, and Hepingwan Community present, the election results were announced: Li Mou ranked first, Xu Mou ranked second, and Shen Mou ranked fifth. However, on February 21 of this year, the Heping District Housing Property Bureau and the Shashan Subdistrict Office jointly issued an announcement, explicitly excluding Li Mou and the other two from the preparatory group members, while simultaneously confirming two owners who received very few votes and one non-owner who was not elected as members of the Sanli Hepingwan Home homeowners' meeting preparatory group.
To reclaim their rights, the three "removed" individuals sued the District Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office in court. Li Mou and the other two argued that they were members of the homeowners' meeting preparatory group elected by the majority of owners, and that the Housing Property Bureau and the Subdistrict Office had no authority to "remove" the representatives elected by the owners. Therefore, they requested the court to confirm that the administrative actions of the defendant District Housing Property Bureau and Subdistrict Office were illegal and to revoke the announcement decision they made.
In early June of this year, the defendant Housing Property Bureau and Subdistrict Office argued in court that during the process of recommending and producing the homeowners' meeting preparatory group members, they lawfully fulfilled their guiding responsibilities without any misconduct, and the procedure for recommending and producing the preparatory group members was legal. However, Li Mou and the other two had a history of拖欠物业费 (defaulting on property fees), failing to fulfill their obligations as owners, which did not comply with the relevant provisions of the "Property Management Regulations" and the "Homeowners' Meeting Procedures."
Recently, the court issued a first-instance judgment on this case: When the defendant announced the members of the homeowners' meeting preparatory group for the Sanli Hepingwan Home community in Heping District, they confirmed the changed preparatory group members through an announcement without prior public notification, infringing upon the right to information that other owners should have. Their announcement procedure was illegal and should be revoked.

Title: Will Informal Property Houses Be "Completely Demolished"? New Document Issued, Releasing "Important Signals"! Content: When it comes to informal property houses, I believe everyone is familiar with them. Especially in recent months, the uproar over Shenzhen's informal properties has drawn even more attention. According to statistics: in Shenzhen, a city with over 17 million people, informal property houses already account for 60% of all housing. So, it's quite normal to call Shenzhen a city propped up by informal property houses! However, although informal property houses have been developing enthusiastically for so many years, they have actually always been in a legal gray area—neither protected by law, nor eligible for property registration, and private transactions are not allowed. Yet, despite this, informal properties continue to proliferate despite bans. This ultimately leads to significant waste of collective land. So why does this反常 situation occur? I believe it boils down to two words: "cheap." After all, in today's real estate market where prices are in the ten-thousands per square meter era, buying a commercial housing unit often costs around a million. Many rigid demand buyers, in order to purchase a home, can only empty out six wallets (family savings) and even shoulder decades of mortgage debt—the pressure is immense! Informal property houses are different. Generally, you can buy one for 70,000 to 80,000 yuan, or a more expensive one for around 100,000 to 200,000 yuan. For friends with rigid demand, this is truly a福音. Hence, it leads these individuals to take risks and choose to buy informal properties! Of course, although informal property houses can indeed be lived in, and the living experience seems not much different from commercial housing, the产权 issues they face will inevitably need resolution someday. From the current perspective, there are mainly two solutions: one is full legalization (转正), and the other is: complete demolition and reconstruction! So, does this also mean that informal property houses might "completely disappear" in the future? Actually, from the important signals released in the new central document, we can find the answer! The document mainly mentions issues like housing property rights, rural homesteads, and the transfer of usage rights. In exploring pilot reforms for rural homesteads, it creatively points out: the separation of three rights for homesteads—qualification right, ownership, and usage right (三权分置). This has great significance for solving the current informal property house problem! After all, the most important reason informal property houses are illegal is that in earlier years, we lumped all aspects of informal properties together uniformly. This led to the land under informal properties and the construction process being unable to undergo independent approval. Now, with the separation of three rights, perhaps through targeted back payment of taxes and fees, the informal property issue can be resolved more perfectly! In summary, from the above analysis, everyone should understand that although the informal property problem persists despite bans, the state has been actively seeking solutions, which is commendable. Of course, the document uses the word "explore," meaning that in the coming years, there might not be significant progress on the informal property issue! That's all for today. So, are you looking forward to the legalization of informal property houses? Welcome to leave your comments below. Follow me to learn different knowledge points every day! Title: Is it normal for the elderly to have increased nocturia and not need attention? Debunking myths for you and explaining the harms of nocturia. Content: Is it normal for the elderly to have increased nocturia and not need attention? Debunking myths for you and explaining the harms of nocturia. I believe many people with elderly family members at home are very curious about these questions: Does nocturia increase with age? Is increased nocturia a normal phenomenon? How to determine if an elderly person's nocturia has increased? What are the causes of the increase? What are the harms of increased nocturia? And what should we do? Next, let's take a look together. Does nocturia become more frequent with age? A long time ago, a survey in the UK showed that generally, the elderly do experience an increase in nocturia. Moreover, this situation becomes more obvious with age, but many people think it is a natural phenomenon due to aging. Actually, that's not the case; increased nocturia has many harms. (Image: Increased Nocturnal Urine Volume) I. How to determine if an elderly person's nocturia has increased. Whether in the past or in today's society, people often say 'children sleep a lot, the elderly urinate a lot,' which indirectly indicates that many elderly people do not pay special attention to their urination. They might think that increased nocturia is a very normal situation with age. Even if they get up multiple times at night to urinate, they consider it normal and not a big deal. However, what they don't know is that their lack of attention could lead to a series of very serious consequences. Because of their neglect, their nocturia condition might become more severe, and even the underlying diseases causing nocturia, such as nocturia disorder or diabetes, could worsen. Therefore, the elderly should pay attention to whether their nocturia has increased. So, how should the elderly determine if their nocturia has increased? There are many simple methods for the elderly to judge this in daily life. The elderly can record their urination habits to determine if nocturia has increased. They can record their daily water intake, urination times, and frequency. Under normal water intake conditions, if an elderly person urinates twice or more at night, with a urine volume greater than 500 milliliters, then it can be judged that nocturia has increased, and it is not what we call normal nocturia. II. What are the causes of increased nocturia in the elderly? We generally categorize the causes of frequent nighttime urination in the elderly into physiological causes and pathological causes. Generally, physiological causes do not cause very serious harm to the elderly's health, so we only need to pay attention to common situations that lead to increased nocturia. However, nocturia increased due to pathological causes is very serious and can cause significant damage to the elderly's health. Therefore, if the increase is due to pathological reasons, timely medical help should be sought for effective treatment measures targeting the cause. (Image: Elderly frequently getting up to urinate at night) Everyone urinates every day to eliminate toxins from the body, but urination usually occurs during the day. Frequent urination at night, known as increased nocturia, can be very troublesome. Many elderly people experience increased nocturia. So, what exactly causes it? 1. Increased nocturia in the elderly could be due to physiological reasons, i.e., physiological nocturia. This might be caused by drinking too much water, tea, or other beverages before sleep, leading to increased urination at night. If this is the case, there's no need to worry; reducing fluid intake before bed can solve the problem. 2. Increased nocturia could be due to psychological factors. Some elderly people, when under significant mental stress, may also experience increased nocturia (though the volume might not increase, just the frequency). This can be resolved by learning self-guidance or talking to someone. 3. Increased nocturia could be caused by kidney disease. This is a pathological factor. As we know, the kidneys are a vital part of the urinary system. Kidney disease can affect urination, leading to increased nocturia. If kidney disease is the cause, early treatment is essential. Based on one's condition, hospital examination and effective treatment measures should be taken to avoid more severe diseases and the various troubles caused by nocturia. 4. Increased nocturia could also be due to pathological changes in the bladder, etc. The bladder is an important organ for storing urine. If it is damaged, it can easily lead to abnormal urination. Once an elderly person's bladder undergoes such changes, it might not only cause increased nocturnal urine volume but also symptoms like frequent urination and urgency. 5. Diabetes is also a common cause of increased nocturia in the elderly. This is a pathological factor. Diabetes can easily cause abnormal blood sugar levels, leading to metabolic disorders in the body, which affects normal urination. So, there are many reasons for increased nighttime urination in the elderly. Besides the physiological, psychological, and pathological factors mentioned above, many other factors can cause it. Therefore, once increased nocturia is noticed, one must be vigilant as it could be due to some disease. Timely diagnosis and, if necessary, treatment are essential. If the causes of increased nocturnal urine volume are not addressed promptly and improved, serious consequences can occur. III. What are the harms of nocturia? So, what are the harms of frequent nighttime urination for the elderly? Studies have shown that the more times we get up at night, the worse our sleep quality. The body is an integrated system, so this can directly lead to poor rest for our internal organs. When various parts of the body do not get good sleep quality, toxins in the body may increase, and blood sugar and blood pressure levels may become abnormal. In short, our overall health may deteriorate. So, what are the main hazards of frequently getting up to use the toilet at night? 1. Nocturia easily leads to poorer sleep quality. As mentioned, nocturia involves frequent nighttime urination. If we get up frequently, we might have difficulty falling back asleep, and sleep quality worsens. Severely, it can lead to poor daytime energy. 2. Nocturia increases the risk of falls in the elderly. Nocturia involves getting up due to urgency. Elderly people might feel dizzy when getting up, leading to falls and even more serious accidents. 3. Nocturia can easily cause depression or irritability in the elderly. Frequent nighttime urination leads to insufficient sleep, resulting in poor physical and mental condition during the day. This can easily cause the elderly to become more depressed and irritable, potentially affecting their interpersonal relationships. 4. Nocturia can accelerate the aging of internal organs. Poor nighttime sleep quality can damage the internal organs as the body is a whole system. Vision may become blurry, and hearing may deteriorate. 5. Nocturia can cause toxin accumulation in the body. Sleep promotes toxin elimination. Insufficient sleep leads to serious toxin buildup, causing dry, itchy skin and possibly age spots. 6. Nocturia can damage the immune system. Severe nocturia requires medication. If not cured for a long time, medication use increases, and our immune system can be severely compromised. 7. Nocturia increases the probability of complications. The occurrence of nocturia may reduce immune function, weakening the body's condition and leading to some complications. 8. The most severe consequence of nocturia is the occurrence of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events. One might wonder, as these events usually happen upon waking in the morning or during periods of high blood pressure and increased heart rate, how can nocturia cause them? This is because patients with nocturia may experience hemodynamic changes when getting up to urinate at night, which easily increases the probability of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events. IV. Nocturia has so many harms, what should we do? Through the previous explanations, I believe everyone has a basic understanding of nocturia. So, if there are elderly people around us or we ourselves suffer from nocturia, what should we do? What can we do to reduce the frequency of nocturia? 1. We can reduce nocturia frequency by controlling water intake. As mentioned, some frequent nighttime urination is due to physiological factors, like drinking too much water before bed. In such cases, we should strictly control our fluid intake, try not to drink water within 30 minutes before sleep, and avoid diuretics or things that promote urination. Otherwise, it can easily increase body fluid, leading to increased nocturnal urine volume, frequent nighttime urination, and seriously affecting the elderly's sleep quality. 2. Patients with frequent nighttime urination should eat less high-salt foods. Patients with nocturia should mainly have a light diet, avoid overly salty foods, keep salt intake below 6 grams, and avoid excessive pickled foods. Especially at night, control yourself and avoid rich, heavy meals. 3. Patients with nocturia can improve sleep quality through exercise. If physical condition allows, elderly patients with increased nocturia can do about 30 minutes of aerobic exercise daily, such as yoga, brisk walking, or swimming. These exercises can improve bodily functions, speed up blood circulation, and are very helpful for sleep. If the patient has urinary incontinence, Kegel exercises are recommended. Kegel exercises can improve symptoms like loose anus and constipation, help reduce nighttime urination, and assist in treating incontinence. 4. Patients who frequently get up at night to urinate can eat more calming and sleep-promoting foods. In daily life, consume foods like black sesame, goji berries, or walnuts that aid sleep. These can promote sleep and, most importantly, improve sleep quality. 5. Patients with polyuria should learn self-guidance and emotional regulation. Elderly with polyuria should manage their emotions well, use correct methods to vent negative emotions (e.g., running, exercise), and most importantly, maintain a good mindset before sleep. If possible, play some music that aids sleep before bed, drink some milk, and avoid thinking about乱七八糟的东西 (messy thoughts). These are all methods that help us fall asleep and improve sleep quality. Summary Through the previous introduction, I believe everyone understands that frequent nighttime urination is not a normal phenomenon and can lead to a series of problems in the body. We should take measures to avoid it. Have you or anyone around you experienced increased nocturia? If so, we should actively find the cause. If it is due to physiological factors, we can adjust through diet, exercise, etc.

Title: Is it worth spending 170,000 to save a newborn's life in an incubator? Content: My wife's water broke at 35+5 weeks, the baby was premature. The doctor told me the baby was premature, had underdeveloped lungs, and needed injections costing 6,000 per shot. I went down to pay, came back up, and the doctor said the baby had a pulmonary hemorrhage, required immediate intubation, and transfer to another hospital. The first time I ever rode in an ambulance was for my daughter. Looking at my daughter in the incubator, as a father, I felt utterly powerless. I couldn't tell my wife any of this, I didn't dare. After transferring hospitals, the doctor told me several times the baby's condition was critical, requiring various medications and antibiotics. The doctor also needed to give the baby a blood transfusion. Although I didn't fully understand, I knew that because the doctor needed my signature for the medication and transfusion, these procedures must carry some risks for her. Fortunately, after half a month, my daughter pulled through. It cost over seventy thousand. The moment we were discharged, I held her and felt that no matter how much money I spent, it was worth it. A child's health is truly much more important than money. Money can be earned again, but a child only gets this one chance to be a baby. So, no matter the cost, I would save her. Is it worth spending 170,000 to save a newborn's life in an incubator? This is a true story. Lazy Mom knows a couple who, because both had some health issues, only conceived a child after about ten years of marriage. In the early stages of pregnancy, she needed a progesterone shot every half month, costing 1,500 per shot. Maybe 1,500 doesn't seem like much to everyone, but at the time it was equivalent to a month's salary. Misfortunes never come singly. The mother had a cesarean section at 30 weeks due to preeclampsia. The baby weighed just over two pounds at birth and was immediately placed in an incubator after leaving the operating room. The mother developed other complications and couldn't breastfeed, so the baby drank premature formula, which is much more expensive than regular formula, adding another significant expense. In this small family, the mother already had substantial medical bills, and the baby's situation was uncertain because the lungs weren't fully developed, and it was unknown how long the stay in the incubator would be. Before the pregnancy, due to constant medical treatments, the small family was already impoverished. Faced with these huge medical expenses, the father didn't hesitate and shouldered the burden. Finally, the baby stayed in the hospital for over a month, costing a total of over one hundred thousand yuan. At the time, that amount could have bought a nice apartment locally, but they didn't hesitate because, in their view, the child was more deserving. 170,000 versus a baby – for some families, it's indeed a difficult choice. I believe anyone would feel for their own child and wouldn't want to face such a situation, but others' choices are not necessarily your own. It depends on the specific circumstances; everyone's capabilities are different, so choices will differ. If I had to pay 300,000 upfront to ensure my child's lifelong health, I would do it without hesitation. My son is now three years old, and we've spent nearly 100,000 on him. He has developmental delays, and rehabilitation therapy is a bottomless pit. The key is the child suffers. However, I still never consider whether it's worth it. He is my child. He came to me. Before he turns eighteen, whatever I do for him is worth it. He is my child! He is my flesh and blood! All the money I spend on him is earned by me, penny by penny. My mother-in-law said this child was born to collect a debt, not letting you save a single cent. I really dislike hearing that. I earned it myself, and I'm willing to spend it. As long as my child is safe and healthy, I'd be willing to throw the money on the street! Don't even ask if it's worth it!! It seems you've never been a parent!! A few years ago, my son was born with some trouble!! He was admitted to the ICU right after birth. In less than 10 hours, we spent over 20,000. My salary at the time was just over 2,000!! Plus, the doctor said the baby had oxygen deprivation at birth, and it was unclear if there would be any long-term effects!! And he hadn't passed the critical period! The后续费用也可能很高!! I actually thought about giving up!! Later, I went back and talked to my family!! One sentence from my family woke me up: they said a life is priceless, we must save it no matter the cost!! From then on, every time I went to see the baby, I stopped looking at the costs!! The baby was discharged after over a month, with total costs over 80,000!! After that, we gave him the best of everything!! He's almost 7 years old now!! Very healthy!! Now when I think back, I deeply regret having that thought back then!! If I had thought wrongly for just a moment, I would have abandoned my own son!! So, when it comes to your own child, don't talk about money. Even if it costs your life, you should give it to him!! Now, playing with my son is like playing with a friend!! And our second child is on the way!! I really don't understand the intention behind the poster's question. This is a life, not some object. Of course, you save the life! A colleague from my previous workplace had a premature baby girl, weighing just over three pounds. She needed to stay in an incubator for a month. Her mouth was so small she couldn't even take a bottle. The doctors suggested giving up! The young couple wasn't well-off, and the financial pressure from all sides was immense. They were very hesitant. Later, the baby's aunt came. She reached her hand in, and the little girl tightly grasped her aunt's finger. The aunt cried and scolded them, 'This is a life! How can you give up?!' Later, the couple tried every means possible. No breast milk, they bought expensive formula. Since she couldn't take a bottle, they used a syringe to feed her, tube by tube. That child was sickly from a young age, getting sick several times almost every year. The difficulties of raising her go without saying. Later, she grew into a fine young woman. The couple sighed, thankful they didn't give up back then. Otherwise, how could they have lived with themselves for the rest of their lives! So, when facing a life, of course you save it! My grandson was in an incubator for a month at 31 weeks. Due to oxygen therapy in the incubator, he developed retinopathy. We went to Peking University People's Hospital many times. He's five now. Staying in the incubator cost 3,000 per day. Trips to Beijing sometimes cost ten or twenty thousand, sometimes several thousand. At Peking University People's Hospital, I saw some families spending one or two million on their child's treatment. The child's father was afraid of losing both the child and the money. My husband firmly said we'd even sell the house to pay for the child's treatment. Now, aside from some sensory integration issues, the child has no other problems. Lately, I've been taking him for sensory integration training, which costs over 1,000 per session. As long as the child can be healthy... money is earned by people. For the sake of the child, I don't think money is important. Having money but no people is pointless. Although I'm not rich, my and the child's grandfather's combined monthly salary is only about 7,000 yuan, but I'll be frugal myself and won't miss the opportunity to create health for my child. I don't value money that much. My second pregnancy was an unexpected identical twin pregnancy, conceived only a year and a half after my first C-section. At five months pregnant, they were diagnosed with Stage II Twin-to-Twin Transfusion Syndrome. We immediately went to Hong Kong for surgery, spending tens of thousands to save both babies. At six months and ten days, because I took my eldest daughter out to play, I came home with frequent contractions leading to premature birth (I still feel guilty). Both babies weighed just over one pound at birth. The older brother was hospitalized for over eighty days, the younger brother for over ninety days due to a patent ductus arteriosus, intestinal gas, and slow weight gain. He was transferred to another hospital for observation for nearly three months and had a ligation surgery. After coming home, I breastfed them, and they recovered quickly. Both brothers are now chubby toddlers weighing over ten pounds each, with normal intelligence and reactions. They just need some physical rehabilitation because they lay in the incubator for so long. Even though hospitalization for the two cost 200,000 out-of-pocket after insurance, and now besides breast milk, they need hydrolyzed formula costing nearly five to six thousand per month, plus the eldest's tuition and the cost of a nanny at home, monthly expenses exceed ten thousand. The father, the sole breadwinner supporting the whole family, has it tough, but at least we did everything we could. When I was still on the delivery bed after having the twins, the pediatric intensive care doctor asked me if we wanted to save them. I said yes without hesitation, thinking I would spare no expense. If the doctor didn't say there was no hope, how could I bear not to save them? The twins had a journey full of misfortunes from pregnancy to birth, yet were ultimately fortunate, blessed by heaven, healthy and safe!!! May all strong premature babies have a bright future! For me, my child's life is more important than anything. My pregnancy was difficult. The first one ended in miscarriage. The second time, I was diagnosed with antiphospholipid syndrome. I was on bed rest from the moment I conceived. Just the four daily heparin injections cost over 200 yuan. Intravenous immunoglobulin cost 6,000 per course, and we used it without hesitation. I'm only five months pregnant now and have already spent 100,000, but our whole family has no hesitation; we think it's completely worth it. Not to mention 170,000, even 270,000 or 370,000, I would save my child. And once you're in the hospital, you realize how hard it is for many to have a child nowadays. Some people have five or six IVF attempts that end in chemical pregnancies. Others have five pregnancies, each ending in miscarriage midway, wanting to save the baby but unable to, their tears dried up. For us mothers, people asking if they should spend 170,000 to save a pregnancy are simply unbelievable. Isn't your child worth that much money? It's not even a year's salary for some. Even a factory worker can save over one hundred thousand in three years. Choosing to abandon a child... unless you're insane. Those who say it's not worth it definitely don't have children of their own. When you truly have a little life that belongs to you, you feel that everything in the world exists for that little one. My husband and I were together for 10 years before we had our son. Before having a baby, I didn't feel maternal at all. I played and partied, always worried that having a child would affect my quality of life. When I found out I was pregnant, all that playing, KTV, dining and drinking stopped! I stopped eating out, stopped drinking soda and switched to plain water, and definitely stopped staying out all night partying. The feeling of being a mom hit me all at once... Especially after my son was born, for a while I felt this little thing was mine. Besides me and my husband holding him, I even felt jealous when my mother-in-law held him, feeling like the baby was being taken away.. It's better now; I feel it's good for the baby to have lots of love and care! So, saying it's not worth spending money to exchange for a child's life is impossible. When you really have a child, everything is worth it. This is also related to the current healthcare system. I have personal experience. If our family condition had been slightly worse, my now fourth-grade child wouldn't be here. In 2009, in Shenzhen Longgang, my child decided to come early. No family was in Shenzhen. The hospital said premature babies can have brain problems. We were scared and agreed to an afternoon surgery to terminate. My wife cried nonstop after finding out. A friend who worked for the government called and said wait until he arrived. When he came, he found the hospital director. The director's tone was much less frightening then, basically just discussing the后续费用. The chief physician's exact words were: 'I was a premature baby too. There are lots of premature babies. It's just that the后续 costs might be eighty or a hundred thousand, who knows.' My wife had no insurance, meaning we had to pay ourselves. But we had no money. After discussing with the family, we really couldn't bear to terminate, especially since it was seven months. The family said if the doctor says so, we should keep it. Then we transferred to the Children's Hospital. Birth weight was 3.9 pounds. Then every two or three days I ran to swipe my card to pay five or six thousand, afraid we wouldn't have enough money. Later, upon discharge, the hospital even refunded me over ten thousand cash. The actual cost was only over forty thousand. Premature babies' intelligence seems fine, even better sometimes, but their physical constitution really isn't good. When young, they basically went to the hospital monthly, and were hospitalized every other month, especially for pediatric pneumonia. Premature babies must buy insurance early. Because the amount of medicine they used... it was almost more than the water they drank.

Title: Can students using the 2023 new textbooks for the old college entrance exam in Heilongjiang retake the exam? Do they need to retake from the first year of high school? Content: Why do you want to retake the exam? If it's because you had good grades but didn't perform well in the exam, and you choose to retake, that's understandable. This requires rational analysis, not emotional decision-making or wanting to save face. You can consider it. But if your grades are not ideal and you want to make up for knowledge gaps, you need to think carefully. What are your strengths and weaknesses? You need to think clearly before making a decision. Since you were eliminated by the college entrance exam, there must be some deficiencies. If you don't identify these deficiencies and just rely on luck, it's unnecessary. You need to think carefully.

Usually, after you apply for a refund, if the seller doesn't respond to you within 15 days, or takes no action (like discussing the refund with you, etc.), then after 15 days, you will naturally receive the refund. However, the prerequisite is that you must have used Alipay for the transaction, otherwise, it's very difficult to guarantee the refund. Once you receive the goods and they agree, you can get the money immediately. Thank you, please accept the answer.

Title: What are the reasons for abnormal WeChat voice signals? Content: The main reasons for abnormal WeChat voice signals are as follows: Poor mobile network signal: If you are using mobile data, please check if the mobile network signal is full. If the signal is not full, try moving to a different location or turning mobile data off and on again. Poor Wi-Fi network signal: When using a Wi-Fi network, check if the Wi-Fi signal is full. If the signal is not full, try restarting the router, restarting the phone, or moving closer to the Wi-Fi source. Poor network signal on the other party's side: A poor network signal on the other party's side can also cause voice chat issues. It is recommended that the other party check their network conditions. Poor network coverage in the area: Poor network coverage in your area may cause unstable network signals. Try testing from a different location. Network signal interference or shielding: Near some special units or military areas, network signals may be interfered with or shielded. You need to leave these areas. Aging phone hardware: If the phone has been used for a long time, the signal transceiver may be aged, affecting signal reception and transmission. You can try testing with a different phone. In summary, abnormal WeChat voice signals can be caused by various factors and need to be investigated and resolved based on the specific situation.

Title: Is the basis for injury assessment in a fight solely determined by the hospital's diagnosis results on the same day? Content: Injury assessment is made by forensic doctors from public security authorities based on the admission records and examination reports issued by the hospital. In practice, it is not necessarily based solely on the examination results of the same day. Some injuries may not be detectable or confirmed on the day itself, and re-examinations are usually conducted during the hospitalization period. The results of these re-examinations are generally considered part of the current injury. For example, in cases of bone fractures, the initial examination report upon admission might indicate a suspected fracture that cannot be confirmed. This could be due to machine issues or the doctor's conservative approach in determining the injury. If it's not clearly a fracture, the report may conclude with 'suspected fracture,' as doctors are cautious to avoid liability. Another example is an eardrum perforation injury. If an injury assessment is issued, it might be preliminarily classified as a minor injury. Whether it constitutes a more serious injury requires a re-examination after six weeks, based on the results of that follow-up. In extreme cases, injuries self-inflicted by the other party to worsen the condition might not be immediately apparent. For instance, if you hit someone's nose with insufficient force to cause a fracture, but before going to the hospital, the victim intentionally injures their own nose in a secluded area to cause a fracture. If all evidence confirms you hit the nose and the victim's nose is fractured, even if you deny it, witness statements, surveillance footage, and the injury assessment could lead to the conclusion that you caused the serious injury. This is a rare scenario that requires significant courage from the victim. Title: Liu Guoqiang Sentenced to Death with a Two-Year Reprieve in First Instance! Content: The first-instance verdict was announced on the bribery case of Liu Guoqiang, former deputy secretary of the Party Leadership Group and vice chairman of the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. On the morning of November 8, 2022, the Tianjin No. 1 Intermediate People's Court publicly announced the verdict in the bribery case of Liu Guoqiang, former deputy secretary of the Party Leadership Group and vice chairman of the Liaoning Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. The defendant Liu Guoqiang was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve for the crime of bribery, deprived of political rights for life, and all personal property was confiscated. After the two-year reprieve period expires and his sentence is legally commuted to life imprisonment, he will be imprisoned for life without the possibility of parole or commutation. The bribes and illicit money seized in the case will be recovered according to law and turned over to the state treasury, with any shortfall to continue to be recovered. After trial, it was found: From 2006 to 2016, defendant Liu Guoqiang took advantage of his positions as Vice Governor of Liaoning Province and Vice Chairman of the Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference to assist relevant units and individuals in matters such as business operations, project approvals, obtaining financial funds, and job promotions. From 2008 to 2020, Liu Guoqiang accepted money and property from others totaling more than 352 million yuan, of which 49 million yuan had not been actually obtained. The Tianjin No. 1 Intermediate People's Court held that defendant Liu Guoqiang's actions constituted the crime of bribery, with the amount of bribes being particularly huge, the circumstances particularly serious, causing particularly significant losses to state and people's interests, and thus deserved the death penalty according to the law. Considering that after being brought to justice, Liu Guoqiang truthfully confessed his crimes, proactively disclosed most of the bribery facts not yet known to the investigating authorities, pleaded guilty and showed remorse, actively returned the illicit money, and most of the bribes had been recovered, possessing statutory and discretionary circumstances for a lighter punishment, he was sentenced to death but not immediate execution. Simultaneously, based on the facts and circumstances of Liu Guoqiang's crime, it was decided that after the two-year reprieve period expires and his sentence is legally commuted to life imprisonment, he will be imprisoned for life without the possibility of parole or commutation. The court then rendered the above judgment. —————————————— Source: Xinhua News Agency, Dahe Bao · Yu Video Editor: Wang Lihong Proofreader: Zhao Xiurong Reviewer: Chen Jun Supervisor: Cai Erxin Help and assistance Follow Dahe Bao video account ▼ Hot recommendations ● Zhengzhou High-tech Zone adjusts classified management in some areas ● Latest notice, penalties temporarily suspended! ● The weather is about to change! Title: Taobao delivery, unable to receive goods, how to handle Content: I bought something at school. Because the delivery was very slow, the goods arrived after I was already on holiday and I couldn't receive them. What should I do? Will the package be automatically returned? If I apply for the 7-day no-questions-asked return, will my money be refunded? If someone at the school signs for it, the package won't be automatically returned; it will just sit there until someone picks it up or... embezzles it. If you apply for the 7-day no-questions-asked return and it's successful, the money will be refunded to you, but there's no guarantee the shipping cost will be returned. Also, the condition is that you must apply within 7 days, and your goods must be returned promptly. The most important thing now is to check if the package has been signed for. If it hasn't been signed for, you can apply for a refund or change the address. Otherwise, you can only wait until you go back to school to pick it up yourself. If the store has a 7-day no-questions-asked return policy, you can get your money back, don't worry, but you'll have to pay the return shipping fee yourself! There are a few mistakes in the 'Recommended Answer' above, reminding the original poster to pay attention. The answer is as follows: When the package arrives at the destination, if the recipient cannot be found, the courier will try to contact the sender. If the sender also cannot contact the recipient, the goods will be returned by the courier company to the sender. However, Alipay is still counting down and will transfer the payment to the seller ten days after the shipping is completed. In this situation, you cannot use the '7-day no-reason return' because the goods are not in your hands at all. You simply cannot 'return' them to the seller, and therefore cannot get a refund. The correct way to handle this is to contact the seller before the goods arrive at the destination and ask them to change the delivery address, sending it directly to your home. If you have more questions, keep asking me. Tell the seller to change the address, you'll pay the extra shipping cost, or have it returned, you pay the return shipping, and they refund you the money.

Title: How to Clean a Yellowed Wool Quilt Content: 1. Use rice washing water: Rice washing water is weakly alkaline and can react with the oils in the stain, turning them into water-soluble substances. Soak the yellowed part in rice washing water for about 20 minutes, then proceed with regular washing. Note: only clean the yellowed part; there is no need to wash the entire wool quilt. \n2. Use lemon juice or white vinegar: Lemon juice or white vinegar has an acid-base neutralization effect and can react with the residue on the yellow stain, removing the yellow mark. It is recommended to use household white vinegar to avoid damaging the quilt. \n3. Choose dry cleaning: Wool quilts are not recommended for water washing. If conditions permit, it is best to take them to a dry cleaner. When sending it for cleaning, remind the dry cleaner that the wool quilt cannot be washed with water. Remember to inspect it upon retrieval to prevent some merchants from washing it with water, causing the quilt to shrink. If you know how to dry clean, you can also purchase dry cleaning materials and clean it yourself.

Title: Applying for a US Master's with a Bachelor's in CS and Math? Content: Applying for CS heavily emphasizes research internships. Anyway, BU and NEU's CS programs are safe bets. For NYU, back in the 20F cycle, it was definitely a safe bet, but now it's tough. The average admitted GPA for NYU's CS program, specifically the Tandon School, has become extremely competitive, reaching around 3.8+. Comparatively, USC's CS28 program feels more lenient. Basically, that's the situation. You can try Rice, USC, JHU, UCI, NYU. As for finding an agency, it's actually very easy. Don't pay attention to the case studies, analyses, and sales pitches the initial salesperson gives you—they're irrelevant. Just remember one thing: your purpose in hiring an agency is to pay for a result, not for service. Otherwise, you'll likely get scammed. So you only need to ask one thing: If I sign a contract with you, will it explicitly list the target schools and specific majors, state that the list cannot be changed after signing, and guarantee a full refund if I don't get into any school on the list? Only under these conditions, then look at what the 'safety' project is. Title: Doctor, my cat is a Scottish Fold, but currently everything is normal. Is it true that all Scottish Folds have genetic diseases? Content: Cat Owner: Hello doctor, my 'Meimei' is a Scottish Fold. My family wants her to have one litter before being spayed, but I've heard that all Scottish Folds have genetic diseases. Is that true? Will the offspring of a Scottish Fold also definitely have genetic diseases? Currently, Meimei is nine months old and everything seems normal, only her tail is a bit shorter. Cat Doctor: Hello, it is not recommended to breed Scottish Fold cats! The fold gene is an incomplete dominant gene. If the cat already has obvious folded ears, and conditions like a short, stiff tail, then it definitely carries the fold gene, and there's a high probability of giving birth to kittens with folded ears as well. Cats carrying the fold gene will experience abnormal cartilage development, which may manifest as shortened, deformed limbs accompanied by pain, and this condition worsens over time. This is very painful for the cat, so it is strongly advised not to breed Scottish Folds. Cat Owner: Will a Scottish Fold definitely develop the disease? Currently, Meimei shows no abnormalities. Cat Doctor: Cats carrying the fold gene will definitely have issues with osteochondrodysplasia. However, heterozygous genotypes might develop the disease later or with milder symptoms compared to homozygous ones, but problems will still occur. Furthermore, this condition cannot be completely cured; it can only be managed symptomatically based on the cat's condition, providing joint maintenance medication and pain relief drugs to alleviate the symptoms. Title: Originally, I came to install the squat toilet water tank. However, the customer had relatively high requirements. They asked me to help fix the decorative cover of this faucet. The decorative cover of the customer's faucet couldn't be installed because the faucet spout was too deep, and the hole in the decorative cover was too large. The hollow part of the decorative cover was much thicker than the faucet stem, so it simply couldn't snap into place. I looked at it carefully, thinking about how to solve it. Directly replacing the decorative cover would be too costly, and the customer might not be satisfied anyway. Content: Originally, I came to install the squat toilet water tank. However, the customer had relatively high requirements. They asked me to help fix the decorative cover of this faucet. The decorative cover of the customer's faucet couldn't be installed because the faucet spout was too deep, and the hole in the decorative cover was too large. The hollow part of the decorative cover was much thicker than the faucet stem, so it simply couldn't snap into place. I looked at it carefully, thinking about how to solve it. Directly replacing the decorative cover would be too costly, and the customer might not be satisfied anyway. I had a sudden idea and decided to modify it myself. First, I removed the faucet and the decorative cover. Then, using pliers, I carefully cut several small notches in the hollow part of the decorative cover. You have to be careful when cutting not to damage it. After cutting a few small notches, the decorative cover could snap perfectly onto the square part of the faucet near the threads. Finally, I reinstalled the faucet and then put the decorative cover back on. Perfect! The decorative cover fit tightly against the wall, just covering the water outlet. The customer was very happy and praised my skill. This job, which looks simple, actually requires some thought. Sometimes, the right tool can solve many problems. If you encounter a similar problem next time, you can also try this method.

Title: Michelin Two-Star Feast, ca vaut le voyage Content: The annual anticipation, the Michelin Star Feast at Chongqing Regent Hotel. This year's guest chef is Guillaume Bracaval, the Executive Chef of Cuisine[s] Michel Troisgros in Japan, which has held two Michelin stars for 12 consecutive years. He presents a unique two-star feast blending classical French foundations with traditional and innovative techniques. Foodie Encyclopedia: Cuisine[s] Michel Troisgros in Tokyo opened in 2006 and has held two Michelin stars for 12 consecutive years. It is helmed by Michel Troisgros, the third-generation chef-owner of the French restaurant "Troisgros," which maintained three Michelin stars for 50 years. The [s] in the restaurant's name signifies embracing diverse flavors and forms based on traditional French classics, reflecting Michel Troisgros's personal style developed through years of world travel and culinary inspiration. The brilliance of French chefs lies in their layered sauces: sauce is the glory and radiance of French cuisine, paired with premium ingredients like Japanese sea bream sashimi, French duck liver, Australian M8 wagyu beef... luxury is evident. This experience was a five-course lunch: The first course started with seasonal chestnuts and black truffle—a small bite sent the truffle's aroma swirling, offering a delightful surprise. The appetizer featured Japanese sea bream sashimi with the chef's special sauce, garnished with caper buds, using Cuisine[s] Michel Troisgros's signature subtle acidity to eliminate any fishy taste. The third course, French duck liver, burdock, and onion soup, broke from the usual pan-seared approach by pouring French onion soup over it. Eating the soup with burdock paid homage to the restaurant's French roots with a Japanese touch. The main course featured Robinson's Steakhouse classic Australian M6 wagyu beef and rare roasted celeriac, ignited with a truffle port wine sauce for a passionate twist. Dessert was a seasonal citrus tart on a cream base—one spoonful captivated with its tangy flavor. Chef Guillaume Bracaval started with autumn-foraged black truffles and ended with early winter's fresh citrus tart. The five-course lunch was exquisite and enchanting, overflowing with French elegance and subtle Japanese influences, like wind under the moon or stars at dusk, returning to earth to appreciate seasonal beauty. After the meal, one thought came to mind, akin to Yayoi Kusama's perseverance: all the warmth in life, I must generate myself. Borrowing a phrase from the Michelin Guide: ca vaut le voyage—worth the journey. Spending Tips: 1. Five-course lunch 888+ / Eight-course dinner 1688+ (includes wine). 2. Available only from November 22-24, six seatings.

Title: My new cat fought with me, lost, and became withdrawn. What should I do? Content: First, let me say: Hahaha, score 6. You could try not to immediately view this feline 'domestic dispute' as a failed adoption. Instead, approach it from the perspective of cat psychology and behavior to see if there are ways to ease the situation. 1. This is likely 'resource anxiety' leading to a bruised ego. When you play with the new cat, its intense reaction might be because it hasn't established a foundation of trust with you, its 'human cohabitant.' Especially within the first three days of arriving in a new home, many cats are in a state of high alert. If they feel their boundaries are 'invaded,' they will strike. It hitting you might be because it sees you as a cat that doesn't follow the rules; you hitting it back makes it even more upset, feeling it has lost. After being defeated, behaviors like hiding in small corners and only coming out at night are classic 'withdrawn' actions, indicating it's trying to avoid and self-soothe. What you need to do now is 'give it a way to save face,' not 'fight again to win back.' 2. Suggested steps you can take: 1. Temporarily reduce direct contact: Maintain basic care, but don't proactively initiate interaction, allowing it to slowly regain confidence. 2. Use treats to build a connection: Feed treats or canned food at scheduled times, each time calling its name beforehand to associate you with positive things. 3. Use toys instead of hand interaction: Use wand toys, laser pointers, etc., instead of your own hands to avoid it thinking 'you are challenging it again.' 4. Consider using synthetic calming pheromones: Products like Feliway can sometimes have good effects on stressed cats. 5. Provide high hiding spots: Let it have a safe place to hide, like the top of a bookshelf or a high platform on a cat tree, so it doesn't feel it can only hide in corners to 'exile itself.' 3. Should you consider returning the cat? Three days is far too short a time to consider giving up. But you can keep the communication channel open with the previous owner, giving yourself an out (e.g., agree to observe for a week) to avoid excessive psychological pressure. 4. Stop 'retaliating.' A cat is not your elementary school desk mate. Hitting a cat will only destroy trust, not 'win back face.' It's like venting at your boss won't get you a raise. Give each other some time, give it a sense of security, and give yourself a chance too.

Title: Lower Your Center of Gravity When Playing Badminton to Improve Your Defensive Skills Against Smashes Content: In badminton singles matches, the importance of defensive ability is self-evident. If you can successfully defend against your opponent's attacks, your chances of winning the match increase significantly. However, returning a smash is not easy when facing a fierce offensive. Here's a small tip I find quite useful: lower your center of gravity when defending against a smash. You might say, isn't that obvious? Of course I know to lower my center of gravity, and I already do that. So why am I still struggling with smashes? I think the reason might be that I'm not lowering my center of gravity enough. From my observations, professional players lower their center of gravity first and then move laterally to return smashes. If you look closely at the movement of their rackets, the trajectory is basically a line parallel to the ground. But when I try to return a smash, I find it very difficult to get my center of gravity that low. This leads to the following situation: if the opponent's smash is flat and the landing point is far away, my racket's movement trajectory is also a line parallel to the ground, and the quality of my return is good. However, if the opponent's smash is steep and lands close to the net, my racket's trajectory becomes a downward diagonal line. In this case, the quality of my return is poor; the shuttlecock often goes into the net, and I lose my balance. I thought about why this happens. Through repetitive training, the grip when moving laterally becomes almost fixed. As long as the racket face makes contact, you can direct the shuttlecock to the desired angle. But when moving diagonally downward, each situation is different, requiring constant adjustment of the grip – it's like using a new stance every time. Furthermore, you have to move the racket down while simultaneously hitting the shuttlecock upwards, which increases the difficulty and the error rate. Another point: don't you think professional players make diving saves look easy? But when I can't reach the shuttlecock on court and want to dive, I can't seem to do it – I'm afraid it will hurt when I hit the ground. This is also because my center of gravity isn't low enough. Professional players basically glide along the ground when they dive. For me, it's more like falling flat. The impact is too great; even if I force myself down, it's hard to get up quickly. Since lowering the center of gravity has so many benefits, why can't I do it? The most important reason is insufficient leg strength. The lower you go, the more strength you need to move. This is quite difficult for amateur players like me. Also, if the opponent doesn't smash but plays a flat clear, without enough leg strength, you'll just be stuck standing there. So, it all comes back to the foundation: physical fitness. To improve your ability to return smashes, lower your center of gravity when your opponent smashes. To get your center of gravity even lower, you need to improve your physical fitness. Therefore, technical improvement and physical conditioning are both indispensable. For me, I still need a lot more practice. Source: ddxxll2008 Return to Sohu, view more

Title: What are the consequences of a tooth cracking after root canal treatment? Content: Generally, teeth become brittle after root canal treatment, and it's usually necessary to place a post and crown depending on the situation. After crowning, it won't crack but might have a root fracture. However, molars usually don't have this issue if you're careful. It's recommended to get a metal crown for the back tooth. For an economical and healthy option, choose a cobalt-chromium material. If you have the means, go for precious metals (palladium, gold) or titanium alloy. If you're very wealthy, consider zirconia. Don't worry, with good technique, there should be no major problems for twenty years. After twenty years, you can replace the post with a better material and use it for another twenty years. By then, probably other teeth will be gone too, so just get dentures. I got a cobalt-chromium one, and it's fine. I don't feel uncomfortable, and there's a post inside, very sturdy. For back teeth, it's advised not to get porcelain-fused-to-metal crowns as they are relatively brittle and prone to wear. Just get a big steel tooth, hehe.

Title: Didi-like Business Hindered, Are Sharing Economy Projects Doomed to Misfortune? Content: Due to the introduction of online car-hailing policies, 90% of drivers in cities like Beijing and Shanghai do not meet the local household registration requirements stipulated by the policies, significantly impacting Didi's ride-hailing business. If we say Didi has affected the traditional taxi business, it is not enough to warrant such severe restrictions; rather, the Didi model has mobilized private cars that were originally parked, increasing the proportion of cars on the road, leading to worsened traffic congestion and air pollution, which might be the main reason for the restrictions. According to foreign media reports, San Francisco regulators have just thrown cold water on the short-term rental platform Airbnb. The city's Board of Supervisors proposed today that Airbnb hosts be limited to renting out their properties for no more than 60 days per year. Before this regulation was introduced, the tug-of-war between Airbnb and San Francisco government departments had been ongoing for a long time, and the new rule will have a major impact on Airbnb. Globally, Airbnb services cover over 200 countries, with nearly 200 million rental listings on the platform. The company's services have long been controversial among legislators. Regulators in other cities worldwide are also watching San Francisco's stance, hoping its government departments can explore the best regulatory model. Therefore, this new rule might affect Airbnb's operating environment in other cities globally. Two of the most representative sharing economy projects have encountered policy restrictions. Will other projects share the same fate? From the perspective of bike-sharing, it meets pedestrians' short-distance travel needs and reduces people's dependence on cars, making it a project worth promoting and supporting. Domestic projects like ofo and Mobike, which have been gradually gaining momentum, have also received strong capital backing. However, inevitable problems have emerged, such as users hiding bikes, intentional damage, improper parking, adding private locks, etc., challenging moral and legal awareness. But these issues should not hinder the progress of these projects; I believe these problems will be gradually resolved. The most worrying aspect is their profitability; currently, bike-sharing projects have not presented sufficiently promising profit points. Furthermore, media can also be shared. The advertising industry is a traditional sector that has developed over decades or even centuries. With the development of the internet and mobile internet, new media's market share is increasing. For example, Tencent's advertising revenue has risen from 5% to 40%. While the gaming business continues to grow rapidly, advertising revenue is increasing even more sharply. It is reported that Tencent's strong revenue growth, driven by mobile games and advertising, led to a 43% year-on-year increase in net profit for the third fiscal quarter. The company's net profit increased from 7.44 billion yuan in the same period last year to 10.65 billion yuan (approximately 1.55 billion USD). Revenue during the same period surged 52% to 40.39 billion yuan. The company's revenue mainly comes from releasing games and advertisements through its social platforms like WeChat and QQ. WeChat Moments ads are one of the important forms of Tencent's advertising. Besides Tencent itself having an投放入口 (placement portal?), companies can use third-party platforms to share on WeChat. For example, Gougou Cloud Platform is a new marketing platform under the sharing economy where everyone becomes media. Users are compensated for sharing to self-media channels like WeChat, Moments, and Weibo, sharing with friends and achieving裂变传播 (viral spread). This turns customers into corporate promoters, instantly giving enterprises a庞大的云推广团队 (huge cloud promotion team) to help them achieve growth. In reality, we should not worry about the sharing economy because projects like Didi and Airbnb face obstacles. The integration of sharing models into traditional fields requires a gradual adaptation process. It needs to digest the adverse effects of rapid expansion, but ultimately, the development of the sharing economy will certainly bring great benefits to society and individuals. We look forward to better projects emerging.

Title: Case Study on the Principle of Good Faith in the Civil Code Era (Part 1) - Shanghai First Intermediate People's Court
Content: Shanghai First Intermediate People's Court, Civil Code Good Faith Case Tour: Air Passenger "Gets" Platinum Card but is Downgraded Due to "Improper Conduct"
I. Case Summary
Yang Gaoxiang became a Platinum Card member of China Eastern Airlines' "Eastern Miles" program starting July 2016 by accumulating points and flight segments. China Eastern Airlines issued him a Platinum Card, with membership number 640279955314. As of December 3, 2018, he had 432,999 consumption points, plus 547,000 points pending from his ticket refunds not yet credited.
On July 1, 2013, China Eastern Airlines launched the "Elite Plan," offering coupons ("Elite Coupons") to passengers who purchased and completed travel on China Eastern's official website or mobile E-channel, redeemable for discounts on future ticket purchases. According to the "User Guidelines" provided by China Eastern, these coupons were valid for 180 calendar days after the flight date. Participants were required to participate in the Elite Plan in good faith, protect system security, not maliciously exploit or abuse the benefits, and China Eastern reserved the right to hold users liable for losses caused by violations, involving criminal activity reported to judicial authorities.
Yang Gaoxiang purchased and flew on China Eastern flights, obtaining a large number of Elite Coupons. To extend their validity, he used them to purchase tickets for potentially delayed flights and then refunded them (refunds returned the coupons to his account with validity extended by one month, and delayed flights qualified for full refunds). Starting March 2017, Yang exhibited frequent purchase-and-refund behavior. Examples include: buying 6 tickets for flight FM9128 on March 27, 2017, and refunding all shortly after; similar patterns for flights MU2936, FM9298, MU2309, MU2491, MU5622, MU2654 on various dates, involving multiple tickets purchased close to departure and later refunded. From January 2017 to January 2019, Yang purchased 1,118 tickets, refunded 830, and used only 161.
After discovering this, China Eastern emailed Yang on November 27 and December 4, 2018, notifying him that due to multiple actions exploiting his Platinum status, disrupting operations, and harming company interests, violating the Membership Handbook clause 4, his account was downgraded to Standard Card and would close on December 31, 2018. His 432,999 points could be used if he contacted member services seven working days in advance. Yang complained to China Eastern and authorities.
It was also found that the Membership Handbook stated members could only accrue points in one frequent flyer program simultaneously. Clause 4 specified that abuse of the program (including rule violations; selling/buying/trading awards; misreporting; other improper conduct deemed by China Eastern, such as violating partner rules, harassing staff, etc.) could result in account termination, forfeiture of points and awards, and liability for fare differences. China Eastern reserved the right to take legal action.
The first-instance court held: 1) The contract based on the Membership Handbook was valid. Although it was a standard form contract and Clause 4 limited Yang's rights, it did not create imbalance and was binding. 2) Yang's refund behavior violated the contract. Considering the volume, timing (after scheduled departure), and purpose, his actions lacked legitimacy and violated the principle of good faith, falling under Clause 4's "improper conduct." 3) China Eastern had the right to close the account and cancel points per the contractual termination clause. The court did not support China Eastern's claim about dual point accrual due to insufficient evidence. Citing Contract Law Articles 8, 39, 93, and 96, the court rejected all of Yang's claims.
Yang appealed to Shanghai First Intermediate People's Court, arguing: 1) He did not abuse rights; 2) The Handbook was a standard contract, and China Eastern failed to adequately highlight terms, making the clause invalid; 3) The clause was ambiguous, so China Eastern couldn't exercise contractual termination, only statutory termination.
China Eastern responded: 1) Yang's frequent purchases/refunds severely impacted ticket sales, caused losses, and harmed other passengers, lacking good faith; 2) Their actions per the Handbook were justified.
II. Key Issues
1) Validity of the relevant Handbook clauses; 2) Whether Yang engaged in improper conduct; 3) Whether China Eastern had the right to cancel Yang's points.
III. Judgment Reasoning
The appellate court reviewed whether Yang's actions constituted abuse of rights, the clause validity, and point cancellation rights.
First, regarding clause validity: The Handbook, given industry specifics, was customary and compliant with Contract Law. Yang, through his actions and membership duration, was deemed aware of its contents. Thus, a contract was formed. Although a standard form, China Eastern had fulfilled提示义务, and the clauses did not unfairly exempt its duties or加重Yang's responsibilities; they were valid and binding.
Second, regarding improper conduct: The court interpreted Clause 4 based on wording, context, custom, and good faith. Yang's actions constituted "other improper conduct." Contract Law Article 60 requires good faith performance. Yang's conduct violated this principle. His extremely low ticket usage rate (14.40%) and high refund rate (74.24%), including 30 instances of buying multiple tickets for the same flight and refunding all, contradicted the contract's purpose. If allowed, it could lead to empty flights, harming airline operations. His method to extend coupon validity abused the system,占用resources, impaired ticket resale, harmed China Eastern's interests, and affected other passengers. Thus, his behavior was improper.
Third, regarding point cancellation: Per Contract Law Article 93, China Eastern had the right to terminate the contract due to Yang's improper conduct. The Handbook stipulated forfeiture of accumulated points for abuse. The 547,000 points from refunds were rightly canceled. Yang's request to restore these points and invoke statutory termination was rejected.
However, for the 432,999 points legitimately earned, they had property attributes. When closing the account, China Eastern must strictly follow the Handbook. Clause 1 required at least 6 months' notice before terminating the program to minimize member loss. Contract Law Article 41 states ambiguous standard terms should be interpreted against the drafter. China Eastern argued the 6-month notice was for industry-wide changes, not individual misconduct, but provided no evidence. The court interpreted this against China Eastern, ruling the 6-month notice period applied here. China Eastern's failure to give notice violated the Handbook. Thus, Yang's request to restore these 432,999 points was supported. Yang's claim for damages due to downgrading/closure was rejected for lack of evidence. Regarding the 220 Elite Coupons, both parties acknowledged they were usable at first instance, and no evidence showed China Eastern restricted their use, so the request to restore them was rejected.
IV. Judge's Commentary
Presiding Judge Tang Chunlei stated that both parties, as civil subjects, must adhere to contract terms and basic civil principles. Yang must follow good faith; the Handbook's non-exhaustive list of improper conduct doesn't permit boundless behavior. China Eastern should improve contract terms and strictly comply; its failure to provide advance notice for point cancellation was also improper, hence the appellate adjustment.

Title: What to do if there is an odor after installing soundproof windows? Content: Most homeowners who install soundproof windows have already moved in, meaning they basically move in on the same day after installation, so the product needs to be environmentally friendly. Our most direct impression of soundproof windows is whether they have a pungent smell. There are three possible sources of odor in soundproof windows: sealing strips, glass sealant, and foam sealant. The odor from glass sealant and foam sealant can dissipate after a period of time. Good glass sealant has a slight smell and usually dissipates completely within two or three days. The odor from sealing strips is harder to dissipate because they are made of EPDM material, which takes time to off-gas. Even after closing the windows and doors and sealing the room for a while, there may still be some odor. Solution: If the odor persists after a week, choose better quality sealing glass glue and foam sealant. Replace the strips with silicone ones. Note: Ventilate the room well after installing soundproof windows. If you have questions or need after-sales service, contact the merchant. Title: Can I do IVF if I have the 'small three positives'? Content: Patients with 'small three positives' can undergo in vitro fertilization (IVF). If a woman with 'small three positives' wants to do IVF, she must ensure normal liver function. Pregnancy is possible when liver function is normal, whether through natural conception or IVF. If liver function is abnormal, liver-protecting or antiviral treatment is necessary. After treatment, once liver function remains stable within the normal range, normal pregnancy can proceed. After conception, women with 'small three positives' need to monitor liver function and viral load. Regardless of artificial insemination or natural conception, monitoring viral load in the later stages of pregnancy is crucial for mother-to-child transmission blocking. If the viral load is high, oral antiviral therapy is required for blocking. After birth, the newborn needs hepatitis B vaccine and hepatitis B immunoglobulin for blocking.
