Title: Can I get a bank loan if I have recent online loans? Content: Xiamen Bank loan, many online loans, just a regular office worker, can I get a loan with existing loans? Having many online loans can be broken down into many situations. Generally, if there are many online loans, the number of loan accounts is also likely high. If you are not using new loans to repay old ones, the number of credit inquiries might not be high. However, if you are using loans to repay other loans, the number of inquiries will definitely be high. When caught in a cycle of using loans to repay loans, what you need to do is secure a single loan large enough to pay off all the existing online loans, close those accounts, reduce the total monthly loan repayment burden, and stop the cycle of debt. Only then can you start to rebuild your credit. So, under what circumstances can someone with many online loans get a new loan, or are there products available? First and foremost, your income must be sufficient. This means that after covering living expenses, the remaining funds must be enough to cover the new loan's monthly payment. If it's clearly insufficient, you definitely won't qualify. For example, if your online loan repayments total over 20,000 per month, but your salary is 15,000, and you want a 200,000 loan with a 3-year term (monthly payment around 7,000), your 15,000 salary is clearly enough. Therefore, some offline communication-based products are certainly feasible. So, when you have many online loans, you need a solution tailored to your specific situation. Because 100 people will have 100 different situations, it's impossible to explain each one in detail.

Title: Man Induced Underage Girls to Send Indecent Photos, Recognized as "Virtual Sexual Assault" and Sentenced to 7.5 Years. Court: Parents Should Prevent Online Sexual Abuse. Content: On December 21, the Huaying City People's Court in Guang'an, Sichuan Province, announced a case of "virtual sexual assault," sentencing the defendant Xia Mouxiong to seven years and six months in prison for the crime of child molestation. It is understood that from May 2020 to August 2021, the defendant Xia Mouxiong added eight victims, including Qi and Huang, all under eight years old, as friends through social software. After gaining their trust by sharing games and common interests, he induced the victims to send nude pictures or engage in video calls to molest them. ▲Reference picture from IC photo. The Huaying City People's Court held that the defendant, Xia Mouxiong, to satisfy his desires, knowing the victims were children under 14, used the internet via platforms like Douyin and WeChat to request multiple victims to send nude/sensitive area photos and videos for viewing, induced them to perform obscene acts nude during video chats, and recorded the screens. His actions violated the criminal law, constituting child molestation, and he was sentenced accordingly. So, what is "virtual sexual assault"? It refers to illegal acts where perpetrators, for sexual stimulation, use the internet under pretenses like "personal交友" or "recruiting child stars" to deceive or coerce minors into "nude chats" or sending "nude photos/videos." Unlike traditional physical contact, "virtual sexual assault" is more hidden and harmful. Forcing minors under 14 to send private part photos/videos or engage in nude chats, even without physical contact, seriously infringes on their dignity and mental health, with the same social harm as physical molestation, and should be recognized as child molestation. Judge's reminder: To prevent online sexual abuse, parents should take these measures: Online sexual abuse tactics are varied; be cautious with online交友! With the internet's rapid development, platforms like WeChat, Douyin, and Kuaishou have emerged, and younger users are increasing. The mixed online information and diverse abuse tactics make minors prone to deception due to lack of experience and filtering ability. Parents should: 1. Strengthen supervision: Monitor minors' use of phones/computers, guide their interests reasonably. 2. Actively care: Communicate with children, provide adolescence and sex education, understand their thoughts. 3. Don't trust easily: Educate minors not to trust online sweet talk, protect privacy, don't share with strangers, don't add strangers, don't meet online friends. Red Star News reporter Wang Chao, editor Guo Yu, responsible editor Wei Kongming.

Title: Handling Status of CPPCC Members' Proposals by the Autonomous Region Civil Affairs Department in 2020 Content: Government Information Disclosure Handling Status of CPPCC Members' Proposals by the Autonomous Region Civil Affairs Department in 2020 Release Date: 2020-10-13 Share: [Font Size: Large Medium Small] In 2020, our department handled a total of 23 proposals from the Third Session of the 12th Autonomous Region CPPCC Committee, including 2 solely handled proposals and 21 jointly handled proposals; 18 proposals received Category A responses, and 5 received Category B responses. By the end of September, written responses had been provided for all 23 proposals, and the results were uploaded via the CPPCC proposal handling platform. Simultaneously, the handling status was promptly disclosed on the government supervision website and the department's portal, achieving a 100% response and disclosure rate, successfully completing the handling of CPPCC members' proposals. I. Approach to Handling CPPCC Proposals The department's Party leadership highly values the handling of CPPCC proposals, treating it as an important task to deeply understand public sentiment, fully reflect public opinion, broadly pool collective wisdom, accept supervision from CPPCC members, and enhance civil affairs capabilities. After the assignment meeting, the deputy director in charge immediately convened a meeting to study and deploy the handling work, requiring responsible offices to prioritize this task, focus on issues raised by members, and take strong measures to ensure quality responses, aiming to promote work and fulfill public expectations. (1) Strengthening Organizational Leadership Incorporating proposal handling into key tasks, requiring all handling units to raise standards, establish scientific mechanisms, innovate methods, and fully enhance handling work. Clearly defining responsible leaders, units, and individuals, strictly implementing the leadership responsibility system, forming a mechanism where top leaders oversee overall responsibility, deputy leaders handle specifics, and offices/functional units execute. Including proposal handling in annual performance evaluations for all offices, refining assessment methods based on attitude, approach, progress, and outcomes to strengthen accountability. Requiring deputy leaders to personally lead unit heads in studying each proposal, identifying issues, setting goals, and ensuring implementation with a highly responsible attitude, making the process one of conscious acceptance of supervision and promotion of scientific decision-making. (2) Standardizing Handling Procedures Focusing on quality and efficiency, strictly following procedures and requirements outlined in CPPCC proposal handling rules, revising the department's implementation plan for handling NPC representatives' suggestions and CPPCC proposals, further standardizing the process, and advancing handling with high standards. Designating relevant offices to draft responses, reviewed by office heads, approved by deputy leaders, then uniformly formatted and content-checked by the general office before leadership final approval and official documentation. The general office enhances coordination and supervision, identifying reasons for delays and urging progress to improve quality and timeliness. (3) Innovating Work Methods Adopting a 'dual interaction approach' to strengthen service awareness, gain member support, foster collaboration, involve members in the process, and ensure their understanding and satisfaction before responses. This includes: Communication and Feedback: Upon receiving proposals, handling units immediately contact members to understand intent and seek input; during handling, actively invite member participation to jointly find solutions and accept supervision; after response,高度重视 member feedback, re-handling if dissatisfied. For issues hard to resolve promptly, explain situations honestly and sincerely. (4) Emphasizing Practical Effectiveness Integrating with Key Tasks: Focusing on issues and suggestions raised, especially difficult or hot topics, studying work plans, setting goals, with top leaders personally overseeing key proposals to accelerate implementation and promote sustainable development. Integrating with Research: Systematically incorporating hot and difficult issues from proposals into annual research plans, concentrating efforts on urgent problems to propose targeted solutions, addressing recurring proposals. Integrating with On-site Supervision: When handling key proposals, inviting representatives beyond the proposers to participate, accepting their suggestions and supervision. II. Using Proposals as Motivation to Comprehensively Promote Civil Affairs Work In 2020, proposals handled involved elderly care service system construction, social organization registration management, and social affairs. These well-targeted suggestions reflected CPPCC members' high concern for livelihoods and civil affairs. Our department attached great importance, responding promptly to drive regional civil affairs development, achieving significant results in key public-focused areas. (1) Elderly Care Service System Addressing proposals like No. 0281 on improving community elderly care, No. 0078 on rural elderly care, and No. 0651 on enhancing community elderly care services, we explored development paths based on regional realities. The Autonomous Region Government issued documents like 'Opinions on Accelerating Elderly Care Service Industry Development' and 'Implementation Opinions on Fully Opening the Elderly Care Market and Improving Service Quality'. The Civil Affairs Department, with health, housing, and market supervision departments, issued guidelines to clarify service targets, content, methods, and providers, offering policy support. Accelerating reform pilots for home and community care, with Hohhot, Baotou, and Wuhai designated as national pilot areas since 2019, receiving central funds of 50.02 million yuan to support pilots. Speeding up community daytime care center construction, providing 200,000 yuan per new center via rewards. 906 centers built region-wide, using the 12349 hotline to offer home assistance like cleaning, emergency aid, and medical support. Encouraging social forces like Nei Mongol Shoukang and Huidé to operate embedded, small-scale community facilities, extending institutional services to homes. (2) Social Organization Registration Management Addressing proposal No. 0699 on supporting healthy rapid development of social organizations, we issued documents like 'Direct Registration Measures for Social Organizations in Nei Mongol Autonomous Region (Trial)' and 'Notice on Canceling Some Administrative Approval Items and Delegating Management Levels'. Conducted government purchases from social organizations from 2014-2019, allocating 94 million yuan from lottery funds for services like home care for elderly, disability care, community social work, and training, benefiting over 170,000 directly and nearly 200,000 indirectly. Promoted incubation parks for social organizations, providing free offices and consulting; 86 bases established, incubating 2,563 organizations. Conducted random inspections ('double random, one public') for non-compliant organizations, disbanding 42 illegal ones and revoking 147 at the autonomous region level. (3) Social Affairs Addressing proposal No. 0018 on strict enforcement of burial systems to avoid farmland burials, coordinated with development reform and finance departments to increase funding and project support in funeral services, improving public facilities, prioritizing public ossuaries, and building public cemeteries. Since the 13th Five-Year Plan, central and regional investments of 130 million yuan funded 22 new funeral parlors, 11 renovations, 53 cremation facility upgrades, 11 public cemeteries, and 10 public ossuaries. Regional annual cremation reached 77,000 bodies, 51% rate. In 2019, 13 departments conducted special rectification on illegal 'residential-style' tombs, inspecting and rectifying 27 sites. Issued a notice with public security, natural resources, and forestry departments to establish a long-term mechanism, clarifying departmental responsibilities, regular inspections, and combing 'blocking with疏导' to manage scattered burials, preventing resurgence. III. Next Steps In future proposal handling, we will focus on: Strengthening Organizational Leadership: Continuing to prioritize proposal handling and follow-ups, with top leaders responsible, deputies in charge, and offices executing, ensuring each proposal is implemented. Improving Procedures: Refining responsibility systems, standardizing processes, clarifying tasks, and enhancing methods to boost effectiveness. Enhancing Supervision: Increasing coordination and oversight, ensuring scientific assignment, guidance, multi-party coordination, and proper implementation. Conducting regular inspections with relevant offices to ensure suggestions are truly落实.

Title: Can Huabei still be used after my ID card expires? Content: After the ID card expires, Huabei can still be used for a short period, but if it remains expired for a long time, it will affect the normal use of Huabei and Alipay. Here is a detailed explanation: Short-term impact: In the initial stage after the ID card expires, the Huabei function is usually not immediately restricted, and you can still continue to use Huabei for consumption. Long-term impact: If the ID card remains expired for too long, Alipay will, in accordance with regulatory requirements, impose batch restrictions on users with expired ID cards. At that point, not only will the Huabei function be affected, but the use of the entire Alipay account will also be impacted to varying degrees. Recommendation to update document information promptly: To avoid inconvenience caused by an expired ID card when using Alipay and Huabei, it is recommended that you update your document information promptly. After renewing your ID card, you can log in to Alipay and follow the path [My] -> [Top Profile Bar] -> [Identity Authentication] -> [Document Photos] to upload color pictures of the front and back of your ID card for review to complete the update of your document information. In summary, although Huabei can still be used initially after the ID card expires, it is recommended to update your document information promptly to avoid potential risks.

Title: Chuo River Water Pollution Incident, Principal Responsible Person of Quanjiao County Committee Has Been Dismissed, Previously an Official Said They Shouldn't Interfere Too Much as They Retire in Two Months, How to View This Matter? Content: The Chuo River water pollution incident originated from a fire at the raw material warehouse of Quanjiao County Fuxin Petroleum Additive Co., Ltd., leading to a large amount of pollutants flowing into nearby ditches and pipelines. Subsequently, due to rainfall and improper decision-making, these pollutants eventually entered the Chuo River, causing massive deaths of fish and shrimp and water pollution. This incident attracted widespread social attention and concern from higher authorities. Quanjiao County took measures such as building dams to intercept and pump pollutants, collecting and storing part of the leaked pollutants for treatment. The Anhui Provincial Government and the Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection formed a joint investigation team to thoroughly investigate the Chuo River water pollution incident, identified the cause of the incident, and pointed out relevant responsibilities. The principal responsible comrade of the Quanjiao County Committee has been dismissed, and relevant responsible persons are under investigation. This measure demonstrates the importance attached by higher authorities to this matter and their zero-tolerance attitude towards dereliction of duty. During the incident handling process, an official stated that 'they will retire in two months' and shouldn't interfere too much. This attitude is extremely irresponsible and seriously violates the duties and missions of Party members and cadres. When facing major ecological and environmental damage incidents, any Party member or cadre should engage in the handling work with a high sense of responsibility and mission, rather than using personal retirement as an excuse to shirk responsibility. The Chuo River water pollution incident is a major ecological and environmental damage event with very serious consequences and egregious nature. It not only caused severe damage to the local ecological environment but also significantly impacted the production and life of the people. For this incident, accountability must be pursued according to laws, regulations, and facts. Cadres who are derelict in their duties must be dealt with according to cadre management authority and relevant laws and regulations. At the same time, supervision and penalties for the involved enterprises must be strengthened to prevent similar incidents from recurring. This incident also exposed problems such as low political awareness, lax and unrealistic work styles, and weak procedural and legal consciousness among a few Party members and cadres. Therefore, while strengthening supervision and accountability, attention should also be paid to enhancing work style construction and improving the political quality and professional ability of Party members and cadres.

Title: Why does the face turn red after wet compress?_Baidu Knows Content: The reasons for red cheeks after wet compress may be allergies, or it could be due to excessive temperature differences. It might be caused by prolonged mask application leading to severe skin hydration, or using too many masks which prevents the skin from retaining moisture.\x0d\x0aSo although wet compress is a way to hydrate the skin, incorrect methods or wrong product choices can also cause facial redness and allergies. Facial redness is a sign of allergy; if there is itching and swelling during wet compress, it must be taken seriously because the next step could be acne or disrupted circulation causing the entire face to become abnormally swollen.\x0d\x0aTherefore, when doing wet compress, choose masks from reputable brands to avoid product selection errors and prevent facial allergies. After applying the mask, wash it off before skincare. Some people store masks in the refrigerator, but the temperature in the fridge is too low. Applying a mask directly from the fridge may irritate the face due to the cold, leading to redness and swelling. This is a phenomenon caused by temperature differences, so masks taken from the fridge can be warmed in lukewarm water before use.\x0d\x0aThe recommended mask application time is generally 15-20 minutes. Exceeding this duration can cause severe skin hydration from the mask ingredients, potentially leading to skin suffocation in severe cases. Overusing masks can also prevent the skin from retaining moisture, resulting in redness and swelling.\x0d\x0aFor more information on why the face turns red after wet compress, visit: https://www.abcgonglue.com/ask/bcab2c1615827145.html?zd to see more content

Title: Thumbs up! Huimin Traffic Police Race Against Time to Open a "Life Channel" for a Premature Baby Content: Huimin Bang, 1 in every 6 Huimin people follows. Time is life, and the police call is an order. After understanding the situation, the police immediately turned on the police lights, sounded the siren, and continuously used a loudspeaker to signal other vehicles along the route to yield. Title: "Micro Reminder" Tinnitus, Brain Ringing - Identifying the Cause is Key Content: Tinnitus, Brain Ringing - Identifying the Cause is Key 2019-6-3 Elderly Newspaper Page 8 Guiding Expert: Liu Peng, Deputy Director, Chief Physician of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and Professor of the Otolaryngology Department, The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine Reporter: Cai Weiyang Correspondent: Zhang Qiuxia, Suo Zhuoqi Reader Auntie Yu's Letter: My left ear started having tinnitus sounds over a year ago. Recently, not only has the tinnitus in my left ear become louder, but my left brain has also started experiencing brain ringing, leading to very poor sleep quality. Sometimes I can only sleep for one or two hours, and my body has started developing other minor issues. This makes me very anxious. May I ask how exactly should I regulate and treat this? Answer: Auntie Yu's tinnitus or brain ringing are different manifestations of tinnitus and have no essential difference. A detailed treatment and regulation plan can only be carried out after identifying the cause. Tinnitus and Brain Ringing Should First Identify the Cause For some people experiencing tinnitus or brain ringing, the first step is to find the cause. Liu Peng, Deputy Director of the Otolaryngology Department at The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine, stated that when tinnitus occurs, it is generally first necessary to check through hearing and ear examinations whether it is caused by ear problems. Subsequently, CT scans and other tests may be used to rule out whether it is caused by cranial issues. Currently, the cause of some tinnitus cases remains difficult to identify. However, tinnitus patients should not underestimate the importance of examination, especially since some tumor diseases can also trigger tinnitus. If it is unilateral tinnitus, attention should be paid to whether it is an auditory nerve lesion. A non-invasive ABR examination can be首选ed to rule out if it is caused by an acoustic neuroma; some cases can be confirmed with CT or MRI scans. Furthermore, tinnitus patients in the Guangdong and Guangxi regions need to be extra cautious about whether it is caused by nasopharyngeal cancer; early examination is very important. Additionally, Liu Peng reminded that if no disease is found through examinations in people with tinnitus or brain ringing, it is also necessary to investigate whether it is caused by long-term use of medications such as antihypertensive drugs, lipid-lowering drugs, or aspirin. Body Imbalance Can Also Cause Persistent Tinnitus and Brain Ringing However, if the cause truly cannot be found, then this tinnitus or brain ringing is likely caused by an imbalance in the body. Liu Peng explained that Traditional Chinese Medicine believes the ear has extensive connections with other organs and meridians. Imbalances in the qi and blood of the five zang and six fu organs and the twelve meridians can all lead to tinnitus, with spleen and stomach dysfunction being the most common. In other words, when the body is in a state of imbalance—such as staying up late, lack of sleep, improper diet, or poor emotional state—causing the body to be in a dysfunctional state, the body may manifest this through tinnitus or brain ringing. Treating Tinnitus Should Not Turn You into a "Medicine Jar" People with tinnitus can suffer greatly. Tinnitus worsens their mood, leading to insomnia, creating a vicious cycle. When they go to the hospital, they urgently request doctors to prescribe various medications, hoping for an immediate cure. This, however, might turn them into a "medicine jar," and sometimes not only is there no improvement, but the tinnitus may recur or worsen due to some medications. Liu Peng reminded that for tinnitus patients, psychological counseling is particularly important, sometimes even more so than drug therapy. Emotional stability is beneficial for self-regulating the functions of the organs. Traditional Chinese Medicine treatment does not directly suppress tinnitus; instead, it uses Chinese herbs, acupuncture, and配合s with good personal lifestyle habits to help the body gradually recover from the imbalanced state. Tinnitus may gradually ease as the body's condition improves. Link: "Habituation Therapy" May Be Effective for Elderly Tinnitus So far, there are no specific drugs that can cure tinnitus. Clinically, medications are habitually used to treat tinnitus, such as vasodilators, neurotrophic drugs, and drugs that regulate the autonomic nervous system, but none provide clear therapeutic effects. Therefore, sometimes non-pharmacological methods—"Habituation Therapy"—can be used to improve tinnitus. "Habituation Therapy" refers to adaptation or habituation to tinnitus. Simply put, it involves providing the patient with another sound to mask the tinnitus. Generally, it requires two to three years of treatment, and the effectiveness varies from person to person. Commonly used external noise-generating devices include tinnitus maskers, hearing aids, portable audio players, home recorders/players, etc. If you think it's good, please click like ↓

Title: How should compensation be handled when collective land is expropriated for resettlement and the land has already been incorporated into the urban planning area? _ State-owned Land Expropriation and Compensation _ Lanshan County People's Government Content: How should compensation be handled when collective land is expropriated for resettlement and the land has already been incorporated into the urban planning area? • Release Time: 2022-12-02 11:00 • Source: NetEase News • Author: • Font [ Large Medium Small ] "A few years ago, the village posted a notice saying that land would be expropriated, but no compensation or resettlement was carried out for years. Later, the village committee said compensation and resettlement would happen this year, but our area has long been incorporated into the urban planning area, and the compensation standard is still based on the standard from years ago." In recent years, with the continuous increase in highways, railways, and new infrastructure projects, the state's demand for land has grown significantly, and many rural houses and lands have been included in the scope of expropriation. However, some projects have not actually started the expropriation work for various reasons, and compensation and resettlement only begin years later. So, how should the expropriated persons be compensated at this time? Today, we will explain the compensation standards for land expropriation. Generally, the expropriating party should, according to Article 48 of the "Land Management Law" - "Expropriation of land shall provide fair and reasonable compensation, ensuring that the original living standards of the expropriated farmers are not reduced and their long-term livelihoods are secured. Land expropriation shall lawfully, timely, and fully pay land compensation fees, resettlement subsidies, compensation for rural villagers' residences, above-ground attachments, and young crops, and arrange for social security expenses for the expropriated farmers" - compensate the expropriated persons lawfully and timely. For rural villagers' residences involved, it is necessary to follow the principle of "compensation first, relocation later, and improved living conditions," respect the villagers' wishes, provide fair and reasonable compensation through methods such as reallocating homesteads for building houses, providing resettlement housing, or monetary compensation, and also compensate for costs incurred due to the expropriation, such as relocation and temporary安置, to protect the rural villagers' right to residence and legitimate housing property rights and interests. If the expropriated person chooses resettlement housing, the resettlement housing provided by the expropriating party must be roughly equivalent to the area of the actual legal housing, meaning it should be exchanged at a 1:1 ratio. If the expropriated person chooses monetary compensation, it generally needs to be determined based on the actual situation and local relevant regulations. Areas incorporated into the urban planning area should be compensated with reference to the expropriation compensation regulations. In practice, although some rural collective land has been approved for expropriation, for various reasons, the relevant authorities have not lawfully compensated and resettled the houses on the rural collective land, and the houses are still used by the expropriated persons. Years later, when the relevant authorities carry out compensation and resettlement, the location of the houses has been incorporated into the urban planning area, and the surrounding house values have already urbanized. If compensation is still based on the standard for attachments on collective land, it would be difficult to solve the farmers' housing problems. Although, due to different land natures, the expropriation of houses on collective land cannot directly apply the "Regulations on the Expropriation and Compensation of Houses on State-owned Land," because the land where the houses are located has already urbanized, the compensation standards of the "Regulations on the Expropriation and Compensation of Houses on State-owned Land" can be referenced for compensation, but the land compensation fee already obtained needs to be deducted. This is because the compensation for expropriation of houses on state-owned land already includes the land price. If compensation for the land has already been made when expropriating farmers' collective land, then when compensating the expropriated persons according to the standards for expropriation of houses on state-owned land, the land compensation fee already obtained needs to be deducted. In summary, whether it is state-owned land expropriation or collective land expropriation, fair and reasonable compensation must be provided to the expropriated persons, ensuring that their original living standards are not reduced. If the expropriating party fails to carry out compensation and resettlement timely, and during this period, the real estate market prices fluctuate significantly, the expropriated persons should promptly collect relevant evidence and file a lawsuit in court to strive for reasonable拆迁 compensation. They should not simply delay or take extreme actions, as this will only cause significant losses to themselves.

Title: Android is no longer laggy, why do you still buy Apple? Content: Although Android phones have made huge improvements in performance and smoothness, there are still many compelling reasons to choose an iPhone! First, let's acknowledge that Android phones have indeed progressed rapidly; their hardware configurations and optimization technologies make the phones run very smoothly. But the iPhone still has its unique charm: Ecosystem: Apple's ecosystem is seamless. If you already own a MacBook, iPad, or other Apple devices, using an iPhone allows you to enjoy seamless connectivity and data synchronization between devices, such as AirDrop, Handoff, etc. Privacy Protection: Apple excels in privacy protection. Their measures to protect user data are strict, giving users more peace of mind during use. Software Updates: Apple's software updates are very timely and support older devices for a long time. This means that even if your iPhone is a model from several years ago, you can still get the latest iOS updates and security patches. Design and Quality: Apple's design always leads the trend, giving a high-end feel from appearance to touch. Moreover, the manufacturing quality of the iPhone is very high, with good durability. App Store: The quality of apps in the App Store is generally higher, with strict review standards ensuring that every app downloaded by users is safe and reliable. Customer Service: Apple's customer service is famously good, whether it's online support or the Genius Bar in physical stores, providing quick and effective help. Resale Value: iPhones have a relatively high resale value. If you plan to upgrade your phone in the next few years, iPhones usually fetch a good price on the secondary market. When you are working on your MacBook and suddenly need to check a file on your phone, with an iPhone, you can easily transfer it via AirDrop without needing email or other methods. This convenience is hard to match by many Android phones. Of course, everyone's needs and preferences are different, and choosing a phone is a very personal decision. But for me, the iPhone offers more than just a phone; it's a lifestyle and a way of working. That's why, even though Android phones are no longer laggy, I still choose the iPhone. This article is from the WeChat public account VOKAMO

Title: Feeling overwhelmed by stress lately? Public security police's psychological Q&A on epidemic prevention is here! Content: Don't miss out on this official account as you pass by! Click on "Pu'er Police Subscription Account" above to subscribe. During the Spring Festival, the vast number of public security police and auxiliary police officers across the province have been going all out, fighting on the front lines of the prevention and disposal of the novel coronavirus pneumonia outbreak. Faced with the epidemic, the police do not retreat. While protecting their physical health, it is even more important to protect their mental health in order to accumulate energy to fight the epidemic. The Yunnan Provincial Public Security Police Psychological Service Center has compiled several psychological protection questions that frontline police and auxiliary officers are most concerned about, hoping to be helpful to everyone. Q 1. I will not hesitate to throw myself into my work no matter how dangerous it is, but I am still worried and panicked inside. How can I eliminate this emotion? A Fear is a human instinct that protects us from danger; it is a normal emotion. One type of fear comes from not understanding the unknown. Once we understand it, we won't be so afraid. The reason why most medical staff can directly contact patients without getting infected is that they have taken protective measures. As long as we learn about the transmission routes, protection methods, and treatment progress of the disease through authoritative channels, and take protective measures in our daily work, our worry and fear will ease. Q 2. When I encounter members of the public who don't understand or cooperate with my work, it makes me feel depressed and wronged. How should I adjust? A Don't deliberately suppress it; allow yourself to have negative emotions like depression and grievance, and find appropriate ways to express these complex feelings. You have already done very well; others in the same situation might not do better. In fact, the vast majority of the public are grateful, understand the hard work of the police, and appreciate their efforts. It's impossible to take care of everyone at once. When facing uncooperative or ununderstanding members of the public, you can first take a deep breath to adjust your emotions, become aware of your own feelings, then observe, listen, and understand the feelings, needs, and requests of the public, and provide them with feedback, explanations, and suggestions. If necessary, ask colleagues to jointly face the uncooperative public, and afterwards, you need to vent your frustrations to someone you trust. Q 3. When on duty outside, I'm afraid of getting infected. What should I do? A Police officers are also ordinary people, equally at risk of infection, and have normal emotions like everyone else. Feeling nervous, worried, and afraid of infection are normal reactions during such extraordinary times. Therefore, we should: First, understand scientifically by choosing authoritative mainstream information channels to learn reliable knowledge; second, pay moderate attention, controlling the time spent checking related information to no more than 1 hour per day, and ensuring information about the epidemic does not exceed 40% of all information consumed, to avoid unnecessary stress from information overload; third, and most importantly, focus on doing a good job with protective measures: wear masks scientifically, wash hands frequently, disinfect, regularly disinfect items like mobile phones and keys, disinfect shoe soles before entering home, and provide moderate eye protection. Q 4. I feel somewhat helpless after seeing a member of the public I just had contact with being quarantined. A Of course, we will feel worried and sad when we see someone we just had contact with being placed under quarantine observation, feel helpless because we can't help, or be afraid of getting infected ourselves. However, quarantine observation does not mean confirmed diagnosis. Close contacts need to be quarantined for health inquiries and medical examinations. This is to better protect them and everyone else, and also to ensure better treatment in case of infection. If you really want to do something to help this person, you can communicate with them online, listen to their feelings, and encourage them to cooperate actively with the treatment. Q 5. Lately, I have no appetite, feel nauseous, vomit, dizzy, have headaches, and can't sleep well. Is there a big problem with my body? A People's police officers endure enormous stress and work pressure, which naturally affects both body and emotions. These could be physical reactions caused by stress, tension, and fatigue. After returning to the unit at the end of each workday, observe whether these symptoms gradually disappear. If they do, it's a stress response, no need to worry; if they don't, please first seek telephone consultation with a doctor. If they persist severely, go to the hospital for a check-up and symptomatic treatment. Q 6. Why does listening to music and exercising still not relieve my tension and stress? A To achieve the effect of relieving tension and stress, you need to listen to music like this: choose a favorite song and listen to it repeatedly with focus – you must focus! First, listen to the details. Once familiar, while listening, pay attention to your inner feelings, and then observe the changes in your body. If the music lingers in your mind, the effect is achieved. Exercise should be done like this: First, most people need to do rhythmic exercises with alternating fast and slow paces, which can make the body secrete the soothing substance serotonin; second, another group of people need to do exercise as intense as possible within their body's adaptable range, for 5-8 minutes each time, at an intensity that makes them sweat, with a frequency of 3-4 times per day. Q 7. What should I do if I want to sleep but can't fall asleep? A Try to use fewer electronic products before bed, especially mobile phones, to avoid prolonged exposure to blue light which can prevent melatonin from secreting normally, thus affecting sleep. You can read a boring book before bed, which might唤醒 your sleepiness; listen to a piece of music on repeat; if you wake up in the middle of the night, let yourself lie calmly in bed, don't deliberately think about things, and don't force yourself to fall asleep again; wake up at a fixed time in the morning; try not to take naps at noon. You can also listen to the "Awaken Your Inner Vitality" hypnosis audio provided last time on the official account. Furthermore, we will continue to recommend some effective methods to help sleep, pushed to everyone through the "Yunnan Police" WeChat official account. Title: How should rural law students plan their future career paths? Content: It's quite straightforward. Title: Precautions for Purchasing Water Purifiers Content: (Jiaxing Huzhou Hangzhou Shaoxing Suzhou Shanghai Ningbo Wuxi Kunshan) (Schools Hospitals Factories Workshops, Household Commercial) (Midea Angel Qin Yuan Ao Smith Haozee Kangliyuan) Water Dispenser Water Purifier Drinking Water Machine Water Treatment Water Boiler Water Purifier Leasing Rental Manufacturer To ensure safe drinking water, many households now choose to install home water purifiers. However, many people get tricked by sellers due to insufficient understanding of the product when selecting a water purifier. Below are some misconceptions about water purifier selection summarized by the editor that consumers must avoid. 1. The more functions a water purifier has, the better? To cater to people's pursuit of health, most sellers attach many concepts to water purifiers, such as: activation, mineralization, antioxidant, antibacterial, etc., claiming that the filtered water can have special effects like health care, beauty, lowering blood pressure, anti-aging, etc. Friends can't help but exclaim, this is even more magical than 'turning stone into gold'! But don't be too happy yet, because any seller promoting health benefits of water purifiers is just hyping. Water purifiers are actually simple; they filter and purify polluted water to achieve safe drinking water. 2. The more filter cartridges a water purifier has, the better? Some sellers, to seek profit, promote 'the more filter cartridges, the better' as a gimmick, misleading many consumers, essentially just increasing their profits. The editor learned that selecting a water purifier isn't about more cartridges being better, but about the quality of the filter media. Generally, using ultrafiltration membrane and RO membrane as the main purification cartridges, four to five stages are common, offering good purification effect and high cost-effectiveness. The idea that more cartridges are better is just a marketing tactic by sellers; consumers should be cautious to avoid being deceived. 3. 'Imported Water Purifiers' Nowadays, people have quality requirements and value brands highly. Some merchants use the label of imported products, but they are actually products manufactured domestically through OEM. Machines originally costing a few hundred yuan are labeled as imported products priced at thousands or even tens of thousands in the end market, generating tenfold or even several tenfold profits. Therefore, consumers must recognize that these so-called imported big-brand water purifiers might be products without proper certification. So, when selecting a water purifier, we still need to learn more about water purifier knowledge and choose one suitable for our use. Title: I want to prepare for the civil service exam. During the winter vacation, I don't have a good study environment at home. My boyfriend rents a place outside and wants me to stay with him during the vacation. He goes to work during the day, and I study. Is this appropriate? Content: This matter is indeed a bit纠结. Here is some analysis for your reference. Regarding the study environment, from a practical perspective, if his place can indeed provide a quiet and suitable environment for studying, it would be helpful for your civil service exam preparation. During the day when he is at work, you can focus on studying, which can improve your learning efficiency. This is a good objective advantage. Regarding the relationship aspect, although you have discussed some ways to handle the future, your relationship is currently facing obstacles from his family. Staying at his place under these circumstances might complicate the relationship further. If small frictions or emotional fluctuations occur during your time together, it could affect your exam preparation mindset. Furthermore, from a traditional perspective, a girl staying at a boy's place might be viewed differently by others (like his family, etc.), which could leave a somewhat unfavorable impression on his family and be detrimental to the future development of your relationship. On a personal psychological level, it's completely normal for you to feel uneasy about this, especially since the future of the relationship is not yet certain. Staying there in this situation might make you feel relatively passive or insecure. Perhaps you could consider if there are other solutions. For example, try looking for online study rooms on the internet where you can study with others to create a learning atmosphere, or see if you can find a suitable study room a bit further away and commute daily. If there really are no better alternatives and you decide to stay at his place, it's best to communicate clearly with him in advance about potential situations and each other's expectations.

Title: Are Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End and Zhongmin Bao in the same funding pool? Content: Recently, many partners have been inquiring about Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End, and quite a few policies have been sold. I've reviewed the core of the product, i.e., the reasons to purchase: 1. No health declaration Compared to common million-yuan medical insurance, it's not only available for purchase but also pays claims, only excluding 6 major pre-existing conditions. Nodules, polyps, hypertension, etc., are all eligible for reimbursement. 2. Zero deductible, 50% reimbursement for expenses within 20,000 yuan, 100% reimbursement for expenses above 20,000 yuan Some people can get reimbursed immediately after purchasing, greatly enhancing the experience. Otherwise, if claims are always denied, it inevitably makes customers suspect that insurance is a scam. 3. No restrictions on externally purchased drugs and devices The coverage is more advanced, able to adapt to DRG policies and compensate for the shortcomings of older policies. There's a detail I bet most of you wouldn't guess: there are more people adding this to existing medical insurance than first-time purchasers. The reason is simple: those who have experienced it know the shortcomings of products and can recognize the positioning of Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End. Of course, that's not the main point today. The main point is a question every fan asks before buying: Is the renewal of Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End stable? This is a 1-year product, not guaranteed renewable. What if it gets discontinued? Today, I'll share my views on this: 1. No health declaration, will it really lead to excessive claims? Firstly, no health declaration does attract some high-risk clients, but this is precisely the traffic logic of internet insurance: rapid customer acquisition to build a large client base. ZhongAn, as an old hand in the medical insurance market, has already accumulated vast amounts of data through previous products like Quanneng Bao and Puhui Bao. They know exactly how much they'll profit or lose and are certainly prepared. Zhongmin Bao, launched in 2022, has undergone multiple upgrades, fixing product bugs and gradually improving stability. Previously, a client of a team member purchased a million-yuan medical insurance and claimed 5 million over 5 years! If the product's client base isn't large enough, such high claims would be unsustainable. But Zhongmin Bao's pool is large enough; it surpassed 100 million in premiums just 10 days after launch. There's no need to worry about excessive claims in the short term. 2. Not guaranteed renewable, what if it's discontinued? Actually, we are a bit obsessed with guaranteed renewal. It's like a good relationship doesn't necessarily require a marriage certificate. Even medical insurance guaranteed for 20 years in the market might not be more stable than ZhongAn's 1-year product. For the drawbacks of 20-year guaranteed renewal, refer to this article: Three Major Flaws of Medical Insurance Guaranteed Renewable for 20 Years! ZhongAn, as a leader in the medical insurance market, has been deeply involved in this field, from million-yuan medical insurance to the non-standard risk market, and now to mid-to-high end medical insurance. In plain terms: ZhongAn not doing medical insurance is as absurd as Gree not making air conditioners! In 2024, the premium income of ZhongAn's Zunxiang e-sheng series has exceeded 10 billion yuan, solidifying its status as an industry benchmark. If ZhongAn can't sustain it, other companies don't stand a chance. 3. The product design is intelligent Although Zhongmin Bao has a zero deductible, it only reimburses 50% for expenses within 20,000 yuan. This design actually mitigates risk. Compared to Alipay's Good Medical Insurance, which reimburses 30% for expenses within 10,000 yuan, Zhongmin Bao's payout is actually lower. For example, for a hospitalization cost of 30,000 yuan, with social insurance covering 10,000 yuan, out-of-pocket is 20,000 yuan: Alipay Good Medical Insurance reimbursement: 10,000 × 30% + 10,000 = 13,000 yuan Zhongmin Bao reimbursement: 20,000 × 50% = 10,000 yuan Although Zhongmin Bao's reimbursement rate seems higher, the actual payout is lower. If someone tries to exploit the system, ZhongAn isn't afraid of you exploiting it; they're afraid of you canceling after making a claim. If someone buys the product right before hospitalization, serves the waiting period, and then claims; if they continue purchasing, the frequency of adult hospitalization isn't that high, so the annual premiums minus operating costs will continuously turn into profit for the insurance company until the next claim. Additionally, after healthcare reform, with bundled payments for diseases, average hospitalization costs are bound to decrease, and medical resource waste is significantly reduced, which in turn lowers adverse selection events. 4. ZhongAn Insurance, the pillar of medical insurance There aren't many true deep participants in the domestic medical insurance market. ZhongAn started with million-yuan medical insurance and is now entering the non-standard risk and mid-to-high end medical insurance markets, acting as the industry's 'innovator' and leader. Most other companies are 'followers,' waiting for ZhongAn to launch a successful new product before copying and slightly modifying the terms. In plain terms: Companies like Taikang and Taiping can survive without million-yuan medical insurance, but if ZhongAn had no medical insurance, it would be nothing! Medical insurance is ZhongAn's core business and its largest profit source. To summarize: Is Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End worth buying? Based on data, design, and market position, the likelihood of the Zhongmin Bao series being discontinued in the short term is very low. ZhongAn has sufficient data support and will continue to upgrade and iterate the product. If you value cost-effectiveness and stability, Zhongmin Bao Mid-to-High End is a good choice! Of course, the above analysis represents my personal views. Ultimately, product selection should be based on your own needs. For any product or claims inquiries, you can consult Brother Dou.

Title: My ICBC credit card limit was suddenly reduced from 4,000 to 2,000, how much should I pay as the minimum repayment? Content: Your minimum repayment amount is specified in each statement. Title: The newly launched BYD Han made me look at it with new eyes. Content: The other day, BYD Han was officially launched, which surprised me very much and refreshed my inherent impression of BYD. Its presence is no less than that of Tesla, making me look at it with new eyes. Often, people judge by appearance, and choosing a car is no exception; whether it looks good or not is often the deciding factor. At first glance, BYD Han immediately gave me a good impression. For domestic cars, it can be described as stunning. Now, the exterior design of domestic cars has made significant progress, moving from simple imitation to independent innovation, and the manufacturing process is fully in line with international standards. BYD Han has a total of four models, including three Han EV models and one Han DM model. The pre-subsidy price includes a national subsidy of 20,250 yuan. After comprehensive subsidies, the guide prices for Han EV are 229,800 yuan, 255,800 yuan, and 279,500 yuan respectively, while the post-subsidy guide price for Han DM starts at 219,800 yuan. It also enjoys a vehicle warranty of 6 years or 150,000 kilometers, and a lifetime warranty for the power battery cells. From the perspective of post-subsidy price and battery policy, it has a competitive advantage over Tesla. In terms of exterior, BYD Han is 4980 mm long with a wheelbase of 2920 mm, which is standard for a mid-size car, larger than Tesla Model 3. The body shape of BYD Han is very smooth, jointly designed by international design masters Wolfgang Egger and JuanMa López. The front face features floating Dragon Crystal LED headlights composed of more than 730 LED beads. When the headlights are turned on, the贯穿 dragon whisker-style daytime running lights connect in the middle. Additionally, the clamshell-style engine hood and sharp waistline design are very harmonious. The rear lines are even smoother, perfectly matching the entire vehicle. I think this is currently the best-looking model in the BYD brand. In terms of interior, BYD Han uses relatively exquisite materials, with an ambiance that follows a luxury route. The cockpit adopts an enveloping intelligent luxury flight cabin design, equipped with a 12.3-inch full LCD anti-glare dashboard and a 15.6-inch ultra-high-definition 8-core adaptive rotating floating PAD. The manufacturing process uses top-grade brushed and screen-printed genuine aluminum. Compared to the minimalist route of Tesla's interior, I prefer the ambiance of BYD Han. In terms of configuration, it is also very rich, standardly equipped with 11 airbags, and features active safety functions such as FCW, EBA, LDW, DOW, and RCW. It also includes BYD's autonomous driving Di Pilot intelligent driving assistance system, which consists of DiDAS and DiTrainer, and can continuously evolve and upgrade via OTA. The interior coating uses water-based environmentally friendly damping materials, reaching European standard level 3.0. In terms of power, the front motor of BYD Han has a maximum power of 163 kW and a maximum torque of 330 Nm. The four-wheel drive high-performance flagship model has a rear motor with a maximum power of 200 kW and a maximum torque of 350 Nm, with a system comprehensive maximum power of 363 kW. The 0-100 km/h acceleration time is 7.9 seconds, and for the four-wheel drive model, it only takes 3.9 seconds, making it the fastest accelerating mass-produced new energy sedan in China. BYD Han has five power mode options: pure electric, parallel, series, high-speed, and energy recovery. In terms of battery, BYD Han has a battery capacity of 76.9 kWh, and the battery type is the blade battery, which is the world's first sedan to use the blade battery. The blade battery and its protective enclosure are very safe, having passed the stringent "nail penetration test," with comprehensive precautions from the source. This battery combines long life and long range, with a NEDC comprehensive工况 pure electric range of up to 605 km, and 550 km for the four-wheel drive model. BYD Han has an ultra-low drag coefficient of 0.233, which reduces high-speed energy consumption while also increasing the range. The maximum charging power of BYD Han can reach 100 kW, allowing a range of 135 km after 10 minutes of charging. The fast charging time from 30% to 80% is only 25 minutes. It is compatible with various charging methods and can adapt to public charging piles nationwide. In terms of chassis, BYD Han was crafted by German tuning master Heinz Keck and his team. The front suspension uses a MacPherson independent suspension, and the rear suspension is a multi-link independent suspension. The brakes use four-wheel disc brakes, with tire specifications of 245/45R19, achieving a 100 km braking distance of 32.8 meters. The four-wheel drive model is equipped with BYD's self-developed super intelligent electric four-wheel drive, which can achieve millisecond-level response and has three driving modes: ECO, SPORT, and snow driving. Its handling and comfort are well guaranteed. Overall, BYD Han has brought earth-shaking changes to the BYD brand. Whether it's the exterior or interior, or the chassis and handling, it offers a great experience. Don't judge this model with old perceptions. Moreover, I believe that through the creation of this model, BYD's brand power has been greatly enhanced. Driving a BYD Han doesn't make you feel inferior to Tesla; the key is to be confident. For me, if I had to choose between BYD Han and Tesla Model 3, I would prefer BYD Han. (Image from BYD Han official pictures)

Title: The 'Q' key on my Samsung RV411 laptop bought in 2011 is not working. The repair shop said the entire keyboard needs to be replaced. Are there any other solutions? Content: Dear Samsung user, According to your description, your laptop keyboard has a key malfunction. This is often caused by software issues, key ghosting, short circuits, or other hardware failures, leading to other keys failing. We recommend you perform the following checks to confirm the issue: 1. When the Samsung logo appears during startup, press F2 to enter BIOS settings, then press F9 to restore BIOS to factory defaults. 2. Try booting into DOS mode from a CD or press F8 after startup to enter Safe Mode to check if it's a system or software issue. 3. Check if there is any debris under the faulty key. 4. Check if the keyboard has ever been exposed to liquid, and if the key presses and releases normally. If there has been liquid exposure or the key doesn't spring back properly, please visit a Samsung service center for further inspection and repair by an engineer. 5. For temporary use, you can connect a USB keyboard. If you need assistance, please visit support.samsung.com.cn. The official website offers multi-channel service support! What they said is correct. Laptop keyboards are integrated; if one key is broken, the whole keyboard needs replacement. It's better to let them replace it. If you knew how to fix it, you wouldn't be asking. Since you're asking, it means you don't know how, so don't try to fix it yourself and risk damaging other parts, which would be more costly than it's worth.

Title: Road Trip Observations Part 5 – The Town Government Office Content: Road Trip Observations Part 5 – The Town Government Office Ruixue Yinglan 1629113593 In the Huayang Scenic Area of Yang County, Hanzhong City, Shaanxi Province, behind the hotel, there is a compound of the Huayang Town Government where tourists can park their vehicles. This is an ancient town that has only recently opened to the public, with few tourists and very limited parking spaces. The town government compound was almost entirely filled with tourists' vehicles. A corner of the government office The ancient town is small, consisting of just one street. The kindergarten, school, and hospital are all built along the street. From the outside, these places look quite impressive, with tall gatehouses and buildings within the compounds, not only constructed in a classical style but also decorated with considerable refinement. The town hospital In contrast, the town government office located behind the hotel appears ordinary, inconspicuous, and even somewhat dilapidated. Various offices are distributed in old-fashioned brick houses around the compound. All town government departments are enclosed within one courtyard, and the rooms are very small. Without looking closely, one might mistake it for an ordinary old residential courtyard. Probably, many people would never associate such buildings with a government office. Yet, it is indeed the office of the Huayang Town Government, the local yamen in the minds of the residents. In recent years, almost everywhere across the country, the most luxurious and impressive buildings are local government offices. A government office like the one in Huayang Town is truly very rare. In fact, whether the government serves the people and shares weal and woe with them can perhaps be sensed from this.

Title: Yuergou Station Police Station Implements Three Measures to Strengthen Police Officers' Education on Views of Marriage and Love Content: China News Network Xinjiang News, December 6 (by Wang Ting) To further educate and guide police officers in establishing correct views on marriage and love, properly handle relationships involving marriage, love, and family, effectively prevent various problems arising from such relationships, and ensure the internal security and stability of the force, the Yuergou Station Police Station of the Korla Public Security Department has adopted "Three Measures" to educate and guide officers in establishing correct views on marriage and love. 1. Strengthen Education and Guidance, Fortify the Ideological Defense Line. The Yuergou Station Police Station treats the education on police officers' views of marriage and love as a routine educational content. Integrating it with the "Constitution Publicity Week" activities, the station organizes officers to regularly study the "Civil Code". Based on an analysis of the officers' current ideological trends, it focuses on analyzing new situations and problems emerging in officers' views and experiences of marriage and love. It educates officers on the importance and necessity of such education, actively guiding them to strictly comply with relevant marriage system regulations, establish correct views on making friends and on marriage and love, and strive to create healthy and happy marriages. 2. Understand the Actual Situation, Conduct Heart-to-Heart Talks. Attention is paid to distinguishing the ideological characteristics of officers of different age groups, such as young officers and veteran officers. Categorized regular heart-to-heart talk sessions are conducted. Centering on the most concerning issues for officers, such as "how to date, how to choose a partner, how to manage a marriage," practical examples from around them are used to clarify doubts and resolve confusion, continuously enhancing the officers' sense of family responsibility. 3. Foster a Positive Atmosphere, Share Techniques through Examples. The Yuergou Station Police Station insists on enhancing communication and interaction between the unit and the officers' families as an effective way to strengthen education on views of marriage and love. It invites married officers who have happy families and harmonious relationships to share personal experiences and life insights on how to handle the relationship between work and family, among other officer concerns. This enables officers to master skills for correctly handling issues related to dating, marriage, and family, enhances the practical effectiveness of the education, strengthens their ability to correctly handle issues related to career, love, marriage, and family, and ensures the security and stability of the force.

Title: What are the treatment methods for basement water leakage? Content: Structurally, we can divide basements into frame or brick-concrete structure basements and frame shear wall structure basements. The walls of the former type of basement are mostly built with brick walls, while the walls of the latter are basically concrete. Common basement water leakages include wall leakage (including leakage around wall pipes), floor leakage, as well as leakage from inside pipes, and situations where there is moisture and water droplets but no active leakage. For multi-story frame structure or brick-concrete structure basements built over 10 years ago, the exterior walls are mostly brick walls. If the basement's exterior wall is leaking, it generally requires excavating the outside of the wall for a careful inspection; this is often caused by damaged waterproofing, and repairing the waterproofing can solve the issue. Leakage around pipe roots can also be repaired this way. Sometimes water flows out from pre-embedded pipes, which is due to poor sealing of the pre-embedded pipes, and resealing is sufficient. For water leakage in high-rise frame shear wall structure basements, especially for basement levels two and below with depths over three meters, excavation is often too difficult, and grouting for waterproof repair can be considered. For basement floor leakage, grouting is almost the only option. However, the waterproofing methods for the basement floors of frame or brick-concrete structures differ from those of frame shear wall structures; their waterproofing cannot achieve complete 'encapsulation,' so grouting for floor leakage might not fully resolve the problem and may require combination with other methods. Often, basements face not obvious leakage but copious water droplets on walls and floors, and items stored in the basement can mold quickly. Some online suggestions, like placing lime powder or using fans in the basement, are largely ineffective. I encountered such a situation in 2011. The basement had brick walls, slight floor leakage, and water droplets at the base of the walls, which was particularly severe in summer. During repairs, we tried various methods like external excavation and internal waterproofing, but the results were not significant. Later, our engineering department attempted to completely encapsulate the problematic basement using polyurethane foam, applying it thoroughly to the floors and walls. Polyurethane foam firstly provides excellent insulation, serving to isolate the interior from the exterior, and secondly, its material is very dense, capable of blocking even minor leaks. After application, plastering was done. Subsequently, no water droplet phenomenon occurred in the basements of that residential complex.

Title: Yanzhou Rural Commercial Bank Yangzhou Road Sub-branch: Warm Door-to-Door Service Resolves Public Needs Content: Liu Yang Cao Youyou "Excuse me, an elderly person at home urgently needs to apply for a bank card to receive subsidies, but she cannot come in person. What should we do?" Recently, a customer anxiously entered the business hall of Yanzhou Rural Commercial Bank Yangzhou Road Sub-branch seeking help. It is understood that the government Disabled Persons' Federation department is currently collecting bank card numbers to distribute subsidies to disabled individuals. The funds are designated to be deposited into Rural Commercial Bank card numbers. However, the customer's mother has mobility issues and cannot come to the branch to open an account, hence the visit to the business hall for assistance. Title: Tourists Lost in the Mountains, Local Villager Enthusiastically Helps Content: Hubei Gucheng license plate E FG2V00 owner, well done! Title: Why Ant Credit Pay (Jiebei) No Longer Offers Interest-First Principal-Last Repayment? Content: The main reasons why Ant Credit Pay (Jiebei) no longer offers the interest-first principal-last repayment method are as follows: Risk considerations of the interest-first principal-last repayment method: Under this method, borrowers only need to pay the interest monthly during the loan term and repay the principal in a lump sum at maturity. While this reduces the borrower's initial repayment pressure, it also increases the risk of loan default. Once a borrower defaults, especially on the principal, it can cause significant losses to the lending institution. Therefore, to reduce loan risk, Jiebei has chosen to cancel or restrict the interest-first principal-last repayment method. Impact of stricter credit market regulation: In recent years, national regulation of the credit market has become increasingly strict, with high importance placed on issues like loan defaults. As a well-known product in the industry, Jiebei actively responds to national policies by adjusting repayment methods to reduce the risk of loan defaults. Canceling or restricting the interest-first principal-last method is an important measure for Jiebei to comply with national regulatory policies. Consideration of user qualifications and credit history: When providing loan services, Jiebei comprehensively evaluates users' qualifications and credit history. Although the interest-first principal-last method is attractive to some users, it is not suitable for all. To ensure the safety of loan funds and stable returns, Jiebei strictly reviews users' qualifications and credit history, and only eligible users can enjoy the interest-first principal-last repayment method. Current status of Jiebei's repayment methods: Currently, Jiebei's repayment methods mainly include equal monthly installments and interest-first principal-last (only available to specific eligible users). The equal monthly installment method helps reduce loan risk and stabilize the lender's returns, while the interest-first principal-last method is more targeted at users with excellent credit records and strong repayment capacity. In summary, the reasons why Jiebei no longer offers the interest-first principal-last method involve risk considerations, regulatory policies, user qualifications, and credit history, among other factors. When choosing a loan product, borrowers should make rational decisions based on their actual situation and repayment capacity.

Title: Lanxi Vehicle loses control while driving, plunges into ditch and hits tree! Owner: Sensor failure... Content: Click "Longshi News Online" to follow us! Judicial appraisal also ruled out the possibility of drunk or drugged driving. Recalling the accident, owner Lu Yaohui was still shaken. Near the entrance of Yuanda Town, the speedometer sensor failed, the odometer rapidly dropped, causing the steering wheel to lose control and the car to plunge into the ditch. Within less than a year of use, the speedometer malfunctioned four times. The car's after-sales service repeatedly replaced the speedometer sensor and eventually replaced the wiring harness, but the problem wasn't completely resolved. Wang Yaming, Manager of Zhongyuan Lanxi Auto Trade: "The mechanics checked multiple times. The sensor quality might have been defective. Many 530s were sold, quite a few in the entire region. Title: What to Do When Your Phone Screen Dims Content: When your phone screen dims, you can try the following solutions: Check the ambient light sensor: Confirm no obstruction: Check if the ambient light sensor above the phone screen is blocked by oil, dirt, or a non-compliant screen protector. These can cause the sensor to misjudge the ambient light, leading to automatic screen dimming. Turn off auto-brightness: Manual brightness setting: If you confirm the ambient light sensor is unobstructed, try turning off the phone's auto-brightness feature and manually set the screen brightness to a suitable level. Contact after-sales service: Display inspection: If the above methods are ineffective and the screen brightness still cannot be increased after manual setting, it might be a display malfunction. In this case, you need to contact the phone's after-sales service for inspection to determine the problem and carry out repairs. Summary: Phone screen dimming is usually related to the auto-brightness feature, but it can also be caused by an obstructed ambient light sensor or a faulty display. Troubleshooting step by step as described above usually solves the problem. If the issue persists, it is recommended to contact a professional repair technician.

Title: Untitled Content: I see the pictures. The frame shown in the picture is the type that installs a quick-release axle, which is 5*135. The word "or" in the picture description indicates that the frame also has the 142 thru-axle type. That type of frame should have a round hole at the rear axle mount, not an open slot. I recommend a 12*142 frame; it's newer and better than the quick-release type. The rear wheel picture shows it's the same wheelset. By installing different end caps, it can be either 5*135 (does the wheelset picture say 10*135? I didn't look closely) or 12*142. When you buy it, you can confirm if both options are provided. When asking the seller, you can directly ask about both the frame and the wheelset: is it 135 quick-release or 142 thru-axle? That makes it very clear. For quick-release, mountain bikes generally use the standard 135mm spacing, so just saying "quick-release" is usually fine. For thru-axles, there are different widths (e.g., downhill bikes sometimes use wider spacing), so you generally need to specify 142 thru-axle. You also need to pay attention to the fork compatibility here. Firstly, the fork must be a tapered steerer to match the values in the frame picture. Secondly, the front wheel also differs between thru-axle and quick-release, and a thru-axle is also recommended.

Title: Municipal Transport Management Department Organizes Symposium on Concentrated Rectification of Various Issues, Actively Soliciting Opinions and Suggestions from Service Recipients Content: The Municipal Transport Management Department organized a symposium on the concentrated rectification of formalism and bureaucracy's "ten manifestations" and the "Work Style Construction Year" activity to solicit opinions from service recipients. Twenty representatives from four industries including long-distance passenger transport, taxi, freight transport, motor vehicle maintenance, and driver training were invited.
