Title: Official Explanation of Employee Healthcare Insurance Reform: Personal Contribution Ratio, Fund Flow, and Account Balance Ownership Remain Unchanged, Many People Experience Varying Degrees of Reduction in Funds, What Information Deserves Attention? Content: In the second half of last year, I had a CT scan diagnosing pneumonia, bronchiectasis, and focal emphysema. I went to the hospital for treatment, getting a 6-day supply of Chinese medicine each time, going weekly. I was treated at the Henan Provincial Hospital of Integrated Traditional Chinese and Western Medicine (a Grade 3A hospital). Each time the medicine cost varied from a few hundred yuan. I took medicine continuously for over 2 months. I thought I had long exceeded the outpatient reimbursement deductible threshold and kept hoping to directly get part of the outpatient costs reimbursed. Until the end, each time I checked carefully, not a single cent was reimbursed. I became doubtful. How is this healthcare reform? They said outpatient medical expenses would be reimbursed, but they weren't! I started looking up the healthcare insurance policy and found out that for outpatient visits, not only must the deductible threshold be met, but there is also a National Healthcare Insurance Drug List. Only drugs within the healthcare insurance list can be reimbursed proportionally. Although there are drugs for my condition in the healthcare insurance list, the Chinese medicine decoctions I got are not within the healthcare insurance reimbursement scope, so they cannot be reimbursed. Question 1: Isn't Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) a national treasure of our country? Having lasted for thousands of years, isn't our own country now maintaining the development of TCM? Not supporting the use of Chinese medicine for treatment, how can we promote the growth of TCM? Question 2: Shouldn't healthcare reform aim to reimburse more to reduce the burden on the people? Setting so many thresholds that prevent reimbursement, how can we talk about improving healthcare insurance benefits? Question 3: Retirees only get a few dozen yuan deposited into their healthcare insurance cards each month. Saving for a year amounts to about a thousand yuan, which can be spent on just one episode of cold or fever. At this age, various illnesses start to appear. Can ordinary people still afford to see a doctor? Question 4: Regardless of whether the funds used during the three-year pandemic came from the medical social pooling fund, and regardless of where the money was spent, should the common people have to foot the bill? Question 5: The dual-track system for social security pensions has only been superficially reformed. The average salary for provincial and municipal social security pensions has been unified, but the distribution mechanisms are different, and the calculation formulas result in different benefits. For permanent staff, the initial pension approval is a temporary benefit and will later be formally determined according to the provincial social security, resulting in a higher formal pension. They also receive monthly annuities, and the government provides annual trade union fees, heating allowances, public funds, health recuperation fees, national civilization awards, monthly civilization awards, property subsidies, plus civil servants' healthcare insurance reimbursement ratio is as high as 95%. Contract workers only have a pension of around three to four thousand yuan, employee healthcare insurance reimbursement of 70%, and nothing else! People with the same years of service and professional title have a pension difference of 3-4 times due to their different statuses! Comparing this, the policy favors those with higher salaries and better benefits; the lower the salary, the fewer the benefits! Permanent staff never contributed a single cent to social security before but their seniority is recognized, while enterprise contract workers have been paying pension insurance since 1985, yet end up receiving such a small pension? Where is the fairness? This will only lead to more social polarization and conflict! Protests due to healthcare reform are inevitable! Only by improving the well-being of all citizens and ensuring reasonable policies can development be promoted!

Title: What problems will occur if the camera's photoresistor is broken? Content: If the camera's photoresistor is broken, it will cause the problem that the camera cannot be used at night. The camera's photoresistor can detect day and night. When night comes, the resistance value of the photoresistor changes, and the camera turns on the infrared fill light. If the photoresistor is broken, the infrared fill light cannot turn on normally, and because the light is too dark, the camera cannot work properly. Therefore, if the camera's photoresistor is broken, the camera cannot be used at night. Basic introduction: The working principle of the camera is roughly that the optical image generated by the scene through the lens is projected onto the surface of the image sensor, then converted into an electrical signal, which becomes a digital image signal after analog-to-digital conversion, then sent to the digital signal processing chip for processing, and then transmitted to the computer for processing through the USB interface. The image can be seen on the display. At night, the camera needs an additional fill light for the sensor to correctly identify the scene. Without the fill light, the scenes captured by the camera are very dark, even black. For the fill light to turn on correctly at night, the photoresistor must work normally. If the photoresistor is abnormal, the camera cannot be used normally at night.

Title: Pros and Cons of Registering for Shenzhen Household Registration Content: Uses and benefits of Shenzhen household registration: 1. Required for competing for positions that require Shenzhen household registration. Many enterprises and civil service positions specify that applicants must have Shenzhen household registration (or require Shenzhen household registration as a guarantee). Shenzhen staff or employee exams are generally only open to Shenzhen residents. 2. Convenience for handling certificates and various documents, such as Hong Kong and Macau passes, passports, etc. Shenzhen household registration holders can apply for a multiple-entry Hong Kong and Macau pass valid for one year, the so-called "multiple-entry permit." 3. Higher social insurance benefits. 1) In addition to higher medical insurance, permanent residents with Shenzhen household registration also have pension insurance; after contributing for 15 years, they can enjoy retirement benefits. If the woman has Shenzhen household registration, maternity insurance reimburses a lot (giving birth in Shenzhen costs about 5500 yuan in hospital fees, the individual only needs to pay 500 yuan). There is also housing provident fund, unemployment insurance (the individual does not pay, the company pays it all), etc. The social insurance amount on the social security card of Shenzhen household registration holders is at least 3000 yuan more per year. Outpatient visits can be paid by card; 5% of medical insurance goes into the personal account, with the individual contributing 2% and the company contributing the other 3%, equivalent to a 60% reimbursement rate. Hospitalization only requires paying 10% of the cost. If you do not have Shenzhen household registration, your medical insurance can only reimburse 70-90%. 2) Newborns with Shenzhen household registration can apply for children's medical insurance. If the child is not in kindergarten or school, children's medical insurance can be processed through the community workstation or by going to the social security bureau. Non-Shenzhen household registration children must be in kindergarten or school to apply. 3) Can apply for unemployment insurance, plus subsidies, nearly 800 yuan per month in unemployment benefits. If you have an unemployment certificate, you can learn to drive for free, get a driver's license for free, and can reimburse 2000 yuan in training fees per year. Participate in various professional titles and certificate trainings organized by the labor security department. If you are an outsider insured in Shenzhen, compare the benefits after retirement, education, social security, work (some work environments require Shenzhen household registration), and other aspects between having Shenzhen household registration and not. Those who are not from Guangdong cannot appreciate this convenience; those who have struggled in Shenzhen for decades but still do not have local household registration cannot understand. 4. Convenience for children's schooling. Exempt from temporary schooling fees, tuition can be lower, and can apply for placements in schools with higher admission rates. Do not need to return to their place of origin for the college entrance exam; the score requirements are much lower than in other provinces and cities, increasing the probability of entering university. Even better, there is the benefit of priority employment. 5. Eligibility to apply for low-rent housing, affordable housing, and newly introduced public rental housing and affordable commercial housing. Moreover, the housing market is currently under purchase restrictions; the home purchase quota for Shenzhen household registration holders is twice that of non-Shenzhen household registration holders. Many people often ask the editor whether they need to apply for Shenzhen household registration, unsure if Shenzhen household registration is really necessary for them, so they are conflicted. To resolve this conflict, the editor has specially compiled the pros and cons of Shenzhen household registration today. Everyone can judge whether they need to apply based on their own needs! First, let's see why the number of people applying for Shenzhen household registration through the points system started increasing in 2019? What aspects did the role of Shenzhen household registration in 2019 reflect? Is it good to join Shenzhen household registration? Let's look at the following points regarding the role of Shenzhen household registration: 1. In 2016, the nationwide two-child policy was liberalized. Shenzhen is originally a young city with a high proportion of people of marriageable and childbearing age. After the liberalization, the number of Shenzhen household registration population will increase. Second children who were originally unregistered can directly register in Shenzhen if one parent has Shenzhen household registration. 2. People who originally wanted to have a second child but were afraid of heavy fines in Shenzhen can now safely transfer their household registration to Shenzhen after the policy liberalization. After the second child is born, they can also directly obtain Shenzhen household registration. 3. The State Council has announced the cancellation of 256 professional qualification certificates again. Shenzhen has successfully transformed into a high-tech industrial city, and the demand for skilled talent is decreasing. This means that people without academic qualifications can only enter Shenzhen household registration through the tax payment channel. 4. Shenzhen's house price increase ranks first in the country. Housing has currently become Shenzhen's biggest pain point. However, for Shenzhen household registration holders, there is another option: applying for Shenzhen affordable housing. Moreover, Shenzhen is also researching policies to create talent-oriented affordable housing specifically for high-end talents. The prerequisite for applying for such housing is: you must have Shenzhen household registration, become a Shenzhen resident! 5. Non-Shenzhen household registration holders currently need to have paid social security continuously for at least five years to buy a house, and at least two years continuously to buy a car. Shenzhen household registration holders have no social security duration requirement! Therefore, everyone wants to obtain household registration as soon as possible. After all, housing prices wait for no one! 6. Starting from 2015, Shenzhen has provided rental subsidies for people with a bachelor's degree or higher, under 30 years old, and without property. In 2016, the rental subsidy amount reached 15,000 for bachelor's degrees, 25,000 for master's degrees, and 35,000 for doctoral degrees. This policy attracts the most household registration population. Many university graduates choose to transfer their household registration to Shenzhen immediately after graduation to receive the subsidy. 7. The last point, and the most important! That is school placements! Shenzhen currently uses a points-based system for school enrollment, competing based on: property, household registration, length of residence in the district, and parents' social security contribution history! This young city is no longer like the first generation of Shenzhen migrants who raised their children in their hometown. Everyone is willing to bring their children with them. If they cannot compete based on property, then household registration is the easiest way to add points for school enrollment. The number of people transferring their household registration each year because their children need to go to school probably accounts for half of the total. Pros and cons of registering for Shenzhen household registration. The benefits of registering for Shenzhen household registration are many, the treatment is very good. The downside is that Shenzhen's climate is very humid, and consumption is also high. The benefit of registering for Shenzhen household registration is definitely being able to attend Shenzhen's public schools. Now, the standard for enrolling in public schools in most cities is to have a local household registration. The downside is giving up rural household registration; it will be difficult to move back to rural areas in the future. There are many benefits to registering for Shenzhen household registration. It's easier to make money in Shenzhen, social welfare is good, benefits are high, and children will have sufficient educational resources in the future. However, job competition is fierce, the pace of life is fast, and pressure is high.

Title: Patients Using Bags to Hold Spots in Queue at a Shanghai Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital - Hospital Says Difficult to Interfere - Sohu News Content: "Seeing the bag but not the person" in medical queues - Such spot-holding makes other patients quite unhappy Evening News Report: Similarly arriving early at the hospital to queue for registration, some people use bags to hold spots. Recently, Mr. Bao has repeatedly encountered queue-jumping during hospital registration. Clearly, there were only two or three people ahead, but there were five or six bags holding spots, which made other patients very unhappy. Mr. Bao lives on Kongjiang Road in Yangpu District and goes to a certain Shanghai Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital twice a week for specialist outpatient visits to get Chinese medicine for his sister's recuperation. Unexpectedly, in recent weeks, even waking up at 3:30 AM and arriving at the hospital by 4:30 AM, he still only managed to be sixth or seventh in line. Usually, only one or two people arrived earlier than him, but three or four bags were placed on other seats to indicate they were taken. At first, he truly thought the owners of these bags came earlier, but later discovered they were all brought by the two or three people who came first. This morning, a reporter accompanied Mr. Bao to the hospital. At 4:30 AM, it was still dark outside, but the hospital was already brightly lit. Arriving at the registration area, indeed two people were already waiting in line. The reporter noticed that two empty seats in the middle each had a bag-like object placed on them. Mr. Bao went forward to ask if the seats with bags could be taken, but both individuals said "someone is already here." Mr. Bao could only move down, sitting in the fifth seat. "It's relatively better today; I got number five. Otherwise, like last time when I was seventh, after registering, seeing the doctor, and getting the Chinese medicine prepared, it was already noon," Mr. Bao said helplessly. It is understood that considering the hot summer weather, this TCM hospital has moved the registration start time forward to 6:00 AM, and nurses will distribute appointment vouchers for different specialists based on the department being registered for that day. However, because preparing Chinese medicine takes much longer than Western medicine, there are quite a few citizens like Mr. Bao who arrive at the hospital as early as 4:30 AM to get appointment vouchers and register. The reporter observed that the owners of the two "spot-holding bags" did not arrive until just before outpatient registration began. It turned out the early arrivals were saving spots for them, allowing their friends to sleep longer. By then, there were already twenty or thirty patients queued behind. "This situation happens almost every time I come now. Seeing that they are also here to register and see a doctor, I don't want to make a big deal out of it, but it's ultimately uncivilized. Everyone came this early, and now they come later but get ahead of us," Mr. Bao expressed with some anger. Nurse Li from the hospital told the reporter: "Actually, we have asked security to maintain order, and we also distribute appointment vouchers based on the queued patients before registration starts. But when patients委托 use bags to hold spots for each other, the hospital finds it very difficult to interfere." Author: Intern Zhu Xiaowei Reporter Jiao Xiaohong (Responsible Editor: Wan Zhenhong)

Title: 3-Year Didi Driver: Who Says Didi Doesn't Make Money? That's Because You Don't Know How to Operate It. Running Didi Also Has Great Learning Content: When it comes to Didi, what are your opinions? The editor believes that Didi has made many contributions to society, bringing a lot of convenience. It also makes up for many shortcomings that exist with taxis. For example, many young people are workaholics and often work overtime at night. However, if they work too late, the last bus has already left, and taking a taxi becomes very expensive, especially at night when some drivers charge even more. If you're unlucky enough to encounter a rainy day, taking a taxi is like walking into a trap waiting to be overcharged! It must be said that taxis have many drawbacks, but Didi恰好弥补了 these drawbacks and achieves many details that taxis cannot,毕竟 it's high-tech software, it's just different! For instance, you can see the car's location on your phone, which makes passengers very happy because they can know how far the driver is and don't have to wait foolishly. Sometimes, if you can't remember which day you went out to see a movie or which day you went out, just open Didi and check, and you can get a rough idea. Those accounts you didn't know where the money went can also be reconciled. Not only are more and more people taking Didi, but there are also more and more private car owners driving for Didi. However, I always hear Didi drivers complaining, saying that running Didi doesn't make money, etc. So I discussed this matter with a friend who has been driving for Didi for 3 years. Unexpectedly, my friend smiled helplessly and said that running Didi also has great learning; it's not that it doesn't make money, but those people don't know how to run it. He also shared the secrets of running Didi! Operate two Didi accounts simultaneously. This way, your probability of receiving orders will naturally be higher. If an order comes in on one account, temporarily turn off the other account. However, the problem with this is that eventually, the vehicle information for one account will definitely not match. As long as you explain it well to the passenger, the passenger can understand. After all, it's not easy to make money. If you provide good service, the passenger will turn a blind eye. Five-star ratings and service scores are very important as they affect your order acceptance rate, which is directly linked to your income. Therefore, you must serve passengers well. Take the initiative to greet passengers and wish them a safe journey when they leave. When passengers get off, remind them to watch for vehicles behind them. Passengers will feel very warm. Also, if you need to take a detour, explain the reason clearly to the passenger in advance, such as congestion ahead. To get good ratings, sometimes you may have to tolerate passengers' bad habits. Leave a note or card for passengers. It may seem unimportant, but it is actually necessary, especially when passengers are going to the airport or train station. Because such places are usually far away and hard to get a taxi, passengers are likely to contact you for a ride. In this case, you operate offline, and Didi cannot take a commission, so you make a steady profit without any loss!

Title: Personal Income Tax Refund Rejected? A Guide to Avoid Pitfalls of Mismatched Invoicing and Labor Remuneration Declarations
Content: As the end of June approaches, many freelancers have recently found their annual personal income tax reconciliation refund applications rejected, with the system prompting "Declared labor remuneration income is lower than the invoiced amount." What exactly is going on? As someone who has experienced the same issue, I'll help you clarify the key points.

I. The Core Issue: The "Mismatch" Between Invoice Amount and Declared Income
• The tax system automatically aggregates invoicing data under your name (checkable in the "My Invoices" section of the Personal Tax App).
• When declared labor remuneration income < invoice amount, the system flags incomplete income declaration.
• This often occurs when the hiring enterprise fails to fulfill its withholding obligation.

II. Three-Step Self-Check (with Instructions)
1️⃣ Check Invoice Details
Log into the Personal Tax App → [Services & Inquiries] → [Invoice Management] → [Invoices I Issued], filter for 2024 data.
2️⃣ Verify Tax Records
Check [Income and Tax Details] to confirm if corresponding income has been declared.
3️⃣ Review Withholding Entity
Pay special attention if the invoice recipient differs from the withholding entity.

III. Remedial Actions (Still applicable for 2025)
▷ Scenario 1: Enterprise withheld but declared incompletely
Contact the enterprise to amend the declaration, or provide withholding proof to the tax authority.
▷ Scenario 2: Enterprise did not withhold
Declare the difference during the annual reconciliation via [Add New Income].
▷ Dispute Resolution
Apply for a credit note (冲红) for invalid invoices; contact the issuing tax authority.

IV. Important Reminders
• Invoicing ≠ Tax Payment Proof! The payer still has withholding obligations.
• The deadline for issuing credit notes for 2024 invoices is December 31, 2025.
• False declarations impact tax credit and may trigger audits.

Recommend all freelancers check their invoices and income details quarterly to avoid issues during reconciliation. If enterprises refuse to cooperate, call 12366 to report to the issuing tax authority.
(Note: This case is based on 2024 reconciliation policies; follow the latest tax authority guidance for specific operations.)

Title: What causes the engine yellow light to come on with a jerking sensation? Content: When a car experiences jerking during driving, it is generally related to the engine and transmission. The engine consists of ignition, intake, and fuel injectors working together to achieve fuel combustion, which is the power source of the engine. If the fuel injection volume decreases, the intake volume reduces, or the ignition weakens, the power will be insufficient, and the engine will exhibit a jerking sensation.
Reasons for engine jerking:
1. Engine carbon deposits. Carbon deposits, as a persistent issue in engines, are a significant cause of car jerking. Carbon buildup in areas such as fuel injectors, throttle valves, intake ports, and combustion chambers can all lead to car jerking. Therefore, it is necessary to regularly use effective PNF concentrate-type fuel additives to clean the fuel system and carbon deposits. It is recommended to take the car to a repair shop to clean the carbon deposits inside the engine item by item.
2. Ignition system failures, such as spark plugs, ignition coils, cylinder pipeline leaks, wiring faults, etc. Issues with spark plugs, ignition coils, etc.
3. Fuel system failures, low fuel supply pressure in the fuel lines. Fuel supply pressure ensures fuel atomization, but fuel line blockages and fuel pump failures can cause excessively low supply pressure, affecting atomization. Untimely fuel supply can lead to vehicle jerking.
4. Sensors malfunctioning or failing. Sensors are the sensory nerves of the car's brain (ECU) and can perceive effective signals.
If the jerking is caused by transmission problems, it is recommended to go to a professional repair shop or a 4S店 to conduct an inspection of the transmission control system.

Title: When leaving a job, the boss doesn't want to change the financial responsible person or tax handler information? 3 ways to solve your troubles! Content: ● Follow and set 'Tax Mobilization' as a star account, delivered daily at 09:00. "Hot Q&A 1. Buying gas cards for clients, do I need to withhold individual income tax? 2. Setting up a branch, choose independent or non-independent? 3. The boss keeps giving me children's training fee invoices to account for, but this isn't a company expense, can this be accounted for? Reply '907T' in the official account dialog to get the answers. "Sister Li, I've been gone from my previous company for a week, and the financial responsible person and tax handler are still under my name, what should I do?" I believe many people have encountered this problem. The former company refuses to change the financial personnel and tax handler information for various reasons, but as a "former" employee, you genuinely don't want to bear the responsibilities of the "current" position. What exactly should you do? With a mindset of valuing harmony, it is still recommended to first contact the former employer and handle it through friendly negotiation. But if negotiation fails, to protect your own rights, you have to resort to tougher measures when soft approaches don't work. Today, I will recommend 3 methods to help you solve the troubles after leaving a job! Appeal on the Individual Tax App This method is not a direct change, but involves the tax authority feeding the information back to the former employer, who then relays it back to the appellant via the tax authority. Operation process: Open the Individual Tax App, [Personal Center] → [Enterprise Tax Handling Authority] click on the enterprise that needs the appeal, then click the appeal button in the top right corner. Select the appeal type and complete the supplementary explanation (at least 5 characters). Confirm the information is true and valid, click [Submit]. After submitting the appeal, you can view the appeal details by clicking [View Appeal] on the success page or [Query] - [Objection Handling Record]. Call the local tax consultation number to report a tax-related issue You can report the actual situation to the tax authority. The local tax consultation number is usually the area code + 12366. This operation also does not directly change the information over the phone, but after informing the tax authority, they will contact the unit for clarification and then provide feedback to you. Go directly to the local tax service hall to handle it Bring a personal statement, ID card, proof of resignation, or social security payment proof (documents proving you no longer work at the original unit, etc.). The person requesting the change is responsible for the authenticity and legality of the submitted materials. If an accounting agency is changing the financial responsible person for a client unit, it needs to first terminate the agency agreement with that enterprise on the electronic tax bureau. Then the financial personnel should go to the hall with a statement of the situation and their ID card. For enterprises, how to change the financial responsible person and tax handler? I've also compiled that for you, save it for future use! Changing the Financial Responsible Person Step 1: Open the Jiangsu Tax App on your phone, find [My Information] on the "My" page, and click to enter [Enterprise Personnel Change Application]. Step 2: Click [Initiate Change], enter the enterprise tax number to be bound in the "Enterprise Tax Number" field, and click [Query]. The system will automatically display the enterprise name after querying. In the [Application Position] field, select Financial Responsible Person, click [Change Application], and the system will prompt "Application initiated successfully". Step 3: After successful submission, it enters a pending approval status. You can click [View Details] to see the specific application information. After the natural person initiates the binding application, it needs approval from their superior in the Jiangsu Tax App. That is, a binding application for the enterprise financial responsible person requires approval by the enterprise's legal representative. For enterprises in Suzhou Industrial Park, currently you cannot change financial personnel information through the Jiangsu Tax App, but must operate directly on the electronic tax bureau. Specific steps are as follows: Step 1: After logging into the Jiangsu Provincial Electronic Tax Bureau, click [My Information] → [User Management] → [Basic Information Maintenance] → [Registration Information Change]. Step 2: Enter the "Registration Information Change" form interface. In the "Financial Responsible Person ID Type" module, click whether to modify and select 'Yes'. Modify the financial responsible person's name, ID number, and mobile phone number that need to be changed. Send a verification code to the original accountant's mobile number. After completion, click [Save] → [Submit]. The data is saved successfully to change the financial responsible person. Step 3: After completion, you still need to submit the tax matter reminder information through the "Jiangsu Tax" WeChat official account. Enter the "Jiangsu Tax" WeChat official account - click "Micro Services" at the bottom, click "Real-name Authentication" in the pop-up menu - then click "Resident ID Card Facial Recognition Verification' to operate. Changing the Tax Handler Step 1: The new tax handler opens WeChat, searches for and follows the Suzhou Tax WeChat official account (taxpayers in other areas of Jiangsu need to follow the Jiangsu Tax WeChat official account), click: [My Information] → [Real-name Authentication]. Select "Resident ID Card Facial Recognition Verification", a binding agreement will pop up, click accept. Upload the front and back of the ID card, then start facial recognition verification. After prompting that real-name authentication is successful, it is considered complete. Step 2: Log in to the State Administration of Taxation Jiangsu Provincial Electronic Tax Bureau, click [My Information] → [User Management] → [Basic Information Maintenance]. In the taxpayer basic information核对明细表, in the tax handler name row, select 'Yes' for whether to modify, and the system will pop up a prompt box. Fill in the information of the new tax handler to be changed (name, ID number, mobile number) in the confirmation information, click get verification code, enter the received verification code, click confirm, then save and submit the basic information核对表. Step 3: After the basic information核对表 is accepted and approved, the new tax handler will receive a tax matter reminder on the Suzhou Tax WeChat official account. Click into it, confirm the change registration information, and submit. After submission, wait a moment, then check the identity in Suzhou Micro Tax Handling - My - Personal Center. If it shows as a tax handler, the change is successful. For enterprises in Suzhou Industrial Park, the operation steps are as follows: Step 1: After the taxpayer logs into the Jiangsu Provincial Electronic Tax Bureau, click [My Information] → [User Management] → [Basic Information Maintenance] → [Registration Information Change]. Step 2: Enter the "Registration Information Change" form interface. In the "Tax Handler ID Type" module, click whether to modify and select 'Yes'. Modify the tax handler's name, ID number, and mobile phone number that need to be changed. Send a verification code to the original accountant's mobile number. After completion, click [Save] → [Submit]. The data is saved successfully to change the tax handler. Step 3: After completion, you still need to submit the tax matter reminder information through the "Jiangsu Tax" WeChat official account. Enter the "Jiangsu Tax" WeChat official account - click "Micro Services" at the bottom, click "Real-name Authentication" in the pop-up menu - click "Resident ID Card Facial Recognition Verification' to operate. Warm reminder: If the new financial responsible person and tax handler have already done real-name authentication before, after a successful change, you need to refresh the collection information on WeChat. ·END·--- Recommended Reading -- - 01｜ Tax Incentives 02｜ Pre-tax Deduction for Asset Losses 03｜ Travel Expenses Expert teacher one-on-one consultation service ☞ Please scan the code to consult

Title: Network is normal but cannot connect to Blizzard Battle.net Content: If the network is normal but you cannot connect to Blizzard Battle.net, you can try the following methods to solve this issue. Title: Check firewall and security software settings: Sometimes, firewalls or security software may block access to Blizzard Battle.net. Ensure these security settings are not mistakenly intercepting the Battle.net client. Try adding Blizzard Battle.net to the firewall or security software's trust list, or temporarily disable these security measures for testing. Update or reinstall the Battle.net client: Sometimes, issues with the software itself can cause connection failures. Go to the official Blizzard website to download the latest version of the Battle.net client installer. If you already have the latest version installed, try uninstalling and then reinstalling it to resolve potential file corruption or configuration issues. Check network configuration: Confirm whether your network connection settings are correct, such as DNS server addresses, proxy settings, etc. If you are using a router, try restarting it, as this can sometimes resolve network connection problems. Contact Blizzard customer service: If the above methods cannot solve the problem, you can contact Blizzard customer service for help. They may be able to provide more specific solutions or inform you if it is a server-side issue.

Title: Real Estate Commercial Paper Dealers Operating in the Gray Area, Holding Millions in Overdue Commercial Paper Unable to Be Cashed Content: Real estate commercial paper dealers operating in the gray area, holding millions in overdue commercial paper unable to be cashed. The Paper reporter Li Xiaoqing. 100,000 yuan, 150,000 yuan, 80,000 yuan, 1.5 million yuan... Looking at the stack of unpaid commercial papers in his hand, Zhang Di sighed. 'I've given up hope of getting all the overdue money this year. Getting a payment every now and then is the best outcome I can hope for. Getting paid in full seems hopeless,' Zhang Di said wryly to The Paper (www.thepaper.cn). He currently holds nearly 3 million yuan worth of real estate commercial paper, of which over 1 million yuan is overdue. Only 300,000 yuan has been paid so far. In the real estate sector, commercial paper can be understood as an IOU from a real estate company to a supplier. Suppliers can transfer the commercial paper if they need cash before the acceptance period, but they need to offer a discount. 'Real estate paper dealers' is the term outsiders use for people like Zhang Di. Zhang Di's main role is to connect suppliers with funding sources (real estate developers), earning a commission from the spread between the buying and selling prices. Where there are issuers and acceptors, the role of the paper dealer naturally emerges. Real estate companies are usually at the core of the supply chain, making real estate commercial paper one of the main financing methods for developers. For both parties, they are a special presence operating in the gray area of the real estate commercial paper industry. They participate directly in transactions, exchanging commercial paper for cash on the spot, which is their daily practice. Using 3 million yuan from demolition compensation to become a paper dealer Zhang Di is from Nanyang City, Henan Province. Before getting into real estate paper, he ran a small convenience store at the entrance of his residential compound, earning about over 100,000 yuan a year. In 2019, through a friend's introduction, he entered this circle. 'At that time, my family's old house was demolished. We had many properties there, but we didn't live there, so we didn't take the replacement houses from the developer and opted for cash instead, totaling close to 3 million yuan scattered around,' Zhang Di told The Paper. 'Suddenly having so much money, I didn't know what to do with it. I already had a house and a car. Coincidentally, a fellow townsman was doing this and said it was very profitable. As long as you have money, you can profit from the time difference.' Generally, the acceptance period for real estate developers is up to one year, with a relatively short cash-out cycle. If things go smoothly, the annualized return on investment can be very substantial. Zhang Di recalled that seeing his friend make a lot of money back then made him itch to try it himself. But he was afraid of losing money due to his lack of understanding. So, Zhang Di first spent two months learning from his friend to understand how it actually worked. After that, Zhang Di entered the circle. 'The first deal was for a 200,000 yuan commercial paper. A supplier urgently needed money to pay for goods. The paper still had three months until maturity, but he couldn't wait. So, my friend introduced him to me. The developer offered him a 13% discount, but I managed to push it down another point and got it,' Zhang Di said. He naively thought he would make a profit after waiting three months. However, three months later, when Zhang Di took the paper to the developer, he was told payment would be delayed. 'I was naive back then, seeing how easily others made money, thinking it was that simple. I didn't expect the developer to directly say, 'We don't have money for you now, you'll have to wait a while.' When I asked until when, they impatiently told me to just wait,' Zhang Di said. He started to panic, feeling the money might be lost. He said his sleep suffered during that time, constantly worrying about what if the money was gone. But his friend assured him that the company was fine, just had a longer account period, and wouldn't default. This reassurance calmed the inexperienced Zhang Di. He thought, if others got paid, why wouldn't they pay his relatively small amount? Sure enough, two months later, Zhang Di successfully received the 200,000 yuan payment. The first deal gave Zhang Di a taste of the sweetness of paper trading. After that, Zhang Di's business grew. He gradually developed his own experience in selecting acceptors. 'Papers that everyone in the circle deals with usually don't have major problems. Don't be greedy for exceptionally high discounts; making a little is fine. This approach is more stable and less likely to result in non-payment.' But Zhang Di admitted that most people in this line want to win big with small stakes, so they usually go for high-yield papers. Even though everyone knows the risks are high, they do it for the high returns, as long as they can ensure their cash flow doesn't break, they can be bold. 'If you haven't dealt with high-risk commercial paper from a certain developer, we don't consider you an insider. Because their discount rate is high, and the volume is large with strong liquidity. Of course, high risk, high return. If you have sufficient funds and can maintain cash flow, dealing in their paper can earn you a lot.' However, Zhang Di also emphasized that because commercial paper amounts are often fragmented and terms vary, their liquidity in the secondary market is not as good as bonds. Furthermore, the yield from discounting/transferring heavily depends on the holder's urgency for cash, and there is a risk of non-payment. Closing the building materials business to focus on trading commercial paper, earning 1 million yuan in two years Real estate commercial paper is a payment and settlement tool issued by developers using their own credit to upstream and downstream partners. Simply put, these commercial papers issued by developers to suppliers are instruments payable at maturity. The developer purchases raw materials from a building materials supplier but doesn't pay cash; instead, it issues a commercial paper. The holder can present the paper to the acceptor for payment upon maturity. 'If you have a 1 million yuan paper that matures in six months or a year, but you need cash urgently and can't wait that long, then you need to discount it. At that point, you usually go to a paper intermediary, also called a paper dealer. You give them your paper, and they give you cash. It's that simple,' said another paper intermediary, Gu Jia. 'But generally, the discount rate varies depending on the company's credit. We don't accept all papers; we are selective.' Gu Jia entered the business earlier than Zhang Di, starting in 2013. She made a lot of money by buying commercial paper at low prices. 'I originally was in the building materials business and dealt with developers. The practice of issuing commercial paper existed back then. I had commercial paper myself, but I also started buying it at a discount from others, targeting those who needed cash urgently,压低价格收, and profiting from the spread.' Gu Jia recalled that the market situation was far better then than it is now. 'Back then, we didn't worry about developers being unable to pay. Usually, they would delay for about six months and then pay. If you weren't in a hurry for cash, earning the spread over time was very cost-effective.' Gu Jia said that later, she found that trading commercial paper was more profitable than her building materials business. Gradually, she closed her building materials business and focused on buying commercial paper. In two years, she earned about 1 million yuan. With the 1 million yuan earned, Gu Jia bought a house outright in her hometown. She felt like the house fell from the sky. 'This money was earned very easily, without much cost. I just used my own money upfront to buy discounted commercial paper, and then all I had to do was wait for the developer to pay. My previous business couldn't make this much money in such a short time.' Back then, Gu Jia even considered going all-in with her money, but her husband stopped her. 'He said not to put all your eggs in one basket. This money-making method isn't sustainable in the long run; it's essentially exploiting a loophole. He thought this should only be a side income. Later, we started a small business together.' Gu Jia also admitted that this business heavily relies on the real estate market. If the market takes a downturn, the commercial paper in hand could turn into worthless paper at any time. 'If houses don't sell, developers can't get payments, then our papers can't be cashed. You can pressure them to death, but they still have no money for you, so the risk is also huge. I was gambling, betting that the real estate market would always be good, that their houses would sell well, and payments would come quickly, so the papers I hold could be cashed.' Holding millions in overdue paper unable to be paid on time Starting in 2020, rumors spread in the market about several real estate companies facing cash flow problems. News of debt defaults kept emerging, making everyone in the circle somewhat nervous. Since the beginning of this year, many developers have delayed or defaulted on commercial paper payments. Buying commercial paper now requires being prepared to lose the principal. Some papers enter the market already close to their maturity date, making the recovery of principal and interest somewhat a matter of 'leaving it to fate.' In May of this year, after hearing that someone in the circle had paper that couldn't be cashed for a long time, Zhang Di started to worry. He held over 1 million yuan in commercial paper. If it all became unredeemable, it would be a significant loss for him. Even though some of his papers were still a month away from maturity, Zhang Di started inquiring everywhere about the situation. Over 1 million yuan was not a small amount for him. 'Although online news can be true or false, seeing so many reports, and the stock price falling every day, doesn't that mean the company is no longer favored by the market? Not seeing any sign of the stock price recovering makes me very anxious. The discussion in the circle is, if this company goes into bankruptcy restructuring, will these papers become worthless, or will new papers be issued to extend the term? Could the papers I hold really turn into worthless scrap paper?' Zhang Di said. So, Zhang Di tried to contact the project companies that issued the papers. One project company told him that payment on time was definitely impossible. The company's funds were very tight now, priority was to ensure normal repayments to other financial institutions. Regarding commercial paper, they could only pay back little by little. 'But they told me not to worry, saying they would definitely pay,' Zhang Di said. When the acceptance date arrived, just as the staff said, these commercial papers were not paid. Thus, Zhang Di's current overdue paper reached over 1 million yuan. For him, besides waiting, there was no better option. Zhang Di said some impatient people around him started speaking out on social media, trying to get everyone together to pressure the developer for payment. The strategy did have some effect. On July 15th, a 100,000 yuan paper he held was paid. On July 20th, another 200,000 yuan was paid. Zhang Di is very clear about the current situation. 'If you go to them, they won't tell you they have no money for you; they just delay. But when? It's unknown. They just say 'as soon as possible.' You can't afford to break relations with them, otherwise you might not get a single cent.' As for Gu Jia, she has 200,000 yuan in unreal estate commercial paper,其中一家逾期未兑付的有12万元，另一家逾期未兑付的有8万元. Initially, Gu Jia thought the two developers' failure to pay at maturity was like before - replacing old with new, and they would be paid within a year at most. But this time, the developer's payment never came. 'Before, even if payment was delayed at maturity, no one thought it was a problem. But this time seems different. Initially, I saw online that the company owed banks a lot of money and couldn't pay. I asked them and got the reply that they had no money for me now and I should wait. After asking a few times and getting the same answer, I realized this money probably won't come back,' Gu Jia said. Gu Jia lamented to The Paper, 'Thankfully, my husband stopped me from buying a lot back then, otherwise I might have even more now. Now, I can only wait for their news. I also hope they can recover; I don't want them to collapse. If they collapse, I have even less chance of getting my money back.' (The names of the interviewees in the article are pseudonyms)

Title: The Seventh Weapon for Handling Life Insurance Disputes: The Principle of Inferring Seriousness from Minor Cases Content: First, a question is raised: Is the 'principle of inferring seriousness from minor cases' applicable to critical illness insurance contract disputes in civil matters? In criminal law, 'inferring seriousness from minor cases' means that if an act with even lesser social harm is defined as a crime in criminal law, then this act should certainly be treated as a crime as well. Applied to critical illness insurance, it means that if the current illness is more severe than the conditions listed in the critical illness definition, then this illness should logically be treated as a critical illness. Let's look at two real-life examples: Case 1: The critical illness insurance clause required the use of a ventilator for over 96 hours for severe coma, but the insured met the severe coma score criteria yet died before using the ventilator for 96 hours, leading to a claim denial. Case 2: The clause for uremia (end-stage renal failure) required regular dialysis for over 90 days to claim, but the patient died less than 2 months after diagnosis, and the insurer denied the claim citing failure to meet the 90-day condition. The purpose of critical illness insurance products is to provide financial support for severe illnesses with high medical costs. Whether it is a critical illness is not determined by whether a specific treatment was performed. If a patient has a critical illness but, due to local medical limitations, financial constraints, or other irresistible reasons, cannot undergo the corresponding treatment, denying the existence of the critical illness is clearly unreasonable. From the underlying logic of the critical illness classification model developed by the China Insurance Association and the Chinese Medical Doctor Association, the definitions and conditions in the contract should represent the minimum criteria for that critical illness. If there are more severe consequences, they naturally align better with the essence of a critical illness. Therefore, the states and durations stipulated in the clauses are used to distinguish severity; death shortly after diagnosis clearly indicates a more severe condition. As is well known, there are many catch-all disease definitions in critical illness insurance clauses. Recently, a case involving a claim denial due to death before a clear diagnosis of myocardial infarction was resolved by applying this principle. We know that if the party with superior professional knowledge and ample drafting time creates ambiguous standard terms in unilaterally drafted contracts, the drafter cannot be absolved of responsibility. Thus, beyond the examples of deep coma and renal failure, conditions like stroke, paralysis, loss of independent living ability, and end-stage disease are significant in critical illness contract interpretations, especially for policies with multiple claims and no restrictions on the same cause. In light of this, similar to the principle of non-retroactivity of laws, the principle of inferring seriousness from minor cases, born in criminal law, can still serve as an interpretive and reasoning principle in civil disputes. Deservedly, it stands as the seventh weapon for handling life insurance disputes. -end- Recommended reading: The Six Divine Swords of Life Insurance Problem-Solving

Title: Redmi Note 12 Turbo phone keeps restarting after a year and a half of use. Have you encountered this problem? Content: If it's an automatic restart during operation that is completely unexpected and has no discernible pattern, it could be due to a weak CPU solder joint. Several years ago, one of the Redmi Note 9 Pro phones I bought (out of a total of 5) had a similar issue - it would restart just a few seconds after booting into the system, and even if you managed to get into the RECovery interface and left it idle, it would still automatically restart. Searching online suggested that for this kind of restarting issue, the CPU needs to be re-soldered or re-balled and then re-soldered to fix it. I found a shop on Xianyu that does this kind of repair, mailed the phone to them, and they fixed it. The files and everything on the phone were completely unaffected. The charge was 69 yuan. As for whether they just re-soldered it or removed it, re-balled it, and then soldered it back on, I can't say for sure. I just checked again, and the price has even gone up now :)

Title: What kind of insurance is the Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance? How many serious illnesses does it cover? Before the following analysis begins, if you are not familiar with critical illness insurance, you can read this article to learn more: "A Step-by-Step Guide to Avoiding These Pitfalls of Critical Illness Insurance." 1. What are the coverage details of Huaxia Life's Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance? Let's first look at the coverage structure diagram of Huaxia Life's Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance: The following content is based on my analysis, and here's something important to note about Huaxia Life's Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance: > No additional payout for critical illnesses Huaxia Life promotes this Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance as simple and enjoyable, so this product only covers 81 major diseases. Flexible payment options Huaxia Life's Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance allows for a single premium payment (i.e., paying the entire premium at once) or payment over 10, 15, or 20 years, offering great flexibility in choices. However, the maximum payment term for the Zhizun Bao YOYO Bao Critical Illness Insurance is 20 years, which is slightly inferior compared to critical illness insurance products on the market with a maximum payment term of 30 years! Title: Authoritative Responses from Five Ministries, Read Now→ Content: The State Council Information Office held a regular State Council policy briefing on the morning of November 22. The Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the People's Bank of China, and the General Administration of Customs introduced relevant policy measures to promote stable growth of foreign trade and answered questions from journalists. Let's pay attention! Will adjusting the duty-free policy for small cross-border parcels affect the development of China's cross-border e-commerce? Ministry of Commerce: The reason cross-border e-commerce has been able to develop relatively rapidly so far is mainly because it has its own unique advantages compared to traditional trade. Specifically: First, it can meet customers' personalized needs. Through big data analysis, cross-border e-commerce can design products needed by consumers based on the needs of individual consumers, so its design is very fast, batch sizes are small, and it can track market trends, which are conditions not possessed by general trade. Second, fast delivery. Some cross-border e-commerce involves small parcels being exported directly from China to foreign countries, or goods can first be shipped abroad by ship or plane, and then transactions are completed abroad via small parcels, so its timeliness is fast. Third, cost savings. Everyone has experience with e-commerce procurement; cross-border e-commerce does not require going to physical stores, thus saving on store costs, personnel costs, financial costs, and also eliminating secondary wholesale costs, going directly from producer to consumer. Precisely because of these advantages, cross-border e-commerce has good competitiveness, becoming a very important vital force in world trade, and its share in international trade will continue to grow. These three characteristics are not closely related to small parcels. Therefore, after canceling the preferential treatment for small parcels, the inherent characteristics of cross-border e-commerce have not disappeared, and cross-border e-commerce still maintains strong competitiveness. To support the development of new business forms, the "Several Policy Measures on Promoting Stable Growth of Foreign Trade" proposes specific measures, and the next step will involve continued intensified efforts. First, strengthen supply-demand matching. Organize foreign trade enterprises that have stores on cross-border e-commerce platforms to connect with overseas smart logistics platforms, and support eligible localities in holding cross-border e-commerce fairs and supply-demand matching events. Second, improve compliance building. Currently, there are already 120,000 cross-border e-commerce export enterprises in China, most of which are small and medium-sized enterprises. They encounter issues such as customs declaration, taxation, product quality, and intellectual property during the export process. Therefore, it is necessary to help these enterprises with training to improve their compliance capabilities. Third, vigorously develop cross-border e-commerce to empower industrial belts. Encourage platform enterprises and leading chain enterprises to deeply engage with local characteristic industrial belts, including the 165 national cross-border e-commerce comprehensive pilot zones, to cooperate and help more foreign trade enterprises, especially small, medium, and micro enterprises, reach foreign buyers through cross-border e-commerce online platforms, obtain orders, and participate in international trade. Fourth, deepen international cooperation. China has currently signed 23 free trade agreements. In recently signed bilateral FTAs or upgrades of past FTAs, cross-border e-commerce has been included as a new clause in the bilateral FTA, promoting the development of cross-border e-commerce with relevant FTA partner countries. Simultaneously, as an important member of the WTO, China is actively promoting the WTO negotiations on the e-commerce agreement. We hope the WTO e-commerce agreement negotiations can conclude soon. This will allow us to provide a better development environment for cross-border e-commerce with more WTO members. Faced with fluctuations in the international shipping market, what conveniences and support does the Ministry of Commerce provide to foreign trade enterprises? Ministry of Commerce: China is a major goods trading nation. Last year, China's foreign trade volume reached 41 trillion RMB. 95% of this trade volume's freight volume is completed by sea transport. This year, key shipping channels like the Red Sea, Suez Canal, and Panama Canal have encountered obstacles, and worker strikes have occurred in ports of some countries. These have caused some disturbances in the international sea transport market and negatively impacted the normal transportation of China's foreign trade. The most direct result is a significant increase in freight costs from China to Europe and the Mediterranean, and extended transportation times. During research, many foreign trade enterprises expressed the hope that the government would take measures in this regard. Building on existing measures, our next steps are: First, work with the transport department to organize local foreign trade enterprises and foreign trade transport companies to conduct matchmaking, so that the supply and demand sides of sea transport can better match needs. Second, encourage shipping companies to develop online platforms to meet the booking needs of small and medium-sized enterprises. This is the second measure, which has already begun; we hope more shipping companies can provide online sea freight booking services. Third, work with relevant departments, especially the maritime transport authorities, to guide shipping companies to optimize route layouts and ensure capacity supply on popular routes to Latin America, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, etc. For example, when automobile exports required Ro-Ro ships, China's Ro-Ro ship capacity was insufficient. Through joint efforts with some shipping companies, the capacity for automobile transport using Ro-Ro ships has now significantly improved. We will work together with the transport department, local commerce authorities, shipping enterprises, and foreign trade enterprises to enable foreign trade enterprises to obtain more convenience and support in organizing international transportation. How to promote enterprises' integration into international industrial and supply chains? Ministry of Industry and Information Technology: Encourage multinational enterprises, especially high-tech enterprises in biopharmaceuticals, electronic information, etc., to establish R&D centers, pilot platforms, and production bases in China, jointly promote industrial innovation cooperation, promote domestic enterprises to enhance their international operation levels, and deeply integrate into the global industrial and supply chains. Guide enterprises to strengthen cooperation with overseas enterprises through methods like overseas investment setting up factories and technology licensing, tailored to local conditions. At the same time, build various platforms to guide the vast number of Chinese and foreign small and medium-sized enterprises to actively integrate into the global market while sharing China's development opportunities. How does the People's Bank of China assess the current and next year's RMB to USD exchange rate situation? People's Bank of China: Our basic judgment is that the RMB exchange rate will remain basically stable at a reasonable and equilibrium level, mainly supported by a series of favorable factors: China's balance of payments remains stable, foreign exchange traders are more mature, trading behavior is more rational, market resilience has significantly increased, the recently introduced package of macro policies has significantly improved market expectations, and the trend of economic stabilization and improvement is further consolidated and strengthened. These are the fundamental supporting factors for the current basic stability of the RMB exchange rate. Of course, we also acknowledge that factors influencing the exchange rate are diverse, such as economic growth, monetary policy, financial markets, geopolitics, risk events, etc. Influenced by various factors including divergent economic trends among countries, geopolitical changes, and international financial market fluctuations, the future RMB exchange rate may maintain a two-way fluctuation trend. In the several measures to promote foreign trade stability and growth, how will the Customs side implement them? How to create a more efficient, convenient, and predictable customs clearance environment for foreign trade enterprises? General Administration of Customs: Customs will focus on achieving "Four Promotions" to implement policies and measures effectively. First, promote the innovative development of new business forms like cross-border e-commerce. Customs will continue to deepen comprehensive reforms in cross-border e-commerce customs supervision, strengthen intellectual property protection in the cross-border e-commerce field, and promote the high-quality development of cross-border e-commerce. Additionally, Customs will continue to support the innovative development of bonded maintenance and border resident mutual trade, further stimulating foreign trade growth vitality. Second, promote the export of characteristic and advantageous agricultural products. Customs has always helped Chinese agricultural products "go global" by increasing recommendations for enterprises' official foreign registrations, setting up green channels for local inspection of fresh and perishable agricultural products, and helping enterprises actively respond to unreasonable foreign trade restrictions. In the next step, we will continue to use a combination of policy guidance, facilitated customs clearance, technical standard services, etc., to support the expansion of characteristic agricultural product exports. Third, promote the import of energy resources and other products. Customs will continuously optimize facilitation measures such as "release before inspection" and "acceptance of inspection results," especially recently introducing reforms to deepen the control and inspection mode for high-tech goods like vacuum packaging, guiding enterprises to make good use of various tax preferential policies, and better serve the "introduction" of high-tech equipment and energy resources. Fourth, promote the accurate and efficient delivery of policies. To allow enterprises to enjoy policy benefits as soon as possible, we will continue to deepen long-term mechanisms such as "Customs Directors Delivering Policies to Doorsteps" and the Customs 12360 consultation hotline service, strengthen the宣传 interpretation of existing and new policies, continuously enhance the warmth and precision of customs supervision and services, continuously contribute to the qualitative improvement and quantitative stability of foreign trade, and contribute Customs strength to achieving the annual economic and social development goals and tasks. What measures has China recently taken to facilitate the entry of foreign nationals? Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Recently, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has continuously introduced visa facilitation measures and continuously improved the experience of foreigners coming to China. First, make personnel exchanges smoother. ● Over the past year, we have signed mutual visa exemption agreements with six countries: Singapore, Thailand, Kazakhstan, Antigua and Barbuda, Georgia, and Solomon Islands. Currently, we have achieved comprehensive visa exemption with 25 countries. ● To date, China has concluded mutual visa exemption agreements covering different passport types with 157 countries and regions. ● Additionally, foreigners can use transit visa exemptions, cruise ship visa exemptions, and visa-free policies for specific areas like Hainan Island to travel to China or conduct business activities. Second, make personnel exchanges more convenient. ● We have launched a new version of the Chinese visa application form, optimizing and simplifying items by 34%, significantly reducing form filling time. ● Chinese embassies and consulates abroad have comprehensively abolished the visa appointment system, further expanded the scope of fingerprint exemption, and exempted fingerprint collection for all applicants for short-term visas for one or two entries with a stay of within 180 days. After eliminating appointments and fingerprinting, visa procedures for foreigners coming to China have become increasingly convenient. ● Furthermore, we have temporarily reduced visa fees by 25% according to the current standard, further reducing the cost for foreigners to come to China. Third, make personnel exchanges more frequent. ● This year, we have reached arrangements with countries like Brazil and Australia for mutual issuance of ten-year multiple-entry and five-year multiple-entry visas, issued five-year multiple-entry visas for personnel from Central and Eastern European countries, issued five-year multiple-entry "Lancang-Mekong visas" for business people from Mekong countries, and actively participated in the APEC Business Travel Card program to facilitate exchanges of Chinese and foreign business personnel in the Asia-Pacific region. ● We have also issued five-year multiple-entry visas for foreign residents of the Hong Kong and Macao Special Administrative Regions, further facilitating their travel to the mainland and actively supporting the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. According to data released by competent authorities, in the third quarter of this year, foreign nationals entered China 8.186 million times, a year-on-year increase of 48.8%; among them, 4.885 million entries were visa-free, a year-on-year increase of 78.6%. The scale of bonded maintenance business is relatively small, but enterprises have such demands. How will we support its development next? Ministry of Commerce: The development of bonded maintenance business is currently at a relatively small scale stage, but there is a good trend. Currently, China has carried out over 260 bonded maintenance projects, spread across 23 provinces and cities. Last year, the import and export value reached 32 billion USD. This scale is relatively small, but enterprises have such demands. Bonded maintenance also involves some regulatory issues, so carrying out this work is very important, while also strengthening supervision. The next steps are: First, promote the issuance of a new batch of comprehensive bonded zone maintenance product catalogs. This work is mainly carried out within customs comprehensive bonded zones; which products can be maintained is determined by a catalog. The next step is to further expand the product catalog because, after pilot programs, there is more regulatory experience. Second, prepare to issue regulations on bonded maintenance in Pilot Free Trade Zones, as well as the maintenance product catalog within Pilot Free Trade Zones. This shows that the scope of openness is further expanding. Originally, it was comprehensive bonded zones; now it extends to Pilot Free Trade Zones. Third, promote the pilot implementation of bonded maintenance projects with high technological content and high added value in areas outside comprehensive bonded zones and Pilot Free Trade Zones. Some bonded maintenance products are very large in size, and comprehensive bonded zones/Pilot Free Trade Zones cannot provide so much land, so we plan to conduct some pilots outside these two zones. Fourth, continuously expand the range of maintenance products. As mentioned earlier regarding geographical scope, the product scope also needs further expansion, forming replicable and scalable institutional innovation results, and on this basis, further expand bonded maintenance.

Title: Do you think eating at the airport is expensive? Content: There's no need to even think about this question, it's definitely expensive! Yesterday, I flew from Nanjing to Lijiang. I hadn't eaten lunch, so I had to grab something at the airport. At a fast-food style restaurant, a small bowl of steamed pork ribs was 29 yuan, a bowl of steamed eggs was 19 yuan, and there was no plain rice, only fried rice for 15 yuan. One meal cost me 63 yuan. If I ate somewhere outside the airport? The ribs would be 15 yuan at most, steamed eggs should be 5-8 yuan, and rice would be free. Of course, if we're talking about the cheapest option, it's probably still McDonald's. A chicken wrap is 19 yuan, which is much better compared to places where a meal easily costs sixty or seventy yuan. Why is eating at the airport so expensive? Brother Xian thinks there are a few main reasons: First, the rent is high. In a place like an airport, opening a restaurant or clothing store is definitely more expensive than in a regular location. After all, airport resources are monopolistic. The foot traffic is high, and there are only a few spots available – take it or leave it.

Title: What to do if the car key is lost? Content: What to do if the key is lost? If the car key is lost, don't panic first. The first question you should clarify is whether you lost the car key yourself or if it was stolen. If you lost it yourself, the solution is simple. But if the key was stolen, that's a different matter. Generally, in this case, comprehensive security protection for the car is needed. 1: Lost by yourself If you confirm that you lost the key yourself, you can contact a specialized 4S shop and have them tow your car to the shop to get a new key made for you. Alternatively, you can directly request their door-to-door service, which avoids the hassle of towing. They can come directly to your home or the car's location to make the key, which is very convenient. 2: Key stolen If you confirm that your key was stolen, what you need to do is not let the car leave your sight, because the car is at risk of being driven away at any time. You can still contact the 4S company. After the company personnel tow the car to the 4S shop, have them completely replace the locks and reconfigure keys for the new locks. You absolutely must not continue using the old locks. Furthermore, after changing the locks, you must always be vigilant to avoid being targeted by criminals. 3: Unsure if lost or stolen If you don't know whether your key was lost or stolen, then for safety's sake, it is recommended that you completely change the locks. Admittedly, the cost of changing the locks is much higher than the cost of making a new key, but this is still better than the loss of the car being stolen. Don't risk a big loss for a small gain. When your key is lost, first, you should analyze clearly which of the above three situations applies to you? After making a clear analysis, choose the most effective solution to resolve the difficulty you are facing. Some people usually have a habit of being forgetful, either forgetting where they put this thing or forgetting where they put that thing. They usually put items anywhere, and can't find them when they need them. Some car owners sometimes forget where they put their car keys. Let's talk about what to do if you can't find your car key. So, if you can't find the key and need to use the car key, there are two ways to get one. The first way is to go to a 4S shop to get a key made. If you want to use this method, the 4S shop staff will generally find the corresponding key code based on your car model, then destroy the code of the lost key, and finally give you a new key code. This way, if the original lost key is found by someone else, you don't have to worry because they cannot start your car. The second method is to go to an auto parts market to get a key made. However, if you get a key made at the auto parts market, there is still some risk to your car's security. At the auto parts market, they only copy the key's code. Therefore, if someone finds your original key, that person can still open your car. However, the price of getting a key made at the auto parts market is several times cheaper than at a 4S shop. Each has its own advantages and disadvantages. Actually, when we buy a car, we will find a plastic tag on the key with numbers written on it. This is actually to prevent the key from being lost. If it is lost, you can take the code on the small aluminum tag to the manufacturer to have a new car key matched. Therefore, that small aluminum tag is very important. Friends who buy cars must keep it safe. Losing a car key is a bit frustrating, but don't worry, as long as you are not in some remote wilderness, it can be solved. Call the 4S shop people, tell them your location, and remember to make up a good reason to make them believe you are not stupid for losing the key. For example, you can say the key fell into a river and was washed away, but the reason you went into the river was to save an elderly person or child who fell into the water, and you lost the key under heroic circumstances. At this time, the 4S shop's after-sales service will feel respect and be more proactive in solving the窘境 of you being unable to enter or start your car because of the lost key. You need to wait by the car for the 4S people to arrive. Even keyless entry cars have a physical keyhole; you can use the physical key to open the door. At this time, the 4S shop person will bring a self-made key and try to open your car door, first letting you take your things out. But don't worry, your car still cannot be driven away, because if a car could be driven away so easily, it would be too unsafe. The 4S shop person will also call a tow truck to come at the same time. The tow truck will load your car and tow it back to the 4S shop for processing. After it goes back, you can basically go home to get your spare key to open the door and drive the car. If you need to get a key made, that is also possible. Every car has a unique key tooth pattern. If it's keyless entry, there is also a unique chip. Copying it allows for making another key. But if you have even lost your spare key, then there's really nothing to say. It's like changing a door lock: change the car door lock, then change the electronic lock chip, and then match a new set of keys for you. The price of changing keys depends on the price of the car. For a 100,000 yuan car, it's probably around 2000 yuan. If you have a luxury car, it's more expensive, and you also have to wait, because luxury cars are strict and have good service; they make you wait to solve the problem properly, because good things take time. The above are the possible things that happen when a car key is lost and the possible handling methods. Remember, if the key is lost, don't panic; contact the 4S shop and anything can be discussed. What to do if the car key is lost? You've asked the right person. After all, many drivers have the habit of being forgetful. I believe many car owners have lost their car keys. Generally, when the car is delivered, you are given two keys, one as a spare. But what if both keys are lost? Actually, if the car key is lost, you can go to two places to get a new one. One is to go to a 4S shop to get it made, and the second is to go to an auto parts market to get it made. The price is definitely different. For example, the auto parts market is at least half the price of the 4S shop. Why is that? Because the 4S shop makes the key based on your car model and purchase record to find the key code, and then resets a new code for you. This way, the lost car key becomes invalid, and anyone who finds the key cannot use it to start your car. The auto parts market directly copies the code, so someone who finds the key can still start your car. So there is a reason why the 4S shop is much more expensive. After all, they don't just directly copy the key for you.

Title: 💍 Should the ring setting for a diamond ring be made of platinum or 18K gold? Content: 18K gold is recommended. 18K gold has greater hardness, is wear-resistant, and is suitable for diamond ring styles with a sense of design and complexity; platinum does not fade, but its texture is relatively softer, so it is recommended to choose simple styles. - When buying a diamond ring, should you choose custom-made or branded? 💬 Diamonds are not brand-specific; the price of a diamond is entirely determined by its 4C quality. Well-known brands allow you to get the diamond faster, but the product range is relatively limited, and the selection of diamonds is more constrained. There is a brand premium, so sisters with brand loyalty, feel free to choose! - Custom brands rely on word-of-mouth reputation and excel in service quality. You can design the diamond ring style according to your own ideas, ensuring a unique piece. When selecting the diamond's 4C, you also have more flexibility. However, you need to reserve enough time for the customization cycle. Besides the diamond ring, what other rings should you buy for marriage? 💓 Wedding bands, one for each the man and the woman. - What other diamond knowledge should you know when buying a lab-grown diamond ring to avoid pitfalls? Reject milky and brown diamonds. Reject fluorescent diamonds. Reject certificates issued within 1-2 years to avoid dishonest merchants swapping certificates. The color, weight, composition, etc., of the diamond are subject to the actual product description at the time of purchase. ❣️ #NaturalDiamond #LooseDiamond #DiamondRingStyles #ShowOffMyDiamondRing #EngagementRing #ProposalRing #EternityRing #ChowTaiFookDiamondRing #OneCaratDiamondRing #SixProngDiamondRing
