Title: Is it difficult for computer science majors to find jobs now? Can someone tell me the real situation? Content: Do you have project experience? Those demo-level projects online are completely useless. What companies want now are projects that can be truly implemented in the market. The problem is you need a job to gain this experience, but companies require experience to hire you, so it's a bit of a vicious cycle. There are also many training institutions in the market that only teach superficial skills, claiming they can guarantee employment but you might not even pass the probation period. It's best to find training programs that actually guide you through real projects. Once you accumulate experience, you won't have to worry about finding a good job.

Title: How to apply for a data analyst position without experience? Content: Although you have no experience, the following points may be helpful when applying for a data analyst position: Enhance your skills: Look for relevant data analysis tutorials online, self-study some basic knowledge of data analysis, and get hands-on practice by completing small data analysis projects. Consider using some free data analysis tools, such as R and Python. Take courses or training programs: Enrolling in courses or training programs can help you systematically learn the fundamental knowledge and skills of data analysis, and you can obtain some certificates, which can increase your competitiveness during the application process. Gain internship experience: Try applying for data analysis internship positions. Through internships, you can gain practical experience and skills in data analysis, and get to know some industry professionals; these connections can also help you find a job in the future. Self-marketing: Showcase your data analysis skills and projects on social media platforms like LinkedIn, participate in discussions and activities in data analysis communities, and build your personal brand. Finally, it's important to realize that data analyst positions have high requirements for experience and skills. Do not be overly optimistic about your abilities; instead, continuously learn and practice to improve your capabilities and competitiveness.

Title: How to keep debt restructuring costs low? Content: Restructuring costs mainly focus on 3 areas 1️⃣ The upfront funding part, this area has room for savings. Try to bear the monthly payments yourself as much as possible, even partially, because these monthly payments don't necessarily have to be fully covered by the funding party. The less you use, the lower your costs will be. 2️⃣ Credit card maintenance part. If there is any remaining credit card amount, you can manage the card rotations yourself according to the company's requirements, which can save some costs. 3️⃣ Later-stage fees are based on the contract agreement, there is no room for savings. Feel free to discuss if you have any questions.

Title: Exercising consistently for 5 years, but diagnosed with liver cirrhosis: Why did self-discipline become the enemy of health? Content: What are the causes of liver cirrhosis? Don't tell me the doctor said exercising hardened your liver... If the doctor really said that, I suggest you file a complaint. If the doctor said it's due to chronic viral hepatitis leading to cirrhosis, then I can only say that exercise and self-discipline cannot stop the virus from damaging your liver, just like the healthiest lifestyle cannot make people immortal. Take antiviral medication promptly, accept this reality, and don't let the virus further harm your liver. If cirrhosis progresses further, it can lead to liver cancer. If it's alcoholic liver disease causing cirrhosis, then I want to ask you, does your self-discipline mean persistently drinking heavily every day for over a decade? Then you are indeed quite 'self-disciplined'—most alcoholics can't keep that up. If it's fatty liver disease, sorry, I haven't seen clinical cases of fatty liver progressing to cirrhosis. Even if it is fatty liver, after five years of exercise, no matter how poorly you trained, even without muscle gain, you shouldn't have persistent steatohepatitis, right? Unless you actually did no exercise at all and didn't control your diet at all, then your so-called self-discipline is baseless. Or did you misuse medication? Drug-induced hepatitis?

Title: Collection丨Ministry of Finance Centralized Reply on Three Questions Regarding Government Procurement Projects Content: Introduction: 1 Question: Our unit has numerous subordinate units, widely dispersed locations, and many separate sporadic decoration and repair projects with uncertain amounts. According to our province's regulations, decoration and repair require fixed-point procurement (currently applicable for amounts below 4 million). Our unit's annual budget for decoration and repair is over 9 million. May our unit use open tender to select three suppliers to provide decoration and repair project services? If using the open tender procurement method, it must follow project tender procedures. Does it need to clarify procurement requirements such as service standards and pricing principles based on the service area? If not using open tender, can the competitive consultation procurement method be used? When using the competitive consultation procurement method, for decoration projects, is it necessary to determine three suppliers under the premise of clarifying procurement requirements like service standards and pricing principles based on the service area? Answer: 1. For projects that indeed require multiple suppliers, the procuring entity should, under the premise of clarifying procurement requirements such as service standards and pricing principles, reasonably set procurement packages based on factors like business nature and service area, and through competitive selection, assign the corresponding procurement business to specific suppliers. It cannot directly select three suppliers through the open tender procurement method. 2. Separate decoration and repair projects can be regarded as service items and procurement activities should be organized according to relevant government procurement regulations. 3. Title: Buying stocks of the four major banks with 5 million, the annual dividend is about 7%, which is 350,000. If held for more than one year, there is no personal income tax. Is long-term holding reliable? Content: It is feasible, but you should not go all in at once, and you should wait for a bear market to start building your position. For example, with Agricultural Bank of China, you can build a position of 200,000 at around 3-3.5 yuan, then add 200,000 for every 0.1 yuan drop. Do not operate on small increases. Funds not yet invested can be used to buy reverse repurchase agreements daily, which is not worse than a one-year bank time deposit. The entire process of going full position may take several years. During this time, you can do intraday trading (T+0). As long as your holding cost is low enough, this is your best financial management strategy, and it allows you to participate fully in the Shanghai market's new share subscriptions. Title: What are some ways to speed up recovery from heatstroke? Content: The most critical steps after heatstroke are rapid cooling, rehydration, and timely treatment according to the severity of symptoms. 1. Immediately leave the high-temperature environment Upon discovering heatstroke, first move to a cool, ventilated area away from direct sunlight. If outdoors, prioritize shade or an air-conditioned indoor space. Lie flat and elevate your legs to promote blood return to the heart. 2. Rapid physical cooling Loosen clothing and apply cool, wet towels to areas with major blood vessels like the neck, armpits, and groin, or use an ice pack (wrapped in a thin cloth to prevent frostbite). If possible, use a spray bottle to mist cool water and combine with a fan to accelerate evaporative cooling. Avoid full-body immersion in ice water to prevent shivering. 3. Replenish fluids and electrolytes If conscious, drink small amounts of diluted salt water or electrolyte sports drinks frequently (100-200 ml every 15 minutes). If vomiting or confusion occurs, do not force fluids and seek immediate medical attention. 4. Emergency medical treatment If body temperature exceeds 40°C, or if there are convulsions, coma, or persistent vomiting, call emergency services immediately. Before medical help arrives, try wrapping the body in a wet sheet to cool it. Hospitals typically treat severe heatstroke with intravenous fluids and medication to reduce fever. After recovering from heatstroke, avoid strenuous activity for 24 hours and maintain a light, easily digestible diet of porridge, fruits, and vegetables. For daily prevention, wear light-colored, breathable clothing and carry salty drinks—for example, replenish 500 ml of diluted salt water per hour during exercise, while high-temperature workers can consume an additional 3-5 grams of salt daily (about half a teaspoon).

Title: How does the tourism industry press the "restart" button? Content: Affected by the COVID-19 pandemic, during the Spring Festival, the domestic tourism industry almost came to a complete standstill. As the state and various regions successively introduced plans and support measures for the resumption of work and production for cultural and tourism enterprises, some scenic spots gradually reopened, signifying the restart of the tourism industry's recovery path. However, facing the crisis, the transformation of the tourism industry has only just begun. An unexpected pandemic pressed the "pause button" on what should have been a booming Spring Festival tourism market. The China Tourism Academy recently released the "China Tourism Economy Blue Book No.12" online, pointing out that "affected by the pandemic, the highly marketized tourism industry is one of the sectors suffering the greatest revenue losses." With the successive introduction of resumption plans and support measures for cultural and tourism enterprises from the state to various provinces, and the gradual reopening of some outdoor scenic spots, it means the tourism industry has begun to restart its recovery path. Dai Bin, President of the China Tourism Academy, stated that the confidence in the tourism industry is slowly thawing, but it will face new challenges and changes. The "frozen" market "The promotional marketing we specifically did for the winter vacation and Spring Festival Golden Week around New Year's Day was all in vain," sighed Zhao Chunwei, head of the marketing department of Chongqing Wansheng Ordovician Scenic Area. Hindered by the pandemic, the entire scenic area suspended operations. The usually busy Spring Festival became idle this year. Ma Dejun, a marketing staff member of Nanchuan Jinfo Mountain Scenic Area, shared the same feeling as Zhao Chunwei. He bluntly stated that in over ten years in the industry, this Spring Festival was the longest holiday he had ever rested. Scenic spots closed, activities canceled, hotels shut down, travel agencies and online travel companies stopped accepting customers... Under the pandemic, the domestic tourism industry completely paused, and the market was forced into a freeze. Regarding the impact of this pandemic on the domestic tourism industry, the China Tourism Academy estimated that in the first quarter and the whole year of 2020, the number of domestic tourist trips would experience negative growth of 56% and 15.5% respectively, with a year-on-year reduction of 932 million trips for the whole year; domestic tourism revenue would experience negative growth of 69% and 20.6% respectively, with a reduction of 1.18 trillion yuan in revenue for the whole year. "Feeling panicked and at a loss," the words of tour guide Chen Jun also expressed the sentiments of those in the tourism industry. Chen Jun regularly leads tour groups within Chongqing. In early January, his group bookings were scheduled until the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. He had hoped to increase his income during the Spring Festival, but the sudden pandemic disrupted all plans. "Tour guides are definitely severely affected," Zhao Chunwei said, as most guides do not have a base salary and rely mainly on service fees from leading tours. Once the tourism market stalls, many people lose their income. Zhou Mingqi, an expert from the Phoenix Net Cultural Tourism Think Tank, believes that after traditional famous scenic spots close, their daily operational maintenance costs are relatively low, so the impact is not too significant. The harder hit are the B-end channel providers, agents, and offline travel agencies. Data shows that during the 2019 Spring Festival holiday, the total number of tourist receptions nationwide was 415 million, generating tourism revenue of 513.9 billion yuan. It was originally expected that the total number of tourist receptions and revenue during this year's Spring Festival holiday would hit new highs, but none of that can be realized now. Self-rescue and mutual assistance Facing the sudden freeze, "what to do" became the primary question for those in the tourism industry. During interviews, reporters learned that for survival, the tourism industry has already taken some measures to "stop the bleeding and create blood" through self-rescue and mutual assistance. With a light tap of the finger, one can enter museums, tour网红景点, and listen to gold-medal commentary. This is the online cultural tourism service "Cloud Tour Chongqing" recently launched by the Chongqing Municipal Commission of Culture and Tourism on its WeChat official account. The reporter personally experienced it: clicking on the "Online Museum" under the "Fighting the Pandemic" section, one can access the official accounts of venues like the Chongqing China Three Gorges Museum, Chongqing Natural History Museum, Chongqing Three Gorges Immigration Memorial Hall, and Chongqing Hongyan Revolutionary History Museum via QR codes, allowing online exhibition viewing 24 hours a day. "Cloud Tour Chongqing is an online service launched in response to the pandemic period, allowing the public to fulfill their travel wishes without leaving home, and also helping scenic spots maintain visibility," explained a relevant负责人 from the Chongqing Municipal Commission of Culture and Tourism. From this platform, all famous scenic spots in Chongqing can be searched. It is reported that "cloud tourism" is a全新尝试 for the tourism industry during the pandemic. Currently, at least 20 cities and over 1,000 scenic spots in China have opened online tour services, offering a different experience to many people eager to travel. "By fully displaying their tourism image and resource advantages through forms like VR, high-definition video, and graphic materials, on one hand, it can provide rich cultural and tourism content for people staying home for long periods during the pandemic, and on the other hand, it can help tourist destinations prepare for the recovery and development of tourism after the pandemic," said Wang Kai, Vice President of Tongcheng-Elong. It is reported that Tongcheng-Elong also initiated the establishment of the city "Ark Alliance," providing free tourism promotion services to all tourist destinations that join the alliance, with display forms including VR and high-definition video materials. "Facing the current situation, enterprises should互助共享 and overcome difficulties together," pointed out an industry insider. Currently, some companies in the industry have begun to抱团取暖. For example, Ctrip Group launched a "Store Care Plan," including a temporary waiver of management fees for three months during the pandemic, and a three-month extension for the task quotas signed by each store, to alleviate operational pressure on stores. Fliggy announced the launch of a tourism merchant assistance plan, containing multiple elements such as traffic support, waiver of annual fees and commissions, preferential loan interest rates, transformation support, and insurance protection. Opportunities behind the crisis Although the pandemic has caused a crisis for the tourism industry, as the frozen market slowly thaws, many industry insiders have stated that opportunities behind the crisis should be seen, and predictions should be made about the new landscape and opportunities after the pandemic. Hong Qinghua, founder of Lvmama and Chairman of Jingyu Lvmama Group, said that the tourism industry, which was put on pause, has actually won a rare period of "quiet reflection." Not long ago, the Chongqing Municipal Commission of Culture and Tourism held a "Cloud Learning" session. Nearly 300 people from over 200 tourism enterprises learned about思路和方法 for handling tour cancellations and refunds under the impact of the pandemic through an online lecture, making active preparations for effectively handling tourism disputes under special circumstances, reducing losses for consumers and tourism operators, and revitalizing the tourism industry. "This lecture was extremely timely. It clarified our思路 for solving the problems we are currently encountering and also showed us hope after resuming work and production," said Liu Jin, Deputy General Manager of Chongqing China Youth Travel Service Co., Ltd. The reporter found that using this period for learning is also a popular method among many industry practitioners. The "Product Operations College" launched by Mafengwo (马蜂窝) has been well-received by cooperative merchants and industry peers. "Continuous learning during the downturn, improving online operational capabilities and content asset construction capabilities, is essential to better welcome the recovery after the pandemic," said one participant. "We can't just rely on waiting. We should take this opportunity to adjust the traditional business model," called for Liu Fang, President of the Chongqing Tourism Chamber of Commerce. Some industry insiders pointed out that the "cloud tourism" launched this time could become a常态方式 in the future. "Although the offline experience of tourism is inherently irreplaceable, online can serve as a solution during special periods or off-seasons, complementing the incompleteness of the offline industry chain," Ma Dejun stated in an interview, indicating that the scenic area plans to focus on development in the online tourism field next, seizing new consumption opportunities after the pandemic. "Although personnel movement is currently controlled, future-oriented tourism transaction activities are not affected by pandemic prevention and can fully proceed. For example, booking services can be considered," suggested tourism expert Liu Feng, advising not to be confined by restrictions. Industry enterprises and scenic spots can, under the guidance of relevant departments' regulations, launch post-pandemic tourism products with significant discounts, coupled with insurance, to enhance market vitality. Recent research results released by Ctrip show that 85% of users will still continue their travel plans for this year after the pandemic. According to Ctrip's flight data, current search volumes for flights during the May Day holiday on Ctrip are already higher than last year. "After the pandemic, people will have a more urgent need to get some fresh air," said Liao Wei, General Manager of Chongqing China Travel Service Group. Although the pandemic has had a huge impact on the tourism market, the public's enthusiasm for tourism still exists, indicating that the tourism industry will not remain depressed for long after the pandemic, which also serves as a "reassurance" for practitioners.

Title: Period delayed for a week, pregnancy test shows negative. Content: If your period is delayed for a week but a pregnancy test shows negative, the possible reasons are summarized as follows: Normal phenomenon: A normal menstrual cycle is generally 28-35 days. If it is early or delayed by about a week, it is usually a normal phenomenon and does not require special treatment. Early pregnancy: Some individuals may have a delayed ovulation period, leading to a later conception time. Even if the period is delayed by a week, it might still be early pregnancy, and the pregnancy test might not detect it. Solution: It is recommended to go to the hospital for a blood test to check HCG levels for a more accurate determination of pregnancy. Inaccurate measurement time or incorrect method: The best time for a pregnancy test is usually the first morning urine after a missed period, when HCG levels are highest, allowing for more accurate detection. If the test is taken at an inaccurate time, such as several days after a missed period, it might not detect pregnancy. If the urine is too diluted, the HCG concentration might be diluted, leading to a negative result. Incorrect usage, such as too short or too long immersion time, or inaccurate reading of results, can also cause a false negative. Solution: It is recommended to use the first-morning urine for the test and carefully read the instructions to operate correctly. Medication effects: Daily use of certain medications containing progesterone, such as progesterone or emergency contraceptive pills, might prolong the luteal phase, causing a delayed period. Solution: Stop taking the current medication immediately and seek treatment under a doctor's guidance, such as using spironolactone to maintain hormonal balance. Endocrine disorders: Obesity, excessive dieting, irregular lifestyle, premature ovarian failure, polycystic ovary syndrome, etc., can lead to endocrine disorders in women, resulting in a delayed period. Solution: Use medications like mifepristone or hydrocortisone under a doctor's guidance for treatment. Chronic diseases: Chronic conditions such as chronic hepatitis, tuberculosis, tumors, hypothyroidism, etc., might also cause a delayed period. Solution: Treatment targeting the specific chronic disease is necessary. Psychological factors: Long-term staying up late, excessive stress, etc., can disrupt hormone secretion, leading to a delayed period. Solution: Adjust your schedule, ensure adequate sleep, and engage in appropriate physical exercise to relieve stress. Please note that the above are just some possible reasons and solutions. If your period continues to be delayed or is accompanied by other discomforting symptoms, it is advisable to seek medical attention promptly for detailed examination and treatment.

Title: How does the insurance company compensate for a car accident that results in the vehicle being written off? Content: My car was involved in a single-vehicle accident on the highway, and I was at fault. After assessment by the insurance company, it was determined to have reached the write-off standard. The insured value of the car is 69,000 yuan. (I have comprehensive insurance and no deductible). How much should the insurance company compensate? The insurance company will compensate based on the insured amount of your vehicle damage insurance, minus depreciation (the insured amount for a new car's damage insurance is generally the invoice price of the new car). 
If your car is a small car with fewer than 6 seats, the monthly depreciation rate is 0.6%. You can basically claim the body value (around 130,000 - 140,000 yuan). 
License plate fees, purchase tax, and document fees are not covered by the insurance company and will not be compensated. 
After the write-off claim is settled, the scrapped car belongs to the insurance company. The insurance company will entrust an auction house to evaluate and auction it (this has nothing to do with you). You will be compensated for the actual value of the car before it was written off. This is calculated by subtracting the depreciation amount from the new car's purchase price. The depreciation formula is: number of months between the accident date and the vehicle's initial registration date × depreciation rate × new car purchase price. The depreciation rate for a small car is 0.6% per month, and for a large truck, it is 1.1% per month. First, register with the traffic management department of the public security organ: (1) The car owner must take their ID card, vehicle registration certificate, vehicle license, and license plate to the business department of the vehicle dismantling plant to fill out the "Application Form for Vehicle Suspension, Resumption/De-registration"; (2) Apply at the registration acceptance counter. For vehicles that have reached the mandatory retirement age, a "Vehicle Scrapping Notice" will be issued. For vehicles that have not reached the retirement age but need to be scrapped due to a traffic accident, after inspection and confirmation by the vehicle inspection counter that they meet the scrapping standards, a "Vehicle Scrapping Notice" will be issued; (3) The owner can choose a qualified recycling company to send the vehicle for dismantling, using the "Notice"; (4) The owner must take the "Change Form", "XX Province Updated Vehicle Technical Appraisal Form", "Scrapped Vehicle Recycling Certificate", and photos of the dismantled vehicle, and submit them for approval according to regulations to complete the vehicle scrapping registration. Second, prepare the following materials for the insurance company: insurance policy, vehicle license, driver's license, insured's ID card, insurance policy, vehicle license plate, organization code certificate (if applicable), accident vehicle certification materials, and the vehicle scrapping notice. Bring these materials to the insurance company to apply for the vehicle scrapping insurance claim. The compensation amount is calculated according to the legally prescribed loss rate. Each insurance company has a complete claims system. The compensation is calculated based on the annual 6% depreciation of the insured amount of the vehicle damage insurance, and the depreciation period is calculated from the initial registration date on the vehicle license. When a vehicle is written off due to an accident, the owner can file a claim with the insurance company based on their own vehicle damage insurance coverage. For new drivers, who lack experience and are prone to accidents, the repair cost for just one or two parts can amount to thousands of yuan. Therefore, many car owners wisely purchase vehicle damage insurance. Whether the damage is minor (partial body deformation) or major (vehicle write-off), they can receive some compensation. If the insurance company determines your vehicle is a write-off, they will calculate the compensation based on the monthly depreciation. Depreciation: New car purchase price * (1 - number of months * 0.6%). If the new car purchase price on your policy is 65,000 yuan, then it would be: 65000 * (1 - 19 * 0.6%) = 57,590 yuan. After the write-off is determined, there are two solutions: 1. You can directly transfer ownership to the insurance company, meaning you sell the salvage value to the insurance company, and the insurance company then sells it to someone else. 2. The insurance company finds a salvage buyer to sign an agreement with you to purchase the salvage value. The salvage buyer pays you for the salvage value, and the insurance company covers the remaining amount.

Title: Q&A with the Head of the Department of Occupational Ability, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, on the "Notice on Implementing the 'Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan' under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action"
Content: Recently, to further promote the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" and encourage and support workers to participate in online vocational skills training, a responsible official from the relevant department of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security answered reporters' questions regarding the background, objectives, main content, and work requirements of this plan.

Q: The Vocational Skills Enhancement Action is an important measure to stabilize and promote employment. Since last year, the country has implemented the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. What is the current progress?
A: As we know, vocational skills training is a key measure to maintain employment stability and alleviate structural employment contradictions, as well as an important support for economic transformation, upgrading, and high-quality development. In May 2019, the General Office of the State Council issued the "Vocational Skills Enhancement Action Plan (2019-2021)". The State Council Leading Group for Employment specially convened a national video-teleconference to deploy and promote the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action, and Premier Li Keqiang issued important instructions. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security attaches great importance to this, fully implements the deployment requirements of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, and works with relevant departments to promote the implementation of the enhancement action. First, strengthen organizational leadership. The Ministry established a leading group for the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action, with Minister Zhang Jinan serving as the leader, held multiple leading group meetings to study and deploy work, and implemented chart-based operations and ledger management. Second, increase policy promotion efforts. Starting in June, documents were issued on deeply studying and implementing General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on skilled talent work, key task division and fund use management for the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action, real-name management and statistics of training information, and streamlining proof materials and optimizing application procedures. Special training plan documents were successively issued in conjunction with seven departments including the Ministry of Veterans Affairs. Third, strengthen work research and guidance. From July to the end of the year, multiple research teams were sent to 17 provinces for on-site research and guidance. Meetings were held with responsible comrades from human resources and social security departments of some provinces to coordinate work progress. Video-teleconferences were held to guide localities in carrying out work solidly and efficiently. Fourth, strengthen policy publicity and guidance. Increased publicity efforts in mainstream media, opened special columns and sections, and released policy interpretations and local work updates. Public service advertisements were launched in densely populated areas such as buses and subways. Organized the National Vocational Skills Enhancement Action Service Week activity, promoted policy publicity to enterprises, schools, and communities, and continuously expanded policy awareness. In summary, since the implementation of the enhancement action, human resources and social security departments at all levels and relevant departments have done a lot of work. With the joint efforts nationwide, the annual target of 15 million person-times has been exceeded, and the total amount of training subsidy funds has increased significantly. The enhancement action has played a positive role in stabilizing employment, benefiting people's livelihoods, helping enterprises, and promoting development.

Q: What impact has the prevention and control of the novel coronavirus pneumonia (COVID-19) epidemic had on the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action? What are the countermeasures?
A: At the beginning of 2020, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security held a national video-teleconference to promote the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action, mobilizing and deploying various tasks for the 2020 Vocational Skills Enhancement Action early. However, the outbreak of the COVID-19 epidemic has significantly impacted offline centralized vocational skills training. In recent years, with the deepening application of the internet, the integrated development of online and offline vocational skills training has provided convenient, diverse, and personalized training services for various workers to learn theoretical knowledge and vocational skills. Internet technology arranges courses through forms such as live online streaming, recorded videos, interactive communication, and assessment tests, achieving the effect of online learning and learning skills at home. Therefore, we believe that online vocational skills training is not only an important way to improve workers' vocational skills levels but also an effective way to reduce personnel gatherings during the epidemic. At the same time, it also provides a development opportunity to promote the new training model of "Internet+Vocational Skills Training". To effectively prevent and control the epidemic, we have taken the following measures: First, prevent epidemic outbreaks from聚集性 offline training. To reduce personnel gatherings during the epidemic, during the Spring Festival holiday, our Ministry required local human resources and social security departments, in accordance with the unified deployment of local Party committees and governments, to focus on conducting online training during the epidemic period. Second, follow up with policy measures. On February 5, our Ministry, together with the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments, issued the "Notice on Supporting and Encouraging Workers to Participate in Online Vocational Skills Training in Response to the Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Epidemic", clarifying that during the epidemic, key training courses would be freely opened to workers through relevant online training platforms. Actively guide and encourage relevant training institutions to freely open online training resources during the epidemic. Increase policy support for key groups such as migrant workers delaying their return to work to participate in online training. On February 6, our Ministry issued the "Notice on Effectively Doing a Good Job in Skill Talent Evaluation During the Prevention and Control of the Novel Coronavirus Pneumonia Epidemic", clearly requiring that enterprises carrying out independent skill talent evaluation could, based on their actual production and operation, adopt methods such as online theoretical exams, production process assessment, and work performance evaluation to organize evaluations in a coordinated manner. Promote the filing of vocational skill level evaluation institutions, especially employers conducting independent evaluation, online, promote comprehensive vocational skill level independent evaluation in various enterprises, and guide social training evaluation organizations to carry out vocational skill level certification in an orderly manner. On February 20, the "Notice of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and the Ministry of Finance on Implementing the 'Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan' under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action" was issued, determining online training targets and tasks, innovating training content and methods, and clarifying online training policies. Third, increase the supply of online training resources. On February 7, our Ministry issued a notice on soliciting online training platforms and digital resources for the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action, publicly soliciting platforms and digital resources that are legally qualified, have good credibility, and can provide online vocational skills training services. After selection by our Ministry, they will be recommended nationwide. Localities can, based on actual conditions, include the online training platforms selected by our Ministry and locally into their local subsidized training institution catalogs and specify training hours and corresponding subsidy policies. We also solicited excellent online teaching courses from technical schools to achieve resource sharing and provide convenience for students of delayed-opening technical schools to study and train independently. Fourth, strengthen supporting services for online training. Timely release a batch of new occupations, accelerate the development of vocational skill standards and training materials, and provide basic support for implementing the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. Guide localities to implement online approval or filing for enterprise new apprenticeship systems, enterprise skill talent independent evaluation, and training institution establishment.

Q: What are the objectives and tasks of implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action?
A: The "Notice" serves as both a measure for "wartime" vocational training and a need for常态化 vocational training, achieving a win-win situation of doing a good job in epidemic prevention and control and continuously implementing the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. Based on the requirements for COVID-19 prevention and control and the needs of economic and social development and employment and entrepreneurship, the "Notice" clarifies the objectives and tasks for implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan". In 2020, achieve the "511" online training target: select and recommend more than 50 high-quality online vocational skills training platforms面向全国, launch digital training resources covering more than 100 occupations (types of work), and carry out online vocational skills training for more than 1 million person-times throughout the year; by 2021, improve the management and service mode for "Internet+Vocational Skills Training", build a work pattern with sufficient online training resources, seamless online-offline integration, strong policy support and guarantees, and orderly and in-place supervision, further expand the scale of online training, and improve the quality of online training.

Q: What is the overall work思路 for implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action in response to the COVID-19 prevention and control?
A: The overall work思路 is: First, serve the overall situation, with prevention and control as the priority. Localities should proceed from the overall situation of epidemic prevention and control, follow the unified deployment of local Party committees and governments, adjust measures to local and timely conditions, and promote the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action in a coordinated manner. During the epidemic prevention and control period, suspend offline centralized training and actively carry out online vocational skills training. Second, free opening and resource sharing. Increase the supply of online training resources. During the epidemic prevention and control period, organize online platforms to freely open training course resources, strengthen the development of online training courses, and promote the sharing of high-quality training resources. Third, implement policies by category and promote integrated development. Vigorously promote online-offline combined training methods and organize implementation by category. For theoretical knowledge, general professional qualities, disease prevention and health, and other comprehensive content, as well as simulation and skill video demonstrations, focus on online training; for skills training with strong practical操作性, integrate online learning with offline practical training. Fourth, consolidate the foundation and strengthen services. Strengthen the connection between online training and public employment services and human resources market information, strengthen the development of vocational skill standards and skill evaluation work, and enhance the basic capacity for online training. Clarify incentive policies and measures for online training, and do a good job in online training management, supervision, and service.

Q: What are the innovative policies and measures of the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action?
A: The focus of implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" is to highlight "policy incentives", with the emphasis on aiding enterprises, stabilizing employment, and benefiting people through training. Summarized as "three supports": First, strengthen support for enterprises. In response to COVID-19 prevention and control, the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" clarifies that during the work suspension period affected by the epidemic (full or partial suspension), online training independently carried out or commissioned by various enterprises (including platform enterprises and new business format enterprises that operate relying on internet technology) for their employees (including those with established labor relations or those without established labor relations but obtaining remuneration through platform services) will be included in the scope of vocational training subsidies according to regulations, and the required funds can be disbursed from the special funds for the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. For project-based training carried out by enterprises affected by the epidemic, a certain proportion of training subsidy funds can be pre-allocated according to regulations. Second, increase support through training subsidy policies. It is clarified that for trainees who participate in online training and obtain the corresponding course training certificate, training subsidies will be given according to regulations, and the required funds can be disbursed from the special funds for the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. Third, strengthen support for workers participating in online training. Clearly require localities to, based on actual conditions, provide certain living expense subsidies during the training period to registered impoverished laborers, employment困难人员, zero-employment family members, rural students among the "两后生" (referring to youth who have graduated from junior high school or senior high school but are not enrolled in higher education or employed), and urban subsistence allowance family students who participate in online training. The required funds can be disbursed from employment subsidy funds.

Q: What are the specific measures for organizing and implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action?
A: To organize and implement the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" well, we require the following measures: First, vigorously carry out online vocational skills training. Innovate training methods, make full use of portals, mobile APPs, WeChat, and other channels to expand the coverage of online vocational skills training. Solicit online vocational skills training platforms and digital resources that are legally qualified, have good credibility, and provide high-quality services from the public. Based on the industrial development and employment实际情况 of each locality, organize laid-off, returning, and on-the-job enterprise employees, as well as college graduates who have left school but are not yet employed, key employment groups, etc., to participate in online training. Second, enrich online training course resources. Include content such as professional ethics, general professional qualities, employment guidance, craftsmanship spirit, quality awareness, legal awareness and relevant laws and regulations, safety, fire protection, environmental protection and health hygiene, epidemic prevention and control, as well as new knowledge, technologies, and processes into online course development. Actively promote technical schools, enterprises, and social training institutions to develop online training courses, open online training resources, and cooperate with online training platforms to carry out online training. Give full play to the role of skill masters and other outstanding highly-skilled talents, organize the development of micro-courses on unique skills, skill and process operation methods to enhance the effectiveness of online training. Third, do a good job in skill talent evaluation services to support online training. During the epidemic prevention and control period, coordinate the carrying out of skill talent evaluation to service and support online training. Fourth, consolidate the foundation of online training. Localities should, based on industrial development and employment conditions, include relevant online training platforms and digital resources in the local "两目录一系统" (likely referring to catalog of training institutions, catalog of vocational qualifications, and management system). Do a good job in new occupation development, accelerate the development of vocational skill standards and training materials, and provide basic support for online training. Fifth, optimize management services. Localities should strengthen the scheduling, statistics, and management of online training, and establish electronic files for workers' vocational training. With the core of improving the convenience and effectiveness of vocational training subsidies, achieve online application for subsidies, simplify the subsidy processing流程, and shorten the subsidy distribution cycle.

Q: What are the specific work requirements for localities in organizing and implementing the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" under the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action?
A: Summarized, the requirements are as follows: First, improve political stance. Require human resources, social security, and financial departments at all levels to deeply implement the important instructions of General Secretary Xi Jinping on epidemic prevention and control work, fully recognize the importance and urgency of carrying out "Internet+Vocational Skills Training", and promptly implement the Vocational Skills Enhancement Action. Second, effectively strengthen organizational leadership. Require localities to actively implement the "Internet+Vocational Skills Training Plan" and conscientiously implement the targets and tasks for 2020 and 2021. Decompose training tasks level by level and压实主体责任. Third, increase policy publicity. Strengthen policy publicity for carrying out online training during the epidemic prevention and control period, release relevant information timely, strengthen service awareness, and guide various workers to actively participate in online training. Fourth, do a good job in supervision and management. Strengthen the management and supervision of online training, regularly collect training data, analyze the status of online training, strictly supervise the online training process, and prevent the套取 of training subsidy funds. Institutions, training platforms, and individuals who engage in fraudulent online training to obtain or骗取 funds must be severely punished according to law and discipline.

Title: What are the consequences of not paying the arrears after losing a real-name registered telecom contract phone? Content: Real-name registered telecom contract phone lost, arrears not paid: 1. Before the contract phone is cancelled, it will incur monthly fees. If the arrears persist for too long, late fees will also be charged. 2. When the arrears reach a certain amount, China Telecom will pursue recovery through legal channels. Arrears also affect the processing of other telecom services. 3. If you do not plan to continue using Telecom products, it is recommended to cancel the service promptly. Cancelling during the contract period requires paying a penalty. During the contract period (usually two years), the SIM card for the contract phone cannot be cancelled or suspended. Even if unused, the minimum monthly charge will be deducted. Because it was registered with real-name identification, if you lose this card and the contract has not expired, the accumulated minimum monthly charges will affect the user's personal credit. Unless the user never uses a card from this operator again (real-name system), these fees must be paid in full to use the operator's services. Extended information: When a phone is no longer used, the number should be cancelled promptly. Rules for cancelling mobile phone numbers — 1. Postpaid customers must provide valid ID when cancelling. (If delegated to someone else, the agent must also submit the original valid ID of both the principal and themselves; for corporate clients, the company's valid documents and the individual's valid ID are required). 2. Cancellation cannot be processed for non-local users. If you cannot do it yourself, you can authorize someone else, but they must bring the original IDs of both the authorizer and the authorized person. If failure to cancel leads to suspension due to arrears, the number holder will be blacklisted by the local business hall. 3. Users within the contract period cannot cancel their service in principle. 4. Users must settle all overdue arrears, current period arrears, and the real-time charges for the current month for the number being cancelled under the same customer account before they can cancel. Reference source: Baidu Baike - Suspension due to arrears

Title: Which brand of glucosamine has good effects? Has anyone who has taken it come to share their experience? Is move free okay? Content: For people with different joint conditions, the effects of taking glucosamine and Move Free will definitely be different. Different dosages and durations of continuous use will also lead to different effects. Therefore, the same product can produce vastly different results in different people. Below is a brief explanation of the role of glucosamine and the relevant situation regarding Move Free. You can check the link in the article for more detailed information. Glucosamine might be unfamiliar to some, but it's probably very familiar to friends with joint problems. Clinically, glucosamine is primarily used for degenerative arthritis of the knee joint. Glucosamine can repair articular cartilage, promote the generation of synovial fluid, preventing hard friction between joint surfaces, thereby eliminating symptoms like pain, swelling, and bone crepitus. Furthermore, by repairing the articular cartilage, it helps restore the normal joint space and allows for good recovery of joint function. It also has a good effect on bone spurs (osteophytes) in the knee joint, helping to restore the glucosamine content within the joint to a balanced state, stimulating chondrocytes to synthesize proteoglycans and collagen fibers to generate cartilage matrix, thereby improving the self-repair ability of the articular cartilage. Thus, by repairing articular cartilage and promoting synovial fluid, glucosamine plays an important therapeutic role in osteoarthritis with bone spurs. Additionally, glucosamine can also treat meniscus injuries, chondromalacia patellae, and various types of cervical spondylosis. There are numerous brands of glucosamine on the market. How to choose one that suits you from the dazzling array of products can be a headache for many. Today, I'll share with you the top ten glucosamine brands. The quality of their products is quite good, and I hope it helps with your selection. So, here goes. 1. What is Glucosamine? 'Wei Gu Li' (维骨力) is another name for glucosamine. Its medical name is glucosamine, also abbreviated as amine sugar. It is a joint health supplement suitable for long-term use, helping to repair and maintain the health of articular cartilage and stimulate the growth of chondrocytes. Glucosamine is a substance synthesized by the human body, an important nutrient for forming chondrocytes, and a natural component of healthy articular cartilage. Numerous medical studies from the US, Europe, and Japan indicate that glucosamine can help repair and maintain cartilage and stimulate the growth of chondrocytes. 2. The Two Main Forms of Glucosamine Actually, many people don't know that there are currently two mainstream forms of glucosamine: one is glucosamine hydrochloride, and the other is glucosamine sulfate. The main difference lies in the salt radical. The hydrochloride form is more easily absorbed by the body, but long-term use can irritate the stomach. The sulfate form is more stable, its absorption is not as good as the hydrochloride form, but it does not irritate the stomach and is suitable for long-term use. Another major difference is the purity of the glucosamine. Glucosamine hydrochloride has higher purity. To maintain stability, about 20% sodium chloride is added during the production of glucosamine sulfate, meaning the maximum purity of glucosamine sulfate can only be around 80%. Regardless of whether it is sulfate or hydrochloride, glucosamine will be completely dissolved by stomach acid in the gastric juice. Stomach acid releases all the glucosamine for absorption in the small intestine. Once glucosamine is absorbed into the bloodstream through the small intestine, it is independent of the original salt; both forms have the same effect on the human body. Patients concerned about gastrointestinal reactions may prefer crystalline glucosamine sulfate. Patients with osteoarthritis who also have hypertension, heart failure, etc., and need strict salt control, may consider prioritizing glucosamine hydrochloride. Therefore, before purchasing glucosamine, it's best to confirm whether it is the hydrochloride or sulfate form. Schiff's Move Free glucosamine is one of the best-selling bone health supplements in the United States. Many people bring it back to their home country as gifts or for elderly family members. Common varieties include Red Box, Green Box, Blue Box, and Purple Box (4 types). Later, a White Box was introduced, and the newest additions include Gold Green Box and High-Calcium Glucosamine. Of course, it's also now sold on well-known domestic e-commerce platforms. Main Ingredients, Efficacy, and Side Effects of Glucosamine (Move Free) 1. Glucosamine: Also translated as amino sugar, it is a substance that the human body can synthesize itself, found in cartilage and other connective tissues. Glucosamine can repair damaged cartilage tissue and improve symptoms like swelling, inflammation, and pain caused by joint degeneration and friction. As a health supplement, glucosamine is often used as an adjunct therapy for osteoarthritis, helping to rebuild cartilage. However, its efficacy is not conclusive in the medical field, and it has not been approved by the FDA as a drug. According to WebMD, glucosamine is generally very safe, with no or very mild side effects. If high doses are used, possible side effects include: stomach discomfort, heartburn, drowsiness, and headache. Most glucosamine on the market is extracted from shrimp and crab shells, so people allergic to seafood and shellfish may have allergic reactions. Brands that extract glucosamine from fungi or grain fermentation can be chosen. If you have diabetes, kidney disease, heart disease, blood disorders, or high blood pressure, please consult a doctor before taking supplements. Children, pregnant women, and breastfeeding women should use glucosamine with caution; there is currently insufficient evidence to confirm its safety for these groups.

Title: "Height Restriction" Measures Should Not Be a "One-Size-Fits-All" Approach Content: "Height Restriction" Measures Should Not Be a "One-Size-Fits-All" Approach Source: Democracy and Law Tribune Release Time: 2024-9-10 21:32|According to data from the China Enforcement Information Disclosure Website, as of February 28, 2024, the number of published dishonest persons subject to enforcement has reached 8,297,955. Restricting high consumption is a punitive measure against the person subject to enforcement or their legal representative, aimed at urging them to restrain their own high-consumption behavior and consciously fulfill debt repayment obligations. However, the "one-size-fits-all" application of "height restriction" in specific law enforcement processes affects the work and life of entrepreneurs while also bringing certain impacts to the normal operation of enterprises. Tianyuan Financial Company and its legal representative Zuo Anyi are facing such a situation. In September 2007, Zuo Anyi was declared innocent by the Heilongjiang Provincial High Court and received corresponding judicial compensation. In 2019, Zuo Anyi was again subjected to "height restriction." Recently, several legal experts and well-known lawyers held a legal seminar on the issue of restricting high consumption in the "Zuo Anyi case." In November 2003, the prosecution filed a lawsuit against Zuo Anyi, accusing him of "using a terminated cooperation project to defraud Xiangfang Securities of a loan, and should be investigated for criminal responsibility for contract fraud." According to a report by Democracy and Law Tribune, in September 2002, Zuo Anyi, deprived of his personal freedom, was forced to sign the Tianyuan Square "Equity Transfer Agreement" with Harbin Xiangfang Securities involuntarily, "transferring" the equity of Beijing Tianyuan Square, which had an expected profit of over 2 billion yuan, to Xiangfang Securities to offset Tianyuan Financial's debt of less than 200 million yuan to Xiangfang Securities. This equity transfer also indirectly caused the abortion of the Beijing Yuantai International Apartment project, which had an expected profit of nearly 3 billion yuan. At the seminar, the party involved claimed that because the handling officers forcibly seized Tianyuan Company's business license, official seal, etc., all companies of the Tianyuan Group, including Harbin Tianyuan Financial Company, were unable to operate, became paralyzed and bankrupt, resulting in asset losses of over 4 billion yuan for the Tianyuan Group. In September 2007, Zuo Anyi was declared innocent by the Heilongjiang Provincial High Court and received corresponding judicial compensation. In October of the same year, one month after Zuo Anyi was declared innocent, Xiangfang Securities sued Tianyuan Financial Company in Harbin for repayment of the nearly 200 million yuan loan. In June 2009, the court ruled that Tianyuan Financial Company must repay Xiangfang Securities the nearly 200 million yuan debt. Zuo Anyi stated that he was already bankrupt and could not afford the nearly 2 million yuan appeal fee, resulting in the loss of his right to appeal, which led to this civil judgment becoming an enforcement case with an effective judgment. He believes that the wrongful case caused over 4 billion yuan in property losses to the Tianyuan Group, rendering Tianyuan Financial Company incapable of repaying the loan. Tianyuan Financial Company does not fall under the category of a person subject to enforcement who "has the ability to perform but refuses to perform the obligations determined by the effective legal document." Article 3 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Publishing Information of Dishonest Persons Subject to Enforcement" states: "Under any of the following circumstances, the people's court shall not include the person subject to enforcement in the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement in accordance with Item 1 of Article 1 of these provisions," among which Item (4) is "other circumstances that do not constitute having the ability to perform but refusing to perform the obligations determined by the effective legal document." Lawyers and legal experts discussed and believed that, according to this provision, Tianyuan Financial Company should not be included in the list of dishonest persons subject to enforcement. Zuo Anyi, as the legal representative of Tianyuan Financial Company, is not himself a dishonest person subject to enforcement and should not legally be subjected to consumption restriction measures. "What is the biggest problem after being height restricted? Even if I have the intention to repay the money, I am now riding a bicycle, taking green-skinned trains, and long-distance buses to earn money. The debt collectors are taking planes and high-speed trains. My speed is too slow; I will never be able to earn enough money." Several years ago, on a talk show, the well-known entrepreneur Feng Lun commented on his own experience of being "height restricted." At this year's National Two Sessions, Zhang Qiaoliang, a deputy to the National People's Congress and chief partner of Shandong Kangqiao Law Firm, suggested optimizing the measures for restricting high consumption. Zhang Qiaoliang stated that there are already over 8 million dishonest persons subject to enforcement nationwide. More and more legal representatives, directly responsible personnel, and actual controllers are being subjected to restricted high consumption by courts because their enterprises are deeply mired in debt, which is not conducive to enterprise production and operation nor to the creation of a business environment. The "Opinions of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Growth and Strengthening of the Private Economy" point out the need to legally protect the property rights of private enterprises and the rights and interests of entrepreneurs, improve the mechanisms for appeals and retrials in enterprise-related cases, and establish an effective mechanism for preventing and routinely correcting wrongful cases. At the same time, optimize the three major environments—financial, public opinion, and judicial—to create a fairer, more transparent, and predictable business environment for private entrepreneurs. Among these, especially the judicial environment, should become the most solid backing for entrepreneurs, committed to building a social atmosphere where entrepreneurs dare to innovate and have the courage to take responsibility, allowing the private economy to thrive under the sunshine of the rule of law and jointly promote the high-quality development of China's economy.

Title: Government Procurement of Services Knowledge Q&A (Part 2) Content: 1. Who are the purchasing entities for government procurement of services? Administrative organs at all levels are the purchasing entities for government procurement of services. The following organs and units can also implement service procurement according to actual needs and relevant regulations: (1) Party organs of the Communist Party of China at all levels; (2) Organs of the People's Congresses and their Standing Committees at all levels; (3) Organs of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference committees at all levels; (4) Supervisory organs at all levels; (5) Judicial organs at all levels; (6) Procuratorial organs at all levels; (7) Organs of democratic parties at all levels; (8) Public institutions classified as undertaking administrative functions according to the public institution classification reform policy; (9) Mass organization organs included in the administrative staffing management. 2. Why can't public welfare type I institutions be the purchasing entities for government procurement of services? The eligibility of a purchasing entity for government procurement of services depends on whether it undertakes administrative functions. Public welfare type I institutions do not have administrative management functions; their functional positioning is to be the main body responsible for directly providing public welfare services in specific fields. Their nature is different from administrative organs, so they are not suitable as purchasing entities for government procurement of services. It should be noted that prohibiting public welfare type I institutions from being purchasing entities means they cannot purchase their main responsibilities, i.e., they cannot outsource their primary functions. To fulfill their own duties, public welfare type I institutions can procure necessary auxiliary services. 3. Can the public welfare services undertaken by public welfare type I institutions be implemented through government procurement of services? The fact that public welfare type I institutions cannot be the承接主体 (undertaking entities) for government procurement of services does not mean that the public welfare services they undertake cannot be purchased from social forces via government procurement. If existing public welfare type I institutions temporarily struggle to meet relevant public service demands due to insufficient capacity, the competent administrative departments can also purchase related services from qualified social forces as a supplement. However, before specifically implementing the procurement, the finance department and competent department at the same level must strictly review and approve,坚决防止 (resolutely prevent) the phenomenon of purchasing from social forces while the supply capacity of existing public welfare type I institutions lies idle. 4. What is the status of social organizations in undertaking government procurement of services? Social organizations are important承接主体 (undertaking entities) for government procurement of services and play a significant role in leveraging the unique advantages of government procurement, such as efficiency and flexibility. To advance the reform of government procurement of services and improve the system, social organizations are indispensable. The "Decision" of the Third Plenary Session of the 18th CPC Central Committee proposed: "Public services and matters suitable for provision by social organizations should be handed over to social organizations to undertake." Therefore, it is necessary to vigorously support and standardize the participation of social organizations in undertaking government procurement of services. 5. What specific roles do social organizations play in participating in government procurement of services? First, undertaking government procurement of service projects, utilizing their professional capabilities to improve the quality and efficiency of public service delivery. Second, as an important vehicle for public participation in social management, social organizations can effectively organize social labor resources to participate in public service delivery and social public management, which helps improve the level of social governance. Third, identifying and providing feedback to the government on public demand for public services, proposing suggestions for public service supply plans, and promoting effective alignment between public service supply and demand. 6. Do social organizations undertaking government procurement of services enjoy tax preferential policies? In February 2018, the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration jointly issued the "Notice on Issues Concerning the Management of Tax-Exempt Qualification Recognition for Non-Profit Organizations" (Caishui [2018] No. 13), which revised and improved the policy for recognizing tax-exempt qualifications for non-profit organizations, adjusted the recognition conditions for the salary levels of staff in non-profit organizations, appropriately expanded the coverage of tax exemption preferential policies for non-profit organizations, and strengthened supervision over non-profit organizations. Social organizations undertaking government procurement of services should pay relevant taxes according to tax laws and regulations, and those meeting the conditions can enjoy unified national tax preferential policies. 7. How do industry associations and chambers of commerce participate in undertaking government procurement of services, and what support policies exist? Industry associations and chambers of commerce are currently undergoing reform to separate them from administrative organs. The reform direction is to promote industry associations and chambers of commerce to become social organizations established according to law, operating independently, service-oriented, governed standardly, and self-disciplined in behavior. After separation, the relationship between industry associations/chambers of commerce and administrative organs is no longer one of administrative subordination. Industry associations and chambers of commerce can undertake government procurement of service projects and obtain government funding support through fair competition with other social forces. Supporting and standardizing their participation in undertaking government procurement of services is conducive to the smooth progress of the separation reform. In 2015, the Ministry of Finance formulated and issued the "Notice on Issues Related to Industry Associations and Chambers of Commerce Undertaking Government Procurement of Services (Trial)" (Caizong [2015] No. 73), supporting industry associations and chambers of commerce in transforming into social organizations by undertaking government procurement of services. It stipulates that, all else being equal, priority should be given to purchasing industry management service projects—such as industry planning, industry evaluation, industry statistics, industry standards, occupational evaluation, and grade assessment—from already separated industry associations and chambers of commerce. 8. What are the general principles for determining the content of government procurement of services? The content of government procurement of services should meet the following requirements: First, it falls within the scope of government responsibilities. If the government purchases matters outside its responsibility scope, that constitutes governmental overreach. Second, it is suitable for provision through market-oriented methods. That is, it is suitable to be handed over to qualified social forces and public institutions through competitive means. Third, it pertains to service matters. The concept of service has its specific connotation and should not be broadly interpreted. The concept of service used in government procurement of services is consistent with that used in the "Government Procurement Law" and its implementation regulations, and is fundamentally different from goods and projects; they cannot be conflated. Therefore, the content of government procurement of services should be service matters that fall within the scope of government responsibilities and are suitable for provision through market-oriented methods, with a focus on basic public services for which there is budget allocation. Title: I am a high school graduate and would like to ask, for a non-prestigious business major, if not going through the application system, are internship experience and a high GPA useful for postgraduate entrance exams and employment? Content: For employment, internship experience is very useful. Companies mainly look at internship experience; most companies don't pay much attention to GPA, only a few might ask about it. For postgraduate entrance exams, internship experience can add a little bonus in the re-examination. Supervisors value research ability more; it's best if you can write some articles with a teacher during your undergraduate studies. As for GPA, it depends on the supervisor and the university. Some require uploading transcripts during the re-examination, while others don't ask. But supervisors generally look at the grades of a few core professional courses and don't pay much attention to the overall GPA. So, you need to study your professional courses well, as the postgraduate entrance exam tests professional courses. If you do well in your undergraduate studies, the pressure for the postgraduate exam won't be too high. Of course, if you want to secure a postgraduate recommendation, GPA is very important, and you need to work hard.

Title: Acupuncture Beauty: Poking a Whole Body of Problems Content: Acupuncture Beauty: Poking a Whole Body of Problems http://www.sina.com.cn 2007-05-30 08:10 Qianhua Net Qianshan Evening News Report (Reporter Wang Jue) In early summer, weight loss has once again become a compulsory course for many beauty lovers. Among them, acupuncture weight loss has won the favor of many customers under the name of 'green weight loss'. However, a reporter's visit yesterday found that the so-called acupuncture beauty methods in some traditional Chinese medicine beauty salons in Anshan are currently fraught with hidden dangers due to the lack of qualifications among practitioners. Acupuncture leaves the face bruised. Under the packaging of the rhetoric that 'TCM beauty is healthy and safe', are the acupuncture beauty treatments in some TCM beauty salons in Anshan really 'healthy' and 'safe'? Ms. Zhang recently underwent acupuncture weight loss at a TCM beauty salon near Shannan. However, after a period of time, Ms. Zhang discovered that the so-called 'professional doctors' at the salon were not only unskilled in their techniques but were even ambiguous about some common-sense TCM theories. After one course of treatment, not only did Ms. Zhang not lose weight, but she also became physically weak due to the salon's requirement for her to diet. Ms. Guan underwent several months of acupuncture wrinkle removal at a TCM beauty salon in Zhanqian. Ms. Guan told the reporter that when the beautician performed acupuncture therapy on her to remove crow's feet around the eyes, bleeding often occurred due to inaccurate technique, followed by a bruise that would take several days to subside. Simple training makes an acupuncturist. According to relevant national regulations, in the TCM industry, acupuncture is a medical act. Beauty salons engaged in acupuncture therapy must have a medical license issued by the health department; otherwise, it is an illegal act. Practitioners must hold a practicing physician certificate, meaning only professional doctors can perform acupuncture. However, when the reporter visited several TCM beauty salons in Anshan yesterday posing as a customer, it was found that some acupuncture 'doctors'敷衍 the reporter by saying 'the relevant certificates are not with me,' while others claimed their acupuncture skills were passed down from their ancestors and guaranteed to be effective. In a TCM beauty salon inside a mall in Zhanqian, the receptionist told the reporter that those performing acupuncture there were trained beauticians. An anonymous veteran TCM practitioner also revealed to the reporter that he is currently a nominal doctor for a TCM beauty salon in Anshan but rarely sees patients. The salon only calls him when they need to应付 relevant inspections. 'Usually, the beauticians there do the acupuncture themselves. These beauticians can start working after attending short-term training classes elsewhere,' the old TCM doctor said. Poking the wrong place can be harmful. The reporter learned during interviews that due to the lack of relevant qualifications in many TCM beauty salons, the effectiveness of acupuncture beauty is greatly reduced, and some may even cause harm to customers. For example, the bruising on the face experienced by Ms. Guan mentioned earlier. Principal Zhu of a TCM traditional therapy training school in Anshan explained that the blood vessels in the human face are extremely rich. When performing acupuncture, blood vessels must be avoided. If these vessels are accidentally damaged, it can lead to bruising and pain in mild cases, and in severe cases, it may even cause facial nerve damage. Furthermore, Principal Zhu also mentioned that a common practice in some TCM beauty salons for acupuncture weight loss is to 'poke where you want to lose fat.' However, from the perspective of TCM acupuncture theory, which emphasizes辩证取穴 (dialectical point selection), this approach is not only unscientific but also yields minimal results. Principal Zhu used abdominal weight loss as an example, stating that performing acupuncture weight loss by only selecting points on the abdomen is not scientific because the liver meridian located in the lower limbs also plays an important role. Ignoring the regulation of the liver meridian results in very weak weight loss effects. Director Wang of the TCM Department of Angang Lishan Hospital also stated that relatively speaking, needling the abdomen and limbs of the human body is less likely to cause problems, so some non-professionals in beauty salons often select points in these areas, holding the idea that 'if it's not done well, at least it won't cause harm.' However, several TCM practitioners reminded the public that there are some acupoints on the human body where acupuncture cannot be performed. If the wrong point is needled, it may endanger life. Therefore, one must not轻易 entrust their life and health to unregulated TCM beauty salons and counterfeit acupuncturists. 0530B072
