Title: Is the Applied Psychology Graduate Entrance Exam Worth Taking? Content: The applied psychology graduate entrance exam is an option worth considering. Whether it is specifically worth taking requires a comprehensive consideration of factors such as personal interest, career planning, and employment prospects. This field is broad and can be applied to many industries like education, human resources, consulting, healthcare, and business management, thus offering good employment prospects. Through graduate study, one can systematically learn and master the basic theories and research methods of psychology, laying a solid foundation for future work and further study. Furthermore, graduate study in applied psychology provides a good opportunity for in-depth research and exploration in the field of psychology, allowing participation in related academic research work and contributing to the discipline's development. However, personal interest must also be considered. If one is not interested in psychology and takes the applied psychology graduate exam solely for employment or other purposes, it might lead to learning difficulties and unsatisfactory career development. Therefore, choosing a field one is genuinely interested in is crucial. Career planning is also an important factor to consider; it's necessary to comprehensively assess the situation of other majors and choose the direction most suitable for oneself. Considering the demands of the job market, one also needs to pay attention to the competition within the industry and the availability of employment opportunities, taking into account one's own conditions and abilities. Overall, the extent to which the applied psychology graduate exam is worth considering varies from person to person and requires a comprehensive evaluation of factors like personal interest, career development, and employment prospects. The most important thing is to choose a major that aligns with one's interests and dreams, thereby better developing one's career path. Even when employment prospects are good, one must consider personal interest and career planning to ensure the chosen major brings satisfactory returns. In summary, the applied psychology graduate exam is a choice that requires careful weighing. Before making a decision, gaining a deep understanding of one's own interests and career goals, as well as the current job market situation, will help find the most suitable direction. Regardless of the final field chosen, the key is to find a direction that ignites one's passion and allows for the realization of personal value. At the same time, it is advisable to consult with supervisors or experienced peers before the exam to obtain more information and advice. This can lead to a better understanding of the true situation in this field and whether it is suitable for the individual. Additionally, understanding the characteristics of different schools and programs and choosing a school that can provide high-quality education and research opportunities is also very important.

Title: The Economic Crime Investigation Brigade's Intelligence Squad called me and asked me to go see them, using a personal phone number. What should I do? Content: (1) The Intelligence Call Ford was held hostage by thugs at the Golden Crown Hotel. The thugs forced him to call home and report that he was safe in front of them. Ford's phone conversation went like this: 'Dear Rosa, how are you? This is Ford. I was feeling unwell last night and couldn't accompany you to the nightclub. I'm much better now, thanks to the special medicine the manager of the Golden Crown Hotel gave me last month. Darling, don't be angry with a 'bad person' like me. We will be together forever. Please forgive me for breaking our date. Didn't I get better quickly? I'll come to your house tonight to apologize. Please don't be angry with me! Okay, goodbye!' But five minutes later, the police suddenly appeared before them. The thugs had no choice but to surrender. Do you know how Ford reported the crime? Answer: Ford played a trick during the phone call. While talking, whenever he said something unimportant, he covered the mouthpiece tightly with his palm so the other party couldn't hear. But when he spoke the key words, he released his hand. This way, his family received this 'intermittent' intelligence call: 'This is Ford... now... Golden Crown Hotel... with bad people... together... Please... quickly... come...' (2) The Flaw Please read the following dialogue between an officer and a suspect. Officer: 'Where were you at 10 PM last night when the crime occurred?' Suspect: 'I was at home last night.' Officer: 'However, according to one of your friends, he went to look for you at that time, pressed the doorbell for a long time, but no one came to open the door.' Suspect: 'Oh, at that time I was using a high-power electric stove. The fuse in the room blew, there was a power outage for a while, so of course the doorbell wouldn't ring...' Officer: 'Stop making up stories. You're under arrest.' Why is that? Answer: The doorbell runs on dry batteries and is unrelated to the power outage. (3) The Beautiful Alibi On a summer morning, the cashier of a large supermarket discovered that the safe had been pried open, with a total theft of valuables worth 250,000 yuan. The police found fingerprints left by the criminal on the safe and determined the time of the crime was between 2 AM and 4 AM. After investigation, the fingerprints of a food company's truck driver who delivered goods to the supermarket matched the fingerprints from the crime scene. The police summoned the driver for questioning. But the driver claimed he was at home during that time photographing the process of morning glories blooming, and he presented the photos as evidence. The interrogation reached a deadlock. Puzzled, the detective went to the Botanical Research Institute and consulted an expert. The expert confirmed that morning glories do indeed bloom in the early morning in summer, and upon comparison, confirmed that the photos were indeed of the potted plants at the driver's home. This was strange, as fingerprints cannot be identical. So, is the driver the thief? If so, how did he manage to be in two places at once? Answer: The driver is the thief. He used a specific method (for example, putting a paper sleeve over the flower buds) to delay the blooming time of the morning glories. After committing the crime, he quickly returned home and took continuous photos of the blooming process as an alibi. (4) 'Heartless' Jack Jack took flowers to the hospital to see his girlfriend. The nurse said, 'Your girlfriend is busy performing surgery. You can see her after the surgery is successful.' 'What surgery?' 'Brain surgery.' Jack hummed a tune, looking delighted as he waited outside. Why was Jack so 'heartless' towards his girlfriend? Answer: Because his girlfriend is a surgeon and was performing surgery on a patient. (5) Where is the Fingerprint? Totti borrowed a lot of money from Anthony to buy a luxurious villa, but it's been almost half a year now, and Totti hasn't repaid a single cent. Anthony couldn't take it anymore and pressed the doorbell, going to Totti's new house to ask for the money. During the ensuing argument, they got into a physical fight. The tall Anthony used both hands to strangle Totti's neck tightly. In his struggle, Totti's left hand found a hammer and hit Anthony on the head. Anthony immediately fell to the ground and stopped breathing. After killing Anthony, Totti quickly dragged Anthony's body to the backyard and buried it. Then he wiped clean all the bloodstains and meticulously cleaned the hair, floor, and everything Anthony might have touched, leaving no fingerprints behind. Just as he finished all this, there was an urgent knock on the door – it was Anthony's two police friends. Anthony had told them that if he wasn't home by the afternoon, they should come looking for him here. Although Totti remained very calm, the police easily found Anthony's only fingerprint. Do you know where this fingerprint was? Answer: This is a question to test if you read carefully enough. If you were careless, you would make the same mistake as Totti. Anthony entered by pressing the doorbell, so his fingerprint remained on the doorbell button. The reason the police knocked on the door instead of ringing the bell was to avoid destroying this last fingerprint that hadn't been wiped clean.

Title: What does it imply when a cat is lost at home? Looking at the content from other perspectives: Some of us are with our cats every day, and the cats are kept in a free-range mode at home. Because cats are not suitable to be kept on a leash, if a cat is kept on a leash, it is not conducive to the healthy development of the cat's physical and mental health. Cats are different from dogs; cats are animals that pursue freedom and are inherently romantic. If you restrain them, they may develop depression. Precisely because we keep cats free-range, one day you suddenly find that the cat you raised at home went out for a stroll and did not return. You searched near your home but did not find it. At this time, we need to discuss: what does it imply when your cat is lost at home? Looking at problems dialectically from multiple angles is a scientific approach to cat ownership. According to past beliefs, if a cat is lost at home, it means something bad is about to happen to your family. In the past, there was a family that was just like any ordinary household, with a little cat that had lived with them for over five years. The little cat liked to play around, but every day around evening, it would return home on its own. This went on day after day, year after year for a long time. However, one evening, the little cat did not come home on time. At first, the family wasn't too worried, thinking that the cat might have been playing and would return soon. But by night, the cat still hadn't come back. The family went out to search but found nothing, so they returned home. That night, they left the door open for the cat, but it never showed up. Early the next morning, they searched again but still found nothing. It was then clear that the cat was lost. After that, many misfortunes befell the family. Originally, the family was a business household in the local area and could be considered quite wealthy. Legends are legends, but accumulated summaries become experience. However, after the cat was lost, the family's business gradually declined until it hit rock bottom, and eventually, the family went bankrupt. A wealthy family slowly faded from the local area. It is often said that cats bring wealth and prosperity. Losing your cat may indicate that your family might recently experience a sign of wealth outflow. A lost cat at home also implies another issue. It suggests that you have been busy lately and haven't had time to take good care of your cat, leading to its loss. It also implies that you have been forgetful and absent-minded recently, remembering things one minute and forgetting them the next. Unintentionally, you left your cat outside, which may indicate that your energy levels are low lately, and you need to adjust your state promptly. If the cat can be found, that is extremely fortunate; if not, it is very unfortunate. Valuable sayings are also worth referencing. Although there is a somewhat superstitious belief that losing a cat at home implies wealth outflow, it is not without reason. Considering reality, losing your cat indicates that your energy is low recently, and your mental state is poor, leading to setbacks in everything you do, which in turn causes wealth outflow. Seriously adjust your state, live healthily every day, and avoid incidents like losing your cat at home.

Title: Local Connection Issue Content: My computer suddenly can't access the internet. I selected automatic IP acquisition. Sending and receiving data are both normal, but I just can't get online. Why is that!! Check if the router has a hardware problem. First, look at whether the WAN indicator light on the router is working normally. If it's not lit, you can unplug and replug the cable from the modem/splitter to the router. If it's still not lit, restart the router. Not a soft restart, but find the reset hole on the router and poke it with something to restore the factory settings. This setting is generally safe, don't worry too much. Then, after ensuring the WAN light is normal, plug in the network cable and see if the LAN light(s) on the router are normal. If they are normal, then proceed to software settings. If it's Telecom broadband, there's no need to set a static IP. It's different from a campus network switch; there are no other routers or HUBs competing for your IP. Accessing the router settings - I think you probably know, but I'll briefly explain. To access the router, generally type http://192.168.1.1 into your browser, sometimes it's 192.168.0.1. The username is generally 'admin', and the password is also 'admin'. Sometimes the password is blank. After getting in, find the setup wizard, then next. There will be a step asking you to enter the username and password given to you by Telecom. The password is usually the phone number associated with this line. If you don't know the username, you can call the free number 10000 to inquire. Then just click next, next, finish, and do a soft restart of the router. That should solve the problem you mentioned. That's because you didn't choose to fill in a fixed IP. After filling in a fixed IP, you can fill in the DNS server address below. Once you have the DNS server address, it should work normally. Some routers cannot automatically assign a DNS address. Our old LAN computers were like that; after filling in the fixed IP and DNS, internet access worked normally. The connection to the external network might be blocked, or maybe no one can get online. Sending and receiving data being normal only indicates that your connection within the local network is fine. Is this your home computer or a company computer? Maybe another computer got infected, and the server blocked your segment of the network. It's okay, it will be fine later (after that computer is dealt with). You'd better unplug the network cable and plug it back in. 192.168.1.100 255.255.255.0 192.168.1.1 DNS: 202.96.128.86 202.96.128.166 I don't know where you are. If you are in Dongguan, filling this in should work. If you are elsewhere, just change the DNS. Telecom often has this issue lately.

Title: The Gap in Pension Issues from Achieving Reciprocity Justice Content: Recently, the National Working Commission on Aging released the "2010 Tracking Survey of the Status of Elderly Population in Urban and Rural China Key Data Report." The data shows that the coverage rate of social pension security reached 84.7% in urban areas, with an average monthly pension of 1,527 yuan; in rural areas, it was 34.6%, with an average monthly pension of 74 yuan, only about 5% of the average monthly pension for urban elderly. Nearly 75% of urban elderly are retired employees. In rural areas, 44.3% of the elderly are still engaged in farming. Comparing the average annual income structure of the elderly, pension security accounts for 86.8% for urban elderly, while in rural areas, it mainly relies on family and land for old-age support, with pension security accounting for only 18.7%. "Rural" and "urban" not only refer to two different modes of communal living but also imply vastly different life choices. In rural China, traditions such as self-sufficiency and small-scale farming are far from extinct. On the vast land, the relationship between the farming community and modern civilization can be broadly summarized as "maintaining a distance while having some contact." In cities, the forces of commerce and the market, coupled with the implementation of new public governance, have greatly reshaped life paradigms. Thus, the gap or difference is evident, as seen in the dual trajectories of "pension undertakings": one represents the most thorough "self-reliance," while the other has been moderately taken over by "public services." To some extent, it is understandable that urban elderly receive more pensions than rural elderly. After all, farmers own land, possess direct means of production, and many necessities of life are available for free. In their old age, with a small plot of land, they can barely get by. However, for urban elderly living in a world where "everything costs money," without external support or a pension safety net, basic survival would be difficult to maintain. When the welfare system construction of a specific era is incomplete, the disparity in pension resources allocated to rural and urban areas becomes doubly prominent. The public can see the stark contrast between "1,527 yuan" and "74 yuan." Although this data is "understandable," it still shocks the public. It might be said that in the process of building the pension mechanism, policymakers have adopted a strategy of "partially postponing, partially advancing": first addressing the demands of the urban population, who coincidentally have more channels to voice their concerns and stronger policy advocacy power; meanwhile, rural pensions seem less urgent. For a long time, the inherent "self-reliance" and family-based mutual aid capabilities of rural society have been repeatedly emphasized by policymakers, even leading to a justified "stinginess," neglecting farmers' needs for public security. Unbeknownst to many, the self-sufficiency and self-reliance inherent in rural communities are inherently fragile. Rural elderly can indeed "age through labor" or rely on their children for support. But that is all; their twilight years often only achieve a low level of "survival" rather than a high level of "living." Based on the principle of "reciprocity justice" in society, any decent society should provide appropriate returns to those who have contributed, especially the elderly with diminished earning capacity. In reality, urban groups such as enterprise employees and public servants enjoy "society's reciprocity" through "pensions"; in rural areas, "pensions" are not only meager but often relief funds for "needy households." For the majority of other farmers, a lifetime of hard work has not received adequate "recognition" or "reciprocity" at the institutional level. Correcting this is "urgent," as relevant officials have stated: "In the coming period, we must strive to achieve full coverage of pension security."

Content Title: Toilet inlet making a hissing sound, like whistling, repair method Release Date: 2025-08-23 20:06:47 Content Status: Review Completed Content Type: Multimedia Industry: Digital Public Service_Life Payment_Life Payment Author Name: User377477737 Owner Name: User377477737 Content Number Type: Personal Content Details: Repairing the toilet. The inlet is making a hissing sound. The most critical thing is to check the water level height. If the water level inside the tank is lower than this water line on the upper edge of the inlet valve float. Then it is caused by the middle drain valve leaking. You just unscrew the drain valve left and right. Clean the sealing ring at the bottom. Also clean the corresponding circle of water outlets on the base. Then take a screwdriver. Tighten the middle fixing screw a couple of turns. That should solve the problem. Then, if during the filling process or when full, during the filling process, it is the sealing water stop pad at the top of the inlet valve that has scale stuck to it. We first pry up this decorative cover on top. There is a pin at the top. Pull it out. Then hold the middle gland, turn it counterclockwise to remove it. Inside there will be a black rubber gasket. There will be scale inside and out. Remember to clean it. Then take a small pin. If this pressure relief hole is blocked, we clear it out, unclog it. Also remember to clean the black rubber particle here on the float. Then reassemble it back the same way. Put the sealing pad back properly. Reinstall the gland. Press the pin back on. Put the decorative cover back on. This way we can solve it.

Content: . Half of this year has already passed. With strong control over the pandemic, life is slowly getting better. But for the melon farmers in Shaanxi, looking at the endless fields of golden honey melons, their hearts are filled with anxiety. Recently, in areas like Yanliang, Dali, Pucheng in Shaanxi, the honey melon yield is extremely high, especially in Dali and Yanliang, the main production areas for golden honey melons. Coupled with the impact of the pandemic, there are fewer outside merchants coming to purchase, causing the melon purchase price to be halved. The melon farmers are extremely anxious but have no solution. If they cannot sell soon, they will face the predicament of losing everything. After receiving an invitation from the local government, we found the situation very urgent. After nearly an hour of communication on the phone, our years of experience aiding farmers told us: even a delay of half a day could lead to incalculable losses for the farmers, so we must not delay for a moment! We immediately drove overnight to the Dali production area, arriving at 7:30 PM. The actual situation on the ground was worse than we imagined. Everywhere, melon farmers were waiting on their tricycles for merchants, their vehicles piled high with melons, a sight that stretched as far as the eye could see, a shocking scene that left us feeling incredibly heavy-hearted. With no sales channels, the farmers don't want to sit idle. Even if they can't sell, they ride their tricycks for miles to the roadside to sell, guarding their stalls all day, selling whatever little they can. This year, sales are difficult; besides bringing them out to try their luck, there's no other way! An elderly Uncle Sun, over 70 years old, selling by the roadside, told us that in all his years of growing melons, he has never seen prices this low. With the melons unsold, he can't sleep at night, just hoping someone will come to buy, willing to sell at any price. His words were filled with reluctance, yet helplessness. I saw the anxiety and expectation in his eyes, and felt a pang of sorrow myself. They just hope to sell a few more melons, so that their year's hard work won't be a total loss. Children love it especially, and we hope everyone can taste it. Each melon is super juicy, with the core sweetness reaching nearly 19° Brix. It's not like melons stored for days in supermarkets or fruit shops, which taste bland and dry. Such good golden honey melons, and we can't even understand why they aren't selling. Looking at these cartloads of melons, they weigh on the farmers' hearts like stones, leaving them worried, unable to eat or sleep peacefully. Golden Honey Melon Sales Blocked, A Year of Hard Work Resulting in Negative Income - What Does It Mean for the Farmers? Farmer Brother Sun said: Nowadays, the young people have all gone out to work. The countryside is left with farmers willing to stay and grow melons. Besides growing melons, there are no other means of livelihood. This is the children's school fees, the elderly's medical expenses, the family's living expenses – all gone. Selling at a measly price of a few mao per jin, what's being sold cheaply is not just the golden honey melon, but a year of the farmers' hard work, a difficult choice between survival and dignity. A farmer's life depends on their farmland. If the farmland yields no income, the farmer gets nothing after a whole year of toil, leaving only endless helplessness. Shaanxi is known as the "Hometown of Chinese Melons" and one of the "Top Ten Green Ecological Melon Zones in China." Golden honey melons, with their excellent taste, storage resistance, and transportability, have been bestsellers not only across more than twenty provinces and cities in China but also exported overseas. The local climate has distinct seasons, ample sunlight, significant day-night temperature differences, and deep sandy soil, allowing the golden honey melons to accumulate more sugar, resulting in a sweeter, finer texture, with a sugar content 2-3 degrees higher than other regions. Those who have tasted them say even the rind is delicious. According to incomplete statistics, there are currently at least tens of millions of jin of melons awaiting sale in Dali. Title: Summer vacation is here, do you leave your 11-year-old child alone at home? Content: Occasionally, when forced by circumstances to leave a child alone at home, safety is the top priority. Assigning homework, ordering takeout, equipping them with a smartwatch, setting up surveillance, watching TV, playing on a tablet—none of that matters as much as ensuring safety. Since the children were about six or seven years old, the two kids have often been left alone at home. They call if anything happens, and I check the surveillance when I have time. If the children get bored, they go downstairs to the residential complex to play with other kids, sometimes for the whole day. From a young age, we teach them what they should and shouldn't do, how to protect themselves, and how to respond and seek help if something happens. Overall, if parents have no other choice, leaving an 11-year-old child at home is completely fine, provided the child has been taught how to stay safe.

Title: Xiaomi SU7 crashes into 8 cars and 7 electric vehicles at an intersection, driver detained by police. What exactly happened? What is the cause of the accident? Content: Another accident involving the Xiaomi SU7 has occurred, this time in Zhengzhou. Around 9 PM at a crossroads, it directly collided with 8 cars, 7 electric vehicles, and 1 motorcycle. Video from the scene shows the front of the car almost completely wrecked, the hood deformed, electric bikes scattered on the ground, and the scene in chaos. Ambulances and traffic police were all on site, the injured were taken away, and fortunately, there were no fatalities. The driver has been detained by the police. After this incident, some say it's a problem with the Xiaomi SU7, while others blame driver error. So, who is at fault? The investigation is still ongoing, the traffic police haven't issued a final determination of responsibility, so we can only analyze based on currently available public information and not jump to conclusions. First, let's look at the sequence of events. According to on-site rescue group chats and eyewitness accounts, this Xiaomi SU7, in a left-turn lane, suddenly made a right-turn maneuver, was then lightly sideswiped by a vehicle going straight, after which the driver slammed on the accelerator, and the car shot directly from the west side of the road to the east side, colliding with over ten electric vehicles and cars along the way. Some say the driver panicked, hit the accelerator instead of the brake, and lost control. But there are also voices suspecting the electric car's acceleration is too fierce, or that there's an issue with the vehicle system causing an inability to brake. The Xiaomi SU7 has been in the spotlight recently, but it hasn't been short on safety incidents. Three months ago, on an expressway in Anhui, an SU7, while in intelligent driving mode, after the system issued a warning and the driver took over, still crashed into a barrier, resulting in three fatalities on the spot. In Qingdao, another SU7, driving normally straight, caught fire after being hit by a vehicle crossing its path; fortunately, there were no casualties. These incidents have raised many questions about the safety and intelligent driving system of the Xiaomi SU7. Back to the Zhengzhou accident, the driver is a young woman, and the cause is still under investigation. Some say it was her operational error, others suspect a problem with the vehicle itself. Electric vehicles have powerful acceleration and quick starts; pressing the accelerator or brake pedal results in a more intense response compared to fuel-powered cars. For novices or in stressful situations, mistakenly pressing the accelerator is a possibility. Recently, news of "mistaken accelerator pedal" incidents in electric vehicles causing chain-reaction accidents has been common. But the issue is, the Xiaomi SU7's main selling point is intelligent safety. It has a C-NCAP five-star rating, a host of active safety features: AEB automatic emergency braking, collision warning, lane keeping, blind spot monitoring – all are present. In theory, for such a large-scale multi-vehicle collision, the car's active safety systems should have intervened. If the system was working properly, it should have at least mitigated the impact. But judging from the scene, the severe damage to the front suggests a very high impact force. Did the system react at all? No one can give a clear answer. Looking at user feedback for the Xiaomi SU7, there have been many recent complaints about intelligent driving system failures and automatic parking crashes. Instances include the intelligent driving system disengaging suddenly on highways, emergency braking failing, and collisions with pillars during automatic parking. Dozens of owners have collectively sought维权 (rights protection). Some technical experts bluntly state that the SU7's intelligent driving algorithms and hardware have shortcomings, and safety mechanisms are not fully developed. Xiaomi's official responses always say they will investigate and improve, but new problems keep emerging. Some say the car is fine, and it's always the driver's fault. But reality isn't that simple. Electric vehicles have strong power, intelligent systems are complex; if the driver is slightly distracted or not very proficient, the probability of an accident increases. This is especially true for novice drivers who, in sudden situations, tend to panic, often press the wrong pedal, and make operational errors – this is quite common. However, the problem is, if a car brand promotes intelligence and safety as key features, the manufacturer needs to find ways to use technology to mitigate these "basic errors." They can't just blame the driver every time something happens. Furthermore, frequent electric vehicle accidents aren't unique to Xiaomi. Which of Nio, Li Auto, or Tesla hasn't had incidents? But the Xiaomi SU7 has only been on the market for a few months, and the accident frequency seems a bit high. Some question whether Xiaomi rushed car production, putting an intelligent driving system on the road before it was fully refined, thus creating hidden dangers. Delivery numbers are surging quickly, but safety concerns aren't keeping pace, and in the end, the owners suffer the most. For this Zhengzhou accident, the traffic police are involved, the driver is detained, and the specific cause awaits the official report. It's irresponsible to conclude now whether it's the car's or the person's fault. We can only say that driver error is a strong possibility, but whether the Xiaomi SU7's active safety systems fulfilled their duty is also worth questioning. Every time an incident occurs, the response is just "under investigation," but the truth cannot be delayed indefinitely. Electric vehicles aren't magic cars, and intelligent systems aren't omnipotent. Drivers must still learn the rules and maintain vigilance – none of that can be neglected. No matter how much a car company promotes, safety must come first. Before the cause is clear, don't rush to conclusions. But every accident is a reminder for both car manufacturers and drivers. Don't let intelligence become a gamble, don't let safety become just a slogan. Details: In this special campaign, the Cyberspace Administration Commission of the Shanghai Municipal Committee discovered that some self-media accounts are using increasingly covert methods to lure traffic and profit with fake high-salary part-time job information, forming a pattern that severely disrupts the online ecosystem and the order of the job market. Let's look at a typical case. In March 2024, numerous self-media accounts online posted fake recruitment information such as 'a certain library paying 300 yuan per day for assisting with book categorization' and 'library data sorting paying 270 yuan per day,' seriously interfering with the online ecosystem. Investigations by relevant departments revealed that this information was actually a trap to lure traffic for scams. Accounts such as 'Part-time Job Buddies,' 'Magic City Post,' 'Eight,' and 'Loves Strawberries' were permanently banned according to law and regulations. In fact, these paid part-time job advertisements essentially use prominently displayed high-salary information to redirect users to third-party platforms, gradually inducing unaware netizens to purchase memberships on job-seeking websites, etc. After consumers top up, they discover that the actual available positions do not match the advertisements. Lawbreakers fabricate positions and exaggerate salaries to entice netizens to click links, then use excuses like paying membership fees, unlocking registration eligibility, submitting deposits, or reserving spots to carry out fraud. This information often poses as official cooperation or public welfare recruitment, and even misuses the names of public institutions like libraries and museums, making it highly deceptive. We utilize relevant technologies to improve the monitoring, early warning, and rapid identification capabilities for such information, ensuring it can be quickly detected and handled as soon as it emerges. To address the issues of strong concealment of fake recruitment information and the difficulty of platform review, relevant departments urge platforms to establish sample databases for keywords like 'high-salary part-time job' and 'hire without interview,' implementing pre-filtering. Simultaneously, they conduct dynamic tracking of associated information, including accounts with historical violation records.

Title: Jiyuan Land Surveying, Mapping and Geological Environment Monitoring Institute Successfully Completes Review and Certification Renewal Work Content: Jiyuan Land Surveying, Mapping and Geological Environment Monitoring Institute (hereinafter referred to as the Surveying Institute) planned early, prepared meticulously, established rules and systems, strengthened communication, and made every effort to do a good job in the review and renewal of surveying and mapping qualifications. Recently, after review and approval by the Provincial Department of Natural Resources, the surveying and mapping qualification was upgraded from Grade C to Grade B, successfully completing the review and certification renewal work. Early Work Planning and Layout In December 2020, the Surveying Institute held a meeting to specifically study the review and certification renewal work. By studying superior documents, everyone agreed that the reform of the surveying and mapping qualification management system is an important measure to deepen the "delegating power, improving regulation, and upgrading services" reform and further optimize the business environment. By significantly streamlining the professional categories of surveying and mapping qualifications, merging surveying and mapping qualification levels, delegating approval authority, lowering entry barriers, optimizing approval services, strengthening national geographic information security, and strengthening post-event supervision, it will optimize the business environment of the surveying and mapping market, stimulate market vitality, and promote the high-quality development of the surveying and mapping industry. After the meeting, a leading group for the review and certification renewal work was established, clarifying respective work responsibilities and main tasks, and relevant work was quickly launched. Comprehensive Preparation According to Conditions According to the requirements of the "Henan Province Surveying and Mapping Qualification Review and Certification Renewal Work Implementation Plan", the 10 professional standards and 3 categories with 31 sub-items of general standards in the surveying and mapping qualification classification and grading were used as a benchmark for data collection, organization, and improvement one by one. The educational background, professional titles, and employment status of technical personnel were reviewed and improved, surveying and mapping professionals were introduced to ensure the team met standards; 3 GNSS receivers, 1 drone, 5 sets of NewMap surveying and mapping software, 2 sets of remote sensing data collection and information processing software, and 1 high-definition printing and copying all-in-one machine were purchased to ensure software and hardware equipment met standards; all surveying and mapping equipment was sent to the Henan Provincial Institute of Metrology for calibration, and appraisal reports were issued to ensure equipment accuracy met standards; 19 systems including the "Surveying, Mapping and Geographic Information Security and Confidentiality Management System", "Technical Management System", "Quality Inspection System", and "Surveying and Mapping Results and Data Archive Management System" were successively improved and formulated, and the informatization and standardization of the archives room were strengthened to ensure all systems met standards. Timely Reporting and Frequent Communication The Surveying Institute logged into the "National Surveying and Mapping Qualification Management Information System" in advance and, according to procedural requirements, assigned dedicated personnel to carefully input various types of information. On August 23, after the Provincial Department formally accepted the Jiyuan application, it was promptly uploaded to the Provincial Department to await review. During the review process, there were more than 20 requests for instructions and communications with relevant staff from the Provincial Department's Surveying, Mapping and Geographic Information Management Office and the Administrative Service Center, further clarifying the specific requirements and reporting standards for various materials. For items where policy understanding was unclear or material preparation was incomplete, timely corrections and uploads were made to ensure the review and certification renewal work was highly recognized by the Provincial Department staff and successfully passed the two-level review. The review and certification renewal work is not only a stage summary and comprehensive evaluation of all aspects of the Surveying Institute's work, but also a journey of improvement in establishing rules, systems, and standardizing the management of the Surveying Institute's work. After the qualification upgrade, the Surveying Institute will increase learning and training efforts, improve the level of surveying and mapping business, comprehensively optimize the business environment, and provide technical services and support centered on the overall work of the bureau.

Title: Should motorcycles queue up or filter through traffic? Content: Legally and logically, they should queue up! But practically speaking, filtering through is necessary. If traffic police are reasonable, they might ignore you, but if it's during a crackdown or the officer is strict, then there's no way around it. Additionally, when filtering, it's best to do so slowly on the far right side of the rightmost lane; filtering by crossing the white line is hard to justify if seen by police. Secondly, the Road Traffic Safety Law explicitly states that motorcycles can use non-motorized vehicle lanes when necessary. However, they bear full responsibility if an accident occurs. But honestly, it's better to avoid filtering through traffic whenever possible.

Title: 【Interpretation of the Civil Code】Two children have both testamentary inheritance and statutory inheritance. How should the estate be divided? Content: Uncle Wang and his wife passed away one after another. Their biological daughter produced a will demanding to inherit the entire estate, while the adopted daughter, who was adopted by Uncle Wang and his wife since birth, argued that the printed will with only the mother's signature and fingerprint was invalid, and the estate should be divided equally according to statutory inheritance. How is the validity of a will without witness signatures determined? Can the adopted daughter inherit the elderly's estate? — The will is invalid, the adopted daughter enjoys equal inheritance rights. Article 1136 of the Civil Code: A printed will shall have two or more witnesses present to witness it. The testator and the witnesses shall sign on each page of the will, indicating the year, month, and day. Article 1111 of the Civil Code: From the date the adoption relationship is established, the rights and obligations between the adoptive parents and the adopted child shall be governed by the provisions of this Law regarding the relationship between parents and children; ... This article stipulates that when making a printed will, two or more witnesses must be present to witness it, and the testator and witnesses must sign each page of the will. In this case, the will submitted by the biological daughter only had the testator's signature and fingerprint, lacking the formal requirement of witness signatures, and should be considered an invalid will. The estate will be handled according to statutory inheritance. Furthermore, based on the fictional effect of adoption, both the adopted daughter and the biological daughter are first-order statutory heirs and equally enjoy the right to inherit. Title: 9. Beijing Demolition Lawyer: Beware, Some People Are Using... Content: 9. Beijing Demolition Lawyer: Beware, Some People Are Using Shantytown Renovation to "Set Traps" The processes for completing shantytown renovation plans vary significantly across different localities. As demolition work accelerates, instances of illegal demolition or forced eviction occur from time to time. Today, Lawyer Shi Xining, Director of Beijing Jingkang Law Firm and Co-Director of the Northwest University of Political Science and Law's Property and Land Research Institute, will discuss several major pitfalls of shantytown renovation to help you avoid detours. What is Shantytown Renovation? Shantytown renovation is a government-proposed and organized initiative targeting historically遗留 concentrated areas of dilapidated housing, broken courtyards, severely crowded dwellings, lack of supporting public facilities, limited fire access, and areas with significant public safety hazards in urban settings. It aims to address chronic urban issues such as resident mobility, housing safety, spacious activity areas, convenient living, emergency public security guarantees, and environmental sanitation. The goal is to eliminate public safety hazards, optimize living and production environments, and resolve the housing issues of many low-income families that are incompatible with social development. It is a popular民心工程. Potential Pitfalls in Shantytown Renovation Pitfall 1: No Property Assessment in Shantytown Renovation If the acquiring party does not conduct an assessment process before signing compensation agreements with those whose property is being acquired during shantytown renovation, it is likely a trap set by the acquiring party. Because whether it's acquisition and demolition, shantytown renovation, or old city renewal, property assessment is the most basic and crucial step. Since the assessment result directly affects the compensation amount, some acquiring parties intentionally omit this step to reduce compensation costs. The so-called shantytown demolition assessment refers to what we commonly call the demolition compensation price assessment. This assessment occurs after the demolition notice is issued, where qualified real estate price appraisal institutions evaluate the shantytown properties according to the shantytown acquisition assessment methods. During the shantytown demolition process, assessing the market value of the properties to be demolished must follow a specific流程, including: selecting an institution, signing a contract, on-site assessment, public notification and explanation, delivering the report, applying for review, and applying for appraisal. The affected residents can participate in every step, and each step is legally mandatory. For the frequently occurring demolition disputes, openness and transparency are necessary principles for demolition assessment. It is also important to note that the selection of the appraisal company should be jointly determined by the acquiring party and the affected residents. Pitfall 2: Using the Name of Shantytown Renovation for Land Acquisition and Demolition In specific shantytown renovation projects across localities, the types of shantytowns are not strictly defined. Generally, areas concentrated with simple structures and shacks, lacking urban planning resulting in chaotic courtyard distribution, too many winding, dead-end, or curved roads, structurally简陋 with poor disaster resistance (earthquake, fire, flood), overcrowded living conditions, poor functionality, poor living environment, absence of roads, greenery, public activity spaces, and poor lighting and ventilation can be identified as shantytowns. This leads some local administrative agencies to use the name of shantytown renovation to carry out land acquisition and demolition, with the real purpose being to压低 the compensation for affected residents. Therefore, affected residents should gather information from various sources, understand the relevant local policies, and prevent their homes from being "designated as shantytowns." Lawyer Shi reminds everyone that demolition is a long-term struggle requiring comprehensive professional knowledge, overall control of the situation, and reasonable application of legal provisions. Even lawyers with years of litigation experience continuously learn and update their knowledge to calmly analyze and make correct judgments in each case. For non-lawyers, this is a vast subject that cannot be mastered through short-term cramming. Therefore, when encountering any demolition issues, it is advisable to consult a lawyer and pursue professional rights protection under their guidance.

Title: Why do hearing aids often require maintenance and are prone to clogging? Content: In fact, in many cases, we underestimate our earwax. Many cases of hearing aids becoming silent are caused by earwax. Earwax is pervasive, especially oily earwax. Receiver mesh clogging: Clogging of the receiver's sound outlet mesh is the most common issue. However, usually, we only need to simply replace a cerumen mesh, and the sound problem can be easily resolved. Different receiver meshes clog in different ways, but all can lead to faint or no sound. Microphone mesh clogging: Not only the receiver mesh, but the microphone mesh can also be clogged by earwax. If sound cannot enter, how can it be heard? Internal component clogging: If the earwax on the mesh is not cleaned promptly, it can quietly seep into the underlying components. BTE earhook dust filter clogging: BTE (Behind-The-Ear) hearing aids can also clog. The earhook damper can clog, and the dust filter can be blocked by earwax and dust. Recommendations: Clean the ear canal daily (using cotton swabs). Before sleeping each night, use the small brush provided by the manufacturer to clean the sound outlets. Only by cleaning promptly can clogging be prevented. Keeping the hearing aid clean ensures sound is transmitted normally. For custom hearing aids, replace the cerumen mesh and pluggable microphone mesh promptly. For BTE hearing aids, replace the earhook and replaceable dust filter promptly. If the ear tip of a BTE hearing aid is clogged, you can simply wash the ear tip yourself. For hearing aids with external receivers, remove the ear tip, take off the mesh (the white part) and wash it. Alternatively, you can go to a fitting center for cleaning.

Title: Why don't Chinese people use bathtubs for bathing? Content: I've renovated three apartments, and installed bathtubs in all of them. The first two apartments were relatively small, so I used wooden barrel bathtubs. [Picture of bathtub in first apartment] [Picture of bathtub in second apartment] This is the bathtub in the apartment I'm currently living in. When I lived with my parents as a child, although the house wasn't big, it also had a bathtub installed. Perhaps influenced by my parents, I inherently have that desire for comfort, ease, and better enjoyment. One thing is certain: the usage rate of these bathtubs is indeed not high. Especially the bathtub in my parents' house - it's almost never used. Well, it must have been used a few times, but I was too young to remember. My parents also rarely used it. I only used the bathtub in my first apartment a few times. But I still installed a bathtub in my second apartment, and again only used it a few times. Even though the usage rate was really low, I still installed a bathtub in my third apartment. I've lived here for over two years now, and I truly haven't used it once. But if you ask me whether I would design a space for a bathtub when renovating a fourth apartment, the answer is definitely yes. Why am I so determined to choose a bathtub, even if the usage rate is very low? Probably because deep down, I'm someone who pursues a comfortable life. When it comes to increasing life comfort, as long as it's within my means and in areas I value, I believe it's better to have it and not need it than to need it and not have it. As long as I want to, I can take a bath anytime, use the bathtub anytime. Psychologically, this gives me a sense of peace, an emotional value. As for whether I use it frequently, that's a secondary matter. Often, people pursue psychological and spiritual comfort more than just physical comfort. If you define the value of an object's demand and exchange solely by frequency of use, that might be too one-sided. That's why terms like 'emotional value' and 'soulmate' exist. It's undeniable that the positive effects brought by emotional value are far stronger than the object itself. Okay, I've digressed. Back to why Chinese people don't use bathtubs for bathing. The three most important factors affecting bathtub usage frequency are: 1. Daily cleaning, maintenance, and disinfection. 2. Wasting water and gas, resource waste. 3. Leisure time for bathing. I think the deepest reason here is that most Chinese families do not have live-in housekeepers or the habit of hiring hourly cleaners. There's no one to regularly clean and maintain. Abroad, ordinary families regularly use hourly cleaners or live-in housekeepers, like Filipino domestic helpers, to assist with household chores, cleaning, and house maintenance. But in China, even well-off families, the middle class, might only occasionally hire an hourly cleaner, let alone have a long-term live-in housekeeper or Filipino helper. China doesn't have that 'Filipino helper culture,' and the cost of domestic services is indeed quite high now. Frequent use of a bathtub involves frequently needing to clean and disinfect it. If a whole family uses one bathtub, it also needs regular cleaning and disinfection. Before and after each use, the bathtub needs to be cleaned. Otherwise, after bathing, the dirt from the body will stick to the tub. Bathing is supposed to be enjoyable; who wants to sweat cleaning before the bath, and then, just after feeling comfortable from the bath, sweat again cleaning up? It negates the bath, and one might as well not bathe. The issue of wasting water and gas isn't actually that important. Most families that install bathtubs can afford the cost of water and gas. A bath doesn't cost much in water and gas fees. Even bathing every other day, the cost is affordable. So, this isn't the real reason preventing us from using bathtubs. Taking a leisurely bath requires at least 60 minutes. Cleaning the bathtub at the start and end takes about 10 minutes each, at minimum. Then, filling the tub takes 15-20 minutes, depending on water pressure and gas heater. Bathing for 15-20 minutes, then draining the water and taking a quick shower for 5-10 minutes. Altogether, it's about an hour. Whereas taking a shower only takes 5-10 minutes. It saves gas, water, and time. China's fast-paced life; having a 9-to-5 job is considered good. One might get home at 7 pm, finish dinner by 8 pm, then help the kids with homework, take a little rest, have some entertainment like watching TV, playing games, or browsing the internet. Need to sleep by 10:30 pm, otherwise can't get up the next day. Where is the time for a bath? Finally, some time on the weekend, but might have errands to run, visit relatives, meet friends, go grocery shopping and meal prepping, take the kids out for fresh air. Well, no personal time at all. This is the current situation for most Chinese families, and also the reality for most 'workhorses.' Where is the leisure time for a bath? The non-essential demand for bathing naturally gets pushed back, indefinitely. Plus, apartments aren't large, making design difficult. With low usage rates, people naturally don't design or install bathtubs. So how can they use a bathtub to bathe? How important is sharing housework! Actually, solving the problem of having a housekeeper or hourly cleaner to share the housework already solves the problem of using a bathtub for bathing. If bathtub cleaning and disinfection are taken care of, then you only need 30 minutes at any time: fill water, bathe. No longer needing 20 minutes before and after. You might not even need to count the filling time, just consider the 20-minute bathing time. Who doesn't have 20 minutes? After work on a weekday, come home to a cooked meal, eat directly, and after eating, put the bowl down and enjoy yourself. On weekends, no need to go grocery shopping or do housework cleaning. Surely, one could find time for 2 or 3 baths a month? Then, isn't the problem of using a bathtub for bathing solved? Ultimately, the reasons why Chinese people don't use bathtubs for bathing are: First, no time. Second, no mood. The comfort and enjoyment a bathtub can bring have been eroded away to nothing.

Title: Should You Attend Bank Wealth Management Seminars? Content: Managing finances is essential for every household, creating a universal need for financial management. Nowadays, the widespread adoption of online banking and the gradual development of new payment tools like WeChat and Alipay have led to a yearly decline in branch visits by the general public. Customers are the lifeline for banks; without them, tactics like phone invitations and wealth management seminars have emerged. Many who have done business with banks have likely received such invitations—a branch hosting a client appreciation event or wealth management seminar, offering gifts and hoping for your attendance. Uninformed individuals might attend as scheduled and certainly not leave empty-handed, as small gifts are indeed prepared. However, these events typically include a marketing segment. Some banks explain their large-denomination certificates of deposit, funds, wealth management products, etc., while others collaborate with insurance companies to promote insurance products. Recently, the state has significantly lowered fixed deposit interest rates, and since the beginning of 2022, wealth management products have moved away from rigid redemption guarantees, with capital-guaranteed products phased out entirely in favor of net-value-based products. The sluggish investment market and the tense Russia-Ukraine situation have caused many bank wealth management products to experience net value drawdowns—essentially, losses. The era of passively earning returns at home is over. With inflation worsening, people seek both security and attractive returns for their savings, leading many to consider bank-recommended products after seminars. Ultimately, financial management should align with one's family situation and risk tolerance. For instance, bank-recommended increasing whole life insurance is a relatively safe long-term investment but isn't suitable for everyone. Thus, avoid blindly following trends; understand product features by reading prospectuses or contracts. If you receive a bank seminar invitation, would you choose to attend or not?

Title: Should ordinary people invest in stocks or buy funds? Content: For novice investors, buying funds is better because a fund is a collective asset management plan that entrusts funds to a trusted fund manager. When the fund manager makes money by investing in stocks, everyone shares the profits; when the fund manager incurs losses, everyone shares the risks, so the risk is smaller. For investors with some investment experience, analytical skills, and the ability to bear certain risks, buying stocks is better because stocks have high volatility and may yield超额 returns. Overall, whether investing in funds or stocks, investors need to have some judgment about the market and avoid frequent trading.

Title: How to distinguish between good and bad personal card swiping machines? Content: With the rise of third-party payments, there are currently many third-party personal card swiping machines circulating on the market! For example, brands like Mola, Mowallet, Moshu, etc... So how should one choose among these card swiping machine brands? Before discussing this issue, let me share some valuable information! Before September 6, 2016, merchants were not categorized. Whether swiping a debit card or credit card, the handling fee was a capped single transaction fee ranging from 15 to 35. Some merchants, who applied directly through banks, even had a handling fee of 0! On September 6, 2016, merchants were divided into three major categories! First: Standard Category (related to basic necessities like clothing, food, housing, and transportation). For example, convenience stores, restaurants, hotels, KTVs, etc., are collectively called the standard category. The national standard fee rate is 0.6%. This means when a customer swipes their card at such a merchant, the card machine provider or bank charges the merchant a 0.6% handling fee. A transaction of 10,000 yuan will incur a 60 yuan handling fee. Second category: Discounted Category, such as gas stations, large supermarkets/warehouse clubs, utilities (water, electricity, gas), air tickets, insurance, etc., with a fee rate of 0.38%. Third category: Public Welfare Category, such as tax bureaus, hospitals, schools, charities, etc., with a fee rate of 0. Normally, the card swiping handling fee is collected by three institutions in a 7:1:2 ratio! The bank takes 70%, UnionPay takes 10%, and the card machine service provider takes 20%. For example, if a customer swipes 10,000 yuan at a standard category merchant, generating a 60 yuan handling fee, then the bank gets 42 yuan, UnionPay gets 6 yuan, and the card machine provider gets 12 yuan! So, is it reasonable for the card-issuing bank to take such a large share? Very reasonable. The card-issuing bank has financing costs; the money comes from depositors, and the bank bears interest expenses. Additionally, it pays salaries to card issuance staff and bears the risk of bad debts. Overall, the bank's total cost for handling 10,000 yuan amounts to about 38 yuan. So, the bank makes 4 yuan per 10,000 yuan swiped – not much, but reasonable! This is for standard category merchants. What about discounted or public welfare categories? Then the bank would lose money. There is a ratio here; customers won't always spend at public welfare or discounted category merchants; the vast majority of spending is still at standard category merchants. So, the question arises: Is this related to which brand of card machine I use? Yes, and it's very closely related! Currently, as long as the card machine bears the UnionPay logo, it at least indicates it is registered and recognized by UnionPay. Generally, there should be no problem with the funds arriving after swiping! (Special reminder: Don't be greedy for low fee rates offered by telemarketers or door-to-door salespeople. Low fee rates almost inevitably lead to scams like tricking you into paying activation fees or deposits! Ranging from 199 to 899 yuan). Is a machine that reliably deposits funds necessarily a good machine? Not necessarily. Machines that are not bound to a fixed merchant will match you with a (potentially changing) merchant for each transaction. If it matches a standard category merchant, congratulations, it's a good machine! If it matches a discounted or even public welfare category merchant, the bank loses money long-term. Over time, your credit card's comprehensive score may become insufficient, affecting your ability to get new cards or future loans. So, how can you check if your card machine's merchants are standard category? It's simple! Download the UnionPay App (Yunshanfu), bind all your credit cards to it. Each consumption record has a 15-digit merchant receipt number (like the merchant's ID card). Then input this code into the WeChat public account 'posquan zhifuwang' (POS Circle Payment Net) to query. It will be clear at a glance. Any merchant not showing a 0.6% fee rate is abnormal. There's another type of merchant that is more hidden, commonly called fake merchants. Any merchant code containing English letters is a fake merchant! The fee rate shows as 0%! If you swipe 10,000 yuan, the card machine provider pockets the entire 60 yuan handling fee, and the bank receives nothing while still losing 38 yuan in comprehensive costs. Check the quality of your machine's merchants. Also, if there is such code-jumping, it's often accompanied by an increase in the exchange rate fee. Pay attention to whether your card swiping handling fee has been raised! If you don't know how to check, you can send a private message.

Content Title: Why does fuel consumption increase on highways? Many drivers don't know, an insider tells you the root cause. Publication Date: 2024-10-10 22:35:12. Content Status: Review completed. Content Type: Multimedia. Industry: Digital Government Affairs_Government Media_Government Media. Author Name: Zhongbo Finance. Owner Name: Zhongbo Finance. Content Account Type: Enterprise. Content Details: High fuel consumption on highways? Revealing the truth. When everyone drives on the highway back to their hometown, they probably notice one thing. Why does the fuel consumption of their car increase rapidly after getting on the highway? When driving on national roads, the average fuel consumption might only be 6 liters. After getting on the highway, it becomes 7 liters. Isn't the highway supposed to be fuel-efficient? Why does my fuel consumption become higher after getting on the highway? What exactly is going on? Today, Xiao Li will talk to everyone about this issue. Exit 654. Fu. Tells you the correct answer. First, after we get on the highway, can we actually save fuel? It is related to the engine displacement. The larger the engine displacement, the better the power. When you drive on the highway, the engine's performance can be fully utilized, so the official fuel consumption is lower. Conversely, for cars with smaller displacement, after you get on the highway, the engine's performance is no longer being fully utilized; it already needs to be pushed to its limits. In this situation, it needs to burn more fuel. Wu Sheng Fang Jian. It's like riding a horse in ancient times. 100. 80. A good horse needs to eat fine grain. But it runs faster. However, if you have a poorer quality horse, and you want it to run as far and as fast as a good horse, you need to constantly whip it. In that case, the horse needs to eat more, consume more feed, to have the stamina to run that far. It's like it eats less but still can't run as far. This is the difference between a large-displacement car and a small-displacement car. When we drive a small-displacement car on the highway and maintain a speed around 120 km/h, it has already exceeded its most fuel-efficient speed range. At this point, the engine's burden is already quite heavy. Although it's not that it can't run, or that it's very difficult to drive, it has exceeded the economical speed range, causing it to burn more fuel to deliver greater power. But large-displacement cars are different. Content Understanding Label: Non-serious livelihood content

Title: Why did my Shiba Inu suddenly start snoring while sleeping? Content: There can be multiple reasons why a Shiba Inu snores. Here are some common causes: Obesity: Shiba Inus are a breed prone to weight gain. If a Shiba Inu is overweight, it can lead to a narrowed airway, causing snoring. Respiratory Infection: If a Shiba Inu has a respiratory infection, such as sinusitis or laryngitis, it might also cause snoring. Allergies: Shiba Inus can be allergic to certain substances like pollen, dust, or food. Allergic reactions can cause nasal swelling, leading to snoring. Improper Sleeping Position: If a Shiba Inu's head is in an incorrect position while sleeping, it can put pressure on the airway, causing snoring. Age Factor: As Shiba Inus age, the muscles in their airways may relax, leading to snoring. Underlying Diseases: If a Shiba Inu has conditions like heart disease or high blood pressure, it might also cause snoring. If your Shiba Inu has suddenly started snoring, it is recommended to take it to a veterinarian for a check-up to determine the specific cause and take appropriate treatment measures. Meanwhile, you can also pay attention to the following points to help alleviate your Shiba Inu's snoring symptoms: Weight Control: Keep your Shiba Inu's weight within a normal range to avoid obesity. Maintain Fresh Indoor Air: Regularly clean dust and pet hair in the home to avoid allergens. Adjust Sleeping Position: Try to adjust your Shiba Inu's sleeping position to make its head more comfortable. Increase Exercise: Appropriately increase your Shiba Inu's exercise to improve its physical fitness. Regular Check-ups: Take your Shiba Inu for regular health check-ups with the veterinarian to promptly detect and address potential health issues.

Title: Artificial Intelligence Helps Identify New Risk Factors for Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer Content: Research results presented by Parker et al. at the AACR Virtual Special Conference: Artificial Intelligence, Diagnosis, and Imaging (Abstract PR-10): Artificial intelligence based on electronic health records may help discover new risk factors for early-onset colorectal cancer. Diseases causing chronic immunosuppression, such as Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), inflammation, obesity, asthma, sinusitis, and dermatitis, were identified by machine learning models as new risk factors for colorectal cancer in young people. Although the incidence and mortality rates of colorectal cancer in people over 65 are decreasing by 3.3% and 3% per year respectively, the incidence and mortality rates of colorectal cancer in people under 50 are increasing by 2% and 1.3% per year respectively. In 2020, approximately 147,950 people were diagnosed with colorectal cancer in the United States, and 53,200 died from it. While obesity, diet, lack of exercise, inflammatory bowel disease, and family history are often considered factors for the early onset of this cancer, they do not explain why the incidence of colorectal cancer in young people is trending upwards. Research Methods: Researchers retrieved electronic health records of 1,227 colorectal cancer patients from the OneFlorida Clinical Data Research Network and matched them with 34,157 controls under the age of 50. They then applied four machine learning algorithms to the data; separate models were built for colon cancer and rectal cancer. For each patient, the researchers created a prediction window starting from the first record in the patient's electronic health record and ending 0, 1, 3, and 5 years before the index date for the colon or rectal cancer case. For each control patient, researchers matched them to a case based on age to approximate the case's index date. The data was split into a training set (80%) for training the models and a testing set (20%) for measuring the models. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) was used to analyze important features. Research Findings: Researchers found that in both the rectal cancer and colon cancer cohorts, a significant trend in the model prediction results was that sensitivity decreased across the entire prediction window as the data for each patient decreased. In all algorithms for both rectal and colon cancer, the Area Under the Curve (AUC) for 0-year and 1-year predictions was significant, ranging from 0.64 to 0.75. As the prediction window expanded, predictive performance decreased to 0.35 (i.e., 5-year prediction). The best-performing algorithm in all experiments was the Support Vector Machine. The highest predictive factors identified by researchers in the colon cancer cohort included hypertension, cough/asthma, chronic sinusitis, anxiety disorder, and atopic dermatitis. The highest predictive factors in the rectal cancer cohort included obesity, female gender, HIV, anxiety disorder, and asthma. Researchers concluded: Chronic immunosuppressive diseases (such as HIV) or inflammation (such as obesity, asthma, sinusitis, dermatitis) may represent disturbances in the immune axis, promoting colorectal cancer development. This preliminary study provides early insight into the ability of artificial intelligence to discover new risk factors in young colorectal cancer patients; more algorithm optimization and exploration of risk factors are ongoing. Title: To get into prestigious schools, extracurricular activities need to be well planned! Content: We have reviewed many resumes, and many students have a vast number of extracurricular activities, the sheer quantity and variety are truly astonishing. What they lack is not the quantity, or even the quality, of extracurricular activities, but the establishment of an image. After reading the entire activity list or resume, what is the image of this student? What is the connection with what is presented in the student's essay? Can the student's extracurricular activities show a connection to the future? Because we are so accustomed to involution, when we see what activities or competitions others are doing, we rush to do them in a swarm. This leads to severe homogenization. Remember, for American universities, Chinese students are already the largest group among international student applicants. Prestigious schools receive application materials from Chinese students and will see students with similar backgrounds countless times. Imagine, if you were an admissions officer, and in one application season you saw 100 students who had done similar extracurricular activities, especially many activities that are paid for, with a large number of similar project experiences appearing on the admissions officer's desk, would you still be impressed by this student? Most importantly, when planning extracurricular activities, many students do not prioritize their own interests and exploration of the future. Instead, they first chase after activities that seem high-end but in which they can only participate superficially. It seems like the quickest path, but it is actually the least cost-effective and longest path. So, how should extracurricular activities be planned? First, distinguish the application stage. For undergraduate applications, extracurricular activities generally focus more on comprehensive qualities and your exploration of interests. For graduate applications, research-oriented projects place more emphasis on academic foundation and research experience, while professional programs focus more on practical experience. A common point is that volunteer/public welfare activities should be participated in regardless of the application stage, as they can demonstrate the student's sense of responsibility towards others, the school, the community, and society. Second, pay attention to your role in the activities. Meaningful activities should involve deep participation, active engagement, achieving results, and尽可能 cultivating and exercising leadership and creativity as much as possible. Think carefully: what have you gained from these activities? What growth have you achieved? What impact will they have on your future? Third, extracurricular activities should reflect your personal characteristics and leverage your strengths. If you like small animals, you can participate in public welfare activities of animal protection organizations, initiate activities related to caring for animals in school clubs, or even conduct related research. If you like computers, you can participate in computer competitions or do more creative projects. Remember, extracurricular activities should not be overly utilitarian and short-sighted. Don't treat them like checking off a list. Try to choose activities you are interested in, and try to engage in them for a relatively long time to form your unique advantages. In applications, extracurricular activities are only one of the evaluation factors. The overall competitiveness of the application should be based on a comprehensive assessment of academic performance and courses, standardized tests, recommendation letters, essays, and other aspects. Plan early to make adequate preparations! #升学规划 #留学 #课外活动规划
