Title: Jiangsu Court Network Content: To meet residents' daily drying needs, residential communities often set up public drying facilities in common areas. While this is intended as a convenience, it can unexpectedly lead to situations where residents are injured while going to dry their laundry, raising the question of who is liable for such disputes. The Kunshan People's Court recently heard a case arising from a breach of safety assurance obligations. On a fine, sunny day, Aunt Wu, seeing the excellent sunshine, decided to sun her quilts and pillows. However, while carrying a heavy winter quilt to the public drying area, an accident occurred! Aunt Wu's vision was obstructed by the quilt, and she suddenly fell to the ground. Looking back, the culprit turned out to be a damaged manhole cover in the green belt! Due to persistent pain, Aunt Wu went to the hospital and was diagnosed with a fracture. After treatment, she negotiated compensation with a certain communications company, which owned the manhole cover, and a certain Tian property service provider for the residential community. Failing to reach an agreement, Aunt Wu sued them in court, claiming approximately 30,000 yuan in medical expenses, lost wages, nursing costs, etc. During the trial, the communications company argued that the manhole cover it installed was located within the residential green lawn, not on a pedestrian walkway, and therefore required no warning signs. It also stated that Tian Property had never informed it of the damage, so it was unaware and should not be held liable. Tian Property argued that the maintenance and management responsibility for the manhole cover lay with the communications company, as it was not a facility within its public area management scope. It also claimed that Aunt Wu was at fault for entering the green belt, which was not a walking path, and falling. The court found that the manhole cover was located within the green belt lawn, with aging,脱落 (fallen off) cement edges and exposed reinforcement bars, and bore markings related to the defendant communications company. According to Article 51 of the "Property Management Regulations," the communications company should bear management responsibility for this facility. The defendant Tian Property, as the residential community's service provider, is obliged to properly maintain, conserve, clean, landscape, and manage the common areas owned by the homeowners within the service area. Although the manhole cover was not within Tian Property's repair responsibility range, its failure to mark the damaged condition and notify the actual manager constituted fault. The defendant communications company failed to fulfill its management duty for the manhole cover, and the defendant Tian Property failed to meet the safety assurance obligation of a public space manager; both should bear compensation liability. The plaintiff, as a person with full civil capacity, carried the quilt across the green belt lawn, obstructing her own vision, and also bore some fault. Ultimately, the court comprehensively considered the degree of responsibility of each party for the accident and determined that the plaintiff should bear 30% of the loss responsibility, the defendant communications company 30%, and the defendant Futian Property 40%. Based on judicial appraisal opinions, the plaintiff's total loss was determined to be over 9,000 yuan. The court ruled that the defendant communications company compensate the plaintiff over 2,700 yuan, and the defendant Tian Property compensate the plaintiff over 3,600 yuan. None of the parties appealed, and the first-instance judgment has now taken effect. [Judge's Tip] While it is beneficial for property service enterprises to set up recreational facilities, drying facilities, etc., for residents' convenience, inadequate safeguards and a lack of reasonable anticipation of potential dangers can easily lead to 'good intentions resulting in bad outcomes,' causing personal and property losses to residents and triggering disputes. Therefore, property service enterprises should regularly collect residents' opinions and suggestions, conduct safety inspections, eliminate potential hazards, promptly repair facilities, and create a safe and beautiful living environment for residents. Residents should always remember that they are the primary responsible persons for their own life and property safety. They should carefully observe changes in their surroundings, remain vigilant against dangers, promptly report discovered safety hazards to the responsible managing party, and urge them to make corrections.

Title: What to do if I don't want to renew my child's insurance? Content: If you don't want to renew your child's insurance, you can consider the following handling methods: Surrender: You can bring the policy, ID card, and bank card to the insurance company to go through the surrender procedures, or handle it directly online. Surrendering during the cooling-off period will refund the paid premium, while surrendering after the cooling-off period will refund the policy's cash value. After surrender, the coverage becomes invalid. If coverage is needed later, you need to reapply. Continue Payment: If the premium payment does not put too much financial pressure on the family, you can consider continuing to pay the premium to maintain the coverage. Reduced Paid-Up: Applicable to standard life insurance. If the policy has a cash value, you can apply to the insurance company for a reduced paid-up policy. Use the policy's cash value, after deducting overdue premiums, interest, loans, and interest, as a one-time payment of the full premium. The sum insured will be reduced accordingly, but no further premiums need to be paid, and the coverage remains valid. Partial Surrender: Obtain the cash value of part of the policy through partial surrender. The coverage remains valid. The money received from the partial surrender can be used to pay premiums or for other purposes. Policy Loan: If the insurance contract has a policy loan function, you can apply for a policy loan. Generally, you can borrow 70% or 80% of the policy's cash value, but it must be repaid within six months. Utilize Grace Period and Reinstatement Period: If you do not renew or surrender the policy, one-year insurance will become invalid immediately. Long-term insurance will enter a 60-day grace period, during which the coverage remains valid. If the premium is not paid during the grace period, the coverage is temporarily invalidated and enters a 2-year reinstatement period. If the premium is not paid during the reinstatement period, the coverage is completely invalidated, and the insurance company will refund the policy's cash value. It is recommended to choose the appropriate handling method based on your actual situation and needs, and consult professionals for more accurate advice.

Title: I'm 25 years old with a college degree and want to participate in IT training. I've looked at Beida Jade Bird and Tarena. Are there any other institutions you can recommend? Content: I haven't been trained myself, and I'm not a programmer, but I'm a headhunter. I've helped many internet or development companies recruit people, and I've also referred people to many IT training institutions. As someone who earns a commission, I naturally know about the interview situations and how people perform after joining the company, otherwise how would my pay be calculated? So I can say for sure that these two are definitely not the best choices, especially since one of them has had major issues in the past two years. Of course, it might also be because there are differences between branches; I've only handled business in the Shandong region this year. Most of the companies I cooperate with in Shandong are in Jinan, Qingdao, or first-tier cities like Beijing and Shanghai. Among the trained students who successfully joined and stabilized in their jobs, the highest proportion came from a small 5-person class IT training institution in Jinan, Shandong. Actually, it's understandable; this is the largest local IT training institution in Shandong, with a certain level of influence and a good reputation within the province. Some students even come from other provinces to study there. At first, I didn't understand why someone would travel across provinces for training when institutions are everywhere, so I subtly inquired with one job seeker. It turns out they provide free accommodation during the training period, and the class sizes are small, so the teachers can pay adequate attention to each student. From this perspective, it seems very cost-effective. Later, as I contacted more job seekers from this institution, I basically got to know them. Besides the 5-person small classes, they also teach entirely in-person and have innovated an enterprise training-style teaching method. Unlike most institutions where you just code along with the teacher, they separate theory and practice. They have classes in the morning and then focus on coding in practical sessions in the afternoon, using real enterprise projects for practice. This leads to a better grasp of the technology and develops overall logical thinking and independent problem-solving skills, which is the main reason their graduates can stay in companies. I have no cooperation with this institution, just sharing purely. If you want to know more, contact them directly. Don't ask me; I don't know anything beyond this.

Title: Why can't a certain switch or router be remotely logged into? How to solve it? Content: The reasons and solutions for a certain switch or router not being able to be remotely logged into are as follows: Reasons: 1. Remote management function not enabled: The remote management function of the switch or router may not be enabled, preventing remote login. 2. Port settings Title: The default remote management port may be occupied or incorrectly configured, causing remote access to fail. 3. IP address restrictions: If the remote management function is restricted to a specific IP address range, and the visitor's IP address is not within this range, remote login will be impossible. 4. Network Title: Unstable network or configuration errors can also cause remote login failure. Solutions: 1. Enable the remote management function: Log in to the management interface of the switch or router. Find and enable the remote management function. 2. Configure the correct port: Check and confirm that the remote management port is not occupied. If the default port is occupied, change it to an unused port. 3. Set the correct IP address range: In the remote management settings, set the IP address range to the allowed access range. If you need to allow all Internet users to access, you can set the IP address to "0.0.0.0". However, for security reasons, it is usually recommended to restrict it to specific IP addresses or ranges. 4. Use the correct access method: When accessing remotely, use the method "WAN port IP address + port" (e.g., http://WAN-port-IP-address:8080). Ensure the visitor's network connection is normal and can access the WAN port IP address. 5. Restart the device: After modifying the relevant settings, restart the switch or router for the settings to take effect. 6. Check the network connection: Confirm the network connection is stable and the configuration between the switch/router and the network is correct. By following the above steps, the problem of a switch or router not being able to be remotely logged into can usually be solved. If the problem persists, it is recommended to check the device's log files for more detailed error information, or contact the device supplier's technical support team for assistance.

Title: The water heater trips automatically after burning for a while, and there are no problems with the circuit or thermostat? Content: 1. The problem may occur due to unstable power supply voltage. When the power supply connected to the water heater becomes unstable due to heavy usage by many people or other reasons, the water heater will automatically shut off the gate to avoid damage as a form of self-protection. In this case, you can wait for the power voltage to stabilize or switch to a more stable power source and try again. 2. The problem may occur due to a malfunction in the water heater system. When the water heater system ages after prolonged use, the system may become unable to support heating normally for extended periods, leading to the above problem. In this case, you can send the water heater to an after-sales service center for inspection and repair. After reinstalling the system, try again. 3. The problem may occur due to hardware damage in the water heater. When the water heater's hardware malfunctions due to prolonged use or other reasons, the water heater may be unable to start the hardware normally, thus failing to heat properly. In this case, you can send the water heater to an after-sales service center for inspection and repair. After replacing the hardware, try again.

Title: Sudden brake failure in a car? Correct operation within 1 second can save your life. Content: Changan Automobile, moving forward, closer to you! For car owners, the most terrifying and critical situation while driving is brake failure. What exactly causes car brake failure? What are the emergency life-saving methods when facing brake failure? What are the reasons leading to car brake failure? 1. Daily operational errors. Most reasons are due to mistakes in the owner's usual car operation and maintenance. As an owner, it is essential to regularly maintain the car's brake system. Once brake issues arise, they must not be ignored; be sure to have them thoroughly checked at a car 4S shop. 2. Car overload. In summer, many owners find the brakes hard to press. This is because most cars use air conditioning in summer. If the car's displacement is small, it can easily increase the engine's load, ultimately affecting brake performance. 3. Weather factors. Brakes not holding firmly. This is a common situation for many owners when using brakes, especially for small-displacement cars. Due to insufficient engine power and using air conditioning, the brake booster may not function properly when the owner repeatedly applies the brakes. In fact, brake failure is a severe car malfunction; a slight mistake could even endanger the owner's life. If it happens on a downhill slope without brakes, the situation is even more dangerous. How should we save ourselves when facing car brake failure? 1. Use the handbrake with engine braking. Manual transmission. If a manual transmission car experiences brake failure, immediately release the accelerator pedal. Depress the clutch to downshift, aiming to generate engine braking force. Repeated downshifting and using the handbrake can help decelerate. However, when pulling the handbrake, do not pull it to the locked position; do it gradually. Otherwise, if the rear wheels lock, the vehicle may lose control again. Automatic transmission. Most cars today are automatic. Although automatic transmissions don't have the obvious downshifting effect of manual transmissions, and some transmissions don't have a downshift function, downshifting should still be attempted if possible, combined with the handbrake. When applying the handbrake, press the release button and pull it continuously. For electronic handbrakes, pull up the handbrake and press the electronic brake button to slowly bring the car to a stop. 2. Choose the emergency lane for braking. If the above methods still fail to stop the car, turn on the vehicle's hazard lights to avoid involving other vehicles. Also, look for suitable road sections to decelerate, such as emergency escape ramps or uphill roads, which are good options. 3. Use obstacles on the road. If brake failure occurs and the above methods are not applicable, the owner may have to use large objects along the roadside, such as big trees, large stationary objects, or even buildings, as buffer obstacles to stop the car. However, this is a last resort, as it may endanger the owner and cause some damage to the car. That said, it must be acknowledged that modern cars have quite stable performance. As an owner, ensuring regular maintenance generally prevents brake failure. If brake failure does occur, stay calm and composed; don't panic. Only then can an ideal solution be found. Title: Difficulty for the elderly getting off the subway! Why can't a down escalator be added to Exit 2 of Gaoxin Development Zone Station on Line S8? The subway response is here. Content: "Every time I take an elderly person out of Exit 2 of Gaoxin Development Zone Station on Line S8, the four flights of stairs are like 'roadblocks'. The height of about two floors makes it difficult for the elderly with mobility issues; they walk unsteadily." Recently, a citizen of Nanjing reported to the subway, hoping a down escalator could be installed at this exit to facilitate travel for the elderly. This request resonated with many people – the accessibility facilities at subway exits are often the 'last meter' for special groups. Why can't an escalator be added to this exit? The response from Nanjing Metro is here. Citizen's Concern: Four Flights of Stairs Become an "Obstacle", Making Travel Difficult for the Elderly The Exit 2 of Gaoxin Development Zone Station on Line S8 mentioned by the citizen requires passing four flights of stairs to exit, with a total height of about two floors. "Usually, even young people need to be careful when walking, it's even harder for the elderly using walking sticks. When the steps are wet and slippery on rainy days, it's truly nerve-wracking with every step." Similar scenes are not uncommon at subway exits: parents with strollers, travelers with luggage, and the elderly with mobility difficulties often have to move awkwardly when faced with stairs without elevators. The suggestion to install a down escalator voices the thoughts of many. Subway Response: Structural Limitations + Regulatory Requirements, Temporarily Cannot Be Installed In response to the citizen's request, Nanjing Metro Group explained the reasons in detail during a phone communication on June 23: Existing structure does not support it: Exit 2 is a "covered canopy structure", and adding a down escalator requires foundation pit civil engineering structures at the top and bottom (such as the load-bearing foundation at the bottom and space for motor installation at the top). The current exit design has no预留 (reservation) at all. "Forcibly adding" one would compromise the safety of the existing structure. Does not meet evacuation regulations: According to Article 9.5.1 of the "Code for Design of Metro" (GB 50157-2013), the number of public area exits in each station leading directly to the ground "shall not be less than two". If Exit 2 were temporarily closed for construction to install an escalator, it would result in an insufficient number of station exits, affecting evacuation safety in emergencies and posing a significant hazard. Alternative Solution: "Compassionate Relay" Service Available Anytime, Call the Station if Needed Although an escalator cannot be installed for now, Nanjing Metro stated that a "safety net service" is ready: Passengers needing assistance can call the station service phone number (posted at each platform and exit), and staff will arrive promptly to provide a "compassionate relay" – for example, pushing the elderly in a wheelchair, helping carry luggage, and assisting with exiting the station throughout the journey. How can subway accessibility facilities be more "considerate"? In fact, Nanjing Metro has been continuously promoting the construction of accessibility facilities: To date, over 90% of the station exits in the city's metro network are equipped with elevators or ramps. Some stations also have tactile paving, accessible toilets, and priority seats. However, older stations, due to their early construction dates and structural limitations, inevitably have "historical遗留 problems". For early stations like Gaoxin Development Zone Station on Line S8, the design might not have fully anticipated later accessibility needs, leading to the dilemma of "structural difficulties to modify, constraints by regulations" when trying to add elevators. In such cases, "manual safety net services" become a temporary solution, but many citizens still hope: In the future, can technical renovations allow more exits to solve accessibility issues 'in one step'? Source | People's Daily Network

Title: Computer CPU Cooling Fan Very Noisy Content: The fan noise is because the computer has been used for a long time, not because of a virus; it's a hardware issue. Most desktop computers develop this phenomenon after prolonged use. If you ignore it, after some time, some computers will still be noisy, but others might naturally become quiet. Different CPUs have different durations of noise. I've seen Celeron ones make a very loud sound, making the person starting the computer wonder if something is broken. AMD and INTEL are better. Firstly, Intel's stock fans are notoriously loud (AMD is similar, strangely enough). Secondly, it might be aging. When the temperature sensor detects the CPU temperature rising, it speeds up the fan, and the fan might have slight looseness, causing noise. Another possibility is... you should lubricate it. Finally, I've heard that some viruses can cause high CPU load, but that usually results in abnormal hard drive noise; I haven't heard of fans getting loud. Well, that's all I have to say. I suggest you just replace the fan blade; the noise will drop significantly. You can buy a Deepcool fan blade. As for your heat issue, I suggest you buy some thermal paste, remove the heatsink, and apply the paste evenly on the CPU, not just squeeze it on and be done. Only then will it effectively dissipate heat. First, open the case and remove the fan, clean the dust with a small brush. Second, it might be a virus causing prolonged high CPU usage, leading to overheating and the system automatically increasing the fan speed. I suggest running a virus scan and replacing the CPU fan! It only costs a few bucks! Buy one at the computer market! Take the heatsink and fan off! Bring it to the computer market and have a professional technician replace it for you, and it'll be OK!

Title: My child does homework until midnight, should I let them go to sleep? Content: This needs to be considered from multiple aspects. First, listen to the child's own thoughts. If the child insists on finishing before resting, even if you force them to sleep, they might not be able to fall asleep. At this time, just accompany them and do your best to provide logistical support. Or negotiate with the child about what time to stop and go to sleep, otherwise it will affect their mental state the next day. Second, look at the child's actual physical condition. If they are nodding off like a pecking chick, even if you insist they finish before sleeping, it won't help. It's better to sleep first and continue writing early the next day. There are also two special situations. The first is: if they didn't finish their homework during the day because they were playing, even if you repeatedly emphasized and urged them to hurry up with their homework, they still chose to play to their heart's content first and write later, promising to finish it no matter what, even if it means not sleeping. Then I think at this time, you should not let the child go to sleep, regardless of whether they are tired or want to sleep, you cannot relent. Because they must fulfill their own promise and cannot go back on their word; they created the cause and must taste the consequence themselves. At the same time, it lets them experience the discomfort of staying up late to do homework, so they won't make the same mistake next time. The second is: if time was lost because they went out for an activity with their parents during the day, for example, taking them out for fun, visiting relatives, etc., then you can let them sleep first and make it up the next morning. If they made some kind of deal with their parents during the day, for example, wanting to go out to play and promising to finish their homework after returning, then you can let them finish, or based on the child's attitude, let them sleep first and make it up the next morning. For example, if after returning home they consciously and proactively start their homework, and work very diligently, without wanting to sleep as soon as they feel tired at night, then you can relax the requirements, but explain that it is an extra reward for their attitude. However, criticism should still be given for not completing the homework and breaking the promise. Also, consider whether they can complete the homework with quality and quantity the next morning. If they have had such a situation before, where they didn't finish the homework the previous night but could complete it with quality and quantity after getting up the next morning, then you can also let them sleep first. The actual situation is certainly more complex than what I described, so you need to be flexible when applying these ideas.

Title: 15 Accidental Injuries at Home for Children, 65 Tips for Handling Home Accidents Content: 15 Accidental Injuries at Home for Children, 65 Tips for Handling Home Accidents Eleven: Baby's Home Accidental Injury: Accidental Ingestion of Medicine Children are still naive and have a strong curiosity. If adults are slightly careless or negligent in storing medicine, accidents of accidental ingestion may occur. Some medicines are highly toxic and can quickly endanger life if not handled promptly. Immediate Tips for Handling Baby's Home Accidental Injuries: 44. If a child accidentally ingests general medicine, stimulate the throat with a finger to induce vomiting, then immediately send to the hospital for gastric lavage. 45. If the ingested medicine is highly corrosive, immediately drink milk, thick rice soup, or raw egg white to protect the gastric mucosa, then quickly send to the hospital for emergency treatment. 46. When going to the hospital, bring the accidentally ingested medicine and the medicine bottle to provide the doctor with as much rescue information as possible. Twelve: Baby's Home Accidental Injury: Choking Foreign objects entering the trachea are common accidents for infants and toddlers under 3 years old. Once it happens, it is very dangerous. If not treated promptly, it can quickly lead to choking and adverse outcomes. Immediate Tips for Handling Baby's Home Accidental Injuries: 47. When choking occurs, do not pat the back, as this may push the foreign object deeper into the trachea. 48. If the foreign object is small and round, such as a tangerine seed, for a small infant, immediately hold them upright and pat their back, while pushing down on the chest from top to bottom with your hand to encourage the object to enter one bronchus, allowing the trachea to connect with the other bronchus, thus relieving cyanosis caused by hypoxia. 49. For older children, stand behind them, place your hands above their navel and push upwards and inwards to help cough out the foreign object. 50. Whether the cyanosis is relieved or the foreign object is coughed out, quickly send to the hospital for emergency treatment simultaneously. Thirteen: Baby's Home Accidental Injury: Burns and Scalds Faced with burns and scalds that happen in an instant, mothers often panic, but the most important thing at this time is to quickly assess and identify the injury site in order to take appropriate measures. Immediate Tips for Handling Baby's Home Accidental Injuries: 51. Provide appropriate treatment at the first moment. For example, if clothing is on fire, quickly extinguish it with a coat or small blanket; for hot water scalds, carefully remove the clothing immediately or cut open the clothing around the scalded area. 52. When clothing and skin are stuck together, cut away the unstuck clothing, and leave the stuck clothing for the hospital to handle to prevent worsening the wound. 53. Immediately rinse the scalded area with running water and soak in cold boiled water or clean cold water for 30 minutes. Then apply burn ointment. 54. After emergency treatment, quickly send to the hospital, especially for burns on the face, hands, legs, genital areas, and for infants under 1 year old. 55. For severe burns and scalds, during transport to the hospital, have the child lie flat, do not hold them upright, and can give them some light sugar-salt water to drink. 56. Never apply soy sauce or similar substances to the wound, to avoid causing infection. Fourteen: Baby's Home Accidental Injury: Electric Shock Children are very curious about power outlets and wires, and often touch these dangerous items when adults are not paying attention, leading to frequent electric shock accidents. Immediate Tips for Handling Baby's Home Accidental Injuries: 57. Immediately cut off the power supply, do not pull the electrocuted child with your hands. If the power cannot be cut off immediately, use a wooden stick or other insulator to move the child away from the power source. 58. Quickly perform artificial respiration and cardiac massage. 59. Provide treatment for local burns and quickly send to the hospital for treatment. Fifteen: Baby's Home Accidental Injury: Foreign Objects in Ear, Nose, Eye Foreign objects entering the ear or nose are mostly inserted by the children themselves, causing injuries such as chronic otitis media or chronic rhinitis. Additionally, small insects, dust, etc., often fly into the eyes, causing infection or abrasion. Immediate Tips for Handling Baby's Home Accidental Injuries: 60. When a foreign object enters one ear, pull the auricle backward and upward with your hand, straighten the ear canal, and tilt the head to the affected side to help the object slide out. 61. If it's a small insect, you can use a flashlight to shine into the ear, and the insect may naturally fly out. 62. When a foreign object enters the nose, help the child mimic the action of blowing their nose to expel the object. ? 63. When a foreign object enters the eye, if tears do not wash it out, rinse with boiled water or saline solution. While rinsing, gently pull open the upper and lower eyelids with your thumb and index finger. 64. If the foreign object is on the conjunctiva, especially on the black part of the eye (cornea), wipe gently. If it cannot be wiped out, seek a doctor's help. Do not rub the eye with hands or a handkerchief. 65. If none of the above methods are effective, seek a doctor's help.

Title: Computer hibernation or sleep mode - monitor turns off but host doesn't, is it broken? Content: It's normal for the monitor to turn off during computer hibernation or sleep mode. During hibernation or sleep, the host hardware is still working; the computer isn't broken. To wake a hibernating computer, just press the power button, and it will wake up in tens of seconds. To wake a sleeping computer, press any key on the keyboard or move the mouse, and the system will wake up in tens of seconds. Can be resolved by the following methods: Title: 1. Computer hibernation mode means only the monitor is off, the host is still active. 1. Press the Windows logo key, type regedit, enter the registry; 2. Go to HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SessionManager\Power in the registry, check if there is a "DWORD 32-bit value" named AwaymodeEnabled on the right side: if it exists, disable this mode – change the key value to 0 or delete this key value; if it doesn't exist, sleep failure generally won't occur. Found this answer online, tried it myself, it worked and solved the problem. Solution: Download and install Thunder 9 - Settings - Advanced Settings - Turn off "Away Mode".

Title: If a round-trip flight ticket cannot take off due to weather reasons, can both legs be fully refunded? Content: If it is a round-trip ticket under the same ticket number, it can be refunded simultaneously. I couldn't find an example for a round-trip flight, but I found one for a connecting flight (just to illustrate the relevant knowledge, infringement deleted), but the logic is the same. Take the following image as an example. These two flight segments are purchased together but have only one ticket number. In this case, they can be refunded or changed together. On some platforms or airlines, the ticket number is sometimes not clearly stated in the text message. In this case, you can check it on Umetrip. Conversely, if there are two ticket numbers, whether for flights with the same airline or different airlines, in principle, they cannot be refunded simultaneously. It is particularly important to note that sometimes the "round-trip tickets" you purchase in one go on third-party platforms like Ctrip or Fliggy might be "round-trips" combined by these agents, but they actually have two ticket numbers. Therefore, you must check the ticket number carefully. Generally, the purchase order page and the mobile confirmation message will state it clearly. Here, "in principle" is used because there are some exceptions. Specifically, starting this year, airlines like China Eastern Airlines have expanded the scope of free refunds and changes, allowing free refunds and changes for situations where subsequent flights cannot be taken due to certain force majeure events. This means that if weather or other reasons affect the first leg of the flight, and because of the first leg, it is obvious that the second leg cannot be taken either, the airline can provide free refunds or changes based on relevant conditions. The specific details of these conditions have not been published. Based on my personal experience, for situations where both segments are China Eastern Airlines flights, China Eastern Airlines acknowledges it, and the second segment can be refunded without a service fee. My experience involved an overnight transfer. Both segments were with China Eastern Airlines, both purchased directly from China Eastern, but they were bought separately (because a connecting ticket couldn't be combined). The first segment was canceled, and I applied for a free refund for the second segment. After applying with customer service, the refund was approved. A friend of mine experienced a situation similar to the one described by the questioner: a round-trip ticket over two days, also both with China Eastern Airlines. The outbound flight on the first day was canceled due to weather, and there was only one flight per day. He requested a refund for the return ticket on the second day and obtained approval. I have seen some netizens' posts stating that if the first leg is with another airline, China Eastern Airlines usually does not acknowledge it; even if both segments are with China Eastern Airlines, if the interval is too long (exceeding 72 hours), China Eastern Airlines is unwilling to provide a free refund for the second segment. I have also seen netizens report that for a round-trip over two days, if the first leg was delayed, China Eastern Airlines was willing to rebook the first leg for free onto another airline but unwilling to refund the return flight the next day. However, other netizens reported that for situations where the first leg was not with China Eastern Airlines, but due to the previous flight diverting to an alternate airport, they were originally supposed to catch the China Eastern flight but missed it because of the diversion. After applying with customer service, they were also granted a free refund. I speculate that China Eastern Airlines' definition of "separately purchased tickets for a continuous itinerary" is judged based on the actual situation, mainly focusing on whether the two flight segments are truly "continuous," whether there are alternative options, or whether it genuinely affects the passenger's travel arrangements. For example, in the case of an excessively long interval mentioned earlier, it might be considered as not substantially affecting the passenger's itinerary; whereas in the case of a previous flight diversion, it is clear that the passenger cannot rearrange their itinerary, so customer service probably still acknowledges it. Given this complexity, it is recommended to call the airline's customer service to inquire.

Title: Is DiDi Chuxing really taking too high a commission? DiDi's response: Most of the high commission is used to reward drivers. Content: Is DiDi Chuxing really taking too high a commission? DiDi's response: Most of the high commission is used to reward drivers. Source: Global Network Auto. Recently, DiDi Chuxing responded to the issue of high commission rates for ride-hailing. Lately, DiDi ride-hailing has been questioned for 'excessively high commissions' and 'non-transparent commission rules.' There have been reports that for a passenger payment of 154 yuan, the driver actually only receives 95 yuan, meaning DiDi's platform commission rate reaches nearly 40%. This series of topics has caused great dissatisfaction among DiDi drivers, as they work hard to accept orders only to see a large portion of the earnings taken by the platform, which is frustrating for anyone. Some netizens even commented that DiDi's commission is not just a cut but 'bloodsucking,' causing significant waves in the industry. In response, the DiDi ride-hailing platform immediately stated: 'We have noticed that drivers, media, and self-media have been reporting on issues like 'commissions' through individual bill comparisons, driver visits, etc. We thank the public for their supervision and criticism.' DiDi also provided a breakdown of costs: In 2020, DiDi drivers' income accounted for 79.1% of the total passenger payment. Of the remaining 20.9%, 10.9% was used for passenger subsidies and discounts, 6.9% for corporate operating costs (R&D, servers, security, customer service, HR, offline operations, etc.), taxes, and payment fees, and 3.1% was the net profit of the ride-hailing business. We also acknowledge that there are indeed some orders where the driver's income proportion is relatively low, such as shared rides. Orders with commissions exceeding 30% account for 2.7% of total orders. Although such extreme cases are not common, they have caused concerns among drivers, leading to the misconception that all DiDi commissions are above 30%. We are gradually investigating the reasons for these extreme orders and striving to avoid such situations. Driver earnings include: basic income for each order, other income (full amount of dynamic pricing, dispatch fees, thank-you fees, Spring Festival service fees paid by passengers, as well as platform-paid empty driving compensation, etc.). Driver subsidies include: platform-issued bonuses for order completion, peak-hour rewards, holiday subsidies, etc. (subsidies are usually credited to drivers the next day). In simple terms, apart from operating costs, DiDi uses a portion of the high commission to fund other rewards, which are then redistributed to drivers with special contributions. This approach aims to incentivize drivers to accept more orders during rain or snow, peak hours, holiday travel peaks, and high-demand areas. Through subsidies, the platform encourages drivers to earn more by working more and better. DiDi believes that if 'equalitarianism' were strictly followed, it would reduce the flexibility of supply and demand regulation, making it harder to get a ride during peak hours and in popular areas. In fact, DiDi's ride-hailing business had been operating at a loss for a long time due to intense competition and only recently turned a profit. The net profit margin for DiDi's ride-hailing business in 2020 was 3.1%, which is indeed not very high.

Title: Traffic Accident, Issue Regarding Lost Wages Time. Content: In civil compensation for traffic accidents, disputes often arise between involved parties and insurance companies when negotiating the duration of lost wages. When negotiating compensation directly with the insurance company, the party believed the lost wages should be calculated for at least one month, but the insurance company insisted on only 20 days. What should be done in such a situation? Some suggest directly commissioning a third-party institution for a three-phase assessment. They assume that with an assessment conclusion, the insurance company will certainly accept the lost wages duration. I can accurately tell you that sometimes the insurance company simply won't accept it. Others say you can directly file a lawsuit in court. I think the method suggested by such people is correct in principle, but not necessarily practical. Civil litigation in a People's Court takes time. The best approach is to negotiate with the insurance company multiple times. Continue discussing with the insurance company's claims adjuster. As long as your reasons are solid and your demands are reasonable, the best method is to negotiate several times with the insurance company. In civil compensation mediation, insurance companies actually prefer to avoid court lawsuits. As long as the difference is not significant, the insurance company will usually agree. Consider this: in civil compensation, the insurance company aims to minimize payouts to maximize company profits.

Title: What Can Save You, My Renovated House Content: The paint renovation of a renovated house needs to balance aesthetics, environmental friendliness, and construction quality, while avoiding damage to the original decoration structure. The following are key details to pay attention to, organized step-by-step for reference: --- Today at the construction site 【Poly Mansion Phase 4】 I. Preliminary Preparation Stage 1. Assess the original wall condition - Check the base layer quality: Confirm if the wall surface is flat, and if there are cracks, hollows, or peeling. If the original wall has wallpaper or diatomaceous mud, it needs to be completely removed and sanded flat. - **Test paint adhesion**: Apply and pull off tape; if severe peeling occurs, the original paint layer needs to be scraped off and the base layer re-treated. - **Confirm wall material**: Different base layers like gypsum board, putty layer, latex paint, etc., require matching treatment processes. 2. **Clarify renovation needs** - **Style matching**: Choose wall color based on furniture and floor tones to avoid color clashes (e.g., wood-colored floors pair better with warm tones). - **Functional needs**: Children's rooms can choose scrubbable paint; kitchens/bathrooms need moisture and mold resistant paint. 3. **Material selection** - **Environmental friendliness**: Prioritize low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compounds) or environmentally certified paints (such as China's Ten-Ring Certification, US GreenGuard). - **Paint type selection**: - Latex paint: Cost-effective, suitable for most areas. - Artistic paint/micro-cement: Enhances texture, but complex construction and high cost. - **Color testing**: Test paint on a small area and observe color differences under natural and artificial light to avoid mistakes. #RenovatedHouseDecoration[Topic] #LatexPaintColorMatching[Topic] #RenovatedHouseRenovation[Topic] #NewHouseDecoration[Topic] #TaishanDecoration[Topic] #Dulux[Topic]

Title: Unknowingly Activated 'Pay After Use'? Someone Only Discovered After Receiving Multiple Deduction Messages in a Row
Content: Recently, have your wallets been emptied by the successive shopping festivals? At the same time, many consumers have reported that when shopping online, their payment methods were inexplicably changed, allowing them to place orders directly without facial recognition or entering a password. Upon closer inspection, a payment function called 'Pay After Use' has quietly been launched. In early October this year, Mr. Li saw a jacket he liked on Taobao, clicked to buy, and successfully placed the order without entering a payment password. Only then did he discover that the 'Pay After Use' function had been activated without his knowledge. This function actually doesn't align with Mr. Li's consumption habits. Previously, when faced with the password entry screen, Mr. Li would reconsider, but now items are directly ordered, and if he doesn't want them, he might have to contact the seller for a return. Mr. Li expressed that this function did not bring him a pleasant shopping experience; instead, it deprived him of his right to know and easily leads to impulse purchases. Consumer Mr. Li: This payment mechanism wasn't explained to me. With one click, the order is placed, which has caused me trouble. I'm also worried that placing orders directly without seeing the payment process will lead me to buy many unnecessary things. Ms. Hu, 68, is an elderly online shopping enthusiast. Some time ago, she also found, somehow, that the 'Pay After Use' function had been activated. Ms. Hu was worried that this function would deduct money arbitrarily and went through great effort to turn it off. Consumer Ms. Hu: I went to a nearby mobile phone service store and had a staff member help me turn it off. Mr. Zhang, on the other hand, only discovered he had activated the 'Pay After Use' function after receiving multiple deduction messages in a row. Mr. Zhang: One day I received payment notifications concentrated together. I checked later and found that I hadn't paid when placing the orders initially, which is actually quite convenient. But now I have a child. If my child mistakenly operates my phone and there's no password payment, I might lose a lot of money, as I can't monitor the child all the time. Similar complaints are common online – being activated for the 'Pay After Use' function for no reason, and it becomes the default payment method in subsequent shopping. Regarding this, a 'Zero Distance' reporter personally experienced it. They opened a shopping app and selected a tube of toothpaste. Upon entering the interface, the first thing they saw was 'Order at 0 yuan, pay after confirming receipt.' By searching, one can also find the cancellation method. In the App's system settings, there are payment-related options. The second one is the 'Pay After Use' item. The default status is 'activated.' At the very bottom, there is a 'Close Service' option. However, after clicking it, a message pops up saying, 'There are orders in progress, unable to confirm service closure.' The path to close this 'Pay After Use' function is not only very hidden but also requires waiting for all orders to be received or after-sales processes to end before it can be closed. Additionally, changing the priority order of payment methods is also inconvenient. Zero Distance reporter Wang Hongyun: Wanting to close the 'Pay After Use' option in the payment settings, after opening it, found that setting 'Pay After Use' as the preferred payment method is also the default. Clicking to turn off this default state, then going back to the product page just visited, and clicking 'Buy Now,' the first default payment method is still 'Pay After Use.' Such a complex and hidden cancellation method is indeed a headache, and one can easily fall into a 'trap of tricks' if not careful. 'Pay After Use, Password-Free Payment' is a new consumption model that can help merchants attract traffic and promote sales, and it also increases consumers' willingness to buy. However, the 'Pay After Use' function should allow for 'one-click activation' and also 'one-click deactivation,' making cancellation and changes easy and convenient. Only then can it provide consumers with a good shopping experience. The 'Implementation Regulations of the Consumer Rights and Interests Protection Law,' which came into effect on July 1st this year, also specifically detailed the obligations of businesses in online transactions and consumer rights protection. Xu Yue, staff member of the Propaganda Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Consumer Council: When merchants enable this function, they fail to adequately fulfill their duty to inform and draw attention. When canceling, they set up numerous obstacles, which无形中 deprives consumers of their right to know and their right to free choice. The Provincial Consumer Council emphasized that when consumers choose this service, they should fully consider their own financial situation and consumption habits, and be wary of the resulting overconsumption and credit risks. Platforms should use pop-up windows or conspicuous methods like red bold text for prompts, enhance reconfirmation prompts for 'misclicks,' and improve after-sales system arrangements. Xu Yue, staff member of the Propaganda Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Consumer Council: Strengthen attention to how elderly family members use their phones. If an elderly person at home has activated this function unknowingly, be sure to remind them. If it's not needed, turn it off promptly to prevent subsequent troubles with returns and refunds. Currently, e-commerce sales models are diverse, but fundamentally, technological convenience should serve consumers, not trick them. For e-commerce platforms to grow bigger and stronger, the primary requirement is honesty and trustworthiness, which is the reputation and word-of-mouth accumulated through long-term, considerate service for consumers. If inappropriate functions lead to widespread complaints from consumers, it would be counterproductive.

Title: How is the compensation at water plants? Content: In first-tier cities like Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, the basic salary for formal employees of water companies is about 7,000 yuan. With various subsidies, perfect attendance bonuses, etc., the total income can reach around 10,000 yuan. These employees also enjoy five social insurances and one housing fund, as well as statutory holidays, and receive an annual bonus at the end of the year. In contrast, in some smaller cities, such as third or fourth-tier cities, the basic salary might only be around 3,000 yuan. After adding various subsidies, the comprehensive income is approximately 5,000 yuan. Although the income is lower, the work for such employees is relatively stable, with fixed working hours, and they also enjoy statutory holidays and the five social insurances and one housing fund. Formal employees in water companies in these smaller cities typically have more regular working hours and less overtime. On the other hand, the work environment in first-tier cities might be busier, but the benefits and career development opportunities are also greater. Overall, there is a significant difference in compensation between employees of water companies in small cities and first-tier cities. Although employees in first-tier cities have higher incomes, their cost of living is also relatively higher. In small cities, while the income is lower, the cost of living is also lower, and work pressure is less. In either case, employees can enjoy statutory holidays and the five social insurances and one housing fund, which provides them with basic security. For people seeking stable employment, the choice of which city to work in mainly depends on personal career plans and cost of living considerations.

Title: Why do we still need to use 'pregnancy-preserving medicine' after transplantation? Is there something wrong with IVF babies? Content: I had IVF and gave birth to twin boys. I didn't understand this at first and thought there must be something wrong, which is why I needed to take pregnancy-preserving medicine. Later, my consultant told me that our bodies haven't adjusted naturally with IVF! The normal progesterone levels are very low, so we need to take pregnancy-preserving medicine to help our bodies adapt to the pregnancy. That's why we continue with pregnancy preservation after the embryo transfer. I had to get pregnancy-preserving injections for three months, one shot a day, over a hundred shots, plus other medications. IVF is really not easy, so we cherish the babies born through IVF even more! I hope my babies grow up healthy and strong.

Title: Changchun removes park fences, do you support removal or not? Content: I support Changchun's removal of park fences. The following is a specific analysis: I. Rationality of fence removal Parks like Changchun Nanhu Park are located in the central urban area and are an important part of the city. These parks not only provide citizens with places for leisure and entertainment but also serve the functions of improving the urban environment and enhancing the city's image. However, the existence of fences restricts the convenience of citizens entering and exiting the parks, preventing this public resource from being fully utilized. Therefore, removing the fences is reasonable and helps to better realize the functions and roles of the parks. II. Benefits of fence removal Returning green space to the people: As a public resource, parks should provide convenient services for citizens. After the fences are removed, citizens can more quickly enjoy the greenery and public facilities of the parks, increasing park utilization and citizen satisfaction. Greening supplementation and construction: Removing fences does not mean a relaxation of park management. On the contrary, relevant departments will carry out greening supplementation and construction based on the park's original appearance, increasing the green spaces in the city and creating a more beautiful environment for citizens. Improved management efficiency: After fence removal, park management departments might find their work easier. For example, positions like gatekeepers may no longer be needed, thus reducing management costs. Meanwhile, commercial activities within the parks might recover to some extent due to the openness, bringing more economic benefits to the parks. Government's people-friendly image: Removing park fences is also an expression of the government's closeness to the people. Through this measure, the government conveys the concepts of openness, inclusiveness, and sharing to the citizens, enhancing their trust and support for the government. III. Concerns about fence removal and countermeasures Although fence removal brings many benefits, some citizens have expressed concerns. They worry that after the parks are opened, some individuals with low civic-mindedness might enter and damage the park environment; they worry that previously prohibited behaviors might become commonplace; they worry that management pressure might increase, etc. To address these concerns, the following measures can be taken: Strengthen publicity and education: Use various channels such as media and communities to strengthen publicity and education, improving citizens' environmental awareness and civic quality. Help citizens understand the importance of protecting the park environment and consciously abide by park regulations. Improve management systems: Establish sound park management systems, clearly defining management responsibilities and authority. Severely crack down on and penalize behaviors that damage the park environment or violate park regulations to maintain park order and image. Strengthen supervision: Increase the number of park management staff and patrol frequency, enhancing supervision of the parks. Identify and address problems promptly to ensure park safety and cleanliness. IV. Considerations for special parks For national 5A-level scenic spots like Jingyuetan, although they are large and integrated into the city, considering their importance and特殊性 for protection, it is recommended to continue implementing closed management. However, methods such as reducing ticket prices can be used to attract more citizens to visit and exercise, while strengthening management and services within the scenic area to enhance visitor satisfaction and experience. In summary, Changchun's removal of park fences is a measure that benefits both the country and the people. By removing fences, green space can be returned to the people, management efficiency can be improved, and a people-friendly government image can be shaped. At the same time, corresponding measures can be taken to address citizens' concerns and consider the situations of special parks. Therefore, I support Changchun's initiative to remove park fences.

Title: Q&A with the Head of the Department of Teacher Work, Ministry of Education, on Strengthening Teacher Student Education Practice Content: To implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech on Teachers' Day in 2014, continuously improve the quality of primary and secondary school teacher training, focus on cultivating 'Four Haves' good teachers, and strengthen the construction of the teaching workforce at the source, the Ministry of Education recently issued the "Opinions on Strengthening Teacher Student Education Practice" (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions"). Recently, the head of the Department of Teacher Work of the Ministry of Education answered reporters' questions regarding strengthening teacher student education practice. 1. Please discuss the background and significance of formulating the "Opinions". Answer: During the Teachers' Day in 2014, General Secretary Xi Jinping profoundly pointed out in a discussion with representatives of teachers and students from Beijing Normal University that it is necessary to strengthen the construction of the teacher education system, increase support for teacher training colleges, identify the main problems in teacher education, seek breakthroughs and focal points for deepening teacher education reform, and continuously improve the quality of teacher training. Premier Li Keqiang clearly demanded in the 2015 Government Work Report to promote the fair development and quality improvement of education, strengthen the construction of the teaching workforce; focus on promoting entrepreneurship and employment, strengthen employment guidance and entrepreneurship education, implement the employment promotion plan for college graduates, and encourage employment at the grassroots level. The speeches of the central leadership have pointed out the direction for deepening teacher education reform and provided guidelines for work. Conducting teacher student education practice is a necessary part of teacher training and a key measure for ensuring the quality of teacher training. In recent years, China's teacher education reform has continued to advance, and various localities and schools have actively explored teacher student education practice, achieving encouraging results. However, there are still varying degrees of problems that need to be urgently resolved. The education and teaching abilities of teacher graduates are not yet fully adapted to the practical needs of primary and secondary school education and teaching. Strengthening teacher student education practice, clarifying tasks, standardizing processes, strengthening guarantees, enhancing teacher students' sense of social responsibility, innovative spirit, and practical ability, and focusing on cultivating high-quality and professional 'Four Haves' good teachers are important tasks for deepening teacher education reform and comprehensively improving the quality of teacher training. It is also an urgent need to promote the integration of practice and employment and focus on promoting the employment of college teacher graduates. According to the new situation of China's education reform and development, and targeting the current state of teacher student education practice, the Ministry of Education recently issued the "Opinions on Strengthening Teacher Student Education Practice", aiming to promote teacher students to deeply experience education and teaching work through systematically designed and effectively guided education practice, gradually form good teacher ethics and professional identity, better understand professional knowledge of education and teaching, master necessary abilities in education and teaching design and implementation, class management and student guidance, etc., and lay a solid foundation for engaging in primary and secondary school education and teaching work and continuous professional development. 2. Please introduce the main framework and outstanding features of the "Opinions". Answer: The "Opinions" are divided into two parts with a total of nine articles. The first part (Articles 1-6) mainly contains opinions on the norms of teacher student education practice, including six aspects: practice objectives, practice content, practice forms, education internship, practice guidance, and practice evaluation. The second part (Articles 7-9) mainly contains opinions on the guarantees for teacher student education practice, including several aspects such as practice base construction, incentive mechanisms for guiding teachers, and funding guarantees. Overall, the "Opinions" mainly have the following three outstanding characteristics: First, it reflects comprehensive thinking on teacher student education practice. The "Opinions" provide overall planning and requirements for strengthening teacher student education practice from multiple aspects such as objectives, content, forms, guidance, evaluation, bases, and funding, reflecting both the current theoretical and practical achievements of teacher education institutions regarding teacher student education practice and the comprehensive thinking of the Ministry of Education on teacher student education practice. Second, it adheres to a problem-oriented approach. The "Opinions" address issues such as unclear practice objectives, insufficiently rich practice content, relatively singular practice forms, weak practice guidance forces, and relatively weak management evaluation and organizational guarantees, proposing a series of targeted requirements and opinions. Third, it follows the concept of professional training. Teacher training is highly professional. The "Opinions" do not consider how to strengthen teacher student education practice in isolation but strive to guide and promote teacher education institutions to incorporate teacher student education practice into the entire teacher training process, designing and implementing it in a coordinated manner according to the concept of professional training, thereby enhancing the effectiveness of teacher student education practice. 3. Please discuss the main reform measures of the "Opinions". Answer: In response to the prominent problems existing in current teacher student education practice, the Ministry of Education researched and formulated the "Opinions" based on summarizing and condensing local experience, vigorously promoting comprehensive reforms in the content, form, faculty, bases, funding, and other aspects of teacher student education practice in various localities and schools. First, integrate education practice throughout the entire teacher training process. Set sufficient education practice courses in the teacher student training plan, using education observation, internship, and research as the main modules, to construct a comprehensive education practice content system including teacher ethics experience, teaching practice, class management practice, and teaching research practice, and effectively implement the system of teacher student education practice accumulating to no less than one semester. Second, organize and carry out standardized education internships. Require the formulation of work norms such as education internship curriculum standards, implementation plans, internship manuals, and evaluation standards, so that there are clear requirements before the internship, strict supervision during the internship, and assessment and evaluation after the internship. Establish a teacher student internship qualification assessment system and an internship file system. Third, comprehensively implement the 'dual-tutor system' for education practice. Joint guidance by teachers from teacher education institutions and outstanding teachers from primary and secondary schools, fully leveraging the theoretical and research advantages of university guiding teachers and the education and teaching practical advantages of primary and secondary school guiding teachers. Institutions training secondary vocational school teachers should also collaborate with industries and enterprises to select enterprise professional technicians and highly skilled personnel to serve as guiding teachers. Fourth, establish and improve incentive mechanisms for guiding teachers. Teacher education institutions should provide preferential policies in terms of converting workload, professional title promotion, and salary distribution for teachers guiding teacher student education practice. The performance of primary and secondary school teachers in guiding teacher student education practice should be used as an important basis for awards, excellence evaluation, and professional title promotion, and as an important condition for selecting special-grade teachers and subject leaders. Fifth, collaboratively build long-term and stable education practice bases. Require local education administrative departments to coordinate the scale, structure, and service orientation of teacher students in their regions, and jointly select and build long-term, stable, and diversified education practice bases with teacher education institutions. Encourage provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities) to select and build a number of demonstration education practice bases. Sixth, effectively guarantee the investment in education practice funding. Require local education administrative departments to strengthen organizational leadership and coordinated planning, and increase funding investment. Teacher education institutions should establish a funding guarantee mechanism for teacher student education internships to ensure the needs for completing teacher student education practice tasks are met. 4. How to implement the "Opinions" effectively? Answer: To promote the implementation of the "Opinions", the Ministry of Education will focus on the following tasks: First, increase publicity efforts. Conduct extensive publicity of the "Opinions" through expert interpretations, centralized presentations, and other means. Second, strengthen demonstration and guidance. Make the effective implementation of the "Opinions" an important part of evaluating the 'Outstanding Teacher Training Plan' project, guiding and promoting the project implementation institutions to play a demonstrative and leading role in implementing the "Opinions". Third, organize supervision and inspection. Request the State Council Education Steering Committee or rely on the Teacher Training Teaching Guidance Committee to supervise and inspect the implementation effect of the "Opinions".

Title: When you draw a late sequence in the civil service interview and the examiners are tired, is that a big disadvantage? Content: It is a bit of a disadvantage, but not for the reason you mentioned. The disadvantage is that you have to wait for a long time, like being in solitary confinement for a day. I was the fourth from last to interview, and my score was the second highest in the entire group. The key is: if you have something to say, say it, and leave when you're done. When you chat, say what you think the listener wants to hear. Just be genuine, say a few words, and that's it. Be a normal person; don't give the examiners a political lecture. As for the issue you mentioned, during the interview, the three candidates for the same position are interviewed consecutively. If they're tired, they're all tired; it's basically fair. There's no disadvantage in that regard.

Title: Can a free gift be invoiced separately? Content: A friend asked whether a free gift can be invoiced separately, as shown in the picture: Actually, it cannot be issued. The system will automatically block a 0-yuan invoice. Some readers of the article have other related questions, and Second Brother will provide a systematic reply here. #1 Bought an air conditioner from a mall, market price 2000 including tax. The mall gave a free induction cooker, market price 300 including tax. The buyer paid a total of 2000 including tax. Accountant A issues the invoice like this: the gifted product is directly given a 100% discount on the invoice. Accountant B issues the invoice like this: uses the proportion of the market price (fair value) of each item to allocate and calculate the discount amount for the product and the gift, listing them separately. Second Brother thinks both methods are acceptable. The first method is used more often in practice because it's simple; you just apply a full discount directly. The second method requires allocation calculation, which is relatively troublesome, so the invoice issuer tends to simplify and choose the easier method. There are no relevant VAT regulations stating that allocation is mandatory or that discounts must be issued separately. From a VAT perspective, 'buy-and-get' is essentially a discount sale (physical discount). Whether the discount amount is applied to a single item or allocated across multiple items, I think both can be justified and do not affect the seller's tax calculation. Second Brother doesn't see major issues with the invoicing method. However, some regions have explicitly required allocation, so follow the local tax bureau's requirements. For example, Sichuan Province: Announcement from the Tax Bureau on VAT Treatment for Buy-and-Get Activities. #2 Bought a car at a 4S shop, market price 120,000 including tax, received a free backup radar, market price 2000 including tax. The buyer paid a total of 120,000 including tax. The format of the Motor Vehicle Sales Uniform Invoice is not like a digital electronic invoice; it cannot show a discount. How to handle this? Some say issue a separate special invoice for the gift with a 100% discount rate. But an invoice with a 100% discount rate and a total amount of 0 cannot be issued. The invoice shown in the picture above cannot be issued; the system blocks a total of 0! Others say to use the allocation method: allocate a discount amount to the vehicle and a discount amount to the gift. But doing so changes the amount on the Motor Vehicle Sales Uniform Invoice, which affects the Vehicle Purchase Tax calculation base. If there's a discrepancy with the contract vehicle price (the contract price is 120,000), this could be problematic. Actually, Sichuan Province has a reference guideline. Announcement from the Tax Bureau on VAT Treatment for Buy-and-Get Activities. Second Brother hasn't handled this practically. Adding "(including gift)" after the total amount including tax on the invoice – is this possible? Isn't the total amount including tax field automatically generated? Can it be added manually? Actually, many have given feedback on this issue. Before the Motor Vehicle Sales Uniform Invoice software is modified, as a temporary adjustment to the requirement of Announcement No. 6 to write "(including gift)" after the capital letters amount in the "Total Amount Including Tax" field of the Motor Vehicle Sales Uniform Invoice, it is temporarily adjusted to write "(including gift)" after the vehicle type in the "Vehicle Type" field. But from this regulation, we can see that for special invoices where the discount amount cannot be shown on the same invoice, there are still solutions. Through corresponding operations, it can be avoided being treated as a deemed sale for tax purposes. In practice, as you might experience when buying a car, buyers basically never receive an invoice for the gift. Also, the total amount including tax on the motor vehicle invoice is the full price, not the amount after allocating the gift discount. Therefore, 4S shops should pay more attention to the compliant handling of gifts. The outbound documents for the gift, the stipulation of the gift content in the contract, and local regulations regarding gift invoicing can all serve as evidence to avoid being classified as a gratuitous gift later. Be careful not to confuse it with promotional items given for free. #3 Service buy-and-get is common with property management companies. For example, Second Brother recharges 2 years of property fees, 2400 (single month fee 100), and gets 1 month of property fees free. This is essentially a sales discount behavior (service discount). According to the "Notice of the State Administration of Taxation on Issuing 'Several Specific Issues Concerning Value-Added Tax Regulations'" (Document No.: Guo Shui Fa [1993] No. 154), Article 2, Item (2): "If a taxpayer adopts a discount method to sell goods, and if the sales amount and the discount amount are indicated separately on the same invoice, the value-added tax may be levied on the sales amount after the discount." Therefore, if the VAT invoice is issued based on the discounted amount, VAT can be levied on the discounted sales amount. The gifted or discounted part does not need to pay VAT. #4 The issue of "pay property fees, get rice" is also a buy-and-get, just buying a service and getting a product. The principle is the same. But in practice, when you pay property fees, you probably rarely see the gifted item shown on the invoice, or maybe you don't even get an invoice, just a receipt. So, property companies need to pay attention to the tax treatment of these gifts. If no invoice is issued in the first place, then there is no risk of invoicing the gift. However, the outbound documents for the gift and the activity rules should be kept as supporting documents (e.g., if the gift is recorded as sales expense, the attached documents need to be complete and reasonable), serving as evidence of the buy-and-get activity. Through substantive evidence, the tax bureau can generally understand the nature of the gift during an audit and usually will not treat it as a deemed sale for the property company. As for other activities like garden parties, making zongzi, illustration classes, these can be recorded as sales expenses and do not need to be treated as deemed sales.
