Title: What is the content of Zhonghong Health New Star Critical Illness Insurance? Content: Since the implementation of the new critical illness regulations, various insurance companies have launched new products to attract consumers. Zhonghong Life Insurance has also kept up with the trend by introducing Zhonghong Health New Star Critical Illness Insurance. This product is promoted as having comprehensive coverage, but upon closer examination of the terms, we found several details that require attention. Firstly, Zhonghong Health New Star is a lifetime multiple-payment critical illness insurance that provides basic coverage for major and minor illnesses, along with other additional benefits. However, to determine whether this product is worth purchasing, a deeper understanding of its features is necessary. A major highlight of Zhonghong Health New Star is the provision of automatic premium loan, policy loan, and reduced paid-up insurance rights. These rights are very practical. For example, the automatic premium loan feature can automatically pay the premium using the cash value if the policyholder fails to pay the renewal premium on time, keeping the policy valid. The loan function allows the policyholder to mortgage the policy to the insurance company to obtain a loan of a certain percentage of the cash value. The reduced paid-up insurance function allows the policyholder to use the cash value as a single premium payment to reduce the insurance amount. However, Zhonghong Health New Star also has some shortcomings. Firstly, its coverage is not comprehensive enough, only providing coverage for major and minor illnesses, lacking coverage for intermediate illnesses. In the critical illness insurance market, the combination of major, intermediate, and minor illnesses is standard. Intermediate illness coverage can expand the claim scope and provide better protection for the insured. Secondly, its critical illness compensation ratio needs improvement. Although Zhonghong Health New Star divides critical illnesses into 6 groups for compensation, with a maximum of 3 payments, the highest compensation ratio is only 120%. In comparison, some products on the market can pay up to 6 times, even reaching a 200% compensation ratio. Finally, its coverage term options are relatively limited, with only a lifetime option, lacking flexibility. Overall, considering the incomplete coverage and less optimistic compensation situation, Zhonghong Health New Star does not offer high cost-effectiveness. Although it provides some practical rights, the shortcomings in coverage and compensation ratio make its overall performance less outstanding. When choosing critical illness insurance, consumers should comprehensively consider all aspects of the product and select the one that suits them best.

Title: When encountering someone else's baby with very high jaundice, should I suggest they go to the hospital to see a doctor? Yesterday afternoon, my husband and I took our second baby to the community hospital to get his jaundice tested. The baby in front of us had a very high jaundice value (head over 21, neck over 20, body over 18). I thought, with levels this high, they would probably take him to a larger hospital. However, the couple said to each other, "It's fine, we'll come back to test again tomorrow." My husband and I glanced at each other, both shocked. While waiting for the elevator, we asked them, "How old is your baby?" They said he was born on the 11th. "Only four days old? The jaundice value is a bit high, you should go to a bigger hospital to get it checked," I hadn't even said it yet, but my husband did. They still didn't react. Then, as we all left the community hospital together, my husband went up to them again and said, "You'd better go to a big hospital to get it checked. Your baby is only four days old, and the jaundice is a bit high. See what the doctor says. Our baby was even hospitalized because of high jaundice." Then we went our separate ways. I asked my husband, "Aren't you afraid they'll think you're a medical tout?" He said, "I'm not taking them to the hospital, I'm just suggesting they go see a doctor. Plus, their baby's jaundice is so high, I'm afraid they might be new parents who don't know any better, just like we were before." It's true. As new parents, there's a lot we didn't understand. Thinking back now, we wondered why our first child was always crying, always uncomfortable here and there, and we always felt he was difficult to care for. Now we've found the reason: it wasn't the baby's problem, but the parents who hadn't found the cause and the solution. We were just kindly reminding them, hoping they could avoid some detours, hoping the baby's jaundice would disappear sooner and have no impact on the baby. Because if the jaundice is particularly high, you need to go to the hospital to check whether it's pathological jaundice or physiological jaundice. Although pathological jaundice is rare, we need to be prepared for the worst. Wouldn't it be more reassuring to confirm it?

Title: What does the U8 display on the air conditioner mean? Content: The U8 display on an air conditioner usually indicates two types of faults: one is a fault with the mainboard of the indoor unit, and the other is a fault with the remote control. Specific explanations are as follows: Fault with the indoor unit mainboard: When there is a problem with the mainboard of the indoor unit, it may cause the air conditioner to fail to operate normally and display the U8 fault code on the screen. In this case, professional troubleshooting and repair of the indoor unit mainboard are required. Fault with the remote control: The remote control can also cause the U8 fault code to appear. Insufficient battery power or a damaged mainboard in the remote control may prevent it from controlling the air conditioner properly. When troubleshooting, you can first check if the remote control's battery is sufficient and if the remote control's mainboard is damaged. If the emergency switch can turn on the air conditioner but the remote control cannot, it is likely a problem with the remote control. Recommended steps: First, check the remote control: Because troubleshooting the remote control is relatively easy, start by checking the battery and mainboard of the remote control. If the remote control is not the issue, then proceed to troubleshoot the mainboard of the indoor unit. Since this requires professional knowledge, it is recommended to have a professional technician perform the inspection and repair.

Title: My girlfriend and I had sex on the 18th of last month. We didn't do any safety measures. On the 10th of this month, she felt a bit nauseous, vomited,... Content: My girlfriend and I had sex on the 18th of last month. We didn't do any safety measures. On the 10th of this month, she felt a bit nauseous, vomited, and wanted to eat sour things. May I ask, could it be pregnancy? We were too careless. However, it's not certain she is pregnant. First, generally, there are no feelings or physiological changes in the very early stages of pregnancy. Real nausea usually occurs after 40 days! You only start feeling it at least one month later. It's only been 22 days for you now, over 99% of people wouldn't have any sensation. So judging by nausea and vomiting is not accurate! Your most urgent task now is to go to the pharmacy and buy early pregnancy test strips. Be sure to buy from reputable manufacturers, buy a few extra strips, and test the first morning urine. You must carefully follow the instructions. You can test twice to prevent errors. The accuracy of these test strips is almost 99.9%. If there are two red lines, you can basically conclude pregnancy. If there is only one red line, it's best to test again in a few days, around the 28th, on the 16th. Because some people have low HCG levels early on and it might not be detected, sometimes the second line appears faint. But this situation is less common; generally, it can be accurately detected after 7 days. So if there's only one line at 22 days, it basically means no pregnancy! If pregnancy is detected, then you need to take measures. If you want a medical abortion, remember it must be done before 40 days, the earlier the better, as it causes less physical damage. The following is a quote: Medical abortion, also known as medication abortion, refers to the oral use of Mifepristone tablets plus Misoprostol to terminate an early pregnancy. The former causes degeneration and necrosis of the decidua and softening of the cervix, while the latter causes uterine contractions to expel the embryo. Choosing medication abortion within 49 days of pregnancy has relatively minor side effects, so this period is the optimal time for medication abortion. Terminating an unintended pregnancy with medication abortion generally takes three to four days. Usually, the medication regimen for abortion takes 4 days, on an empty stomach. Take one tablet each morning and evening for the first three days, and take three tablets at once on the fourth day. Generally, there are no major sensations in the first three days. On the fourth day, after taking the medication, the pain can be quite severe, although some individuals may not have significant reactions. Medication abortion causes less damage but can easily lead to incomplete abortion, requiring a D&C procedure, which causes greater damage to the uterus. Medication abortion not only takes a long time but also usually requires about two weeks of rest afterward. To determine if you are pregnant, you can buy an early pregnancy test kit. One red line is negative, indicating no pregnancy. Two red lines are positive, indicating pregnancy. Read the instructions carefully for usage. There's a 90% chance she is pregnant. You can go to a local hospital for a simple check to confirm. If her period usually comes on the 1st, a delay of about 10 days is usually enough to get a result with a pregnancy test kit. For greater accuracy, go to the hospital for a test. I don't agree with the view from the 2nd floor. When I was pregnant, I had sensations at 20 days. If an abortion is needed, surgical abortion is better. Medication abortion often doesn't complete the process fully, requiring a follow-up D&C, which causes significant damage to the uterus. The possibility is high. Go get checked.

Title: New Kidney Disease Drugs Welcome a "Double Whammy": 2 Breakthroughs Rewrite Kidney Fate! Content: Recently, two new types of kidney disease drugs have made breakthrough progress; let's look at them one by one. The first is a new drug for IgA Nephropathy: Atrasentan, which succeeded in a Phase 3 clinical trial! IgA Nephropathy is the most common type of kidney disease in China. Most people have heard of it, or are patients themselves, but may not understand its pathogenesis or intervention targets. I have created a diagram illustrating the pathogenesis of IgA Nephropathy (the "four-hit" theory) and the new drug targets; you can take a look: In the lower right corner of the diagram is Atrasentan. Atrasentan is an endothelin receptor antagonist. Its therapeutic target is the final step in the four-step pathogenesis: endothelin. Endothelin is a harmful substance that constricts the efferent arteriole outlet of the kidney, essentially trying to suffocate it. Atrasentan acts like a "dilator," reducing pressure in the kidney and extending its lifespan. When I previously discussed Sparsentan, I also mentioned endothelin. You might recall that Sparsentan is a dual-channel inhibitor of endothelin and angiotensin II. That drug is like a combination of a 'sentan' and a 'sartan'. However, it's too expensive, costing 840,000 RMB per year, and it's not yet available in China (you'd have to go to the US), making it largely impractical. Within the family of endothelin receptor antagonists, Atrasentan has an older "brother," Ambrisentan, which you might know is used to treat pulmonary arterial hypertension. In recent years, some have also used Ambrisentan to treat IgA Nephropathy, but this is considered "off-label use" - not approved by drug regulatory authorities, so it cannot be widely applied. If you ask your primary doctor to use it, they might refuse. This Phase 3 trial for Atrasentan, however, is intended for regulatory approval. Once approved and marketed, it can be widely used among kidney disease patients, so let's focus on it. The Phase 3 trial for Atrasentan in IgA Nephropathy is called the ALIGN trial. I won't go into excessive detail about it being double-blind, randomized, controlled, multinational, stratified by regional proteinuria, etc. Suffice to say it was costly, rigorously designed, and yields reliable results. One aspect I find particularly valuable about this trial is the inclusion criteria for participants: they must have been continuously using ACE inhibitors/ARBs ("Pril" or "Sartan" drugs) for 3 months. This is because both Atrasentan and ACEi/ARBs reduce kidney pressure, naturally raising concerns about "duplicative therapy." Is the effect redundant? If so, would it be ineffective or cause increased side effects? This needed to be answered. If participants weren't on ACEi/ARBs, leaving room for improvement, Atrasentan would easily show efficacy, but it might then just become a "generic alternative" to ACEi/ARBs – if it can be replaced, it's not particularly valuable. Only by testing it in participants already on ACEi/ARBs (where the drugs have already shown effect) and demonstrating an *additional* further benefit, does it prove to be a truly successful, unique, and irreplaceable new drug. After 9 months of the trial, results showed that compared to the placebo group, the Atrasentan group achieved a 36.1% reduction in proteinuria. Of course, the effect wasn't only apparent at 9 months; at the first assessment at 6 weeks, there was already a reduction of nearly 30%, with the effect gradually increasing over the subsequent months. Even in participants already taking ACEi/ARBs *and* SGLT2 inhibitors ("Liejing"), Atrasentan still reduced proteinuria by 37.4%, indicating its effect does not duplicate (or duplicates very little) that of ACEi/ARBs or SGLT2 inhibitors. It possesses a novel mechanism, independent action, and additional benefit – in short, it is irreplaceable by other drugs. Naturally, Atrasentan also cannot replace other drugs. While having a new drug "outcompete" older ones can be a form of progress, this "me-better" model doesn't lead to massive leaps. For example, if an older drug extends kidney lifespan by 30%, and a new drug on the same familiar pathway extends it by 40%,淘汰ing the old drug, the actual net progress is only 10% – a minor improvement. True major progress comes from the "first-in-class" model, expanding the pie, bringing an *additional* 40% extension in kidney lifespan through a completely new mechanism. That's a fourfold greater improvement, worthy of being called a "major breakthrough." The safety profile was also quite good. The incidence of adverse events was 82.2% in the Atrasentan group and 84.7% in the placebo group, with no significant difference. Notably, Atrasentan reduced blood pressure by an average of 4 mmHg, equivalent to half a blood pressure medication. This won't affect most people, is an extra benefit for hypertensive patients, but those with low blood pressure need to consider it carefully. In recent years, Phase 3 trials have tended to conduct interim analyses, releasing mid-term proteinuria results while saving the final kidney function results for later. This is also because the causal link between proteinuria and kidney outcomes is so strong that, following regulatory reforms, drug agencies can grant accelerated approval based on proteinuria effects alone. Of course, we still need to wait for the full trial completion to see the kidney function results. After all, some drugs create a big splash at launch, only for subsequent trials to reveal mediocre performance. Even the most promising drugs must be scrutinized rigorously. Now, let's look at the progress of the second drug: Finerenone, proven safe and effective in kidney transplant and heart failure populations. There aren't many kidney transplant patients among my readers, but this is still relevant, as the disease mechanisms before and after transplantation are largely the same, and treatment strategies overlap. At the recent 2025 World Congress of Nephrology, a retrospective study involving 28 kidney transplant patients was presented, demonstrating that Finerenone showed good results in both safety (most crucially, hyperkalemia) and efficacy (proteinuria reduction, kidney function improvement) in the transplant population. Finerenone belongs to the class of mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (MRAs). You might be more familiar with its older "brother," Spironolactone, which has diuretic, antihypertensive, and anti-heart failure effects. As its younger sibling, Finerenone naturally shares these properties. The difference is that Spironolactone and Eplerenone are *steroidal* MRAs, while Finerenone is a *non-steroidal* MRA (lacking the steroidal structure). They are indeed "brothers," closer than their "cousins" the ACEi/ARBs. But lacking the steroidal structure sets it apart from Spironolactone. Spironolactone and Eplerenone are like full brothers (same father and mother), while Finerenone is a half-brother (same father, different mother). Finerenone was born later. The eldest brother, Spironolactone, has led the family for decades. The half-brother Finerenone clearly has superior abilities, but fully replacing the elder brother will take time. Actually, "replacement" might not be the right word. Spironolactone has been active in the cardiovascular field for decades but has repeatedly failed to make significant inroads into nephrology, largely because it not only raises potassium but can also cause gynecomastia – which male kidney patients can accept? Female patients might not mind breast enlargement but are often unwilling to use it due to menstrual disturbances. It's not that Spironolactone is ineffective for kidney disease, but its side effects make it rarely used. Finerenone is different. While it shares the same "father" as Spironolactone (carrying the hyperkalemia risk gene), the "mother" is different (no steroidal structure). This results not only in less impact on potassium (in this study, 0 patients stopped due to side effects, hyperkalemia rate only 10% – compared to 30% with Spironolactone) but also eliminates the interference with sex hormones (0% incidence of gynecomastia). Last year, the FINEARTS-HF trial (Phase 3 trial of Finerenone for heart failure) succeeded, allowing Finerenone to effectively replace its elder brother Spironolactone's role in heart failure. Now it's making gains in nephrology, a field its elder brother never truly conquered. So, it's not so much "replacement" but genuinely expanding the pie of renal benefit, just like Atrasentan above – a "major breakthrough." Moreover, these two major breakthroughs are not redundant. Both new drugs have novel mechanisms and do not replace each other. If they were substitutes, the net progress would be the difference between their effects. But with two novel mechanisms, the progress is the *sum* of their effects: endothelin pathway + aldosterone pathway. What is the potential combined effect? There aren't rigorous combination trials yet. Based on some small-scale, less rigorous studies, it's predicted that together they could extend kidney lifespan by 3 to 5 times. Of course, formal, rigorous large-scale studies haven't been completed. Small-sample data can be unreliable, so I shouldn't say too much; I'm just mentioning it in passing here, so consider this part unsaid. Summary: The current landscape and trends in kidney disease treatment indicate that an era of multi-pronged approaches has arrived. The "brute force development model" of the last century – if a low oral dose doesn't work, try a high dose; if a high dose fails, try IV infusion; if regular infusion fails, try pulse therapy – is outdated. For a multi-factorial disease like chronic kidney disease, the efficacy ceiling for a single target is limited. Struggling intensely on a single pathway has a low upper limit. The focus now isn't solely on abandoning old drugs and substituting them on the same path (though that still happens – even small gains are gains), but on continuously opening up *new pathways* to obtain *new benefits*. Only by doing this can we control the various pathogenic pathways. Our hospital utilizes both Western and Traditional Chinese Medicine, developing both new formulations and new delivery methods, precisely to avoid getting stuck competing for minor gains within the old mechanisms of the last century. The human kidney has its own self-repair mechanisms. Why can't it self-repair? Simply because too many pathogenic pathways are left unblocked; repair can't keep up with damage. If we block enough pathogenic pathways, then the kidney's inherent self-repair mechanisms can lead us to achieve the historic transformation of chronic kidney disease progression: from slowing, to halting, to reversing.

Title: Shanghai Peace Hotel sells a can of Coke for 50 yuan per cup. The Market Supervision Bureau says it is a market-regulated price. How did this pricing come about? Can you accept it? Content: Of course, I can accept it. What's the problem with their clearly marked prices? It's not like they wrote Coke for 5 yuan, the picture shows a cup, and then after you finish drinking, they tell you it's 5 yuan per milliliter, 100 milliliters totaling 500 yuan. It's also not that you ask how much a Coke is, they immediately open the can and pour it, and then say 50 yuan. They didn't say it was fresh Coke and then serve you flat, warm Coke. They certainly didn't bring you a half-drunk Coke from someone else and make you pay for it. Why can't it be accepted?

Title: What happens if I can't afford my bank mortgage anymore and stop paying? Content: Based in Zhengzhou, with 6 years of experience, let me briefly talk about this issue. Being in the loan industry, I have seen many clients who cannot repay their loans. Getting to know them, I found that each person's story is quite lamentable. Mr. Zhang, a businessman in his forties doing business in Zhengzhou, bought a property in Zhengzhou a few years ago when business was good. In 2016, the total price was 1.3 million yuan, and he paid a down payment of over 300,000 yuan. At that time, he felt no pressure and bought it easily. In recent years, as everyone knows, due to the pandemic, the real economy has been hit hard, and Mr. Zhang was no exception. Others owed him money and couldn't pay, and he owed the bank money and couldn't pay either, eventually leading to a mortgage default. When he first defaulted, the bank kept calling him, urging him to repay. Later, after a long time without payment, his case was transferred to the specialized post-loan department. The post-loan department started communicating with him to negotiate repayment, otherwise they would send a lawyer's letter. But Mr. Zhang still had no money to repay. The bank then suggested he quickly sell the property to repay the loan, but Mr. Zhang didn't want to sell and had no money to repay. So, after three months of default, the bank sued Mr. Zhang. During the court hearing, Mr. Zhang was in low spirits, didn't want to face it, and didn't attend. Originally, the judge hoped he would come for a pre-trial settlement, but Mr. Zhang's absence directly led to a judgment ordering him to repay. After the judgment was issued, the bank quickly applied for enforcement. The court ordered Mr. Zhang to vacate the property. The 1.3 million yuan property was auctioned at a 30% discount from the current market price of 1 million yuan. If the auction proceeds were insufficient to cover the remaining principal owed to the bank, Mr. Zhang would need to continue repaying the bank until the debt was cleared. Mr. Zhang deeply regretted his emotional decision-making and not following the bank's advice to sell the property. He paid a down payment of over 300,000 yuan and had repaid 400,000 yuan in monthly installments over the years, of which 100,000 yuan was principal. You can calculate how much Mr. Zhang lost in total over these years. This is a true reflection of what happens to many ordinary people after a mortgage default. Here, I also remind everyone not to default unless it's absolutely necessary. Once you default, the consequences are truly terrifying. For more content, please follow the WeChat public account Zhengzhou Financial A.

Title: Old House Renovation - What to Do When the Foundation Is Unstable? Content: Old houses carry the memories of time, but as years go by, foundation issues often become the most troublesome problem in renovation. An unstable foundation not only affects the appearance of the house but may also endanger living safety. Today, let's talk about foundation reinforcement for old houses. I. How to Determine if the Foundation Is Stable? Before starting renovation, first accurately assess the foundation condition: Observe wall cracks: Especially diagonal cracks at the corners of doors and windows, vertical cracks on walls Check floor levelness: Use a level to measure if the ground is sloping Door/window operation test: Check if doors/windows are deformed or difficult to open/close Rainy season observation: Check for water seepage or pooling after rain II. Common Foundation Problems and Solutions 1. Uneven Foundation Settlement Symptoms: Diagonal wall cracks, localized sinking of house Solutions: Micro-pile reinforcement: Drive micro-piles into sinking areas to enhance bearing capacity Grouting reinforcement: Inject cement slurry into foundation to fill voids and increase density Underpinning technology: Gradually replace damaged foundation with new foundation 2. Insufficient Foundation Bearing Capacity Symptoms: Overall sinking, large-area ground cracks Solutions: Expand foundation area: Add concrete ring beams around original foundation Foundation replacement: Excavate weak soil layers, backfill with sand/gravel or concrete Add ground beams: Install reinforced concrete beams under walls 3. Problems Caused by Groundwater Level Changes Symptoms: Seasonal settlement, worsening during humid seasons Solutions: Improve drainage system: Add French drains, drainage pipes Moisture-proof treatment: Apply waterproof coatings, install moisture barriers Foundation sealing: Wrap foundation with waterproof materials III. Foundation Reinforcement Precautions Professional assessment first: Must have professional机构 conduct foundation survey Progressive construction: Avoid secondary damage from one-time reinforcement Consider overall structure: Foundation reinforcement must coordinate with superstructure Choose suitable season: Avoid construction during rainy season/extreme weather Complete legal procedures: Obtain relevant approvals before old house renovation IV. Prevention Over Cure: Daily Maintenance Suggestions Regularly check drainage around house Avoid heavy loading near house Promptly repair small cracks to prevent water seepage Plant large trees away from house foundation Have comprehensive professional inspection every 5-8 years Conclusion Old house foundation issues are like the "skeletal health" of the human body - requiring scientific diagnosis and precise treatment. When facing foundation problems, avoid reckless DIY handling and务必 seek professional team assistance. Only with a solid "foundation" can old houses be revitalized to continue carrying warm family memories. Title: What are some good shampoos to recommend? Content: Why is it so hard to buy a bottle of shampoo? I need an oil-control shampoo that won't cause hair loss after long-term use. Please recommend a few options for me? The ingredients should be natural, healthy, safe, and gentle, without added fragrances, preservatives, silicone oil, colorants, or other irritating chemical components. I can try a sample first. Friendly reminder: even the best shampoo is not medicine; for any claimed effect, it only plays a certain auxiliary role. It cannot achieve therapeutic effects. Those that claim to prevent hair loss, promote hair growth, or turn white hair black are just marketing gimmicks by unscrupulous merchants. A simple example: topical skin medications need to be applied several times a day for several consecutive days to show good results. Shampoo is rinsed off after three or four minutes and used only once every two or three days—how could it have such obvious effects? Even those with special product filings—the state does not recognize their claimed efficacy; they are merely allowed to use certain restricted vocabulary in advertising. Look at the image below. Therefore, you must learn to read the ingredient list yourself and choose a shampoo with healthy and safe ingredients. Be sure to check the filing information on the official website of the National Medical Products Administration to view the ingredient list from there. Many unverified products use other products' filing numbers to be listed for sale, which is highly harmful. Also, let's talk about those hand-brewed shampoos. They are very cheap. If they were really as good as advertised, they would be sold out locally—how could they be available online? If production is increased, machinery would be needed for production, filling, and labeling. That would make it factory-based, requiring a business license. You can ask their customer service for one to see if they have it. Another reason is that they lack filings. The cost of testing and filing is around 2000 yuan, which isn't much. So it's not about the money—it's because the ingredients are falsified, harmful components exceed standards, they fail testing, and cannot be filed. Finally, for all cosmetics, it's best to check the filing information on the National Medical Products Administration website to see if it's a legitimate product, then check its ingredient list and search online for the functions of various ingredients. This is the safest approach.

Title: Increasing Whole Life Insurance, Taking Over from 4.025%, But I Only Recommend 3 Models! Content: At first glance, many people think Increasing Whole Life Insurance only pays out when you 'die'. Actually, it has both life insurance functions and, like annuity insurance, allows you to receive money during your lifetime for uses such as education funds, pension funds, etc. To some extent, it is even more flexible and offers higher returns than annuity insurance! The concept of Increasing Whole Life Insurance is relatively new. Today, by reviewing high-quality products, let's see what it really is. The article content is as follows: 1. What is Increasing Whole Life Insurance? 2. Comparing 7 models, which has higher returns? 3. Duola's Insurance Purchase Advice N1 What is Increasing Whole Life Insurance? Life insurance pays out only upon death and is divided into Term Life Insurance and Whole Life Insurance based on the coverage period. Whole Life Insurance can be further divided into Level Whole Life Insurance and Increasing Whole Life Insurance. The former has a fixed sum assured, while the latter is special: ■ The sum assured and cash value increase at a compound interest rate for life, at least 3.5%, with the interest rate written into the contract. ■ Partial withdrawals can be made through policy partial surrenders to achieve functions like education funds and pension funds. Einstein said: Compound interest is the eighth wonder of the world. The difference between compound interest and simple interest is significant: ■ Simple Interest: Commonly used in bank wealth management products and fixed deposits. The principal is fixed, interest is settled in a lump sum at maturity, and interest generated by the principal during the term does not earn further interest. ■ Compound Interest: 'Interest on interest', where the principal and interest from the previous year become the principal for calculating interest in the next year. Assuming 100,000 yuan is deposited for 10 years at an annual interest rate of 3.5%, let's see the difference: It can be seen that if deposited for another 40 years, the interest difference between 3.5% compound interest and 3.5% simple interest reaches 150,000 yuan! The longer the time, the more pronounced the effect of compound interest growth. Therefore, this is the biggest advantage of Increasing Whole Life Insurance. It is equivalent to a lifelong compound interest growth account, where the death/total disability sum assured and cash value grow at a compound rate annually. The longer you live, the higher the returns and your 'value'. Besides this, it has many other advantages: Advantage 2: Flexible Deposits and Withdrawals Like an account, it allows flexible deposits and withdrawals. Deposit: This means increasing the coverage. If you feel the sum assured is insufficient after purchasing, you can choose to increase it. Generally, the younger you are, the lower the premium. Withdraw: This means partial surrender. After the free-look period, you can withdraw funds at any time for urgent needs, education funds, pension funds, etc., with the amount determined by you. Advantage 3: Policy Loans Generally, Increasing Whole Life Insurance supports policy loans, with a loan amount up to 80% of the cash value. Due to the relatively high cash value in the early stages, if you urgently need money, you can use a policy loan for emergencies. Of course, it also has disadvantages. Compared to the fixed withdrawals of annuity insurance, withdrawals from Increasing Whole Life Insurance require your own planning and are less stable. Besides this, what other differences are there between it and annuity insurance, and which is better? See the chart directly: To summarize, neither is inherently better or worse. ■ Annuity insurance is more suitable for people who know nothing about financial management, offering fixed withdrawals with no need for worry. ■ Increasing Whole Life Insurance is more flexible; with well-planned withdrawal timing, it can achieve higher returns. We won't elaborate on annuity insurance here; interested friends can directly add WeChat for consultation: baozhidao87 As for Increasing Whole Life Insurance, what high-return products are currently available? N2 Comparing 7 models, which has higher returns? We selected several popular and well-regarded products currently on the market and compared them based on 2 aspects: 1. Comparison of Insurance Rules (Click to view larger image) Ruyi Zun: Maximum entry age up to 80 years old, allows additional premiums and partial surrenders. Unfortunately, the attached universal account was recently delisted, reducing the product's advantage. Qintong Zunxiang: Low entry threshold, starting from 1000 yuan, supports premium increases and partial surrenders, but has more restrictions on additional premiums, limited to a maximum of 3 times. Huagui Ai, Jiaye Changqing G, Shouhushen, Hongli Niannian: These three are quite similar but less flexible, not supporting premium increases. Chuanshi Yingjia: Like Qintong Zunxiang, it's from Hengqin Life, supports partial surrenders, has the same premium increase rules, but the sum assured increases at a 4% compound rate. 2. Return Comparison For ordinary people, the main significance of Increasing Whole Life Insurance lies in planning for education funds, pension funds, and forced savings. Ultimately, it's about financial management, so the rate of return must be considered. IRR, the Internal Rate of Return, is the 'mirror' for all financial products, reflecting their true return. Taking a 30-year-old male and female as examples, with an annual premium of 100,000 yuan, let's look at the real returns of the 7 products under different payment terms: (Click to view larger image) For a 30-year-old male: Single Premium: Ruyi Zun has higher returns in the early years and recovers costs faster, but as age increases, Shouhushen's returns will surpass it. 3-year pay, 5-year pay, 10-year pay: Qintong Zunxiang has the highest returns. 15-year pay: Ruyi Zun recovers costs slower initially, but returns get higher with age. 20-year pay: Ruyi Zun recovers costs faster initially, but Shouhushen has higher returns later. (Click to view larger image) Looking at a 30-year-old female, the situation is similar: Single Premium: Ruyi Zun has higher returns initially and recovers costs faster, but as age increases, Shouhushen's returns will surpass it. 3-year pay, 5-year pay, 10-year pay: Qintong Zunxiang has an absolute advantage, with the highest interest rate throughout the policy term. 15-year pay, 20-year pay: Ruyi Zun recovers costs faster initially, Shouhushen has higher returns later. From the above analysis, Ruyi Zun, Qintong Zunxiang, and Shouhushen have the highest returns. 1. For females, Qintong Zunxiang can be prioritized. Product details: 2. For males, both Qintong Zunxiang & Ruyi Zun can be considered. Product details: 3. Shouhushen is also good, focusing on later-stage performance, with gradually increasing returns. But it recovers costs slower in the early stages. Product details: N3 Duola's Insurance Purchase Advice Domestic interest rates continue to decline. The 3-month fixed deposit rate in banks dropped from 10.98% in 1993 to 1.35% in 2020. Looking at global interest rates, developed countries have already entered the era of negative interest rates, and China might join the trend sooner or later. As ordinary people, we cannot influence the macro situation. The only thing we can do is manage our asset allocation based on our capabilities and personal preferences. Although annuity insurance and Increasing Whole Life Insurance do not offer exceptionally high returns, they win in terms of safety and stability. If you have needs for pension funds, education funds, or even asset inheritance, but lack a suitable planning method, you can definitely consider annuity insurance or Increasing Whole Life Insurance. Perhaps, if you missed the 4.025% annuity insurance, then don't miss the 3.5% Increasing Whole Life Insurance. Title: I might be able to get into a state-owned enterprise after graduating as a senior. Should I take the postgraduate entrance exam? Content: I can already guess which airline the original poster is from. You can start the job first, or after signing the tripartite agreement, then decide whether to take the postgraduate exam. Because even after signing, you can still break the agreement, and even after starting the job, you can still resign. However, missing out on a good job would be a case of gaining little at the expense of much. If you still feel like taking the postgraduate exam later, it's completely doable. Set your target universities a bit higher. If you get in, just resign, break the agreement, and go study – no problem. If the job is decent, with acceptable salary, environment, and other aspects, then keep the job and later take the exam for an on-the-job postgraduate degree, which is also a very good option.

Title: Are there any tenured teachers who want to resign? Content: I graduated as a tuition-free teacher at the end of 2017 and started working in another city 2 hours away from home. Started in a county town, then was assigned to the countryside. Really wanted to resign in my 3rd year, the salary was too low, and I had even contacted a private school in the city. Then the pandemic scared me, didn't dare to go back. Stayed until now, my 5th year. My salary has increased by 30,000 per year compared to when I started, taking home around 70,000 a year. Anyway, I feel I won't resign for now, and I don't want to go to the county town in this city either, since I live in the school's single dormitory with about 10 peers. Now I'm saving for a down payment. When my service period ends, I'll take exams for Chengdu or my hometown. If I pass, I'll resign; if not, I'll stay. Low salaries can't retain people. But currently, teacher salaries are okay. Anyway, I feel I couldn't find conditions like this in a private company.

Title: Multiple insurance companies have newly launched "0 deductible" million-yuan medical insurance on Alipay. Is a deductible = 0 better? Content: Life is unpredictable, and misfortunes lie in wait. Everyone wishes for a peaceful life, but illnesses and accidents are often hard to foresee, especially hospitalization. Typically, 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance features a low threshold for claims but also low coverage. The advantages and disadvantages of such insurance products are often distinguished by examining aspects like the product's coverage, renewal friendliness, and practical value-added features. Today, using products provided by Alipay's Ant Insurance as an example, let's look at the pros and cons of Hao Yibao's 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance. Is it worth buying for adults? Interested friends might as well take a look. Method 1: Start with the product's coverage. By examining the coverage details, you can understand your own insurance needs while also identifying the product's shortcomings and highlights. Evaluating the pros and cons of Hao Yibao's 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance follows the same principle. Taking the Hao Yibao 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance product as an example: The coverage of this product is quite broad, which can be considered an advantage. It provides coverage for general hospitalization, critical illness hospitalization, emergency department visits 30 days before and after hospitalization, special outpatient services, outpatient surgery, proton and heavy ion therapy, externally purchased drugs, a ¥10,000 critical illness allowance, expense advance payment, and hospitalization green channel services. It lacks none of the essential coverages. Method 2: Assess the product's renewal friendliness. The friendliness of the renewal terms is an indicator for judging the pros and cons of 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance. If it guarantees renewal, that's a selling point; otherwise, it's a drawback. It's worth mentioning that for products requiring annual review, you could be denied coverage in the second year due to worsened health, product discontinuation, or having made a claim. Evaluating the pros and cons of Hao Yibao's 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance is similar. Regarding the Hao Yibao 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance product: The renewal stability of this product is average. Renewal after the policy term expires if the product is discontinued, or switching to a new product upon discontinuation, both require review. It's a one-year policy (pay for one year, cover for one year) and is not a guaranteed renewable product, which is a shortcoming worth noting. Method 3: Examine the product's selling points and weaknesses. Understanding the selling points and weaknesses of 0-deductible medical insurance is crucial to determine if you need such a product. For Hao Yibao's 0-deductible hospitalization medical insurance, the shortcomings and advantages can be summarized as follows: 1. Advantages: (1) Comprehensive coverage: Besides basic coverages like special outpatient services, hospitalization medical expenses, outpatient services 30 days before and after hospitalization, and outpatient surgery, it also covers 100% of the costs for externally purchased drugs and proton and heavy ion therapy. (2) Good value-added services: In addition to hospitalization advance payment and critical illness green channel services, the external drug coverage is not limited to the social security list and includes CAR-T immunotherapy. It also offers direct payment for drugs purchased at designated pharmacies. (3) External drug coverage keeps up with mainstream medical technology: The external drug coverage is not limited by social security and includes recent advancements like CAR-T immunotherapy. It also provides direct payment for drugs bought at specified pharmacies. 2. Disadvantages: (1) It does not guarantee renewal, and renewal stability is quite average. It's better for customers to choose products that guarantee renewal for 20 years or offer long-term renewal. (2) Limitations on general hospitalization reimbursement: Although this product offers coverage up to 3 million yuan for general hospitalization medical expenses, the reimbursement rate for expenses below 10,000 yuan is only 30%, which is very low.

Title: I am a college student. I failed an exam in the first semester of my freshman year, and also failed the make-up exam in my sophomore year. Title: Slipped and fell while walking barefoot in the swimming pool, lay on the ground for a long time due to pain without getting up, and not a single passerby, not even staff, came forward to help. Content: Slipped and fell while walking barefoot in the swimming pool, lay on the ground for a long time due to pain without getting up, and not a single passerby, not even staff, came forward to help.

Later, I got up by myself, felt fine and left. About two hours later, the pain intensified, I went to the hospital, underwent a series of examinations, and was diagnosed with a fracture.

The next day, I went to the merchant to claim compensation, but the staff said this was a personal accident caused by my own reasons, and the swimming pool was not responsible.

The merchant's explanation was that they had clearly posted safety slogans in various prominent locations: 'The floor is slippery, be careful not to fall.'

Regardless of whether customers saw them or not, they had fulfilled their due responsibility. As for customers falling, they felt helpless, but it should not be their responsibility to bear; it should be borne by the customer themselves.

A friend complained about their experience on their social media feed. In the end, they argued fiercely with the merchant, but the matter was not resolved.
The friend felt they had some responsibility, but the merchant also had undeniable responsibility. Now that the merchant has completely shirked all responsibility, it's really infuriating. They decided to sue the merchant, determined to get an explanation.

@学长伴读 From a legal perspective: The manager of the swimming pool has a duty of safety assurance.

: According to national law, if a natural person, legal person, or other organization engaged in business activities such as accommodation, catering, entertainment, or other social activities fails to fulfill safety assurance obligations within a reasonable limit, causing personal injury to others, and the person entitled to compensation requests them to bear corresponding liability for compensation, the People's Court shall support it.

: The merchant uses posting safety slogans as a shield. Leaving aside whether the posting was standard, even if safety slogans are posted, the merchant should still bear corresponding responsibility. Does posting safety slogans mean the merchant is exempt from liability? This makes one doubt the merchant's true intention: was it to kindly remind customers to avoid accidents, or to evade responsibility?

If negotiation fails, I support my friend's decision to file a lawsuit in court to seek justice.

According to my friend, compared to the dispute with the merchant, one detail struck me as even more tragic: after my friend fell and lay on the ground, many people passed by, but not a single person came forward to help?

Were they afraid of being falsely accused? Or were there other reasons? It's unknown. I just saw the extinction of human nature and endless desolation.

It's not hard to be a good person in this world. What's hard is to always possess a compassionate heart that sympathizes with the world's suffering, at all times, rather than indifference.

Title: How to choose a water softening equipment? Content: With the development of society, water softening equipment is widely used in many industries. So, how should one choose a water softening equipment? Below, let's follow Jingmiao editor to look at several points that need to be understood when selecting water softening equipment. 1. The water production capacity of the water softening equipment. Before selecting a water softening equipment, a preliminary estimate of the water demand must be made. It is necessary to know the peak water usage and choose equipment with an appropriate water production capacity. Choosing equipment with too high a production capacity will increase the initial investment cost. Choosing one that is too small will, firstly, lead to insufficient water supply, and secondly, cause the equipment to run continuously for long periods, increasing wear and tear. 2. The water quality requirements of the water softening equipment. Different industries have different requirements for water quality. Typically, the effluent conductivity from reverse osmosis processes can be <10μs/cm. If higher water quality is needed, additional equipment such as mixed beds or EDI equipment must be added after the reverse osmosis unit. 3. The quality requirements of the water softening equipment. Nowadays, the water treatment industry is a mixed bag. Some purchasers operate under the mistaken notion of choosing only the cheapest option rather than the right one when buying water softening equipment. The result is not only a failure to save costs for the enterprise but also an increase in usage costs, and even delays in production. Water softening equipment is a non-standard device; different manufacturers use different components and consumables, leading to variations in price and quality. The principle of 'you get what you pay for' is an eternal truth. This requires that during the selection process, one should strive to choose high-quality water softening equipment while controlling costs as much as possible. That's all for the introduction on how to choose water softening equipment. If you have any other questions, please feel free to contact us.

Title: No More Worries About Accounting Temporary Estimation and Warehousing Issues! Content: [Rainbow R] Strictly adhere to the invoice acquisition deadline to avoid corporate income tax adjustment risks. Clearly define the bottom line of "must obtain a legal invoice before the final settlement (May 31 of the following year)". If it is anticipated that the invoice cannot be obtained on time, proactively make a tax adjustment during the final settlement to avoid being deemed by the tax authorities as underpaying taxes. Example: For costs temporarily estimated in December 2024, invoices must be chased back before May 31, 2025, otherwise the taxable income for the 2024 tax year will need to be adjusted. [Rainbow R] Standardize temporary estimation accounting treatment to prevent illegal VAT deduction. Strictly implement the rule of "only estimate the cost excluding tax, do not estimate input tax". The temporary estimation entry only accounts for the goods price; input tax must be confirmed after obtaining and verifying the special VAT invoice, avoiding the risk of early deduction or inflated input tax from the source. [Rainbow R] Establish a dynamic tracking mechanism to eliminate the hidden dangers of long-term suspense accounts. Centered around the "Temporary Estimation Warehousing Tax Risk Prevention and Control Ledger", check the "invoice receipt status" at the end of each month. For items where invoices have not been received for over 3 months, assign dedicated personnel to communicate with suppliers and chase the invoices; for suspense accounts unresolved for over 1 year, promptly investigate whether there are false transactions to avoid triggering tax audits. [Rainbow R] Retain supporting documentation for tax inspection purposes. When making temporary estimations, simultaneously retain supporting documents such as purchase contracts, warehousing receipts, and logistics documents to prove the authenticity of the transaction. Even if the invoice for the temporarily estimated cost is obtained before the final settlement, these documents must be kept for at least 10 years to prove business compliance during tax authority audits. #AccountingPractice #FinanceProfessionals #FinancialTips #AccountingWork #InventoryManagement

Title: Regarding the discovery of bad sectors on a mobile hard drive after startup and the possibility of data recovery? Content: How to recover data from a mobile hard drive that has bad sectors? Bad sectors on a mobile hard drive can lead to important data loss, but there's no need to worry excessively. In the following article, I will detail 6 methods to help you quickly and effectively recover data from your mobile hard drive. 1. Protecting Mobile Hard Drive Data After discovering data loss on a mobile hard drive, taking correct protective measures is crucial for successful data recovery. Here are the methods to protect mobile hard drive data: Stop using the mobile hard drive immediately: Once data loss is discovered, stop using the mobile hard drive immediately and store it safely. Continued use may lead to data overwriting, making recovery more difficult. Avoid physical damage: The mobile hard drive might have physical damage, such as impacts or vibrations, which could cause bad sectors to expand further. Therefore, avoiding further damage is crucial for subsequent data recovery. Do not attempt self-repair: Non-professionals should not attempt to repair the mobile hard drive themselves, as this may cause further data damage. Professional data recovery services can provide safer and more effective solutions. Avoid formatting or repartitioning: Formatting or repartitioning can cause data loss and should be avoided. Even data that seems inaccessible might be recoverable in subsequent recovery processes. Use professional software for detection: Using professional data recovery software to scan the mobile hard drive can help determine the cause and extent of data loss, providing a reference for subsequent recovery work. Seek professional help: If the above methods cannot solve the problem, seek professional data recovery services promptly. Professionals have more experience and specialized equipment, enabling more effective recovery of lost data. Special note: For solid-state mobile hard drives, after data loss occurs, stop using it immediately and unplug it directly, rather than performing a normal shutdown operation. A normal shutdown might cause data loss, further increasing the difficulty of data recovery. Please click to watch the tutorial video on how to back up mobile hard drive data: 2. Correct Methods to Protect Mobile Hard Drive Data After discovering data loss on a mobile hard drive, to successfully recover the data, we need to adopt correct methods to protect the mobile hard drive data, ensuring the possibility of future data recovery. Here are the correct operating methods to protect a mobile hard drive with lost data: Stop using the mobile hard drive: Immediately stop using the mobile hard drive and disconnect it from the computer. This avoids new data overwriting the already lost data, increasing the success rate of data recovery. Use professional tools: Seek professional data recovery tools or services, avoid attempting operations yourself that could cause further data damage. Maintain physical integrity: Avoid further operations on the mobile hard drive, especially disassembling or repairing it, to prevent physical damage. Avoid formatting and repartitioning: Do not attempt to format or repartition the mobile hard drive, to avoid permanent data loss. Keep dry and avoid shocks: Store the mobile hard drive in a dry, stable environment, and avoid vibrations and collisions to prevent further damage to the disk surface or internal components. Power off promptly: When data is lost on a solid-state mobile hard drive, unplug it from the computer immediately, rather than after a normal operating system shutdown, to avoid the risk of data loss. The purpose of these methods is to maximize the protection of data on the mobile hard drive, creating favorable conditions for subsequent data recovery work. Multiple Avenues for Data Recovery When dealing with file loss issues, we often employ multiple strategies to try to recover these documents from storage devices. As long as the storage device has not undergone low-level formatting and the document data has not been overwritten by new information, recovery is possible. Therefore, if attempts to recover documents from a recently lost data storage device fail, we should consider checking other storage media that might contain this data. For example, if file A was originally on the D drive of a computer, was later cut to a mobile hard drive, and file A on the mobile hard drive was accidentally deleted, while the D drive was also formatted, then, provided no new data has overwritten it, file A can potentially be recovered from both the mobile hard drive and the D drive. Q&A and Practical Methods on How to Recover Data from a Mobile Hard Drive with Bad Sectors How to determine if a mobile hard drive has bad sectors? Answer: You can use disk detection tools to scan the mobile hard drive, such as Windows' built-in disk check tool or third-party software. Answer: Once bad sectors are found on a mobile hard drive, stop using it immediately and back up important data. You can try using data recovery software methods like Quick Deleted File Recovery, Deep Recovery, or Custom File Format Recovery to attempt data recovery. If these methods don't solve the problem, it is recommended to seek professional data recovery services. How to protect mobile hard drive data security? Answer: To protect mobile hard drive data security, first, regularly back up important data to other storage devices, such as cloud storage or another computer. Second, avoid exposing the mobile hard drive to extreme temperatures or humidity, and try to avoid collisions or vibrations. Additionally, use encryption software to encrypt the mobile hard drive, ensuring data security during transmission and storage. Finally, regularly check the health status of the mobile hard drive and address potential issues promptly to ensure data integrity and security. What to do if the mobile hard drive is not recognized after being plugged into the computer? Answer: First, try connecting the mobile hard drive to another computer or a different USB port to see if it is recognized. If it still isn't recognized, try using a different data cable or USB interface to ensure the connection is normal. Also, check if the mobile hard drive appears in Device Manager. If it does, it might be a driver issue; try updating or reinstalling the drivers. If all the above methods fail, it might be a hardware failure of the mobile hard drive, and it is recommended to contact professional repair personnel or data recovery services. What is the success rate of using the chkdsk command to repair mobile hard drive errors? Answer: The chkdsk command can usually repair some common mobile hard drive errors, such as file system errors or bad sectors. Its success rate depends on the extent of the hard drive's damage and the type of error. For minor errors, chkdsk is often effective, with a relatively high success rate. However, for severe hardware damage or bad sector issues, chkdsk might not be able to fully repair them, and other data recovery methods may be needed to attempt a solution.

Title: Should Grandpa Be Told About His Grandson's Sudden Death? Content: Whether to inform Grandpa about his grandson's death should be judged primarily based on his health condition; a one-size-fits-all approach is not advisable. I. Key Considerations 1. If Grandpa has a history of severe heart disease or stroke, it is not recommended to inform him directly in the short term. A sudden emotional shock may trigger a secondary health crisis. His physical resilience should first be assessed by a family doctor. 2. Dementia patients require special handling. Patients in the middle to late stages have a confused perception of time. If he has asked about his grandson's whereabouts multiple times recently, a delaying explanation such as 'on a business trip for training' can be chosen, accompanied by guiding him through family photo reminiscence. 3. For elderly living alone as empty nesters, concealment can easily lead to greater risks. Neighbors or old colleagues might inadvertently reveal the information. It is better for the closest family member to inform him with companionship, while having emergency medication ready. II. Culture-Adapted Strategies In traditional northern families with strong clan values, the right to know within the 'five degrees of mourning' relationship is often emphasized. A respected elder from the clan can explain with the family tree to avoid Grandpa feeling the sense of loss from being 'excluded from family affairs.' In families from southern coastal areas that emphasize the custom of 'performing a happy event to counteract bad luck,' it is advisable to simultaneously prepare religious rituals such as chanting scriptures for the deceased, giving the elderly concrete activities to participate in. III. Information Delivery Techniques The 'double buffering' method of disclosure is more effective: during the first communication, say 'the child has a sudden critical illness and is undergoing emergency treatment,' observe the elderly's reaction, and then deliver the tragic news 12-24 hours later. This is easier to accept than a direct shock and avoids the emotional rupture caused by long-term concealment. During the accompaniment, playing the grandson's favorite music or looking through growth photo albums can create an outlet for emotional release. There was a case where children chose to conceal the news from their 80-year-old father for fear he couldn't bear the blow, but the elderly man learned about the car accident report through a mobile news push and suffered a sudden heart attack requiring hospitalization. This highlights the increased difficulty of information isolation in the digital age, making it particularly necessary to set up keyword blocking functions on the elderly's electronic devices in advance. For families adhering to the custom of burial, it is recommended to retain an appropriate amount of 'substitute mourning items,' such as placing the grandson's clothes in the coffin as a symbolic ritual. This can provide emotional solace for the elderly without violating relevant regulations.

Title: 2023 Top Ten Famous Brands of Air Energy Ranking What are the top ten famous brands of air energy water heaters? Content: When buying air energy products, the preferred choices are Haier, Gree, and Midea. The principle of an air energy water heater is called the 'Reverse Carnot Principle'. It uses a small amount of electricity to drive the compressor to work. Through the evaporator, it allows the refrigerant to circulate, transferring heat from the air to the water tank to heat water. If you reverse the principle of air conditioning cooling - air conditioning expels heat - the air energy water heater uses it to heat water. It's that simple. Therefore, in the field of air energy water heaters, the leading brands are the top players in air conditioning. Which are the largest domestic ones? Exactly, they are Haier, Gree, and Midea. Just theory isn't enough; let's talk using data from a well-known third-party ranking website for home appliances. Below is a chart from Gaide Ranking. The top three are Haier, Gree, and Midea. These three brands occupy 90% of the air energy market share. While there are many other brands on the market, air energy water heaters have very high requirements for after-sales service, especially installation conditions. Particularly in towns and rural areas, the installation and maintenance services of these three major brands are more reliable. 1. Haier: Haier entered the air energy water heater field in 2011 but came from behind, achieving rapid growth for many consecutive years. It participated in leading the formulation of 7 national and industry standards, won the 'China Heat Pump Industry Leading Brand' award five times, and was selected for the National Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's 'Energy Efficiency Star' list for three consecutive years. Haier adopts a multi-brand strategy. Besides 'Haier', it also has the 'Leader' and 'Casarte' brands. Leader focuses on cost-effectiveness, while Casarte focuses on the high-end market. Haier, as the group's most important brand, offers the most and richest variety of models. Haier's compressor is jointly developed with Hitachi. Haili compressors also have a good reputation in China. Some high-end Haier models use imported Japanese compressors. They offer a ten-year warranty, the longest in the industry. 2. Gree: Gree is the pioneer of Chinese air energy water heaters. It developed China's first air energy water heater in 2002 and launched a household product series in 2005. Gree has participated multiple times in the formulation of international ISO standards related to heat pumps. All of Gree's compressors are its own brand. Benefiting from Gree's technical strength in the air conditioning field, Gree compressors are of excellent quality. Based on fixed-frequency compressors, they have also developed two-stage enhanced vapor injection variable frequency compressors, which are more energy-efficient. They provide a 6-year warranty. 3. Midea: Midea air energy water heaters belong to Guangdong Midea Commercial Air Conditioning Equipment Co., Ltd. They launched air energy water heater products in 2003 and are widely used in both household and commercial fields. Midea uses GMCC Meizhi compressors manufactured in cooperation with Toshiba. GMCC compressors are one of the highest-selling compressor brands, with a global market share of about one-third. They provide a 6-year warranty. These three brands have a huge number of models. Title: Are there second-tier undergraduate programs in 985 and 211 universities? I just finished the college entrance exam, and my estimated score only meets the second-tier cutoff. Are there any second-tier programs in those good universities that I can apply to? Content: In China's higher education system, Project 985 and Project 211 universities typically represent the top tier of Chinese universities. These universities have high reputations in terms of comprehensive strength, discipline construction, and scientific research level. Generally, the undergraduate programs in 985 and 211 universities admit students based on the first-tier cutoff score. However, there are some special circumstances. Some 985 or 211 universities may establish cooperative education programs or specific majors, which might set different admission cutoff scores based on actual situations. Sometimes these cutoff scores might be close to or even reach the second-tier cutoff. These cases are usually relatively rare and may change annually. The specifics need to refer to the current year's college entrance exam policies and the enrollment brochures of each university. For students who just finished the exam and estimate their scores only meet the second-tier cutoff, if they hope to enter a 985 or 211 university, they can consider the following pathways: 1. Pay attention to special programs: Some 985 or 211 universities might have special programs or majors with relatively lower score requirements. These programs might include Sino-foreign cooperative education, art specialties, sports specialties, etc. 2. Early admission batch: Some majors in certain 985 or 211 universities might admit students during the early admission batch, and the cutoff scores for these majors might differ. 3. Local special plans: Some 985 or 211 universities establish special plans for students from specific regions, and the admission cutoff scores might be more favorable. 4. Major transfer opportunities: Some universities allow students to apply for a major transfer after enrollment based on certain academic achievements and conditions. Therefore, even if initially unable to enter the desired major, there is an opportunity to transfer later through effort. 5. Postgraduate entrance exam: If unable to enter a 985 or 211 university for undergraduate studies, one can also pursue further study in the graduate schools of these universities through the postgraduate entrance exam. Finally, it is recommended that students comprehensively consider their interests, strengths, future career plans, and other factors when filling out their applications. At the same time, they should closely follow the enrollment information of various universities to make the choice that best suits them.

Title: I am a migrant worker from Sichuan who contracted tuberculosis in Shache, Xinjiang. Now the hospital requires me to pay for myself, and my boss won't give me money for treatment. What should I do? Content: Tuberculosis cannot be considered an occupational disease because it is an infectious disease. Although it may be related to the work environment, the work environment is not the main factor causing the illness, so it cannot be classified as an occupational disease. If it is recognized as an occupational disease, you can enjoy work-related injury benefits. Since tuberculosis is not an occupational disease, the boss is not responsible for your illness.

Title: I am a female science student from Tianjin taking the college entrance exam today. I scored 6 points below the second-tier undergraduate cutoff. I suggest studying languages, especially less common foreign languages, as this makes it easier to find a job. I recommend against retaking the exam; a year is very valuable for a girl.

Title: How to Respond When Parents Ask if Tuition Can Be Cheaper Content: When facing parents' inquiries about whether tuition can be reduced, my suggestion is: Dear parents, I'm sorry, but the tuition is set according to the regulations of the Education Bureau, and we cannot adjust it arbitrarily. In fact, the setting of education costs involves multiple factors. The Education Bureau considers the investment in educational resources, teachers' salaries, school operating costs, and the needs of social and economic development. Therefore, tuition is not fixed but adjusted appropriately based on actual circumstances. Our school also regularly submits applications for fee adjustments to the Education Bureau to ensure the reasonableness and transparency of the costs. Additionally, to assist students from families with financial difficulties, the school usually offers various financial aid options such as scholarships, grants, and student loans. Parents can inquire with the school to learn about specific application conditions and procedures to secure necessary financial support for their children. At the same time, the school encourages parents to explore other ways to alleviate financial burdens, such as participating in volunteer activities organized by the school. This not only provides practical experience for the children but may also help reduce some costs. In summary, tuition is determined by multiple factors. We understand parents' concerns about education costs but hope they can understand and support the school's decisions. The school will do its best to provide students with high-quality educational resources and services. We will also actively seek various possible solutions to help more families reduce their burdens and ensure every child receives a quality education.

Title: Tan Jiao Jian Yi Fu Zi [2018] No. 28 (Category A) Content: Tan Jiao Jian Yi Fu Zi [2018] No. 28 (Category A) Reply to Suggestion No. 152D239 from the Second Session of the 15th Xiangtan Municipal People's Congress Dear Representative Liu Jinling: Greetings! We have received your suggestion titled 'Accelerate Road Surface Hardening and Improve Safety Facilities' and hereby reply as follows: Since the '13th Five-Year Plan' period, 80% of the provincial rural road construction plan funds have been allocated to the Greater Western Hunan region. The development of rural roads will fully implement the development philosophy of 'innovation, coordination, green, open, and sharing,' achieve the goal of 'three improvements and one coverage,' and comprehensively carry out the 'Four Good Rural Roads' initiative. In 2018, our city adhered to the simultaneous advancement of road construction, maintenance, management, service, and safety, focusing on building a modern highway maintenance management system, and collaboratively promoted reform攻坚, maintenance transformation, management upgrading, and service quality improvement to drive the transformational development of highway maintenance management. First, comprehensively build 'Four Good Rural Roads.' Aiming to 'build, manage, maintain, and operate' rural roads well, we formulated the 'Xiangtan City Rural Road Medium and Long-Term Development Construction Plan (2018-2030),' developed and implemented supervision plans for 'Four Good Rural Roads' construction from the city to county and county to township levels, strictly implemented county and township-level primary responsibilities, worked to补齐交通'短板' in贫困村, upgraded county and township road grades, and carried out initiatives to create 'Civilized Demonstration Roads,' 'Demonstration Townships,' and 'Demonstration Counties' to comprehensively improve the density and service level of rural roads. Integrating technological means, we achieved scientific, standardized, and informatized condition survey and evaluation of rural roads. One provincial-level 'Four Good Rural Roads' demonstration county was created. Second, solidly handle民生实事. We strengthened task progress scheduling and increased supervision and inspection efforts to ensure the successful completion of provincial and municipal practical projects and targeted poverty alleviation work. We fully launched rural road congestion alleviation and smooth flow projects, implemented measures such as adding passing bays, widening narrow roads, renovating dangerous bridges, safety projects, industrial roads, and dead-end road construction, emphasized the follow-up management of practical projects, effectively enhanced the people's sense of gain, and improved road network connectivity and accessibility. Third, initiated the construction of cement (asphalt) roads connecting natural villages. Adhering to the 'Three Basics and Three Ensures,' following the model of 'provincial coordination, municipal organization, county primary responsibility, and unified construction,' we scientifically determined standards, strengthened funding guarantees, enhanced construction management, and implemented maintenance responsibilities. The construction of cement (asphalt) roads to natural villages was integrated with rural road congestion alleviation and提前规划 implementation,协同推进, ensuring the goals of project progress, quality, and integrity. In 2018, we fully completed the task of building 900 kilometers of cement (asphalt) roads to natural villages (including 135 kilometers in贫困村). Centering on the 'Rural Revitalization' strategy, we completed the quality improvement and transformation of 225 kilometers of roads for the top ten modern agricultural demonstration parks within the year; fully served the road construction for ten characteristic towns, improving the level of road traffic interconnection. Fourth, deeply promoted the 'Road Chief System.' Through reform攻坚 in the maintenance system, we established a highway management and maintenance system adapted to the modern economic system. Using informatization to promote management upgrading and marketization to promote service quality improvement, and through the separation of supervision, responsibility, and execution in highway management and maintenance work, we clarified responsibilities and ensured承诺履行 at all levels, building a work pattern with clear responsibilities, smooth information flow, and effective execution. We integrated systems for routine maintenance, road administration management, and major hazard reporting into the 'Road Chief System' for统筹管理. Using routine maintenance and preventive maintenance as抓手, we carried out 'precision maintenance.' For national and provincial trunk lines, we strengthened the assessment of the 'Six Rates' to achieve the 'Seven Nos' maintenance goal. We ensured that minor repairs covered over 95% of the maintained mileage and preventive maintenance covered over 5% of the maintained mileage. We properly handled the接管 of trunk highways from the '11th Five-Year Plan' and '12th Five-Year Plan' periods. We completed 289.3 kilometers of rural road safety projects, 170 kilometers of major and medium repairs, with a project qualification rate of 100% and a project excellence rate of no less than 85%. We created 17 civilized demonstration roads. Based on 30% of the total maintained cement concrete pavement mileage within the jurisdiction (1485 kilometers), we performed joint sealing and minor repair maintenance. The year-end中等路率 (PQI) for rural roads reached 86.5%, and the greening rate reached 86%. We improved the rural road maintenance system, strictly implemented supporting maintenance funds,健全了乡镇农村公路建设管养机构, implemented a three-level maintenance model, ensured a 100% rural road maintenance rate, and achieved routine maintenance rates of 100%, 85%, and 75% for county, township, and village roads respectively. We strengthened road environment management to achieve clean, beautiful, and comfortable environments on both sides and surrounding areas of roads; standardized the management of advertisement boards on national and provincial trunk lines, continued清理 actions such as non-highway signs and 'roadside markets,' and strived to meet the 'Eight Nos' requirements. Regarding your suggestion to accelerate road surface hardening and improve safety facilities, after on-site inspection, and despite our bureau's very tight budget, we have agreed to provide a certain amount of financial subsidy for road surface hardening and safety facility construction in Yongfeng Village, Dongjiao Township, Xiangxiang City. Please urge the local government and villagers, following the principle of rural road construction of 'labor self-provided, funds self-raised, land self-adjusted, seedlings self-relocated, compensation self-borne, conflicts self-resolved,' to guide our farmer brothers to voluntarily, independently, and self-reliantly build roads to prosperity. We sincerely request your continued concern and support for our work.
